title: Deterministic Evidence for Enterprise Data Transformations
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Deterministic Evidence for Enterprise Data Transformations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are the founders of VeriConsole, Inc., whose platform is presented in Section 10 as a reference implementation of the architectural framework described in this paper. The paper is intended as a vendor-neutral position paper; the proposed framework is designed to be implementation-independent, and its central claims (Sections 1–9, 11–14) do not depend on VeriConsole's existence.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was independently funded by the authors.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems inherit the trustworthiness of the data they are built on, yet enterprise data typically passes through numerous transformations — extraction, cleansing, enrichment, standardization, aggregation, and integration — before reaching any model or analytical system. Existing disciplines, including data governance, data quality, data lineage, data provenance, observability, and AI governance, provide essential but distinct capabilities; none of them independently produces reproducible, independently verifiable evidence that a specific data transformation executed as intended. This paper introduces the Enterprise Data Trust Boundary (EDTB), the architectural point at which enterprise data first becomes demonstrably trustworthy through deterministic, independently verifiable evidence. It further defines Deterministic Evidence and its required scientific properties (repeatability, reproducibility, verifiability, integrity, completeness, and deterministic consistency), the Deterministic Evidence Chain (DEC) that preserves trust across successive transformations, and Continuous Trust Assurance (CTA), the mechanism that maintains trust as enterprise data, rules, schemas, and context evolve over time. The proposed framework is intentionally vendor-neutral and implementation-independent; it is positioned as complementary to, rather than a replacement for, existing governance and AI assurance disciplines. A reference implementation, VeriConsole™, is presented in Section 10 to demonstrate that the framework is realizable within an operational enterprise platform. The paper concludes by identifying explicit limitations, use cases across regulated industries, and directions for future research, including standardized evidence-pack schemas and cross-organizational trust boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业数据信任边界（EDTB）概念，即企业数据通过确定性、可独立验证的证据首次变得可证明可信的架构节点。论文定义了确定性证据及其科学属性、确定性证据链（DEC）和持续信任保障（CTA），并提供了一个参考实现VeriConsole™，以证明该框架可在实际企业平台中落地。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个架构框架，使企业数据在经历多次转换（提取、清洗、丰富化、标准化、聚合、集成）后，能够产生可复现、可独立验证的证据，从而证明特定数据转换按预期执行？
AI.motivation: 现有学科（数据治理、数据质量、数据血缘、数据溯源、可观测性和AI治理）各自提供必要但不同的能力，没有任何一个能独立产生可复现且可独立验证的证据来证明特定数据转换按预期执行，存在信任缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业数据信任边界（EDTB）、确定性证据及其科学属性（可重复性、可复现性、可验证性、完整性、完备性和确定性一致性）、确定性证据链（DEC）、持续信任保障（CTA）
AI.method: 概念框架构建与参考实现：提出理论框架，并通过参考实现（VeriConsole™）在运营中的企业平台中演示框架的可实现性。
AI.findings: EDTB框架能够定义企业数据首次变得可证明可信的架构节点；DEC能够在连续转换中保持信任；CTA能在企业数据、规则、模式和上下文演进时维持信任；VeriConsole™参考实现证明了该框架在实际企业平台中的可实现性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了企业数据信任边界的架构概念，定义了确定性证据的科学属性体系，构建了确定性证据链和持续信任保障的理论机制，弥补了现有治理学科在可验证证据方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了供应商中立、实现独立的框架，可作为现有治理和AI保障学科的补充而非替代；提供了可运行的参考实现VeriConsole™；为监管行业提供了用例和实践方向，包括标准化证据包模式和跨组织信任边界。

title: DYNAMICS-WEB: A Pre-Registered Measurement of Web Content Character over the Link Graph, and a Powered Proof that its Sub-Perceptual Half Changes Conversion
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DYNAMICS-WEB: A Pre-Registered Measurement of Web Content Character over the Link Graph, and a Powered Proof that its Sub-Perceptual Half Changes Conversion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Created with Kronaxis, my owned company
declarations.funderStatement: self funded

detail.abstract:
The web's link graph has been mined, for twenty five years, for a single quantity: authority, the standing a page holds, which PageRank and its descendants measure. This paper shows that the same graph carries more than authority, makes several of those signals public and measurable, and establishes that the deepest of them changes what a reader does without ever being consciously seen.
We report five findings. The first is a public measure of topical standing, how much authority a page holds inside a subject rather than across the web at large, computed over the whole graph and served openly. The second is a public measure of authority itself, alongside it. The third, and the centre of the paper, is character: how a page reads, across eight measured axes, with its subject and its standing held fixed, a signal that is neither authority nor topic and that no standard tool measures. Character is genuinely new, not a redescription of quality, authority reconstructing it at a coefficient of determination of 0.030 and a surface text battery at only 0.256; its axes mean what they claim, academic and government domains reading as more rigorous and less commercial than the web and commerce reading the opposite, every sign as convergent validity predicts, and the contrast holds when the model reads Arabic, Chinese and Swahili directly.
The fourth finding is that character propagates through links exactly as authority does, a domain's character correlating with its neighbours' at around 0.4 per axis against a permutation null of zero, and that propagation is a general method rather than a character trick: geographic relevance, a domain's membership of a country, flows through the same graph in the same way, and forty six European countries are produced from one procedure. Link propagation, not character alone, is the reusable engine.

AI.tldr: 本文证明网页链接图不仅能挖掘"权威性"（如PageRank所衡量），还能提取更多信号。文章提出了三个公开可测量的指标：主题权威性（特定主题内的权威）、权威性本身，以及文章核心——"性格"（character），即网页在八个维度上的阅读风格特征，与主题和权威性无关。文章还发现性格像权威性一样通过链接传播，且这种链接传播是一种通用方法，可应用于地理相关性等任务。
AI.research_question: 网页链接图中除了权威性之外还蕴含哪些信号？如何公开测量这些信号？其中最深层的信号（性格）如何影响读者行为而不被察觉？
AI.motivation: 过去25年，网页链接图一直被用来衡量单一量——权威性（PageRank及其衍生算法）。作者试图证明同一张图蕴含更多信息，揭示并公开测量这些信号，特别是此前未被标准工具衡量的"性格"维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于链接图分析理论，包括：权威性传播理论（PageRank家族）、主题权威性理论、以及本文新提出的"性格"概念——一种与主题和权威正交的页面阅读风格信号，以及链接传播作为通用方法学的理论。
AI.method: 在全量网页链接图上计算主题权威性和权威性两个公开指标；提出八维"性格"衡量体系（固定主题与权威性后测量页面阅读风格）；通过置换检验验证性格的独特性（与权威性决定系数仅0.030，与表层文本仅0.256）；通过交叉语言验证（阿拉伯语、中文、斯瓦希里语）；通过链接邻居相关性和置换零假设检验性格的传播性；将链接传播方法扩展到地理相关性任务（从同一程序生成46个欧洲国家）。
AI.findings: 五个发现：1）公开的主题权威性指标；2）公开的权威性指标；3）核心发现——"性格"，八维页面阅读风格信号，与权威性决定系数仅0.030，与表层文本仅0.256，证明其真正新颖；性格轴的含义有效（学术和政府域名更严谨更少商业化，商业域名相反），跨语言（阿拉伯语、中文、斯瓦希里语）验证成立；4）性格通过链接传播，与邻域相关性约0.4（置换零假设为零）；5）链接传播是通用方法，地理相关性也以相同方式在图中流动，可从单一程序产出46个欧洲国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 打破"链接图只蕴含权威性"的范式假设，证明同一图谱蕴含多维信号；提出"性格"作为独立于权威和主题的第三种信号维度，并给出严格验证（低决定系数证明非重述）；确立链接传播作为通用方法学，超越性格本身，扩展到地理相关性等任务。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供公开可用的主题权威性与权威性测量工具；提供八维性格测量体系可供网站优化、内容设计参考；展示链接传播方法可推广到地理归属等实际应用中。

title: Provably Compliant Autonomous Actions: A Consensus Enforced, Dual Authority Certification Gate with Freshness Bound Per Action Proofs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Provably Compliant Autonomous Actions: A Consensus Enforced, Dual Authority Certification Gate with Freshness Bound Per Action Proofs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I own Kronaxis Limited
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded

detail.abstract: Autonomous artificial intelligence agents and automated pipelines increasingly take real world actions in regulated industries: outbound calls, written communications, transactional commitments, regulated data disclosures. The operating organisation must be able to prove, after the fact and to a regulator or counterparty, that each such action conformed to the applicable rules. Existing answers either trust the operator (centralised audit logs, application layer policy gateways) or fail to bind the proof to the action at consensus time (single authority on chain attestations, transparency logs without policy co residency). We present a method by which an autonomous action is made structurally incapable of execution unless, at the moment of admission and on a distributed ledger substrate, it carries valid role typed attestations from a regulator aligned certifier and from the tenant's own controlled certifier, against a deterministically composed ruleset whose version is currently active for that tenant, within an open validity window. The consensus rule of the ledger refuses to admit any action lacking these bindings. We define six gate invariants (three decision time: non bypass, hash binding, composed policy admissibility; three holding over time: refusal code completeness and soundness, consensus time non admit, and freshness bound temporal admissibility) and demonstrate a four validator Byzantine fault tolerant reference embodiment in which the structural invariants reproduce across 26 scenarios. We evaluate adversarial robustness against three independent red teams (43 findings: 10 critical, 12 high, 13 medium, 8 low) and benchmark the augmenting large language model evaluator at 98.86% joint label accuracy and 99.16% refusal precision and recall on n=700. The freshness binding invariant closes the gap between compliant at decision and compliant at action and provides a formal answer to the practical question "verify a subject is not self excluded without a real time lookup". The paper publishes the concept; the production codebase, the on the wire protocols, the canonicalisation rule, the rule pack content, the operating numbers, and the deployment topology remain Kronaxis Limited trade secret.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于分布式账本的结构性约束方法，使自主AI代理在受监管行业中执行的每项行动，必须在共识时刻携带来自监管对齐认证方和租户自有认证方的角色类型化证明，以及当前活跃的确定性合成规则集，否则账本共识规则将拒绝该行动进入。通过六个门不变量保证合规性在决策与执行之间的绑定。
AI.research_question: 如何在分布式账本上使自主AI代理的每次行动在结构上不可能绕过合规证明，从而在事后向监管机构证明行动合规？
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在受监管行业中日益承担实际动作（外呼、书面通信、交易承诺、数据披露），但现有方案要么信任运营商（集中式审计日志、应用层策略网关），要么无法在共识时刻将证明绑定到行动（单一权威链上证明、无策略共驻的透明度日志），缺乏结构性约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式账本共识规则、角色类型化认证（regulator-aligned certifier与tenant-controlled certifier双认证）、确定性合成规则集、六个门不变量（三个决策时：非绕过、哈希绑定、合成策略可接纳性；三个持有期：拒绝代码完整性与健全性、共识时非接纳、新鲜度约束时间可接纳性）、拜占庭容错（BFT）。
AI.method: 提出六门不变量框架；构建四个验证节点的拜占庭容错参考实现；在26个场景中验证结构性不变量；通过三个独立红队进行对抗鲁棒性评估（43项发现：10严重、12高、13中、8低）；使用增强型大语言模型评估器进行基准测试（n=700，联合标签准确率98.86%，拒绝精度和召回率99.16%）。
AI.findings: 四个验证节点的BFT参考实现在26个场景中重现了结构性不变量；对抗鲁棒性评估中发现43项发现（10严重、12高、13中、8低）；LLM评估器在n=700上达到98.86%联合标签准确率和99.16%拒绝精度与召回率。新鲜度绑定不变量弥合了"决策时合规"与"执行时合规"之间的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出六个门不变量形式化框架，将合规证明从"事后审计"转向"共识时刻结构性绑定"；引入"新鲜度绑定"概念，从理论上回答"无需实时查询即可验证主体未被自我排除"的实际问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管行业中的自主AI代理提供可在结构上防止不合规行动执行的分布式账本方案；以实证数据（26场景、43红队发现、99%+评估精度）验证方案的有效性；为监管合规审计提供可证明的行动轨迹。

title: Zero-Cost Sovereign Computing: A 10-Node Heterogeneous Cluster Using Headscale, Cloudflare Tunnels, and Oracle Always-Free Tier

detail.title: Zero-Cost Sovereign Computing: A 10-Node Heterogeneous Cluster Using Headscale, Cloudflare Tunnels, and Oracle Always-Free Tier

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates the Lala City infrastructure described in this paper and has a commercial interest in promoting sovereignty-oriented compute patterns.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All infrastructure was operated on personal/self-funded resources.

detail.abstract: Institutional computing resources are unevenly distributed, and commercial cloud costs create a structural barrier for independent researchers, small manufacturers, and individual practitioners who nonetheless require capable compute for AI workloads, knowledge-graph systems, and persistent services. We present Lala City, a 10-node heterogeneous compute cluster whose measured recurring subscription fees to cloud providers, SaaS vendors, and network services total approximately ₹300/month (≈USD 3.60/month), composed of recycled consumer hardware, enterprise servers acquired secondhand, a consumer WiFi router upgraded to OpenWrt and treated as a first-class mesh node, an ARM64 smartphone converted into a Linux server, and two Oracle Always-Free-Tier virtual machines. We explicitly do not account for electricity, hardware amortization, or operator labor, none of which have been instrumented; Section 4 makes the scope of the cost claim precise. Nodes are stitched together by a self-hosted Headscale (v0.28) control plane, published selectively via Cloudflare Tunnels, and exposed as a federation of seven Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The architecture is deliberately minimal: no Kubernetes control plane, no commercial observability stack, no paid managed services. We describe the topology, authentication model, service mesh, and practical gotchas encountered over ~14 months of continuous operation (Feb 2025-Apr 2026), and argue that this design is a viable pattern for sovereign-first personal and small-organization compute. We release a complete reference configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Lala City，一个由10个异构节点组成的计算集群，通过回收消费级硬件、二手企业服务器、改装路由器、转换的ARM64智能手机和免费云VM搭建，总订阅成本约每月300卢比（约3.6美元），并自托管Headscale控制平面和七个MCP服务器，论证了主权优先的个人和小型组织计算模式的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何以极低的经济成本构建一个可用的异构计算集群，以满足独立研究者、小型制造商和个人从业者的人工智能工作负载、知识图谱系统和持久服务需求？
AI.motivation: 机构计算资源分布不均，商业云成本对独立研究者、小型制造商和个人从业者构成结构性壁垒，阻碍了他们获得AI工作负载等所需的计算能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权优先计算（sovereign-first computing）、异构集群架构、Model Context Protocol（MCP）联邦服务模型、最小化基础设施设计原则
AI.method: 设计并部署一个10节点异构计算集群（Lala City），包含回收消费硬件、二手企业服务器、OpenWrt改装路由器、ARM64智能手机转换的Linux服务器及Oracle免费VM，通过自托管Headscale控制平面和Cloudflare Tunnels进行网络编排，运行约14个月并记录实际运维经验。
AI.findings: 该集群在约3.6美元/月的订阅成本下可持续运行14个月，验证了无需Kubernetes控制平面、商业观测栈或付费托管服务的极简架构可以作为主权优先的个人和小型组织计算的有效模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"主权优先计算"的具体实现模式，展示了异构、回收硬件与免费云资源混合部署的可行性，为去中心化基础设施研究提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了完整的参考配置，为独立研究者和小型组织提供了低成本异构集群搭建的实践指南，包括拓扑、认证模型、服务网格和运营中的实际"坑"（gotchas）。

title: A Survey and Tutorial on AI-Native Network Operating Systems for 6G Communication Networks: Architectures, Control Loops, Memory, and Governed Autonomy
affiliations: , Celona Inc. and Chongqing University

detail.title: A Survey and Tutorial on AI-Native Network Operating Systems for 6G Communication Networks: Architectures, Control Loops, Memory, and Governed Autonomy
detail.abstract: 6G communication networks will require coordinated control of radio access, core functions, transport paths, network slices, mobility procedures, service chains, edge workloads, telemetry pipelines, and security functions across heterogeneous programmable domains. The central problem is therefore not generic AI governance; it is how to operate communication networks whose control surfaces can be observed, reasoned about, modified, verified, rolled back, and improved by AI-assisted systems while preserving latency, reliability, throughput, reachability, isolation, availability, and energy constraints. This paper surveys and provides tutorial guidance on AI-Native Network Operating Systems (AI-NOS): a governed management abstraction for AI-native 6G communication-network management and control. We synthesize prior work on self-organizing cellular networks, zero-touch management, intent-based networking, SDN/NFV, O-RAN, network digital twins, LLMs/LAMs, autonomous network management, and trustworthy network automation. We define AI-NOS primitives, propose a reference architecture, introduce a dual feedback-loop model for operational network control and slower management-system improvement, specify networkmemory and generated-artifact lifecycles, map the architecture to RAN, core, transport, edge/cloud, SDN/NFV, slicing, service assurance, and orchestration platforms, and identify deployment, benchmarking, hardware, memory, energy, security, and open research challenges. The central claim is that AI-native 6G communication networks require an operating-system abstraction for network intelligence, with verification kernels and staged authority rather than unconstrained LLM control.

AI.tldr: 本文对AI原生网络操作系统（AI-NOS）进行了综述和教程式指导，提出了一种用于AI原生6G通信网络管理与控制的治理型管理抽象，并定义了其原语、参考架构、双反馈回路模型及生命周期管理。
AI.research_question: 如何为AI原生6G通信网络设计一种操作系统级抽象，使其能够在满足延迟、可靠性、吞吐量、可达性、隔离性、可用性和能耗约束的同时，实现AI辅助系统对网络控制面的观察、推理、修改、验证、回滚和改进？
AI.motivation: 6G通信网络需要在异构可编程域中协调控制无线接入、核心功能、传输路径、网络切片、移动性流程、服务链、边缘工作负载、遥测管道和安全功能，而核心问题不是通用AI治理，而是如何运营控制面可被AI辅助系统观察和操控的通信网络，同时保持严格的性能与安全约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合了自组织蜂窝网络（SON）、零接触管理（ZSM）、意图驱动网络（IBN）、SDN/NFV、O-RAN、网络数字孪生、LLM/LAM、自主网络管理和可信网络自动化等领域的既有研究。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析方法，提出AI-NOS原语定义、参考架构设计、双反馈回路模型、网络记忆与生成工件生命周期管理，并将架构映射到RAN、核心网、传输网、边缘/云、SDN/NFV、切片、服务保障和编排平台。
AI.findings: AI原生6G通信网络需要一个针对网络智能的操作系统抽象，该抽象应包含验证内核（verification kernels）和分阶段授权（staged authority），而非不受约束的LLM直接控制。研究还识别了部署、基准测试、硬件、内存、能耗、安全等方面的开放研究挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI-NOS这一新的管理抽象概念框架，建立了双反馈回路模型以区分运营控制与管理改进，定义了网络记忆和生成工件生命周期等概念，为AI原生网络管理提供了系统的理论架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为6G网络运营商和研究者提供了AI-NOS的参考架构和实施路径，映射了各网络域（RAN、核心、传输、边缘等）的应用场景，并指出了部署、硬件、能耗、安全等实际挑战及研究方向。

title: Decision Intelligence: A Business-Oriented Framework for Transforming Business Intelligence into Measurable Business Value

detail.title: Decision Intelligence: A Business-Oriented Framework for Transforming Business Intelligence into Measurable Business Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This conceptual study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Business Intelligence (BI) has become an essential capability for organizations seeking to transform data into insight, improve managerial visibility, and support evidencebased decision-making. However, many BI initiatives remain limited to dashboards, reports, descriptive analytics, and historical performance monitoring. While these capabilities are valuable, they often do not fully address a more important managerial question: how can organizations transform analytical insight into decisions that create measurable business value? This paper proposes a business-centric Decision Intelligence framework that extends traditional Business Intelligence by integrating Artificial Intelligence, business value evaluation, decision confidence, and practical software implementation principles. The proposed framework is designed for business and management contexts while maintaining a realistic software implementation perspective. Rather than treating AI prediction accuracy as the final objective, the framework argues that organizations should optimize decision value, business outcomes, and managerial usefulness. The paper uses smart energy management as an application context to illustrate how the framework can support both consumer-level and utility-level decisions. In this context, BI can identify energy consumption patterns, AI can forecast demand and detect anomalies, and Decision Intelligence can recommend actions such as shifting consumption, reducing peak demand, improving cost efficiency, and supporting sustainability goals. The software architecture is presented as an enabling layer rather than the central contribution, showing that the proposed business framework can be realistically implemented using data pipelines, time-series databases, analytical services, recommendation logic, and dashboard interfaces. The main contribution of this paper is a focused business-oriented framework for transforming BI from an insight-reporting capability into a value-driven decision-making capability. The paper contributes to the literature on Business Intelligence, AI-driven business value, decision support, and digital transformation by proposing a practical pathway from data to insight, from insight to decision, and from decision to measurable business value. The proposed framework is intended as a conceptual artifact developed using a Design Science Research approach and provides a foundation for future empirical Decision Intelligence research

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个以业务为中心的决策智能（Decision Intelligence）框架，将传统商业智能（BI）与人工智能、业务价值评估、决策置信度和软件实现原则相结合，帮助组织将分析洞察转化为可衡量的业务价值。框架以智能能源管理为应用情境说明其可行性，主张优化决策价值而非仅追求AI预测精度。
AI.research_question: 组织如何将商业智能的分析洞察转化为能够创造可衡量业务价值的决策？即如何从"洞察报告"的BI向"价值驱动"的决策智能演进？
AI.motivation: 传统商业智能多局限于仪表盘、报表、描述性分析和历史绩效监控，虽然有价值，但未能充分回答一个更重要的管理问题：如何将分析洞察转化为创造可衡量业务价值的决策。现有框架缺乏对决策价值、业务结果和管理效用的整合优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以设计科学研究（Design Science Research）为方法论基础，整合商业智能、人工智能驱动的业务价值、决策支持系统和数字化转型等理论领域。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法开发概念性框架，以智能能源管理作为应用情境，通过消费者层面和公用事业层面的决策案例进行说明；软件架构采用数据管道、时序数据库、分析服务、推荐逻辑和仪表盘界面作为实现层。
AI.findings: 该框架展示了BI如何识别能源消费模式，AI如何预测需求并检测异常，决策智能如何推荐行动（如转移消费、降低峰值需求、提升成本效率、支持可持续发展目标）。软件架构作为使能层被证明可以实际实现该业务框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 为商业智能、AI驱动的业务价值、决策支持和数字化转型文献贡献了一个以业务为导向的框架，提出从数据到洞察、从洞察到决策、从决策到可衡量业务价值的实践路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了从洞察报告型BI转变为价值驱动型决策能力的聚焦业务框架，并通过智能能源管理场景展示了消费者级和公用事业级决策的实际应用，为组织实现决策智能化提供了可操作的实施路径。

title: A New Economic Model in the Age of AI: A Prelude to Economics in the Age of AI

detail.title: A New Economic Model in the Age of AI: A Prelude to Economics in the Age of AI

The Human Intelligence Unit is an independent research unit operating within The State of the Mind, a publication founded and owned by the author. No external funding was received for this research. The paper was produced entirely independently and no organisation, institution, corporation, or individual with a financial interest in its subject matter has had any influence over its content, findings, or conclusions.

It does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, surveys, interviews, or any form of primary data collection from individuals. No ethics approval is required. All costs associated with the research and production of this paper were borne by the author personally. No grant, fellowship, contract, or institutional funding of any kind was received.

detail.abstract:
This paper is a prelude to a longer work, Economics in the Age of AI, and states in compressed form the argument that work develops at length. Its central claim is deliberately bounded. It does not present a completed alternative economic model, and it holds that no paper of this length could responsibly do so. It argues instead that the intellectual and technological conditions for constructing such a model now exist in a configuration that has not previously obtained, and it specifies the requirements any such model would need to satisfy.

The argument proceeds in three movements: first, that the discipline of economics rests on a category error, long identified but never resolved, in which historically constructed institutional arrangements are presented with the epistemic authority of natural law; second, that artificial intelligence alters the practicality, though not the desirability, of alternatives that earlier critics proposed and could not implement; and third, that six propositions, each stated alongside its strongest counter-argument, define the design requirements of a genuinely reconstructed economics.

The paper draws on institutional evidence from Ostrom's Nobel Prize-winning governance research, the Stiglitz-Sen-Fitoussi Commission's measurement proposals, Acemoglu and Restrepo's empirical work on so-so automation, and operational instances including the Anker Living Wage methodology and the ILO Better Work programme's digital monitoring systems. The paper makes no claim to have built a new economics. It claims only that the building has become possible, and states what it would require.

AI.tldr: 本文是《AI时代的经济学》长篇工作的序章，核心论点是有界限的：不提供完整的经济模型，而是论证构建这样一个模型的知识与技术条件现在首次具备，并阐明任何此类模型需满足的设计要求。
AI.research_question: 构建一个真正重构的经济学模型所需的智识与技术条件是否已经具备？这样的模型需要满足哪些设计要求？
AI.motivation: 经济学学科建立在历史性建构的制度安排被赋予自然法则性认知权威的范畴错误之上，这一问题长期被识别但从未解决；人工智能的出现改变了替代方案的可行性，使得经济学重构成为可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学传统，引用Ostrom的治理研究、Stiglitz-Sen-Fitoussi委员会的测量建议、Acemoglu和Restrepo关于"平庸自动化"的实证研究，以及Anker生活工资方法论和ILO Better Work项目的数字监控系统等制度证据。
AI.method: 论述性/理论性方法，通过三个论证步骤推进：识别经济学的范畴错误、论证AI改变替代方案可行性、提出六项设计命题及各自的最强反论证。
AI.findings: 构建新经济学的知识和技术条件现在首次以先前不存在的配置方式具备；论文提出了六项命题作为经济学重构的设计要求，每项命题均与最强反论证并列陈述。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济学分类错误问题与AI技术条件联系起来，明确界定了新经济学模型必须满足的设计要求清单，为后续长篇工作奠定理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 汇集了Ostrom治理研究、生活工资测量方法、ILO数字监控系统等实际制度案例，为经济学重构提供可操作的制度证据和技术路径参考。

title: A Delegation Engine for Assembling Intellectual Ability

detail.title: A Delegation Engine for Assembling Intellectual Ability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Almma.AI. This paper is conceptual and presents no empirical results; the views expressed are the author's own.

detail.abstract: This paper positions AlmmaGPT as a platform designed to assemble intellectual ability from both benchmarked and unbenchmarked capabilities. Rather than competing at the model level, the platform integrates delegation, memory, persona, and governance into a coherent execution layer. The paper articulates a platform thesis grounded in system design rather than algorithmic novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AlmmaGPT平台，旨在整合基准测试能力和未基准测试能力，通过委托、记忆、角色和治理等组件构建统一的执行层，强调系统设计而非算法创新。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够整合多种智能能力的平台，而非在模型层面进行竞争？
AI.motivation: 当前AI领域过度集中于模型层面的竞争，忽视了通过系统设计来整合不同类型智能能力的平台化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台理论（Platform Thesis）、系统设计理论
AI.method: 系统设计与架构方法，通过集成委托（delegation）、记忆（memory）、角色（persona）和治理（governance）四个核心组件构建执行层。
AI.findings: AlmmaGPT作为一个平台，能够整合基准测试和未基准测试的能力，形成一个连贯的执行层，而非在模型层面进行竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI研究视角从模型层面的算法竞争转向平台层面的系统设计，提出了"平台论点"作为新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用的平台架构方案，通过委托、记忆、角色和治理四个组件实现智能能力的整合与治理。

title: Technology Sovereignty and the Digital Dependency Crisis: A Critical Analysis of the United Kingdom's Structural Reliance on United States Technology Infrastructure
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Technology Sovereignty and the Digital Dependency Crisis: A Critical Analysis of the United Kingdom's Structural Reliance on United States Technology Infrastructure

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a policy analysis and literature review based entirely on publicly available data, published reports and secondary sources. No human participants, patients, personal data or primary empirical research involving individuals were involved in this study. Accordingly, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Orion Global Consulting OGC Ltd This research was self-funded by the author through Orion Global Consulting Ltd, an independent AI-first marketing and business strategy consultancy based in Richmond, London, United Kingdom. No external funding, grants or institutional sponsorship were received. The views expressed are those of the author alone and do not represent any third party.

detail.abstract: The United Kingdom's digital economy is characterised by a profound and largely unexamined structural dependency on United States-headquartered technology platforms. This paper analyses the economic, legal and strategic implications of this dependency, drawing on data from McKinsey Global Institute, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Gartner Research, Statista and the UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT). The analysis demonstrates that the UK spends approximately £47 billion annually on US cloud services (Gartner, 2024), with 78% of UK businesses operating on US-headquartered software-as-a-service (SaaS) platforms (Statista, 2024). Against this backdrop, McKinsey (2024) estimates that artificial intelligence could contribute £400 billion to UK GDP by 2030, while BCG (2024) finds that sovereign AI infrastructure generates three times the domestic economic value of imported AI. The paper argues that the UK's current trajectory represents a structural failure of technology policy, with significant implications for national security, economic sovereignty and long-term competitiveness. Drawing on comparative analysis of French, German and European Union sovereign technology strategies, the paper concludes with a framework of four policy interventions required to transition the UK from technology client state to technology sovereign nation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国数字经济对美国科技平台的深度结构性依赖，利用McKinsey、BCG、Gartner、Statista及英国DSIT等多方数据，论证英国每年在美云服务上支出约470亿英镑、78%企业依赖美国SaaS平台。文章认为这构成结构性技术政策失败，对国家安全生产、经济主权和长期竞争力有重大影响，并通过与法国、德国和欧盟主权技术战略的对比分析，提出四项政策干预建议，推动英国从"技术客户国"向"技术主权国"转型。
AI.research_question: 英国数字经济对美国总部科技平台的结构性依赖具有怎样的经济、法律和战略影响？英国应如何通过政策干预实现从技术客户国到技术主权国的转型？
AI.motivation: 英国数字经济对美国科技平台的依赖程度十分深刻且在很大程度上未被充分研究，这种依赖涉及国家安全生产、经济主权和长期竞争力等关键问题，但目前缺乏系统性的分析框架和解决路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术主权理论、技术政策分析框架、基于多来源数据的实证分析、跨国比较分析（法国、德国和欧盟）
AI.method: 基于McKinsey Global Institute、Boston Consulting Group (BCG)、Gartner Research、Statista和英国数字科技创新部(DSIT)等多方数据来源的实证分析，并进行法国、德国和欧盟主权技术战略的比较分析。
AI.findings: (1) 英国每年在美云服务上支出约470亿英镑；(2) 78%的英国企业在以美国为总部的SaaS平台上运营；(3) McKinsey估计AI到2030年可为英国GDP贡献4000亿英镑；(4) BCG发现主权AI基础设施产生的国内经济价值是进口AI的三倍；(5) 英国当前技术发展轨迹构成结构性技术政策失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地揭示和论证了英国数字经济对美国科技平台的深度结构性依赖及其经济、法律和战略影响，填补了该领域研究的空白；提出"技术客户国"到"技术主权国"的转型分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 基于法国、德国和欧盟主权技术战略的比较分析，提出四项具体的政策干预措施，为英国政府、政策制定者和产业界提供从技术依赖走向技术主权的行动路线图；为AI基础设施投资和数字经济发展提供决策参考。

title: How AI Is Transforming Code Review and Refactoring in Software Development: A Reproducible Empirical Evaluation of Code Quality Improvement in GitHub Repositories
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands (formerly Cumberland College)

detail.title: How AI Is Transforming Code Review and Refactoring in Software Development: A Reproducible Empirical Evaluation of Code Quality Improvement in GitHub Repositories
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for code generation, automated review, defect detection, and refactoring, yet evidence remains divided on whether such assistance improves enduring software quality or primarily accelerates production. This study specifies a reproducible empirical evaluation of artificial intelligence-assisted refactoring using production code from licensed public Python repositories on GitHub. A repeated measures design will compare each source code unit before and after a standardized model intervention. Functional preservation will be evaluated through the repositories’ existing automated tests. At the same time, maintainability index, cyclomatic complexity, source lines of code, linting violations, code smells, and security findings will provide complementary quality measures. The study introduces the Artificial Intelligence Refactoring Quality Evaluation Framework, which integrates repository selection, baseline characterization, controlled prompting, functional verification, static analysis, and paired statistical inference. Failed transformations, test regressions, nonexecuting outputs, and unfavorable quality tradeoffs will remain in the analytical dataset to prevent survivorship bias. By extending earlier conceptual research into a transparent repository grounded investigation, the study seeks to identify the conditions under which artificial intelligence improves maintainability without compromising correctness, security, or traceability. A public replication package will support independent verification, model comparison, cross-language extension, and future longitudinal evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一项可复现的实证评估框架（AI Refactoring Quality Evaluation Framework），通过对GitHub上公开Python仓库的生产代码进行标准化AI辅助重构干预，使用重复测量设计对比重构前后代码质量指标（可维护性、圈复杂度、代码行数、lint违规、代码异味、安全发现），并保留失败案例以防止幸存者偏差，旨在识别AI改善可维护性而不损害正确性、安全性和可追溯性的条件。
AI.research_question: 人工智能辅助代码重构是否真正改善软件长期质量（如可维护性），还是仅加速生产？在什么条件下AI能在不损害正确性、安全性和可追溯性的前提下提升可维护性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI辅助代码生成、审查、缺陷检测和重构能否提升软件长期质量尚未得出一致结论，证据存在分歧，缺乏系统性的可复现实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于软件质量度量理论，整合可维护性指数（MI）、圈复杂度（Cyclomatic Complexity）、源码行数（SLOC）、lint违规、代码异味和安全发现等多维度质量指标体系，并结合重复测量实验设计和配对统计推断。
AI.method: 采用重复测量设计（repeated measures design），对来自GitHub上已授权公开Python仓库的生产代码进行标准化模型干预前后的对比评估。具体包括：仓库筛选、基线特征描述、受控提示、功能验证（利用现有自动化测试）、静态分析、配对统计推断。框架完整纳入失败转换、测试回归、非执行输出和不利质量权衡等案例以防止幸存者偏差。
AI.findings: 该论文为研究方案（protocol/study design），尚未报告最终实证结果。预期产出包括：AI辅助重构对可维护性影响的条件性发现，以及一套公开可用的复制包用于独立验证和模型比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 将先前概念性研究扩展为透明的、基于实际代码仓库的实证调查，提出可复现的AI重构质量评估框架（A.I. Refactoring Quality Evaluation Framework），为AI辅助软件开发质量研究提供方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供公开复制包支持独立验证、模型比较、跨语言扩展和纵向评估，帮助实践者在实际项目中识别AI重构的有效适用条件，平衡可维护性与正确性、安全性、可追溯性。

title: Selecting Blockchain Networks for Tokenized Real-World Assets: A Systematic Review and Requirements-based Decision Framework
affiliations: and Western Sydney University

detail.title: Selecting Blockchain Networks for Tokenized Real-World Assets: A Systematic Review and Requirements-based Decision Framework
detail.abstract: Tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) are often discussed as if blockchain selection were primarily a question of transaction speed, fees, or ecosystem size. That framing is incomplete. For tokenized Treasuries, bonds, private credit, funds, equities, commodities, and real estate, the decisive issue is not whether a blockchain is technically usable, but whether the complete issuance stack can support the legal claim, compliance model, custody structure, transfer constraints, settlement design, redemption process, market access, and proof-of-backing required by the instrument. This article conducts a systematic review informed by PRISMA 2020 reporting principles. Approximately 320 potentially relevant records were identified across academic, regulatory, institutional, technical, and official market-infrastructure sources published between 2015 and July 2026. Following deduplication, relevance screening, and source-quality appraisal, 158 unique sources were retained for the final synthesis. Using Task-Technology Fit as the principal theoretical lens, the review conceptualizes tokenization as a set of tasks (i.e., issuing, managing, transferring, settling, redeeming, and governing RWAs) and evaluates fit against the capabilities of the full issuance stack. The review synthesizes five requirement dimensions and develops a two-stage decision framework. Stage 1 applies mandatory feasibility gates to exclude issuance stacks that cannot satisfy minimum legal, regulatory, operational, privacy, settlement, redemption, or proof-of-backing conditions. Stage 2 compares only feasible alternatives using qualitative criteria such as security, finality, cost, interoperability, liquidity infrastructure, stablecoin support, developer support, and operational complexity. The central conclusion is that no blockchain network is universally best for RWA tokenization; suitability is contingent on the asset, jurisdiction, structure, and supporting institutional infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文基于PRISMA 2020报告原则，对2015年至2026年7月间约320篇相关文献进行系统综述（最终保留158篇），以任务-技术适配（TTF）为理论框架，将RWA代币化概念化为发行、管理、转移、结算、赎回和治理等一系列任务，综合出五个需求维度，并提出了两阶段决策框架：第一阶段通过强制性可行性门槛排除不符合法律、监管、运营、隐私、结算、赎回或资产支持证明条件的发行堆栈；第二阶段仅对可行替代方案进行安全、终局性、成本、互操作性、流动性基础设施、稳定币支持、开发者支持和运营复杂性等定性标准比较。核心结论是：没有哪个区块链网络是RWA代币化的普适最优选择，适宜性取决于资产类型、司法管辖区、结构和配套机构基础设施。
AI.research_question: 对于代币化现实世界资产（如国债、债券、私募信贷、基金、股权、大宗商品和房地产），区块链的选择不应仅基于交易速度、费用或生态规模，那么完整的发行技术堆栈如何影响RWA代币化的适宜性？如何系统性地评估和选择适合特定RWA的区块链网络？
AI.motivation: 现有的关于RWA代币化中区块链选择的讨论过于简化，通常仅关注交易速度、费用或生态规模等技术性能指标，而忽略了法律主张、合规模型、托管结构、转让约束、结算设计、赎回流程、市场准入和资产支持证明等发行堆栈的关键维度。这种不完整的分析框架可能导致错误的区块链选择决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务-技术适配理论（Task-Technology Fit, TTF），该理论将RWA代币化概念化为一系列任务（发行、管理、转移、结算、赎回和治理RWA），并评估这些任务与完整发行堆栈能力之间的匹配度。
AI.method: 系统文献综述，遵循PRISMA 2020报告原则。从学术、监管、机构、技术和官方市场基础设施来源中检索了2015年至2026年7月间约320篇潜在相关文献，经过去重、相关性筛选和来源质量评估后，最终保留158个唯一来源进行综合。
AI.findings: 综合出五个需求维度，开发了一个两阶段决策框架：第一阶段运用强制性可行性门槛（mandatory feasibility gates）排除无法满足最低法律、监管、运营、隐私、结算、赎回或资产支持证明条件的发行堆栈；第二阶段仅对可行的替代方案进行比较，评估标准包括安全性、终局性、成本、互操作性、流动性基础设施、稳定币支持、开发者支持和运营复杂性等定性指标。核心发现是没有任何区块链网络是RWA代币化的普适最优解，适宜性取决于具体资产类型、司法管辖区、结构和配套机构基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将任务-技术适配理论首次系统性地应用于RWA代币化的区块链选择问题，将代币化重新概念化为一系列任务而非单纯的技术部署；提出了综合五个需求维度的系统框架，超越了传统的性能指标讨论；建立了包含强制性门槛和定性比较的两阶段决策框架，为区块链选择提供了结构化的理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发行者、监管者和市场参与者提供了系统性的RWA代币化区块链选择决策框架；通过强制可行性门槛，帮助实践者避免在法律、监管、运营等基础条件不满足的区块链上投入资源；开发了两阶段决策工具，可在实际操作中用于筛选和比较不同的区块链选项，支持基于资产类型、司法管辖区和机构基础设施的定制化选择。

title: From Intent Declaration to Running AI Systems in Seconds

detail.title: From Intent Declaration to Running AI Systems in Seconds

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Almma.AI. This paper is conceptual and presents no empirical results; the views expressed are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new user experience primitive: transforming a user's declared intent and persona into a functioning AI system within seconds. It argues that recent advances make this technically feasible by orchestrating existing tools rather than building new infrastructure. Drawing on technology adoption theory, platform economics, transaction cost economics, and behavioral economics, the paper frames system instantiation cost-the composite time, prerequisite knowledge, and sequential effort required to convert a declared intent into a running AI system-as the primary early-stage market-access variable governing non-technical participation in AI delegation markets. Reducing system instantiation cost below a discontinuity threshold, illustrated here by a design-derived heuristic of approximately 45 seconds, produces three simultaneous market-level effects: expansion of the total addressable market, activation of latent demand, and recomposition of the competitive service boundary. The paper argues that investment in orchestration that reduces instantiation latency has higher addressable-market leverage than equivalent investment in model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的用户体验原语：将用户声明的意图和人格在数秒内转化为可运行的AI系统。论文论证了这一技术可行性（通过编排现有工具而非构建新基础设施），并提出"系统实例化成本"（将声明意图转化为运行中AI系统所需的综合时间、先验知识和顺序努力）是决定非技术用户在AI委托市场中参与度的首要早期市场准入变量。
AI.research_question: 如何通过降低"系统实例化成本"来扩大非技术用户在AI委托市场中的参与度？以及这一成本降低对市场结构产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统部署需要较高的技术门槛和成本，阻碍了非技术用户参与。作者认为通过编排现有工具可以实现"秒级"的意图到系统的转化，从而释放大量潜在需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、平台经济学、交易成本经济学、行为经济学
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，结合设计启发式（约45秒的间断阈值）进行论证，属于概念性/理论性论文。
AI.findings: 将系统实例化成本降至间断阈值以下（约45秒），将同时产生三种市场级效应：（1）扩大总可寻址市场；（2）激活潜在需求；（3）重构竞争性服务边界。此外，投资于降低实例化延迟的编排比同等投资于模型性能具有更高的可寻址市场杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"系统实例化成本"这一新的核心构念，将其确立为AI委托市场中早期市场准入的首要变量，并整合多学科理论框架来解释用户体验原语的市场级效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI平台和系统开发者提供了明确的投资优先级指导：应将资源优先投向降低实例化延迟的编排能力而非单纯提升模型性能，并给出了约45秒的具体设计阈值参考。

title: Apertura: Toward a Theory of Intellectual Vulnerability—A Concept Paper
affiliations: and Brigham Young University - Marriott School

detail.title: Apertura: Toward a Theory of Intellectual Vulnerability—A Concept Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The empirical study associated with this research program was approved by the Brigham Young University Institutional Review Board (Approval No. 15351), with written informed consent obtained from all participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This concept paper introduces Apertura, the dispositional posture a learner brings to uncertainty, ranging from closed to open, and proposes it as the posture that determines whether learning under uncertainty deepens or is bypassed. Where existing frameworks for learner engagement describe strategies for overcoming, restructuring, or tolerating uncertainty, Apertura names the disposition that determines whether any such strategy operates generatively rather than defensively. The paper defines the construct, traces its intellectual lineage through Keats’s negative capability, and differentiates it from its nearest neighbor constructs—among them intellectual humility, openness to experience, tolerance of ambiguity, and the personal-epistemology lineage—on a conjunction of properties no single neighbor combines: a behaviorally observable state, set in problem-setting uncertainty, positioned structurally prior to the cognitive resources it organizes. Implications for education and for information systems research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"开放度（Apertura）"这一概念，指学习者面对不确定性时所持的倾向性姿态（从封闭到开放），并主张这一姿态决定了不确定性情境下的学习是深化还是被绕过。文章将Apertura与智力谦逊、经验开放性、模糊容忍度等邻近构念加以区分，并讨论了其对教育与信息系统研究的意义。
AI.research_question: 学习者在不确定性情境下的学习效果取决于何种倾向性姿态？Apertura这一构念如何界定，并与现有的邻近构念相区分？
AI.motivation: 现有学习者参与度框架描述了克服、重构或容忍不确定性的策略，但这些策略在何种条件下以生成性（generative）而非防御性（defensive）的方式运作，缺乏一个前置性解释。本文旨在提出一个决定性的"姿态"构念来填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Apertura构念的智识谱系可追溯至济慈的"消极能力（negative capability）"；并与智力谦逊、经验开放性、模糊容忍度及个人认识论谱系等邻近构念进行概念辨析。
AI.method: 概念性论文（concept paper）方法，通过概念界定、智识谱系追溯、邻近构念对比辨析（在属性组合层面加以区分），并提出多领域启示。
AI.findings: Apertura被定义为一种行为上可观察的状态，设定于问题设定（problem-setting）的不确定性中，在结构上先于其所组织的认知资源。它与其他邻近构念的区别在于：没有任何单一邻近构念同时具备上述属性组合（行为可观察、处于问题设定阶段、结构上先于认知资源）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的理论构念Apertura，将学习者面对不确定性的"姿态"概念化为决定各种应对策略能否"生成性"地运作的前置条件，填补了现有参与度框架中关于"策略何时有效"的解释空白，并为不确定性学习研究提供了新的理论定位。
AI.practical_contributions: 对教育实践提出启示（如何在教学中培养或评估学习者的开放性姿态），并对信息系统研究提出启示（如用户在不确定技术环境中的学习与适应行为）。

title: Quality Assurance After Content in Higher Education: Assessment Integrity, Signal Collapse, and the Epistemology of Verification in the Post-Content Age of Generative AI
affiliations: Anglia Ruskin University

detail.title: Quality Assurance After Content in Higher Education: Assessment Integrity, Signal Collapse, and the Epistemology of Verification in the Post-Content Age of Generative AI
detail.abstract: For a century, higher education has verified capability largely by inspecting content, and the essay, report, problem set, and dissertation stood as evidence of the mind that produced them. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) weakens that evidentiary connection. This paper analyses assessment as a problem of statistical inference about latent student capability and derives four results. First, when fluent content is available at near-zero marginal cost, a content-inspecting assessment instrument with unconstrained and undetectable delegation admits a pooling equilibrium, whereby students below the generative frontier submit artefacts of the same quality, and the signal’s overall informativeness approaches zero as that frontier approaches the upper support of capability. Second, artefact-only detection cannot provide a robust limiting solution. A total-variation bound shows that, as the distributions of human- and machine-produced artefacts converge, the maximum achievable power of a detector subject to a fixed false-positive constraint converges to that false-positive rate; remaining errors may also impose unequal burdens across linguistic and stylistic groups. Third, process-exposed instruments, including live, interactive, supervised, and provenance-supported components, restore positive capability information by constraining delegation and making the expected assessment signal responsive to capability. Their informativeness increases as additional expert judgement time reduces measurement noise. Fourth, at the post-content endpoint, the informativeness of a feasible symmetric assessment system is bounded by the institution’s available supply of expert judgement time per student. The paper then develops a design epistemology for post-content quality assurance organised around four questions, namely what is real (provenance), what is true (validity), what is provable (verifiability), and what is possible (capability inference). The generative-AI moment is therefore not principally a detection problem, but a measurement-theory and institutional-design problem requiring institutions to build provenance into assessment and provide the qualified judgement needed to verify capability at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计推断视角分析生成式AI对高等教育评估的冲击，证明内容检查型评估在AI可及时代会失效（池化均衡），并提出以过程暴露型评估和专家判断时间为核心的"后内容"评估设计理论。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何从根本上削弱基于内容检查的高等教育评估能力验证功能？在AI可及时代，应如何重新设计评估体系以维持对学生潜在能力的有效推断？
AI.motivation: 一百年来高等教育依赖检查内容（论文、报告、习题集、学位论文）来验证能力，但生成式AI以接近零边际成本产出流畅内容，切断了内容与能力之间的证据联系。现有文献多聚焦AI检测技术，但作者认为核心问题在于评估本质上是一个统计推断问题，需要从测量理论和制度设计层面重新思考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计推断理论（潜在能力推断）、博弈论（池化均衡）、信号检测理论（total-variation bound）、测量理论（信息量与信噪比）
AI.method: 理论建模与推导：构建内容检查型评估的博弈均衡模型；运用总变差界推导AI检测器的统计功效极限；分析过程暴露型评估的信息恢复机制；建立后内容时代评估系统信息量的边界条件；提出四问设计认识论框架。
AI.findings: (1)内容检查型评估在可检测的无限制委托下产生池化均衡，信号信息量趋近于零；(2)仅靠内容检测无法提供稳健的极限解决方案，检测功效收敛于假阳性率，且可能对不同语言风格群体产生不均负担；(3)过程暴露型评估（现场、互动、监督、溯源支持）通过约束委托恢复能力信息；(4)后内容时代对称评估系统的信息量受限于机构可提供的每位学生的专家判断时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将评估重新概念化为关于潜在学生能力的统计推断问题，从测量理论视角重新定义生成式AI对教育的挑战（不是检测问题而是测量与制度设计问题）；提出总变差界证明AI检测器极限局限性；建立了过程暴露型评估信息恢复的理论机制和专家判断时间约束下的信息量边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"后内容"质量保障的四问设计认识论（何为真实/溯源、何为正确/效度、何为可证/可验证性、何为可能/能力推断）；为高校重新设计评估体系提供理论指引：应将溯源内建于评估中，并提供足够的专家判断以在规模化条件下验证能力。

title: Costly Information Design in Retail Supply Chains
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Owen Graduate School of Management, Vanderbilt University - Owen Graduate School of Management and Vanderbilt University - Operations Management

detail.title: Costly Information Design in Retail Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Retailers increasingly use advanced information systems to control the granularity of demand-relevant information they share with suppliers. Although such systems can reduce supply-demand mismatches, they are costly to operate and their value may depend on a retailer's revenue model (i.e., sales mode). To examine how information costs and sales mode shape information design, we formulate the retailer's information acquisition and disclosure policy as a costly persuasion problem. We study two common sales modes: wholesale, under which the supplier sets the wholesale price and the retailer sets the retail price, and agency, under which the supplier sets the retail price and pays the retailer a commission. Our analysis reveals both commonalities and differences across modes. Under both modes, full disclosure is optimal when information costs are low, and the retailer switches to coarser disclosure policies as information becomes more costly. When information costs are high enough, the retailer stops disclosing information under wholesale but sustains coarse disclosure under agency. We also show that sales mode affects the value of information for the retailer. Wholesale can generate greater value when information costs are low and agency commission rates fall within commonly observed ranges, whereas agency can generate greater value when information costs are high. The retailer's information design policy can also benefit suppliers and consumers. Overall, our findings imply that retailers should tailor information granularity to the sales mode and information cost and that information design can create supply chain value rather than merely shift surplus to retailers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零售商在信息成本约束下如何设计信息获取与披露策略，比较了批发模式和代理模式两种销售模式下的最优信息设计，发现信息成本低时完全披露最优，成本高时批发模式下停止披露而代理模式下维持粗披露，且信息设计能为供应链创造价值。
AI.research_question: 信息成本和销售模式如何共同影响零售商的信息获取与披露政策设计？
AI.motivation: 零售商越来越多地使用先进信息系统来控制与供应商共享的需求信息的粒度，但这些系统成本高昂，且其价值可能取决于零售商的收入模式（销售模式）。现有研究缺乏对信息成本与销售模式如何共同塑造信息设计的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代价说服（costly persuasion）理论
AI.method: 构建零售商信息获取与披露政策为代价说服问题的数学模型，分别分析批发模式（供应商设定批发价、零售商设定零售价）和代理模式（供应商设定零售价、零售商获得佣金）两种销售模式。
AI.findings: （1）两种模式下，信息成本低时完全披露最优，信息成本增加时转向更粗的披露政策；（2）信息成本足够高时，批发模式下零售商停止披露，但代理模式下仍维持粗披露；（3）销售模式影响信息价值：信息成本低且代理佣金率在常见范围内时批发模式产生更大价值，信息成本高时代理模式产生更大价值；（4）零售商的信息设计政策也能使供应商和消费者受益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代价说服理论应用于供应链信息设计场景，揭示了销售模式（批发vs代理）对信息获取与披露策略的系统性影响，拓展了信息设计理论在供应链管理中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供信息粒度设计的管理启示：应根据销售模式和信息成本调整信息粒度；表明信息设计能创造供应链整体价值而非仅仅是零售商转移盈余的手段。

title: Renew the Group, Reuse the Pair: Relational Histories in Investor Syndication
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University - Edinburgh Business School

detail.title: Renew the Group, Reuse the Pair: Relational Histories in Investor Syndication

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by philanthropic funding from an endowment to Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh (award C23SNDDD).

detail.abstract: Research on embeddedness shows that prior relationships shape partner selection. Theories of Simmelian ties, Simmelian brokerage, and structural folds show that cohesive group contexts shape the meaning and value of those relationships. Yet partnerselection models still represent experience through ties between a focal actor and individual candidates. We argue that relational experience in group assembly is multilevel. Some attaches to the assembler's own ties, and some to relations among prospective partners, which an assembler can reuse without having experienced them. Using relational hyperevent models of investor syndication in six samples across cleantech and financial technology on four continents, we separate three channels of pair recurrence. Contractual continuation within a venture dominates raw recurrence. Reuse of a pair at a new venture is rare but consequential, and it almost never draws on the focal lead's own prior participation. Pair histories established elsewhere, under other leads, predict joint selection in the three samples dense enough for reliable estimation, after controlling for member activity and pair opportunity. Individual repetition, in contrast, depresses selection everywhere once activity is controlled, with significant sectoral attenuation in fintech. Where no pair history exists, syndicates close on shared location, 1 most strongly under seed-stage uncertainty and beyond lead-level homophily. Group assembly, we conclude, responds to relational histories that are not contained in the assembler's own ties, a selection process through which collaborative lineages can be renewed while retaining relational elements.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了伙伴选择研究中"关系经验仅存在于焦点行动者自身联系中"的传统假设，提出团队组建中的关系经验是多层次的：既有组装者自身联系中的经验，也有来自潜在合作伙伴之间关系的可复用经验。通过清洁技术和金融科技领域六大样本（覆盖四大洲）的关系超事件模型，研究发现：合同延续主导了配对重复；新创业中的配对复用虽罕见但重要，且几乎不依赖主牵头人自身的参与；在其他牵头人主导下建立的历史配对关系显著预测联合选择；个体重复在控制活动水平后普遍抑制选择。这表明团队组建响应的是不包含在组装者自身联系中的关系历史。
AI.research_question: 在群体组建过程中，关系经验是否仅仅存在于焦点行动者（组装者）自身的联系中，还是也存在于潜在合作伙伴之间的关系中，并且这种非自身经历的关系经验能否被组装者复用？
AI.motivation: 已有嵌入性研究和Simmelian ties、结构性折叠等理论表明，凝聚性群体背景塑造了关系的意义和价值，但伙伴选择模型仍将经验表示为焦点行动者与单个候选人之间的联系。作者认为这是一种理论缺陷，需要将关系经验视为多层次的概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌入性理论（embeddedness）、Simmelian ties理论、Simmelian经纪理论、结构性折叠（structural folds）理论、多层次关系经验视角。
AI.method: 使用关系超事件模型（relational hyperevent models），对清洁技术和金融科技领域六大样本（覆盖四大洲）的投资银团数据进行分析，区分了配对重复的三个渠道：合同延续、新企业中的配对复用、以及在其他牵头人领导下建立的历史配对关系。
AI.findings: （1）同一企业内部的合同延续主导了原始配对重复；（2）在新企业中复用配对关系罕见但后果重大，且几乎不依赖主牵头人自身的先前参与；（3）在足够密集的三个样本中，其他牵头人建立的配对历史显著预测联合选择；（4）个体重复在控制活动后普遍抑制选择，且金融科技领域存在显著的行业衰减；（5）在没有配对历史的情况下，银团倾向于在共享地理位置下闭合，且在种子阶段不确定性下最强，超出牵头人层面的同质性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将关系经验的概念从组装者自身联系拓展为多层次结构，证明合作伙伴之间的关系历史可以脱离组装者自身的经历而被复用，从而为群体组建理论提供了新的分析维度，弥合了嵌入性理论与伙伴选择模型之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资银团组建实践提供指导：表明牵头人在选择合作伙伴时不应仅依赖自身过往关系，还可借鉴在其他牵头人领导下形成的合作关系历史；同时提示个体重复可能并非最佳选择策略。

title: Tackling the Global Challenges of Tourism and Sustainability: Epistemic Subsidiarity, Posthuman Democracy and the Law
affiliations: University of Strathclyde - School of Law

detail.title: Tackling the Global Challenges of Tourism and Sustainability: Epistemic Subsidiarity, Posthuman Democracy and the Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflicts of interest to report.
declarations.funderStatement: This preprint is part of the Research Project “The International Legal System for Sustainable Tourism Governance” (ILSSToGo / ref. PID2022-137996NB-I00), funded by MCIN/AEI/FEDER-UE.

detail.abstract: This article claims that workable balances between tourism and the sustainable reproduction of societies depend on the legal entrenchment of spaces for local deliberation in which the values, knowledges, and more-than-human members of place-based communities are recognised. It brings into dialogue recent contributions in critical tourism studies (CTS) with critical legal theory (CLT): Teubner's account of transnational regime closure, Jasanoff's principle of epistemic subsidiarity, and Santos's notions of interlegality and the ecology of knowledges. While CTS identifies place, community sovereignty, and more-than-human standing as the substantive content of a justice-attentive tourism agenda, CLT supplies the institutional-legal vocabulary in which those commitments can be conceptualised. The article situates this mutual CTS-CLT conversation at the Mar Menor. This situated discussion leads to advancing a renewed socio-legal research agenda on tourism, taking a transformative understanding of law as a research paradigm, hence bringing together both strands of scholarship towards shared substantive normative commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文主张，旅游与社会可持续再生产之间的可行平衡，取决于在法律上确立地方审议空间，使地方社区的价值观、知识及超越人类（more-than-human）成员得到承认。文章将批判性旅游研究（CTS）与批判性法律理论（CLT）进行对话，以Mar Menor为情境案例，提出以变革性法律理解作为研究范式的旅游社会-法律研究新议程。
AI.research_question: 旅游与社会可持续再生产之间的可行平衡如何可能实现？批判性旅游研究与批判性法律理论如何在规范性承诺上形成对话与整合？
AI.motivation: 旅游发展往往损害地方社区的可持续再生产，而批判性旅游研究虽识别了地方、社区主权与超越人类地位等正义议程的实质内容，但缺乏制度-法律词汇来概念化这些承诺。作者希望通过引入批判性法律理论，弥合这一理论空缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合批判性旅游研究（CTS）与批判性法律理论（CLT），具体包括：Teubner的跨国体制封闭理论、Jasanoff的知识辅助性原则、Santos的跨法律性（interlegality）与知识生态学概念。
AI.method: 理论对话与情境化案例分析。将CTS与CLT置于对话中，并以西班牙Mar Menor（马尔梅诺尔）为情境化案例进行具体讨论与论证。
AI.findings: CTS与CLT之间存在互补性：CTS界定了正义导向旅游议程的实质内容（地方、社区主权、超越人类地位），CLT提供了将这些承诺概念化的制度-法律词汇。二者结合可推进以变革性法律理解为核心的旅游社会-法律研究新议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 开创性地将批判性旅游研究与批判性法律理论进行系统性对话，提出了以法律为研究范式的旅游研究新议程，将两个学术脉络整合至共享的实质规范性承诺之下，丰富了旅游研究的理论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游治理提供法律制度化路径：主张通过法律确立地方审议空间，以承认地方社区的价值观、知识与超越人类成员，从而在旅游发展与社会的可持续再生产之间建立可行平衡。

title: Discredit by Saturation: Topic Level Credibility Penalty as a Concealment Mechanism

detail.title: Discredit by Saturation: Topic Level Credibility Penalty as a Concealment Mechanism
detail.abstract: Some subjects acquire a reputation in public discourse that attaches to anyone who raises them. This paper describes a credibility penalty that operates at the level of topic rather than claim: a speaker who invokes a particular subject is discounted for having invoked it, before any assessment of what was said. The penalty is distinct from ordinary skepticism, which evaluates a claim and finds it wanting, and distinct from the canonical account of testimonial injustice, which locates the deficit in prejudice about the speaker's social identity. Here the sorting is done by subject matter, which means a documented conviction and an unfounded assertion drawn from the same subject receive the same reception. Where the subject has a substantial adjudicated core, the effect functions as concealment, because it suppresses the ordinary follow up that an adjudicated record normally invites, and it does so without requiring that anyone intend it. The paper works three cases: the federal proceedings arising from the conduct of Jeffrey Epstein and his associates, the MKULTRA program, and COINTELPRO. Each has a substantial adjudicated core, each is saturated to the point where invoking it carries a credibility cost, and in each the adjudicated record met a threshold ruling. Two of the three closed. In the third the door opened, and it opened through a doctrine that treats official concealment as a reason to extend a limitations period rather than as a reason to bar a claim. That difference is the paper's comparative finding: the mechanism is not inevitable, and what varies is whether the threshold doctrine encountered treats concealment as a bar or as a tolling event. The paper confines itself throughout to convictions, appellate holdings, and unsealed filings, specifies in advance what would show the effect does not exist, and declines to resolve whether the saturation is emergent or cultivated, because the mechanism operates either way.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了一种发生在"主题"层面而非"主张"层面的可信度惩罚机制：当说话者提起某些特定主题（如爱泼斯坦案、MKULTRA、COINTELPRO）时，其言论会因"提起该主题"这一行为本身而被打折，而无论其具体内容如何。作者通过三个司法案例的比较分析，展示了这种机制如何产生隐藏效应（concealment），并发现其是否起作用取决于司法裁判中"隐藏"被视作起诉障碍还是诉讼时效中止事由。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一种发生于"主题"层面而非"主张"层面的可信度惩罚机制？该机制如何运作，其在司法实践中会产生何种后果，以及其运作的条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有的信任与可信度理论主要聚焦于对主张本身的怀疑（ordinary skepticism）或基于说话者社会身份的偏见（testimonial injustice）。然而，现实中存在一种未被充分理论化的现象：某些主题本身被污名化，提起者即被降信，而无论其具体主张是否成立。这一现象具有重要的认识论和社会正义意涵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文建立在认识论不正义（epistemic injustice）理论框架之上，特别是对Miranda Fricker"证言不正义"（testimonial injustice）理论的拓展与区分，同时借鉴了官方隐藏（official concealment）与司法程序理论。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法。选取三个具有实质性司法裁决核心的案例（爱泼斯坦联邦诉讼、MKULTRA项目、COINTELPRO），分析其诉讼进程与裁判结果，辨别主题饱和（saturation）程度与司法门槛裁定的关联。
AI.findings: 三个案例均具有实质性裁决核心，均因主题饱和而承担可信度代价。其中两个案例的诉讼被关闭，一个（COINTELPRO相关）通过将官方隐藏视为延长诉讼时效的理由而非禁止起诉的理由而打开。比较结果显示：该机制并非不可避免，其是否运作取决于门槛性司法学说将隐藏视为"禁止理由"还是"中止事由"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种与"主张怀疑"和"证言不正义"相区别的新型认识论不正义形态——"主题层面"的可信度惩罚。该机制具有隐藏效应，无需任何人有意的意图即可运作，扩展了认识论不正义理论的解释边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了司法制度中"隐藏"（concealment）概念的两种处理路径（作为障碍 vs. 作为中止事由）如何决定性影响受害者能否获得司法救济，为法律实践中识别和应对主题污名化提供了分析框架。

title: The Philosophy of Question Generation:An Epistemology Beginning with Value

detail.title: The Philosophy of Question Generation:An Epistemology Beginning with Value
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes Generative Value Philosophy as a new philosophical framework for understanding human cognition, knowledge formation, and intellectual activity in the age of artificial intelligence. Existing philosophical traditions have primarily examined fundamental concepts such as being, subjectivity, knowledge, and language. While these perspectives have provided profound insights into human understanding, this paper argues that they do not sufficiently explain a more fundamental cognitive phenomenon: why humans generate questions.

This study proposes that the fundamental unit of human intellectual activity is not knowledge, but Question. A question is not merely a linguistic expression of uncertainty; rather, it is a generative cognitive movement that emerges when an agent evaluates the world according to its values and identifies something as meaningful. Based on this perspective, this paper develops a theoretical model of cognition as a dynamic cycle:

Value → Goal → Question → Reasoning → Knowledge → Value Updating → New Question

In this model, value functions as the origin of cognitive exploration, directing attention, selecting meaningful differences from the environment, and transforming them into questions. Knowledge is not considered the final destination of cognition but a mediator that enables the continuous transformation of values. Therefore, human cognition is understood not as the accumulation of representations, but as a self-generating process of continuous value updating.

Building on this framework, the paper reconstructs several philosophical domains. Ontology is interpreted as the process through which the world gains meaning through questioning; epistemology is redefined as a process of value updating rather than mere knowledge acquisition; subjectivity is understood as the capacity to continuously generate questions and transform oneself; and ethics is reconsidered as the evaluation of the direction and quality of value transformation.

Furthermore, this framework is applied to the relationship between humans and large language models (LLMs). This paper argues that LLMs do not possess intrinsic values and therefore cannot independently generate questions as autonomous subjects. However, LLMs can function as cognitive environments that expand human reasoning by supporting the generation, preservation, comparison, and reconstruction of thought processes. Through interaction with LLMs, humans can create a Reasoning Space in which their assumptions, hypotheses, and conceptual structures become observable and revisable.

From this perspective, the significance of humans in the AI era does not lie in possessing more knowledge or producing answers faster than machines. Rather, human uniqueness lies in the ability to form values, generate meaningful questions, and continuously update oneself through inquiry. AI should therefore not be understood as a replacement for human intelligence, but as a supportive environment that enhances humanity’s capacity for reflective and generative thinking.

This paper argues that Generative Value Philosophy provides a theoretical foundation for understanding human intelligence as a process of continuous question generation and self-transformation. By positioning questioning as a fundamental philosophical unit, this framework offers a new perspective for integrating philosophy, cognitive science, education, and artificial intelligence studies in the emerging AI era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成性价值哲学"作为人工智能时代理解人类认知的新哲学框架，主张人类智识活动的基本单元不是知识而是"问题"（Question），并构建了"价值→目标→问题→推理→知识→价值更新→新问题"的动态认知循环模型。该框架重构了本体论、认识论、主体性和伦理学等哲学领域，并将大型语言模型定位为扩展人类推理的"认知环境"而非独立主体，强调人类独特价值在于持续生成问题和自我转化。
AI.research_question: 为什么人类会生成问题？这一更根本的认知现象如何被理解，以及如何以"问题"为基本单元重构哲学体系并重新定位人类与AI的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有哲学传统（存在论、认识论、语言学等）虽然深入探讨了存在、主体性、知识和语言等概念，但未能充分解释一个更根本的认知现象：人类为何会提出问题。在人工智能时代，需要新的哲学框架来理解人类智识活动的本质，并重新界定人与AI的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成性价值哲学（Generative Value Philosophy），以"问题"作为人类智识活动的基本单元，构建价值驱动的认知循环模型（Value→Goal→Question→Reasoning→Knowledge→Value Updating→New Question）。该框架整合了价值论、认知科学和生成性认知理论。
AI.method: 理论建构/概念分析方法：通过哲学概念分析提出新的理论框架，重新诠释本体论、认识论、主体性和伦理学等传统哲学领域，并将其应用于人机关系分析。
AI.findings: （1）人类认知的本质是价值驱动的持续问题生成与自我转化，而非知识的表征积累；（2）LLM不具备内在价值，不能作为自主主体独立生成问题，但可作为"认知环境"支持人类构建"推理空间"（Reasoning Space），使假设、观念和概念结构变得可观察和可修正；（3）人类在AI时代的独特性在于形成价值、生成有意义的问题以及通过探究持续自我更新。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"问题"（Question）作为哲学基本单元的原创性观点，挑战了以"知识"为核心的传统认识论；（2）重构了本体论（世界通过提问获得意义）、认识论（价值更新过程）、主体性（持续提问与自我转化能力）和伦理学（价值转化方向与质量的评价）；（3）为哲学、认知科学、教育和AI研究提供了统一的整合性理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）重新定义了AI时代的人类价值——不在于比机器更快地产生答案，而在于形成价值和生成有意义问题的能力；（2）将LLM定位为支持性认知环境而非智能替代物，为人机协作提供了新的设计理念；（3）为教育领域提供了以"提问能力"而非"知识积累"为核心的教学方向启示。

title: Does Public Spending Drive Inclusiveness? The Mediating Role of Governance Quality in Sub-Saharan Africa (1996-2021)

detail.title: Does Public Spending Drive Inclusiveness? The Mediating Role of Governance Quality in Sub-Saharan Africa (1996-2021)
detail.abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) experienced impressive macroeconomic growth figures over recent decades. Despite these impressive figures, economies within the region have struggled continuously to achieve growth inclusiveness-characterized by sustained poverty reduction and narrowing income gaps. Drawing on Musgrave's functional theory of public expenditure, this paper evaluates the empirical link between public spending, governance quality, and inclusive growth across 30 SSA economies from 1996 to 2021. To address dynamic modeling challenges surrounding reverse causality, unobserved heterogeneity, and endogeneity, we employ a System Generalized Method of Moments (SYS-GMM) estimation framework. Our findings reveal that aggregate public spending alone does not guarantee inclusive growth, even in economies classified as growth-inclusive by the African Union (AU). Instead, governance quality emerges as the essential mediating channel through which fiscal allocations enhance citizen welfare. We conclude that fiscal expansion must be explicitly paired with institutional governance benchmarks to fulfill AU Agenda 2063 aspirations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Musgrave公共支出功能理论，基于1996-2021年30个撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）经济体的面板数据，采用系统广义矩估计（SYS-GMM）方法，实证检验公共支出、治理质量与包容性增长之间的关系。研究发现公共支出本身并不能保证包容性增长，治理质量是财政分配提升公民福利的关键中介渠道。
AI.research_question: 公共支出、治理质量如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲经济体的包容性增长？公共支出是否足以单独实现包容性增长？
AI.motivation: 尽管撒哈拉以南非洲地区近年来实现了令人瞩目的宏观经济增长，但该地区经济体一直难以实现可持续发展的减贫和缩小收入差距的包容性增长，因此需要探究公共支出与治理质量在其中的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Musgrave公共支出功能理论
AI.method: 采用系统广义矩估计（SYS-GMM）方法处理反向因果、未观测异质性和内生性等动态建模挑战，面板数据涵盖1996至2021年30个SSA经济体。
AI.findings: 公共支出总量本身并不能保证包容性增长，即使在被非洲联盟（AU）归类为增长包容的经济体中也是如此；治理质量是财政分配提升公民福利的关键中介渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Musgrave公共支出功能理论应用于包容性增长情境，识别出治理质量作为财政政策与公民福利之间的中介传导机制，丰富了公共财政与制度经济学交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：财政扩张必须与机构治理基准明确挂钩，才能实现AU 2063议程的愿景，为SSA国家的财政政策和治理改革提供实践指导。

title: LLM-Computed Contextual Surprisal in Financial News: Associations with Market Repricing

detail.title: LLM-Computed Contextual Surprisal in Financial News: Associations with Market Repricing
detail.abstract: Financial-text research has established that the direction of language matters for markets. This paper examines a complementary property: whether realised financial-news wording is unexpected relative to the recent news environment. I use 4.48 million deduplicated English headlines from the public FNSPID dataset over 2014-2023 to construct a daily, clusterweighted contextual-surprisal measure with the causal language model Qwen 3.5-9B. The score is paired, headline by headline, with FinBERT sentiment so that adverse but routine wording is distinguished from adverse and contextually unexpected wording. The main result is contemporaneous. In a 2014-2020 development sample and an independent 2021-2023 holdout, a greater prevalence of unexpectedly negative language is associated with a larger increase in the VIX, a lower SPY return, and higher abnormal SPY dollar volume. The reported associations survive the stated within-family false-discovery-rate adjustment in both samples. A fixed-input comparison across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama shows strong agreement under two pre-computed token-aggregation variants. The evidence is consistent with the view that negative information which departs from a recent linguistic baseline is associated with broad same-day risk repricing. It provides a reproducible headline-level construction for subsequent research on timestamped news, temporal ordering, and the incremental value of contextual surprisal relative to established risk indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2014-2023年FNSPID数据集的448万条英文标题，通过Qwen 3.5-9B因果语言模型构建了日度的、聚类加权的上下文惊讶度（contextual surprisal）度量，并与FinBERT情绪配对，区分"不利但常规"与"不利且上下文意外"的措辞。研究发现，意外负面语言的普遍程度与VIX上升、SPY收益率下降和SPY异常成交量增加显著相关，且该关联在开发样本和独立样本中均稳健。
AI.research_question: 金融新闻措辞的"意外性"（相对于近期新闻环境的上下文惊讶度）是否与市场同日风险重定价相关？
AI.motivation: 已有金融文本研究确立了语言方向（情绪）对市场的影响，但鲜有研究从"意外性"这一互补维度探讨：即新闻措辞相对于近期新闻环境是否出乎意料。本文旨在弥补这一空白，为理解负面信息如何影响市场提供新的语言学视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 上下文惊讶度（contextual surprisal）理论：基于信息论，衡量语言序列中某词在给定上下文条件下的不可预测程度；结合金融文本中的情绪分析框架（FinBERT），区分常规负面措辞与上下文意外的负面措辞。
AI.method: 使用448万条去重英文标题（FNSPID数据集，2014-2023），构建日度、聚类加权的上下文惊讶度测度。采用因果语言模型Qwen 3.5-9B计算惊讶度，并与FinBERT情绪按标题配对。开发样本（2014-2020）与独立保持样本（2021-2023）中，检验意外负面语言与VIX、SPY收益率及SPY异常成交量的关联，并进行家族错误发现率（FDR）调整和跨模型（Qwen、Gemma、Llama）稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 意外负面语言的更高流行度与VIX更大增幅、SPY更低收益率以及SPY更高的异常成交量显著相关（同日效应）。该关联在2014-2020开发样本和2021-2023独立保持样本中均成立，且通过FDR调整；不同语言模型（Qwen、Gemma、Llama）在固定输入下表现出强一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将上下文惊讶度概念引入金融文本分析，补充了传统情绪分析只关注"语言方向"的局限，提出"语言意外性"作为影响市场的互补维度。为理解负面信息脱离近期语言基线时如何触发市场风险重定价提供了理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的标题级别（headline-level）度量构建方法，为后续研究时间戳新闻、时间排序以及上下文惊讶度相对于既有风险指标的增量价值奠定了基础。对市场参与者识别新闻驱动的风险定价具有一定参考意义。

title: Hunting Participation, Intensity, and Expenditures: Evidence from Ruffed Grouse Hunters in Wisconsin
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Department of Environment and Natural Resources and Department of Environment and Natural Resources

detail.title: Hunting Participation, Intensity, and Expenditures: Evidence from Ruffed Grouse Hunters in Wisconsin
detail.abstract: Ruffed grouse (Bonasa umbellus) hunting provides important recreational and economic benefits but faces increasing pressures from habitat loss and climate change. We examine the determinants of hunting participation, intensity, expenditures, and support for habitat funding using survey data from Wisconsin ruffed grouse hunters. We estimate binary choice models for participation, negative binomial models for hunting intensity, and a two-part model for expenditures. Results show that hunting behavior is shaped by experience, satisfaction, access, and travel costs. A key finding is the distinction between day and overnight trippers: while day trippers are more numerous, overnight trippers generate substantially higher expenditures per hunter. Supplemental input–output estimates indicate that grouse hunting expenditures in Wisconsin generate approximately $7.5 million in output, support about 63 jobs, and contribute $4.6 million in value added. Hunters with higher expenditures and those who consider ruffed grouse as favorite hunting species are more likely to support habitat conservation programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于威斯康星州松鸡猎人的调查数据，分析了狩猎参与、强度、支出及对栖息地资金支持的驱动因素，并发现过夜旅行者的人均支出显著更高，松鸡狩猎为威斯康星州带来约750万美元产出和63个就业岗位。
AI.research_question: 什么因素决定了松鸡狩猎的参与率、狩猎强度、支出水平以及对栖息地保护资金的支持意愿？
AI.motivation: 松鸡狩猎具有重要的休闲和经济价值，但面临栖息地丧失和气候变化的压力，需要理解猎人行为以制定有效的资源管理和保护政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机效用理论的参与决策框架、行为经济学中的旅行成本方法以及狩猎需求理论。
AI.method: 采用二元选择模型估计参与决策、负二项模型估计狩猎强度、两部分模型估计支出，并辅以投入产出模型评估经济影响。
AI.findings: 狩猎行为受经验、满意度、可达性和旅行成本影响；日间旅行者数量更多但过夜旅行者人均支出显著更高；松鸡狩猎支出产生约750万美元产出、63个工作岗位和460万美元增加值；高支出猎人和以松鸡为最爱物种的猎人更支持栖息地保护项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参与、强度、支出和支持意愿纳入统一分析框架，区分了日间与过夜旅行者的不同行为模式，丰富了休闲狩猎经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为野生动物管理部门提供猎人细分和行为洞察，为栖息地保护资金筹措策略提供实证依据，量化了松鸡狩猎的区域经济贡献。

title: A Turbulent Honeymoon: Volatility in Trump 2.0’s First 100 Days Compared to Predecessors
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore and Indian Institute of Management Bangalore

detail.title: A Turbulent Honeymoon: Volatility in Trump 2.0’s First 100 Days Compared to Predecessors
detail.abstract: We find that abnormal stock market volatility in Trump 2.0's first 100 days is the highest among all presidencies since 1933. Tariff-related uncertainty between 3 April 2025 and 11 April 2025 due to the introduction and immediate partial withdrawal of the "Liberation Day" tariffs is an important contributor to this volatility. Volatility at the start of Trump 2.0 was higher than presidencies that coincide with the Great Depression, World War 2, Global Financial Crisis, and the Covid-19 pandemic. Volatility dissipates after the presidential honeymoon period but remains higher than the average presidential term in Trump 2.0's first year.

AI.tldr: 本文发现特朗普第二任期（Trump 2.0）上任前100天的股票市场异常波动率是自1933年以来所有总统任期中最高的。其中，2025年4月3日至4月11日期间因"解放日"关税政策的出台及立即部分撤回所引发的关税相关不确定性，是导致这一高波动的重要推手。特朗普2.0任期初期的波动率甚至超过了与大萧条、二战、全球金融危机和新冠疫情重叠的总统任期。波动在总统"蜜月期"结束后有所消退，但特朗普2.0第一年的波动率仍高于历届总统任期的平均水平。
AI.research_question: 特朗普第二任期（Trump 2.0）上任初期的股票市场波动率是否异常偏高？如果是，其驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 特朗普2.0上任初期恰逢"解放日"关税政策的出台与撤回，政策不确定性极高，有必要系统比较其与历史上各总统任期初期的市场波动水平，以理解政策不确定性对市场的冲击程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策不确定性（policy uncertainty）与金融市场价格波动的理论框架，特别是贸易政策不确定性对股票市场波动的影响机制。
AI.method: 历史比较分析法：将特朗普2.0上任前100天及第一年的股票市场波动率与自1933年以来所有总统任期进行系统性对比，并识别特定事件窗口（2025年4月3日至4月11日关税事件）对波动的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 特朗普2.0前100天的波动率是1933年以来所有总统任期中最高，甚至高于大萧条、二战、金融危机和疫情时期的总统任期初期；2. "解放日"关税出台及迅速撤回是波动的重要来源；3. 波动在蜜月期后缓和，但第一年整体仍高于历史总统任期平均水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策不确定性理论提供了新的实证证据，表明关税政策的"出台-撤回"快速反转所产生的不确定性，比持续性的危机更能显著推升市场短期波动，拓展了对贸易政策不确定性冲击金融市场机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者具有警示意义：贸易政策的急剧出台与撤回会造成严重的市场动荡；同时为投资者提供了对总统任期初期波动规律的历史参照，有助于管理政策事件窗口期的风险预期。

title:
Genesis of Logic: Inferences 2
Ontological Friction in Medicine, Computation, and Governance

detail.title:
Genesis of Logic: Inferences 2
Ontological Friction in Medicine, Computation, and Governance
detail.abstract: This paper is the second in the Inferences series, extending the Genesis diagnostic-the ontology-relative account of logic and the Quad-Fold Ontological Spectrum (Substance-, Relation-, Emergence-, and Transcendence-first)-to three domains where the mismatch between formal systems and their objects is most consequential: medicine, computation, and governance. We trace a recurring pattern across all three: a Substance-first formal system, mistaken for a neutral universal standard, is applied to a domain whose native reasoning is Relation-, Emergence-, or Transcendence-first, and the resulting friction is misdiagnosed as a defect in the domain rather than a mismatch of ontologies. In medicine, the biomedical model's discrete disease categories, single-target interventions, and categorical diagnosis are applied to an organism that is a relational network, an emergent homeostatic system, and a whole that transcends its parts. In computation, formal verification's exhaustive state-space search, fixed specifications, and discrete correctness criteria are applied to distributed, adaptive, and intelligent systems whose coherence is relational and emergent. In governance, the regulatory state's statutes, jurisdictions, performance metrics, and cost-benefit analysis are applied to social systems that are emergent markets, relational communities, and transcendent national identities. We argue these are not isolated failures but one structural pattern recurring across the institutional landscape, close by identifying the limits of the diagnostic, and set the agenda for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文是"Inferences"系列的第二篇论文，将Genesis诊断法（本体论相对逻辑观）和四重本体论光谱（实体优先、关系优先、涌现优先、超越优先）扩展到医学、计算和治理三个领域，揭示了一个反复出现的结构性模式：实体优先的形式系统被误认为中立普遍标准，应用于其原生推理方式为关系、涌现或超越优先的领域，由此产生的摩擦被错误诊断为领域缺陷而非本体论错配。
AI.research_question: 在医学、计算和治理三个领域中，形式系统与其对象之间的本体论错配如何产生系统性摩擦，并导致错误的诊断和制度性失败？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到形式系统与其实践领域之间的反复失配并非孤立失败，而是一个结构性的、跨领域的普遍模式，需要从本体论层面进行系统诊断。
AI.theoretical_framework: Genesis诊断框架、本体论相对逻辑观、四重本体论光谱（实体优先、关系优先、涌现优先、超越优先）
AI.method: 跨领域比较分析，对医学、计算和治理三个领域进行本体论层面的案例诊断与模式识别。
AI.findings: 在医学中，生物医学模型的离散疾病分类和单一靶点干预被应用于本质上是关系网络、涌现稳态系统和超越部分的整体有机体；在计算中，形式验证的穷举状态空间搜索和固定规范被应用于分布式、自适应和智能系统；在治理中，监管国家的法规、管辖区、绩效指标和成本效益分析被应用于涌现市场、关系社区和超越性国家认同。三者共享同一结构性错配模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Genesis诊断框架从逻辑学扩展至应用领域，确证本体论错配是一个跨制度的普遍模式，而非孤立现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学、计算和治理领域的制度设计提供本体论诊断工具，帮助识别错误地将实体优先系统强加于关系/涌现/超越优先领域的结构性缺陷。

title: Does Urban Planning Build Fiscal Capacity? Evidence from Brazil
affiliations: Universidade do Estado de Mato Grosso (UNEMAT), Universidade Estadual de Mato Grosso, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso

detail.title: Does Urban Planning Build Fiscal Capacity? Evidence from Brazil
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of municipal master plan adoption on local property tax revenue in Brazil. Identification comes from variation in adoption timing induced by the 2001 City Statute, which imposed statutory deadlines in 2006 and 2008 on municipalities above 20,000 inhabitants. Applying the staggered difference-indifferences estimator of Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) to a panel of 5,562 municipalities covering 2000 to 2012, we find that master plan adoption raises real per capita property tax revenue by 4.5 percent on average. The effect grows over time and reaches 13.6 percent from the fourth post-adoption year onward. Pre-trends are statistically indistinguishable from zero, and estimates are insensitive to the choice of comparison group. We interpret the finding through the cadastral channel: delimiting the urban perimeter and classifying land use zones requires territorial survey work that simultaneously expands and updates the property registry. Two placebo-style tests rule out budgetary expansion as an alternative explanation. Treated municipalities receive fewer federal transfers per capita than controls, and discretionary state transfers fall by 10.3 percent after adoption. Own-source revenue rises despite tighter access to external resources.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2001年巴西《城市法》规定的法定截止日期（2006和2008年）导致的城市总体规划采纳时间差异，采用Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021）的交错双重差分估计器，基于2000-2012年5,562个城市的面板数据，发现总体规划采纳使人均房产税收入平均提高4.5%，且效应随时间增长，第四年后达到13.6%。该效应通过地籍渠道传导，并非预算扩张所致。
AI.research_question: 城市总体规划的采纳对地方房产税收入是否有因果效应？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 城市规划对地方财政的影响在实证上鲜有严谨的因果识别研究，本文利用巴西《城市法》造成的采纳时间外生变异来估计这一效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市规划理论与地方财政学，地籍信息渠道假说（cadastral channel）：总体规划的边界划定和用地分区需要领土调查工作，从而扩展和更新房产登记系统，提升税收征管能力。
AI.method: 交错双重差分估计器（Callaway和Sant'Anna, 2021），面板数据涵盖5,562个城市（2000-2012年），辅以安慰剂检验和替代对照组的稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）总体规划采纳使人均房产税收入平均提高4.5%；（2）效应随时间增长，第四年后达13.6%；（3）预趋势与零无显著差异；（4）对对照组选择不敏感；（5）处理组获得的联邦转移支付更少，可自由支配的州转移支付下降10.3%，排除了预算扩张作为替代解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供城市规划采纳对地方税收因果效应的严谨识别证据，提出并验证了地籍渠道机制，将城市规划与地方财政能力联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家城市规划政策的财政效益提供经验证据，表明总体规划不仅是空间治理工具，也具有增强地方财政自主性的功能；同时揭示了财政转移缩减背景下地方政府通过规划提升自有收入的可能路径。

title: Adaptive Attention Sparse Representation and Weighted Gaussian Mixture Stochastic Process Modeling for Few-shot Fault Diagnosis
affiliations: Hunan Institute of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Adaptive Attention Sparse Representation and Weighted Gaussian Mixture Stochastic Process Modeling for Few-shot Fault Diagnosis
detail.abstract: To address the low diagnostic accuracy and weak generalization caused by limited samples, incomplete data distribution and noise interference in industrial fault datasets, this paper proposes a few-shot fault diagnosis model based on Adaptive Attention Sparse Representation and Weighted Gaussian Mixture Random Process (AASR-WGMP). First, an adaptive attention sparse representation framework is constructed. Embedded with a channel attention mechanism and adaptive update rule, the framework adaptively focuses on critical fault features and suppresses noise, enabling high-precision sparse decomposition and feature extraction. Second, a weighted Gaussian mixture random process is developed. By adopting component-level and sample-level dual weighting strategies, the model prioritizes distribution modeling of core fault features and improves the fitting accuracy of fault patterns under few-shot conditions. Subsequently, sparse Bayesian inference is employed with Dirichlet, Gaussian and Inverse-Wishart conjugate priors to achieve robust posterior estimation of model parameters. The evidence lower bound (ELBO) and a dual convergence criterion are utilized to guarantee iterative stability. Experimental results on rolling bearing faults under different sample sizes and signal-to-noise ratios show that the proposed model achieves a diagnostic accuracy of 95.35% using only 10 samples per category, surpassing comparative methods by 8.85%–13.95%. It retains an accuracy of 86.60% under a low SNR of 10 dB. The model exhibits competitive robustness and generalization capability against existing mainstream approaches, providing an effective and feasible solution for industrial few-shot fault diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自适应注意力稀疏表示与加权高斯混合随机过程（AASR-WGMP）的小样本故障诊断模型，解决工业故障数据中样本有限、数据分布不完整和噪声干扰导致的诊断精度低、泛化能力弱的问题。该模型通过自适应注意力稀疏分解提取关键故障特征，并采用双重加权高斯混合随机过程提升小样本条件下的拟合精度，实验表明在每类仅10个样本时达到95.35%的诊断精度，在低信噪比（10 dB）下仍保持86.60%的准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限样本、数据分布不完整和噪声干扰的工业故障数据条件下，提高故障诊断的准确性和泛化能力？
AI.motivation: 工业故障数据集通常存在样本数量有限、数据分布不完整和噪声干扰严重的问题，导致现有诊断方法精度低且泛化能力弱，亟需一种能有效应对小样本和噪声条件的高精度故障诊断模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀疏表示理论、注意力机制、高斯混合模型、贝叶斯推断（Dirichlet、Gaussian、Inverse-Wishart共轭先验）、证据下界（ELBO）优化
AI.method: 构建自适应注意力稀疏表示框架（嵌入通道注意力机制和自适应更新规则）；开发加权高斯混合随机过程（采用组件级和样本级双重加权策略）；利用稀疏贝叶斯推断结合共轭先验实现稳健后验估计；通过ELBO和双收敛准则保证迭代稳定性。
AI.findings: 在滚动轴承故障数据集上，每类仅10个样本时诊断精度达95.35%，比对比方法高出8.85%-13.95%；在10 dB低信噪比下仍保持86.60%的准确率，展现出良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出自适应注意力稀疏表示框架，将通道注意力机制嵌入稀疏分解以自适应聚焦关键特征并抑制噪声；提出加权高斯混合随机过程，通过组件级和样本级双重加权策略提升小样本条件下的分布拟合精度；利用共轭先验和ELBO保证贝叶斯推断的稳健性和收敛性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业小样本故障诊断提供了有效可行的解决方案，在实际工业场景中可在样本稀缺和噪声干扰条件下实现高精度故障诊断，具有较好的工程应用价值。

title: Extreme Heat, Wildfires and the Economics of Climate Readiness: Historical Change, Ecological Loss and Preparing for a Hotter Future
affiliations: Szymon Zephan Capital (SZC Group)

detail.title: Extreme Heat, Wildfires and the Economics of Climate Readiness: Historical Change, Ecological Loss and Preparing for a Hotter Future

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Managing Partner at SZC Group
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: SZC Group

keywords: conservation leaders and institutional investors climate change
