detail.abstract: This paper examines how rising temperatures, altered precipitation, land management, ignition and urban expansion are changing the human and economic consequences of wildfire. It distinguishes total area burned from destructive forest fire, smoke exposure, emissions and loss: global burned area can decline while catastrophic forest and wildland-urban interface fires become more consequential. The 2026 evidence is reported only to 31 July. Western Europe experienced its hottest June on record and parts of Ontario reached temperatures comparable to the 1936 era, but the unfinished Northern Hemisphere summer is not characterized as a completed global record. Case studies from Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia and Chile integrate climate attribution, fuels, land use, Indigenous and prescribed fire, detection, evacuation, health protection, insurance and recovery. The economic ledger extends beyond insured property to mortality, smoke illness, labour productivity, agriculture, tourism, power and transport disruption, public finance, wildlife, habitat, water, soil and carbon. Four probability-weighted scenarios for 2027-2040 identify unevenly managed adaptation as the base case. The paper proposes a ten-year Heat and Fire Readiness Compact that rebalances expenditure toward maintained landscape stewardship, safer communities and buildings, clean-air cooling, interoperable warning and response, transparent insurance and fiscal risk, and long-term ecological recovery. The objective is not a fire-free landscape, but fewer catastrophic outcomes and faster, fairer recovery in a hotter climate.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了气温上升、降水变化、土地管理、引火源和城市扩张如何改变野火对人类和经济的后果。文章区分了总过火面积与破坏性森林火灾、烟雾暴露、排放和损失，指出全球过火面积可能下降，但灾难性森林火灾和城乡交界区火灾的影响却日益严重。基于加拿大、美国、欧洲、澳大利亚和智利的案例研究，文章提出了2027-2040年四个概率情景，并建议实施为期十年的"热浪与火灾防备契约"，以平衡景观管护、社区安全、清洁空气冷却、预警响应、保险和财政风险及生态恢复方面的投入。
AI.research_question: 不断变化的气候条件（升温、降水变化）、土地管理方式、引火源和城市扩张如何改变野火对人类和经济的后果？如何区分总过火面积与灾害性火灾损失之间的差异？
AI.motivation: 全球过火面积可能呈下降趋势，但灾难性森林火灾和城乡交界区（WUI）火灾造成的后果却日益严重。现有研究往往混淆"过火面积"与"火灾损失"，需要更全面地理解气候变化背景下野火对人类健康、经济和生态系统的真实影响，并为未来适应策略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合气候归因分析、燃料管理理论、土地利用理论、火灾生态学、保险与风险管理理论，以及公共健康与经济学框架，将野火后果从单纯的过火面积扩展至烟雾暴露、排放、死亡率和经济损失的多元维度。
AI.method: 采用多国案例研究法（加拿大、美国、欧洲、澳大利亚和智利），整合气候归因、燃料状况、土地利用、原住民和计划性火烧、火灾探测、疏散、健康保护、保险和恢复等维度；开发四个2027-2040年概率加权情景。
AI.findings: 全球过火面积可能下降，但灾难性森林火灾和WUI火灾的后果日益严重；2026年西欧经历了有记录以来最热的六月；经济后果远超保险财产损失，涵盖死亡率、烟雾疾病、劳动生产率、农业、旅游、电力和交通中断、公共财政、野生动物、栖息地、水、土壤和碳等方面。四个情景中，管理不均衡的适应是基准情形。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分"过火面积"与"火灾后果"的分析框架，将野火研究从单一的燃烧面积指标拓展为包含人类健康、经济、生态多维度后果的综合评估体系，并引入情景规划方法于野火适应研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了为期十年的"热浪与火灾防备契约"（Heat and Fire Readiness Compact），建议将支出重新平衡至景观持续管护、更安全的社区和建筑、清洁空气降温、可互操作预警与响应、透明的保险与财政风险管理，以及长期生态恢复。目标不是无火景观，而是减少灾难性后果并实现更快速、更公平的恢复。

title: Child Welfare Contact and Adolescent Mental Health
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, Washington University in St-Louis and

detail.title: Child Welfare Contact and Adolescent Mental Health
detail.abstract: Using linked administrative data, we examine how child welfare system (CWS) contact affects adolescent behavioral health. We study youth ages 10-16 using a stacked difference-indifferences design comparing adolescents at referral to youth with later CWS contact. Behavioral health claims rise immediately and persistently after contact, especially following in-home services and foster care, with the largest increases for abuse-related referrals and PTSD. In contrast, suicidal ideation and behavioral-health emergency services do not increase, and instead decline, among foster care youth, suggesting the estimates reflect increased health care utilization rather than a decline in mental health.

AI.tldr: 本文利用关联行政数据，通过堆叠双重差分设计，考察儿童福利系统（CWS）接触对10-16岁青少年行为健康的影响。研究发现，CWS接触后行为健康索赔立即且持续上升，尤其在居家服务和寄养之后，虐待相关转介和PTSD群体的增幅最大；但寄养青少年的自杀意念和行为健康急诊服务并未增加反而下降，表明估计结果反映的是医疗利用增加而非心理健康恶化。
AI.research_question: 儿童福利系统（CWS）接触如何影响青少年（10-16岁）的行为健康结果？
AI.motivation: 儿童福利系统接触对青少年行为健康的影响尚不明确，需要利用因果识别方法区分"接触导致心理健康恶化"与"接触导致医疗服务利用增加"这两种竞争性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童福利系统的干预效应理论，区分行为健康结果变化究竟是心理健康真实恶化还是医疗服务可及性/利用率提升所致。
AI.method: 使用关联行政数据，采用堆叠双重差分（stacked difference-in-differences）设计，比较转介时的青少年与后来才接触CWS的青少年。
AI.findings: （1）CWS接触后行为健康索赔立即且持续上升，尤其在居家服务和寄养之后；（2）虐待相关转介和PTSD群体的增幅最大；（3）寄养青少年的自杀意念和行为健康急诊服务未增加反而下降，提示结果反映的是医疗利用增加而非心理健康恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了CWS接触对行为健康的两种可能机制（健康恶化vs医疗利用增加），为理解儿童福利系统的政策效应提供了更细致的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童福利政策制定者提供证据表明CWS接触可能主要提升医疗服务可及性而非损害心理健康，有助于优化对寄养和居家服务青少年的行为健康支持资源配置。

title: Within-country inequality and unequal exchange as joint determinants of carbon emissions
affiliations: and Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Within-country inequality and unequal exchange as joint determinants of carbon emissions
detail.abstract: The relationship between within-country inequality and carbon emissions differs between countries, but the reasons remain poorly understood. We argue that the effect of inequality on carbon emissions depends on the position of a country within the global system of production - which shapes the carbon intensity of production. Using Input-Output (IO) modeling, we construct a novel indicator of value appropriation through global trade. Value appropriation captures whether a country receives more or less value added than the labor it contributes to global value chains. Using a panel of 138 countries from 1990 to 2021, we estimate the compound effect of within-country inequality and value appropriation on carbon emissions. We find that a reduction in inequality is associated with more fossil emissions only in coun-tries with low levels of value appropriation. Also, an increase in value appropriation is associated with more fossil emissions only if inequalities exceed the threshold value of 54, as measured by the Gini. Land use change emissions follow a different pattern. The results show that domestic redistribution and fairer participation in global value chains must go hand in hand to achieve sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过投入产出模型构建了"价值链价值攫取"指标，研究了国内不平等与碳排放的关系如何受国家在全球生产体系中的位置影响。研究发现：在低价值攫取国家，不平等减少与更多化石燃料排放相关；而在高价值攫取国家，不平等的增加（基尼系数超过54）与更多排放相关。土地用途变化排放则呈现不同模式。
AI.research_question: 国内不平等与碳排放之间的关系因国家而异，其原因尚未被充分理解。本文旨在探究：一个国家在全球生产体系中的位置（通过价值攫取衡量）如何调节国内不平等对碳排放的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对国内不平等与碳排放关系的实证结果存在分歧，不同国家呈现出不同的关系模式，但缺乏系统的理论解释。作者认为需要将国家在全球价值链中的结构性位置纳入分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球生产体系理论（世界体系理论/全球价值链理论），认为国家在全球生产体系中的位置决定了其生产的碳强度，从而调节国内不平等对碳排放的影响。
AI.method: 使用投入产出（IO）建模构建价值攫取指标（衡量国家从全球价值链中获得的价值增值与其贡献的劳动力之比）；使用1990-2021年138个国家的面板数据，估计国内不平等与价值攫取对碳排放的复合效应。
AI.findings: （1）仅在低价值攫取国家，不平等减少与更多化石燃料排放相关；（2）仅在基尼系数超过54的国家，价值攫取增加与更多化石燃料排放相关；（3）土地用途变化排放呈现不同的模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全球价值链的结构性位置（价值攫取）纳入不平等-碳排放关系的分析框架，为解释不同国家间不平等与碳排放关系的异质性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策含义在于：国内再分配政策与全球价值链中更公平的参与必须协同推进，才能实现可持续发展目标。

title: Transient dynamics reshapes the safe operating space of bioeconomic coupled infrastructure systems
affiliations: Université Clermont Auvergne, School of Human Evolution and Social Change and University of Florida - Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering

detail.title: Transient dynamics reshapes the safe operating space of bioeconomic coupled infrastructure systems
detail.abstract: There is considerable evidence that interdependencies among infrastructure systems can lead to local-global feedback and abrupt changes that cause the collapse of social-ecological-technical systems. Here, we highlight how such interdependencies may give rise to positive or negative effects in a natural system coupled with a market infrastructure through exploitation. Specifically, we analyze a stylized dynamical model that couples a local bioeconomic system with a global market. We emphasize the importance of transition pathways rather than focusing solely on equilibrium regimes when considering the safe operating space of the coupled system. We find that the coupling between infrastructures may regulate the whole system in ways that avoid the collapse of the biological system as well as the emergence of economic atrophy. The results show how the interplay between local effort and market responsiveness may enlarge the safe operating space. Beyond the quantitative results, we highlight the need to govern such interdependencies in a dynamic way in order to avoid under- and over-coupling for sustainably managing social-ecological-technical systems, especially because the right couplings at the right time depend not only on knowledge about the current state but also on the corresponding emergent transient dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个耦合本地生物经济系统与全球市场的简化动态模型，分析了基础设施系统之间相互依赖关系如何产生正负效应，并强调在考虑耦合系统的安全运行空间时，应关注转型路径而非仅关注均衡状态。研究发现基础设施耦合可以调节整个系统，避免生物系统崩溃和经济萎缩，并扩大安全运行空间。
AI.research_question: 基础设施系统间的相互依赖如何通过开发（exploitation）在自然系统与市场基础设施耦合中产生正负效应，以及如何界定和扩大耦合系统的安全运行空间？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明基础设施系统间的相互依赖可能导致局部-全局反馈和突变，引发社会-生态-技术系统的崩溃。然而，这种相互依赖也可能产生积极效应，现有研究对此关注不足，且大多聚焦于均衡状态而忽略了转型路径的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会-生态-技术系统理论；生物经济系统动态模型；耦合系统理论；基础设施相互依赖理论
AI.method: 构建一个将本地生物经济系统与全球市场耦合的简化动态模型（stylized dynamical model），通过数学建模和数值分析考察系统动力学行为，分析耦合基础设施对系统稳定性的影响。
AI.findings: （1）基础设施间的耦合可以调节整个系统，从而避免生物系统崩溃和经济萎缩的发生；（2）本地努力（local effort）与市场响应性（market responsiveness）之间的相互作用可以扩大系统的安全运行空间；（3）适当的耦合时机取决于对当前状态的了解以及对相应涌现的瞬态动力学的认知。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文超越了仅关注均衡状态的传统分析范式，强调转型路径（transition pathways）在界定安全运行空间中的重要性；揭示基础设施耦合既可能产生正面也可能产生负面效应的双重性，丰富了社会-生态-技术系统相互依赖理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出需要以动态方式治理基础设施相互依赖关系，避免耦合不足（under-coupling）和过度耦合（over-coupling），为可持续管理社会-生态-技术系统提供治理启示。

title: The Political Sustainability of Creative Destruction in the AI Age
affiliations: and University of British Columbia

detail.title: The Political Sustainability of Creative Destruction in the AI Age
detail.abstract: Schumpeterian growth theory predicts that, through creative destruction, new innovations displace older firms and jobs. Although this generates long-term prosperity, it also creates a political sustainability problem: under what conditions will the public support creative destruction? Using an original survey of 3,220 U.S. adults, we elicit beliefs about AI-driven creative destruction and field a conjoint experiment that varies employment, prices, profit distribution, and whether displaced workers receive support. The public expects AI to destroy jobs at adopting firms and does not anticipate the business-stealing mechanism central to Schumpeterian growth theory. Despite these beliefs, respondents remain weakly supportive of allowing AI adoption across all scenarios. Policy support depends far more on distributional arrangements -- whether profits are shared with workers and displaced workers receive support -- than on employment outcomes, especially for Democrats. The political sustainability of innovation thus depends less on aggregate employment effects than on perceptions of distributional fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项对美国3,220名成年人的原创调查和联合实验，考察公众对AI驱动的创造性破坏（熊彼特增长理论中的核心机制）的政治支持条件。研究发现，公众预期AI会摧毁采用企业的就业岗位，且未预期到熊彼特增长理论所强调的"抢生意"（business-stealing）机制。尽管存在这些信念，受访者在所有情境下对允许AI采用的支持度仍然较弱。政策支持更多取决于分配安排（利润是否与工人共享、被替代工人是否获得支持），而非就业结果本身，尤其在民主党人中更为明显。因此，创新的政治可持续性更多取决于分配公平感知而非总体就业效应。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下公众会支持创造性破坏（以AI驱动的创新为例）？
AI.motivation: 熊彼特增长理论预测创新通过创造性破坏带动长期繁荣，但同时会造成就业替代，产生政治可持续性问题。理解公众何时支持创造性破坏，对于创新政策的政治可行性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特增长理论（Schumpeterian growth theory），包括创造性破坏机制和"抢生意"（business-stealing）效应。
AI.method: 原创调查（3,220名美国成年人）+ 联合实验（conjoint experiment），操纵就业、价格、利润分配和被替代工人支持等因素。
AI.findings: （1）公众预期AI会摧毁采用企业的就业岗位，但未预期到熊彼特增长理论中的"抢生意"机制；（2）尽管存在上述信念，受访者对允许AI采用的支持度在所有情境下均偏弱；（3）政策支持主要取决于分配安排——利润是否与工人共享、被替代工人是否获得支持——而非就业结果，这一效应在民主党人中尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将熊彼特增长理论的政治经济学维度与公众信念和偏好联系起来，揭示了创新的政治可持续性更多取决于分配公平感知而非总体就业效应，丰富了关于创造性破坏的政治支持条件的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何设计创新政策（特别是AI政策）以提高公众政治支持度的实证依据，强调利润共享和工人补偿机制比单纯关注就业总量更为关键。

title: Does Renewable Energy Alleviate or Deepen Energy Poverty? Income-Contingent Evidence from the European Union
affiliations: University of Phayao and Chiang Mai University

detail.title: Does Renewable Energy Alleviate or Deepen Energy Poverty? Income-Contingent Evidence from the European Union
detail.abstract: This study examines the association between the renewable energy share and household energy poverty across 22 European Union member states over 2007 to 2023, asking who carries the near-term household costs of the sustainability transition. All associations are identified from within-country variation net of common annual shocks. A one percentage point higher renewable share is associated with a 0.204 percentage point higher composite energy poverty index. The association loads almost entirely on the share of households in arrears on utility bills, while the share unable to keep the home adequately warm shows no distinguishable association, so the burden registers in the financial rather than the thermal face of deprivation. GDP per capita and social protection expenditure carry the largest protective associations, and the renewable association is stable across the conditional distribution of energy poverty. It is, however, conditioned by economic development: the marginal association rises with income and changes sign at a GDP per capita of roughly EUR 20,617, within a wide 95 per cent interval of EUR 5,029 to 35,839. These patterns give the distributional claim of the energy-justice literature a direct panel test, characterising where in the income range, and in which component of deprivation, the household costs of the transition appear.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2007-2023年22个欧盟成员国的面板数据，发现可再生能源占比每提高1个百分点，家庭能源贫困综合指数上升0.204个百分点，且该负担几乎完全体现在拖欠水电费账单的家庭比例上，而非无法保持房屋温暖的指标上。可再生能源的边际关联随收入水平变化，在人均GDP约20,617欧元处发生符号转变。
AI.research_question: 谁承担可持续转型的近期家庭成本？即可再生能源份额与家庭能源贫困之间的关联是什么，以及这种关联在不同经济发展水平和能源贫困维度上如何分布？
AI.motivation: 能源公正文献强调可持续转型可能带来的分配性后果，但缺乏直接的实证检验。本研究通过面板数据直接检验可再生能源转型的分配性主张，回答谁在近期为可持续转型付出家庭成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源公正理论（分配性公正维度）、能源贫困理论（金融维度与热舒适维度的区分）
AI.method: 利用22个欧盟成员国2007-2023年的面板数据，采用国家内变异（within-country variation）识别关联，控制共同年度冲击，构建复合能源贫困指数，并进行条件分布分析（分位数回归）和经济发展水平的调节效应检验。
AI.findings: (1) 可再生能源占比每提高1个百分点，能源贫困综合指数上升0.204个百分点；(2) 该关联几乎完全体现在拖欠账单的金融维度，热舒适维度无显著关联；(3) 人均GDP和社会保护支出具有最大的保护性关联；(4) 可再生能源的关联在能源贫困的条件分布上保持稳定；(5) 关联受经济发展水平调节：边际关联随收入上升，在人均GDP约20,617欧元处改变符号（95%置信区间为5,029至35,839欧元）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源公正文献的分配性主张提供了直接的面板数据检验，明确了转型成本在收入区间和能源贫困具体维度上的分布特征，细化了金融维度与热舒适维度在能源贫困中的差异化表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了能源转型分配后果的实证依据，表明在高收入国家可再生能源转型的近期家庭成本更显著，而人均GDP较低的国家可能展现出不同的模式；同时指出政策应关注拖欠账单这一金融脆弱性维度，并通过社会保障支出加以缓解。

title: When Risk Transfer Fails: Informational Distance and the Limits of Financial Engineering Toward a Unified Theory of Financial Crisis

detail.title: When Risk Transfer Fails: Informational Distance and the Limits of Financial Engineering Toward a Unified Theory of Financial Crisis
detail.abstract: Modern finance reduces risk concentration by distributing exposures across institutions, markets, and instruments. Yet during crises, the same mechanisms may become channels of contagion. This paper explains that reversal through informational distance, defined as the separation between an economic exposure and the information required to identify, evaluate, and respond to it. Financial architecture first compresses informational distance, allowing uncertainty to be represented, priced, and transferred. Redistributive financial engineering may later weaken that compression through three effects. The composition effect moves previously compressed uncertainty back into the residual component. The level effect creates new informational distance through contractual layering, indirect ownership, collateral chains, and common dependencies. The representation effect shifts residual uncertainty from firm-specific toward market risk, reducing the independently identifiable space available for diversification and containment. A financial crisis threshold is reached when residual informational distance becomes sufficiently large and sufficiently concentrated in market-wide risk. The framework extends Minsky's instability hypothesis by identifying an informational mechanism through which stability may reduce independent risk space even before measured losses rise. Applications to securitization, correlated insurance protection, repo markets, and debt markets illustrate the argument.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信息距离"（informational distance）概念来解释金融体系如何从危机前的风险分散机制转变为危机中的传染渠道。金融架构先压缩信息距离使不确定性可被定价和转移，但再分配性金融工程会通过组合效应、水平效应和表征效应削弱这种压缩，导致残余信息距离增大并集中于市场-wide风险，最终到达金融危机阈值。
AI.research_question: 为什么金融体系在正常时期能通过分散风险来降低集中度，而在危机时期却成为传染的渠道？这种反转的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现代金融通过跨机构、跨市场、跨工具分散风险敞口来降低风险集中度，但危机期间同一机制却可能成为传染渠道。现有理论（如Minsky的金融不稳定假说）未充分解释这一反转的具体微观机制，需要一个新的理论框架来阐明稳定性如何孕育不稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息距离理论（informational distance），扩展了Minsky的金融不稳定假说。信息距离定义为经济敞口与识别、评估和回应它所需信息之间的分离程度。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念框架分析，通过三个效应（组合效应、水平效应、表征效应）解释信息距离的削弱过程，并结合证券化、相关保险保护、回购市场和债务市场等应用场景进行阐释。
AI.findings: 1) 金融架构首先压缩信息距离，使不确定性得以表征、定价和转移；2) 再分配性金融工程通过三种效应削弱压缩：组合效应将已压缩的不确定性移回残余成分，水平效应通过合同分层、间接持股、抵押品链条和共同依赖创造新的信息距离，表征效应将残余不确定性从公司特定风险转向市场风险；3) 当残余信息距离足够大且集中于市场-wide风险时达到金融危机阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展Minsky的金融不稳定假说，识别出在可测量损失上升之前，稳定性就可能通过信息机制减少独立风险空间；2) 提出"信息距离"作为统一概念框架，解释金融架构压缩与危机传染之间的辩证关系；3) 为理解金融工程如何重新分配而非消除风险提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者识别系统性风险提供了新的早期预警指标——关注残余信息距离及其市场风险集中度，而非仅关注可测量损失；对证券化、回购市场、保险保护等具体金融领域的风险管理和政策制定具有指导意义。

title: Casting Shadows and the Price of Seabed
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics

detail.title: Casting Shadows and the Price of Seabed

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N.A.
declarations.funderStatement: I have no funder info to declare.

detail.abstract: Wind flows over seabed rights sold block by block. An upwind development reduces output behind it and pays nothing. I measure this directional externality in metered generation and radar backscatter, each against a placebo supplied by the physics, and neighboring wakes remove 0.8 percent of the metered fleet's annual generation. No auction or lease rule in the record levies a charge for the shadow a block casts. Claims concentrate on windward positions, which cast more than they receive, and within its own holdings a developer avoids the shading bearing it prices onto others. The lost generation is worth 1.36 billion euros in present value on the European claimed geometry, of which 0.86 billion is remuneration that a payment between rights holders could move, and 5.48 billion on the full register at the European completion rate. A prospective charge on shadow cast implements the planner's allocation at a common energy price, while minimum-spacing rules exclude seabed worth more than the shading they avert.

AI.tldr: 本文研究海上风电地块之间的尾流（尾风）外部性：位于上风向的风电开发会减少下风向地块的发电量，且无需为此付费。作者利用计量发电数据和雷达后向散射数据，并结合物理原理构造安慰剂检验，测量了这一方向性外部性。研究发现，邻近地块的尾流使整个计量机队的年发电量减少0.8%。在现有拍卖和租赁规则中，没有任何条款对地块投下的"阴影"征收费用。风电开发权主张集中在迎风位置，因为该位置造成的阴影多于接收的阴影；开发商在自己的持有地块内会避免遮挡，但将这一负担定价转嫁给他人。损失的发电量在欧洲主张地块几何构型下的现值为13.6亿欧元，其中8.6亿欧元可通过权利持有人之间的支付进行转移；若按欧洲全量登记及完工率计算，损失达54.8亿欧元。作者提出对投下阴影征收预期费用可实现规划者在统一能源价格下的最优配置，而最小间距规则则排除了价值高于其所避免阴影成本的海床。
AI.research_question: 海上风电地块之间的尾流（阴影）方向性外部性规模有多大？现有制度是否为其定价？如何设计有效的治理机制？
AI.motivation: 海洋风电地块按块出售，上风向开发会减少下风向地块的发电产出却不支付任何代价，形成一种方向性外部性，现有文献和制度对此缺乏系统性测量和定价机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部性理论、产权与拍卖/租赁制度设计、空间规划与资源配置理论
AI.method: 利用计量发电（metered generation）数据和雷达后向散射（radar backscatter）数据测量尾流效应，以物理学原理构造安慰剂检验（placebo）；结合欧洲风电地块登记数据计算现值损失；并对比现有拍卖/租赁规则与提出的预期阴影费用机制的效率。
AI.findings: 邻近尾流使计量机队年发电量减少0.8%；现有拍卖或租赁规则均未对地块阴影征收费用；开发主张集中在迎风位置（造成的阴影多于接收的阴影）；开发商在自己地块内避免遮挡但将负担定价转嫁给他人；损失现值在欧洲主张几何下为13.6亿欧元（其中8.6亿可通过权利人间支付转移），全量登记完工率下为54.8亿欧元；预期阴影费用可实现最优配置，最小间距规则则排除价值高于所避免阴影的海床。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统测量了海上风电地块间尾流这一方向性外部性的规模，将物理学尾流模型与经济学外部性理论结合；揭示了现有产权制度（拍卖/租赁）未对这一外部性定价的制度缺陷；提出了基于"阴影费用"的机制设计以矫正外部性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海上风电地块拍卖和租赁规则设计提供实证基础，建议引入对地块阴影征收的预期费用；为政策制定者提供量化损失（数十亿欧元量级）的决策依据；揭示了开发商选址策略中外部性转嫁的行为模式。

title: From Disclosure Controls to Statutory Enforcement: Regulating Corporate Greenwashing through Forensic Accounting and a Comparative Analysis of HK SFC and UK FCA Regimes

detail.title: From Disclosure Controls to Statutory Enforcement: Regulating Corporate Greenwashing through Forensic Accounting and a Comparative Analysis of HK SFC and UK FCA Regimes

keywords: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) JEL Codes: M42

detail.abstract: As corporate sustainability disclosures transition from voluntary reporting to statutory mandates, corporate greenwashing presents a structural threat to financial market integrity and sustainable capital allocation. Utilizing a desk-based qualitative framework combining doctrinal legal research, comparative institutional analysis, and secondary literature synthesis. This study examines the regulatory enforcement gaps governing corporate greenwashing and evaluates the operational role of forensic accounting in verifying non-financial ESG claims. The findings reveal a distinct enforcement void in Hong Kong. The current oversight relies either on low-level consumer protection under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance (Cap. 362) yielding minor administrative fines or generalist anti-fraud provisions under Sections 107 and 300 of the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571), which impose prohibitive legal thresholds (mens rea and direct financial loss) without defining deceptive ESG terminology. In contrast, the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has established a targeted regulatory regime incorporating the Anti-Greenwashing Rule (FG24/3), Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR), and ESG 4.3 naming and marketing restrictions. This paper advocates that Hong Kong establishes dedicated statutory anti-greenwashing regulations by adapting the UK FCA's ESG 4.3 framework to local market circumstances. Within the Hong Kong government hierarchy, policy leadership should originate from the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau (FSTB), designating the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) as the primary statutory enforcement authority. To operationalize regulatory oversight, forensic accountants must be embedded within enforcement mechanisms to deploy AI-driven anomaly detection, blockchain audit trails and Scope 1-3 emissions reconciliations, converting raw corporate claims into courtroomadmissible evidence. Finally, to mitigate compliance cost barriers for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs), regulators should institute phased compliance timelines alongside standardized public digital verification infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨香港企业漂绿行为的监管执法缺口，通过比较英国FCA的监管框架（反漂绿规则、可持续披露要求、ESG 4.3命名与营销限制），主张香港应建立专门的法定反漂绿法规，由财库局主导政策、证监会作为主要执法机构，并将法务会计嵌入执法机制以验证非财务ESG声明，同时为中小企业设计分阶段合规安排。
AI.research_question: 香港在监管企业漂绿行为方面存在哪些执法缺口？如何借鉴英国经验建立有效的反漂绿监管框架，并发挥法务会计在ESG声明验证中的操作性作用？
AI.motivation: 随着企业可持续披露从自愿过渡到法定强制，漂绿行为对金融市场诚信和可持续资本配置构成结构性威胁。香港现有监管依赖低层次的消费者保护条款或门槛过高的反欺诈条款，缺乏针对ESG术语的明确定义和专门执法机制，形成明显的监管空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用基于案头的定性分析框架，结合了教义性法律研究（doctrinal legal research）、比较制度分析（comparative institutional analysis）和二手文献综合（secondary literature synthesis）。
AI.method: 案头定性研究方法，综合运用法律教义分析、香港与英国监管制度的比较分析以及二手文献综述。
AI.findings: （1）香港存在明显的漂绿执法真空：《商品说明条例》只能提供低层级消费者保护并施以小额行政罚款；（2）《证券及期货条例》第107条和第300条的一般性反欺诈条款设置了过高法律门槛（犯罪意图和直接经济损失要求），且未定义欺骗性ESG术语；（3）英国FCA已建立针对性的监管体制，包括反漂绿规则（FG24/3）、可持续披露要求（SDR）和ESG 4.3命名与营销限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了香港漂绿监管的制度性缺陷，提出将英国FCA的ESG 4.3框架本土化移植到香港的制度设计路径，并首次系统论法务会计在将原始企业声明转化为法庭可采证据中的操作性角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的政策建议：由香港财库局（FSTB）主导政策制定，指定证监会（SFC）为法定执法机构；将法务会计嵌入执法机制，运用AI驱动的异常检测、区块链审计追踪和范围1-3排放对账；为中小企业设置分阶段合规时间表和标准化公共数字验证基础设施。

title: Thorin Measures and Zeta Zeros
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Thorin Measures and Zeta Zeros
detail.abstract: Recent experiments realise the nontrivial zeros of ζ as dynamical quantum phase transitions, with Re(s) an inverse temperature and Im(s) an evolution time. That is the pairing which organises Thorin’s representation of a generalised gamma convolution, and this paper develops the consequences. The Gibbs state in those experiments is the Riemann zeta distribution: its characteristic function is ζ(β + it)/ζ(β), the Euler product is a Levy–Khintchine exponent, unique factorisation is the decomposition of that law into independent prime power jumps, and no transition can occur for Re(s) > 1 because infinitely divisible characteristic functions do not vanish. The main result is that the Riemann Hypothesis holds if and only if Φ(λ) = ξ(1/2)/ξ(1/2 + √ λ) is the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution, necessarily that of X = P k Ek/γ2 k with Ek independent standard exponentials. The Thorin measure is the zero counting measure pushed forward by squaring, with density (4π √ v) −1 log( √ v/2π); the Levy density is x −1Θ(x) with Θ the heat trace of the conjectural Hilbert–Polya operator; the cumulants are (m − 1)!P k γ −2m k ; and − log Φ(λ) ∼ πN( √ λ), whence − log P(X ≤ ε) ∼ log2 (1/ε)/16ε. Second quantisation unifies the picture: 1/Φ is the free fermion partition function of a gas with single particle weights γ −2 k and Φ the free boson one, their Taylor coefficients being the elementary and complete homogeneous symmetric functions of those weights, so the hypothesis says exactly that the weights are positive. The fermionic side is a Polya frequency condition, which places the Turan inequalities and the Jensen polynomial results in this frame; the bosonic side is a Stieltjes moment condition computable from ξ at the central point without any zeros, and verified here through order six. On the apparatus side the probe qubit measures a characteristic function, its dephasing bath spectral density is the Levy measure, and the probe’s time reversal symmetry is the involution whose quotient defines the Thorin variable. These are equivalences rather than a proof strategy, and the circularity that would have to be broken is stated explicitly.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了黎曼ζ函数非平凡零点与量子动力相变之间的深层联系，建立了一套基于"广义gamma卷积"（generalized gamma convolution, GGC）与Thorin测度的严格数学框架，证明黎曼猜想等价于一个具体的Laplace变换（Φ(λ)）是广义gamma卷积的条件。论文通过第二量子化统一了费米子/玻色子图像，将零点计数测度、Levy密度、累积量等核心对象全部联系起来，并在谱密度与时间反演对称性方面给出了实验装置层面的物理解释。
AI.research_question: 黎曼ζ函数的非平凡零点（黎曼猜想）能否通过广义gamma卷积（GGC）与Thorin测度的框架获得全新的等价刻画？该框架如何将实验观测到的量子动力相变、特征函数、费米子/玻色子配分函数等概念统一起来？
AI.motivation: 近期实验将黎曼ζ函数的非平凡零点实现为动力学量子相变，其中Re(s)对应逆温度、Im(s)对应演化时间。这一配对恰好与Thorin对广义gamma卷积的表示相吻合。作者希望以此为切入点，发展该框架的理论推论，最终将黎曼猜想转化为一个可检验的数学条件——即Φ(λ)是否为广义gamma卷积的Laplace变换。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的核心理论框架包括：(1) 广义gamma卷积理论与Thorin测度；(2) 黎曼zeta分布及其特征函数（通过Euler乘积构造Levy-Khintchine指数）；(3) 第二量子化框架——自由费米子与自由玻色子配分函数；(4) Polya频率条件与Stieltjes矩条件；(5) Hilbert-Polya猜想与热迹表示。
AI.method: 作者采用数论、概率论与数学物理交叉的方法论：(1) 将ζ(β+it)/ζ(β)识别为黎曼zeta分布的特征函数，利用无穷可分特征函数的不消失性解释Re(s)>1时无非平凡相变；(2) 证明黎曼猜想等价于Φ(λ)为GGC的Laplace变换，并具体给出Thorin测度（零点计数测度经平方推后）及其密度函数；(3) 通过第二量子化将1/Φ与Φ分别解释为自由费米子与自由玻色子的配分函数；(4) 在玻色子侧通过Stieltjes矩条件从中心点ξ值出发计算（验证至六阶），在费米子侧通过Polya频率条件将Turán不等式与Jensen多项式结果纳入框架；(5) 在实验装置方面分析探测量子比特的特征函数测量、退相干谱密度（即Levy测度）及时间反演对称性（即定义Thorin变量的对合）。
AI.findings: (1) 黎曼猜想成立当且仅当Φ(λ)=ξ(1/2)/ξ(1/2+√λ)是广义gamma卷积的Laplace变换，且该卷积对应随机变量X=Σ_k E_k/γ_k²（E_k为独立标准指数分布）；(2) Thorin测度是零点计数测度平方推后所得，密度为(4π√v)^{-1}log(√v/2π)；(3) Levy密度为x^{-1}Θ(x)，其中Θ为Hilbert-Polya算子的猜想热迹；(4) 累积量为(m-1)!Σ_k γ_k^{-2m}；(5) 渐近行为-log Φ(λ)∼πN(√λ)，且-log P(X≤ε)∼log²(1/ε)/16ε；(6) 第二量子化框架中，1/Φ为自由费米子配分函数、Φ为自由玻色子配分函数，泰勒系数分别对应初等与完全齐次对称函数，黎曼猜想恰等价于这些权重为正；(7) 费米子侧给出Polya频率条件（涵盖Turán不等式与Jensen多项式结果），玻色子侧给出可从中心点ξ值计算的Stieltjes矩条件（验证至六阶）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将黎曼猜想严格等价地刻画为广义gamma卷积条件，建立了一个连接解析数论、概率论与量子统计物理的普适数学框架；(2) 通过第二量子化统一了零点、对称函数、配分函数与Laplace变换，揭示了黎曼猜想的"谱正性"本质（自由费米子与玻色子对偶）；(3) 将Polya频率理论（Turán不等式、Jensen多项式）与Stieltjes矩问题整合到同一框架中，建立了数论不等式与矩理论之间的桥梁；(4) 为Hilbert-Polya猜想提供了概率论层面的具体化表述（Levy密度为热迹）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为实验观测黎曼零点提供了严格的理论基础：阐明了探测量子比特测得的特征函数、退相干谱密度（Levy测度）以及时间反演对称性（Thorin对合）在数学上的精确对应关系；(2) 给出了无需显式知道零点即可从中心点ξ值计算的多项式可验证条件（Stieltjes矩条件已验至六阶），为数值检验黎曼猜想提供了新的具体工具；(3) 明确了该框架是等价关系而非证明策略，明确指出需要打破的循环论证，为未来研究指明了突破方向。

title: Prediction of TP53 Mutation Status in Glioma Based on Terahertz Spectral Data and DA-RMCNet Model
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Capital Medical University - Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University - Beijing Tiantan Hospital, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Science and Technology Beijing and Capital Medical University - Beijing Tiantan Hospital

detail.title: Prediction of TP53 Mutation Status in Glioma Based on Terahertz Spectral Data and DA-RMCNet Model
detail.abstract: Glioma is the primary malignant tumor of the central nervous system and has a high mortality rate. TP53 is an important molecular marker in glioma, and its mutational status is closely associated with tumor malignancy and patient prognosis. To address the limitations of traditional molecular detection methods, such as long turnaround times, complex procedures, and difficulty in meeting intraoperative rapid diagnosis requirements, this paper proposes a TP53 mutation prediction method for glioma based on terahertz spectral data and a dual-attention residual multi-scale convolutional network (DA-RMCNet). Firstly, the collected terahertz absorption spectra of glioma tissues are preprocessed. Subsequently, a residual multi-scale convolutional network integrating a frequency attention mechanism and an SE (Squeeze-and-Excitation) channel attention mechanism is constructed to achieve synergistic enhancement of key spectral bands and important feature channels as well as multi-scale spectral feature extraction. Experimental results demonstrated that DA-RMCNet achieved a classification accuracy of 0.8636 and an AUC value of 0.9350 in the TP53 mutation prediction task, it is superior to traditional machine learning models.The results indicated that terahertz time-domain spectroscopy combined with deep learning methods were enable rapid prediction of TP53 mutation status in glioma, providing a technical approach for intraoperative molecular pathological diagnosis of glioma.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于太赫兹光谱数据和双注意力残差多尺度卷积网络（DA-RMCNet）的胶质瘤TP53突变预测方法，通过融合频域注意力和SE通道注意力机制实现关键光谱波段和特征通道的协同增强，在分类任务中达到0.8636的准确率和0.9350的AUC值，优于传统机器学习方法，为术中分子病理诊断提供了快速技术方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用太赫兹光谱数据结合深度学习实现胶质瘤TP53突变状态的快速、准确预测，以满足术中快速诊断需求？
AI.motivation: 胶质瘤是中枢神经系统高致死率的原发性恶性肿瘤，TP53突变状态与肿瘤恶性程度和患者预后密切相关。传统分子检测方法存在周转时间长、流程复杂、难以满足术中快速诊断需求等局限性，亟需开发一种快速、准确的TP53突变预测技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于太赫兹时域光谱技术、多尺度卷积神经网络、频域注意力机制（frequency attention）和SE通道注意力机制（Squeeze-and-Excitation channel attention）等理论与技术。
AI.method: 首先对采集的胶质瘤组织太赫兹吸收光谱进行预处理，随后构建融合频域注意力机制和SE通道注意力机制的残差多尺度卷积网络（DA-RMCNet），实现关键光谱波段和重要特征通道的协同增强及多尺度光谱特征提取，最终完成TP53突变分类预测。
AI.findings: DA-RMCNet在TP53突变预测任务中取得了0.8636的分类准确率和0.9350的AUC值，性能优于传统机器学习模型。太赫兹时域光谱结合深度学习方法能够实现胶质瘤TP53突变状态的快速预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种融合频域注意力和SE通道注意力的残差多尺度卷积网络架构（DA-RMCNet），为太赫兹光谱数据在生物医学领域的深度学习分析提供了新的方法论范式，拓展了注意力机制在光谱分类任务中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为胶质瘤术中分子病理诊断提供了一种快速、非侵入性的技术路径，有望克服传统分子检测周转时间长、流程复杂的局限，支持术中实时决策；同时证明太赫兹光谱结合深度学习在肿瘤分子标志物检测中的应用潜力。

title: Global GDP Per Capita Growth (1961–2025) and Solar Activity (1960–2024): R2=0.90
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global GDP Per Capita Growth (1961–2025) and Solar Activity (1960–2024): R2=0.90
detail.abstract: Subject of the study: This paper examines the causal relationship between solar activity (SA) cycles (1960-2023) and the growth rate of global GDP per capita for the period 1960-2024, i.e., with a lag of one year. Methodology: The author develops the methodological approach of W.S. Jevons and A.L. Chizhevsky, supplementing it with the modern biochemical concept of Russell Reiter. Main results: Statistical reliability: A high correlation between the indicators was found: the approximation reliability coefficient R2 is 0.93 for the 12-year average cycle, R2 = 0.99 for years 1-5 of the SA cycle (the SA growth phase, 29 years of observations), and R2 = 0.94 for years 5-12 of the SA cycle (the SA decline phase, 40 years of observations). A three-zone biochemical model: The mechanism by which ultraviolet (UV) radiation influences the economy through human neurochemistry is substantiated: - "Biological depression" zone (Wolf number (W) < 20): a deficiency of ultraviolet (UV) radiation leads to a decrease in serotonin levels, creating a mood of pessimism and stagnation in global per capita GDP with a lag of one year. - "Biological optimum" zone (W = 20 - 140): sufficient levels of serotonin and melatonin ensure optimism and peak growth rates of global per capita GDP with a lag of one year. - "Biological stress" zone (W > 140): extreme solar activity suppresses melatonin production (according to R. Reiter's concept), causing "exhaustion pessimism" and a sharp decline in global per capita GDP with a lag of one year. The nature of the one-year lag is substantiated. This one-year lag is a consequence of the inertia of economic contracts: the psycho-emotional state of decision-makers in the current year determines the parameters of contracts, the results of which are reflected in the GDP statistics of the following year. Forecast: Based on the model, the expected growth rates of global GDP per capita are calculated: 1.3% in 2025 and 2.05% in 2026. A significant slowdown in this indicator is projected to -0.1% in 2031 due to the solar minimum being reached in 2030.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1960-2023年太阳活动周期与全球人均GDP增长率（滞后一年）之间的因果关系，提出了三区生化模型，发现不同太阳活动水平通过紫外线影响人类神经化学（血清素和褪黑素），进而影响全球经济表现，R²高达0.93-0.99，并给出2025-2031年的预测。
AI.research_question: 太阳活动周期（1960-2023）是否以及如何因果性地影响全球人均GDP增长率（1960-2024）？
AI.motivation: 将W.S. Jevons和A.L. Chizhevsky的太阳活动与经济周期研究方法论进行现代化拓展，并纳入Russell Reiter的现代生化概念，以解释太阳活动影响经济的微观机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 太阳活动-经济周期理论（Jevons & Chizhevsky方法论）、紫外线-神经化学机制（血清素与褪黑素调节）、Reiter褪黑素抑制概念、经济合同惯性理论（一年滞后解释）
AI.method: 基于Jevons和Chizhevsky方法论的定量统计回归分析，结合Russell Reiter的生化概念构建三区生化模型，计算拟合优度R²并用于预测。
AI.findings: 1）太阳活动与全球人均GDP增长率高度相关：12年平均周期R²=0.93，上升期（1-5年）R²=0.99，下降期（5-12年）R²=0.94；2）确立三区生化模型（"生物抑郁区"W<20、"生物最优区"W=20-140、"生物应激区"W>140）；3）论证了一年滞后的经济合同惯性机制；4）预测2025年增长1.3%、2026年增长2.05%、2031年降至-0.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将19世纪Jevons和20世纪Chizhevsky的古典太阳活动-经济理论升级为现代生化机制解释，将紫外线通过神经化学影响决策者心理状态进而影响经济产出的因果链条理论化，并对滞后机制给出了基于经济合同惯性的原创性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球经济增长预测提供基于太阳活动周期的前瞻性工具，可辅助政府和企业根据太阳活动阶段调整经济预期和决策策略，尤其在太阳活动极端时期提前预警经济下行风险。

title: How Does Education Funding Affect the Quality of School Education And PISA Results?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Nazarbayev Intellectual School of Physics and Mathematics in Aktobe, Almaty Management (ALMA) University, Kokshetau University named after Abai Myrzakhmetov (KUAM) and Kokshetau University named after Abai Myrzakhmetov (KUAM)

detail.title: How Does Education Funding Affect the Quality of School Education And PISA Results?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no
declarations.funderStatement: no

detail.abstract: Background: The quality of school education depends on several factors, including the funding of public schools, and affects a country's ranking. This article examines the relationship between PISA results and school education funding. The objective of this study is to analyse the impact of state funding of education expenditure on the quality of education in state schools in Kazakhstan, based on a study of the relationship between mathematics literacy results and education funding in leading countries according to PISA results, as well as an analysis of a survey of Kazakhstani school principals. Research Method: Theoretical and empirical methods of scientific inquiry are used, including Pearson and Spearman correlation analyses and factor analysis based on the use of the SPSS computer program. Research Findings: The results of the correlation and factor analyses indicate a partial relationship between the structure of school funding sources and the quality of education in Kazakhstan. Budgetary funding remains the primary source of support for public schools, and the findings provide partial statistical evidence of its influence. Conclusion: The results of the correlation and factor analyses of the survey data confirm research hypothesis H1 and show that there is a partial correlation between the funding of school education and the quality of student learning outcomes in state schools in Kazakhstan, including in relation to PISA. Contribution: This study provides a comparative analysis of school education funding based on survey data from school headteachers and PISA results. It identifies relationships between educational quality indicators and funding structures and highlights effective funding practices in leading PISA countries, with the aim of informing improvements in Kazakhstan's education funding system and enhancing the quality of public education.

AI.tldr: 本文基于PISA结果和哈萨克斯坦学校校长调查数据，采用皮尔逊、斯皮尔曼相关分析和因子分析，考察国家教育经费投入对公立学校教育质量的影响。研究发现学校经费来源结构与教育质量之间存在部分相关关系，预算拨款仍是公立学校的主要支持来源，并验证了研究假设H1。
AI.research_question: 国家教育经费投入如何影响哈萨克斯坦公立学校的教育质量？具体而言，学校经费来源结构与PISA数学素养成绩之间存在何种关系？
AI.motivation: 学校教育质量受多种因素影响，包括公立学校的经费投入，且影响国家排名。哈萨克斯坦希望借鉴PISA领先国家的有效经费实践，改善本国教育经费体系以提高公共教育质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育经费投入与教育质量关系理论；基于PISA评估的教育质量比较框架
AI.method: 理论分析与实证分析相结合，采用皮尔逊相关分析、斯皮尔曼相关分析和因子分析，使用SPSS统计软件处理哈萨克斯坦学校校长调查数据及PISA数据。
AI.findings: 学校经费来源结构与哈萨克斯坦教育质量之间存在部分相关关系；预算拨款仍是公立学校的主要经费来源；研究发现为预算经费对教育质量的影响提供了部分统计证据，验证了研究假设H1。
AI.theory_contributions: 基于校长调查数据和PISA结果的比较分析，揭示了教育质量指标与经费结构之间的关系，为理解教育经费与教育质量的关联提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了PISA领先国家的有效经费实践，为改进哈萨克斯坦教育经费体系、提升公共教育质量提供政策参考。

title: The Double Bottom Under the Microscope

detail.title: The Double Bottom Under the Microscope
detail.abstract: We test the widely-taught belief that a double-bottom pattern signals a reliable price reversal, using roughly seven years of hourly data across six liquid futures markets and 13,704 detected occurrences. We measure not only whether the pattern is followed by higher prices, but whether it does so more than a random entry at the same moment-the only test that separates a genuine signal from the rising tide of a bull market. We find that the double bottom carries no statistically reliable predictive edge. None of three entry points (formation, confirmation, neckline break) beats random consistently across markets, and none of five traditional quality filters (symmetry, volume, prior trend, low-match tightness, and a purpose-built similarity score) carries forward information. The one effect that appears overwhelmingly significant-the neckline break-proves mechanical: it measures a move already in progress and vanishes when measured forward from a point a trader could act on. The result is consistent across all six instruments. We report the descriptive analysis and the negative tradability result together, with full sample sizes and methodology, so that other researchers can verify, extend, or refute this work.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用六个流动性期货市场约七年的小时数据，检测了13704个双底形态，发现双底形态并不具有统计上可靠的预测优势，三个入场点（形态形成、确认、颈线突破）均未稳定跑赢随机入场，五种传统质量过滤指标也无前瞻信息。唯一的显著效应（颈线突破）被发现是机械性的——它衡量的是已在进行中的走势，而非可交易的信号。
AI.research_question: 双底形态是否真正具有可靠的预测价格反转的能力，还是仅仅是一种在市场上升趋势中的随机表现？
AI.motivation: 双底形态是金融教育中广泛教授的技术分析形态，但其预测能力从未在严格的对照组设计中得到验证。以往研究未区分"跟随形态后价格是否上涨"与"是否比同期随机入场更好"，后者才是判断信号真正价值的唯一标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于弱式有效市场假说与技术分析的统计检验框架，采用"随机入场对照"作为区分真实信号与牛市上升潮流的基准方法。
AI.method: 使用六个流动性期货市场约七年小时数据，检测出13704个双底形态；比较三个入场点（形成、确认、颈线突破）与随机入场的绩效差异；检验五种传统质量过滤指标（对称性、成交量、先前趋势、低点紧密度、相似度评分）的前瞻信息含量。
AI.findings: 双底形态在所有六个市场中均无统计上可靠的预测优势；三个入场点均未稳定跑赢随机入场；五种质量过滤指标均不含前瞻信息；唯一显著效应"颈线突破"被证明是机械性的，因为该测量从交易者可操作的时点起算后效应即消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 对弱式有效市场假说提供了新的实证支持，揭示了"形态预测"与"随机入场"比较方法的重要性，并阐明了技术分析中"伪显著效应"（机械性效应）可能如何误导研究者。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业人员和教育者提供了双底形态无效性的严格实证证据，警示交易者不应将双底形态作为可靠的交易信号；提供了完整的方法论和样本量，便于其他研究者验证或反驳。

title: The Hidden Cost of Cancelling NEET-UG 2026

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Cancelling NEET-UG 2026
detail.abstract: The National Testing Agency cancelled the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test, Undergraduate (NEET-UG) examination of 3 May 2026 after evidence of a paper leak, and held a fresh examination on 21 June. Registration data carried forward unchanged, so agency records show how many registered candidates chose not to sit the second examination. About 12% stayed away, roughly four times the rate of the three preceding years. Around 2.17 lakh more candidates were absent than recent experience predicts, and the shortfall was uneven. Kerala and Tamil Nadu recorded rates near 25%, while Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan stayed below 8%. Women stayed away at a higher rate than men, reversing the earlier pattern. The Joint Entrance Examination, Main (JEE-Main), conducted by the same agency in the same year, shows no comparable break from its own trend. The evidence is descriptive and identifies no mechanism, but it does establish that re-conducting the examination carried a substantial cost of lost participation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析印度国家考试局（NTA）在2026年因试卷泄露而取消并重考NEET-UG考试的行政数据，发现约12%的已注册考生选择缺席重考，约为前三年缺考率的四倍，且缺席率在地区与性别间分布不均。研究为"重考导致参与率大幅下降"提供了描述性证据。
AI.research_question: 当一场高风险入学考试因泄题被取消并重新举行时，有多少已注册考生选择不再参加重考？重考参与率的下降在不同地区和性别间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 考试泄题后重考是常见的补救措施，但重考可能带来参与率下降的"隐性成本"。以往研究多关注泄题本身或重考的公平性问题，缺少对重考参与率损失的定量刻画；本研究利用NTA行政数据的独特条件（注册信息不变）来量化这一成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究属于描述性实证研究，未明确提出特定理论框架，但隐含了考生应试决策（考试成本、信心丧失、路径替代等）的个体行为逻辑。
AI.method: 利用NTA行政数据（注册数据跨考试保持不变）进行描述性统计分析；将2026年重考缺考率与前三年基线缺考率对比，并分邦（Kerala、Tamil Nadu、Uttar Pradesh、Rajasthan）与分性别进行异质性分析；以同机构同年举行的JEE-Main考试作为对照参照。
AI.findings: (1) 约12%的注册考生缺席重考，约为前三年缺考率的四倍，额外约21.7万名考生缺席；(2) 缺考率地区差异显著：Kerala和Tamil Nadu接近25%，而Uttar Pradesh和Rajasthan低于8%；(3) 女性缺考率高于男性，逆转了此前的性别模式；(4) 同期JEE-Main考试未出现类似趋势断裂，说明该现象并非系统性考试参与下降所致。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为"考试重考的隐性参与成本"这一议题提供了首个系统的量化描述性证据，填补了相关实证空白，为后续机制研究（如地区信任差异、性别差异）提供了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对考试机构（如NTA）具有直接政策启示：重考虽能修复公平性，但会牺牲约12%的参与率，且损失在部分地区（南印度）和女性群体中尤为严重，需要在重考决策时权衡公平修复与参与损失的取舍。

title: Evaluation of Policy-Relevant Forecasting Advantage of Machine and Deep Learning Models over Classical Econometrics: Evidence from Ghanaian Headline Inflation
affiliations: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), Akenten Appiah-Menka University of Skills Training and Entrepreneurial Development. Akenten Appiah-Menka University of Skills Training den Entrepreneurial Development,, University of Bradford and Transilvania University of Brasov

detail.title: Evaluation of Policy-Relevant Forecasting Advantage of Machine and Deep Learning Models over Classical Econometrics: Evidence from Ghanaian Headline Inflation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study evaluates whether machine learning and deep learning models offer a genuine forecasting advantage over classical econometric benchmarks for Ghana's headline (year-on-year) inflation, a question of direct relevance to a central bank operating an inflation-targeting regime in a small, commodity-exposed, currency-volatile economy. Using 280 months (January 2000-April 2023) of Bank of Ghana monetary and macro-financial data, we construct a strictly one-step-ahead forecasting matrix in which every predictor reflects information available one month before the forecast target, and compare nine models (a random walk and seasonal naive baseline, an AIC-selected ARIMA benchmark, two regularized linear models [Ridge, Lasso], two tree ensembles [Random Forest, XGBoost], a kernel method [Support Vector Regression], and a shallow feed-forward neural network) on a chronological train/validation/test split whose 42-month test window (October 2019-April 2023) deliberately spans Ghana's 2022-23 inflation surge. Contrary to the presumption that more flexible models dominate, the ARIMA(3,1,0) benchmark achieved the lowest test-set RMSE (2.41 percentage points), narrowly ahead of the random walk (2.65) and Lasso (3.41). However, Diebold-Mariano tests show that ARIMA is not statistically distinguishable from either of these two closest competitors, while its advantage over every other model is statistically significant. Every nonlinear machine learning model underperformed both simple baselines out of sample, with several models (notably XGBoost and the neural network) showing a large gap between near-perfect training fit and poor test performance: a textbook overfitting signature accentuated by the regime shift embedded in the test period. We argue this is a genuine and policy-relevant finding rather than a failure of specification: headline inflation is highly persistent, and models that best exploit that persistence, rather than those with the greatest functional flexibility, forecast best through a structural break. The study details a leakage-free feature-engineering protocol, reports full hyperparameter-tuning and diagnostic results, and discusses the conditions, such as larger samples, richer nonlinear feature sets, or regime-aware architectures, under which machine learning might be expected to add value for inflation forecasting in a market such as Ghana's.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用加纳280个月的宏观经济数据，通过严格的一步前向预测框架对比9种模型（从随机游走到神经网络），发现ARIMA(3,1,0)基准模型在42个月测试窗口中获得最低RMSE（2.41个百分点），机器学习模型普遍因过拟合和制度突变而表现不佳，表明在高持续性通胀预测中，利用持续性的简单模型优于功能灵活性的复杂模型。
AI.research_question: 机器学习和深度学习模型相对于经典计量经济基准模型，是否能为加纳的同比通胀率预测提供真正的优势？
AI.motivation: 加纳央行实行通胀目标制，但该国属于小型、大宗商品暴露、货币波动剧烈的经济体，通胀预测对其货币政策决策至关重要。现有研究常假设更灵活的模型会主导预测表现，但缺乏在制度突变背景下对机器学习模型与经典基准的系统性实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀持续性理论（通胀具有高度持续性，预测中利用持续性是关键）；过度拟合与偏差-方差权衡理论；制度突变（regime shift）下的模型稳健性理论。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2023年4月加纳银行280个月数据，构建严格的一步前向预测矩阵（所有预测变量仅使用预测目标前一个月的信息），按时间顺序划分训练/验证/测试集（42个月测试窗口覆盖2022-23通胀飙升），对比9种模型：随机游走、季节性朴素、AIC选择ARIMA、Ridge、Lasso、随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量回归、浅层前馈神经网络，并用Diebold-Mariano检验评估预测差异的统计显著性。
AI.findings: ARIMA(3,1,0)取得最低测试集RMSE（2.41个百分点），略优于随机游走（2.65）和Lasso（3.41）。Diebold-Mariano检验显示ARIMA与随机游走和Lasso无显著差异，但显著优于所有其他模型。所有非线性机器学习模型在样本外均劣于简单基准，XGBoost和神经网络显示出训练集近乎完美但测试集表现差的过拟合特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"更灵活的模型必然预测更好"的预设，证明在高持续性通胀且存在制度突变的背景下，模型对持续性的利用能力比功能灵活性更重要；提供了"过拟合+制度变迁"双重因素下机器学习预测失效的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳央行在通胀目标制下的预测建模提供实证指导：ARIMA等经典模型可能比复杂机器学习模型更可靠；提供无泄漏的特征工程协议、完整的超参数调优和诊断结果；讨论了机器学习可能在何种条件下（更大样本、更丰富非线性特征、制度感知架构）增加价值。

title: Acting to Believe
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School and University of Texas at Dallas

detail.title: Acting to Believe
detail.abstract: Can people build confidence simply by misremembering the past, or must they act to earn it? We examine these two routes in a field experiment with university students completing two rounds of self-control tasks. Before the second round, students were randomly assigned to receive no reminder, an expected reminder, or an unexpected reminder of first-round performance. Reminders correct potential memory bias and separate confidence generated by biased recall from confidence generated by effort. Students without reminders formed a positive memory bias, recalling first-round performance as better than it was, but this bias did not robustly increase confidence or second-task participation relative to the unexpected-reminder group. In contrast, students expecting a reminder exerted significantly more first-round effort, then reported higher confidence in self-control and participated more in the second task. We develop an intrapersonal self-signaling model driven by either a self-regulation or a self-image motive. Our findings support the self-regulation motive.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项实地实验，探讨了人们能否仅通过错误记忆过去来建立自信，还是必须通过实际行动来赢得自信。研究发现，记忆偏差并未稳健地提升自信或任务参与度，而真正付出努力（预期会收到提醒）的学生表现出更高的自信和更强的参与意愿。研究支持自我调节动机驱动的内心自我信号模型。
AI.research_question: 人们能否通过误记过去（记忆偏差）来建立自信，还是必须通过实际行动（付出努力）来赢得自信？
AI.motivation: 关于自信来源的核心争论：自信是可以通过认知重建（如选择性记忆）人为构建的，还是必须基于真实行动和努力。已有研究尚未在实地环境中清晰区分这两条路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内心自我信号理论（intrapersonal self-signaling model），包括自我调节动机（self-regulation motive）和自我形象动机（self-image motive）两种驱动机制。
AI.method: 实地实验：大学生完成两轮自我控制任务，在第二轮前随机分配为三组——无提醒组、预期提醒组、意外提醒组。提醒用于纠正潜在记忆偏差，从而分离偏差驱动的自信与努力驱动的自信。
AI.findings: 1. 无提醒组形成了正向记忆偏差（高估第一轮表现），但该偏差未稳健地提升自信或第二轮参与率；2. 预期提醒组在第一轮付出显著更多努力，随后报告更高的自我控制自信，并更多参与第二轮任务；3. 结果支持自我调节动机而非自我形象动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自信来源区分为记忆偏差路径与努力行动路径，通过实验设计巧妙分离二者；为内心自我信号理论提供了实地证据，并明确支持自我调节动机的机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 对教育、组织管理和个人发展具有启示：提醒机制和预期监督可以激励个体付出更多努力并建立真实自信，而依赖自我欺骗式记忆并不能持久提升自信和后续行为参与。

title:
FROM MASSERA TO INFANTINO
Were World Cups Fixed in Argentina's Favor?

detail.title:
FROM MASSERA TO INFANTINO
Were World Cups Fixed in Argentina's Favor?
detail.abstract:
The relationship between Argentina and the World Cup contains two historical moments in which sporting success was surrounded by an extraordinarily problematic institutional structure. In 1978, the tournament was organized by a dictatorship that used the championship as an instrument of internal legitimation and international propaganda. The 6–0 victory over Peru remains the object of suspicion, testimony, and hypotheses of political intervention, although the available public record lacks the documentation needed to establish a fixed match conclusively. Between the two poles, the presidency of Joseph Blatter (1998–2015) left the systemic corruption of the FIFA apparatus proven, with individual responsibilities fragmented between internal ethics sanctions and criminal acquittals. Between 2022 and 2026 a different configuration appears: a statistically extraordinary concentration of penalties and favorable decisions, combined with an opaque international organization, commercially dependent on Lionel Messi and capable of relaxing disciplinary procedures under political pressure.
Argentina was awarded eight penalties in twelve World Cup matches between Qatar 2022 and the 2026 round of 16, a figure that became eight in thirteen after the quarterfinal against Switzerland. That match added no penalties, but it did add another favorable decision of maximum impact: the second yellow card and sending-off of Breel Embolo following a VAR intervention, with the match level and Switzerland in its best stretch. In Qatar, Argentina received five penalties, a record for a single team in one edition. In 2026 a second series accumulated: three penalties in the first five matches, one booking per 19.7 fouls through the round of 16, the absence of any relevant sanction against Messi for a challenge comparable to others punished with a sending-off, and several borderline decisions of high impact against Egypt and Switzerland.
This paper separates three planes that public discussion tends to blur: statistical anomaly,institutional favoritism, and deliberate coordination. Thefirstis real and measurable. The second is documented off the pitch through the inclusion of Inter Miami in the Club World Cup, the disciplinary elasticity applied to commercially valuable figures, and the political intervention surrounding Folarin Balogun’s sanction. The public celebration of Infantino alongside Claudio Tapia and Alejandro Domínguez after the win over Cape Verde further degraded the appearance of neutrality. Deliberate coordination of refereeing decisions, by contrast, remains undemonstrated: communications, payments, instructions, trace ability of appointments, and internal testimony are all missing.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿根廷国家队在2022年卡塔尔世界杯至2026年世界杯期间获得的统计上异常的有利判罚（包括创纪录的点球数和关键红牌），将公众讨论中常被混淆的三个层面——统计异常、制度性偏袒和蓄意协调——进行了区分，认为前两者有据可查，而蓄意协调缺乏证据。
AI.research_question: 阿根廷在2022-2026年世界杯期间获得的有利判罚是否构成统计异常？这种异常背后究竟是制度性偏袒还是蓄意协调？
AI.motivation: 阿根廷在2022年卡塔尔世界杯获得5个点球（单届纪录），在2026年世界杯继续获得异常多的点球和有利判罚，公众讨论常将统计异常、制度偏袒与蓄意操纵混为一谈，需要系统性梳理与区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文章参照了1978年阿根廷军政府主办世界杯及约瑟夫·布拉特（1998-2015）时期FIFA系统性腐败的历史脉络，构建了一个三层分析框架：统计异常（measurable）、制度性偏袒（institutional favoritism，可通过场外证据佐证）和蓄意协调（deliberate coordination，需要通信、支付、指示、任命可追溯性及内部证词等证据）。
AI.method: 本文采用多平面比较分析方法：（1）对2022-2026年阿根廷世界杯比赛中的点球数、黄牌频率、关键判罚进行统计量化；（2）对场外证据（国际米兰迈阿密进入世俱杯、纪律程序弹性、巴洛贡制裁的政治干预、因凡蒂诺与阿根廷足协高层公开同庆等）进行制度性分析；（3）对蓄意协调假设所需证据类型（通信、付款、指示、任命可追溯性、内部证词）进行证据缺口检验。
AI.findings: （1）统计异常是真实且可测量的：阿根廷在卡塔尔获5个点球创纪录，2026年在前5场获3个点球，16强赛前每19.7次犯规收获1张对手黄牌；（2）制度性偏袒有场外文档佐证：国际米兰迈阿密被纳入世俱杯、对商业价值高的球星实施纪律弹性、巴洛贡制裁受到政治干预、因凡蒂诺与阿根廷足协高层公开庆贺；（3）蓄意协调缺乏证据：通信、付款、指示、裁判任命的可追溯性及内部证词均缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了一个区分"统计异常—制度偏袒—蓄意协调"的三层分析框架，避免将可测量的统计异常与未经验证的阴谋论混为一谈，为体育治理研究提供了更精细的概念工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际足联（FIFA）裁判任命透明度、纪律程序独立性及利益冲突管理提供了具体改进依据；提醒媒体与公众在讨论判罚争议时区分证据层级，避免用统计异常直接推导蓄意操纵的结论。

title: Do climate policy uncertainty and artificial intelligence matter in energy markets? A quantile-frequency connectedness analysis for China and the U.S
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Business School, Shandong University, Shandong University at Weihai and University of Wollongong

detail.title: Do climate policy uncertainty and artificial intelligence matter in energy markets? A quantile-frequency connectedness analysis for China and the U.S
detail.abstract: This study  proposes  a quantile and frequency connectedness network based on GARCH-MIDAS decomposition to investigate the state-dependent and horizon-specific spillover dynamics among climate policy uncertainty (CPU), artificial intelligence (AI), and energy markets in China and the United States. The results reveal strong state dependence within the CPU-AI-Energy system, with total connectedness rising significantly under both lower- and upper-tail market conditions, indicating stronger systemic synchronization during extreme periods. Frequency decomposition further shows that long-run spillovers dominate persistent systemic dependence, while short-run transmission mainly reflects temporary market adjustment. The analysis further reveals substantial cross-country heterogeneity. China’s climate policy uncertainty primarily contributes through persistent transmission, whereas U.S. climate policy uncertainty becomes more influential under stressed market conditions. AI displays heterogeneous transmission patterns across countries and horizons, with more active transmission under favorable market conditions. Energy markets predominantly function as shock absorbers, although responses vary across assets and frequencies. Cross-country interactions intensify under extreme conditions, highlighting the growing importance of international transmission and structural adjustment processes. Through a comparison between the U.S. and China, this study provides context-specific insights for systemic risk assessment and cross-market shock diagnostics in an increasingly AI-influenced global energy landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于GARCH-MIDAS分解构建分位数与频率连通性网络，考察中美两国气候政策不确定性（CPU）、人工智能（AI）与能源市场之间的状态依赖和时域特异性溢出动态。研究发现系统总连通性在极端市场条件下显著上升，长期溢出主导持久系统性依赖，且中美之间存在显著的跨国异质性。
AI.research_question: 气候政策不确定性、人工智能与能源市场之间在不同市场状态（分位数）和不同时间频率（短期/长期）下的溢出动态如何？中美两国在这些溢出效应中呈现怎样的异质性与跨国互动特征？
AI.motivation: 气候政策不确定性与AI技术的快速发展正深刻重塑全球能源市场格局，但现有研究缺乏对这三个市场之间状态依赖性和时域特异性溢出机制的系统考察，尤其是中美两大经济体的对比视角更为稀缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: GARCH-MIDAS分解方法、分位数连通性网络、频率连通性分解理论
AI.method: 基于GARCH-MIDAS分解的分位数与频率连通性网络方法，对中美两国的气候政策不确定性、AI和能源市场数据进行溢出效应分析，涵盖多分位数（尾部与中部）和多频率（短期与长期）维度。
AI.findings: （1）CPU-AI-能源系统的连通性呈现强状态依赖性，极端市场条件下总连通性显著上升；（2）长期溢出主导持久系统性依赖，短期溢出反映暂时性市场调整；（3）中国CPU主要通过持续性传导发挥作用，美国CPU在压力市场条件下影响力更大；（4）AI在不同国家和频率下呈现异质传导模式；（5）能源市场主要充当冲击吸收者；（6）极端条件下跨国互动显著增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将分位数与频率维度整合到CPU-AI-能源市场溢出分析框架中，揭示了状态依赖性与时域特异性的双重溢出特征；拓展了气候金融与AI-能源交叉领域的系统性风险理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中美两国政策制定者和投资者提供了系统性风险评估与跨市场冲击诊断的情境化见解，有助于在AI日益影响全球能源格局的背景下制定更精准的风险管理和政策应对策略。

title: Natural Disasters, Health and Recovery around the World
affiliations: International Institute of Social Studies of Erasmus University and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Institute of Social Studies (ISS)

detail.title: Natural Disasters, Health and Recovery around the World
detail.abstract: A substantial share of the world’s children resides in disaster-prone areas and suffers from stunted growth. Child growth in the first 1000 days of life can falter depending on health endowments, shocks and investments. We investigate growth faltering and catch-up in children exposed to comparable earthquakes in utero. Our analysis leverages georeferenced health and earthquake data from almost a million children under the age of five across 55 countries. Our preferred models exploit within cluster or mother variation and control for temporal trends. On average, we document adverse effects on children's height that are more pronounced when earthquakes are more unexpected and higher in magnitude. These average effects, however, conceal negative short-term effects and recovery mechanisms via parental health investments and economic recouping, alongside correlational evidence on development assistance, which coincide with subsequent catch-up growth. We discuss our findings and contributions within the literature on child health and disasters, which is relatively sparse on the analysis of post-disaster recovery mechanisms and has largely been confined to single-country studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用55个国家近百万名五岁以下儿童的地理参考健康数据与地震数据，考察子宫内暴露于可比地震对儿童生长迟缓及追赶生长的影响。研究发现地震平均对儿童身高有不利影响，且当地震更意外、震级更高时影响更显著；但这些平均效应掩盖了短期负面效应和通过父母健康投资、经济恢复及发展援助等机制实现的追赶生长。
AI.research_question: 子宫内暴露于地震如何影响儿童（出生后前1000天）的生长迟缓与追赶生长？哪些机制促进灾后儿童身高的恢复？
AI.motivation: 全球大量儿童居住在灾害多发地区并遭受生长迟缓，而现有关于儿童健康与灾害的文献对灾后恢复机制的分析较为稀少，且多局限于单一国家研究。本研究旨在利用多国、大规模数据填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童早期（前1000天）生长取决于健康禀赋、冲击与投资的理论框架；基于地震作为外生冲击的准自然实验框架。
AI.method: 利用55个国家近百万名五岁以下儿童的地理参考健康数据与地震数据，采用基于聚类或母亲固定效应的偏好模型，并控制时间趋势。
AI.findings: (1) 地震平均对儿童身高有不利影响，且当地震更意外、震级更高时负面影响更显著；(2) 平均效应掩盖了短期负面效应与随后的追赶生长；(3) 父母健康投资、经济恢复以及发展援助与追赶生长相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将研究范围从单一国家扩展到多国（55国），并聚焦于文献中相对薄弱的灾后恢复机制分析，深化了对儿童健康与灾害关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾后儿童健康干预政策提供实证依据，提示父母投资、经济恢复和发展援助对促进儿童追赶生长具有重要作用。

title: The Recipient on Both Sides: Section 504 and the Two Harms Only a University Can Produce with a License Plate Camera

detail.title: The Recipient on Both Sides: Section 504 and the Two Harms Only a University Can Produce with a License Plate Camera
detail.abstract: At least one hundred fifty American colleges and universities have connected their campuses to a private, nationwide automated license plate recognition network. The civil liberties literature treats this as a privacy, immigration, and First Amendment problem. It is also a disability discrimination problem, and no institution has been asked to answer for it. This Article argues that campus deployment violates Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act through two mechanisms that exist only in higher education. The first is documentary. The federal uniform system for disability parking puts the International Symbol of Access on the face of a special license plate, sized like the plate's own characters and physician-certified, which places a disability marker in the exact field the reader is built to capture. A municipality that photographs that field holds a photograph. A university holds the parking permit registry that maps every plate on its grounds to a name and an address, so the same photograph resolves to a person. The register is not built by decision. It is what one covered entity can assemble from components it already holds, and only a university holds all of them. The second is therapeutic, and it must be stated in the terms the clinical literature uses. Contemporary treatment for persecutory delusions does not proceed by presenting counterevidence, an approach that literature has long regarded as unproductive. It proceeds by helping the person learn, through direct experience, that a feared threat is not present. For persecutory belief that takes the common form of a conviction that one is being watched or followed, the learning target is a proposition about the environment, and on a networked campus that proposition is not available to be learned because it is false in the one respect the treatment must address. The university that operates the counseling center delivering that intervention is the same entity that operates the camera network, inside a single program or activity, because Section 504 defines that term to reach all of the operations of a postsecondary institution. In the municipal fact pattern the camera operator and the clinician are different entities. On a campus they are the same defendant, and the population is concentrated at the age of peak incidence. Section 504 is the correct instrument rather than Title II because a substantial share of the deploying institutions are private and outside Title II altogether. The Article maps the claim onto the discriminatory methods of administration and facility siting provisions, notes that the definition of facility expressly includes equipment and parking lots, addresses the vendor as a contractual arrangement rather than a shield, adds a failure-to-accommodate theory that does not depend on the contested availability of disparate impact, identifies a modification the vendor has already stated it is implementing under state law, and locates the surviving damages theory after recent limits on compensatory relief.

AI.tldr: 本文主张美国高校校园部署自动车牌识别（ALPR）网络违反了《康复法案》第504条，通过两种高等教育特有的机制构成残疾歧视：其一为"文书性"机制，联邦残疾停车牌系统将国际无障碍标志置于车牌正面，恰好落入ALPR摄像头的捕捉区域，而大学同时持有停车许可登记册，可将车牌照片直接关联到个人身份；其二为"治疗性"机制，当代针对被害妄想症的治疗依赖通过直接体验学习"威胁不存在"这一命题，而在联网校园中该命题为假（因为确实存在被监控），大学运营咨询中心与运营摄像头网络的是同一实体，构成同一"项目或活动"下的歧视。文章还论证了为何适用第504条而非《美国残疾人法》第二编（因大量部署机构为私立高校，不受第二编约束），并针对行政方法歧视、设施选址条款、供应商合同责任、合理便利 accommodation 理论及赔偿救济等进行了全面法律分析。
AI.research_question: 美国高校校园部署自动车牌识别（ALPR）网络是否构成对残疾人的歧视，以及如何依据《康复法案》第504条对此提起诉讼？
AI.motivation: 现有民权文献将校园ALPR网络仅视为隐私、移民和第一修正案问题，但忽略了其作为残疾歧视问题的维度。目前尚无任何机构被要求为此承担责任，而至少150所美国高校已接入全国性私有ALPR网络，受影响人群正好处于精神疾病（如被害妄想症）发病高峰年龄段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《康复法案》第504条（禁止接受联邦资助的项目中的残疾歧视）；《美国残疾人法》第二编（对比分析）；歧视性行政方法条款；设施选址条款（设施定义明确包含设备和停车场）；合理便利（failure-to-accommodate）理论；临床心理学中关于被害妄想症治疗的理论框架（反证据法被认为无效，需通过直接经验学习威胁不存在）。
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal 分析方法，结合：1）对《康复法案》第504条及其相关法规和判例的法条解释；2）对联邦残疾停车牌系统（国际无障碍标志+医生认证的特殊车牌）的文书性特征分析；3）对临床心理学文献中被害妄想症治疗方法的跨学科整合；4）对ALPR技术运作机制（车牌正面图像捕捉、停车登记册关联个人身份）的技术性分析；5）对公共/私立高校法律适用区分的制度性分析。
AI.findings: 1）校园ALPR部署构成第504条下的残疾歧视，存在"文书性"和"治疗性"两种高等教育特有的歧视机制；2）在文书机制中，残疾停车牌的特殊设计（国际无障碍标志置于车牌正面）使残疾状态直接暴露于摄像头捕捉范围，而大学持有的停车登记册使车牌能关联到个人身份；3）在治疗机制中，大学既是提供被害妄想症治疗（依赖"威胁不存在"的直接经验学习）的咨询中心运营者，又是运营摄像头网络的同一实体，使治疗所必须的学习条件无法成立；4）第504条是正确法律工具而非第二编，因大量部署机构为私立高校；5）该主张可映射到歧视性行政方法和设施选址条款上，设施定义明确包含设备和停车场，供货商应被视为合同安排而非免责屏障。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将校园ALPR网络定性为残疾歧视问题而非仅隐私/移民/第一修正案问题；提出"文书性"与"治疗性"两种仅在高等教育中存在的歧视机制；将临床心理学治疗理论与反歧视法交叉整合，论证治疗性歧视机制；论证第504条（而非第二编）为适用于私立高校的正确法律工具；拓展了facility定义（含设备与停车场）在第504条语境下的适用解释；提出不依赖争议性"差异影响"理论的合理便利主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校残疾学生及教职员工提供了一条新的法律救济路径；指出供货商已表明正在依据州法实施一项修改（可作为合理便利的突破口）；为律师在近期限制补偿性赔偿的司法背景下定位可行的损害救济理论；促使高校在部署ALPR网络时须进行第504条合规评估；为倡导者和政策制定者提供了将残疾歧视纳入校园监控技术审查框架的具体法律论证结构。

title: Delisting Finance and Servicing
affiliations: Democritus University of Thrace, Law School

detail.title: Delisting Finance and Servicing
detail.abstract: The article provides a legal assessment of the pivotal and often instigatory role of credit institutions in the growing voluntary delistings from European regulated markets. This phenomenon signals a reversal of the traditional shift from bank-based to capital market-based financing, positioning banks not merely as financiers, but as architects and sponsors of these complex corporate transactions. The analysis dissects the multifarious engagement of banks, commencing with the provision of structured acquisition finance (typically to dominant shareholders or special purpose vehicles-SPVs) designed to fund the buyout of minority shareholdings. It examines the intricate contractual frameworks of such credit facilities, which are engineered to mitigate credit risk through mechanisms including the "push-down" of acquisition debt onto the target entity (postdelisting), or, alternatively, through stringent covenants compelling expeditious repayment from the target's operational cash flows (if delisting proves unsuccessful). This analysis is contextualized within the architecture of EU company and capital markets law, particularly the prohibitions and rules on financial assistance, takeover bids and squeeze-out regimes. Beyond debt provision, the article elucidates the ancillary advisory and transactional services rendered by banks-including the issuance of fairness opinions and the certification of a bidder's financial capacity-which are indispensable to the execution of such operations. A significant portion of the discourse is dedicated to the attendant legal complexities and risks inherent in those bank activities. Two principal areas of concern are identified: first, the potential conflicts of interest emanating from the banks' diverse and sometimes antagonistic mandates as lenders, advisors, underwriters, asset managers, and proprietary traders; and second, the potential for contravention of the EU market abuse regime, given that the delisting strategy and its associated financing invariably constitute pricesensitive inside information. The article posits that while this deep involvement in delisting projects signifies a strategic resurgence for the banking sector, its future prospects are to be influenced significantly by the macroeconomic environment (interest rates) and market evolutions. Simultaneously, it proposes the implementation of robust internal governance and compliance mechanisms by the engaged banks and financial institutions, so that they mitigate all involved regulatory, litigation and reputational risks, effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文对信贷机构在欧洲受监管市场日益增多的自愿退市交易中所扮演的关键且常具煽动性的角色进行了法律评估，剖析了银行在结构化收购融资、咨询服务中的多重参与，以及由此引发的利益冲突和欧盟市场滥用监管风险。
AI.research_question: 信贷机构在欧洲上市公司自愿退市中扮演何种角色？其法律参与模式、合同框架设计及所面临的法律风险是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧洲市场出现从资本市场融资向银行融资逆转的趋势，银行从单纯融资方转变为退市交易的架构者和推动者，这一现象缺乏系统性的法律分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟公司法和资本市场法框架，包括财务援助禁令与规则、要约收购规则、挤出机制（squeeze-out regime）以及欧盟市场滥用监管制度。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis），通过对银行在退市交易中的各类参与模式——包括结构化收购融资合同的"债务下推"机制、严格契约条款、公平意见与财务能力认证等辅助服务——进行逐层解构与法律评估。
AI.findings: 识别出银行参与退市交易的两大核心法律风险领域：一是银行作为贷款人、顾问、承销商、资产管理者和自营交易商等多重角色间的利益冲突；二是退市策略及其融资安排构成价格敏感内幕信息，可能违反欧盟市场滥用制度。同时指出银行深度参与退市项目标志着银行业战略复兴，但其前景受宏观经济环境（利率）和市场演变影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将银行在自愿退市交易中的多重角色纳入统一法律分析框架，揭示银行从传统融资中介向退市交易"架构师与赞助者"的身份转变，并阐明了该转变与欧盟公司法和资本市场法之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为参与退市交易的银行和金融机构提出了强化内部治理与合规机制的具体建议，以有效缓解监管、诉讼和声誉风险；为监管机构和市场参与者理解银行在退市生态中的系统重要性提供了参考。

title: The Constitutional Architecture of Catastrophe: How Sudan's 2019 Charter Enabled the RSF's Rise and the 2023 Civil War
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Constitutional Architecture of Catastrophe: How Sudan's 2019 Charter Enabled the RSF's Rise and the 2023 Civil War

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The subject is an important part of my research
declarations.ethicsApproval: I am the author of the paper
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

keywords: Parallel Army / Dual-Army Structure. Weak Accountability Mechanisms

detail.abstract: The paper offers a comprehensive critical analysis of Sudan's 2019 Constitutional Document, arguing that its foundational compromises-far from being a neutral framework for democratic transition-contained structural flaws that directly enabled the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) to accumulate power and ultimately launch the civil war of 2023. Drawing on constitutional theory, conflict studies, and empirical evidence from the transition period, the paper demonstrates that the Charter's legitimization of a parallel military structure, its weak provisions for security sector integration, its power-sharing formula that institutionalized military veto authority, and its failure to establish credible accountability mechanisms created what scholars term "nominal constitutionalism"-a formal text that served as a hollow veneer for the unfettered exercise of military power (Saeed, 2026). By examining the Charter's constitutional architecture, this paper demonstrates that the Sudanese war is not merely a failure of implementation but a direct consequence of the constitutional choices made in 2019. These choices reflected a fundamental misunderstanding of the dynamics of military power in post-authoritarian transitions (Tran, 2023). The analysis incorporates comparative constitutional perspectives from post-Arab Spring transitions and examines the role of donor conditionality in shaping the Charter's flawed economic and governance provisions (Ali, Alneel, & Hassanain, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文对苏丹2019年宪法文件进行批判性分析，认为其根本性妥协并非民主转型的中立框架，而是包含结构缺陷，直接使准军事组织快速支援部队（RSF）得以积累权力，并最终引发2023年内战。文章将苏丹战争归因于宪法选择本身，而非仅仅是实施失败。
AI.research_question: 苏丹2019年宪法文件的结构性缺陷如何在制度上使快速支援部队（RSF）得以积聚权力并最终引发2023年内战？
AI.motivation: 苏丹2023年内战的爆发需要超越"实施失败"的简单归因，文章旨在揭示战争与2019年宪法条款之间的直接因果联系，纠正对此宪法文件作为中立转型框架的既有认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法理论（宪政设计）、冲突研究（后威权转型中军事权力动态）、"名义宪政主义"（nominal constitutionalism）概念，以及后阿拉伯之春转型的比较宪法视角。
AI.method: 综合运用宪法理论、冲突研究理论框架，结合转型期的经验证据，并纳入后阿拉伯之春转型的比较宪法分析，同时考察捐助方条件性对宪法经济与治理条款的影响。
AI.findings: 宪法文件存在四大结构性缺陷：（1）将平行军事结构合法化；（2）安全部门整合条款薄弱；（3）权力分享公式制度化军事否决权；（4）缺乏可信的问责机制。这些缺陷共同构成了"名义宪政主义"——正式文本沦为军事权力不受约束行使的空洞外表，直接为RSF积累权力并发动2023年内战创造了制度条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"名义宪政主义"概念用于解释后威权转型中宪法形式与实质权力之间的脱节；挑战了将苏丹战争视为单纯实施失败的传统叙事，将战争归因于宪法设计本身的内在缺陷；丰富了关于后阿拉伯之春转型中军事权力动态的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后威权转型国家的宪法设计提供了警示性教训——特别是安全部门整合、军事否决权制度化和问责机制方面的规范性建议；揭示了捐助方条件性可能对转型宪法产生负面影响，为国际援助政策提供参考。

title: Is Data Privacy a Losing Game? Evidence from Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) Policy
affiliations: Joint Research Centre - European Commission, University of Cambridge, Cambridge Judge Business School and

detail.title: Is Data Privacy a Losing Game? Evidence from Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) Policy
detail.abstract: We study the impact of Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) policy, which requires apps to obtain explicit user permission before cross-app tracking, on the mobile gaming industry. Using SensorTower US data on the top 5,000 games on iOS and Android (2020-2023) and a difference-indifferences design, we show that ATT increases iOS games' revenue and revenue per user, with little impact on user numbers. Gains arise from re-optimised in-app purchase menus and more major updates, not higher prices or paywalls. ATT raises concentration and reduces entry, benefiting Apple and incumbents while raising barriers to entry for new competitors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用SensorTower美国市场iOS和Android平台前5000款游戏数据（2020-2023年），通过双重差分法研究苹果ATT隐私政策对移动游戏行业的影响。研究发现ATT显著提高了iOS游戏的收入和每用户收入，但对用户数量影响甚微。收益来源于应用内购买菜单的重新优化和更多重大更新，而非提高价格或设置付费墙。ATT还提高了行业集中度并减少了市场进入，惠及苹果和现有大型游戏厂商，同时抬高了新进入者的壁垒。
AI.research_question: 苹果的App Tracking Transparency（ATT）隐私政策对移动游戏行业的收入、用户规模、市场结构和竞争格局产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: ATT政策限制了跨应用追踪能力，这是数字经济中隐私监管的重大变革。理解其经济后果对政策制定者、平台和开发者都具有重要意义，但现有研究缺乏对移动游戏这一重要数字内容市场的系统性因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于隐私监管经济学和平台竞争理论，利用ATT作为准自然实验，分析隐私政策如何影响平台的定价策略、内容供给和市场进入/退出决策。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID），以iOS平台游戏为处理组、Android平台游戏为对照组，使用SensorTower提供的2020-2023年美国市场前5000款游戏的收入和用户数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）ATT显著提高了iOS游戏的收入和每用户收入，但对用户数量影响不大；（2）收益增加源于应用内购买菜单的重新优化和更频繁的重大版本更新，而非提高价格或设置付费墙；（3）ATT提高了行业集中度并减少了新游戏的市场进入，惠及苹果和现有头部厂商，同时提高了新进入者的竞争壁垒。
AI.theory_contributions: 为隐私监管的经济后果提供了因果证据，揭示了隐私政策对数字平台市场竞争结构的再分配效应，丰富了平台经济与隐私经济学交叉领域的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估隐私监管的竞争效应提供了实证依据；提醒游戏开发者和投资者关注隐私政策变化对市场格局的深远影响；也揭示了隐私政策可能带来的反竞争后果，为未来的平台监管提供参考。

title: Analysis of the Efficiency of using QRIS in the Management of MSMEs
affiliations: Bung Karno University

detail.title: Analysis of the Efficiency of using QRIS in the Management of MSMEs
detail.abstract:
Although they are essential to the country's economy, small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) frequently struggle with operational financial management. A key tool in advancing the digitalization of this industry is the Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS), a cashless payment standard based on QR codes. The purpose of this article is to examine the effectiveness of employing QRIS in SME management, with a particular emphasis on transaction time efficiency, financial record-keeping accuracy, and operational cost reduction.

A survey of the literature and a contextual analysis of several digital payment methods and SME operational management practices are used in the analysis. In comparison to traditional cash payment methods, the study focuses on assessing the effects of incorporating QRIS-based digital payment systems.

According to the analysis, QRIS installation greatly improves the operational efficiency of SMEs. It has been demonstrated that using QRIS speeds up transaction procedures, reduces the hazards associated with handling cash (such fake money or improper change), and makes it easier to compile financial reports automatically and in real time. However, issues including low digital literacy among business owners, network infrastructure constraints, and settlement delays continue to hinder its efficiency. All things considered, the implementation of QRIS is a successful strategic step toward modernizing SME management and promoting a more diverse digital financial ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨QRIS（印尼标准二维码无现金支付系统）在中小企业（SME）管理中的有效性，重点关注交易时间效率、财务记账准确性和运营成本降低三个方面。研究发现QRIS能显著提升中小企业运营效率，加快交易流程、减少现金处理风险并实现财务报告的自动化和实时化，但也面临数字素养低、网络基础设施限制和结算延迟等挑战。
AI.research_question: QRIS在中小企业管理中是否有效？具体而言，它在交易时间效率、财务记账准确性和运营成本降低方面能带来何种影响？
AI.motivation: 中小企业对国家经济至关重要，但常在运营财务管理上遇到困难。QRIS作为基于二维码的印尼国家标准无现金支付工具，是推动该行业数字化的重要工具，因此需要评估其在中小企业管理中的实效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字支付系统与中小企业运营管理实践的相关理论框架，涉及现金支付与传统支付方式的对比分析。
AI.method: 采用文献综述（survey of literature）和多种数字支付方式及中小企业运营管理实践的上下文分析方法（contextual analysis），对比QRIS数字支付系统与传统现金支付方式的影响。
AI.findings: （1）QRIS的实施能显著提升中小企业的运营效率；（2）加快交易流程，减少现金处理相关风险（如假币、找零错误）；（3）便于自动化和实时化的财务报告编制；（4）但仍存在企业主数字素养低、网络基础设施限制、结算延迟等问题阻碍其效率发挥。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字支付系统在中小企业运营管理中的应用效果提供了实证分析依据，丰富了无现金支付工具在发展中经济体中小企业场景下的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业采用QRIS提供了实践指导，证明QRIS是实现中小企业管理现代化和促进多元化数字金融生态系统的有效战略步骤，同时指出了需要改进的领域（如数字素养提升和网络基建）。

title: "Defying Volatility: An Analysis of Large-scale Firm Stability in Pakistan's Emerging Market"
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: "Defying Volatility: An Analysis of Large-scale Firm Stability in Pakistan's Emerging Market"
detail.abstract: This research examines how large-scale enterprises (LSEs) in Pakistan sustain industrial stability and profitability despite a volatile macroeconomic environment characterized by persistent inflation and political instability. The study seeks to identify the specific internal organizational drivers and management maneuvers that allow these firms to defy conventional predictions of firm-level instability during economic downturns. Through the utilization of a qualitative multi-sectoral research design, the study employed semi-structured interviews with "positional elites", CEOs and senior executives, across six diverse industrial sectors, including manufacturing, textiles, and food services. The findings reveal that stability is maintained through the process of "proactive decoupling," where instead of moving alongside a country's external environment, a firm makes measures to separate their internal performance. Decoupling breaks the dependency between the firm's success and economic health. This is possible through technology hedging, including labor automation and renewable energy transformation, coupled with market economies of scale. Stability, as such, has become increasingly more institutionalized as the adaptation of technology and internal standards act as defence from economic fluctuations. The study presents Pillars of Stability that can be referred to in order to study how mass stabilization of business operating in an emerging market can be achieved. With an ultimate call for a paradigm shift from reactive expense reduction to more proactive decision making.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性多部门研究设计，对巴基斯坦六大工业部门的CEO和高级管理人员进行半结构化访谈，揭示了大型企业在宏观动荡环境下维持稳定与盈利的机制——"主动脱耦"（proactive decoupling），即企业通过技术对冲（劳动自动化、可再生能源转型）和市场规模经济，主动切断内部绩效与外部经济健康之间的依赖关系，使稳定性日益制度化。
AI.research_question: 在内生性通货膨胀和政治不稳定的宏观经济环境下，巴基斯坦大型企业如何维持工业稳定性和盈利能力？哪些内部组织驱动因素和管理策略使其能够抵御企业层面的不稳定性预测？
AI.motivation: 传统理论预测企业在经济下行期会经历不稳定性，但巴基斯坦大型企业在动荡环境中仍能保持稳定和盈利，这一现象与常规预测相悖。现有文献缺乏对新兴市场中大型企业如何在宏观动荡下维持稳定的内部机制的系统性理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度脱耦理论（institutional decoupling），将微观企业层面的脱耦概念从制度理论延伸至宏观环境与企业绩效的关系分析。
AI.method: 定性多部门研究设计，采用半结构化访谈方法，访谈对象为六个不同工业部门（包括制造业、纺织业和食品服务业）的"职位精英"——CEO和高级管理人员。
AI.findings: 企业通过"主动脱耦"维持稳定：企业主动采取措施将内部绩效与外部环境分离，打破企业成功与宏观经济健康之间的依赖关系。具体机制包括技术对冲（劳动自动化和可再生能源转型）以及市场规模经济。随着技术和内部标准的采用作为经济波动的防御手段，稳定性日益制度化。研究还提出了"稳定支柱"（Pillars of Stability）框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将脱耦概念从传统制度理论中的合规性领域拓展至企业战略与宏观环境的互动领域，提出"主动脱耦"作为新兴市场中大规模企业稳定化的理论机制，并构建"稳定支柱"分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场企业提供从被动成本削减转向主动决策制定的战略范式转变建议；为管理者提供技术对冲和规模经济等具体策略以防御宏观经济波动；提出实现大规模商业稳定化的参考框架。

title: Towards Autonomous Sustainability in Electronics Supply Chains: A Systematic Review and Agentic AI-driven Conceptual Framework for Green Supply Chain Resilience

detail.title: Towards Autonomous Sustainability in Electronics Supply Chains: A Systematic Review and Agentic AI-driven Conceptual Framework for Green Supply Chain Resilience
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) in transforming green supply chain resilience in the dynamic electronics and semiconductor industry. Predictive AI is widely adopted in supply chain management; however, the critical challenge of bridging data-driven decisions and independent actions remains. To resolve this challenge, a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) adopting the PRISMA 2020 protocol was applied, analyzing 170 peer-reviewed articles published between 2020 and 2026. The SLR reveals accelerating research into autonomous systems for sustainable supply chain management, yet this body of work remains largely generic and industry-agnostic. Sector-specific deployment that balances efficiency and sustainability remains under-researched. Thus, the study proposes an ASR Framework based on dynamic capabilities and resource management theory. It consists of three layers: autonomous sensing, goal-oriented orchestration, and decentralized execution. This framework emphasizes the role of agentic systems in improving environmental and operational performance. Finally, the study presents research hypotheses and a strategic plan to realize human-centered, Industry 5.0-oriented supply chain systems in the electronics and semiconductor sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述（PRISMA 2020协议，分析2020-2026年间170篇同行评审文章），探讨Agentic AI在电子与半导体行业绿色供应链韧性转型中的作用，并基于动态能力与资源管理理论提出ASR框架（自主感知、目标导向编排、去中心化执行），以弥合数据驱动决策与自主行动之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: Agentic AI如何弥合供应链管理中数据驱动决策与独立行动之间的关键挑战，从而在动态的电子与半导体行业中实现绿色供应链韧性的转型？
AI.motivation: 预测性AI在供应链管理中已被广泛采用，但将数据驱动决策转化为自主行动的能力仍不足；且现有关于自主系统的可持续供应链管理研究大多泛化且缺乏行业针对性，兼顾效率与可持续性的特定行业部署研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities）与资源管理理论（Resource Management Theory）
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020协议的系统文献综述（SLR），分析2020至2026年间发表的170篇同行评审文章，并在此基础上提出概念性ASR框架。
AI.findings: 研究表明自主系统在可持续供应链管理中的研究正在加速，但现有文献大多为通用性且缺乏行业针对性；电子与半导体行业特定场景下平衡效率与可持续性的部署研究不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 基于动态能力与资源管理理论，提出包含自主感知、目标导向编排、去中心化执行三层的ASR框架，丰富了Agentic AI在绿色供应链韧性领域的理论建构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子与半导体行业提供实现以人为本、面向工业5.0的供应链系统的战略规划及研究假设，指导AI在行业绿色供应链中的实践部署。

title: Two Estimands, One Identity: Equilibrium-Implied Electricity Demand from Bitcoin Mining at Coin Prices of $1-$10 Million
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Two Estimands, One Identity: Equilibrium-Implied Electricity Demand from Bitcoin Mining at Coin Prices of $1-$10 Million
detail.abstract: Estimates of Bitcoin mining's electricity use disagree by an order of magnitude, and are usually read as uncertainty about one quantity. They are not.
