title: From Crisis to Gains in the Gulf  ?: Decentralized Migration Management, COVID-19 Pandemic Diplomacy, and the Emirati State

detail.title: From Crisis to Gains in the Gulf  ?: Decentralized Migration Management, COVID-19 Pandemic Diplomacy, and the Emirati State

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Forthcoming in Healthcare, Migration, and Politics in the Middle East: The COVID-19 Pandemic in Local Contexts.
https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-03761-9_7

detail.abstract: Despite such central relevance and contributions, mainstream Gulf migration literature has yet to systematically examine and historicize the complex and multiple institutional and political impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on migration management-both at the domestic and international levels-in the Gulf countries. Using the case of the United Arab Emirates (UAE)-a key node of the regional and global migration system in the Gulf and of the Global South-this chapter examines the host states' strategic shift in migration management responses to the COVID-19 pandemic both at the domestic and geopolitical levels. It features threefold arguments: first, despite its state-centric migration management roots, the COVID-19 pandemic has institutionally forced the host states to adopt a decentralized collaborative model of domestic migration management by integrating migrant community organizations into its government crisis approach. Second, the COVID-19 pandemic not only threatened the national interests and capacities of states, but also compelled host states to strategically mobilize a combination of foreign policy coercion and cooperation towards sending states, including those deemed "non-cooperative," to assert their geopolitical power. Third, the COVID-19 pandemic has also strategically triggered host states to reform their domestic migration management, thus enabling them to effectively position their economic strategies (i.e., more liberalized knowledge-based economy) in a post-COVID-19 pandemic scenario. These strategic responses to the COVID-19 pandemic have not only enabled them to project their global humanitarian image and capacity but also mirror the existing regional power politics and asymmetries between host and sending states in the Global South. Methodologically, I employ semi-structured interviews with state and non-state officials and temporary migrant workers, combined with field observation during the COVID-19 pandemic (2020-2022) in the UAE. I also utilized secondary analysis of local UAE official government policies and newspaper publications to support my empirical findings. Overall, the study contributes to empirical and theoretical discussions on the global politics of migration management by highlighting the role of the global crisis in shaping host states' domestic and foreign policy responses on migration management during the global COVID-19 pandemic period.

AI.tldr: 本文以阿联酋为案例，探讨了COVID-19大流行如何促使海湾宿主国家在国内和国际两个层面战略性地转变移民管理方式，包括采用去中心化的协作治理模式、对外交政策中强制与合作的策略性组合，以及改革国内移民管理以服务于后疫情时代的知识型经济战略。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行如何影响海湾宿主国家在国内外两个层面的移民管理制度与政治应对？
AI.motivation: 主流海湾移民文献尚未系统性地考察和将COVID-19大流行对移民管理的复杂多重制度与政治影响进行历史化处理，尤其是在国内和国际层面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球移民管理政治学、国家中心主义移民管理理论、地缘政治权力不对称理论、全球危机与制度变迁理论
AI.method: 定性研究：对国家和非国家官员及临时移民工人进行半结构化访谈，结合2020-2022年疫情期间在阿联酋的田野观察，以及对阿联酋官方政府政策和报纸出版物的二手分析。
AI.findings: 三重发现：（1）疫情在制度上迫使宿主国家采纳去中心化的协作式国内移民管理模式，将移民社区组织纳入政府危机应对；（2）疫情促使宿主国家策略性地组合外交强制与合作手段以应对母国，包括被视为"不合作"的国家，以彰显地缘政治权力；（3）疫情策略性地触发了宿主国家对国内移民管理的改革，使其在后疫情时代有效定位其经济战略（即更自由化的知识型经济）。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过强调全球危机在塑造宿主国家移民管理国内外政策应对中的作用，为全球移民管理政治的经验和理论讨论做出贡献，揭示了全球南方宿主国与母国之间现有的区域权力政治和不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解海湾国家在危机时期的移民管理政策制定提供实证洞察，有助于政策制定者认识到危机情境下移民治理的灵活性与战略调整空间。

title: The Hollowing of Office: Human Sovereignty, Compelled Assent, and the Loss of Discernment When AI Governs in Practice
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Hollowing of Office: Human Sovereignty, Compelled Assent, and the Loss of Discernment When AI Governs in Practice
detail.abstract: This Article identifies an institutional governance failure obscured by conventional human-oversight frameworks: formal authority can remain human while practical governing capacity migrates to artificial-intelligence systems. It calls this pathology the hollowing of office. The Article makes three contributions. First, it distinguishes decision competence from governing competence and explains how epistemically compelled assent and a discernment-atrophy loop can reduce human approval to ceremony. Second, it shifts the unit of analysis from a single human-machine interaction to the office and its surrounding intelligence architecture. The relevant question is whether an institution can still frame problems, contest outputs, intervene, reconstruct decisions, remedy harm, and continue essential functions if the principal system is unavailable. Third, it proposes a proportionate response: a ten-part Minimum Governing Capacity Standard, a Human Discernment Reserve, a Qualified Right of Normative Refusal, tiered obligations, shared assurance capacity, and reciprocal tempo governance for military and financial settings. The argument distinguishes assistive, dependence-producing, and epistemically dominant AI; superintelligence need not be imminent or inevitable. This is a conceptual framework, not a claim that office hollowing is already widespread. Its indicators, research agenda, worked examples, and illustrative statutory provisions are offered for empirical testing and sector-specific adaptation. The central claim is not that humans must outperform advanced AI. Institutions lose legitimacy when they can no longer determine when a system should be resisted, explain why, and act effectively on that judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了一种被传统人类监督框架所忽视的制度治理失灵现象：正式权力仍属于人类，但实际治理能力已迁移至人工智能系统，作者称之为"办公室空心化"（hollowing of office）这一病理现象，并提出相应的最低治理能力标准作为回应。
AI.research_question: 当正式权威仍归属人类、但实际治理能力已迁移至AI系统时，制度治理面临何种失灵？应如何识别并回应这种"办公室空心化"现象？
AI.motivation: 传统的人类监督框架（human-oversight frameworks）假设只要人类保留形式上的审批权和控制权，治理就没有问题。但这一框架忽略了正式权威与实际治理能力可能分离的可能性——人类可能被降格为"仪式性批准"的角色，而真正的判断、决策和治理能力已悄悄转移至AI系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出三个核心概念框架：（1）区分"决策能力"（decision competence）与"治理能力"（governing competence）；（2）将分析单元从单次人机交互转向"办公室"及其周围智能架构；（3）区分辅助型AI、依赖型AI和认知主导型AI三类人工智能。此外还包括"认知压缩同意"（epistemically compelled assent）和"判断力萎缩循环"（discernment-atrophy loop）两个机制概念。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析/规范性论证方法，构建概念框架而非实证检验。作者提供指标、研究议程、工作示例及示范性法律条款，供实证检验和部门化适配使用。
AI.findings: 本文提出三项贡献：（1）区分决策能力与治理能力，揭示"认知压缩同意"和"判断力萎缩循环"如何将人类审批降格为仪式；（2）将分析单元从单次人机交互转向办公室及智能架构整体，提出判断制度健康的关键问题——制度能否在主导系统不可用时仍进行问题框架化、输出质疑、干预、决策重构、损害补救和维持核心功能；（3）提出比例性回应方案：十项最低治理能力标准、人类判断力储备、规范性拒绝的限定权利、分层义务、共享保障能力，以及军事和金融领域的互惠节奏治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：（1）提出了"办公室空心化"这一新的制度病理概念，丰富了AI治理理论；（2）将分析单元从个体人机交互层面提升至制度/办公室层面，为AI治理提供了新的分析视角；（3）引入"治理能力"概念，弥补了仅关注"决策能力"的不足；（4）区分辅助型、依赖型和认知主导型AI，为分类治理提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：（1）提出十项最低治理能力标准，为机构和监管者提供可操作的评估框架；（2）提出人类判断力储备、规范性拒绝限定权利、分层义务等具体制度设计；（3）为军事和金融等高风险领域提供"互惠节奏治理"（reciprocal tempo governance）方案；（4）提供指标、研究议程、工作示例和示范性法律条款，支持实证检验和部门化适配。

title: From Housework Traps to Spatialized Poverty: The Changing Landscape of Welfare Dependency and Generalized Trust in South Korea

detail.title: From Housework Traps to Spatialized Poverty: The Changing Landscape of Welfare Dependency and Generalized Trust in South Korea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilized publicly available secondary data from the Korea Welfare Panel Study (KOWEPS). As the dataset contains anonymized data, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the structural transformation of welfare dependency and social trust in South Korea over a nearly two-decade period (2005 vs 2023). Using household-weighted linear regressions and Firth's penalized logistic models, I demonstrate a profound shift in the 'poverty profile' of the nation. The findings reveal that the 'housework trap'-a unique interaction between domestic labor and psychological distress that predicted welfare entry in 2005-has effectively dissipated. By 2023, welfare status has become increasingly driven by a 'spatialization of poverty'-marked by intense economic pressures in metropolitan Seoul-and a deficit in Positive Psychological Capital (PsyCap). Furthermore, while educational attainment remains a predictor of social trust, its relative influence has diminished, highlighting a persistent 'Education-Trust Paradox' in a highly credentialed society. Crucially, welfare receipt emerged as a significant negative predictor of social trust in 2023, signaling an escalation of latent welfare stigma and institutional alienation. These results suggest that contemporary welfare frameworks in rapidly aging, post-developmental states must transcend traditional monetary transfers. Instead, policy interventions should integrate spatial inequality and psychological resilience to restore social citizenship and mitigate systemic risks.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了韩国近二十年（2005 vs 2023）福利依赖与社会信任的结构性转型。研究发现"家务陷阱"（家务劳动与心理困扰的交互作用）在2005年预测福利进入，但到2023年已消失；福利状态日益由"贫困的空间化"（首尔都市区的经济压力）和积极心理资本（PsyCap）缺失所驱动。同时，教育对社会信任的预测力减弱，且福利领取在2023年成为社会信任的显著负向预测因子，表明福利污名与制度疏离的加剧。
AI.research_question: 韩国近二十年（2005 vs 2023）福利依赖的决定因素及其与社会信任关系发生了怎样的结构性变化？
AI.motivation: 韩国作为快速老龄化的后发展国家，其福利依赖的"贫困特征"已发生深刻转变，但现有研究缺乏对福利依赖结构性转型及其社会信任影响的时间维度比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家务陷阱理论；贫困空间化理论；积极心理资本（PsyCap）理论；教育与信任悖论。
AI.method: 使用家庭加权线性回归和Firth惩罚逻辑回归模型，对2005年与2023年韩国数据进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）2005年预测福利进入的"家务陷阱"到2023年已消失；2）2023年福利状态主要由首尔都市区的空间经济压力和PsyCap缺失驱动；3）教育对社会信任的预测力减弱，存在"教育-信任悖论"；4）2023年福利领取成为社会信任的显著负向预测因子，反映福利污名和制度疏离的升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出福利依赖的"贫困特征"从"家务陷阱"向"贫困空间化与心理资本缺失"的结构性转型；提出"教育-信任悖论"概念；揭示福利领取对社会信任的负向效应随时间升级，拓展了福利污名与制度疏离的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后发展国家当代福利政策设计提供启示：应超越传统货币转移支付，整合空间不平等修复与心理韧性建设，以恢复社会公民身份并缓解系统性风险。

title: Marginalism and Institutions in the Making of the Economics Profession in Spain, 1900-1959
affiliations: University of Sevilla, Complutense University of Madrid and University of the Balearic Islands - Department of Applied Economics

detail.title: Marginalism and Institutions in the Making of the Economics Profession in Spain, 1900-1959
detail.abstract: This article examines how economists emerged as a distinct professional community in Spain between the early twentieth century and the Stabilization Plan of 1959. It argues that the historical significance of marginalism lay not in establishing a unified economic doctrine but in providing the common analytical language through which economists forged a shared professional identity. By distinguishing economists from competing expert communities, this methodological framework strengthened their claims to scientific authority and technical competence. Yet marginalism alone does not explain the growing political influence of economists. Combining intellectual history, institutional analysis, and social network analysis, the article shows that the consolidation of the profession also depended upon the gradual construction of an institutional and social network linking universities, financial institutions, government ministries, research institutes, specialist journals, and international organizations. Together, these institutions transformed a shared methodological language into professional authority and professional authority into political and administrative influence. The Stabilization Plan of 1959 therefore appears less as the starting point of Spain's technocratic transformation than as the culmination of a longer process through which economists became one of the Franco regime's principal expert communities..

AI.tldr: 本文考察了20世纪初至1959年稳定计划期间，西班牙经济学家如何形成一个独特的专业共同体。文章认为，边际主义的历史意义不在于建立统一的经济学说，而在于提供了共同的分析语言，使经济学家得以构建共享的专业身份。结合思想史、制度分析和社会网络分析，文章表明该职业的巩固还依赖于大学、金融机构、政府部门、研究所、专业期刊和国际组织之间逐步建立的制度与社会网络。1959年稳定计划并非西班牙技术官僚转型的起点，而是一个长期过程的顶点——经济学家由此成为佛朗哥政权的主要专家共同体之一。
AI.research_question: 西班牙经济学家如何在20世纪初至1959年间作为一个独特的专业共同体出现？边际主义与制度网络在其专业身份建构和政治影响力提升中分别扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将1959年稳定计划视为西班牙技术官僚转型的起点，但对经济学家在此之前如何形成专业身份并积累政治影响力缺乏系统的历史考察。文章旨在揭示这一长期塑造过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业社会学理论（专业知识共同体的形成与权威建构）、边际主义经济学的知识史视角、制度主义理论（制度网络对专业权威的转化作用）
AI.method: 结合三种方法：思想史分析（追踪边际主义的话语传播）、制度分析（考察大学、金融、政府等机构的角色）、社会网络分析（揭示各机构之间的联结关系）
AI.findings: 边际主义提供了共同的分析语言，使经济学家区别于其他专家群体并确立科学权威；但仅靠方法论不足以解释其政治影响力。制度与社会网络的逐步构建将方法论语言转化为专业权威，再转化为政治和行政影响力。1959年稳定计划实际上是这一长期过程的顶点而非起点。
AI.theory_contributions: 对专业社会学理论的贡献：提出边际主义作为"共同分析语言"而非统一学说的作用，丰富了专业知识共同体形成机制的理解；揭示了方法论框架与制度网络在专业权威建构中的互补关系，超越了单一因素解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解西班牙佛朗哥政权下的技术官僚转型提供新的历史视角，说明专业知识与政治权力之间的关系是逐步建构的过程，对研究威权政体下专家角色的演变具有参考价值。

title: Double Jeopardy: The Climate and Fiscal Space Crises in Small Island Developing States
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Double Jeopardy: The Climate and Fiscal Space Crises in Small Island Developing States
detail.abstract: The fiscal space crisis overlaps with the climate crisis in developing countries, complicating efforts to achieve sustainable development goals, especially in small island developing states (SIDS). This paper examines the impact of a year of extreme weather events on fiscal balance and investment in small island states. The paper utilizes a panel dataset of 26 countries across three regions (the Caribbean, the Pacific, and Atlantic, Indian Ocean, Mediterranean and South China Sea, AIMS) from 1990 to 2023. It employs a dynamic event study that accounts for heterogeneous treatment effects. The results show that extreme weather events impact the fiscal space of SIDS. In the treatment year, extreme weather events negatively impact fiscal balance and persist in post-treatment years. Net lending and borrowing exhibit similar pattern to fiscal balance, albeit with slightly greater elasticity, as indicated by the coefficients. This suggests that after an extreme weather event, governments of small island states tend to increase public borrowing to offset losses and meet budgetary needs, including the repair of damaged infrastructure, as borrowing costs rise. The revenue loss is attributable to declines in tax revenue, exports, and primary income. The results also show that weather shocks have a statistically significant negative impact on gross fixed capital formation and education spending.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1990-2023年三大区域（加勒比、太平洋及AIMS）26个小岛屿发展中国家的面板数据，采用考虑异质性处理效应的动态事件研究方法，考察极端天气事件对财政平衡和投资的影响。研究发现，极端天气事件在冲击当年对财政平衡产生负面影响且持续多年，政府倾向于增加公共借贷以弥补损失和修复基础设施，同时天气冲击对固定资产投资和教育支出有显著的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件如何影响小岛屿发展中国家的财政空间（财政平衡和投资）？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家面临财政空间危机与气候危机的重叠压力，特别是小岛屿发展中国家（SIDS）在实现可持续发展目标方面面临更大挑战，但缺乏对极端天气事件如何影响其财政空间与投资的系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政空间理论；气候冲击与财政可持续性理论；动态事件研究框架（考虑异质性处理效应）
AI.method: 采用1990至2023年26个小岛屿发展中国家的面板数据集，涵盖加勒比、太平洋及AIMS三个地区；使用考虑异质性处理效应的动态事件研究（dynamic event study）方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）极端天气事件在冲击当年对财政平衡产生显著负面影响，且该效应在后续年份持续存在；（2）净贷款与借款呈现与财政平衡类似的模式，但弹性稍大，表明政府倾向于增加公共借贷以弥补损失、满足预算需求（包括受损基础设施修复）并应对上升的借贷成本；（3）收入损失来源于税收收入、出口和初级收入的下降；（4）天气冲击对固定资产形成总额和教育支出具有统计上显著的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次针对小岛屿发展中国家提供极端天气事件影响财政空间的系统性实证证据；采用考虑异质性处理效应的动态事件研究方法，弥补了传统方法的估计偏差；揭示了天气冲击通过财政收入（税收、出口、初级收入）和支出（投资、教育）双重渠道压缩财政空间的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小岛屿发展中国家的财政规划与气候适应政策提供实证依据；提示政策制定者关注极端天气事件后公共借贷成本上升和基础设施修复的财政压力；建议国际社会对小岛屿发展中国家提供气候财政援助和债务缓解支持。

title: The Skeleton Key: Borrowed Urgency, Unpredicated Child Exploitation Suspicion, and the Cost No Plaintiff Can Recover

detail.title: The Skeleton Key: Borrowed Urgency, Unpredicated Child Exploitation Suspicion, and the Cost No Plaintiff Can Recover
detail.abstract: A federal officer who wants to search a traveler's phone at the border needs no warrant, no probable cause, and in the Eleventh Circuit no suspicion of any kind. Yet officers still give reasons, and the reason they give is not doctrinally idle. This article examines what happens when the reason given is child sexual exploitation and the record contains no predicate for it. The immediate cost falls on the traveler and is litigated in the ordinary way, through suppression. A second cost falls on a population that will never appear in the caption. Every unpredicated invocation of child exploitation as a search rationale spends down the credibility of the same assertion when it is made with a predicate, teaches the public to hear the phrase as an access request rather than an allegation, and supplies the strongest available argument to platforms resisting genuine child protection obligations. That cost is real, it is attributable, and no doctrine can reach it. Standing runs to the searched party, suppression compensates the searched party, and pretext analysis after Whren declines to examine subjective motive at all. The article traces the border search regime and its own internal suspicion floor, identifies why child exploitation is the optimal pretext under that regime, locates the structural blindness in standing and remedy rather than in judicial indifference, and proposes a contemporaneous articulation requirement calibrated to the one protection the agency already imposes on itself.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国边境官员在搜查旅客手机时，以"儿童性剥削"为理由但缺乏任何事实基础的情况。文章指出这种无根据的指控不仅伤害被搜查者，更会削弱该指控本身的可信度，助长公众将其理解为"访问请求"而非"指控"，并给反对真正儿童保护义务的平台提供论据。文章提出基于机构自我约束的同步陈述要求作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 当边境搜查的理由是"儿童性剥削"但记录中没有任何事实基础时，会产什么样的直接和间接成本？现行法律框架（第四修正案、站立资格、救济机制）为何无法解决这一问题？应如何设计制度性补救措施？
AI.motivation: 在第十一巡回法院辖区，边境官员搜查旅客手机无需令状、无需合理根据、甚至无需任何怀疑，但官员仍会给出理由。这些理由并非无关紧要——特别是当理由为"儿童性剥削"却毫无依据时，会产生无法被现行法律框架触及的真实成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第四修正案搜查与扣押法、边境搜查例外理论、Whren案后的借口(pretext)分析框架、斯坦丁(standing)原则、证据排除规则。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal analysis）：梳理边境搜查制度及其内部怀疑下限，分析儿童性剥削作为该制度下最优借口的原因，定位制度结构盲区，并提出制度性解决方案。
AI.findings: (1) 每次无根据的儿童性剥削搜查理由都会"消耗"同一指控的可信度；(2) 这种使用教导公众将该短语理解为访问请求而非指控；(3) 它为抵制真正儿童保护义务的平台提供了最强有力的论据；(4) 该成本真实存在且可归因，但现行法律（站立资格、证据排除、Whren后的借口分析）均无法触及；(5) 问题根源在站立和救济的结构性盲区，而非司法冷漠。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文揭示了法律体系中一个未被认识的结构性问题：某些搜查理由存在"二重成本"——直接成本（对当事人）和间接成本（对公共话语和制度可信度），而后者无法被任何现行法律教义捕获。文章将借口分析从主观动机审查拓展到集体声誉与制度信任的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一种"同步陈述要求"（contemporaneous articulation requirement），其校准标准参照边境机构已自我施加的保护措施，为政策制定者提供具体、可操作的改革方案。

title: The Latent: Finite Sufficient Representations of Smooth Systems

detail.title: The Latent: Finite Sufficient Representations of Smooth Systems
detail.abstract:
We define the Latent of a smooth system as the basis-free element of a graded Hilbert tensor algebra that completely characterizes the system's distributional, dynamic, and functional properties. The paper develops 35 theorems and propositions and includes formal verification in Lean 4 and the Platonic kernel.

Canonical Zenodo version: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19678631

AI.tldr: 本文提出"光滑系统的潜变量"（Latent of a smooth system）概念，将其定义为分级Hilbert张量代数中的无基元素，该元素能够完全刻画系统的分布、动态和功能特性。论文包含35个定理和命题，并通过Lean 4和Platonic内核进行了形式化验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个不依赖于坐标系（basis-free）的数学框架，以统一且完整地表征光滑系统的分布性、动态性和功能性特征？
AI.motivation: 现有光滑系统的数学描述往往依赖于特定的基或坐标系，缺乏统一的、不依赖于基的形式化框架来完整刻画系统的多重属性（分布、动态、功能）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分级Hilbert张量代数（graded Hilbert tensor algebra）理论
AI.method: 数学推导与形式化验证：发展35个定理和命题，并采用Lean 4证明助手和Platonic内核进行机器验证。
AI.findings: 定义了"潜变量"（Latent）作为光滑系统的完整表征元素，并证明了其能够全面刻画系统的分布、动态与功能属性；所有理论结果均通过了Lean 4的形式化验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种全新的、无基（basis-free）的光滑系统表征框架——潜变量概念，将分布、动态、功能三类性质统一在张量代数的代数结构中，拓展了系统理论的形式化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过Lean 4和Platonic内核的形式化验证，为系统理论提供了机器可验证的定理证明，增强了理论结果的可靠性，并为后续系统分析与设计提供了严谨的数学工具。

title: Macroeconomic Effects and Labor Market Reallocation under the EU Digital Product Passport Mandate An Integrated Heterogeneous Firms, Porter, Task Based, and Search Matching Analysis

detail.title: Macroeconomic Effects and Labor Market Reallocation under the EU Digital Product Passport Mandate An Integrated Heterogeneous Firms, Porter, Task Based, and Search Matching Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have inappropriately influenced or biased the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants or personal data
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The European Union's Digital Product Passport (DPP) mandate, established under the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 and operationalized first through the Batteries Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, imposes a large, asymmetric, and durable increase in the fixed cost of participating in the European product market. This paper develops the first integrated framework in which the mandate operates simultaneously as a fixed compliance cost in a Melitz heterogeneous firms model, a potential trigger of Porter type innovation offsets, a source of new tasks in an Acemoglu Autor task based labor model, and a driver of job creation and destruction in a Mortensen Pissarides search and matching environment. We derive five signed, testable hypotheses and show that the mandate's aggregate macroeconomic sign hinges on whether the Porter offset clears a low but non trivial threshold, while its distributional consequences consolidation toward large firms, a shift in import supply toward large foreign incumbents, and a mismatch driven transitional unemployment cost are unambiguous across the parameter space. A calibrated simulation quantifies these mechanisms, and a heterogeneity robust staggered difference in differences design is specified to identify the effects as the sector by sector phase in generates data.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了整合Melitz异质性企业模型、Porter创新抵消理论、Acemoglu-Autor任务型劳动模型和Mortensen-Pissarides搜索匹配模型的统一框架，分析欧盟数字产品护照（DPP）强制要求对宏观经济和分配效应的影响。研究发现总体宏观效应取决于Porter抵消效应是否超过一个低但非零的阈值，而分配性后果（向大企业集中、进口供应转向大型外国企业、错配导致的过渡性失业）在参数空间中是无歧义的。
AI.research_question: 欧盟数字产品护照（DPP）强制要求作为一个大规模、不对称且持久的固定合规成本，如何影响欧洲产品市场的宏观经济总量与分配性结果？
AI.motivation: 欧盟DPP强制要求是根据《可持续产品生态设计法规》(EU) 2024/1781和《电池法规》(EU) 2023/1542实施的重大监管变革，对企业参与欧洲产品市场施加了显著的固定成本。然而，现有文献缺乏一个整合的理论框架来全面评估其宏观经济影响，既包括总量效应也包括分配性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文整合了四个核心理论框架：(1) Melitz异质性企业贸易模型（固定合规成本）；(2) Porter假说（创新抵消效应）；(3) Acemoglu-Autor任务模型（新任务来源）；(4) Mortensen-Pissarides搜索匹配模型（工作创造与毁灭）。
AI.method: 论文采用理论模型推导与量化模拟相结合的方法。首先在统一框架下推导出五个有符号的可检验假说，然后通过校准模拟量化各机制的作用，最后设计了一个异质性稳健的交错双重差分（staggered difference-in-differences）识别策略，利用分行业分阶段实施产生的数据来估计效应。
AI.findings: 研究发现：(1) 宏观总量效应的符号取决于Porter创新抵消效应能否超过一个低但非零的阈值；(2) 分配性后果在参数空间中无歧义，包括市场向大企业集中、进口供给向大型外国在位企业转移、以及由于匹配错配导致的过渡性失业成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于首次将四个互补的宏观经济理论框架整合到一个统一的模型中，为分析环境法规的固定合规成本效应提供了综合性分析工具，并推导出可检验的符号化假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献包括：为政策制定者提供了评估DPP强制要求宏观影响的量化框架；揭示了监管可能导致的市场集中化和进口结构调整等分配性后果；为识别DPP因果效应提供了严谨的计量识别策略。

title: FitQuest: A Territory-based Gamified Fitness Ecosystem Integrating Blockchain Ownership and Machine Learning Coaching
affiliations: Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur, Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur, Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur, Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur and Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering, Nagpur

detail.title: FitQuest: A Territory-based Gamified Fitness Ecosystem Integrating Blockchain Ownership and Machine Learning Coaching
detail.abstract: We present FitQuest, a systems integration contribution combining territorial gamification via Uber's H3 hexagonal grid (resolution 9), blockchain-based territory ownership via ERC-721 smart contracts on Base Layer-2, and machine learning coaching via XGBoost and retrieval-augmented generation-in a single deployed architecture with on-device GPS-to-H3 privacy abstraction (35-60× location ambiguity). Four Solidity contracts are deployed on Base Sepolia (94.2% coverage, 2.1 s confirmation, $0.004/tx). The backend API handles 13,192 requests/second at p99 latency of 11 ms with zero errors at up to 500 concurrent connections; a systematic OWASP-based audit identified and resolved 12 vulnerabilities (2 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH) across all severity levels. A simulation-based feasibility analysis of the XGBoost recommendation model indicates potential precision of 72.8% at 87.7% recall on synthetic behavioral data, pending real-user validation. A pilot study (n = 20, 2 weeks) provides preliminary evidence of improved engagement (82% retention) compared to standard step counting (44%). All code is open-source on GitHub.

AI.tldr: FitQuest是一个系统集成贡献，结合了基于Uber H3六边形网格（分辨率9）的地域性游戏化、基于Base Layer-2上ERC-721智能合约的区块链领土所有权，以及基于XGBoost和检索增强生成的机器学习教练功能，并部署了设备端GPS到H3的隐私抽象（35-60倍位置模糊度）。四个Solidity合约部署在Base Sepolia上（94.2%覆盖率、2.1秒确认、每笔交易$0.004）。后端API在500个并发连接下每秒处理13,192个请求，p99延迟为11毫秒且零错误；基于OWASP的系统性审计识别并解决了12个漏洞（2个严重、3个高危）。XGBoost推荐模型的仿真可行性分析显示，在合成行为数据上潜在精确率为72.8%，召回率为87.7%，尚待真实用户验证。一项试点研究（n=20，2周）提供了改善参与度的初步证据（82%留存率），而标准计步为44%。所有代码在GitHub上开源。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合地域性游戏化、区块链领土所有权和机器学习个性化教练来提升用户的运动参与度与留存率？
AI.motivation: 传统计步应用留存率低（44%），缺乏激励与个性化反馈，需要一种结合游戏化、去中心化所有权和智能推荐的新型健身参与系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地域性游戏化理论、区块链资产所有权理论、机器学习个性化推荐理论（XGBoost）、检索增强生成（RAG）
AI.method: 系统架构集成开发：H3六边形网格（分辨率9）实现地域游戏化；ERC-721智能合约部署于Base Layer-2实现领土所有权；XGBoost与RAG实现智能教练推荐；设备端GPS-to-H3隐私抽象；OWASP安全审计；仿真可行性分析及小规模试点研究（n=20，2周）。
AI.findings: 系统性能卓越：合约覆盖94.2%、2.1秒确认、$0.004/交易；后端处理13,192请求/秒、p99延迟11ms、500并发零错误；识别并修复12个安全漏洞；XGBoost模型仿真精确率72.8%、召回率87.7%；试点研究显示82%留存率（对比标准计步44%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将地域游戏化、区块链所有权与机器学习教练三者集成于单一架构的理论框架，证明了游戏化激励、去中心化资产所有权和个性化推荐之间的协同效应，并引入隐私保护机制（GPS-to-H3模糊化）作为用户参与系统中的关键设计维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了开源的FitQuest完整系统实现，包括四个已部署的Solidity合约、高吞吐后端API、可复用的安全审计清单，以及初步的实证证据表明该系统显著提升用户留存率（82% vs 44%），为健身科技企业提供可落地的集成方案。

title: Theorizing a Transnational Contract Law: What Role for the CISG?
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - School of Law

detail.title: Theorizing a Transnational Contract Law: What Role for the CISG?

keywords: Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods

publicationDetails.detailsText: 25 Wash. U. Global Stud. L. Rev. 435 (2026)
U. of Pittsburgh Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-20
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Pittsburgh School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article investigates whether a coherent transnational contract law can be said to exist and examines the role of the Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (“CISG”) within this framework. It begins by identifying five prominent cross-border contracting practices: isolated commercial transactions, trade association contracts, supply chain governance, sovereign debt, and investment arbitration, revealing a fragmented legal landscape. It then evaluates these practices through two distinct jurisprudential lenses. A strict legal positivist account, the paper argues, struggles to identify a unified transnational legal system due to a lack of systemic coherence and shared rule-making agency. In contrast, a contemporary jus commune approach is a more viable framework for conceptualizing a common law that transcends national borders. Beyond this analytical inquiry, the article raises normative concerns, highlighting how powerful actors in areas like sovereign debt and investment law often select favorable legal regimes, creating risks of injustice and domination. In this context, the CISG is presented as a comparatively balanced and transparent model for international lawmaking, suggesting that more traditional international conventions may offer a more equitable alternative to the often opaque and power-oriented arrangements that currently characterize transnational contracting.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨是否存在连贯的跨国合同法，并考察《国际货物销售合同公约》（CISG）在此框架中的作用。文章识别五种跨境缔约实践，揭示法律碎片化格局，通过严格法律实证主义与当代"共同法"两种法理视角进行评价，并指出跨国合同领域存在的权力不对称与不公正风险，最终主张CISG作为更平衡、透明的国际立法模式。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一个连贯的跨国合同法体系？CISG在此框架中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 跨国合同实践日益复杂且碎片化，需要厘清是否存在统一的跨国法律体系，并评估CISG在其中的地位与价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 严格法律实证主义（legal positivism）与当代共同法（jus commune）两种法理学视角。
AI.method: 规范分析：识别五种跨境缔约实践（孤立商业交易、行业协会合同、供应链治理、主权债务、投资仲裁），并通过两种法理透镜进行理论评价。
AI.findings: 严格法律实证主义因缺乏系统连贯性和共享造法主体而难以识别统一的跨国法律体系；当代jus commune方法则是概念化跨国共同法的更可行框架。此外，主权债务和投资法领域中的强势行为者常选择有利的法律制度，造成不公正和支配风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证jus commune方法优于法律实证主义作为理解跨国合同法的框架；指出CISG可作为更平衡、透明的国际造法范式的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议更传统的国际公约（如CISG）可能为当前以不透明和权力导向为特征的跨国缔约实践提供更公平的替代方案。

title: Loss Averse over Beliefs

detail.title: Loss Averse over Beliefs

keywords: Belief motivation for their constructive comments. Support from Liikesivistysrahasto
and Yrjö Jahnsson Foundation is gratefully acknowledged

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a behavioral foundation for information design when information changes both what a loss-averse agent believes and the reference point, driven by rational expectation, relative to which he evaluates esteem. This dual role of the same expectation creates a central tension: a more favorable belief raises confidence but elevates the reference, compressing prospective gains and enlarging prospective losses. This reference channel can weaken, reverse, or render nonmonotone the canonical motivational role of favorable beliefs. The result is a unified preferencebased taxonomy of esteem management: high, low, intermediate, or polarized beliefs that motivate and sort rational agents according to their psychological stakes defined by those beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文为信息设计提供了行为基础，探讨当信息同时改变损失厌恶型代理人的信念与参照点时（参照点由理性预期驱动），如何影响其自尊评估。同一预期的双重角色造成了核心张力：更乐观的信念提升信心但也抬高参照点，压缩潜在收益并放大潜在损失。这一参照通道可能削弱、逆转甚至使有利信念的经典激励作用非单调化。最终形成统一的基于偏好的自尊管理分类：高、低、中间或极化信念，根据信念定义的心理风险遴选理性代理人。
AI.research_question: 当信息同时影响损失厌恶型代理人的信念和由理性预期驱动的参照点时，信息设计应如何塑造其自尊管理行为？
AI.motivation: 现有信息设计理论通常只关注信念的激励作用，忽视了信息通过参照点（参考依赖）影响行为的多重通道。本文旨在为信息设计提供更贴近现实的行为基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 损失厌恶理论；参照依赖偏好（参考依赖效用）；理性预期参照点；信息设计；信念—参考二元作用框架
AI.method: 理论建模与行为基础分析，构建损失厌恶型代理人的偏好模型，考察信念与参照点双重变化下的激励效应与自尊管理分类。
AI.findings: 参照通道可以削弱、逆转或使有利信念的激励作用非单调化；据此可对自尊管理进行偏好基础分类：高、低、中间或极化信念分别激励不同类型代理人。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信念与参照点的双重角色统一纳入信息设计框架，揭示参照通道对经典激励作用的非单调影响，并提出统一的偏好基础分类理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息设计者（管理者、政策制定者）提供基于心理风险的自尊管理策略指导，帮助按代理人的心理特征匹配信念设计以优化激励效果。

title: From Consumption to Capital Formation: An Extension of the Keynesian Stimulus Framework to Private Investment

detail.title: From Consumption to Capital Formation: An Extension of the Keynesian Stimulus Framework to Private Investment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.

detail.abstract: The empirical literature on fiscal and monetary responses to the COVID-19 shock has concentrated almost entirely on short-run consumption, employment, and output. Osuoha (2022, 2023) estimated parallel Keynesian and monetarist multiple-regression specifications on data from July 2019 to May 2022 and found that percentage changes in disposable personal income and personal consumption expenditures, together with the unemployment rate, predicted movements in real GDP more successfully than conventional monetary variables. This paper retains that independent-variable structure while shifting the dependent variable to real private nonresidential fixed investment and extending the sample through 2026Q2. Estimation with Newey-West standard errors shows that the percentage change in real personal consumption expenditures is the only consistently significant predictor of private investment growth. Disposable personal income loses significance once consumption is controlled for, and monetary variables remain weaker. Within this specification, the association between stimulus and capital formation appears to run primarily through realized consumption demand.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Osuoha（2022, 2023）关于财政与货币应对COVID-19冲击的实证研究，将因变量从实际GDP改为实际私人非住宅固定投资，样本期延伸至2026Q2。使用Newey-West标准误估计发现，实际个人消费支出百分比变化是私人投资增长的唯一一致显著预测变量，表明刺激与资本形成之间的关联主要通过已实现的消费需求传导。
AI.research_question: 在COVID-19冲击背景下，财政刺激（可支配个人收入、个人消费支出）与货币政策变量（传统货币变量）中，哪些因素能更有效地预测实际私人非住宅固定投资的增长？
AI.motivation: 既有COVID-19财政与货币应对的实证文献几乎完全集中于短期消费、就业和产出，而忽视了投资（资本形成）这一关键经济变量。Osuoha（2022, 2023）的估计以实际GDP为因变量，未考察对私人投资的影响，因此需要将分析扩展至投资领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯主义框架（强调财政刺激通过消费需求驱动经济）与货币主义框架（强调货币变量对实体经济的影响）的对比检验。
AI.method: 保留Osuoha（2022, 2023）的自变量结构（可支配个人收入和个人消费支出的百分比变化、失业率、传统货币变量），将因变量改为实际私人非住宅固定投资，样本期从2019年7月延伸至2026Q2，采用Newey-West标准误进行多元回归估计。
AI.findings: （1）实际个人消费支出百分比变化是私人投资增长的唯一一致显著预测变量；（2）一旦控制消费后，可支配个人收入失去显著性；（3）传统货币变量仍然较弱；（4）刺激与资本形成之间的关联主要通过已实现的消费需求传导。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将COVID-19财政应对的实证研究从短期需求变量拓展至资本形成领域；（2）为凯恩斯主义消费驱动投资传导机制提供了实证支持；（3）明确了在COVID-19情境下，财政刺激通过消费需求的间接路径影响投资，而非直接的收入效应。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了COVID-19冲击下刺激政策影响资本形成的传导路径证据；（2）暗示财政刺激政策的投资效应取决于能否有效转化为消费需求；（3）为评估疫情后财政与货币政策效果的长期影响提供了分析基础。

title: The State-Local Information Crisis
affiliations: Michigan State University - College of Law

detail.title: The State-Local Information Crisis
detail.abstract:
Local governments operate in environments of state-imposed stress.  States threaten and impair their ability to enact regulations, generate revenue, and advocate for their communities’ interests.  States also impose wide-ranging reporting mandates on local governments, through which local officials must provide information to state agencies on matters of public finance, land use, policing, ethics, and more. 

The forces of state-imposed stress have received sustained attention in recent years, as commentators have documented with alarm the increasingly partisan and punitive methods that state governments employ to restrain local behavior.  But reporting mandates have escaped popular and academic scrutiny.  Legal scholarship has ignored these mandates.  Legislatures have imposed them reflexively.  Courts have found them inconsequential and declined to place guardrails around them.  And residents pay reporting mandates little attention—unless and until their local officials run afoul of them, that is—even as substantive forms of state preemption have increasingly captured public attention and become part of the national political discourse.  But reporting mandates are not so dissimilar from the traditional ways that states shape and reshape local power, and indeed, they can achieve comparable outcomes through more inconspicuous and potentially insidious means.

In recent years, moreover, the system of local reporting has entered a period of crisis, driven by a proliferation of new reporting requirements and ballooning non-compliance with state mandates.  Local governments lack the staff and resources to tackle the ever-growing reporting obligations placed before them.  In this environment, reporting mandates can play deregulatory roles: they can capture and divert local resources, pulling attention away from locally desirable initiatives and pushing localities to prioritize matters favored by the state.  The result is a composite system of reporting that more and more often assumes a regulatory flavor.

This article draws upon thousands of primary source materials to document the system of state-local reporting and illuminate its ongoing compliance crisis.  The article argues that state-imposed reporting mandates are misunderstood by legal doctrine and mischaracterized by local government law.  While a single reporting obligation might advance desirable goals—it may illuminate low-visibility government action, produce valuable information, and enable states and residents to hold local leaders accountable—the composite state-local reporting system reflects and reinforces sustained capacity challenges that cut to the heart of local self-governance.  On this understanding, the article advocates for a legal approach to reporting mandates that recenters the important role of capacity in the sub-federal system.  It concludes by proposing interventions designed to mitigate the burdens of reporting mandates, an effort to tackle the state-local information crisis without compromising reporting’s transparency and accountability virtues.

AI.tldr: 本文基于数千份一手资料，系统记录了美国州政府对地方政府施加的"报告义务"（reporting mandates）体系及其合规危机，论证这些义务在复合层面上具有监管色彩，削弱了地方自治能力，并主张法律应重新重视次联邦体系中的"能力"（capacity）问题，提出减轻报告负担的干预方案。
AI.research_question: 州政府施加给地方政府的报告义务体系如何运作？其合规危机如何产生？这一体系在何种意义上构成对地方自治的隐性侵蚀，以及法律应如何回应？
AI.motivation: 州政府通过报告义务约束地方行为的方式被法律学术界、立法机关和法院所忽视。虽然实质性优先购买权（preemption）已受到公众关注，但报告义务作为更隐蔽、可能更具阴险性的手段，其影响被严重低估，且该体系正进入合规危机时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方自治理论、州-地方关系（sub-federal system）框架、监管理论（deregulatory roles）、能力理论（capacity）
AI.method: 基于数千份一手资料的文献与制度分析，系统梳理州-地方报告义务的法律与实践，分析其合规危机的成因与后果。
AI.findings: （1）报告义务在复合层面具有监管功能：捕获和转移地方资源，将地方注意力从本地优先事项拉向州偏好事项；（2）报告义务体系正因要求激增与地方政府资源不足而陷入合规危机；（3）单一报告义务可能有价值（提升透明度、问责性），但复合体系削弱了地方自治的核心能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了法律学说对报告义务"无足轻重"的传统认知，重新理论化了报告义务在州-地方关系中的监管角色，并将"能力"概念引入州-地方关系的法律分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出旨在减轻报告义务负担的具体干预方案，在保留报告制度透明度与问责价值的同时，应对州-地方信息危机，为立法机关、法院和政策制定者提供改革路径。

title: Repatriation Is a Policy Flow, Not a Rate Flow (Version 1)

detail.title: Repatriation Is a Policy Flow, Not a Rate Flow (Version 1)
detail.abstract: Using Ministry of Finance weekly data on international securities transactions, this note runs an event study of Japanese resident portfolio flows around four Bank of Japan tightening events between March 2024 and June 2026. The pattern is asymmetric. Around anticipated hikes, residents sell foreign assets during the pricing-in window and then buy them back at the announcement: 6.2 trillion yen out over the ten weeks into the July 2024 hike, 7.8 trillion yen back within four weeks of it, and an equity-specific rerun of the same shape into the June 2026 hike. The one unanticipated regime shift, the March 2024 exit from negative rates, is the only event followed by durable net repatriation. Three decompositions support the reading: the August 2024 yen surge traces to carry positioning rather than resident selling, domestic institutions did not buy the post-crash dip, and Japan's Treasury holdings barely respond to hikes. Durable repatriation follows policy regimes and mandates, not rate increments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本财务省国际证券交易的周度数据，对2024年3月至2026年6月间日本央行四次紧缩事件开展了关于日本居民投资组合资金流动的事件研究。研究发现资金流动呈现非对称模式：在预期内的加息事件中，居民在定价窗口内卖出外国资产，在公告后买回；而唯一未预期的制度转变（2024年3月退出负利率）则导致了持续性的净资金回流。
AI.research_question: 日本央行紧缩事件如何影响日本居民的投资组合资金流动？不同性质的紧缩事件（预期内加息vs未预期制度转变）是否产生不同的资金流动模式？
AI.motivation: 理解央行政策事件对跨境投资组合流动的影响机制，特别是区分预期内的利率调整与未预期的制度性转变对资金流动的不同影响，从而揭示"利率增量"与"政策制度/授权"哪个才是驱动持久性资金回流的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究方法论，结合央行政策沟通预期管理理论、投资组合再平衡理论与套息交易（carry trade）理论。
AI.method: 使用日本财务省周度国际证券交易数据，对四次日本央行紧缩事件（2024年3月退出负利率、2024年7月加息、以及后续加息事件至2026年6月）进行事件研究。采用三重分解分析以验证解释的稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）资金流动呈非对称模式：预期内加息时，居民在定价窗口（加息前10周）卖出外国资产，公告后4周内买回（2024年7月加息前流出6.2万亿日元，公告后4周内回流7.8万亿日元）；（2）唯一未预期的制度转变（2024年3月退出负利率）导致持久性净资金回流；（3）2024年8月日元飙升源于套息交易头寸而非居民抛售；（4）国内机构未在暴跌后买入；（5）日本国债持有对加息反应微弱。结论：持久性资金回流源于政策制度与授权而非利率增量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分了预期内利率调整与未预期制度转变对跨境资金流动的不同影响，揭示了"政策制度与授权"而非"利率增量"才是驱动持久性资本回流的关键机制，深化了对央行政策传导至国际资本流动的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于央行沟通与预期管理对资本流动影响的实证证据；为市场参与者理解日本央行政策事件对日元汇率及跨境资金流的影响提供了分析框架；对全球投资者评估日本政策制度性转变的资本流动后果具有参考价值。

title: The Economics of Feng Shui: A Theory of Culturally Transmitted Beliefs in Asset Markets
affiliations: Columbia University

detail.title: The Economics of Feng Shui: A Theory of Culturally Transmitted Beliefs in Asset Markets
detail.abstract: When can a belief with no objective payoff consequences become permanently embedded in asset prices? I couple intergenerational preference transmission to a competitive asset market where an attribute yields utility only to those who believe it does; parents exert costly effort to pass belief or skepticism to their children. The attribute's price capitalizes the belief's future prevalence and feeds back on transmission. When the belief is rare, believers scarcely compete for the attribute and believing is nearly free, so transmission revives; when it is widespread, the premium taxes believing children, discouraging their parents from transmitting the belief, and enlarges the visible overpayment, mobilizing skeptical parents to transmit skepticism to their children, so the belief recedes. The market taxes the belief but cannot eliminate it: every equilibrium path converges to a unique, globally stable interior steady state with a permanent premium. Cultural parameters determine how many believe; the interest rate determines only what believing costs. Payoff-based selection alone would render premia transient, so their persistence among the native-born identifies the transmission mechanism itself. In extensions, cheaper supply-side accommodation of a belief spreads it, and verifying intermediaries capture the speculative component of its price. The framework rationalizes superstition premia in housing markets, its motivating application, and applies to any heritable taste attached to a tradable asset.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个跨代偏好传递与竞争性资产市场耦合的模型，证明即使信念没有客观收益后果，也可能在资产价格中永久嵌入（形成持久溢价）。信念的流行度通过资产价格反馈影响代际传递：稀少时信念近乎免费得以复兴，普及时溢价使传递受阻、促使怀疑论传播。市场对信念征税但无法消除，所有均衡路径收敛到唯一全球稳定的内点稳态，形成永久溢价。
AI.research_question: 一个没有客观收益后果的信念何时能够永久嵌入资产价格？即信念的流行度如何通过资产价格形成持久溢价并自我维持？
AI.motivation: 传统基于收益（payoff）的选择机制只能产生暂时性溢价，无法解释现实中信念长期嵌入资产价格的持续性现象（如住房市场的迷信溢价）。作者希望识别背后驱动信念永久嵌入的传递机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨代偏好传递模型（intergenerational preference transmission）耦合竞争性资产市场定价；价格反馈效应（price feedback）、文化传递（cultural transmission）、信念资本化机制。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建代际偏好传递与资产市场均衡的耦合动态模型，分析信念流行度的路径动态与稳态性质，并通过扩展分析（供给侧调节、验证中介）考察机制的稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）市场对信念征税但无法消除，所有均衡路径收敛到唯一、全局稳定的内点稳态，产生永久溢价；（2）文化参数决定多少人相信，利率仅决定相信的成本；（3）供给侧对信念的廉价调节会扩大信念传播，验证中介会捕获价格的投机成分；（4）信念的持久性可识别传递机制本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"信念嵌入资产价格"提供了理论基础，将文化传递与资产定价结合，证明基于收益的选择不足以保证持久溢价，从而识别出传递机制的理论必要性；扩展了偏好内生化的资产定价文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房市场的迷信溢价等现象提供了统一解释框架；为政策制定者理解非理性信念如何定价、如何通过供给侧干预影响信念传播提供参考；验证中介的角色为市场设计提供启示。

title: When Numbers Become the Crime: Crime-Statistic Corruption From the Soviet Stick System to CompStat – and the Incentive-Decoupled Evaluation Model

detail.title: When Numbers Become the Crime: Crime-Statistic Corruption From the Soviet Stick System to CompStat – and the Incentive-Decoupled Evaluation Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or personal, in relation to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The empirical component is an anonymous survey of adult law-enforcement professionals who took part voluntarily after being informed of the survey's purpose and its anonymity. No personally identifying information was collected, and free-text responses were stored separately from the response data. The study was conducted as independent research, not under an institution maintaining an institutional review board (IRB), and adhered to the principles of voluntary, informed participation and participant anonymity.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding; it was conducted independently by the author.

keywords.keywords: police performance metrics; crime statistics; CompStat; clearance rates; Goodhart's Law; Campbell's Law; metric fixation; palochna sistema; police reform; post-Soviet policing; organized crime; anti-corruption; institutional design; incentive design; Ukraine; comparative criminal justice

detail.abstract: When the statistics that describe crime also decide which officers are promoted, the numbers stop describing reality and begin manufacturing it. This Article shows that quantitative performance metrics, once they double as the instruments by which individual officers are evaluated, systematically corrupt the information they exist to produce: crimes go unrecorded, serious offenses are reclassified downward, and cases are fabricated to hit the target. Drawing on archival history, a comparative study of nine policing systems, and an original 2026 field survey of 150 Ukrainian law-enforcement personnel, it traces this pathology from the Soviet plan-fulfillment system and its post-Soviet successor, the palochna sistema, through American CompStat and Britain's "Targetworld." The failure is one of design, not culture: it recurs wherever evaluative weight is placed on manipulable output indicators, from a Moscow precinct to a New York one, and recedes wherever measurement is institutionally separated from appraisal, as in Germany and Norway. The costs are concrete-wrongful convictions, impunity for organized crime whose complex cases become professionally irrational to pursue, and the erosion of the public trust on which lawful order depends. Building on Campbell's Law and Goodhart's Law, the Article offers a remedy: the Incentive-Decoupled Evaluation Model (IDEM), which separates the analytical use of crime data from personnel evaluation, flags corrupted indicators, and verifies performance through citizen reporting-implementable by administrative order at near-zero cost. The same logic, it concludes, governs any institution judged by numbers its own agents generate.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了当犯罪统计数据同时作为警务人员晋升依据时，这些数字会从描述现实变为制造现实——导致案件漏记、重罪降级和案件造假。作者通过档案历史、九国警务系统比较以及2026年对150名乌克兰执法人员的实地调查，追溯了这一病理从苏联计划完成体系到美国CompStat和英国"目标世界"的演变，并提出"激励脱钩评估模型"(IDEM)作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 当定量绩效指标同时作为个体警务人员的评估工具时，如何系统性腐蚀其本应产生的信息质量？
AI.motivation: 犯罪统计数据既是描述现实的工具，也是晋升决策的依据，这种双重角色导致数据被系统性操纵。作者旨在揭示这一普遍性制度缺陷并提出可行补救方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 坎贝尔定律(Campbell's Law)和古德哈特定律(Goodhart's Law)，即当指标成为目标时，指标便失去其作为指标的价值。
AI.method: 混合方法：档案历史研究、九国警务系统的比较研究、以及2026年对150名乌克兰执法人员的原始实地调查。
AI.findings: 该失败是设计问题而非文化问题：只要评估权重放在可操纵的输出指标上，腐败就会复发（如莫斯科和纽约的警局）；当测量与评估在制度上分离时（如德国和挪威），腐败就会消退。具体代价包括错误定罪、有组织犯罪的逍遥法外以及公众信任的侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 将坎贝尔定律和古德哈特定律系统化应用于警务绩效评估领域，揭示了"测量与评估合并"这一制度设计缺陷的普遍性，并提出了激励脱钩评估模型(IDEM)作为理论性补救框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可在行政命令下以近零成本实施的IDEM模型，分离犯罪数据的分析用途与人事评估，标记被腐蚀的指标，并通过公民举报验证绩效；该逻辑适用于任何由自身代理人产生数字并以此评判的制度机构。

title: Overcoming Administrative Overload: An Innovative Quality Project Management Framework Shifting to Patient-Centered Care
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Overcoming Administrative Overload: An Innovative Quality Project Management Framework Shifting to Patient-Centered Care
detail.abstract: This study critically evaluates the systemic barriers generated by excessive quality reporting under the National Health Service of Ukraine (NHSU) and proposes a novel quality management framework to redirect operations toward patient-centered care. Using a cross-sectional dataset of 435 stakeholders (medical workers, civil servants, and patients), we analyzed perceptions of administrative burden, systemic barriers, and funding preferences. The results indicate a profound perceptual disconnect: while medical workers and patients evaluate interpersonal care positively (dignity and communication >4.0/5.0), civil servants rate structural convenience (2.3/5.0) and financial affordability (1.7/5.0) as critical failures. Top systemic barriers preventing patient-centered care include insufficient funding (n=213), low staff motivation (n=193), and staff shortages (n=192). A robust majority of stakeholders (n=261) prefer a mixed funding model over pure capitation or payment per case. Cost-sharing analysis reveals a strong preference for full state funding (100%) at the primary care level, shifting toward co-payment splits (80% state / 20% patient) at secondary and tertiary tiers. We conclude that bureaucratic quality reporting and personnel shortages heavily overload the clinical environment, displacing direct care. To resolve this, healthcare project management must pivot toward agile, value-based workflows. We introduce the Patient-Centric Value-Testing Framework (PC-VTF), which integrates selective automation, Minimally Disruptive Medicine, and continuous feedback loops. The PC-VTF optimizes resource allocation, protects clinical cognitive capacity, and enhances patient experiences. Ultimately, healthcare quality is realized when the institutional architecture is designed to support, not disrupt, the patient-physician relationship.

AI.tldr: 本研究批判性评估了乌克兰国家医疗服务体系（NHSU）下过度质量报告产生的系统性障碍，基于435名利益相关者的横截面数据揭示了医疗工作者、公务员和患者之间的认知断裂，并提出以患者为中心的敏捷质量管理框架（PC-VTF）来优化资源分配、保护临床认知能力并改善患者体验。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰NHSU体制下过度的质量报告如何产生系统性障碍，阻碍以患者为中心的医疗服务？如何设计新的质量管理框架来应对这些障碍？
AI.motivation: 官僚化质量报告和人员短缺严重超载了临床环境，挤占了直接照护的时间和资源。当前的质量管理体系未能支持患者与医生之间的核心关系，需要重新设计以转向以患者为中心的照护模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 患者中心价值测试框架（PC-VTF），整合选择性自动化、最小干扰医学（Minimally Disruptive Medicine）和持续反馈循环；涉及敏捷价值导向工作流、资金模型理论（混合资金、按人头付费、按病例付费）
AI.method: 横截面调查法，收集435名利益相关者（医疗工作者、公务员、患者）的数据，分析行政负担感知、系统性障碍和资金偏好。采用描述性统计分析和利益相关者感知对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）存在显著的感知断裂：医务人员和患者对人际关怀评价正面（尊严和沟通>4.0/5.0），而公务员对结构性便利（2.3/5.0）和财务可负担性（1.7/5.0）评价为关键失败；（2）主要系统性障碍包括资金不足（n=213）、员工积极性低（n=193）和人员短缺（n=192）；（3）大多数利益相关者（n=261）偏好混合资金模式而非纯按人头或按病例付费；（4）成本分摊分析显示初级卫生保健层面偏好全额国家资助（100%），二级和三级层面转向共付模式（国家80%/患者20%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出PC-VTF（患者中心价值测试框架），将选择性自动化、最小干扰医学和持续反馈回路整合进质量管理，为医疗质量管理从官僚化转向以患者为中心的敏捷模式提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰及类似转型期卫生系统提供了质量管理改革路径：建议采用混合资金模式、优化初级/二级/三级卫生保健的成本分摊比例、通过敏捷工作流减轻行政负担并保护临床认知资源。

title: Economists'  Amicus Critique of District Court Opinion in FTC v Meta
affiliations: Georgetown University Law Center

detail.title: Economists'  Amicus Critique of District Court Opinion in FTC v Meta
detail.abstract: This amicus brief analyzes the flaws in the district court opinion.  The flaws involve the analysis of market definition, including the application of the List experiments, and the failure to analyze Meta’s market power as of the date of the complaint.  If upheld, this latter error can lead to severe under-deterrence effects in monopoly maintenance cases by incentivizing delay.

AI.tldr: 本文是法庭之友意见书，分析了地区法院判决中的缺陷，涉及市场定义的错误分析（包括List实验的应用）以及未能按起诉日期分析Meta的市场力量。如果后一错误被维持，将通过在垄断维持案件中激励拖延，导致严重的威慑不足效应。
AI.research_question: 地区法院在垄断维持案件中，对市场定义（包括List实验的应用）和Meta市场力量的时间点分析存在哪些错误？这些错误会带来什么政策后果？
AI.motivation: 地区法院判决在市场定义和市场力量分析上存在根本性缺陷，若维持原判将产生严重的威慑不足效应，激励企业通过拖延策略规避反垄断责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法中的垄断维持（monopoly maintenance）理论、市场定义理论（包括List实验方法）、市场力量分析的时间维度理论、反垄断威慑理论。
AI.method: 法庭之友意见书（Amicus Brief），通过对地区法院判决的法律分析，从法律逻辑和证据标准两个层面剖析其推理错误。
AI.findings: 地区法院存在以下缺陷：(1)市场定义分析有误，包括对List实验的错误应用；(2)未按原告起诉日期分析Meta的市场力量；(3)后一错误可能导致严重的威慑不足效应，激励企业通过拖延诉讼来维持垄断地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调在垄断维持案件中市场力量评估的时间基准应定于起诉日，并阐明错误的时序分析会如何破坏反垄断法的威慑功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上诉法院提供具体的法律分析框架和纠错建议，同时警示司法实践中的时间点错误可能对反垄断执法产生的系统性负面影响。

title: Reconciling the Association Between ESG Performance and Corporate Financial Performance: International Evidence Using MCDA Approach
affiliations: Coventry University, Coventry University and Institute of Professional Education and Research

detail.title: Reconciling the Association Between ESG Performance and Corporate Financial Performance: International Evidence Using MCDA Approach
detail.abstract: Empirical and theoretical studies on the association between corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) score and financial performance suggest conflicting predictions. To reconcile these inconsistencies, we draw on a dataset of 5,227 firms and 40,160 observations across 41 countries from 2002 to 2021, and examine the association of ESG score with corporate financial performance and market value creation. To this end, we further explore how a country’s development status, legal origin, strength of investor protection, and periods of economic downturn moderate this relationship. Accounting for various potential endogeneity concerns, we find a significantly positive association between ESG score and financial performance, particularly in G7 countries, common law systems, and jurisdictions with stronger investor protection. This effect is more pronounced during economic crises. Using a multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) method, in an attempt for further reconciliation, we construct a peer-relative ESG measure using an MCDA approach based on the PROMETHEE method. By employing comprehensive pairwise comparisons and outranking relationships within industries, this method provides a stable alternative to assess how ESG affects performance, especially when existing indices may be subject to revisions. The core results remain robust under this specification. Our findings support the institutional difference hypothesis, which suggests that the link between ESG and financial performance and value is shaped by a country's specific institutional frameworks. These results offer implications for managers, regulators, and policymakers in evaluating the explanatory power of ESG metrics across diverse markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2002-2021年间来自41个国家5,227家企业的40,160个观测值，考察企业ESG评分与财务绩效和市场价值之间的关系，并探讨国家发展水平、法律渊源、投资者保护强度和经济下行期对该关系的调节作用。研究发现ESG评分与财务绩效显著正相关，尤其在G7国家、普通法系和投资者保护较强的司法管辖区更为明显，且在经济危机期间更为显著。作者还采用基于PROMETHEE方法的多准则决策分析(MCDA)构建同行相对ESG测度，作为对现有指数的稳健性替代，结果支持制度差异假说。
AI.research_question: 企业ESG评分与财务绩效和市场价值创造之间的关联是什么？国家层面的制度因素（发展水平、法律渊源、投资者保护）和经济周期如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 现有关于ESG评分与企业财务绩效关系的理论研究和实证研究存在相互矛盾的预测，需要更大规模、跨国家的数据来调和这些不一致的结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度差异假说（Institutional Difference Hypothesis）
AI.method: 基于2002-2021年41个国家5,227家企业的40,160个观测值的实证分析，处理各种潜在内生性问题；采用基于PROMETHEE方法的多准则决策分析(MCDA)构建同行相对ESG测度作为稳健性检验。
AI.findings: ESG评分与财务绩效显著正相关，尤其在G7国家、普通法系和投资者保护较强的司法管辖区；该效应在经济危机期间更为显著；基于MCDA/PROMETHEE方法的同行相对ESG测度下核心结果保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过大规模跨国家数据调和了以往研究中关于ESG与企业绩效关系的矛盾结论，实证支持了制度差异假说，表明一国的制度框架塑造了ESG与财务绩效之间的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者、监管者和政策制定者提供了在不同市场中评估ESG指标解释力的参考，并引入了基于MCDA/PROMETHEE方法的同行相对ESG测度作为现有指数的稳定替代方案。

title: From Improvised to Standardized: Testing Interaction Effects in Logit, Probit, And Other Nonlinear Models
affiliations: Aarhus University - Department of Economics and Business Economics

detail.title: From Improvised to Standardized: Testing Interaction Effects in Logit, Probit, And Other Nonlinear Models
detail.abstract: Management theories are routinely tested as moderation hypotheses about whether a firm enters, adopts, or fails, or whether a candidate is hired. In the nonlinear models such outcomes call for, like logit and probit, the coefficient on a product term is not the interaction effect: it can differ in magnitude, significance, and sign. Across 205 articles in five leading journals, only 5% test the interaction effect from a model suited to the outcome; nearly half retreat to a linear probability model. I introduce a standardized remedy: the average interaction effect, computed by ginteff in Stata and R for binary, ordered, multinomial, and fractional models. Reanalyses of three published studies change or sharpen conclusions; simulations show each common practice failing while the average interaction effect holds.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了管理学研究中一个普遍但被忽视的方法论问题：在检验交互效应时，大量研究使用logit、probit等非线性模型，但乘积项的系数并不能直接代表交互效应。作者通过分析205篇顶级期刊文章发现，仅5%的研究正确检验了交互效应，近半数退回到线性概率模型。作者提出了标准化解决方案——平均交互效应（average interaction effect），并提供Stata和R软件的ginteff命令实现。通过重新分析三个已发表研究和模拟实验，证明该方法优于常见做法。
AI.research_question: 在非线性模型（如logit、probit）中，管理学研究者如何正确检验和解释交互效应？当前实践存在哪些方法论错误，如何提供标准化的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 管理学理论经常以调节效应（moderation）的形式进行检验，但许多结果变量是分类变量（如企业是否进入、是否采纳、是否失败、候选人是否被录用），需要用logit、probit等非线性模型。然而在这些模型中，乘积项的系数并不能直接解释为交互效应，其大小、显著性和符号都可能与真实的交互效应不同。作者通过调查发现这一错误在顶级期刊中极为普遍，需要提供方法论上的纠正方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性模型（logit、probit）中的交互效应理论；平均边际效应（average marginal effect）框架
AI.method: （1）对5本顶级期刊的205篇文章进行系统性内容分析，评估交互效应的检验实践；（2）提出平均交互效应（average interaction effect）作为标准化方法，开发ginteff命令（支持Stata和R，适用于二分类、有序、多分类和分数模型）；（3）重新分析三个已发表研究以展示效果；（4）通过模拟实验比较不同方法的统计表现。
AI.findings: （1）在205篇顶级期刊文章中，仅5%使用合适的模型检验了交互效应，近半数退回到线性概率模型（LPM）；（2）重新分析三个已发表研究后，结论有所改变或更加明确；（3）模拟实验显示，常见的错误做法（如直接解读乘积项系数、使用LPM）均会失败，而平均交互效应方法表现稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非线性模型中的调节效应检验提供了标准化的方法论框架，纠正了管理学文献中长期存在的系统性偏差，有助于提高理论检验的有效性和结论的可靠性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了易于使用的ginteff软件命令（支持Stata和R），覆盖二分类、有序、多分类和分数模型，使研究者能够便捷地正确计算和检验平均交互效应。

title: Handling Incomplete or Missing Data in Agent-Based Transportation Recommendation Engines

detail.title: Handling Incomplete or Missing Data in Agent-Based Transportation Recommendation Engines
detail.abstract: Agent-based recommendation engines have emerged as a transformative paradigm for intelligent transportation systems, offering personalized, context-aware mobility solutions by simulating heterogeneous traveler preferences, real-time network conditions, and multi-modal transit options. However, the operational efficacy of these systems is critically undermined by the pervasive challenge of incomplete or missing data-a structural inevitability in dynamic urban environments where sensor failures, communication latency, privacy constraints, and sporadic user inputs create fragmented state representations. This paper addresses a fundamental research gap: how can agentic recommendation frameworks maintain decisionmaking integrity and user trust when the underlying data stream is inherently partial and uncertain? We propose a novel hybrid imputation-reasoning architecture that integrates (1) a spatio-temporal graph neural network for contextual missing value prediction across traffic, weather, and demand dimensions; (2) a probabilistic Bayesian inference layer that quantifies epistemic uncertainty in agent beliefs; and (3) a regret-minimizing recommendation policy that explicitly accounts for imputation confidence in its utility calculations. Our framework departs from conventional "impute-then-optimize" pipelines by enabling agents to dynamically adapt their exploration-exploitation trade-offs based on real-time data completeness metrics, effectively treating missingness as a first-class feature rather than a nuisance artifact. We evaluate our system using three large-scale, real-world mobility datasets-including GPS trace logs, transit feed specifications, and crowdsourced incident reports-under controlled missingness scenarios (ranging from 5% to 45% data absence) simulating hardware degradation, network partitioning, and user opt-out events. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves up to 34% improvement in recommendation acceptance rates compared to state-of-the-art baseline imputation methods, while simultaneously reducing average trip deviation by 22% under high-missingness conditions. Furthermore, we introduce a novel Missingness-Aware Trust Score (MATS) that provides end-users with transparent confidence indicators for each recommended itinerary, fostering calibrated trust without overreliance on potentially spurious imputations. Our findings establish that proactive uncertainty management-rather than passive data completion-constitutes the cornerstone of resilient agent-based transportation recommenders. We conclude by delineating deployment considerations for smart city infrastructures, including edge-computing constraints, privacy-preserving imputation protocols, and human-in-the-loop escalation mechanisms when uncertainty thresholds are exceeded. This work contributes a principled, empirically validated framework that transforms data incompleteness from an operational liability into a governance opportunity for next-generation mobility ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合插补-推理架构，将时空图神经网络、概率贝叶斯推理层和遗憾最小化推荐策略整合到基于代理的推荐引擎中，将数据缺失视为一等特征而非干扰因素，使代理能够动态调整探索-利用权衡。在三个大规模真实移动数据集中（5%-45%缺失率），该方法相比最先进基线在推荐接受率上提升高达34%，平均行程偏差降低22%，并引入缺失感知信任评分（MATS）为用户提供透明的置信度指标。
AI.research_question: 当底层数据流本质上不完整且不确定时，基于代理的推荐框架如何维持决策完整性和用户信任？
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统中基于代理的推荐引擎面临传感器故障、通信延迟、隐私约束和偶发用户输入等造成的缺失数据问题，这是动态城市环境中的结构性必然。现有"先插补再优化"管线忽视了不确定性管理，导致决策质量下降和用户信任受损。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时空图神经网络（插补）、概率贝叶斯推理（认知不确定性量化）、遗憾最小化决策理论（探索-利用权衡）、校准信任理论（MATS信任评分）
AI.method: 构建混合插补-推理架构：(1) 时空图神经网络用于跨交通、天气和需求维度的上下文缺失值预测；(2) 概率贝叶斯推理层量化代理信念中的认知不确定性；(3) 遗憾最小化推荐策略在效用计算中显式考虑插补置信度。代理根据实时数据完整性指标动态调整探索-利用权衡。在三个大规模真实数据集上，通过控制缺失场景（5%-45%）模拟硬件退化、网络分区和用户退出事件进行验证。
AI.findings: 在高度缺失条件下，相比最先进基线插补方法，推荐接受率提升高达34%，平均行程偏差降低22%。引入的缺失感知信任评分（MATS）为每个推荐行程提供透明置信度指标，培养校准信任而不过度依赖可能虚假的插补值。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破了传统"先插补再优化"范式的局限，将数据缺失性从"干扰伪影"重新定义为"一等特征"，建立了主动不确定性管理（而非被动数据补全）作为韧性代理推荐器基石的理论框架，并引入MATS作为校准信任的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智慧城市基础设施提供部署考量，包括边缘计算约束、隐私保护插补协议，以及当不确定性阈值被超过时的人机协作升级机制。将数据不完整从运营负债转化为下一代移动生态系统的治理机遇，并以大规模真实数据集实证验证。

title:
How Much of DeFi Liquidity Is Higher-Order? 
Survivorship, LP Representation, and a Null that Holds
affiliations: Hofstra University

detail.title:
How Much of DeFi Liquidity Is Higher-Order? 
Survivorship, LP Representation, and a Null that Holds
detail.abstract: How much of the loop structure of a DeFi liquidity network is genuinely higher-order, and is that quantity stable? Curve's 3pool binds {USDC, USDT, DAI} in a single contract, a three-way relationship that a pairwise graph discards and that the nerve complex of pool comembership retains. Measured over Ethereum stablecoin pools by persistent homology, the quantity is not stable at all. The higher-order fraction swings from 0.31 to 0.93 across two defensible modeling choices that are rarely reported as sensitivities. The larger driver is LP-token representation. Resolving an LP token such as 3CRV into its base assets collapses metapools toward a cone and roughly doubles the fraction; keeping 3CRV as its own vertex does not. The second driver is survivorship, and it is fixable. Standard registry-based reconstruction filters today's pool list backwards, silently conditioning on survival, and recovers only ∼10 % of the loop structure. Internet Archive snapshots of the registry endpoint recover the rest: we rebuild the full historical universe over 36 snapshots (Oct 2022 to May 2025). De-censoring also revives the LP-resolution comparison, which a survivor-only view cannot run at all, since the relevant metapools have all delisted. Against that fragility, one result survives every choice we vary. Through both the March 2023 USDC depeg and the July 2023 Curve/Vyper exploit the reconstructed structure is inert, moving less than routine month-to-month drift, under either representation and on either sample. An apparent signal at the exploit traced to corrupted TVL in the one archive crawl captured mid-event, and repairing it removes the signal. That is a second data-quality trap beside survivorship, and registry-based work has to guard against it. We read the null economically: stablecoins are common-numéraire substitutes, so their liquidity scaffold is shallow and does not rewire under price stress. The methodological lesson is to report the higher-order content of a DeFi network as a sensitivity range over survivorship and representation, never as a point estimate. Code and data are fully reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文使用持续同调（persistent homology）分析以太坊稳定币流动性池中DeFi流动性网络的高阶环结构，发现其高阶比例在0.31到0.93之间大幅波动，主要受LP代币表示方式和生存偏差（survivorship bias）两个建模选择驱动。尽管结构脆弱，但研究发现该网络在2023年3月USDC脱锚和2023年7月Curve/Vyper攻击等重大事件中均保持惰性，未发生明显重构。
AI.research_question: DeFi流动性网络中有多少环结构是真正的高阶结构？这一数量是否稳定？
AI.motivation: 传统成对图（pairwise graph）无法捕获如Curve 3pool中三个代币在同一合约中的三方关系，需要更丰富的高阶拓扑表示。同时，现有研究很少报告建模选择对高阶结构度量的敏感性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 持续同调（persistent homology）理论、神经复形（nerve complex）理论、拓扑数据分析
AI.method: 使用持续同调分析以太坊稳定币池的神经复形结构；利用Internet Archive的36个快照（2022年10月至2025年5月）重建完整历史池宇宙，以修正生存偏差；对比LP代币解析（如将3CRV解析为基础资产）与不解析两种表示方式；通过数据修复检验事件信号的有效性。
AI.findings: 1) 高阶结构比例在0.31到0.93之间大幅波动，远非稳定；2) 最大驱动因素是LP代币表示方式——解析LP代币会使高阶比例约翻倍；3) 第二个驱动因素是生存偏差，标准注册表重建仅恢复约10%的环结构，而Internet Archive快照可恢复完整历史；4) 在2023年3月USDC脱锚和2023年7月Curve/Vyper攻击期间，网络结构均保持惰性，变动小于常规月度漂移；5) 攻击期间表观信号可追溯至单一存档爬取中的TVL数据损坏，修复后信号消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将持续同调应用于DeFi流动性网络的高阶结构分析；2) 揭示高阶结构度量的严重脆弱性，提出必须报告为敏感性范围而非点估计的方法论原则；3) 识别出LP代币表示和生存偏差两大建模陷阱；4) 发现第二种数据质量陷阱——事件期间存档爬取的TVL污染问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供完全可复现的代码和数据；2) 提出使用Internet Archive快照重建完整历史池宇宙的方法，修正标准注册表方法的生存偏差；3) 从经济学视角解释稳定币流动性支架的浅层性——稳定币是共同计价替代品，因此价格压力下不会重构；4) 为DeFi网络分析提供数据质量检查指南（生存偏差和TVL污染双重防护）。

title: Dismantling the Deficit: Diagnosis, Inequity, and Strengths in Neurobiological and Sociological Approaches to Dyslexia

detail.title: Dismantling the Deficit: Diagnosis, Inequity, and Strengths in Neurobiological and Sociological Approaches to Dyslexia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: Drawing upon both sociological and neurobiological perspectives, this paper explores issues surrounding the framing of dyslexia as a disability. The introduction presents neurobiological underpinnings of this condition as opposed to its social construction. It addresses the neurobiological problems entailed in rapid automatized naming, morphological awareness, visual attention and eye movements, the magnocellular dorsal pathway, auditory processing, and the visual word form area. The paper then investigates the sociological structures involved in diagnosing and providing support to people with dyslexia. This reveals that delayed and non-diagnosis are often caused by socio-economic, racial, and linguistic disparities. In addition, the paper discusses the psychological and lifelong outcomes of delayed and non-diagnosis. These outcomes include bullying, anxiety, depression, noncompletion of degrees, unemployment, and health inequalities. At that point, the analysis shifts to dyslexia treatment, accommodations, and non-traditional methods for intervention. Personalized education programs, assistive technology, and musical-based interventions are also considered. The paper further investigates the gifts associated with dyslexia, namely creativity, visuospatial ability, semantic fluency and processing style, socio-emotional strength, and the role of the parasympathetic nervous system in these abilities. Through a deeper understanding of the condition's neurobiological and sociological factors throughout the life course, its diagnosis and treatment can be improved.

AI.tldr: 本文从社会学和神经生物学双重视角探讨阅读障碍（dyslexia）作为残疾的建构问题，涵盖其神经生物学基础（快速自动命名、形态意识、视觉注意、大细胞背侧通路、听觉处理、视觉词形区等）、社会学诊断与支持结构中的不平等（社会经济、种族、语言差异导致延迟或漏诊）、延迟诊断带来的心理与终身后果（欺凌、焦虑、抑郁、辍学、失业、健康不平等），以及治疗干预（个性化教育、辅助技术、音乐干预）和阅读障碍者所拥有的天赋（创造力、视觉空间能力、语义流畅性、社会情感优势及副交感神经系统的作用）。
AI.research_question: 如何从神经生物学与社会学双重视角全面理解阅读障碍作为残疾的建构，以及这种理解如何改进其诊断与治疗？
AI.motivation: 阅读障碍作为一个既有神经生物学基础又受社会建构影响的条件，单一视角难以全面理解；且延迟/漏诊导致的负面终身后果凸显了跨学科综合研究的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经生物学视角（大细胞背侧通路、视觉词形区、听觉处理等脑机制）与社会建构主义视角（残疾的社会建构、诊断的社会结构）相结合。
AI.method: 综述性论文，整合神经生物学与社会学两大学科领域的研究文献，进行跨学科综合分析。
AI.findings: 延迟和非诊断常由社会经济、种族和语言差异导致；延迟诊断引发欺凌、焦虑、抑郁、学位未完成、失业和健康不平等等终身后果；个性化教育、辅助技术和音乐干预是有效手段；阅读障碍者拥有创造力、视觉空间能力、语义流畅性、社会情感优势等天赋，与副交感神经系统相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将神经生物学与社会学视角整合的框架来理解阅读障碍，突破传统单一学科局限，丰富了对阅读障碍"残疾"属性的辩证理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进阅读障碍的诊断公平性（减少社会不平等造成的漏诊）、制定更有效的个性化干预策略，以及重新认识阅读障碍者的优势能力提供了实践指导。

title: Artificial Sameness
affiliations: Hofstra University - Maurice A. Deane School of Law and Florida State University College of Law

detail.title: Artificial Sameness
detail.abstract:
A lesbian couple asks ChatGPT to generate a family from their photo, only to get a heterosexual couple with two children. AI selects minorities out of mortgages and jobs, but into prison. Scholars call this algorithmic discrimination and propose debiasing AI models along protected-class lines, litigating algorithmic screening, and regulating automated decisionmaking.


This account is mistaken. AI’s distinctive danger is not discrimination, but homogenization—the erasure of diversity by compressing everyone and everything toward the most common pattern. The lesbian couple were overwritten, not targeted, for deviating from that pattern: the heterosexual couple with two children. This Article theorizes artificial sameness as the systematic convergence of outputs, reasoning, and ultimately thought itself, driven by AI’s architecture. Existing tools, including bias audits and disparate impact analysis, are blind to artificial sameness because they detect skew, not compression. Worse, when the law mistakes homogenization for discrimination, it creates the debiasing trap: correcting AI outputs along protected-class lines supplies the very intentional classification that current doctrine forbids.


Artificial sameness compounds at two levels. AI first homogenizes what people produce, and then what people expect, as AI-mediated norms become the new standard. Today’s artificial sameness is the least dangerous form because it is still recognizable as “AI slop”—choppy sentences, six-fingered hands, and synthetic polish. Before technological progress conceals those fingerprints, we must ask ourselves: what happens to a society predicated on diverse minds when every mind reasons through the same machine?


Artificial sameness threatens the constitutional order. The marketplace of ideas, the laboratories of democracy, and the adversary system all presuppose distinct judgments in a shared enterprise. We identify the common value underlying these commitments as “laboratories of originality”: the cognitive diversity that artificial sameness erodes, not by shutting down any particular laboratory, but by making every laboratory run the same experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将AI风险定义为"算法歧视"的主流观点，提出AI的真正危险在于"人工同一性"（artificial sameness）——即AI系统将一切输出、推理乃至思想压缩向最常见模式的同质化倾向。这种同质化不同于歧视，因为AI并非针对少数群体，而是将所有偏离主流模式的现象覆盖重写。现有法律工具（如偏见审计、差异影响分析）只检测"偏斜"而非"压缩"，因此对人工同一性失明。更为严重的是，若法律将此误判为歧视并进行"去偏"纠正，反而落入"去偏陷阱"——按照受保护类别校正AI输出恰恰实施了现行法所禁止的意图性分类。
AI.research_question: AI系统的真正危险究竟是什么？它如何威胁宪法秩序和思想多样性？
AI.motivation: 主流学术界和监管者将AI风险框定为"算法歧视"，但这一框架存在根本性误判：AI的核心危险不是对少数群体的针对性排斥，而是对所有偏离主流者的同质化压缩。现有反歧视工具无法识别这种风险，且法律误判可能导致更严重的后果（去偏陷阱）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出"人工同一性"（artificial sameness）理论，将其定义为输出、推理乃至思想本身的系统性趋同，由AI架构驱动。文章还提出"原创性实验室"（laboratories of originality）概念，作为连接思想市场、民主实验室和对抗制诉讼共同价值的理论框架——即认知多样性。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念建构的方法：通过案例（女同性恋夫妇被ChatGPT重写为异性恋夫妇）、既有的去偏研究和宪法理论，进行多层次的规范性论证。
AI.findings: （1）人工同一性在两个层面累积：先同质化产出，再同质化期望；（2）现有反歧视工具（偏见审计、差异影响分析）检测的是偏斜而非压缩，因此对人工同一性失明；（3）法律将同质化误判为歧视时产生"去偏陷阱"：按受保护类别校正输出现恰是现行教义所禁止的意图分类；（4）人工同一性威胁宪法秩序，因为思想市场、民主实验室和对抗制系统都预设共享事业中的独立判断，而AI使每个"实验室"运行同一实验。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将AI风险从"歧视"范式转向"同一性"范式，提出"人工同一性"和"原创性实验室"两个新概念，为AI治理提供了不同于反歧视法框架的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者不要简单套用反歧视工具来规制AI，指出去偏操作可能加剧而非解决宪法层面的危害；呼吁在AI技术进一步进步、其同质化"指纹"消失之前，认真审视AI对社会认知多样性的根本威胁。

title: Earnings Quality, Corporate Governance, and Market Valuation: Empirical Evidence on Accrual Discretion and Controlling Shareholder Ownership
affiliations: Inha University

detail.title: Earnings Quality, Corporate Governance, and Market Valuation: Empirical Evidence on Accrual Discretion and Controlling Shareholder Ownership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes publicly available empirical corporate finance data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how two earnings-quality-related constructs - the absolute magnitude of discretionary accruals and controlling shareholder ownership concentration - are priced by equity markets. Using a pooled sample of 6,078 firm-year observations drawn from firms listed on the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) over 2000–2016, we estimate ordinary least squares regressions of Tobin's Q on lagged absolute discretionary accruals (|DA|, estimated via the Modified Jones Model), lagged controlling shareholder ownership (Control), and a set of standard firm-level controls. We document two robust and, notably, offsetting results. First, |DA| is significantly positively associated with Tobin's Q (β = 0.627, p < 0.001), contradicting the conventional discretionary-accrual valuation discount and instead consistent with a signaling channel through which managers use accrual discretion to convey credible private information, or alternatively with functional fixation on the part of investors. Second, controlling shareholder ownership is significantly negatively associated with Tobin's Q (β = −0.229, p < 0.001), consistent with an entrenchment-based governance discount whereby concentrated control heightens the risk of private-benefit extraction. We interpret these two results jointly as evidence that “earnings quality” is not a unidimensional construct: signal-based and ownership-structure-based proxies can carry opposite valuation implications within the same market and sample period. We discuss the identification challenges in distinguishing signaling from functional fixation, and draw out implications for accounting standard-setters, securities regulators, and investors evaluating firms in concentrated-ownership markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2000-2016年韩国KOSPI上市公司6,078个公司-年度观测值，考察两类盈余质量相关构念——可操纵应计绝对值与控股股东持股集中度——在股票市场中的定价。研究发现两者对托宾Q的影响方向相反且均显著：|DA|与托宾Q显著正相关（β=0.627），控股股东持股与托宾Q显著负相关（β=−0.229），表明"盈余质量"并非单一维度构念。
AI.research_question: 可操纵应计绝对值（|DA|）与控股股东持股集中度这两类盈余质量相关构念如何被股票市场定价？它们的估值影响方向是否一致？
AI.motivation: 传统研究通常将盈余质量视为一个统一的构念，但盈余质量的信号维度（可操纵应计）与治理维度（股权集中度）可能蕴含相反的市场定价含义。在股权集中度较高的市场中（如韩国），同时考察这两类指标对估值的独立影响，有助于深化对盈余质量多维性的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（管理层通过应计操纵传递私有信息）；功能固定假说（投资者对盈余数字的机械反应）；壕沟效应理论（控制权集中导致私人利益攫取风险上升）；盈余质量多维性理论。
AI.method: 以2000-2016年KOSPI上市公司为样本（6,078个公司-年度观测值），采用修正Jones模型估计可操纵应计绝对值（|DA|），将滞后|DA|、滞后控股股东持股比例（Control）及标准公司层面控制变量对托宾Q进行OLS回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）|DA|与托宾Q显著正相关（β=0.627, p<0.001），与传统的应计估值折价观点相悖，支持信号传递渠道（管理层通过应计裁量传递可靠私有信息）或投资者功能固定；（2）控股股东持股比例与托宾Q显著负相关（β=−0.229, p<0.001），支持壕沟效应下的治理折价，即集中的控制权提高了私人利益攫取的风险。两大结果方向相反且均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）实证表明"盈余质量"并非单维度构念，信号型代理变量与股权结构型代理变量在同一市场、同一期间内可携带相反的估值含义；（2）为应计操纵的估值后果提供了与主流文献不同的证据，揭示了信号渠道或功能固定假说在集中所有权市场的适用性；（3）讨论了区分信号传递与功能固定假说的识别挑战，为后续研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对会计准则制定者：提示盈余质量衡量标准的复杂性，需考虑不同维度指标可能带来的不同市场解读；（2）对证券监管者：在集中所有权市场中，治理层面的盈余质量监管（如股权集中度带来的壕沟风险）与报表数字层面的盈余操控应区别对待；（3）对投资者：评估公司时应综合考虑信号维度与所有权结构维度的盈余质量，避免单一指标误导估值判断。

title: Governing Heritage Through Novelty: Programme Proliferation, Maintenance Neglect, and Temporal Politics In Indonesia

detail.title: Governing Heritage Through Novelty: Programme Proliferation, Maintenance Neglect, and Temporal Politics In Indonesia
detail.abstract: Governments often respond to pressure on heritage destinations by adding projects, brands, events, digital tools, and coordination bodies. Heritage, however, depends on slower work such as repair, monitoring, skills, trust, and cultural transmission. This article asks how novelty becomes a governing logic and when it displaces maintenance. It develops the concept of novelty-oriented heritage governance through an integrative review and a comparative documentary analysis of Borobudur, the Subak cultural landscape of Bali, and the Ombilin coalmining heritage of Sawahlunto. The evidence combines peer-reviewed research, Indonesian laws and regulations, official programme records, and UNESCO decisions through 2025. The analysis identifies four linked mechanisms. They are visibility incentives, annualised performance and budgeting, projectification, and additive institutional layering. These mechanisms direct attention towards interventions that are easy to launch and claim, while maintenance remains harder to attribute and defend. The cases also show that new programmes are not inherently harmful. Their effect depends on whether they strengthen durable stewardship, fit an agreed management plan, protect community authority, and include lifecycle finance and exit rules. The article contributes to governance research by treating maintenance as a core public function, linking political time to programme proliferation, and proposing observable indicators and testable propositions. It concludes with a decision gate that requires an overlap review, heritage impact assessment, community agreement, lifecycle funding, and a rule for consolidation or termination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"以创新为导向的遗产治理"概念，通过综合回顾和对婆罗浮屠、巴厘岛苏巴克文化景观、沙哇伦多翁比林煤矿遗产三个印尼案例的比较文献分析，识别出四个相互关联的机制（可见性激励、年度化绩效与预算、项目化、增量制度叠加），这些机制使创新项目不断增殖而维护工作被边缘化。文章提出维护是核心公共职能，并设计了包含重叠审查、遗产影响评估、社区同意、生命周期资金和整合/终止规则的决策门控框架。
AI.research_question: 新颖性（创新）如何成为遗产治理的主导逻辑？以及在什么条件下它会取代维护（maintenance）工作？
AI.motivation: 政府常通过增加项目、品牌、活动、数字工具和协调机构来应对遗产地压力，但遗产本质上依赖修复、监测、技能、信任和文化传承等缓慢的维护工作。现有治理研究对"创新供给"关注过多，而忽视了维护作为一种核心公共职能的治理价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以创新为导向的遗产治理（novelty-oriented heritage governance）概念框架；整合制度主义、政治时间与公共政策中项目化治理的理论视角。
AI.method: 综合回顾（integrative review）加比较文献分析（comparative documentary analysis）；分析材料包括同行评审研究、印尼法律法规、官方项目记录以及截至2025年的UNESCO决议，覆盖印尼三个世界遗产案例。
AI.findings: 识别出四个将治理推向创新的相互关联机制：可见性激励、年度化绩效与预算、项目化（projectification）、增量制度叠加。这些机制使易于启动和宣称的干预更受关注，而维护工作更难归因和辩护。但案例表明新项目并非天然有害，其效果取决于是否强化持久管理、契合既定管理计划、保护社区权威、以及是否包含生命周期资金和退出规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将维护（maintenance）视为治理研究的核心公共职能；将政治时间（political time）与项目增殖相关联；提出可观察指标和可检验命题，为后续实证研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一个"决策门控"（decision gate）工具，要求新项目须通过重叠审查、遗产影响评估、社区同意、生命周期资金安排以及整合或终止规则五道关卡，为遗产管理实践提供可操作的政策工具。

title: Ten Rules for Deploying Large Language Models in Official Statistics
affiliations: Decatab Pte Ltd and University of Canterbury

detail.title: Ten Rules for Deploying Large Language Models in Official Statistics
detail.abstract: Official statistics is increasingly produced with the help of large language models, which are being asked to write the code of its pipelines and to guide the statistics themselves, work whose outputs carry institutional weight and inform policy. The fluency of these models creates a failure mode distinct from ordinary software error: they produce plausible text whether or not it is correct, so a pipeline that relies on them can fail silently while still looking authoritative, which is at odds with the obligations written down in the Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics and the European Statistics Code of Practice. We offer ten rules for deploying these models safely in official statistics at the current state of the technology. The rules follow one architectural principle: the model serves as a monitoring agent that observes,corrects bounded deviations, flags, and reports, while data selection, method choice, processing, causal reasoning, interpretation, and disclosure control remain with human analysts. We place this boundary on an adoption frontier, a decision tool that weighs the impact of a model error against the cost to the office of not adopting, so that each use case can be triaged on its own terms. We ground each rule in the Principles it protects and locate it in the phases of the Generic Statistical Business Process Model.

AI.tldr: 本文针对官方统计领域中使用大型语言模型（LLM）编写代码和指导统计工作的现象，指出其"流畅但可能不正确"的失败模式与官方统计的基本原则相悖。作者提出了十条在LLM当前技术水平下安全部署的规则，核心架构原则是：模型仅作为监控代理（观察、纠正有限偏差、标记、报告），而数据选择、方法选择、处理、因果推理、解释和披露控制等关键环节仍由人类分析师掌控。文章还提出了"采用前沿"（adoption frontier）决策工具，用于权衡模型错误的影响与不采用模型的成本，并将每条规则锚定在官方统计原则和通用统计业务流程模型（GSBPM）的各阶段中。
AI.research_question: 如何在官方统计机构中安全地部署大型语言模型，使其既利用LLM的能力，又不违背《官方统计基本原则》和《欧洲统计业务守则》所规定的统计质量与可信度义务？具体而言，应如何划定人机责任边界、评估采用风险，并将安全规则与现有统计流程框架对接？
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于官方统计的代码编写和统计流程指导，其输出具有制度性权重并影响政策制定。但LLM的"流畅性"使其无论正确与否都能生成看似合理的文本，导致依赖LLM的统计管线可能在"看起来权威"的情况下静默失效，这与官方统计的法定原则（如透明度、可信度、责任性）直接冲突。因此亟需一套系统性的安全部署规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①《官方统计基本原则》（Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics）——提供官方统计的伦理与质量义务框架；②《欧洲统计业务守则》（European Statistics Code of Practice）——提供欧洲层面的统计质量规范；③通用统计业务流程模型（GSBPM）——用于定位规则在统计生产流程中的具体阶段；④采用前沿（adoption frontier）决策框架——一种风险评估工具，用于权衡模型错误的影响与机构不采用的成本。
AI.method: 规范性/框架性研究。文章基于对LLM在官方统计中使用现状的分析，提出十条操作性规则；每个规则均通过"架构原则"（模型作为监控代理）约束LLM的职责边界，并以"采用前沿"作为用例级决策工具进行风险评估，同时将每条规则映射到GSBPM流程阶段和统计原则条款加以锚定。
AI.findings: ①LLM在官方统计中存在与传统软件错误不同的"静默失败"风险模式，威胁统计的可信度与问责性；②提出了十条安全部署规则，核心是将LLM限定为"监控代理"角色——只负责观察、纠正有限偏差、标记和报告，而将数据选择、方法选择、处理、因果推理、解释和披露控制等关键决策保留给人类分析师；③提出"采用前沿"决策工具，使每个用例可以基于模型错误影响与不采用成本之间的权衡进行独立分流；④每条规则均与统计基本原则及GSBPM流程阶段相对应，提供了可操作的实施框架。
