AI.theory_contributions: ①首次将LLM的"流畅性失败"（fluency failure mode）明确定义为官方统计领域区别于传统软件错误的新型风险类型；②提出"采用前沿"（adoption frontier）这一决策框架，为官方统计组织评估LLM用例提供了新的理论工具；③将AI治理原则（人机责任边界-监控代理架构）与官方统计的制度性义务（基本原则、统计守则、GSBPM）系统性地对接，填补了LLM在官方统计领域缺乏规范性指导的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: ①提供十条可直接操作的安全部署规则，供官方统计机构在现有技术条件下实施；②"采用前沿"工具使统计办公室能够按具体用例独立评估采用与否，降低决策成本；③通过将规则映射到GSBPM各阶段，帮助统计机构将AI治理嵌入既有业务流程而非另起炉灶；④明确了人类分析师必须保留的职责清单（数据选择、方法选择、处理、因果推理、解释、披露控制），为组织职责划分和人员培训提供了依据。

title: Does Smart Money Seek AI Advice?
affiliations: North Dakota State University and Kasetsart University

detail.title: Does Smart Money Seek AI Advice?
detail.abstract: We examine how objective financial literacy shapes consumers' willingness to use artificial intelligence (AI)-based financial advice. Drawing on nationally representative U.S. survey data, we test competing substitution and complementarity hypotheses. The substitution hypothesis predicts that less financially literate individuals will be more willing to use AI because they have a greater need for external guidance, whereas the complementarity hypothesis predicts that financially literate individuals will be more receptive because they are better able to understand and evaluate AI-generated advice. The results support the complementarity hypothesis. Higher objective financial literacy is positively associated with willingness to use AI-based financial advice, with estimated average marginal effects of 0.8 to 1.7 percentage points. Given that only 22.5 percent of respondents expressed such willingness, these effects represent relative increases of roughly 3.6 to 7.5 percent over the baseline, an economically meaningful magnitude. The findings suggest that financial literacy may facilitate, rather than reduce, the adoption of emerging AI-based financial services.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国全国代表性调查数据，检验客观金融素养与消费者使用AI财务建议意愿之间的关系。结果支持互补性假说：金融素养越高的人越愿意使用AI财务建议，边际效应为0.8至1.7个百分点，相对于22.5%的基线意愿率，相当于3.6%至7.5%的相对增长。
AI.research_question: 客观金融素养如何影响消费者使用基于AI的财务建议的意愿？
AI.motivation: AI财务建议服务日益普及，但消费者是否愿意采纳此类服务存在不确定性；金融素养既可能因降低使用门槛而增加使用意愿（替代效应），也可能因提高理解和评估AI建议的能力而增加使用意愿（互补效应），需要实证检验这两种竞争性假说。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代性假说与互补性假说：替代性假说认为金融素养较低的个体对外部指导需求更大而更愿意使用AI；互补性假说认为金融素养较高的个体因更能理解和评估AI生成的建议而更愿意使用。
AI.method: 使用美国全国代表性调查数据，通过回归分析估计客观金融素养对AI财务建议使用意愿的平均边际效应。
AI.findings: 结果支持互补性假说。更高的客观金融素养与使用AI财务建议的意愿呈正相关，估计平均边际效应为0.8至1.7个百分点。在仅22.5%受访者表达使用意愿的基线下，这代表约3.6%至7.5%的相对增幅，具有经济意义上的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证检验替代性与互补性两个竞争性理论假说，为理解金融素养与新兴金融科技采纳之间的关系提供了理论证据，表明金融素养可能促进而非阻碍AI财务服务的采用。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对AI财务服务的市场推广和政策制定具有启示意义：提升消费者金融素养有助于促进AI财务服务的采纳，而非构成障碍；金融服务提供商和监管机构应关注金融教育在推动新兴金融科技普及中的作用。

title: ForeComp: An R Package for Comparing Predictive Accuracy Using Fixed-Smoothing Asymptotics
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and

detail.title: ForeComp: An R Package for Comparing Predictive Accuracy Using Fixed-Smoothing Asymptotics
detail.abstract: We introduce ForeComp, an R package for comparing predictive accuracy using Diebold-Mariano type tests of equal predictive ability with standard and fixed-smoothing inference. The package provides a common interface for loss-differential based testing and includes Plot Tradeoff, a visual diagnostic for bandwidth sensitivity and the size-power tradeoff. We illustrate the toolkit with Survey of Professional Forecasters applications and Monte Carlo evidence on finite-sample performance.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ForeComp，一个用于比较预测精度的R包，它使用Diebold-Mariano类检验来评估相等预测能力，并提供标准推断和固定平滑推断。该包提供统一的损失差分检验接口，并包含Plot Tradeoff可视化诊断工具，用于展示带宽敏感性和大小-功效权衡。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个统一的R包工具，用于实现基于Diebold-Mariano类型检验的预测精度比较，并提供标准推断和固定平滑推断两种方法？
AI.motivation: 预测精度比较在经济学和金融学中至关重要，但现有的Diebold-Mariano检验工具缺乏统一的接口和可视化诊断功能，难以帮助研究者理解带宽敏感性和检验的大小-功效权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: Diebold-Mariano类型检验（损失差分检验）、固定平滑推断理论、频谱密度估计的带宽选择理论
AI.method: 开发R软件包ForeComp，提供统一的损失差分检验接口，支持标准与固定平滑推断；开发Plot Tradeoff可视化工具用于诊断带宽敏感性；通过Survey of Professional Forecasters数据集进行应用演示，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟评估有限样本性能。
AI.findings: ForeComp包能够有效实现预测精度的比较检验，Plot Tradeoff工具能直观展示带宽选择对推断结果的影响以及大小-功效之间的权衡；蒙特卡罗模拟验证了该工具箱在有限样本下的良好表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Diebold-Mariano类检验提供了标准化的软件实现框架，整合了标准推断与固定平滑推断两种理论方法，并将带宽敏感性诊断系统化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和实践者提供一个易于使用的R包，简化预测精度比较的流程；Plot Tradeoff可视化工具帮助用户更好地理解检验稳健性；通过SPF数据实例展示实际应用价值。

title: The Effectiveness of Consumer Protection in Electronic Tax Services: A Case Study of Annual Tax Return Filing via CoReTax at the Tax Service, Education, and Consultation Office (KP2KP) of the Directorate General of Taxes in a Study on Sharia Economic Law in North Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia
affiliations: State Islamic Institute of Palopo, Ministry of Finance of Republic of Indonesia (Kementerian Keuangan Republik Indonesia), Ministry of Finance of Republic of Indonesia (Kementerian Keuangan Republik Indonesia), Ministry of Finance of Republic of Indonesia (Kementerian Keuangan Republik Indonesia), Tax Service, Education, and Consultation Office (KP2KP) of the Directorate General of Taxes and Institut Agama Islam Negeri Palopo

detail.title: The Effectiveness of Consumer Protection in Electronic Tax Services: A Case Study of Annual Tax Return Filing via CoReTax at the Tax Service, Education, and Consultation Office (KP2KP) of the Directorate General of Taxes in a Study on Sharia Economic Law in North Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human or animal subjects, therefore ethical approval was not required.

contentType.other: Report on Community Service Activities During a Government Office Performance Internship

detail.abstract: The author employed a descriptive-qualitative research method and gained firsthand insights through observation and an internship experience at KP2KP Masamba, North Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia from March 25 to May 26, 2026. Field observations clearly showed that CoReTax has made tax administration far more practical for those who are already digitally literate. However, significant challenges also became evident, including low levels of tax literacy among the public, widespread difficulties in adapting to the new digital system, and limited access to tax services-especially in remote areas. When assessed through the lens of Islamic Economic Law, the CoReTax service is evaluated against core principles such as public benefit (maslahah mursalah), transparency, and fairness in public services. Existing consumer protection initiatives include SPT filing assistance, the Mobile Tax Corner program, and support for activating Authorization Codes or Electronic Certificates. Nevertheless, to ensure that taxpayers' rights are fully protected and benefits are distributed evenly, further efforts are required: strengthening digital tax literacy, expanding the reach of the Mobile Tax Corner program, and fostering inter-agency collaboration. The ultimate goal is to guarantee that taxpayers' rights are safeguarded and that justice is upheld for all regions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过描述性定性研究方法，在印尼南苏拉威西省Masamba的KP2KP税务机构进行实地观察与实习，评估了CoReTax数字税务系统在实践中的应用效果与挑战，并从伊斯兰经济法的视角（maslahah mursalah公共利益、透明度、公平性）进行了分析，提出了加强数字税务素养、扩展Mobile Tax Corner项目及促进机构间合作等改进建议。
AI.research_question: CoReTax数字税务服务在实际应用中面临哪些挑战？如何从伊斯兰经济法视角评估其合规性与公平性？现有消费者保护举措是否充分保障纳税人权益？
AI.motivation: 随着数字化税务系统（CoReTax）的推行，虽然为具备数字素养的纳税人提供了便利，但公众税务素养低下、系统适应困难及偏远地区服务受限等问题突出，亟需评估该系统在伊斯兰经济法框架下的公平性与纳税人权益保障情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰经济法原则（公共利益maslahah mursalah、透明度、公共服务公平性）
AI.method: 描述性定性研究方法，通过实地观察和在KP2KP Masamba的实习经历收集第一手资料（2026年3月25日至5月26日）
AI.findings: （1）CoReTax对具备数字素养的纳税人显著提升了税务行政效率；（2）存在公众税务素养低、数字系统适应困难、偏远地区服务可及性差等重大挑战；（3）伊斯兰经济法视角下，CoReTax需进一步对齐公共利益、透明度和公平原则；（4）现有消费者保护措施包括SPT申报协助、Mobile Tax Corner项目和授权码/电子证书激活支持，但仍不足以全面保障纳税人权益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将伊斯兰经济法原则（maslahah mursalah、透明度、公平性）应用于数字税务系统的评估框架，为伊斯兰视角下的数字化公共服务合规性分析提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三项具体改进建议：加强数字税务素养教育、扩展Mobile Tax Corner项目的覆盖范围、促进跨机构协作，以确保纳税人权利得到全面保护并实现各地区的公平正义。

title: The Structural Rentier Asset

detail.title: The Structural Rentier Asset
detail.abstract: This paper formalises the conditions under which a single asset class structurally absorbs capital from a market economy in violation of the standard equilibrating dynamics assumed by general equilibrium and ecient markets frameworks. We dene a structural rentier asset as one whose supply elasticity with respect to sustained capital inow tends to zero, and show that when such an asset is also (i) eligible as loan collateral within a nancial system that supplies credit procyclically, and (ii) taxed at preferential rates relative to productive returns, the risk-adjusted return on the asset is monotonically increasing in cumulative capital inow with no interior steady state. The framework yields six principal results. The risk-adjusted return on the rentier asset diverges monotonically from that on productive assets (Proposition 1). The dynamic admits no interior steady state and terminates in either policy intervention or Minsky-type correction (Proposition 2). Productive capital is starved of replacement investment and contracts endogenously (Proposition 3). Standard national accounts methodology causes measured GDP to diverge from productive output, with the imputation of rental income carrying headline growth while the productive base contracts (Proposition 4). The dynamic survives full Markowitz portfolio optimisation and in fact accelerates as the terminal boundary approaches (Proposition 5). The post-2008 wedge between UK measured labour productivity and real wages, widely treated as an unsolved macroeconomic puzzle, is shown to be consistent in direction and channel with the framework, with the rental-imputation component identied as one structural contributor to the divergence (Proposition 6). The result is that the standard indicators of macroeconomic performance and nancial stability function as inverted indicators during the rentier accretion phase, supporting indicatorweighted non-reform across electoral cycles until the terminal boundary is reached. A companion empirical paper applies the framework to the post-1995 UK housing market.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化定义了一种"结构性食利资产"（其供给弹性随持续资本流入趋于零），并证明当这类资产同时满足（i）可作为贷款抵押品且金融体系顺周期提供信贷，以及（ii）相对于生产性回报享受优惠税率时，其风险调整回报随累计资本流入单调上升且不存在内部稳态。该框架推导出六项核心命题，涵盖食利资产与生产性资产回报发散、无内部稳态动态（终将引发政策干预或明斯基式修正）、生产性资本内生萎缩、GDP计量失真、马科维茨组合优化下动态加速，以及对英国2008年后劳动生产率和实际工资背离之谜的结构性解释。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，单一资产类别会结构性吸收市场经济中的资本，从而违背一般均衡和有效市场框架所假设的标准均衡动力学？
AI.motivation: 标准一般均衡和有效市场框架假定资本流动具有均衡恢复机制，但现实中存在某些资产类别能够持续吸收资本却无法通过价格机制自我修正。英国2008年后劳动生产率和实际工资之间持续且广泛的背离，被视为未解之谜，需要一种结构性理论框架来解释这一宏观经济现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性食利资产理论：核心在于供给弹性随持续资本流入趋于零；信贷抵押品资格与顺周期信贷供给的金融制度条件；税收偏好条件；基于风险调整回报的资本配置动力学。
AI.method: 理论形式化建模：定义结构性食利资产概念，建立资本配置动态模型，通过六项命题（Propositions 1-6）推导框架的数学结果，并与英国2008年后宏观数据（劳动生产率和实际工资背离）进行方向性和渠道一致性检验。
AI.findings: （1）食利资产风险调整回报与生产性资产单调发散；（2）动态不存在内部稳态，终点是政策干预或明斯基式修正；（3）生产性资本被剥夺重置投资并内生收缩；（4）标准国民账户核算使实测GDP偏离生产性产出，租金归核算推高表面增长而生产基础收缩；（5）该动态在完全马科维茨组合优化下仍然存活且在接近终局边界时加速；（6）2008年后英国生产率与实际工资背离与该框架在方向和渠道上一致，租金归核算成分是背离的结构性贡献者之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次形式化定义"结构性食利资产"概念，并将其纳入资本配置的宏观动力学框架；证明了标准均衡动力学在这种情况下失效，说明存在无内部稳态的资本吸收路径；识别出宏观绩效与金融稳定指标在食利资产积聚阶段会变成反向指标（inverted indicators），对现有宏观经济理论构成挑战；为英国生产率-工资之谜提供了结构性理论解释而非经验拼凑。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了在食利资产积聚阶段，标准宏观经济和金融稳定指标（GDP增长、生产率、金融稳定指标）可能具有误导性，实际上反映的是资本错配而非健康增长；为政策制定者理解为何"指标加权的非改革"（indicator-weighted non-reform）能在选举周期中维持提供了理论基础；为检测和干预食利资产积聚过程提供了明确的制度条件（供给弹性、抵押品资格、税收待遇）作为监测信号；配套实证论文将该框架应用于1995年后的英国住房市场，提供可操作的验证途径。

title: Key Dimensions of Human Capital as an Important Factor in Enhancing Economic Development: Case of The Republic of Moldova
affiliations: and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Key Dimensions of Human Capital as an Important Factor in Enhancing Economic Development: Case of The Republic of Moldova
detail.abstract: Over time, human capital has always been a topic of strategic importance for the development of countries around the world. People are the basic resources for economic growth. Various authors have attempted to identify the key factors that determine the formation of effective human capital. The human capital ecosystem can be formed by knowledge, skills, health, but also by attitude, involvement, and creativity. The level of development of countries depends on the capacity and training of human capital. The authors aim to identify the elements that contribute to the formation of efficient human capital, how it has evolved over time, and what are currently the key factors in a world increasingly dictated by artificial intelligence, to the disadvantage of human intelligence. In present research we applied primarily logical and historical methods, as well as dialectical ascents from the abstract to the concrete, including general scientific methods of analysis and synthesis. Based on main results, can be concluded that Republic of Moldova, being a developing country with a fragile economy, needs a human factor prepared for all the challenges it faces in the context of EU integration, but also a war at the border. The demographic crisis, the migration process, studies that do not correspond to the labor market, and the lack of talent represent the shortcomings of human capital in the Republic of Moldova, and this creates a series of problems for the national economy. It is imperative to identify the main determining factors in the growth of human capital potential, both using the example of other countries and the situation in the Republic of Moldova.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人力资本的形成要素及其演变，特别关注人工智能时代下人力资本的关键因素，并以摩尔多瓦共和国为案例分析其人力资本面临的挑战与瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 哪些要素有助于形成高效的人力资本？人力资本如何随时间的推移演变？在人工智能日益主导的世界中，当前的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 人力资本一直是各国发展的战略重点，但摩尔多瓦作为经济脆弱的发展中国家，面临人口危机、移民、教育与劳动力市场不匹配、人才缺乏等问题，亟需识别人力资本增长的关键决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论；人力资本生态系统理论（涵盖知识、技能、健康，以及态度、参与度和创造力）。
AI.method: 主要采用逻辑与历史方法，辩证地从抽象上升到具体，并运用一般科学方法中的分析与综合。
AI.findings: 摩尔多瓦人力资本存在人口危机、移民流失、教育与劳动力市场脱节、人才短缺等缺陷，这些问题对国民经济造成一系列负面影响；在欧盟一体化及边境战争的背景下，摩尔多瓦需要为各种挑战做好准备的人力资源。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了人力资本生态系统概念，指出其不仅包含知识、技能和健康等传统要素，还包含态度、参与度和创造力；将人工智能时代背景下人力资本要素的演变纳入理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为摩尔多瓦及类似发展中国家提供人力资本发展战略参考，指出应借鉴其他国家经验并结合本国国情，识别人力资本潜力增长的关键决定因素。

title: Interdependence Between Political Environment and Competitiveness of Companies in a Complex Business System

detail.title: Interdependence Between Political Environment and Competitiveness of Companies in a Complex Business System
detail.abstract: Amidst a landscape of constant change-marked by the incredible speed of pandemics and military conflicts on one hand and the advancements of the metaverse with its artificial intelligence elements on the other-the global business environment must redefine itself at an even faster pace. Against this background, companies are continuously pressured to maintain their level of competitiveness in foreign or local markets and are directly influenced by the business environment. The interdependence between company competitiveness and the political environment is becoming increasingly powerful because a country's level of prosperity depends on its political system. In this article, the author aims to analyse how the elements of the political environment directly affect the business environment and companies' competitiveness, ultimately determining a country's level of development. The author attempts to analyse a company's level of competitiveness through the prism of the type of political system used in certain countries, such as the USA, Germany, and Venezuela.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了政治环境要素如何直接影响商业环境与企业竞争力，并通过美国、德国和委内瑞拉三个国家的政治体制类型作为棱镜，探讨政治环境最终如何决定一个国家的发展水平。
AI.research_question: 政治环境的要素如何直接影响商业环境和企业的竞争力，并最终决定一个国家的发展水平？
AI.motivation: 在全球商业环境剧烈变化（疫情、军事冲突、元宇宙及AI发展）的背景下，企业面临维持竞争力的持续压力，而国家繁荣程度取决于政治体制，政治环境与企业竞争力之间的相互依存关系日益增强。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治环境与商业环境相互依存理论；政治体制类型（国家）对企业竞争力的影响框架
AI.method: 比较分析法：以美国、德国和委内瑞拉三个不同政治体制的国家为例，分析其政治环境对企业竞争力和国家发展水平的影响。
AI.findings: 文章分析论证了不同类型的政治体制会以不同方式影响企业的竞争力水平，进而影响国家的发展水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治体制类型作为分析企业竞争力的理论棱镜，丰富了政治环境与商业环境关系的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业在不同政治体制国家中的竞争策略制定提供参考，也为政策制定者理解政治环境对经济发展的重要性提供启示。

title: Preying on Leveraged ETFs
affiliations: Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Preying on Leveraged ETFs
detail.abstract: We argue that the extreme volatility of the Korean market in 2026 was driven by arbitrageurs preying on the closing rebalance of leveraged exchange-traded funds (LETFs). An LETF must trade in the direction of the day's move at a close that also measures it, so its demand rises in price, and arbitrageurs buying ahead of it enlarge the order by trading at the print, then unload into what they manufactured. As predicted, pre-open U.S. news is reversed one day later in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix once their products list, and in no control group. At measured parameters the loop added forty-seven percentage points of annualized volatility and transferred KRW 4 trillion from retail holders in eight weeks. Dispersing the rebalance through the session, Korea's chosen remedy, moves the order but not the reference that sizes it and can raise the toll. Changing the reference works instead: an average of two prints halves what displacing either can manufacture.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了2026年韩国市场的极端波动是由套利者利用杠杆ETF（LETFs）收盘再平衡机制所驱动的。LETF必须在收盘时按当日涨跌方向交易，导致其需求随价格上升，套利者提前买入放大订单，然后在高位抛售。研究预测并验证了三星电子和SK海力士股票在纳入相关产品后，盘前美国消息会在次日被反转，而对照组无此现象。在测得的参数下，这一循环贡献了47个百分点的年化波动率，并在八周内从散户转移了4万亿韩元。韩国选择的将再平衡分散到整个交易时段的方案只会移动订单而非决定规模的参考价格，可能反而增加成本。改变参考价格才有效：对两次打印取平均可将可制造的影响减半。
AI.research_question: 韩国市场2026年的极端波动是否以及如何由套利者利用杠杆ETF收盘再平衡机制所驱动？
AI.motivation: 解释韩国市场2026年极端波动的原因，揭示杠杆ETF收盘再平衡机制被套利者利用的放大效应，为市场监管提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 杠杆ETF收盘再平衡机制、套利者策略性交易、价格影响与波动率放大理论。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证检验：利用三星电子和SK海力士股票纳入相关产品的自然实验，对比对照组，验证盘前消息次日反转的预测；并基于测量参数量化波动率贡献与财富转移规模。
AI.findings: 1) 盘前美国消息在三星电子和SK海力士上次日被反转，对照组无此现象；2) 该循环贡献了47个百分点的年化波动率；3) 八周内从散户转移了4万亿韩元；4) 韩国将再平衡分散到整个交易时段的方案效果有限甚至可能增加成本；5) 改变参考价格（对两次打印取平均）可将可制造的影响减半。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了杠杆ETF收盘再平衡机制作为波动率放大器的新机制，阐明了套利者"提前买入-打印交易-高位抛售"的完整循环，并比较了不同监管方案的相对有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国及全球市场监管者提供了关于杠杆ETF收盘再平衡机制的实证证据，指出分散再平衡时段的方案可能无效甚至有害，而改变参考价格（取平均打印价）才是更有效的监管手段，直接关系到散户投资者保护与市场稳定。

title: If You're NOT So Smart, Why Are You Rich? Robust Market Selection with General Recursive Preferences
affiliations: University of Warwick and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill

detail.title: If You're NOT So Smart, Why Are You Rich? Robust Market Selection with General Recursive Preferences
detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for studying equilibrium consumption dynamics in complete-market stochastic exchange economies with a general class of recursive preferences, allowing for rich heterogeneity in both preferences and beliefs. We characterize long-run allocations under complete markets and reassess the \textit{market selection hypothesis} that markets favor consumers with more accurate beliefs. We show that the failure of market selection is robust across a large class of recursive preferences: multiple preference types—including those with incorrect beliefs—survive regardless of the preferences and beliefs of other participants, so no single belief is selected in the long run. Our findings reveal a fundamental tension between two central economic principles: that markets allocate resources efficiently and that prices eventually reflect correct beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一框架，在完全市场的随机交换经济中研究均衡消费动态，涵盖一般类别的递归偏好，并允许偏好与信念存在丰富异质性。研究发现市场选择假说的失效在广泛的递归偏好类别中是稳健的：多种偏好类型（包括信念不正确的消费者）都能长期存活，没有任何单一信念被市场选中，揭示了市场有效配置资源与价格最终反映正确信念这两个核心经济原则之间的根本张力。
AI.research_question: 在完全市场与一般递归偏好设定下，具有异质性偏好和信念的消费者均衡消费动态如何演化？市场选择假说是否成立？
AI.motivation: 传统市场选择假说认为市场会淘汰信念不准确的消费者，但该结论依赖于特定的偏好设定。本文旨在检验在更一般化的递归偏好类别下，这一假说是否依然成立，并探讨市场效率与价格理性之间的张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场选择假说；递归偏好（recursive preferences）；完全市场竞争均衡；随机交换经济（stochastic exchange economies）
AI.method: 构建完全市场下具有异质性偏好与信念的一般递归偏好均衡模型，刻画长期消费分配特征，并通过理论分析重新评估市场选择假说的成立条件。
AI.findings: 市场选择假说的失效在广泛递归偏好类别中具有稳健性：多种偏好类型（包括信念错误的消费者）均能在长期存活，没有任何单一信念被市场选择，无论其他参与者的偏好与信念如何。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场选择假说的检验扩展到一般递归偏好框架，揭示了市场选择失效的稳健性，并阐明了市场效率原则与价格正确反映信念原则之间的根本张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融市场中长期价格形成机制提供理论依据，提示在多元信念共存的市场中，价格可能无法完全反映最优信息，对资产定价与市场效率的实践认知具有启示意义。

title: Institutional Trades through Affiliated Brokers
affiliations: University of Bristol

detail.title: Institutional Trades through Affiliated Brokers
detail.abstract: Using U.S. institutional equity trading data, I show that routing through affiliated brokers declines sharply following the SEC's 2004 compliance reforms, which strengthened monitoring, documentation, and board oversight. The decline is concentrated among investment managers with high pre-reform reliance on affiliated brokers and in large, high-commission orders, and it is matched by greater routing to unaffiliated brokers, primarily through pre-existing broker relationships. I then study trading outcomes in a difference-in-differences design that classifies fund-stock pairs by pre-reform exposure. Effects are heterogeneous: for money-manager funds, moving away from affiliated brokers is followed by worse execution and lower one-day realized returns; for pension-plan funds, the decline in affiliated routing is associated with lower commissions and improved net outcomes. Overall, the findings highlight a trade-off: tighter compliance and governance can reduce reliance on conflict-sensitive routing, but may also reduce the value of broker relationships and raise trading frictions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国机构股票交易数据，研究SEC 2004年合规改革（加强对监控、文件和董事会监督的要求）如何导致通过关联经纪商的路由大幅下降。这种下降集中在改革前高度依赖关联经纪商的投资经理以及大额、高佣金订单中，同时伴随更多转向非关联经纪商（主要通过已有经纪关系）。通过双重差分设计，研究发现效果具有异质性：货币经理基金离开关联经纪商后执行质量变差、一日实现收益下降；养老金计划基金则佣金降低、净收益改善。总体揭示了加强合规治理与交易摩擦之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: SEC 2004年合规改革如何影响机构投资者通过关联经纪商进行交易路由的行为？这种变化对不同类型基金（货币经理基金vs养老金计划基金）的交易结果有何异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 机构投资者通过关联经纪商路由交易可能存在利益冲突（如以佣金换取销售服务），而SEC 2004年合规改革提供了研究监管如何改变这一行为的自然实验。现有文献对关联经纪路由的经济后果缺乏清晰证据，尤其是在合规监管强化条件下的权衡效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托代理理论（投资经理与受益人的利益冲突）和监管合规理论，分析强化监控与治理如何影响冲突敏感型交易路由行为。
AI.method: 使用美国机构股权交易数据（含经纪商路由信息），采用描述性分析（关联路由的时序变化）、异质性分析（按投资经理依赖程度、订单规模、佣金水平分组）以及双重差分（DID）设计，按基金-股票对的改革前暴露程度分类，比较货币经理基金与养老金计划基金的交易结果差异。
AI.findings: （1）SEC 2004年合规改革后，通过关联经纪商的路由显著下降；（2）下降集中于改革前高度依赖关联经纪商的管理者和高佣金大额订单；（3）资金转向非关联经纪商（主要通过既有经纪关系）；（4）效果异质：货币经理基金离开关联经纪商后执行质量恶化、一日实现收益下降；养老金计划基金佣金降低、净收益改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了合规监管对冲突敏感型经纪关系的治理效应，并发现其可能带来交易摩擦和经纪关系价值损耗的代价，为理解"合规—交易效率"权衡提供了理论证据。区分了不同受益结构（货币经理基金vs养老金基金）下监管效果的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和政策制定者设计合规改革提供了实证依据：强化治理可减少潜在利益冲突，但也需考虑对执行质量和交易成本的负面影响；为机构投资者优化经纪商关系管理提供了参考。

title: From 1993 To 2023: 30 Years Of Human Rights Process In The Association Of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)
affiliations: Mahidol University International College and Mahidol University International College, Mahidol University, Thailand

detail.title: From 1993 To 2023: 30 Years Of Human Rights Process In The Association Of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)

keywords: ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights

detail.abstract: ASEAN first incorporated the human rights into official regional discourse in 1993. It was only in 2007 with the ASEAN Charter did ASEAN determine that a regional human rights body would be established in the last region of the world where a regional mechanism was not present. With the establishment of the ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights in 2009, ASEAN official became a 'normal' regional organization by incorporating a human rights mechanism into its regional integration project. This article will trace the contours of human rights institutionalism in ASEAN and pinpoint the major conjuncture points and reasons for progress. This will provide insights into the nature of ASEAN regionalism, identify primary trigger factors for integrative projects and point and analytical arrow towards the possible evolution of AICHR in being a human rights mechanism which engages in protection activities or not.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪了东盟人权制度化的演进脉络，指出东盟从1993年首次将人权纳入区域话语，到2007年《东盟宪章》决定建立区域人权机构，再到2009年成立东盟政府间人权委员会（AICHR），标志着东盟正式将人权机制纳入区域一体化进程。文章分析了这一过程中的关键节点与进展原因，并探讨AICHR未来可能的发展方向——是否会从促进活动转向保护活动。
AI.research_question: 东盟人权制度化的演进过程是怎样的？哪些关键节点和因素推动了这一进程？AICHR未来可能如何演变？
AI.motivation: 东盟作为世界上最后一个建立区域人权机制的地区，其人权制度化的独特性值得深入研究。理解这一过程有助于洞察东盟区域主义的本质，识别推动一体化项目的主要触发因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 东盟区域主义理论；人权制度化/人权机制理论
AI.method: 定性分析/历史追踪法，通过梳理东盟人权制度化的关键时间节点（1993年、2007年、2009年）及背后的政治动因进行过程追踪。
AI.findings: 东盟从1993年首次将人权纳入官方区域话语，到2007年《东盟宪章》明确建立区域人权机构，再到2009年成立AICHR，标志着东盟通过纳入人权机制而成为一个"正常"的区域组织。文章指出了一体化项目的主要触发因素，并分析了AICHR未来可能从促进（promotion）活动向保护（protection）活动演变的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了东盟区域主义的本质特征，为理解区域人权机制的建设路径提供了东盟案例的洞见，指出了区域一体化项目中整合性活动的主要触发因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为观察和评估AICHR的未来演变方向提供了分析框架，有助于预判东盟人权机制是否以及何时会从促进职能转向保护职能。

title: The Impact of ESG Performance on Firm Performance: Evidence from JSE Mining Companies (2019-2023)
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Impact of ESG Performance on Firm Performance: Evidence from JSE Mining Companies (2019-2023)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial and sustainability data. No human participants were involved, and therefore no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This study examines the relationship between Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance and firm outcomes in the South African mining sector. Using panel data from 5 JSE-listed mining firms from 2019 to 2023, we employ firm and year fixed effects regressions with robust standard errors clustered at the firm level. We find that ESG scores are negatively and marginally significantly associated with both Tobin's Q and Return on Assets (ROA). A 100-point increase in ESG score is associated with a 0.04 decrease in both market valuation and accounting profitability. 

     The negative relationship is consistent with the resource-intensive nature of mining, where ESG compliance requires substantial upfront capital expenditure on environmental rehabilitation, community development, and governance systems. In the absence of immediate market premiums or regulatory incentives, these costs reduce short-term profitability and valuation. Our descriptive analysis further shows that Environment and Social pillars are negatively correlated with performance, while Governance has a weak positive association, suggesting heterogeneous effects across ESG dimensions. 

     These findings contribute to the emerging market ESG literature by providing firmlevel evidence from Africa's largest mining exchange. The results imply that policymakers and investors should account for sector-specific trade-offs when promoting ESG adoption. While long-term benefits may exist, firms face a transition cost burden in the short run. Future research should expand the sample and examine whether market rewards for ESG materialize over longer horizons.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2019-2023年南非约翰内斯堡证券交易所（JSE）5家矿业上市公司的面板数据，通过公司和年份固定效应回归发现，ESG评分与托宾Q和资产回报率（ROA）呈显著负相关，100分ESG提升对应0.04的市场估值和会计盈利能力下降，反映出矿业ESG合规的高昂前期资本支出对短期绩效的拖累。
AI.research_question: 南非矿业部门中ESG表现与企业绩效（市场估值和会计盈利能力）之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有ESG研究主要集中在发达市场，对新兴市场特别是非洲最大矿业交易所——南非JSE上市企业的ESG与企业绩效关系缺乏企业层面证据，且矿业行业的资源密集型特征使ESG成本效应存在特殊性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于成本-收益权衡理论，认为矿业ESG合规需要大量前期资本支出（环境修复、社区发展、治理体系建设），在缺乏即时市场溢价或监管激励的情况下，这些成本会降低短期盈利能力和市场估值。
AI.method: 采用2019-2023年5家JSE上市矿业公司的面板数据，使用公司和年份固定效应回归，标准误在公司层面聚类，并进行描述性统计分析和ESG各维度（E、S、G）的异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）ESG评分与托宾Q和ROA均呈显著负相关（边际显著），ESG评分每增加100点，市场估值和会计盈利能力各下降0.04；（2）E（环境）和S（社会）维度与绩效负相关，而G（治理）维度与绩效呈弱正相关，存在ESG维度间的异质性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场ESG文献提供了来自非洲最大矿业交易所的企业层面证据，揭示了矿业行业ESG投资的短期成本转嫁效应，并识别了ESG各维度对企业绩效的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者在推动ESG采用时需考虑行业特定权衡提供实证依据，表明企业在短期内面临转型成本负担，长期ESG收益的实现需要更长的观察窗口和更完善的市场激励机制。

title: Dynamic Green Tax Incentives and Credit Risk Pricing in Circular Supply Chain Networks

detail.title: Dynamic Green Tax Incentives and Credit Risk Pricing in Circular Supply Chain Networks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have inappropriately influenced or biased the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants or personal data
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Circular supply chain networks (CSCNs) reconfigure the flow of materials, capital, and risk among interdependent firms, yet the interaction between environmental fiscal policy and the credit risk borne by network participants remains poorly understood. This paper develops a dynamic hybrid framework in which a carbon intensity indexed green tax incentive scheme, declining over time, alters firm level cash flows, default intensities, and the propagation of credit risk across a supply chain network. We embed a time varying incentive control into a reduced form default model and couple it with an Eisenberg Noe clearing mechanism to capture contagion among circular network actors. Solving the associated Hamilton Jacobi Bellman problem, we characterize the optimal incentive path and derive semi closed form relationships linking incentive intensity to credit spreads and the probability of default (PD). Calibrated numerical experiments show that dynamic, intensity linked incentives compress credit spreads for high-circularity firms while attenuating systemic contagion, but that poorly timed incentive withdrawal a "green fiscal cliff" can amplify default clustering even when the fiscal budget is held fixed. Comparative statics identify the conditions under which green tax policy is credit stabilizing versus destabilizing. The findings inform the joint design of environmental fiscal policy and prudential credit assessment in transitioning economies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个动态混合框架，研究基于碳强度的绿色税收激励政策如何影响循环供应链网络中的企业信用风险及其传染效应，发现动态激励能压缩高循环度企业的信用利差并减缓系统性传染，但时机不当的激励退坡（"绿色财政悬崖"）即使在预算固定情况下也会放大违约聚集。
AI.research_question: 环境财政政策与循环供应链网络中参与者所承担的信用风险之间存在怎样的相互作用？动态绿色税收激励如何影响企业违约强度和信用风险的网络传播？
AI.motivation: 循环供应链网络重构了相互依存企业间的物质、资金和风险流动，但环境财政政策与网络参与者信用风险之间的相互作用仍未被充分理解，亟需填补这一理论与实践空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以简化形式违约模型（reduced form default model）为核心，结合Eisenberg-Noe清算机制捕捉循环网络参与者间的信用风险传染，并通过Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程刻画最优激励路径。
AI.method: 开发动态混合框架：将随时间递减的碳强度指数化绿色税收激励控制嵌入简化形式违约模型，与Eisenberg-Noe清算机制耦合；求解HJB问题以刻画最优激励路径，推导激励强度与信用利差及违约概率之间的半封闭解关系；辅以校准数值实验。
AI.findings: （1）动态、强度挂钩的激励可压缩高循环度企业的信用利差并减弱系统性传染；（2）时机不当的激励退坡（"绿色财政悬崖"）即使在财政预算固定的情况下也会放大违约聚集；（3）比较静态分析识别了绿色税收政策在何种条件下具有信用稳定效应或去稳定效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将环境财政政策（碳强度指数化绿色税收激励）与信用风险传染机制在循环供应链网络中进行统一建模；将时变激励控制引入简化形式违约模型，并推导出激励强度与信用利差及违约概率之间的半封闭解关系，为绿色财政政策与信用风险评估的交叉研究提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为转型经济中环境财政政策与审慎信用评估的联合设计提供政策启示，帮助决策者识别绿色税收政策在何种条件下具有信用稳定效应，避免"绿色财政悬崖"带来的系统性风险。

title: The Invisible Financial Empire: Money Laundering and the Digital Underground
affiliations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology

detail.title: The Invisible Financial Empire: Money Laundering and the Digital Underground
detail.abstract: Informal value transfer systems, money laundering, and the criminal exploitation of digital financial infrastructure impose measurable and under-quantified costs on developing economies. This study provides an integrated analysis of Sri Lanka's shadow financial system across four interlocking dimensions: the mechanics and economics of Hawala and Undiyal; the three-stage architecture of professional money laundering and trade-based laundering (TBML); the digital transformation of financial crime through cryptocurrency stablecoins and artificial intelligence; and the macroeconomic transmission chain from illicit flows to household cost of living. Employing a qualitative desk research design structured within the 10Ps Iterative Research Model, and drawing on evidence from the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), Global Financial Integrity (GFI), the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, blockchain intelligence firms Chainalysis and TRM Labs, and the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime, the study documents a twenty-year pattern of trade misinvoicing in which estimated annual illicit outflows reached USD 4.09 billion and a bilateral trade value gap of 207 per cent was recorded in the Sri Lanka-Thailand corridor in 2024. The stablecoin-dominated digital laundering pipeline, accounting for 84 per cent of USD 154 billion in illicit virtual asset volume in 2025, is found to have qualitatively transformed the financial crime landscape in ways the existing regulatory architecture was not designed to address. Sri Lanka's 2021-2022 exchange rate episode provides a natural experiment demonstrating that formal system price competitiveness is a more powerful determinant of informal channel usage than enforcement intensity alone. The study argues that these phenomena persist not because Sri Lanka lacks adequate laws but because the economic incentive to operate outside the formal system consistently outweighs the practical risk of detection and meaningful sanction. With Sri Lanka facing its third FATF mutual evaluation in 2026, the study proposes a policy framework predicated on formal system competitiveness, legislative gap closure, AI-assisted enforcement, and sustained institutional follow-through on documented misinvoicing flows.

AI.tldr: 本研究对斯里兰卡影子金融体系进行了四个维度的综合分析：Hawala和Undiyal非正式价值转移系统、专业洗钱与贸易洗钱的三阶段架构、加密货币稳定币和人工智能驱动的数字金融犯罪转型，以及非法资金流对家庭生活成本的宏观经济传导链。研究发现年度非法资金外流达40.9亿美元，2025年稳定币主导的数字洗钱管道占非法虚拟资产量的84%，并论证了正规体系价格竞争力比执法强度更能决定非正规渠道使用。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡影子金融体系如何运作？非正规价值转移系统、洗钱架构、数字金融犯罪和宏观经济影响之间存在怎样的互动关系？为何斯里兰卡金融犯罪现象持续存在？
AI.motivation: 非正规价值转移系统、洗钱和数字金融基础设施的犯罪利用对发展中经济体造成了可量化但被低估的巨额成本，斯里兰卡面临2026年第三次FATF互评估，亟需系统性的政策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 10Ps迭代研究模型（10Ps Iterative Research Model）
AI.method: 定性案头研究设计（qualitative desk research），整合FATF、全球金融诚信组织（GFI）、斯里兰卡央行、Chainalysis和TRM Labs等区块链情报公司以及联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室的实证证据。
AI.findings: 1) 二十年贸易虚假发票模式中，估计年非法资金外流达40.9亿美元；2) 2024年斯里兰卡-泰国贸易走廊出现207%的双边贸易价值缺口；3) 2025年稳定币主导的数字洗钱管道占1540亿美元非法虚拟资产量的84%，从根本上改变了金融犯罪格局；4) 2021-2022年汇率事件作为自然实验表明，正规体系价格竞争力比执法强度更能决定非正规渠道使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"正规体系竞争力假说"——即正规金融体系的价格竞争力是决定非正规渠道使用的更强因素，而非执法强度本身；将数字金融犯罪（稳定币、AI）整合进传统影子金融分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为斯里兰卡2026年FATF第三次互评估提出政策框架，涵盖四个支柱：正规体系竞争力、立法缺口弥补、AI辅助执法、对已记录虚假发票资金流的持续制度跟进。

title: Water Wars
affiliations: and

detail.title: Water Wars
detail.abstract: How does the geography of water resources shape violent conflict? We assemble a georeferenced panel spanning the entire African continent from 1997 to 2023, combining detailed data on hydrology and conflict. Leveraging the spatial inequality in surface water resources and the structure of the river network, we show that heat shocks trigger conflict in nearby water-rich areas and that they propagate upstream along rivers, but not downstream. These effects are more pronounced when shocks cross ethnic boundaries along the river, in countries with weak national institutions, and in areas with persistent heat and declining water availability. Our findings highlight the geography of water resources as a key mechanism through which climatic shocks propagate into violence.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1997-2023年覆盖整个非洲大陆的地理参考面板数据，结合水文和冲突的详细数据，发现热冲击会在水资源丰富区域附近引发冲突，并沿河流向上游传播（而非下游）。这种效应在冲击跨越种族边界、国家制度薄弱、以及持续高温和水资源减少的地区更为显著。
AI.research_question: 水资源的地理分布如何塑造暴力冲突？具体而言，气候热冲击如何通过河流网络的地理结构影响冲突的发生与传播？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注气候变化与冲突的关系，但较少从水资源的地理空间分布和河流网络结构角度，系统理解气候冲击如何转化为暴力的空间传播机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水资源地理学、气候冲突传播机制、种族边界与制度质量理论
AI.method: 构建1997-2023年非洲全境的地理参考面板数据，整合高精度水文数据与冲突数据，利用地表水资源空间不平等性和河流网络结构进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）热冲击在邻近水资源丰富的地区引发冲突；（2）冲突沿河流上游传播，但不向下游传播；（3）当冲击跨越种族边界、国家制度薄弱、以及持续高温和水资源减少时，效应更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示水资源的地理分布是气候冲击转化为暴力的关键机制，为理解气候-冲突关系提供了新的空间视角和传播路径解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水资源管理和冲突预防政策提供科学依据，提示政策制定者应关注水资源丰富区域和河流上游地区的气候风险，特别是在制度薄弱和跨种族边界地区。

title: Generative Economics: Verification and the Allocation of Judgment

detail.title: Generative Economics: Verification and the Allocation of Judgment
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence lowers the cost of producing candidate solutions, not the cost of deciding which solutions can be used. I study an economy in which effective candidates 𝑀𝑀 must share scarce verification capacity 𝐴𝐴𝐴𝐴. If scrutiny per candidate is 𝑥𝑥 = 𝐴𝐴𝐴𝐴/𝑀𝑀 and verified value per candidate is 𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥), output is 𝑀𝑀𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥). Two prices that coincide in an ordinary linear technology then separate. The social marginal product of another candidate is 𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥)-𝑥𝑥𝑣𝑣′(𝑥𝑥), while a decentralized contributor can receive the average value 𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥). The difference, 𝑥𝑥𝑣𝑣′(𝑥𝑥), is the verification burden imposed on other candidates. In an integrated competitive economy, a fall in the candidate price raises the return to verification; indeed, 𝑑𝑑𝑑𝑑/𝑑𝑑𝑑𝑑 =-𝑀𝑀/𝐴𝐴. Under open entry, contributors ignore the verification burden and generate too many candidates. As generation cost approaches zero, the overentry ratio diverges under regular conditions. With full private appropriation, aggregate generation expenditure absorbs the entire value created by scarce verification even though the cost of any one candidate vanishes. Integration, submission prices, and review rights can recover that value. Platform economics made participation externalities central when reproduction became cheap. Generative economics must make verification and the allocation of judgment central when creation becomes cheap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式人工智能大幅降低候选方案生产成本但对验证（筛选）成本影响甚微的经济学问题。在有效候选数量M与稀缺验证能力V共享的框架下，当每个候选的稀缺验证投入为x=V/M、每候选验证价值为v(x)时，总产出为Mv(x)。普通线性技术下重合的两个价格在此分离：候选的"社会边际产出"为v(x)-xv'(x)（反映对已有候选的验证挤占），而分散贡献者可获得平均价值v(x)，二者之差xv'(x)即对其他候选施加的"验证负担"。在完全竞争的整合经济中，候选价格下降反而提高验证回报率（dv/dV=-M/V）。在自由进入条件下，贡献者忽视验证负担导致候选过度进入；当生成成本趋近零时，过度进入比率在常规条件下发散。若允许完全私人占有，即使单个候选成本趋近零，总生成支出仍将吞噬稀缺验证所创造的全部价值。整合、提交定价与评审权可挽回这部分价值。平台经济学在复制变便宜时强调参与外部性，生成式经济学则必须在创造变便宜时聚焦验证与判断的配置。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI大幅降低候选方案生产成本后，稀缺验证能力的配置如何影响经济产出与社会福利？自由进入条件下是否会出现候选过度生成？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使"创造"变廉价的趋势下，已有经济学框架（如平台经济学关注复制成本的下降）无法解释验证瓶颈问题。作者试图建立"验证经济学"框架，说明当候选生成成本趋近于零时，验证而非生成成为稀缺资源，并揭示由此产生的市场失灵与政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀缺验证能力的竞争均衡模型：有效候选M与验证能力V的匹配函数；候选人边际价值v(x)（x=V/M为每候选验证投入）；社会边际产出与平均价值的价格分离；开放进入下的过度进入分析；完全私人占有下的吞噬效应。
AI.method: 理论建模与比较静态分析：构建Mv(x)的总产出函数，区分社会边际产出v(x)-xv'(x)与平均价值v(x)；推导验证回报率dv/dV=-M/V；分析开放进入下的均衡过度进入比率及其发散条件；探讨整合、提交定价、评审权等制度机制的价值回收作用。
AI.findings: （1）候选的社会边际产出低于其平均价值，差值为验证负担xv'(x)；（2）整合经济中候选价格下降提高验证回报，且dv/dV=-M/V；（3）开放进入下贡献者忽视验证负担导致候选过度生成，生成成本趋零时过度进入比率发散；（4）完全私人占有时，总生成支出会吞噬全部验证创造的价值；（5）整合、提交定价与评审权可挽回这部分价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"生成式经济学"的理论雏形，区别于平台经济学；将验证/评审视为稀缺资源纳入生产函数，揭示候选价格与验证回报率的内生关系；形式化表达了"验证负担"这一外部性概念，并为过度进入提供了严谨的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生成式AI时代的内容审核、科研评审、代码审查、创意筛选等场景提供政策与机制设计启示：应引入提交定价（submission prices）、评审权制度或垂直整合以纠正验证外部性，防止验证能力被低质量候选淹没。

title: Generative Economics: Verification and the Allocation of Judgment

detail.title: Generative Economics: Verification and the Allocation of Judgment
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence lowers the cost of producing candidate solutions, not the cost of deciding which solutions can be used. I study an economy in which effective candidates 𝑀𝑀 must share scarce verification capacity 𝐴𝐴𝐴𝐴. The social marginal product of another candidate is 𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥)-𝑥𝑥𝑣𝑣′(𝑥𝑥), while a decentralized contributor can receive the average value 𝑣𝑣(𝑥𝑥). The difference, 𝑥𝑥𝑣𝑣′(𝑥𝑥), is the verification burden imposed on other candidates. In an integrated competitive economy, a fall in the candidate price raises the return to verification; indeed, 𝑑𝑑𝑑𝑑/𝑑𝑑𝑑𝑑 =-𝑀𝑀/𝐴𝐴. Under open entry, contributors ignore the verification burden and generate too many candidates. As generation cost approaches zero, the overentry ratio diverges under regular conditions. With full private appropriation, aggregate generation expenditure absorbs the entire value created by scarce verification even though the cost of any one candidate vanishes. Integration, submission prices, and review rights can recover that value. Platform economics made participation externalities central when reproduction became cheap. Generative economics must make verification and the allocation of judgment central when creation becomes cheap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式人工智能大幅降低候选方案生产成本但未降低验证成本的背景下，经济体系中稀缺验证能力与海量候选方案的匹配问题，揭示了"验证负担"外部性导致过度进入（overentry）的机制，并探讨了整合、提交价格和评审权等制度安排如何恢复被浪费的价值。
AI.research_question: 当AI大幅降低候选方案的生产成本时，稀缺的验证能力如何配置？开放进入条件下会产生怎样的过度进入问题？何种制度安排可以恢复验证稀缺性创造的价值？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学聚焦于生产成本下降带来的收益，但生成式AI的独特之处在于它只降低了"生产"成本而不降低"筛选/验证"成本。随着生成成本趋近于零，验证能力成为唯一稀缺资源，理解这一新的瓶颈约束及其经济含义至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产函数M·v(x)的分析框架，其中M为候选方案数量，x=A/M为每个候选方案的审查强度，v(x)为单位候选方案验证后的价值。区分了边际社会价值v(x)-xv′(x)与平均价值v(x)，引入"验证负担"xv′(x)作为外部性概念。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含候选方案生成和稀缺验证能力的均衡模型：通过对比社会最优与分散化均衡，分析开放进入下的过度进入比例；推导验证回报与候选价格的关系dA/dv=-M/A；分析生成成本趋近于零时过度进入比率的极限行为。
AI.findings: (1) 候选方案的边际社会价值v(x)-xv′(x)低于分散化贡献者可获得的平均价值v(x)，差额xv′(x)即对他人施加的验证负担；(2) 一体化经济中候选价格下降会提高验证回报，满足dA/dv=-M/A；(3) 开放进入下贡献者忽视验证负担导致过度生成；(4) 生成成本趋近零时，在常规条件下过度进入比率发散；(5) 完全私人占有下，即使单个候选成本趋零，总生成支出仍会吞噬稀缺验证创造的全部价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台经济学中"复制成本降低引发参与外部性"的逻辑推广到"生成成本降低引发验证与判断配置问题"的新经济领域，正式提出了"验证负担"这一核心外部性概念，并解释了该问题随生成成本趋零而趋于严重的非平凡结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI内容生产平台设计提供了制度启示：通过（1）垂直整合、（2）提交定价（如收费机制）和（3）评审权分配，可以内化验证负担外部性，避免稀缺验证价值被过度生成行为稀释浪费。对AI监管和平台治理有直接政策含义。

title: Rival Precision: Inference Externalities in the Generative Economy

detail.title: Rival Precision: Inference Externalities in the Generative Economy
detail.abstract: Platform economics emphasizes participation externalities: more users can raise other users' value. Generative inference can reverse the sign. Model capability 𝑀𝑀 is nonrival, but realized precision is produced with shared, finite compute. I show that when precision falls with load, another task imposes a negative inference externality on every incumbent task. Competitive use exceeds the social optimum even when access itself is costless. The optimal inference charge equals the marginal precision loss borne by existing users. The distortion vanishes when capacity scales one-for-one with demand. Generative intelligence is therefore scalable in models but rival in use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式人工智能的推理外部性问题，指出模型能力虽是非竞争性的（可被所有人同时使用），但实际推理精度受限于共享的有限计算资源。当精度随负载下降时，每个新任务都会对现有任务产生负向推理外部性，导致竞争性使用超过社会最优水平，即使访问本身免费。
AI.research_question: 在生成式人工智能的推理环节中，当推理精度随计算负载下降时，竞争性使用是否会偏离社会最优？最优的推理定价机制应如何设计？
AI.motivation: 平台经济学强调参与外部性——用户增多会提升其他用户的价值（正外部性）。但本文指出，生成式推理可能逆转这一符号：由于推理精度由共享的有限计算资源生产，用户增多会降低其他用户的精度（负外部性），从而挑战了传统平台经济学中关于网络效应的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台经济学、外部性理论和竞争均衡分析框架，核心论证模型能力（非竞争品）与现实精度（竞争品）之间的本质区别。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈分析：构建精度随负载下降的推理模型，比较竞争性均衡与社会最优的偏差，并推导最优定价规则。
AI.findings: （1）当精度随负载下降时，每个新任务对现有任务施加负向推理外部性；（2）即使访问成本为零，竞争性使用仍超过社会最优；（3）最优推理定价等于现有用户承受的边际精度损失；（4）当容量与需求一对一扩展时，扭曲消失。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了生成式AI的本质特征——"模型可扩展但使用具竞争性"，补充了平台经济学中关于网络外部性方向的讨论；（2）将外部性的符号从传统平台的正外部性扩展至推理情境下的负外部性；（3）明确了能力（非竞争品）与精度（竞争品）的概念区分，为AI经济学提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为推理服务定价提供了理论基础——最优价格应反映现有用户的边际精度损失；（2）提示平台在实践中需关注容量规划与需求管理；（3）为AI资源配置的政策制定提供决策参考。

title: Modeling Downside Risks for China's Security Markets: Does Greenness Make Bonds a Safer Haven?
affiliations: Massey University - School of Economics and Finance (Albany)

detail.title: Modeling Downside Risks for China's Security Markets: Does Greenness Make Bonds a Safer Haven?
detail.abstract: Motivated by its current defective governance regime and institutional characteristics of green finance, this study models Valueat-Risk and Expected Shortfall of security markets for China. We extend Patton et al.'s (2019) models by introducing four exogenous risk factors including China's climate policy uncertainty (CCPU). The results indicate that green bond markets can be downside-riskier than nongreen bond markets. We also show that volatility shocks to CCPU drive up the downside risks of green bonds, nongreen bonds, and equity markets, controlling for volatility shocks to US economic policy uncertainty, a security market's own trading volume, and international stock markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于中国绿色金融的制度特征和治理缺陷，通过扩展Patton等人（2019）的模型，引入包括中国气候政策不确定性（CCPU）在内的四个外部风险因子，对中国证券市场的VaR和ES进行建模。研究发现绿色债券市场比非绿色债券市场具有更大的下行风险，且CCPU的波动冲击会推高绿色债券、非绿色债券和股票市场的下行风险。
AI.research_question: 中国证券市场的风险度量问题：绿色债券市场与非绿色债券市场的下行风险差异如何？中国气候政策不确定性（CCPU）如何影响各证券市场的下行风险？
AI.motivation: 中国绿色金融当前存在治理体制缺陷和制度特征，需要更精确的风险度量模型来评估绿色金融市场及整个证券市场的风险状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Patton等人（2019）的风险模型框架，扩展引入中国气候政策不确定性（CCPU）、美国经济政策不确定性、证券市场自身交易量以及国际股票市场四个外生风险因子。
AI.method: 对中国的证券市场（绿色债券、非绿色债券、股票市场）进行Value-at-Risk（VaR）和Expected Shortfall（ES）建模，通过扩展Patton等人（2019）的模型加入外生风险因子进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）绿色债券市场比非绿色债券市场具有更大的下行风险；（2）控制美国经济政策不确定性波动冲击、证券市场自身交易量和国际股票市场后，中国气候政策不确定性（CCPU）的波动冲击会推高绿色债券、非绿色债券和股票市场的下行风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Patton等人（2019）的风险度量模型，首次将中国气候政策不确定性（CCPU）作为外生风险因子纳入VaR和ES建模框架，为气候政策与金融市场风险的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者提供了中国绿色金融市场风险度量的实证依据，有助于理解气候政策不确定性对金融市场风险的影响，对绿色金融的风险管理和政策制定具有指导意义。

title:
Paisa and Peace as Total Income 
A Targeting-Based Framework for Additive, Neutral, and Subtractive Wellbeing

detail.title:
Paisa and Peace as Total Income 
A Targeting-Based Framework for Additive, Neutral, and Subtractive Wellbeing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known financial or non-financial competing interests that could have influenced the preparation of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not report a human-participant study, clinical study, animal experiment or analysis of identifiable personal data. Practitioner-derived illustrations are anonymised conceptual composites and are not presented as empirical evidence. Institutional ethical approval was therefore not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Research on income and wellbeing has established that financial resources can improve life evaluation and emotional wellbeing, particularly where basic security remains unmet, while also showing that financial aspiration, materialistic orientation, time scarcity, and social comparison may carry psychological costs. What remains less clearly integrated is the role of an agent's targeting configuration: where deliberate effort is directed and how intensely that direction is pursued.
This conceptual paper introduces the Paisa–Peace framework and defines Total Income (TI) as the combined financial and psychological return that an individual derives from work and life. Financial sufficiency is represented by Paisa (P, normalised to [0,1]), while psychological equilibrium is represented by Peace (π, normalised to [0,1]). The framework distinguishes Targeting Orientation (θ)—the relative direction of resource allocation between Paisa and Peace—from Targeting Intensity (τ)—the strength or rigidity of that pursuit. Targeting Imbalance is represented as B = |2θ − 1|. A provisional Total Income Function is proposed: TI = αP + βπ − γτB, with an extended specification permitting a separate penalty for realised divergence between P and π: TI = αP + βπ − γτB −δ|P − π|.
The paper hypothesises three theoretical regimes. In the additive regime, financial and psychological returns reinforce one another. In the neutral regime, marginal change in one produces no consistent change in the other. In the subtractive regime, pursuit or improvement of one dimension erodes the other sufficiently to offset part or all of the gain in Total Income. Four possible mechanisms are considered: attentional scarcity, opportunity cost, social comparison, and cumulative stress. The framework further distinguishes volitional targeting from targeting constrained by material insecurity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Paisa–Peace框架"，将总收入（TI）定义为财务回报（Paisa, P）与心理平衡（Peace, π）的综合函数。框架引入了目标导向（θ）和目标强度（τ）两个维度，并提出总收入函数 TI = αP + βπ − γτB − δ|P − π|，用以刻画财务与心理追求之间可能存在的互补（加性）、中性或互损（减性）三种理论状态。
AI.research_question: 个体如何在不同目标配置（目标导向与目标强度）下实现财务与心理回报的最优平衡？目标配置如何影响总收入（财务与心理的综合回报）？
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别探讨了财务资源对幸福感的正向作用以及财务抱负、物质主义、时间稀缺和社会比较的心理成本，但缺乏一个整合框架来解释代理人的目标配置（努力方向及其强度）在收入和幸福感关系中的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: Paisa–Peace框架；总收入（TI）函数；目标导向（θ）与目标强度（τ）；目标失衡度（B=|2θ−1|）；加性、中性与减性三种理论状态；注意力稀缺、机会成本、社会比较、累积压力四种机制。
AI.method: 概念性论文方法，通过理论建构提出规范化框架（P和π归一化至[0,1]），构建数学化总收入函数，并基于理论推演提出三种假设性状态及四种可能机制。
AI.findings: 提出三种理论状态：（1）加性状态：财务与心理回报相互强化；（2）中性状态：一方的边际变化不对另一方产生一致性影响；（3）减性状态：追求或改善某一维度会侵蚀另一维度，抵消部分或全部总收入增益。框架还区分了自主性目标定向与受物质不安全感约束的目标定向。
AI.theory_contributions: 该框架创新性地将"目标配置"（方向与强度）纳入收入与幸福感研究的分析框架，提供了一个可数学化的统一模型来整合以往分散的研究发现，并区分了目标导向与目标强度的独立作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人在财务追求与心理健康之间进行资源配置提供理论指导；为企业和管理者理解员工目标设定对整体福祉的影响提供参考；为政策制定者关注物质安全与心理平衡的协调发展提供框架性建议。

title: Global Macro-Financial Risks and Cross-Country ESG Market Connectedness: Evidence from a Bayesian Global VAR Framework
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai, Shiv Nadar University and Dublin City University

detail.title: Global Macro-Financial Risks and Cross-Country ESG Market Connectedness: Evidence from a Bayesian Global VAR Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is based exclusively on publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants, personal data, animal subjects, or identifiable individual information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The increasing integration of sustainable finance with global capital markets has heightened the exposure of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) equity markets to macrofinancial shocks, yet the mechanisms underlying their crosscountry transmission remain insufficiently understood. This study examines the dynamic interconnectedness of international ESG equity markets under major macro-financial risk factors, including oil market volatility, geopolitical risk, monetary policy, inflation, long-term interest rates, real effective exchange rates, and stock market performance. Using monthly data for twelve developed and emerging economies, we employ a Bayesian Global Vector Autoregressive (BGVAR) framework to capture crosscountry interdependencies and estimate generalized forecast error variance decompositions. We further decompose total connectedness into Aggregate Domestic Spillovers (ADS), Aggregate Cross-border Spillovers (ACS), and Aggregate Global Spillovers (AGS) to distinguish domestic, international, and global transmission channels. The results reveal a pronounced core-periphery structure in international ESG markets, with developed and commodity-exporting economies acting as major net transmitters of shocks, while several emerging markets primarily absorb external disturbances. Domestic macro-financial conditions dominate spillover transmission in emerging economies, whereas cross-border financial integration is more influential in advanced markets. The proposed spillover decomposition provides new insights into the sources of ESG risk transmission and offers important implications for international portfolio allocation, macroprudential surveillance, and policies aimed at strengthening the resilience of sustainable financial markets under evolving global macro-financial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用贝叶斯全局向量自回归（BGVAR）模型，考察十二个发达和新兴经济体的国际ESG股票市场在主要宏观金融风险因素（如油价波动、地缘政治风险、货币政策、通胀、长期利率、实际有效汇率和股市表现）下的动态互联性。通过将总连通性分解为国内溢出、跨境溢出和全球溢出三个渠道，发现国际ESG市场呈现明显的核心-外围结构，发达国家和商品出口国是主要净冲击传递者，而新兴市场主要吸收外部扰动；国内宏观金融条件主导新兴市场的溢出传导，跨境金融一体化则对发达市场影响更大。
AI.research_question: 国际ESG股票市场在宏观金融冲击下的跨国溢出传导机制是什么？如何区分国内、跨境和全球三大传导渠道，并识别各经济体在ESG风险传播网络中的角色？
AI.motivation: 可持续金融与全球资本市场的日益融合使ESG股票市场对宏观金融冲击的暴露度显著增加，但跨国传导机制尚未被充分理解。现有研究缺乏对ESG市场冲击传导渠道的系统性分解，也未能清晰刻画发达与新兴经济体在ESG风险传播网络中的差异化角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯全局向量自回归（BGVAR）框架；广义预测误差方差分解（GFEVD）；连通性分解框架（区分国内、跨境和全球溢出渠道）
AI.method: 使用十二个发达和新兴经济体的月度数据，构建BGVAR模型捕捉跨国相互依赖关系，并通过广义预测误差方差分解估计总连通性，进一步将其分解为国内溢出（ADS）、跨境溢出（ACS）和全球溢出（AGS）三个渠道。
AI.findings: （1）国际ESG市场呈现显著的核心-外围结构，发达国家和商品出口国是主要净冲击传递者，新兴市场主要吸收外部扰动；（2）国内宏观金融条件主导新兴经济体的溢出传导，跨境金融一体化对发达市场影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的溢出分解方法（划分为ADS、ACS和AGS三大渠道），为理解ESG风险跨国传导来源提供了新视角，填补了国际ESG市场宏观金融冲击传导机制研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际投资组合配置、宏观审慎监管以及增强可持续金融市场韧性的政策制定提供了重要启示。

title: Unveiling Insights into S&P 500 Index Revisions Through Bond Price Reactions
affiliations: National Taiwan University - Department of Finance,  and Rutgers University, Newark - School of Business - Department of Finance & Economics

detail.title: Unveiling Insights into S&P 500 Index Revisions Through Bond Price Reactions
detail.abstract: We examine security price responses to announcements of S&P 500 index revisions. Both stocks and bonds exhibit asymmetric reactions to additions and deletions announcements. We further show that firms with lower credit ratings experience significantly stronger price responses to index inclusions. By contrast, following index deletions, price responses do not differ significantly across credit-rating groups, consistent with the investor awareness hypothesis. These findings suggest that the asymmetric responses to index inclusions are primarily attributable to information and investor awareness effects rather than to price pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了S&P 500指数调整公告对股票和债券价格的影响，发现股票和债券对指数纳入和剔除的公告均呈现不对称反应。信用评级较低的公司对指数纳入的反应更强，但对指数剔除的反应在不同信用评级组间无显著差异，这与投资者认知假说一致。研究表明指数纳入的不对称反应主要归因于信息和投资者认知效应，而非价格压力效应。
AI.research_question: S&P 500指数调整公告如何影响股票和债券价格？这种价格反应的不对称性是由什么机制驱动的——是信息与投资者认知效应，还是价格压力效应？
AI.motivation: 以往关于指数调整对价格影响的研究存在争议，主要分歧在于价格反应是由价格压力（price pressure）还是信息/投资者认知（investor awareness）效应驱动。本文通过分析股票和债券对指数纳入和剔除的不对称反应，以及不同信用评级组间的差异，来区分这两种竞争性假说。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者认知假说（investor awareness hypothesis）；价格压力假说（price pressure hypothesis）
AI.method: 事件研究法，比较S&P 500指数纳入与剔除公告前后股票和债券的价格反应，并按信用评级分组进行横截面分析。
AI.findings: （1）股票和债券对指数纳入和剔除公告均呈现不对称反应；（2）信用评级较低的公司对指数纳入的价格反应显著更强；（3）指数剔除后的价格反应在不同信用评级组间无显著差异；（4）这些结果支持信息与投资者认知效应而非价格压力效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过同时分析股票和债券市场，并为投资者认知假说提供了新的经验证据，有助于厘清指数调整价格效应的理论基础，区分了信息/认知效应与价格压力效应两种竞争性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解S&P 500指数调整公告对资产价格的影响提供了参考，特别是对不同信用评级公司股票和债券价格反应的差异化预期，有助于投资决策和风险管理。

title: When the Weakest Link Answers: Verification under Bottleneck Liability

detail.title: When the Weakest Link Answers: Verification under Bottleneck Liability
detail.abstract: An audit fails at the weakest relevant competence, not the strongest, so the natural liability read on a portfolio of capabilities is keyed to the minimum-and that read is not convex. This paper crosses the boundary its companion drew, where gaming-proof verification was characterised by belief-convexity, and maps what holds on the other side. The silence guarantee fails exactly: an honest sender strictly prefers a designed garble to saying nothing, by a quarter of its liability over partitions under the bottleneck read-a third once mass may split across branches-and a third under an interaction read, and it is pooling rather than transparency that breaks the guarantee. The discount has a floor, however-housing off-diagonal mass costs a share linear in the requirement and quadratic in the price, and Cauchy-Schwarz turns the mismatch into an attained bound-so the honest sender can talk its way off the diagonal but cannot talk its strong generalist out of its own truth. Restoring the capability margin converts the discount into a collapse: the axis faces are the kernel's zero set, a certificate of weakness anywhere extinguishes liability everywhere, and a sender free to choose its own disclosure reduces the entire problem to the cost of reaching the axes-emerging not destroyed but as a certified specialist, capable, lopsided, and unanswerable. Three inversions of the convex programme follow. Composition sharpens rather than flattens, so weakest-link and headline liability select opposite industrial organisations from the same profession. Deterrence depends first on who writes the disclosure: a mandated symmetric partition deters more than enforced opacity, which deters vastly more than sender-authored speech, while sharper detection certifies the escape and lowers deterrence at every regime. And a rational conjecture, the designer's ally under convexity, becomes the sender's accomplice here-though not everywhere, since a diagonal-supported cell holds its beliefs against every conjecture, and the proposition proved as the sender's refuge on the convex side serves here as the designer's prison. Because misreading curvature is far more costly in one direction than the other, the robust policy is the oldest instrument in audit regulation: the prescribed form, written by the regulator, identical for everyone. The curvature of the read reassigns every role in the game-and the curvature is, more often than a model cares to admit, chosen by law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了当审计失败取决于最弱能力而非最强能力（即"瓶颈读取"）时，非凸责任结构下的信息披露博弈。研究发现：诚实发送者偏好设计性修饰而非沉默（可获取其责任的三分之一至四分之一折扣），但这种折扣存在下限；恢复能力边际会将折扣转化为崩塌，发送者通过自由选择披露可成为"认证专家"。文章还识别了凸规划的三个倒置：组合效应、威慑效果取决于披露作者、理性猜想角色反转。最稳健的政策是最古老的监管工具——由监管者制定的规定格式。
AI.research_question: 当审计责任基于最弱相关能力（而非最强能力）且读取函数非凸时，信息披露与验证博弈的均衡特征、政策含义与监管设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 前作论文刻画了博弈防作弊验证的凸性特征（信念凸性），本文旨在跨越该边界，探索非凸一侧的完整图景，理解能力组合组合责任结构下信息发送者的策略行为及其监管启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非凸责任函数理论、信念凸性验证理论、能力最低瓶颈（最弱环节）责任模型、博弈论信息设计
AI.method: 数学形式化建模与证明，包括使用Cauchy-Schwarz不等式推导折扣下限、分析对角支撑单元的信念保持性质、构建能力边际恢复模型及多制度比较分析
AI.findings: （1）沉默保证在非凸侧失败：诚实发送者通过设计性修饰可获得责任的三分之一至四分之一折扣（取决于读取方式），且破坏保证的是混合而非透明；（2）折扣有下限：离对角质量的承载成本与需求线性相关、与价格二次相关，Cauchy-Schwarz将不匹配转化为可达界限；（3）恢复能力边际使折扣崩塌：能力弱点的证书会消除所有责任；（4）发送者自由选择披露可简化为达到轴线的成本，成为"认证专家"而非被摧毁；（5）三个凸规划倒置：组合效应锐化而非平缓、威慑取决于披露的作者、理性猜想从设计者盟友变成发送者同谋。
AI.theory_contributions: 将验证理论从凸读取扩展到非凸（瓶颈）读取，系统刻画了非凸性如何反转凸规划中的各项结论，包括沉默保证的失效、组合效应方向反转、威慑与披露作者的关系、理性猜想角色的转变，以及对角支撑细胞信念的稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计监管提供直接政策建议：最稳健的监管工具是"规定格式"（由监管者制定、人人相同的披露表格），这是审计监管中最古老的工具；同时揭示不同披露制度（强制对称分区、强制不透明、发送者自写）的威慑效力排序，为监管设计提供依据。

title: Climate-driven Wildfire Carbon Feedbacks and the Social Cost of Carbon
affiliations: Colorado State University, Fort Collins

detail.title: Climate-driven Wildfire Carbon Feedbacks and the Social Cost of Carbon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Wildfire links climate change, ecosystem carbon storage and human welfare, but its treatment in social cost of carbon dioxide (SC-CO2) calculations is difficult because fire carbon is often mixed into aggregate land-carbon and emissions pathways. Here we audit the Greenhouse Gas Impact Value Estimator (GIVE), the model used in Rennert et al. (2022), and test a reduced-form wildfire-carbon feedback. GIVE uses exogenous emissions, population and income scenarios, so it does not internally generate a warming-to-wildfire-CO2 feedback. The released aggregate CO2 pathway also cannot reveal whether some fire-related carbon is already embedded in landuse, natural-stock or expert emissions judgements. We therefore distinguish gross fire emissions from the residual net-persistent share not already represented in the baseline, and characterize uncertainty in physical response, atmospheric persistence and accounting overlap. In paired 100-draw validation runs, a high residual feedback raises the mean 2% SC-CO2 by 5.65%, with a 5-95% paired-delta interval of 1.25-37.51 USD/tCO2. A gross forest-fire stress case raises the mean by 74.62%. The results show that wildfire-carbon feedbacks can matter for marginal damages, but that unqualified gross additions would risk double counting.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了Rennert等人(2022)使用的温室气体影响价值估算器(GIVE)模型，并检验了简化的野火-碳反馈。研究发现，在基准情景中纳入高残留野火碳反馈会使2%社会碳成本(SC-CO2)均值提高5.65%，而若将所有野火碳排放（总排放场景）纳入计算则会使均值提高74.62%，凸显了区分毛排放与净持久排放以避免重复计算的重要性。
AI.research_question: 野火碳反馈应如何纳入社会碳成本（SC-CO2）的计算中，以及如何在避免重复计算的前提下准确衡量其对碳排放社会成本的影响？
AI.motivation: 野火将气候变化、生态系统碳储存和人类福利联系起来，但在SC-CO2计算中处理困难，因为野火碳常被混入总体土地碳和排放路径中。现有GIVE模型使用外生排放、人口和收入情景，无法内部生成气候变暖到野火CO2的反馈，需要评估野火碳反馈对SC-CO2的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会碳成本（SC-CO2）框架；温室气体影响价值估算器（GIVE）模型；气候-碳反馈机制；野火碳排放核算理论；双重计数（double counting）理论
AI.method: 对GIVE模型进行审计，区分总野火排放与残余净持久排放份额，刻画物理响应、大气持久性和核算重叠的不确定性；采用配对100次抽取的验证运行，比较不同情景（高残留反馈和总森林火灾压力情景）下的SC-CO2变化。
AI.findings: 在配对100次抽取验证中，高残留反馈将2%贴现率下的平均SC-CO2提高5.65%，配对差值5-95%区间为1.25-37.51美元/tCO2；总森林火灾压力情景使平均值提高74.62%。结果表明野火碳反馈对边际损害有重要影响，但不加限定的总排放增加可能导致重复计算风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SC-CO2核算中纳入野火碳反馈提供了方法框架，明确了区分毛排放与净持久排放的必要性，揭示了现有GIVE模型在气候-野火-碳反馈方面的局限，并系统刻画了物理响应、大气持久性和核算重叠三方面的不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和社会碳成本估算提供了改进方向，警示在SC-CO2计算中加入野火碳反馈时需谨慎处理重复计算问题，为更准确的气候损害评估和碳定价政策提供了实证基础。

title: The Overgeneralization Problem

detail.title: The Overgeneralization Problem
detail.abstract: A wide range of influential claims about human nature-in philosophy, in the social sciences, and increasingly in neuroscience-share a single underlying structural defect: a claim adequately supported only at small or narrow sample size is promoted, without independent verification, to a claim about human beings as such. This paper names that defect, walks through two distinct mechanisms that produce it, and traces both to a common cognitive rootthe tendency, well documented in judgment-and-decision-making research, to build a confident, coherent conclusion out of whatever evidence happens to be in front of us, without any built-in prompt to ask what evidence we don't have. It then offers a simple two-axis test for sorting universalizing claims-plotting how much convergent, independent evidence actually backs a claimed mechanism against how broadly the claim built on that mechanism is asserted to hold-and applies that test to a set of well-known cases: Sartre's account of shame and the Other, Marx's theory of history, Kant's categorical imperative, Rawls's and Habermas's procedural theories of justice and legitimate agreement, Singer's utilitarian ethics, Confucian moral cosmology, and the Nobel Prize as a real-world institution. It closes with an honest look at where the framework's own reach runs out, and where contemporary biology and neuroscience genuinely improve on the older pattern without fully escaping it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并命名了一个普遍存在于哲学、社会科学和神经科学中的结构性缺陷：仅由小样本或狭窄证据支持的主张被提升为关于普遍人性的主张，且未经独立验证。论文识别了两种产生该缺陷的机制，将二者追溯到共同的认知根源（基于手头可得证据建构自信结论、不问缺失证据的倾向），提出一个二维测试框架来区分普遍化主张，并应用于多个经典案例，最后反思了框架自身的局限。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和系统化理解"小样本证据被无验证地推广为普遍人性主张"这一结构性缺陷，并提供一种可操作的方法来检验普遍化主张的合理性？
AI.motivation: 大量关于人性本质的权威主张（横跨哲学、社会科学和神经科学）共享一个未被正式命名的结构性缺陷：仅由小或窄样本支持的主张被提升为关于人类整体（"homo sapiens"）的主张，缺乏独立验证。这一缺陷长期存在但未被系统命名和分析，亟需理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于判断与决策研究（judgment-and-decision-making research）中关于认知偏差的文献，特别是人们倾向于从眼前有限的证据中构建自信、连贯结论的认知倾向，以及缺乏主动追问"缺失证据"的内在机制。
AI.method: 概念分析（概念命名和机制识别）+ 提出二维分析框架（证据收敛性×主张普遍性）+ 多案例比较应用（质性案例分析）
AI.findings: 发现了两种产生该缺陷的机制，并将它们追溯到共同的认知根源。提出二维测试框架（plotting convergent independent evidence against breadth of claim），并将其应用于萨特（羞耻与他者）、马克思（历史理论）、康德（定言命令）、罗尔斯与哈贝马斯（程序正义）、辛格（功利主义伦理学）、儒家道德宇宙观以及诺贝尔奖制度等案例。最后探讨了框架自身的边界，以及当代生物学和神经科学如何部分超越但未完全摆脱这一模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为一种跨学科普遍存在的认识论缺陷正式命名并提供系统性理论分析；将判断与决策研究中的认知发现引入对宏大哲学理论的批判性审视；提出可操作的分析框架（两轴测试）供学术界检验普遍化主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和读者提供一种批判性阅读工具，用以评估各种声称适用于全人类的哲学、社会科学和科学主张的证据基础；有助于识别哪些宏大理论缺乏足够证据支撑。

title: From Quantitative Controls to Price-based Monetary Policy An Assessment of Ethiopia's 2026 Policy Shift
affiliations: Addis Ababa University, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia and Addis Ababa University, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

detail.title: From Quantitative Controls to Price-based Monetary Policy An Assessment of Ethiopia's 2026 Policy Shift
detail.abstract: In July 2026, the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) enacted a landmark policy shift by completely lifting the commercial bank credit growth cap, a quantitative control introduced in August 2023, and fully transitioning to an interest-rate-based, price-driven monetary policy framework. This paper provides an exhaustive academic assessment of this regime shift, drawing upon extensive theoretical and empirical literature on monetary policy transmission mechanisms in emerging and developing economies. The study examines the specific components of the July 2026 Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) policy package, including the increase of the Central Bank Rate (CBR) to 16%, the introduction of a targeted Loan-to-Deposit Ratio (LDR) reserve framework, the reduction of the FX commission fee from 2.5% to 1.5%, and the lowering of the mandatory FX surrender requirement on export proceeds from 50% to 30%. The research evaluates the structural transmission of this transition within Ethiopia's dualistic and developing economy, analyzing its macroeconomic effects on headline inflation, fiscal consolidation, money market integration, and real-sector productivity. Furthermore, it details the operational and financial implications for commercial banks, importers, and exporters. The analysis synthesizes evidence from international experiences with monetary policy framework transitions, particularly from Sub-Saharan African economies that have undergone similar shifts from direct quantitative controls to indirect market-based instruments. The paper concludes with strategic policy recommendations to optimize monetary transmission effectiveness and maintain price and financial stability during this critical transition period (Mimouni & Aguir, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文对埃塞俄比亚国家银行（NBE）于2026年7月实施的历史性货币政策框架转型进行了全面学术评估——即取消商业信贷增长上限（2023年8月引入的数量控制工具），完全转向以利率为基础、价格驱动的货币政策框架。研究分析了2026年7月货币政策委员会（MPC）政策组合的各组成部分，评估其在该国二元发展经济中的结构性传导机制、宏观经济影响以及对各经济主体的运营和财务含义，并借鉴撒哈拉以南非洲类似转型国家的国际经验提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚从直接数量控制向间接市场化货币政策工具转型的政策框架改革，其结构性传导机制是什么？这一转型对宏观经济（通胀、财政巩固、货币市场一体化、实体部门生产率）以及各经济主体（商业银行、进口商、出口商）的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 埃塞俄比亚正经历从数量型直接货币政策工具向价格型间接工具的深刻制度转型，但关于新兴和发展中经济体（尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲）货币政策传导机制的文献表明，此类转型的传导效果受制于经济结构特征。需要一项全面学术评估来理解该转型在埃塞俄比亚二元经济中的特殊性，并为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论（利率渠道、信贷渠道、汇率渠道、资产价格渠道），新兴与发展中经济体货币政策转型理论，二元经济结构下的政策传导理论。
AI.method: 文献综合分析与政策评估方法。基于大量关于新兴和发展中经济体货币政策传导机制的理论和实证文献，系统分析2026年7月MPC政策包的各组成部分，并借鉴撒哈拉以南非洲相似转型国家的国际经验进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 研究评估了政策转型的结构性传导效果，具体包括：CBR提高至16%的紧缩效应、定向LDR准备金框架对信贷配置的影响、外汇佣金费率降至1.5%以及强制外汇上缴比例从50%降至30%对汇率和外汇市场的影响。分析表明该转型对总体通胀、财政巩固、货币市场整合和实体部门生产率均产生多方面影响，同时对商业银行、进口商和出口商产生不同的运营和财务后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于新兴和发展中经济体（特别是撒哈拉以南非洲）从直接数量控制向间接市场化工具转型的货币政策传导机制文献，为二元经济结构下货币政策框架转型的理论分析提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚政策制定者提供优化货币政策传导效率的战略建议，帮助维护转型关键时期的价格与金融稳定；为商业银行、进口商和出口商应对新政策框架提供运营和财务层面的指导。

title: A General, Scientific Unified Theory of Economic Growth, Asset Valuation and Return: A Common Necessary Constant Evidence for a Natural Law
affiliations: Nexxus Wealth Technologies, Inc.

detail.title: A General, Scientific Unified Theory of Economic Growth, Asset Valuation and Return: A Common Necessary Constant Evidence for a Natural Law
detail.abstract:
This paper posits theoretically and demonstrates empirical evidence for a theoretical, empirical and mathematical natural law operating across growth economics and major asset classes including the stock market, bond yield, gold and Bitcoin. A single constant: the long-run real per capita GDP growth rate of approximately 1.5-2% in developed economies determines the valuation reference point and real return of equities, long-term bond yield, gold, and Bitcoin across multiple monetary regimes spanning 200 years in the case of gold by presenting the only definitive solution to Gibson's Paradox in a Jrl. Of Investing paper. The unification of macroeconomics and asset pricing under this constant constitutes a general theory that meets the criterion of natural science by positing a naturally observed constant and specific, quantitative, empirically testable predictions from publicly available real-time data and demonstrating that a risk premium is unnecessary and degrades empirical results. Further, risk does not appear as a factor in deriving GDP growth, and since asset returns must be anchored on growth, cannot be a factor in generalized asset valuation and return. The peer-reviewed published Finance journal papers stemming from this theory offer the highest empirical point-to-point valuation accuracy across published works for the stock market, long bond yield, gold and Bitcoin using real-time data and no back-testing or retrofitting.

      The paper demonstrates that: (1) GDP is the return on the total productive asset base of the economy, making the real per capita productivity constant the economy's natural long-term real return on assets; (2) the equity risk premium as conventionally measured is an artifact of an infeasible full dividend reinvestment assumption at the aggregate market level; (3) Gibson's Paradox-the century-old observation that consol yields varied with the price level rather than the inflation rate under the gold standard-is fully resolved by the constant real inherent yield requirement of gold and gold-denominated instruments; (4) assets divide into inherent return classes, whose real value derives from their stock-to-world-GDP relationship, and fiat return classes, whose value derives from fiat cash flows priced by the generalized Fisher-Darby-Feldstein required yield; and (5) inflation is a monetary phenomenon driven exclusively by government and central bank money creation in excess of real GDP growth, wherein changes in the rate of expected inflation and in the real yield each independently impact asset valuationsinversely for fiat assets and directly for inherent assets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实证验证了一个统一的自然法则：发达经济体长期实际人均GDP增长率（约1.5-2%）是决定股票、长期债券收益率、黄金和比特币等主要资产类别估值基准和实际回报的单一常数。该理论统一了宏观经济学与资产定价，跨越多重货币制度，跨度长达200年（黄金），并解决了吉布森悖论。论文主张风险溢价是不必要的且会降低实证结果，风险不应作为资产定价因子。
AI.research_question: 长期实际人均GDP增长率这一常数是否能够统一解释股票市场、债券收益率、黄金和比特币等主要资产类别的长期估值与实际回报？风险溢价在资产定价中是否必要？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价理论依赖于风险溢价和风险因子，但缺乏统一的自然常数来解释跨资产类别的长期估值。作者试图将宏观经济学与资产定价统一在一个自然法则之下，并解决吉布森悖论这一百年未解之谜。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以长期实际人均GDP增长率（约1.5-2%）为核心常数，提出增长经济学的统一理论框架；结合费雪-达比-菲尔德斯坦（Fisher-Darby-Feldstein）要求收益率框架；区分固有回报资产（inherent return classes）与法币回报资产（fiat return classes）。
AI.method: 理论与实证相结合：提出理论模型后，使用实时公开数据对股票市场、长期债券收益率、黄金和比特币进行点对点的估值准确性检验，不使用回测或回溯拟合。
AI.findings: （1）GDP是经济总生产性资产基础的回报率，实际人均生产力常数是经济体的自然长期实际资产回报率；（2）传统衡量的股权风险溢价是总体市场水平上不可行的完全股息再投资假设的产物；（3）吉布森悖论可通过黄金及黄金计价工具的恒定实际固有收益率要求得到完全解决；（4）资产分为固有回报类（价值源自与世界GDP的存量关系）和法币回报类（价值由广义费雪-达比-菲尔德斯坦要求收益率定价）；（5）通货膨胀是政府与央行货币创造超出实际GDP增长的货币现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宏观经济学与资产定价统一为以单一自然常数为基础的一般理论，符合自然科学标准；提出风险溢价不必要且降低实证结果的论点，挑战传统资产定价理论中风险的核心地位；为吉布森悖论提供了唯一确定性的解决方案；提出固有回报资产与法币回报资产的二分法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需回测或回溯拟合的实时数据点对点估值方法，据称在已发表文献中实现了对股票市场、长期债券收益率、黄金和比特币的最高实证估值准确性；研究论文已在金融期刊上发表，具有可操作的资产估值和配置指导意义。

title: Mind the Gap: Evaluating Forensic Accounting Training in Hong Kong Undergraduate Accounting Programmes

detail.title: Mind the Gap: Evaluating Forensic Accounting Training in Hong Kong Undergraduate Accounting Programmes
detail.abstract: Driven by expanding governance mandates and anti-corruption efforts, the demand for specialized forensic accounting expertise in the Asia-Pacific region has surged, yet persistent talent shortages remain. This study evaluates the integration and availability of forensic accounting education within undergraduate accounting curricula across all eight University Grants Committee (UGC)-funded universities in Hong Kong for the 2025/26 academic year. Utilizing a qualitative curriculum audit framework based on an Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) keyword matrix, official course outlines for BBA accounting majors were systematically analysed. The empirical findings reveal a severe structural deficit, only one institution (The Chinese University of Hong Kong) offers a dedicated, standalone elective course in forensic accounting, while the remaining seven rely exclusively on an "embedded" model that subsumes basic fraud concepts within standard statutory auditing modules. Furthermore, a critical "digital deficit" was identified as 87.5% () of undergraduate curricula omit emerging tech-driven financial crimes, including AI-facilitated fraud, digital forensics, and cryptocurrency laundering. To address this pedagogical gap without disrupting statutory accreditation frameworks, the study recommends adopting a bifurcated elective stream model—inspired by existing ESG and Accounting Analytics pathways—to seamlessly incorporate digital analytics, asset recovery, and financial crime regulation into the undergraduate accounting curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了香港八所UGC资助大学2025/26学年本科会计课程中法务会计教育的整合与可用性，发现严重的结构性缺陷：仅香港中文大学提供独立的法务会计选修课，其余七所采用"嵌入式"模式；87.5%的课程遗漏了新兴技术驱动的金融犯罪内容。研究建议采用二元选修流模型来弥补这一教学空白。
AI.research_question: 香港八所UGC资助大学的本科会计课程中，法务会计教育的整合程度和可用性如何？
AI.motivation: 亚太地区对专业法务会计人才的需求激增（受治理任务扩大和反腐败努力驱动），但持续存在人才短缺问题，需要审视法务会计教育在本科课程中的供给现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ACFE（注册舞弊审查师协会）关键词矩阵的定性课程审计框架
AI.method: 采用定性课程审计方法，利用ACFE关键词矩阵，系统分析香港八所UGC资助大学BBA会计专业的官方课程大纲。
AI.findings: 1）仅香港中文大学提供独立的法务会计选修课，其余七所大学采用"嵌入式"模式，仅在标准法定审计模块中涵盖基础舞弊概念；2）87.5%的本科课程遗漏新兴技术驱动的金融犯罪内容，包括AI辅助欺诈、数字取证和加密货币洗钱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了香港本科会计教育中法务会计教学的结构性缺陷和"数字赤字"，为课程评估提供了基于ACFE关键词矩阵的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出采用二元选修流模型（借鉴现有ESG和会计分析路径），在不干扰法定认证框架的前提下，将数字分析、资产追回和金融犯罪监管无缝纳入本科会计课程。

title: EQUITYchain: Programmable Infrastructure for Equitable Homeownership in New York State

detail.title: EQUITYchain: Programmable Infrastructure for Equitable Homeownership in New York State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and CEO of aequumAI LLC, the company that developed the EQUITYchain architecture described in this paper. This paper presents a proposed framework for policy and technical review; it is not a commercial solicitation. No external funding was received for this work. The author has no competing financial interests with respect to the analysis of housing finance disparities presented herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted by the author independently under aequumAI LLC.

detail.abstract:
Homeownership remains one of the most important pathways to wealth in the United States, yet access to that pathway remains structurally unequal across New York State. Persistent disparities in homeownership, mortgage access, appraisal treatment, foreclosure outcomes, and post-distress ownership patterns are not isolated failures. They reflect a housing finance system in which information asymmetry, misaligned incentives, and centralized gatekeeping reinforce one another over time.

This paper argues that these failures can be understood as a set of self-reinforcing legacy feedback loops. Steering and segmentation shape who receives credit and on what terms; appraisal and valuation practices weaken equity formation in already disadvantaged areas; distress resolution rewards fee extraction over sustainable cure; and in the final stage, outside ownership and eviction-driven churn extract local wealth rather than building it. The result is not only unequal access to homeownership, but unequal retention of housing-related wealth once households enter the system.

EQUITYchain™ is proposed as a rule-based financial infrastructure designed to change how these transactions are recorded, prioritized, and enforced. The architecture centers on a vesting-first model of equity, in which occupants accumulate ownership-share tokens tied to residual net equity rather than receiving informal or discretionary claims. Smart-contract logic governs payment allocation, equity accounting, event-driven valuation, default handling, dispute resolution, and regulator-facing compliance logs.

The paper's core claim is not that technology alone solves structural housing inequity. Rather, it argues that programmable settlement rules, transparent accounting, and auditable enforcement can reduce the discretion and opacity through which inequity is reproduced. Default does not necessarily collapse into eviction or total loss — the system supports multiple structured pathways including cure, replacement, liquidation, and collateralized borrowing against vested equity, all subject to a defined priority waterfall.

For policymakers and regulators, the proposal combines household-level equity accounting with system-level supervision. The architecture contemplates permissioned, real-time visibility into originations, step-ins, valuation events, transfers, and distress outcomes — creating a basis for a pilot framework in which consumer protections, dispute windows, and valuation controls are defined in advance rather than improvised after failure.

AI.tldr: 本文认为纽约州住房拥有权的不平等源于住房金融体系中信息不对称、激励错位和集中式门控所构成的自我强化反馈循环，并提出EQUITYchain™——一个基于规则的金融基础设施，通过归属优先的权益模型、智能合约和可审计的执行机制，旨在减少住房交易中的自由裁量权和透明度缺失，从而缓解结构性住房不平等。
AI.research_question: 住房金融体系中的结构性不平等（包括住房拥有权、抵押贷款获取、评估待遇、止赎结果和困境后所有权模式的不平等）是如何通过自我强化的反馈循环被持续再生产出来的？基于规则的金融基础设施能否通过可编程结算、透明会计和可审计执行来减少这种不平等的再生产？
AI.motivation: 纽约州住房拥有权作为最重要的财富积累途径之一仍然存在结构性不平等，住房金融体系中的信息不对称、激励错位和集中式门控相互强化，导致不仅住房拥有权获取不平等，而且一旦家庭进入系统后对住房相关财富的保有也不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我强化遗留反馈循环理论（self-reinforcing legacy feedback loops），涵盖四个阶段：信贷引导与分割、评估与估值实践削弱弱势地区股权形成、困境解决偏向费用提取而非可持续修复、外部所有权和驱逐驱动的流转提取当地财富。
AI.method: 提出EQUITYchain™作为基于规则的金融基础设施架构，采用归属优先（vesting-first）的权益模型，通过智能合约逻辑管理支付分配、权益核算、事件驱动估值、违约处理、争议解决和面向监管机构的合规日志。
AI.findings: 核心主张是技术本身不能单独解决结构性住房不平等，但可编程结算规则、透明会计和可审计执行可以减少不平等的再生产所依赖的自由裁量权和透明度缺失。违约不必然导致驱逐或全部损失，系统支持多种结构化路径（修复、替换、清算、基于归属权益的抵押借款），并受定义好的优先瀑布规则约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 将住房金融体系的不平等理解为跨阶段、自我强化的反馈循环系统，而非孤立的失败事件；提出通过规则驱动的金融基础设施来打断这些循环，为住房权益研究提供新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管者提供将家庭层面权益核算与系统层面监督相结合的方案，包括对发起、介入、估值事件、转让和困境结果的权限化实时可见性，以及预先定义消费者保护、争议窗口和估值控制的试点框架。

title: Building World-class Organisations through the AVEPRR Framework -Evidence from India's Greatest Warrior-Kings
affiliations: National School of Leadership

detail.title: Building World-class Organisations through the AVEPRR Framework -Evidence from India's Greatest Warrior-Kings
detail.abstract: Management scholarship has long been dominated by Western-centric leadership frameworks, leaving a vast reservoir of organisational wisdom embedded in non-Western civilizational history largely untapped. This paper introduces the AVEPRR Model-a six-pillar leadership framework comprising Authenticity (A), Values (V), Emotional Intelligence (E), Purpose (P), Resilience (R1), and Responsiveness (R2) and validates it historically, through the governance systems of nine iconic Indian warrior-kings: Chandragupta Maurya, Ashoka the Great, Raja Raja Chola I, Rajendra Chola I, Prithviraj Chauhan, Rana Sanga, Krishna Devaraya, Maharana Pratap, and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Employing a qualitative historical-comparative methodology drawn from Ashokan edicts, Kautilya's Arthashastra, Tamil Sangam literature, Chola copper-plate inscriptions, and peer-reviewed scholarship, the paper demonstrates how each AVEPRR pillar manifested in documented governance behaviour spanning two and a half millennia. The study maps these historical insights to contemporary management theory and practice, arguing that India's warrior-kings were, in essence, world-class organisational architects whose governance instincts and systems prefigure modern constructs in authentic leadership, values-based governance, emotional intelligence, purposeful enterprise, resilient institutions, and agile responsiveness.
