Shivaji Maharaj emerges as the most complete AVEPRR exemplar. The framework offers a culturally rooted, empirically grounded alternative to Western-centric leadership paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVEPRR六支柱领导力模型（真实、价值观、情商、目的、韧性、响应性），通过对印度九位传奇 warrior-kings 的历史治理体系进行定性历史比较分析加以验证，论证印度 warrior-kings 实为世界级组织架构师，其治理智慧预示了现代领导力与管理理论中的诸多核心概念，为西方中心主义领导力范式提供了植根于文化、基于实证的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 非西方文明历史中蕴含的组织与管理智慧，如何系统性地提炼为可验证的领导力理论框架，从而为西方中心主义范式提供替代方案？
AI.motivation: 管理学长期以来被西方中心主义领导力框架主导，非西方文明历史中丰富的组织智慧宝库未被充分开发。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过印度历史中的统治者治理实践发掘本土化的领导力模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: AVEPRR六支柱领导力模型，包含真实（Authenticity）、价值观（Values）、情商（Emotional Intelligence）、目的（Purpose）、韧性（Resilience）、响应性（Responsiveness）六大维度。
AI.method: 定性历史比较分析法（qualitative historical-comparative methodology），数据来源包括阿育王石刻诏令、考底利耶《政事论》、泰米尔桑伽姆文学、朱罗王朝铜板铭文及同行评审学术文献，跨度涵盖两千五百年历史。
AI.findings: AVEPRR各支柱在九位印度国王的治理行为中均有文献可考的具体体现；Shivaji Maharaj（希瓦吉大帝）被认为是AVEPRR模型最完整的典范；印度 warrior-kings 的治理直觉与制度设计预示了现代领导力中的多个核心构念。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并历史验证了植根于非西方文明（印度）的AVEPRR领导力框架，为领导力理论提供了去西方中心化的理论建构路径；将历史案例与当代管理理论（真实领导力、价值观治理、情商、目的性企业、韧性制度、敏捷响应）进行系统映射。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理实践者提供了具有文化根基的、经过历史实证检验的领导力框架，可作为西方范式之外的可操作替代方案，尤其对新兴经济体和非西方文化背景的组织管理具有现实指导意义。

title: RNAD: A Regime-Normalized, Tail-Robust, and Direction-Aware Loss for Deep Time-Series Forecasting

detail.title: RNAD: A Regime-Normalized, Tail-Robust, and Direction-Aware Loss for Deep Time-Series Forecasting
detail.abstract: Financial time-series forecasting is commonly optimized using mean-squared error (MSE), though financial returns exhibit volatility clustering, heavy tails, and regime shifts that often make a fixed quadratic objective ill-suited. We propose Regime-Normalized Adaptive Directional Loss (RNAD), a model-agnostic training objective that combines online volatility normalization, adaptive interpolation between quadratic and Charbonnier penalties, and gated directional supervision that suppresses learning from near-zero returns. RNAD requires only a lightweight per-asset volatility buffer and integrates seamlessly into existing forecasting models without architectural modifications or inference overhead. Evaluated across nine financial assets, four state-of-the-art forecasting backbones, and strict chronological train-validation-test splits, RNAD consistently achieves the lowest RMSE while improving MAE and directional accuracy. Ablation studies identify directional supervision as the primary source of improvement, with tail-aware and noise-aware gating providing complementary regime-dependent benefits. These findings demonstrate that objective design offers a simple, effective, and broadly applicable path to improving financial time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模型无关的训练目标函数RNAD（Regime-Normalized Adaptive Directional Loss），通过在线波动率归一化、二次与Charbonnier惩罚的自适应插值、以及门控方向监督相结合，解决了金融时间序列预测中固定二次损失（MSE）在波动率聚集、厚尾和机制转换下不适配的问题。在九个金融资产、四个SOTA预测骨干网络和严格时间顺序划分下，RNAD一致取得最低RMSE，同时改善MAE和方向准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种训练目标函数，使其在金融时间序列预测中优于传统的MSE损失，以更好地处理波动率聚集、厚尾分布和机制转换等金融数据特征？
AI.motivation: 金融收益率具有波动率聚集、厚尾分布和机制转换等特征，使得固定二次目标（MSE）往往不适配。现有方法多聚焦于模型架构改进，而忽略了训练目标函数设计这一简单有效的优化路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于损失函数设计理论，结合波动率归一化（online volatility normalization）、鲁棒损失（Charbonnier penalty）、方向预测loss和门控机制（gating）等思想构建组合式训练目标。
AI.method: 提出RNAD损失函数，由三个组件构成：（1）在线波动率归一化，使用轻量级per-asset波动率缓冲器自适应缩放损失；（2）在二次惩罚与Charbonnier惩罚之间进行自适应插值，以应对厚尾分布；（3）门控方向监督，通过抑制接近零收益样本的学习来增强方向预测。该方法无需修改模型架构或增加推理开销。
AI.findings: 在九个金融资产、四个SOTA预测骨干网络和严格时间顺序训练-验证-测试划分下，RNAD一致取得最低RMSE，同时改善MAE和方向准确率。消融研究显示方向监督是改进的主要来源，厚尾感知和噪声感知门控提供互补的机制依赖收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 表明训练目标函数设计是提升金融时间序列预测的简单、有效且广泛适用的路径，为损失函数设计在金融预测领域的理论补充提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: RNAD是模型无关的，可无缝集成到现有预测模型中，无需架构修改或推理开销，仅需轻量级per-asset波动率缓冲器，具有高度的实用性和部署便利性。

title: Speaking to the Supply Side: Central Bank Communication and Monetary Policy Transmission
affiliations: Shandong University,  and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Speaking to the Supply Side: Central Bank Communication and Monetary Policy Transmission
detail.abstract: Central banks have increasingly embraced transparency, yet standard dispersedinformation models often favor opacity because disclosure weakens the real effects of monetary policy. This paper shows that a supply-side channel of monetary transmission provides a rationale for transparency: although communication weakens demandside transmission, it complements policy by helping firms incorporate policy-induced financing costs into prices, thereby strengthening supply-side stabilization. We find that under the optimal interest-rate rule, this mechanism makes full opacity or full transparency the optimal communication choice. Full transparency is optimal for both technology and markup shocks when the steady-state elasticity of substitution lies below the corresponding shock-specific threshold. Quantitatively, both transparency conditions are satisfied under standard calibrations, and full transparency delivers substantial welfare gains. These results are robust to observable policy rates and centralbank learning from prices.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统分散信息模型认为中央银行应保持不透明的观点，证明货币传导的供给侧渠道为透明度提供了理论依据。在最优利率规则下，完全透明或完全不透明是最优沟通选择，且标准校准下完全透明带来显著的福利收益。
AI.research_question: 中央银行透明度是否以及何时是最优选择？具体而言，在考虑货币传导的供给侧渠道后，沟通政策（透明度）对货币政策有效性的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 标准分散信息模型通常偏好不透明，因为信息披露会削弱货币政策的实际效应（通过需求侧渠道）。但这一结论忽略了货币传导的供给侧渠道，未能全面评估中央银行透明度政策的成本与收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分散信息模型（dispersed information model）、货币传导的供给侧渠道（supply-side transmission channel）、最优利率规则（optimal interest-rate rule）。
AI.method: 理论建模与定量分析。构建包含分散信息和货币传导供给侧渠道的模型，在最优利率规则下分析完全透明与完全不透明的福利比较，并通过标准校准进行定量评估。
AI.findings: （1）透明度虽然削弱需求侧传导，但能帮助企业将政策引致的融资成本纳入定价，从而增强供给侧稳定；（2）最优利率规则下，完全透明或完全不透明为最优沟通选择；（3）技术和加价冲击下，当稳态替代弹性低于对应冲击特定阈值时，完全透明最优；（4）标准校准下两个透明度条件均满足，完全透明带来显著福利收益；（5）结果对可观测政策利率和央行从价格中学习具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将货币传导供给侧渠道纳入透明度分析框架，为中央银行透明度提供了新的理论依据；（2）调和了分散信息模型偏好不透明与传统中央银行透明度实践之间的矛盾；（3）刻画了完全透明与完全不透明的最优性条件及冲击特定阈值。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为中央银行沟通政策设计提供了理论指导，支持在标准参数环境下选择完全透明的沟通策略；（2）有助于中央银行理解透明度政策与货币政策传导机制之间的互动关系。

title: Beyond Competence -How the AVEP-RR Leadership Model Reshapes Organisational Excellence
affiliations: National School of Leadership

detail.title: Beyond Competence -How the AVEP-RR Leadership Model Reshapes Organisational Excellence
detail.abstract: This qualitative paper investigates how the AVEP RR leadership model, centred on Authenticity, Values, Emotional Intelligence, and Purpose, yielding Responsiveness and Resilience, transforms organisational excellence in the frameworks of VUCA (Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity, Ambiguity), BANI (Brittle, Anxious, Nonlinear, Incomprehensible), and RUPT (Rapid, Unpredictable, Paradoxical, Tangled). On the strength of a literature review of adaptive, responsible, and compassionate leadership, and empirical studies of Indian organisations, the paper presents detailed case narratives of Tata Group's post-26/11 resilience, Aravind Eye Care's transformative healthcare model, and Mahindra and Mahindra's "Rise" philosophy. Findings demonstrate the vital role of purpose-led, emotionally intelligent leadership, deeply grounded in authenticity and values, for sustainable human capital development, workforce skilling, and organisational resilience. Comparative analysis, practical trait-outcome mapping, and expanded policy takeaways show how AVEP RR equips leaders and organisations to thrive in an unpredictable world, allowing India to advance its Viksit Bharat 2047 vision. The conclusion offers recommendations for policy, education, and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性的案例研究方法，探讨了AVEP RR领导力模型（以真实性、价值观、情商和目的为核心，产生响应性与韧性）如何在VUCA、BANI和RUPT等动荡环境框架下转化组织卓越性。基于对印度组织（塔塔集团、Aravind眼科医院、马恒达集团）的案例研究，论文发现目的导向、情感智能且根植于真实性与价值观的领导力对于可持续人力资本发展、员工技能提升和组织韧性至关重要，并为印度的Viksit Bharat 2047愿景提供政策与实践建议。
AI.research_question: AVEP RR领导力模型如何在VUCA、BANI和RUPT等复杂多变的环境框架下转化组织卓越性？该模型如何赋能领导者与组织在不可预测的世界中蓬勃发展？
AI.motivation: 当今世界面临VUCA、BANI和RUPT等多重复杂环境框架的挑战，传统领导力模式难以应对高度动荡与不确定性的局面。现有文献虽涵盖适应性、负责任和富有同情心的领导力，但缺乏一个整合性的领导力模型来系统指导组织在动荡环境中实现卓越，尤其缺乏基于印度组织情境的深入实证案例研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: AVEP RR领导力模型（以Authenticity真实性、Values价值观、Emotional Intelligence情商、Purpose目的为核心，产生Responsiveness响应性与Resilience韧性）；适应性领导力、负责任领导力、富有同情心的领导力理论；VUCA、BANI与RUPT环境框架分析。
AI.method: 定性研究方法：文献综述（涵盖适应性、负责任和富有同情心的领导力理论）、多案例实证研究（塔塔集团26/11后韧性、Aravind眼科医院变革性医疗模式、马恒达集团"Rise"理念）、比较分析、实践特质-结果映射、扩展政策启示。
AI.findings: 研究发现目的导向、情感智能且深深植根于真实性与价值观的领导力，对于可持续人力资本发展、劳动力技能提升和组织韧性具有至关重要的作用。AVEP RR模型能有效赋能领导者和组织在不可预测的世界中蓬勃发展，并支持印度推进其Viksit Bharat 2047愿景。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合真实性、价值观、情商和目的四个核心维度，构建了AVEP RR领导力模型，丰富了动荡环境下的领导力理论体系；将VUCA、BANI和RUPT三种环境框架整合分析，拓展了组织卓越性研究的理论视野；通过特质-结果映射，为领导力理论提供了可操作化的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育机构和实践者提供了在动荡环境中培养卓越领导力的具体建议；为印度实现Viksit Bharat 2047愿景提供了领导力发展路径；通过三个印度组织的最佳实践案例，为其他组织提供了可借鉴的范本和实践启示。

title: The Gwadar Port Nexus of Great Power Rivalry: A Trialogue of Marine Economics, Geostrategy, and Economic Impact Assessment in the Strait of Hormuz
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Gwadar Port Nexus of Great Power Rivalry: A Trialogue of Marine Economics, Geostrategy, and Economic Impact Assessment in the Strait of Hormuz

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am interested and teaching International Economics
declarations.ethicsApproval: I am the only author and there is no conflict in interest
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

detail.abstract: Pakistan's Gwadar Port is increasingly at the center of heightened great power rivalry between the United States and China over the Strait of Hormuz, the world's premier tanker chokepoint. Chokepoint nations experience various conflicts and challenges associated with keeping the oil supply lines flowing. Greater US-China rivalry will have further implications on the Gwadar Port industry. Accordingly, the goal of this research is to: (1) identify and analyze the cost structure of the Gwadar port; (2) provide an evaluation of the port using the best vessel operating model in marine economics; (3) conduct a trade-creation versus trade diversion analysis of the Gwadar port using the CGE model and its corresponding indirect multiplier impact; and (4) assess the regional economic impact of the Gwadar port on Pakistan's GDP and regional job creation between 2024 and 2030. The findings of this research are as follows: (1) baseline values indicate that Gwadar offers a 14.5-17.2% cost advantage compared to Jebel Ali; (2) a full closure of the Strait of Hormuz would increase shipping costs to Gwadar by 189-240%; (3) the regional multiplier effect of the Gwadar port is 1.8-2.2 and could create 900,000 jobs between 2024 and 2030; and (4) the US Iranian confrontation is established to serve as an indirect tool to degrade the Gwadar port. Pursuing a cost-benefit analysis of alternate rail and maritime routes between the US and China, this paper argues that the US strategy to influence China is underlined with geostrategic considerations of building a "choke point leverage" and hence "entries" into the Persian gulf region. This strategy is incorporated in Gwadar port projects, together with the US-China agreement on trade-transport-late-kinematics, and the US interest in "busting" of the latter through competing activities at the Expanding Port of Duqm and the construction of the China Railway to Xinjiang. Three policy simulations are carried out to model the impact of a US blockade on the value of Gwadar port project, and test competitiveness of China Railway and Port of Duqm as "insurance" options. The simulations are based on empirical data from US-China trade flows, freight rates and port expandability, as well as historical data from the US-China trade war. The paper concludes that Gwadar is a critical asset in the US China rivalry, but its fate depends less on port infrastructure than on the stability of the Hormuz Strait and the evolution of Iran-US relations.

AI.tldr: 本文以巴基斯坦瓜达尔港为中心，研究美中在霍尔木兹海峡这一全球关键石油咽喉要道上的大国博弈。通过成本结构分析、最佳船型运营模型、CGE贸易创造与转移分析，以及区域经济影响评估，论文发现瓜达尔港相比杰贝阿里港具有14.5-17.2%的成本优势，但霍尔木兹海峡若完全关闭将导致航运成本飙升189-240%。论文提出美国通过"咽喉点杠杆"战略，利用伊朗对抗、扩建杜克姆港和建设中国铁路等方式来制衡中国在瓜达尔港的影响力，并通过三项政策模拟验证了这些竞争策略的效果。
AI.research_question: 在中美大国竞争背景下，瓜达尔港的成本结构、贸易效应及区域经济影响如何？美国的地缘战略（如伊朗对抗、港口扩建、铁路竞争）如何影响瓜达尔港的发展前景？
AI.motivation: 瓜达尔港日益处于中美围绕霍尔木兹海峡（全球最重要的石油航运咽喉）的大国博弈中心。咽喉要道国家面临保持石油供应线畅通的各种冲突与挑战，美中竞争加剧对瓜达尔港产业产生深远影响，亟需系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 海洋经济学中的最佳船型运营模型；可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型及间接乘数效应；地缘政治经济学中的"咽喉点杠杆"（choke point leverage）理论；贸易创造与贸易转移理论。
AI.method: (1) 瓜达尔港成本结构识别与分析；(2) 采用海洋经济学最佳船型运营模型进行港口评估；(3) 利用CGE模型进行贸易创造与贸易转移分析及间接乘数效应评估；(4) 基于美中贸易流、运费率、港口扩展性及美中贸易战历史数据，进行三项政策模拟（美国封锁情景）。
AI.findings: (1) 瓜达尔港相比杰贝阿里港具有14.5-17.2%的成本优势；(2) 霍尔木兹海峡完全关闭将使瓜达尔港航运成本增加189-240%；(3) 瓜达尔港区域乘数效应为1.8-2.2，2024-2030年间可创造90万个就业岗位；(4) 美伊对抗成为削弱瓜达尔港的间接工具；(5) 美国战略核心是建立"咽喉点杠杆"以进入波斯湾地区，通过杜克姆港扩建和通往新疆的中国铁路建设来"破坏"中美贸易运输协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"咽喉点杠杆"概念系统化应用于美中地缘经济竞争分析；将海洋经济学船型模型与CGE贸易模型相结合，构建港口地缘经济评估框架；通过政策模拟揭示了地缘政治冲突（美伊对抗）如何通过间接渠道影响商业港口竞争力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府及投资者提供瓜达尔港2024-2030年经济影响量化评估（GDP贡献及就业创造）；为中美双方提供地缘战略决策参考；为港口规划者提供成本结构与风险情景分析，识别霍尔木兹海峡稳定性和美伊关系对港口命运的关键影响。

title: From Demography to Conversion: Projecting the French Micro-Enterprise Transfer Market to 2035
affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne - Laboratoire PRISM

detail.title: From Demography to Conversion: Projecting the French Micro-Enterprise Transfer Market to 2035

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing financial or non-financial interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available administrative and statistical data. It does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Consequently, formal ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required under the applicable institutional regulations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The ageing of small-business owners feeds a widely announced "wall" of business transfers whose timing remains poorly established. This article offers an operation-level empirical demonstration, focused on the going-concern segment (classic self-employed owners) and informed by a banking lens. The method relies on established demographic tools: an agespecific occurrence-exposure rate of business sale, estimated with a Poisson model, and a cohort-component projection. Two layers are strictly separated. The observed layer characterises the seller-buyer dyad and estimates, on real data, the age-to-sale hazard profile. The projected layer runs national demographic projections (INSEE) through this profile, calibrated by out-of-sample back-testing, under conversion scenarios anchored to the cost of SME credit (Banque de France). The demographic pool has already reached a plateau (about 34,500 potential sales per year): the wall is an installed level, not a wave to come. The variable driving realised flows is not demography but the conversion rate. The central projection stands at about 32,100 transfers per year (2026-2035 cumulative: 322,700). The public-policy question shifts from the stock to conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文从银行视角出发，利用人口统计学方法（泊松模型的特定年龄发生-暴露率及队列成分预测），对小企业主老龄化引发的"企业转让墙"进行了操作层面的实证分析。研究发现潜在转让池已进入平台期（每年约34,500家），"墙"是已确立的水平而非即将到来的浪潮，实际转让流量的关键驱动因素是转化率而非人口结构，核心预测为每年约32,100笔转让（2026-2035年累计322,700笔），政策问题应从存量转向转化率。
AI.research_question: 小企业主老龄化所预示的"企业转让墙"的时间节点究竟如何？实际企业转让流量由什么因素驱动？
AI.motivation: 关于小企业主老龄化引发的大规模企业转让"墙"的时机缺乏可靠的实证依据，现有讨论多为推测性声明，需要基于实际操作层面（going-concern细分市场）进行严谨的量化估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口统计学方法：特定年龄发生-暴露率（age-specific occurrence-exposure rate）、泊松模型、队列成分预测法（cohort-component projection）；银行视角下的企业转让分析框架。
AI.method: 两层严格分离的方法：观察层使用真实数据（卖方-买方二元关系）估计年龄-转让风险曲线（泊松模型）；预测层将法国国家统计局（INSEE）的人口预测代入该风险曲线，通过样本外回测校准，并以法国央行中小企业信贷成本锚定转化情景。
AI.findings: 1) 潜在转让池已达平台期（每年约34,500笔潜在转让），"墙"是已确立的水平而非即将到来的浪潮；2) 驱动实际转让流量的关键因素是转化率而非人口结构；3) 核心预测为每年约32,100笔转让（2026-2035年累计322,700笔）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在操作层面（going-concern细分市场）建立年龄-转让风险的量化剖面，将人口统计学工具系统应用于企业转让研究，并将人口结构与转化率两个维度严格区分，修正了"转让墙"时间节点的既有认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供明确指引：公共政策焦点应从转让存量（stock）转向转化率（conversion），为银行等金融机构评估企业转让市场提供量化基础和预测工具。

title: Declaration or Bare Injunction? Section 34, the Cloud on Title and the Limits of the Bare Injunction Suit under the Specific Relief Act, 1963
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Declaration or Bare Injunction? Section 34, the Cloud on Title and the Limits of the Bare Injunction Suit under the Specific Relief Act, 1963
detail.abstract: Few questions of remedial law arise more frequently before the civil and commercial courts of India than whether a plaintiff may rest content with a suit for a bare injunction or whether the law compels him to seek a declaration, with all that follows for court fees, limitation, the frame of issues and the fate of the suit. This article examines that question doctrinally, working from the text of Sections 31, 34, 35, 38 and 41 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963 and the governing propositions of Anathula Sudhakar v. P. Buchi Reddy, through the modern refinements culminating in the Supreme Court's 2025 pronouncements in Rajeev Gupta v. Prashant Garg, S. Santhana Lakshmi v. D. Rajammal and Annamalai v. Vasanthi. The thesis advanced is that the declaration is mandatory whenever a genuine cloud is cast upon the foundation of the plaintiff's claim, upon title where property is concerned, or upon the subsistence of the contract where termination is concerned, and that the injunction simpliciter suffices whenever that foundation is secure and only its enjoyment is threatened. The article analyses the mandatory bar in the proviso to Section 34, the curative and fiscal consequences of misframing, the limitation fault-line between Sopanrao and Rajeev Gupta, and answers the strongest objection to the thesis, before distilling the doctrine into operative tests for the pleader.

AI.tldr: 本文对印度民事救济法中"仅申请禁令"与"必须同时申请宣告判决"这一高频争议问题进行了教义学分析，基于1963年《特别救济法》相关条文及最高法院2025年三个新判例，提出核心论点：当原告权利基础（产权、合同存续等）受到真实质疑时，宣告判决是强制性的；只有当权利基础稳固、仅享益受到威胁时，单纯禁令才足够。
AI.research_question: 在印度民事诉讼中，原告何时可以仅申请禁令（bare injunction），何时法律强制要求其同时申请宣告判决（declaration）？
AI.motivation: 该问题是印度民事与商事法院中最高频出现的救济法问题之一，因为是否需申请宣告直接关系到诉讼费用、时效限制、争点框架及诉讼结果，实务中亟需清晰的操作性标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于1963年《特别救济法》第31、34、35、38和41条，以及Anathula Sudhakar案的指导原则，结合最高法院2025年Rajeev Gupta、S. Santhana Lakshmi和Annamalai三个新判例的现代精细发展。
AI.method: 教义学（doctrinal）分析方法，从法条文本出发，结合判例法演进，辅以对第34条但书中强制性禁止条款的分析、错误构架（misframing）的矫正与费用后果分析、以及时效问题的判例分歧考察。
AI.findings: 宣告判决在以下情形中具有强制性：（1）原告主张的基础受到真实质疑（genuine cloud）时；（2）涉及产权时产权本身受到质疑；（3）涉及合同终止时合同存续性受到质疑。而当权利基础稳固、仅其享益（enjoyment）受到威胁时，单纯禁令即可满足要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"宣告强制性vs禁令充分性"提出了统一的教义学标准（以"权利基础是否受真实质疑"为分水岭），澄清了第34条但书的强制性禁止条款之适用边界，并系统梳理和调和了Sopanrao与Rajeev Gupta之间在时效问题上的判例裂缝。
AI.practical_contributions: 为诉讼律师提供了可直接操作的操作性检验标准（operative tests），帮助其正确构架诉因，避免因错误构架导致的诉讼费用浪费、时效障碍和诉讼败诉风险。

title: The Transfer of French Micro and Small Enterprises: A Geography of Fragility on the Eve of the Great Wealth Transfer
affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne - Laboratoire PRISM

detail.title: The Transfer of French Micro and Small Enterprises: A Geography of Fragility on the Eve of the Great Wealth Transfer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing financial or non-financial interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available administrative and statistical data. It does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Consequently, formal ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required under the applicable institutional regulations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: France faces a marked ageing of small-business owners: Bpifrance Le Lab estimates that around 370,000 firms will come up for transfer by 2030, but that only some 130,000 will actually be taken over at the current pace. This article shifts the focus from the stock of firms to the conversion of this potential into completed operations, and studies it at the level of individual transactions rather than through aggregates. It draws on the Bulletin officiel des annonces civiles et commerciales (BODACC)-nearly 800,000 sales of business goodwill (fonds de commerce) from 2008 to 2026-combined with business stocks, the INSEE municipal density grid, local bank density and the Permanent Database of Facilities. The flow of transfers is stable, but its geography is pronounced: transfer intensity and goodwill valuations both decline towards sparsely populated rural areas, where they coincide with a structurally thin commercial fabric. That fabric, however, does not erode over the recent period: retail desertification appears as a structural state rather than an ongoing dynamic. Against a churn-based reading, observed post-takeover survival rises along the rurality gradient: where transfers are rarest, takeovers are the most durable, indicating that rural fragility stems from the scarcity of operations, not from their failure. Transfer intensity is finally associated, descriptively and exploratorily, with local bank density-an association robust at the inter-municipal scale but sensitive to spatial specification at the departmental scale. The article thus maps a geography of fragility in which territory leads and proximity finance offers a complementary lens, upstream of the great wealth transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文利用BODACC数据库中2008-2026年近80万笔商业营业资产交易数据，从个体交易层面研究法国中小企业转让的地理分布及其决定因素。研究发现：企业转让流量在地理上极不均衡，农村地区转让强度低、商誉估值低，且商业结构稀疏但并非持续恶化；农村地区的接管后存活率反而更高，表明农村脆弱性源于交易稀缺而非交易失败；转让强度与当地银行密度存在描述性和探索性的正相关关系。
AI.research_question: 法国中小企业转让的地理分布特征是什么？农村地区的转让稀缺性是否源于交易失败，以及银行密度是否与转让强度相关？
AI.motivation: 法国面临中小企业主严重老龄化问题，Bpifrance Le Lab估计到2030年约有37万家企业面临转让，但按当前速度仅有约13万家会被接管。既有研究聚焦于企业存量，本文转向从个体交易层面研究"潜在转让转化为实际完成交易"的过程，弥补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地理学与区域经济学视角，结合"领土领先"（territory leads）概念和"邻近金融"（proximity finance）理论，探讨企业转让的地理分布及其与地方金融生态的关系。
AI.method: 使用BODACC数据库中2008-2026年近80万笔商业营业资产（fonds de commerce）交易数据，结合企业存量、INSEE市镇密度网格、地方银行密度及永久设施数据库（Permanent Database of Facilities），进行描述性统计和探索性空间分析。通过比较不同地理尺度（市际尺度与省级尺度）的回归结果检验银行密度与转让强度关系的稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）转让流量总体稳定，但地理分布显著：转让强度和商誉估值均向人口稀少的农村地区递减；（2）农村商业结构虽然稀疏，但在近期并未进一步侵蚀，零售荒漠化是一种结构性状态而非持续动态；（3）与"翻转式"解读相反，后接管存活率沿农村梯度上升——转让最少的地区，接管最为持久，说明农村脆弱性源于交易稀缺而非交易失败；（4）转让强度与当地银行密度呈正相关，该关联在市际尺度上稳健，但在省级尺度上对空间设定敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业转让研究从存量视角转向交易流量视角，揭示了"领土领先"的地理脆弱性机制；挑战了"农村脆弱源于交易失败"的既有认知，提出农村问题实为交易稀缺问题；建立了转让强度与银行密度的关联，为"邻近金融"理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业转让政策制定提供地理层面的实证依据：农村地区的政策重点应从救助失败交易转向增加交易机会和促进交易撮合；指出地方金融基础设施对促进企业转让的重要作用；为即将到来的大规模财富转移（great wealth transfer）提供前瞻性政策参考。

title: The Impact of Missing Data on the Performance of Agent-Based Transportation Recommenders

detail.title: The Impact of Missing Data on the Performance of Agent-Based Transportation Recommenders
detail.abstract: Agent-based transportation recommendation engines have emerged as a critical component in intelligent mobility systems, offering personalized travel suggestions by simulating the interactions between autonomous decision-making agents, infrastructure, and other travelers. However, the operational effectiveness of these systems is fundamentally constrained by the quality and completeness of their underlying data inputs, which in real-world deployments are frequently subject to sensor failures, communication latency, user non-compliance, and privacy-preserving data masking. This study systematically investigates the impact of missing data on the recommendation accuracy, convergence speed, and overall system stability of a multi-agent transportation recommender operating in a dynamic urban corridor. Using a controlled simulation environment calibrated with real-world traffic flow and user preference data, we introduced three distinct patterns of data absence—completely random, temporally correlated, and feature-dependent—at varying rates of incompleteness (5% to 40%). We evaluated performance across four key metrics: route recommendation precision, average travel time deviation, agent negotiation cycle length, and user satisfaction proxy score. Our results reveal a nonlinear degradation in system performance, with accuracy declining modestly up to a 15% missing-data threshold, but deteriorating precipitously beyond 25%, where recommendation precision dropped by 38% and negotiation convergence times increased by 52% compared to baseline. Notably, feature-dependent missingness (e.g., absent real-time congestion updates) produced disproportionately severe effects relative to random data gaps, indicating that not all missing information carries equal operational weight.The findings underscore that conventional imputation strategies, while effective for structured tabular data, prove inadequate in the interactive, time-sensitive context of agent-based systems due to the cascading propagation of uncertainty across negotiating agents. We further identify that system resilience varies significantly with agent memory length and communication frequency, suggesting architectural countermeasures that do not require perfect data. This research contributes a quantitative framework for diagnosing data-deficiency vulnerabilities in agent-based recommenders and provides actionable thresholds for data quality monitoring in operational deployments. The study concludes that robust transportation recommender design must prioritize adaptive fault-tolerance mechanisms rather than assuming data completeness, particularly as these systems scale toward smart city implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多智能体交通推荐系统中数据缺失对推荐精度、收敛速度和系统稳定性的影响，通过模拟实验引入三种缺失模式（完全随机、时间相关、特征依赖）和不同缺失率（5%-40%），发现系统性能呈非线性退化：15%缺失率以下影响较轻，超过25%后推荐精度下降38%、收敛时间增加52%，且特征依赖型缺失（如实时拥堵数据缺失）影响最为严重。研究指出传统插补策略在多智能体交互环境中无效，并提出通过调整智能体记忆长度和通信频率来增强系统鲁棒性的架构对策。
AI.research_question: 多智能体交通推荐系统在数据缺失条件下，其推荐精度、收敛速度和系统稳定性如何受影响？不同缺失模式和缺失率对系统性能的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 实际部署中的交通推荐系统常面临传感器故障、通信延迟、用户不配合和隐私保护导致的数据缺失问题，但现有研究对数据缺失如何影响多智能体推荐系统性能缺乏系统性量化分析，且传统数据插补策略在交互式、时间敏感的多智能体环境中可能失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多智能体系统理论、智能交通系统框架以及不确定性传播理论，研究数据缺失对智能体协商行为和系统整体性能的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用基于真实交通流量和用户偏好数据校准的受控模拟环境，引入三种数据缺失模式（完全随机、时间相关、特征依赖）和5%-40%的缺失率，测评四个关键指标：路线推荐精度、平均出行时间偏差、智能体协商周期长度、用户满意度代理得分。
AI.findings: (1) 系统性能呈非线性退化，15%缺失率以下性能下降温和，超过25%后推荐精度下降38%、协商收敛时间增加52%；(2) 特征依赖型缺失（如实时拥堵数据缺失）比随机缺失影响更严重，说明不同缺失信息权重不等；(3) 传统插补策略在交互式多智能体环境中因不确定性级联传播而失效；(4) 系统韧性随智能体记忆长度和通信频率显著变化，可通过架构调整而非完美数据来增强鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了诊断多智能体推荐系统数据缺陷脆弱性的定量框架；(2) 揭示了数据缺失在不同模式下的差异性影响权重，挑战了将缺失数据视为同质问题的传统假设；(3) 证明传统插补策略在多智能体交互环境中的局限性，推动了对不确定传播机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为实际运营部署提供了数据质量监控的可行阈值（15%-25%）；(2) 提出了不依赖完美数据的架构级故障容忍对策（调整智能体记忆长度和通信频率）；(3) 为智慧城市规模部署的鲁棒交通推荐系统设计提供了可操作指南。

title: The Forced Bid What Privatizing Social Security Would Do to Stock Prices, and Why Recent Developments in the Economics of Market Flows Strengthen the Case Against It

detail.title: The Forced Bid What Privatizing Social Security Would Do to Stock Prices, and Why Recent Developments in the Economics of Market Flows Strengthen the Case Against It

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: self

detail.abstract:
Proposals to privatize Social Security through personal investment accounts rest on the assumption that equity markets will deliver real returns of 6 to 7 percent, exceeding what the current program can pay. This paper examines that claim from actuarial, financial, and fiscal perspectives and finds it fails in each. Actuarially, Social Security is not an investment account but a package of inflation-indexed insurance benefits, retirement, disability, survivor, and family coverage, delivered through a progressive formula; no private portfolio replicates this package at comparable cost. 

Financially, the paper applies the inelastic markets hypothesis (Gabaix and Koijen, 2021), which holds that a dollar of net equity inflow raises total market capitalization by roughly five dollars, to a 2005-style carve-out diverting approximately $330 billion annually into automatic, price-insensitive equity purchases. Under this framework, valuations rise approximately 28 percent above baseline within a decade, compressing forward returns by nearly one percentage point annually and generating roughly $15 trillion in capital gains accruing predominantly to the top decile of households. Crucially, the classical framework of Diamond and Geanakoplos (2003), in which bond issuance offsets equity flows and prices barely move, reaches the same policy verdict by a different route: the equity risk premium shrinks as risk spreads across the workforce, eliminating the excess return the proposal requires. 

Both models therefore undermine the projected returns, and neither changes the real economics of retirement, which is funded by future production, not financial claims. Fiscal analysis in the functional finance and Modern Monetary Theory traditions confirms that personal accounts financed by government borrowing create no new national saving. The paper concludes that if broader asset ownership is the goal, the appropriate instrument is a voluntary, low-cost add-on savings vehicle layered atop an intact Social Security system, not a carve-out of the payroll tax.

In preparing this paper, the author used an AI assistant (Anthropic's Claude and Perplexity, powered by GPT-5.1) for drafting, editing, and formatting support. All analysis, arguments, and conclusions are the author's own, and all references and figures were verified against primary sources.

AI.tldr: 本文从精算、金融和财政三个视角系统地否定了个⼈投资账户私有化社会保障（Social Security）的提案。精算上，社会保障是包含通胀指数化的保险福利包，无法被私人投资组合复制；金融上，无论采用无弹性市场假说还是经典Diamond-Geanakoplos框架，股票回报预期都会大幅缩水，消除提案所需的超额回报；财政上，政府借债融资的个人账户不会创造新的国民储蓄。作者提出以自愿、低成本的附加储蓄工具替代工资税剥离方案。
AI.research_question: 个人投资账户私有化社会保障能否实现其宣称的6-7%股权回报率，该提案在精算、金融和财政三个维度上是否成立？
AI.motivation: 美国关于社会保障私有化的政策辩论长期基于股市将提供6-7%实际回报的假设，该假设缺乏系统性的跨学科检验。作者希望从精算、金融、财政三个视角综合验证这一核心前提的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无弹性市场假说（Inelastic Markets Hypothesis, Gabaix & Koijen 2021）；Diamond-Geanakoplos（2003）经典一般均衡框架；功能财政理论（Functional Finance）；现代货币理论（MMT）。
AI.method: 跨学科理论分析。通过精算对比分析社会保障福利包与私人投资组合的成本差异；运用无弹性市场假说模型估算大规模股权流入对估值和回报的影响；同时以Diamond-Geanakoplos框架进行对照分析；并基于功能财政与MMT框架进行财政影响评估。采用2005年式工资税剥离方案（每年约3300亿美元）作为模拟情景。
AI.findings: （1）精算上，社会保障是集退休、残疾、遗属和家庭保障于一体的通胀指数化保险包，无任何私人组合能以可比成本复制；（2）金融上，在无弹性市场假说下，每年3300亿美元的无弹性股权购买将推动估值十年内上升约28%，压缩前瞻回报近1个百分点/年，产生约15万亿美元资本利得且主要流入收入前10%家庭；（3）在Diamond-Geanakoplos框架下，债券发行抵消股权流入使价格波动极小，但股权风险溢价因风险在工作人口中分散而缩小，同样消除超额回报；（4）财政上，政府借款融资的个人账户不创造新国民储蓄。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将无弹性市场假说应用于社会保障私有化政策评估，量化了大规模无弹性股权购买对估值和分配的影响；（2）证明两大看似对立的金融框架（无弹性市场与经典一般均衡）在社会保障私有化问题上得出相同政策结论，增强了结论的稳健性；（3）将精算、金融和财政三个学科视角整合为统一的政策分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供基于量化证据的否定性评估，揭示私有化提案的回报假设在多个理论框架下均不成立；（2）指出私有化将产生约15万亿美元资本利得并集中流向顶层家庭，具有重大分配含义；（3）提出替代性政策建议——在保留完整社会保障体系基础上叠加自愿、低成本的附加储蓄工具，作为实现更广泛资产所有权的可行路径。

title: The Accountability-Authority Gap in Senior Leadership Mandates: Evidence from a Large-Scale Structural Decomposition of Job Descriptions

detail.title: The Accountability-Authority Gap in Senior Leadership Mandates: Evidence from a Large-Scale Structural Decomposition of Job Descriptions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of ETA Executive Transition Architecture, a firm whose professional practice applies the classification instrument described in this paper. The research programme, its design, and its findings preceded and inform that practice. No external party influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analysed publicly available job description documents. No human participants were involved and no personal data was collected; ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper reports findings from a structured empirical programme — the AIS-02 research programme — that classified 171 senior leadership job descriptions across 30+ countries and 25+ sectors to test whether a systematic structural pattern exists in how organisations design accountability and authority into senior roles. The central finding is that a single structural variable — the alignment between a role's accountability scope and its direct command authority — predicts mandate classification with zero exceptions across the full evidence base. Roles in which accountability exceeds direct authority (the accountability-authority gap) constitute a structurally distinct mandate type that requires a different operating architecture, governance design, and transition approach than roles in which accountability and authority are aligned. This pattern is domain-independent: it appears across commercial, operational, governance, technical, and advisory contexts without exception. The research programme employed an adversarial two-corpus design: a primary accumulation corpus of 81 JDs drawn from delivery and implementation contexts, followed by a hostile falsification corpus of 90 JDs drawn from nine domains specifically chosen to break the primary finding. Zero exceptions were produced across either corpus. Thirty-one independent organisations across the evidence base coined their own language for the same structural condition — evidence of independent recognition of a real and recurring phenomenon. The findings have direct implications for how organisations design senior leadership roles, how the labour market value of leadership capabilities is assessed, and how AI-assisted analysis of work structures can surface patterns invisible to individual human analysts working from limited samples. The methodology — large-scale structural decomposition of job description text using a theoretically grounded classification instrument — represents a novel application of task-based approaches to the analysis of senior role design, with potential applications to AI's impact on work, occupational change, and the structural transformation of senior labour markets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于AIS-02研究项目，对30多个国家、25个以上行业的171份高级领导职务描述进行结构化实证分析，发现一个关键结构性变量——职责范围与直接指挥权限的一致性——能以零例外预测职务授权类型。职责大于权限（"职责-权限缺口"）的职务构成一种结构性独特的授权类型，需要不同的运营架构、治理设计和过渡方式，且该模式跨领域普遍存在。
AI.research_question: 组织在设计高级领导职务时，是否存在系统性的结构模式，特别是关于职责（accountability）与权限（authority）如何被配置进高级职务中？
AI.motivation: 高级领导职务设计缺乏系统性证据基础。传统的职务分析和任务导向方法多聚焦于中低层职位，而对高级职务的职责-权限结构配置缺乏大规模、跨领域的实证检验，尤其是"职责大于权限"这一常见但未被理论化的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务导向的职务分析方法（task-based approaches）、职责-权限配置理论、职务授权分类理论。
AI.method: 采用对抗性双语料库设计：主积累语料库（81份来自交付与实施领域的职务描述）和敌意证伪语料库（90份来自九个专门为推翻主发现而选的领域的职务描述），共171份高级领导职务描述，覆盖30+国家和25+行业，使用理论驱动的分类工具进行大规模结构分解。
AI.findings: 职责范围与直接指挥权限的一致性这一单一结构变量，以零例外预测职务授权分类。职责超过权限的职务构成结构上独特的授权类型，需要不同的运营架构、治理设计和过渡方法。该模式跨商业、运营、治理、技术、咨询等各领域普遍存在。31个独立组织用各自的语言描述了同一结构条件，证明了该现象的真实性和独立识别性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于职责-权限对齐性的职务授权分类理论，将"职责-权限缺口"界定为一种结构上不同的职务授权类型；将任务导向方法创新性地应用于高级职务设计的结构分析，扩展了该理论框架的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计高级领导职务提供直接指导（不同授权类型的运营架构、治理设计和过渡方法）；影响劳动力市场对领导力能力的评估方式；展示AI辅助工作分析如何发现个人分析师在有限样本中无法看到的模式。

title: Beyond Linear Decision Rules: LLM-Guided Representation Discovery for Data-Driven Optimization
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, National University of Singapore (NUS) and

detail.title: Beyond Linear Decision Rules: LLM-Guided Representation Discovery for Data-Driven Optimization
detail.abstract: Stochastic optimization often restricts recourse decisions to affine parameterizations for computational tractability, potentially creating a substantial and irreducible approximation gap. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to discover richer problem-specific structures that can help narrow this gap. We propose Generative Stochastic Optimization (GenSO), a framework that uses LLMs to discover representations for adaptive recourse while preserving the rigor and tractability of optimization models. The key component of GenSO is the Generative Linear Decision Rule (GenLDR), in which recourse decisions are expressed as linear combinations of closed-form nonlinear basis functions generated by LLMs from problem structure and domain knowledge. Consequently, GenSO increases the expressiveness of recourse decisions without compromising tractability and interpretability. We establish finite-sample guarantees for fixed generated representations and further derive a performance bound under the assumption motivated by empirical scaling laws of LLMs. We evaluate GenSO on a multi-period newsvendor problem and a data center location problem with multi-period job scheduling calibrated using real-world datasets. Across both settings, GenSO consistently outperforms existing benchmarks in out-of-sample evaluations while uncovering interpretable nonlinear decision structures that are difficult to identify through conventional manual design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Generative Stochastic Optimization (GenSO)框架，利用大语言模型发现丰富的问题特定结构，通过Generative Linear Decision Rule (GenLDR)将随机优化中的自适应决策表示为LLM生成的闭式非线性基函数的线性组合，在保持可处理性和可解释性的同时提升决策表达力，并在多周期报童问题和数据中心选址问题中验证了优越性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型发现问题特定的非线性结构，以缩小随机优化中仿射决策规则所带来的不可约近似差距？
AI.motivation: 传统随机优化因计算可处理性通常将补偿决策限制为仿射参数化，这会产生显著且不可约的近似差距；LLM提供了发现更丰富问题特定结构的全新机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机优化、线性决策规则、生成式决策表示、LLM驱动的结构发现
AI.method: 提出GenSO框架，核心是GenLDR——将补偿决策表示为LLM从问题结构和领域知识生成的闭式非线性基函数的线性组合；建立固定生成表示的有限样本保证，并在LLM经验缩放律假设下推导性能界；通过多周期报童问题和多周期作业调度的数据中心选址问题进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 在两类问题中，GenSO在样本外评估中持续优于现有基准，并发现了通过传统人工设计难以识别的可解释非线性决策结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了固定生成表示的有限样本保证；在LLM经验缩放律假设下推导了性能界，为LLM增强的随机优化提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个可操作的GenSO框架，在不牺牲可处理性和可解释性的前提下提升随机优化决策质量；在真实数据集校准的多周期报童问题和数据中心选址问题中展示了实际效用。

title: From Data to Decisions: An AI/IT Intelligence Architecture for Asset-Light International Trading SMEs - The LAEXIM Model in Vietnam

detail.title: From Data to Decisions: An AI/IT Intelligence Architecture for Asset-Light International Trading SMEs - The LAEXIM Model in Vietnam
detail.abstract: Asset-light international trading intermediaries face a distinctive information-management challenge: they must coordinate heterogeneous data-commodity price feeds, supplier and shipment records, customs and phytosanitary documentation, multi-regime regulatory compliance and B2B customer credit exposure-across multiple product lines, without owning the physical infrastructure that traditionally anchors data collection in trading and logistics firms. This paper develops a conceptual informationtechnology and artificial-intelligence (AI) architecture for such firms, using LAEXIM-a proposed asset-light import-export and supply-chain-services start-up serving Vietnamese SME producers and B2B buyersas an illustrative applied case. Adapting a hospital-CIO-style requirements framework (scalability, interoperability, accuracy, regulatory compliance, real-time analytics and ethical governance) to the trading context, the paper specifies a data architecture in which supplier, logistics, compliance and market data are consolidated into a shared analytics layer supporting descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive decision-making. Drawing on peer-reviewed evidence that machine-learning models such as LSTM and gradient-boosted trees outperform classical statistical methods in agricultural commodity price forecasting, and that machine-learning credit-scoring models improve default prediction for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in supply chain finance, the paper argues that a modest, phased analytics investment can materially strengthen an asset-light trading firm's core value proposition: procurement timing, credit-risk management, compliance efficiency and customer retention. The paper maps this architecture onto LAEXIM's five revenue pillars and three-phase growth roadmap, showing how the firm's proposed Pillar 5 (Supply Chain Intelligence and Trade Consulting) can be understood as the natural productization of an internal AI/IT capability built to support Pillars 1-4. Implications for practitioners designing similar SME trading ventures in emerging agricultural economies and for future empirical validation, are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文针对轻资产国际贸易中介企业面临的信息管理挑战，提出了一种概念性的信息技术与人工智能架构，并以拟议中的越南初创企业LAEXIM作为应用案例，论证了分阶段的适度分析投资能够显著增强轻资产贸易企业的核心价值主张。
AI.research_question: 轻资产国际贸易中介企业如何设计信息技术与人工智能架构，以有效协调多源数据（价格、供应商、物流、合规、信用）并强化其核心竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 轻资产贸易中介企业不拥有传统上锚定数据收集的物理基础设施，却需协调异构的商品价格数据、供应商与货运记录、海关与植物检疫文件、多制度监管合规及B2B客户信用敞口，面临独特的信息管理挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴医院CIO式需求框架（可扩展性、互操作性、准确性、监管合规、实时分析、伦理治理），并援引机器学习模型在农产品价格预测和中小企业信用评分方面优于经典统计方法的同行评审证据。
AI.method: 概念性架构设计方法，以LAEXIM为说明性应用案例，将数据架构映射到公司的五大收入支柱和三个阶段增长路线图。
AI.findings: 分阶段、适度的分析投资可实质性强化轻资产贸易企业在采购时机、信用风险管理、合规效率和客户保留方面的核心价值主张；Pillar 5（供应链智能与贸易咨询）可被理解为内部AI/IT能力的自然产品化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将医院CIO需求框架适配到贸易情境，提出轻资产贸易企业共享分析层的数据架构概念，并将内部AI能力建设与外部咨询服务产品化之间的逻辑关系进行了理论化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在新兴农业经济体设计类似中小企业贸易风险投资的实践者提供架构蓝图和实施路径，并为未来实证验证提供方向。

title: The Innovation-Absorption Gap: How Artificial Intelligence Can Accelerate Idea Production Faster Than Complementary Institutions Adapt

detail.title: The Innovation-Absorption Gap: How Artificial Intelligence Can Accelerate Idea Production Faster Than Complementary Institutions Adapt
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence can reduce the time and expertise required to perform selected cognitive tasks, including writing, customer support, analysis, and parts of scientific research. It does not follow, however, that faster task performance produces proportionate gains in realized innovation or social welfare. Innovation is a multistage process: candidate ideas must be evaluated, empirically validated, financed, authorized, and implemented through organizations and physical infrastructure. This paper develops the concept of an innovation-absorption gap: a divergence between the rate at which new candidate solutions are produced and the rate at which complementary institutions can reliably select and deploy them. A simple bottleneck model shows that accelerating one stage has diminishing system-level value when another stage has relatively fixed capacity. Critically, when the marginal cost of generation falls toward zero, rational agents produce a volume of submissions that imposes congestion externalities on capacity-constrained downstream institutions, compounding the gap. The resulting flood of plausible but undifferentiated proposals also risks drowning out unconventional, extrapolative breakthroughs in favor of safer, interpolative recombinations of existing knowledge. Evidence from workplace experiments, AI-enabled science, federal grant review, academic peer review, patent examination, venture-capital screening, and energy infrastructure is consistent with this mechanism, although it does not yet establish an economy-wide causal effect. The framework yields five testable hypotheses concerning downstream attenuation, queue growth, domain heterogeneity, the rising value of evaluation expertise, and institutional co-adoption. It also changes the policy question. The objective should not be acceleration everywhere, but balanced capacity: faster evaluation where it can be made auditable, expanded validation and high-throughput testing infrastructure where those are binding, reformed intellectual-property processing, and labor-market institutions capable of managing both complementarity and displacement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"创新吸收缺口"概念，指新候选解决方案的产生速度与互补性机构筛选、部署它们的能力之间存在落差。即使AI加速了任务执行，系统层面的创新和社会福利收益也可能因下游机构容量受限而大打折扣。
AI.research_question: AI加速认知任务执行后，为什么未必带来成比例的创新和社会福利增长？制度层面的瓶颈如何制约AI驱动的创新潜力释放？
AI.motivation: 现有讨论多聚焦于AI如何加速任务执行，但忽视了创新是多阶段过程这一事实。候选想法仍需经过评估、实证验证、融资、授权和组织实施等环节，这些下游机构的容量可能构成瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 瓶颈模型（bottleneck model）、创新吸收缺口概念、拥挤外部性理论
AI.method: 理论建模（瓶颈模型）+ 多领域证据综合（工作场所实验、AI科研、联邦资助评审、学术同行评审、专利审查、风险投资筛选、能源基础设施）+ 提出五个可检验假说
AI.findings: 当AI使生成边际成本趋近于零时，理性行为者会产生大量提交物，对容量受限的下游机构造成拥挤外部性，加剧创新吸收缺口。此外，大量看似合理但缺乏差异化的提案可能淹没非传统的突破性想法，偏向安全的内插式知识重组。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并系统阐述了"创新吸收缺口"这一新概念；构建了瓶颈模型展示单阶段加速的系统级边际价值递减；将拥挤外部性引入创新过程分析；提出五个可检验假说和新的政策框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 改变政策问题导向：目标不应是全面加速，而是平衡容量——在可审计处加快评估、扩展验证和高通量测试基础设施、改革知识产权处理流程、建设能兼顾互补性与替代的劳动力市场制度。

title: Advanced Numerical Methods for American Option Pricing: A Comparative Study of Recombining Lattices and Regression-Based Monte Carlo
affiliations: and North Carolina State University

detail.title: Advanced Numerical Methods for American Option Pricing: A Comparative Study of Recombining Lattices and Regression-Based Monte Carlo
detail.abstract: This research paper presents a comparative study of advanced numerical methods for pricing American options, with a focus on recombining lattice models (Binomial and Trinomial Trees) and regression-based Monte Carlo techniques (Least Squares Monte Carlo, LSM). The early exercise feature of American options introduces path dependencies, necessitating sophisticated numerical approaches for accurate valuation. The Binomial Tree model, introduced by Cox, Ross, and Rubinstein, provides a structured yet computationally intensive framework based on discrete-time recombining lattices. The Trinomial Tree model, by incorporating an intermediate state, enhances numerical stability and convergence efficiency. In contrast, the LSM method, pioneered by Longstaff and Schwartz, leverages Monte Carlo simulations with regression-based approximations to estimate conditional expectations efficiently, offering scalability for high-dimensional problems. This study evaluates these methodologies in terms of convergence properties, computational complexity, and accuracy in estimating early exercise boundaries. By providing a comparative assessment of these approaches, we offer insights into the trade-offs between discretization-based and simulation-based techniques, aiding practitioners and researchers in selecting optimal pricing methodologies for American derivatives in Financial Engineering and Quantitative Finance.

AI.tldr: 本文对美式期权定价的先进数值方法进行了比较研究，重点评估了重组格模型（二叉树和三叉树）与基于回归的蒙特卡洛方法（最小二乘蒙特卡洛，LSM）在收敛性、计算复杂度和早期行权边界估计准确性方面的表现。
AI.research_question: 不同数值方法（二叉树、三叉树和LSM）在美式期权定价中的比较评估如何？它们各自在收敛性、计算复杂度和早期行权边界估计方面有何优劣？
AI.motivation: 美式期权的早期行权特征引入了路径依赖性，需要复杂的数值方法进行精确估值。然而，不同方法之间存在显著的权衡，需要系统性的比较分析以帮助实践者和研究者选择最优定价方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散时间重组格模型的二叉树模型（Cox, Ross, Rubinstein提出）、三叉树模型，以及基于回归的蒙特卡洛模拟方法（Longstaff-Schwartz的LSM方法）。
AI.method: 对比研究法：从收敛性质、计算复杂度和早期行权边界估计准确性三个维度，对二叉树、三叉树和LSM三种数值方法进行系统比较分析。
AI.findings: 二叉树模型提供结构化框架但计算密集；三叉树模型通过引入中间状态增强了数值稳定性和收敛效率；LSM方法利用回归近似条件期望，在高维问题中具有可扩展性优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融工程和数量金融领域提供了离散化方法与模拟方法之间权衡的洞见，帮助理解不同数值技术在处理美式期权定价中的理论优势与局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者和研究者选择美式衍生品定价方法提供了决策参考，有助于根据具体问题特征（如维度、精度需求和计算资源）选择最优的定价方法。

title: Conflict, Coexistence, or Complementarity: Industrial Policy and Competition Law in Comparative Perspective

detail.title: Conflict, Coexistence, or Complementarity: Industrial Policy and Competition Law in Comparative Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the relationship between industrial policy and competition law, traditionally viewed as a zero-sum trade-off. We synthesize recent economic and legal scholarship and analyze comparative cases from Europe, the United States, Japan, China, and South Korea. We identify two core tensions that structure the debate, static versus dynamic efficiency and national champions versus consumer welfare, and show how both can be reconciled through institutional design. We develop a three-dimensional analytical framework that classifies jurisdictions along a spectrum from conflict through coexistence to complementarity. Applying this framework, we find that complementarity does not arise automatically but requires deliberate policy design, particularly industrial strategies that support multiple firms through transparent mechanisms and competition enforcement that accounts for dynamic efficiency. When these conditions are met, industrial policy and competition law can be mutually reinforcing.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视产业政策与竞争法之间的关系，传统观点认为二者是零和博弈。通过综合近期经济学与法学研究，并比较欧洲、美国、日本、中国和韩国的案例，作者识别出两大核心张力（静态效率与动态效率、国家冠军与消费者福利），并论证二者可通过制度设计实现调和。文章提出一个三维分析框架，将各国法律体系按从冲突到共存再到互补的光谱进行分类，发现互补性不会自动产生，而需要审慎的政策设计，特别是通过透明机制支持多企业的产业战略以及考虑动态效率的竞争执法。
AI.research_question: 产业政策与竞争法之间是否必然存在零和博弈的关系？二者能否通过制度设计实现互补与相互强化？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将产业政策与竞争法视为不可调和的矛盾，但现实中国家在实践中常同时运用两种工具，且各国实践经验差异显著。作者希望超越简单的二元对立，通过比较案例和制度分析探索二者共存的可能路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于制度设计理论，结合静态效率与动态效率的效率经济学框架、国家冠军与消费者福利的福利经济学框架，构建三维分析框架，将各国制度安排区分为冲突、共存与互补三种类型。
AI.method: 综合文献综述与比较案例分析法，对欧洲、美国、日本、中国、韩国五个司法辖区的产业政策与竞争法实践进行系统比较，并在此基础上构建分类框架。
AI.findings: 产业政策与竞争法的互补性不会自发产生，需要满足两个关键条件：（1）产业战略通过透明机制支持多家企业而非单一国家冠军；（2）竞争执法需考量动态效率而非仅关注静态效率。当这些条件满足时，二者可以相互强化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个三维分析框架替代传统的零和博弈二元论，将产业政策与竞争法的关系概念化为冲突—共存—互补的光谱，为制度设计研究提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的制度设计建议，即在产业政策中采用透明机制支持多企业竞争，在竞争执法中纳入动态效率考量，以促进产业政策与竞争法的良性互动。

title: Operator Squared - When Infrastructure Appraisal Becomes an Operator of Governance
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Operator Squared - When Infrastructure Appraisal Becomes an Operator of Governance
detail.abstract: Infrastructure is first a physical object. It has geometry, capacity, condition, cost and material form. It is therefore an object of measurement. Yet infrastructure also changes the possibilities available to individuals and society. It changes where people can travel, whom they can reach, what they can produce, how quickly they can coordinate and what futures they consider possible. Through repeated use, these altered possibilities reshape routines, expectations, norms and patterns of collective behaviour. The physical object therefore induces an operator on the behavioural and dispositional order of society. Layered Operator Appraisal was developed in response to this first transformation. It argued that infrastructure appraisal must move beyond the measurement of the physical object and examine the transformations generated across society, market and state. This paper examines a second transformation. When operator-based appraisal reveals discontinuities, value cliffs or structural weaknesses, it may force changes in the management and governance platform through which infrastructure is conceived and created. The appraisal framework then ceases to be only a means of observation. It becomes an operator on governance. The paper calls this reflexive structure 'Operator Squared'. The term does not denote the repeated application of one identical mathematical operator. It describes the reappearance of the operator principle at a higher order. At the first level, a physical infrastructure object induces a transformation of the social and behavioural order. At the second level, the operator-based appraisal framework induces a transformation of the governance order that created the physical object. Infrastructure shapes society. Appraisal reshapes governance. Governance then creates a different infrastructure object, completing a reflexive loop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Operator Squared"（平方算子）概念，指出基础设施评估框架不仅是对物理对象的测量，更是对治理平台的再操作——第一层是基础设施改变社会行为秩序，第二层是评估框架改变治理秩序，形成反思性闭环。
AI.research_question: 基础设施的评估框架如何从观察工具转变为重塑治理结构的"算子"？这一二阶转型的机制与含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有研究（如分层算子评估Layered Operator Appraisal）关注基础设施作为物理对象如何改变社会行为秩序，但未深入考察评估框架本身如何反身性地改变治理平台，进而影响未来基础设施的创造方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"算子"（operator）概念为核心：第一层算子指物理基础设施对社会行为与制度秩序产生的变换；第二层算子指评估框架对治理秩序产生的变换，形成"Operator Squared"的反思性结构。
AI.method: 概念性/理论分析论文，通过逻辑推演构建"Operator Squared"的理论框架，分析基础设施—评估—治理三者间的递归关系。
AI.findings: 揭示了评估框架的双重角色：既是观察工具，也是治理的算子。当评估揭示出价值断崖或结构性弱点时，会倒逼管理治理平台变革，从而改变未来基础设施的构思与创造，形成反思性闭环。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"Operator Squared"新概念，将基础设施评估理论从物理测量拓展到治理层面，建立了"基础设施→社会→评估→治理→基础设施"的递归理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基础设施评估实践提供警示：评估框架本身会影响治理决策，决策者应意识到评估体系的治理效应，避免评估工具的路径依赖。

title: Position: Strategic Resilience Requires the Targeted Maintenance of Human Technical Capacities
affiliations: and Northeastern University

detail.title: Position: Strategic Resilience Requires the Targeted Maintenance of Human Technical Capacities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest
declarations.funderStatement: David Atkinson is supported by the National Science Foundation CISE Graduate Fellowship under Grant No. 2313998

publicationDetails.detailsText: Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026.

detail.abstract: As AI systems are deployed across critical infrastructural, decision-making, and economic domains, two trends compound to create a structural risk: humans lose proficiency in tasks delegated to AI (deskilling), and AI develops capabilities which exceed current human expertise (supersession). Existing scholarship on resilience to advanced AI does not address this risk as a strategic problem, potentially resulting in human disempowerment vis-à-vis AI. In this paper, we address the technical requirements behind strategic resilience-the ability of a human society to maintain power over critical systems relative to advanced AI-and propose one productive avenue for future research: a Strategic Human Capacity Reserve (SHCR). The SHCR requires further study along three critical dimensions: threat modeling, skill measurement, and policy development.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出一个结构性风险：随着AI系统部署于关键基础设施和决策领域，人类因任务委托AI而技能退化（deskilling），同时AI能力超越人类专家水平（supersession）。现有关于AI韧性的研究未将此视为战略问题，可能导致人类相对于AI的失权。作者提出"战略人类能力储备"（SHCR）作为未来研究方向，需从威胁建模、技能测量和政策制定三个维度展开研究。
AI.research_question: 人类社会如何在面对先进AI时维持对关键系统的控制权？即"战略韧性"（strategic resilience）的技术要求是什么？
AI.motivation: 两个趋势叠加构成结构性风险：(1)人类将任务委托给AI后技能退化（deskilling）；(2)AI能力超越现有人类专业知识（supersession）。现有AI韧性研究未将此作为战略问题处理，可能导致人类相对AI的失权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能退化理论（deskilling）与AI能力超越（supersession）的双重趋势框架，以及"战略韧性"概念——人类社会相对于先进AI维持对关键系统权力的能力。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，识别结构性风险并提出战略研究议程，具体提出"战略人类能力储备"（SHCR）框架，并从三个维度（威胁建模、技能测量、政策制定）勾勒未来研究方向。
AI.findings: 现有AI韧性研究忽略了人类技能退化与AI能力超越的双重累积风险；提出SHCR作为维护人类战略韧性的可行研究路径，需沿威胁建模、技能测量和政策开发三个维度深化研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人类技能退化与AI能力超越问题重新框定为战略安全问题，提出"战略韧性"概念，填补了现有AI韧性研究在人类权力维持方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供SHCR框架作为具体研究方向，强调需要开发技能测量工具和威胁模型，以保障关键基础设施和决策领域中人类对AI的相对控制权。

title: Paradigm Choice and Methodological Reflexivity in Social Science Research: A Reflexive Paradigm Alignment Framework for Public Policy and Management Inquiry

detail.title: Paradigm Choice and Methodological Reflexivity in Social Science Research: A Reflexive Paradigm Alignment Framework for Public Policy and Management Inquiry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Research philosophy shapes problem definition, evidentiary choice, interpretation, and the credibility of knowledge claims, yet it is often reduced to a declaratory label in methodology sections. This article argues that paradigm choice is better treated as reflexive alignment than as allegiance to a philosophical camp. Drawing together positivist and postpositivist, critical realist, interpretivist, pragmatic, mixed methods, and critical or transformative traditions, it identifies five recurring forms of misalignment: label-design, claim-evidence, method-inference, qualitycriteria, and value-position mismatches. Its main contribution is the Reflexive Paradigm Alignment Framework (RPAF), a five-stage diagnostic instrument linking the nature of the phenomenon, the knowledge claim, the logic of inquiry, the evidence and methods, and the criteria for quality, values, and reporting. An illustrative public-policy application shows how the framework can be used to justify design choices, integrate different forms of evidence, and delimit the claims a study can reasonably make. The article concludes that methodological rigour depends less on paradigm orthodoxy than on transparent reasoning and coherence among the research problem, evidentiary strategy, inferential claims, and standards of quality.

AI.tldr: 本文主张研究范式的选择应被视为"反思性对齐"而非对某一哲学阵营的效忠。作者整合了实证主义、后实证主义、批判实在论、解释主义、实用主义、混合方法及批判/变革传统，识别出五种常见的错位形式，并提出"反思性范式对齐框架"（RPAF），这是一个五阶段的诊断工具，用于连接现象本质、知识主张、探究逻辑、证据与方法以及质量标准、价值观和报告标准。文章通过一个公共政策应用的示例展示了该框架的实际用途，并得出结论：方法论的严谨性更多取决于研究问题、证据策略、推论主张和质量标准之间的透明推理与一致性，而非范式的正统性。
AI.research_question: 研究范式选择应如何在方法论实践中被真正理解和运用？如何系统性地诊断和纠正研究中的范式错位问题？
AI.motivation: 研究哲学虽然深刻影响问题界定、证据选择、解释方式和知识主张的可信度，但在方法论章节中往往被简化为一个声明性的标签。作者认为需要对范式选择进行更深入的理论化处理，将其从哲学阵营的归属问题转化为研究设计中的反思性对齐问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了实证主义与后实证主义、批判实在论、解释主义、实用主义、混合方法、批判/变革传统等多种研究范式传统，提出五种错位类型：标签-设计错位、主张-证据错位、方法-推论错位、质量标准错位、价值立场错位。
AI.method: 理论概念构建与框架开发。通过系统整合多种研究范式传统，识别常见的范式错位类型，构建五阶段的反思性范式对齐框架（RPAF），并通过一个说明性的公共政策应用案例来展示框架的实际使用方式。
AI.findings: （1）识别出五种常见的范式错位形式：标签-设计错位、主张-证据错位、方法-推论错位、质量标准错位和价值立场错位；（2）提出RPAF五阶段诊断框架，涵盖现象本质、知识主张、探究逻辑、证据与方法、质量标准/价值观/报告标准；（3）通过公共政策案例展示了框架可用于论证设计选择、整合不同形式的证据，以及界定研究可以合理提出的主张范围；（4）得出结论：方法论严谨性取决于透明推理和一致性，而非范式正统性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将范式选择从"哲学阵营归属"重新概念化为"反思性对齐"过程，提出了系统性的RPAF诊断框架，为研究设计中范式与方法的一致性提供了可操作的理论工具，超越了传统上将范式视为宣言性标签的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了一套实用的五阶段诊断工具，帮助其在研究设计中系统性地检查和纠正五种范式错位问题，增强方法论推理的透明性和研究设计的连贯性，对学术写作、审稿评估以及跨范式证据整合具有直接的实践指导价值。

title: Hidden Bottlenecks in the Rare Earth Supply Chain: Myanmar, China's Processing Hub, and Multilayer Network Vulnerability

detail.title: Hidden Bottlenecks in the Rare Earth Supply Chain: Myanmar, China's Processing Hub, and Multilayer Network Vulnerability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary trade data (BACI HS12 V202601, CEPII) and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. No ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Rare earth supply-chain risk is usually measured through direct import dependence, supplier concentration, and mining production shares. These measures can miss indirect bottlenecks that operate through processing hubs. This paper develops a multilayer network framework to distinguish direct import dependence from second-order feedstock dependence in the global rare earth supply chain. Using CEPII BACI bilateral trade data for upstream ores, midstream compounds, and permanent magnets over 2012-2024, the analysis shows that midstream processing centrality, rather than upstream mining centrality or mining production volume, is the strongest predictor of structural bargaining power. The paper identifies Myanmar as a hidden second-order bottleneck: peaked at 72.4 percent in 2020 and stood at 66.8 percent in 2023, so a Myanmar disruption can propagate through China's processing hub to downstream importers. Shock simulations show that this disruption affects 40 importing economies, while MSP-aligned supply expansion reduces vulnerability only where it creates actual alternative sourcing relationships. The findings suggest that rare earth resilience policy should monitor indirect feedstock dependencies and processing capacity, not only direct import shares or mining concentration.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多层网络框架来区分稀土供应链中的直接进口依赖与二阶原料依赖，发现中游加工中心度而非上游采矿中心度是结构性议价能力的最强预测因子，并识别出缅甸作为隐藏的二阶瓶颈节点。
AI.research_question: 在全球稀土供应链中，如何区分直接进口依赖与二阶原料依赖？哪个环节的中心度最能预测结构性议价能力？
AI.motivation: 传统稀土供应链风险度量方法（直接进口依赖、供应商集中度、采矿产量份额）可能遗漏通过加工枢纽运作的间接瓶颈，需要更全面的网络分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层网络框架（multilayer network framework），区分直接进口依赖和二阶原料依赖（second-order feedstock dependence）
AI.method: 使用CEPII BACI双边贸易数据（2012-2024年），涵盖上游矿石、中游化合物和永磁体三个层次，构建多层网络并进行冲击模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）中游加工中心度而非上游采矿中心度或采矿产量是结构性议价能力的最强预测因子；（2）缅甸被识别为隐藏的二阶瓶颈，2020年达72.4%，2023年为66.8%；（3）缅甸供应中断可影响40个进口经济体；（4）MSP对齐的供应扩张仅在创造实际替代采购关系时才降低脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多层网络框架引入稀土供应链风险分析，超越传统的直接进口依赖度量，提出二阶原料依赖和加工枢纽中心度作为新的理论分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稀土韧性政策提供指导：应监控间接原料依赖和加工能力，而非仅关注直接进口份额或采矿集中度；识别缅甸为关键瓶颈节点，为供应链多元化策略提供依据。

title: From Stockouts to Smart Forecasts: Leveraging Unsupervised Machine Learning for Micro-Operational Efficiency in Retail
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Stockouts to Smart Forecasts: Leveraging Unsupervised Machine Learning for Micro-Operational Efficiency in Retail

keywords: DBSCAN (Density Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise)

detail.abstract: This research presents a case base implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in supply chain optimization at a single IKEA retail store. The project originated from operational challenges observed at the store level, where inaccuracies in demand forecasting frequently led to customer order rejections due to missing or incompatible assembly components. These issues resulted in lost sales, excess inventory, and elevated emergency shipping costs. Traditional statistical forecasting models, such as moving averages and seasonality adjustments, were found insufficient to handle the complexities of SKU level demand variability, particularly during promotional campaigns and seasonal surges. To address this problem, I conducted an in-depth data analysis of 500 high volume SKUs over a 12-month period, incorporating sales history, inventory movements, lead times, and quality records. Using this dataset, a hybrid analytics framework was developed, integrating descriptive statistics, forecast error analysis, and unsupervised machine learning models including Isolation Forest, One Class Support Vector Machine (SVM), and DBSCAN. These models identified anomalies in inventory behaviour and revealed systemic causes of forecasting failures, such as overlooked lead time fluctuations and promotion driven demand spikes. After the implementation of the AI model, the store experienced a notable 5.7% rise in forecast acceptance, improving from 91.8% to 97.5%, along with a 15% decrease in the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Stockout incidents declined by 21%, while emergency shipments were reduced by 27%. Additionally, customer returns caused by mismatched products saw a marked decline. Beyond enhancing key operational performance indicators, the AI-driven strategy equipped planners with advanced decision-support tools, improving forecast transparency and enabling more effective detection of anomalies. This case study demonstrates that AI can be effectively applied at a micro-operational level to solve localized supply chain inefficiencies. The results validate the strategic benefit of embedding machine learning in traditional forecasting workflows and highlight the potential for scalability across multiple retail nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个在宜家单店层面实施人工智能（AI）进行供应链优化的案例研究。针对需求预测不准确导致的订单拒收、库存过剩和紧急运输成本上升等问题，作者利用500个高销量SKU的12个月数据，构建了结合描述性统计、预测误差分析与无监督机器学习（Isolation Forest、One Class SVM、DBSCAN）的混合分析框架，成功识别了库存行为异常和预测失败的系统性原因。实施后预测接受率提升5.7%、MAPE降低15%、缺货减少21%、紧急运输减少27%。
AI.research_question: 如何将人工智能技术应用于单店层面的供应链优化，以解决SKU级需求预测不准确所导致的运营效率低下问题？
AI.motivation: 传统统计预测模型（如移动平均和季节性调整）无法应对SKU级需求变动的复杂性，尤其是在促销活动和季节性高峰期间，导致客户订单被拒、销售损失、库存过剩和紧急运输成本上升等运营问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于需求预测理论与异常检测理论，运用混合分析框架整合描述性统计、预测误差分析以及无监督机器学习算法（Isolation Forest、One Class SVM、DBSCAN）进行供应链优化。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，对宜家某单店的500个高销量SKU进行为期12个月的数据分析，涵盖销售历史、库存变动、前置时间和质量记录，构建混合分析框架并实施AI模型。
AI.findings: 实施AI模型后，预测接受率从91.8%提升至97.5%（提升5.7%），MAPE降低15%，缺货事件减少21%，紧急运输减少27%，客户因产品不匹配导致的退货显著下降，同时增强了规划者的决策支持和异常检测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了AI在微观运营层面解决局部供应链低效问题的有效性，证明了将机器学习嵌入传统预测工作流的战略价值，为供应链AI应用提供了从理论到实践的场景化证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售企业提供了可复制的AI驱动供应链优化方案，通过异常检测和预测改进显著提升关键运营绩效指标（KPI），并展示了跨多个零售节点进行规模化应用的可能性。

title: OMAC International's Argument vs. Kumar et al. and the Broader Shadow-Education Literature, with AKU-IED as Supporting Evidence

detail.title: OMAC International's Argument vs. Kumar et al. and the Broader Shadow-Education Literature, with AKU-IED as Supporting Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest related to this work
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants or patient data; all illustrative scenarios are hypothetical, and all empirical claims are drawn from previously published sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that private tuition, in its ordinary and routine form, is not evidence of a quality gap in formal schooling but is itself a proactive instrument of quality assurance. ISO 9001:2015's risk-based thinking model requires quality management systems to determine risks that could affect their ability to achieve intended results and to plan actions that prevent or reduce undesired effects before those effects occur; a proactive, anticipatory orientation is therefore built into the definition of quality assurance itself, not an admission that the system has already failed. ISO 31000:2018 supplies the operative term for such proactive actions: control, defined at clause 3.8 as any process, policy, device, practice, or other actions that modify risk. Read together, these standards support classifying regular tuition as a control activity that forms part of a system's ordinary quality assurance apparatus, addressing an unavoidable risk rather than signalling institutional underperformance. This reclassification also resolves, as a secondary matter, the loose application of the quality-management term "rework" to tuition: rework, under ISO 9000:2015, presupposes a confirmed nonconforming output, a condition regular tuition does not meet. Central to the paper's argument is a distinction between institutional failure and individual failure: formal schooling can fail as a system-for example, by withholding curriculum, as documented in Pakistan's shadow-education literature-but the ordinary risk that an individual student forgets or fails to consolidate material that was correctly taught is a humanfactor risk, not an institutional one, comparable to the reason pilots train in flight simulators after complete academy instruction. Evidence from Pakistan, including a study from the Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED) and an economic analysis of Punjab's tuition market, is examined as the genuine exception: cases where teachers deliberately withhold curriculum delivery constitute an actual institutional defect, distinct from the ordinary tuition this paper defends as quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文主张常规私人补习并非正规学校教育质量差距的证据，而是质量保证的主动工具。通过ISO 9001:2015的基于风险思维模型和ISO 31000:2018的"控制"概念，论文将常规补习重新归类为质量保证体系中的控制活动，区别于真正的制度缺陷（如巴基斯坦教师故意隐瞒课程内容的情况）。
AI.research_question: 常规私人补习应被如何定性——是正规教育系统质量失败的表现，还是质量保证体系中的主动控制工具？
AI.motivation: 现有文献常将私人补习视为对正规学校教育质量差距的回应或信号。本文旨在挑战这一默认假设，从质量管理标准（ISO 9001:2015和ISO 31000:2018）的角度论证常规补习是质量保证的正当组成部分，而非制度失败的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISO 9001:2015的基于风险思维模型（要求质量管理系统前瞻性地识别风险并采取预防措施）；ISO 31000:2018中"控制"的定义（任何修改风险的过程、政策、装置、实践或其他行动）；ISO 9000:2015中"返工"的概念（预设已确认的不合格输出）。
AI.method: 概念分析与规范性论证，结合质量管理标准（ISO系列）的文本解释，并辅以巴基斯坦影子教育文献（AKU-IED研究及旁遮普补习市场经济分析）作为例外案例的实证参照。
AI.findings: 常规补习应被分类为质量保证体系中的控制活动，针对的是不可避免的人类因素风险（如学生遗忘或未能巩固已正确教授的内容），而非制度绩效不佳的信号。同时，将"返工"一词用于常规补习属于误用，因为返工预设了已确认的不合格产出。真正的制度失败（如教师故意隐瞒课程）是罕见的例外，与常规补习有本质区别。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将国际质量管理标准（ISO 9001/31000/9000系列）的概念框架系统应用于私人补习的定性分析，提出制度失败与个人失败的区分，重新定义了补习在质量保证体系中的概念位置。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育管理者提供概念工具来区分常规补习与真正的制度缺陷，避免将个人学习风险误判为学校质量失败，从而更准确地评估教育系统绩效并制定相应的监管政策。

title: Constrained Efficiency and Capital Accumulation in Japan
affiliations: University of Southern California - Department of Finance and Business Economics and

detail.title: Constrained Efficiency and Capital Accumulation in Japan
detail.abstract: This paper asks whether Japan's competitive equilibrium holds too much or too little capital relative to the benchmark a constrained planner would choose using the same incomplete asset markets but internalizing the factor-price externality from aggregate saving. Our setup follows the constrained-efficiency framework of Dávila, Hong, Krusell, and Ríos-Rull (2012). Japan's relatively high capital-output ratio and compressed earnings distribution make the sign of the inefficiency ambiguous ex ante. We find that the market substantially underaccumulates capital: the constrained-efficient capital stock is 2.14 times the market level, and the transition-inclusive consumption-equivalent welfare gain is 4.5 percent, compared with 20.7 percent under a naive steady-state comparison. The driving force is the factor-income composition of the lower tail of the consumption distribution. Approximately 16 percent of Japanese households hold financial wealth of less than one month of average earnings and sit near the bottom of the consumption distribution-poor hand-to-mouth workers whose near-zero assets and positive labor income make their contribution to the externality strongly positive. The result is robust to alternative treatments of the lower tail of the wealth distribution, and to the welfare criterion: a planner whose Pareto weights sit halfway between the utilitarian benchmark and the Negishi weights that rationalize the market allocation still chooses a capital stock 1.4 times the market level. The policy prescription is a subsidy on the gross return to saving averaging about six percentage points, consistent with the direction of Japan's expanded tax-advantaged saving program-though a uniform flat version of the subsidy, financed out of labor income, reverses both the welfare gain and its incidence, showing that the terminal capital stock alone is not sufficient: implementation and financing are first-order. The reform is progressive in incidence despite operating through capital markets: approximately 80 percent of households gain through higher wages, with the bottom half gaining about eight percent in consumption-equivalent terms, while the top one percent loses through the lower return on accumulated wealth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了日本的竞争均衡相对于约束最优规划者（在相同不完全资产市场下内生化要素价格外部性）是否持有过多或过少的资本。研究发现市场显著资本积累不足：约束有效的资本存量是市场水平的2.14倍，考虑转型的消费等价福利收益为4.5%。驱动力来自消费分布底层的要素收入构成——约16%的日本家庭为穷困的手到口工人（低资产、正劳动收入），其对外部性的贡献强烈为正。其政策含义是对储蓄总回报进行平均约6个百分点的补贴。
AI.research_question: 在不完全资产市场的约束有效框架下，日本的竞争均衡相对于约束最优规划者视角是资本积累过剩还是不足？
AI.motivation: 日本相对较高的资本产出比和压缩的收入分配使效率低下的方向在事前是模糊的。这一问题对评估日本资本积累的配置效率和储蓄政策具有重要含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遵循Dávila, Hong, Krusell, and Ríos-Rull (2012)的约束效率框架，在相同的不完全资产市场中内生化总量储蓄的要素价格外部性。
AI.method: 采用约束效率理论框架，构建日本的不完全市场异质代理人模型，比较竞争均衡与约束有效规划的资本积累水平，并进行福利分析和政策实验。
AI.findings: 市场显著资本积累不足：约束有效资本存量是市场水平的2.14倍；考虑转型的消费等价福利收益为4.5%（而天真稳态比较为20.7%）。约16%的日本家庭为资产极低的手到口工人，其正劳动收入使外部性贡献强烈为正。约束有效方案下资本存量仍为市场的1.4倍。政策建议为对储蓄总回报补贴约6个百分点，但统一平坦补贴（以劳动收入融资）会逆转福利收益和归宿。
AI.theory_contributions: 将约束效率框架应用于日本经济，阐明即使在高资本产出比经济中，市场仍可能资本积累不足；识别了消费分布低尾部的要素收入构成作为要素价格外部性强度的决定性因素；并证明福利标准（功利主义vs Negishi权重）的稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本扩大税收优惠储蓄计划提供理论支持，指出补贴方向与现有政策一致；强调政策实施和融资方式（劳动收入融资的均匀补贴会逆转福利效果）是一阶重要问题；揭示改革虽通过资本市场运作但具有进步性分配效应（约80%家庭通过更高工资获益，底层一半获得约8%的消费等价提升，最顶层1%因财富回报下降而受损）。

title: Central Bank Uncertainty and Long-Run Financial Volatility: Evidence from FOMC Communication and a GARCH-MIDAS Framework
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Central Bank Uncertainty and Long-Run Financial Volatility: Evidence from FOMC Communication and a GARCH-MIDAS Framework
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the tone of Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements is associated with the long-run component of equity market volatility. We construct a dataset of 89 FOMC post-meeting statements issued between January 2015 and June 2026 and score each statement along three textual dimensions: a Loughran-McDonald (LM) net sentiment measure, a phrase-based hawkish-dovish index, and an uncertainty ratio based on hedging language. Average LM net sentiment is 3.08% (SD = 1.32%), while the HD index averages -0.558 (SD = 0.528), indicating a persistent dovish tilt over the sample. GARCH-MIDAS estimates link each dimension to the long-run variance component of daily S&P 500 returns. In the full sample, the Uncertainty Ratio is positively associated with long-run variance (theta-hat = 0.197, SE = 0.061, p = 0.001), implying that a one-standard-deviation increase in linguistic uncertainty is associated with a 21.7% increase in the long-run variance component. The HD loading is insignificant, and the LM loading becomes insignificant when jointly modeled with uncertainty; the uncertainty loading remains significant in that joint specification (p = 0.013). Sub-sample estimates are imprecise and do not preserve the full-sample uncertainty sign, so the result should be interpreted as an in-sample association rather than a stable structural or causal effect. The framework is relevant to international money and finance because FOMC communication has global reach, although the present evidence is confined to U.S. equity returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究FOMC声明语气与股市长期波动成分之间的关联。通过对2015年1月至2026年6月间89份FOMC会后声明进行文本分析（LM净情绪、鹰鸽指数、不确定性比率三个维度），并运用GARCH-MIDAS模型，发现语言不确定性比率与标普500日收益率的长期方差成分显著正相关，而鹰鸽指数和LM情绪在联合模型中不显著。但子样本估计不精确，结果应被视为样本内关联而非稳定的结构性或因果效应。
AI.research_question: FOMC声明的语气（情绪、鹰鸽倾向、不确定性）是否与股市长期波动成分相关联？
AI.motivation: FOMC沟通具有全球影响力，但现有研究较少将央行声明的具体文本特征（而非简单的事件本身）与股市长期波动成分联系起来。理解语言风格如何影响市场波动对国际货币金融具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: GARCH-MIDAS模型（将长期波动成分与短期波动分离）；Loughran-McDonald财务文本情绪分析方法；基于措辞的鹰鸽指数；基于对冲语言的不确定性比率。
AI.method: 构建89份FOMC会后声明的文本特征数据集（LM净情绪、鹰鸽指数、不确定性比率），运用GARCH-MIDAS模型将三个文本维度与标普500日收益率的长期方差成分进行回归关联分析，并进行了全样本和子样本估计。
AI.findings: 不确定性比率与长期方差显著正相关（theta-hat=0.197, SE=0.061, p=0.001），语言不确定性每增加一个标准差，长期方差成分约增加21.7%。鹰鸽指数加载不显著，LM情绪在联合模型中不显著，但不确定性在联合模型中仍显著（p=0.013）。子样本估计不精确且未能保持全样本的不确定性符号。
AI.theory_contributions: 将央行沟通的文本细粒度特征（特别是语言不确定性）与股市长期波动成分建立联系，拓展了货币政策沟通与金融市场波动关系的理论理解，表明语言不确定性是比单纯情绪或鹰鸽倾向更相关的波动驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行决策者和市场参与者提供参考：FOMC声明的语言不确定性（而非单纯的鹰鸽立场）可能是影响股市长期波动的重要沟通因素；也为央行改善沟通策略、降低语言歧义提供了实证依据。

title: When The Picture Still Authorises Action: Toward a Research Programme on the Epistemic Integrity of Decision Systems over Time
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When The Picture Still Authorises Action: Toward a Research Programme on the Epistemic Integrity of Decision Systems over Time

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual paper did not involve human participants, animals, personal data, or an empirical study requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Institutions routinely continue to act on decisions made under earlier conditions. An original decision may have been reasonable, yet the evidence, assumptions, object, scope or authority conditions supporting continued reliance may later change. Existing work in Situation Awareness, Human Factors, organisational sensemaking, assurance, decision provenance, organisational memory, change control, governance and runtime authorisation addresses important components of this problem. What remains insufficiently integrated is the institution-level question of whether continued reliance on a specific prior decision D0 remains justified now. This paper defines the epistemic integrity of decision systems over time as a provisional research object and develops a cross-layer architecture linking current evidence, assumptions, defeaters, authorised-object continuity, institutional status, governance response, policy conversion and runtime authority. Decision-Continuation Warrant is introduced only as a candidate decision-centred application profile, not as a validated independent construct. Decision Justification State is proposed as a provisional tri-state-Warranted, Indeterminate and Not warranted-designed to preserve the difference among sufficient support, unresolved sufficiency and affirmative defeat. Maintained assurance is treated as the leading subsumption threat. The paper specifies strong-comparator tests, an empirical programme and explicit kill criteria under which the proposed constructs should be narrowed, absorbed or retired. The contribution is not a new end-to-end governance architecture. It is a falsifiable research programme for studying when inherited institutional authority outlives the picture that originally made it reasonable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策系统的认知完整性"（epistemic integrity of decision systems over time）作为暂定研究对象，开发了一个跨层架构，用于考察机构在条件变化后继续依赖先前决策D0是否仍然合理。论文引入决策延续许可（Decision-Continuation Warrant）作为候选应用框架，并提出三态决策正当性状态（Warranted/Indeterminate/Not warranted），同时设计强比较检验、实证方案和明确的终止标准，构成一个可证伪的研究纲领。
AI.research_question: 机构在证据、假设、对象、范围或权限条件发生变化后，继续依赖特定先前决策D0是否仍然合理？如何系统性地评估这种"延续依赖"的正当性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究（态势感知、人因工程、组织意义建构、保证、决策溯源、组织记忆、变更控制、治理和运行时授权）虽覆盖了该问题的各组件，但缺乏在机构层面整合性地回答"继续依赖先前决策是否仍然合理"这一核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认识论败因（defeaters）、决策溯源、组织记忆、运行时授权、保证理论、变革管理、态势感知与组织意义建构。
AI.method: 概念架构开发；提出跨层架构（证据、假设、败因、授权对象连续性、制度地位、治理响应、政策转换、运行时权威）；三态状态模型；强比较器检验；实证研究纲领与终止标准（kill criteria）。
AI.findings: ①定义了"决策系统随时间的认知完整性"这一暂定研究对象；②提出决策延续许可（D0W）作为候选决策中心应用框架；③提出三态决策正当性状态（正当/不确定/非正当）以区分充分支持、未决支持和肯定性败因；④将维持性保证（maintained assurance）识别为主要的归并威胁；⑤提供了可证伪的研究纲领及终止标准。
AI.theory_contributions: ①首次将"机构层面对先前决策延续依赖的正当性"整合为独立研究对象；②提出跨层架构弥合现有文献的碎片化缺口；③引入三态分类法超越简单的二元正当/非正当判断；④设定明确的终止标准，体现科学可证伪性精神。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构提供评估"继承性权威是否已超出其原本合理性基础"的系统化诊断工具和检验框架，可用于治理、合规审计、决策审查和运行时授权管理等实践场景。

title: The Ambidextrous Leadership Principles and the Requirements for Driving Innovation and Efficiency

detail.title: The Ambidextrous Leadership Principles and the Requirements for Driving Innovation and Efficiency
detail.abstract: Ambidexterity is an approach that is valuable for leading in the constantly changing business environment. Leadership is crucial in fostering innovation and in managing business processes. This study investigates the concept of ambidextrous leadership by employing an inductive approach. A systematic literature review method and an integrative literature review method was used in analyzing ambidextrous leadership and the behaviors involved in the leadership approach: opening and closing leader behaviors. The findings from this study emphasized that ambidextrous leadership is for driving both radical and incremental innovations and optimizing resources, processes, and systems. The findings from this study indicates that ambidextrous leadership encompasses three leadership behaviors. The locking (freezing) behavior, unlocking (unfreezing) behavior, and transitioning leader behavior or balancing leader behavior. Ambidextrous leadership approaches entail the dimensions of innovation and efficiency which are referred to as exploration and exploitation respectively. Ambidextrous leaders employ unfreezing leader behavior in steering exploration, freezing leader behavior in generating exploitation, and balancing leader behavior in aligning and prioritizing the other behaviors. This article presents some definitions of innovation. This article introduces the ambidextrous leadership theory and model which are useful in extending knowledge about ambidextrous leadership. This study offers propositions that can be used for empirical validation of the constructs of ambidexterous leadership. The practice of ambidexterous leadership can be increased or improved through the strategies suggested by this article.

AI.tldr: 本文采用归纳性方法，通过系统文献综述和整合文献综述，研究双元领导力（ambidextrous leadership）的概念及其行为。研究发现双元领导力包含三种领导行为：锁定（冻结）行为、解锁（解冻）行为和过渡/平衡领导行为，分别对应利用（exploitation）和探索（exploration）两个维度。文章提出了双元领导力理论与模型，并给出了可供实证检验的命题及实践策略。
AI.research_question: 双元领导力的概念是什么？其包含哪些领导行为？双元领导力如何驱动创新（激进创新与渐进创新）并优化资源配置？
