The EGARCH model, estimated as a viable alternative to the non-convergent GARCH(1,1), provides preliminary evidence of asymmetric volatility dynamics consistent with oil price shocks.
SHAP analysis identified oil prices, lagged GDP growth, and trade balance as the most influential predictors, consistent with Algeria’s resource-dependent economic structure. The study contributes to the literature on AI-driven fore casting in emerging markets by providing a replicable, open-source framework that emphasizes model parsimony and theoretical grounding over algorithmic complexity when data are limited.

AI.tldr: 本研究对阿尔及利亚（一个依赖碳氢化合物的新兴经济体）的GDP增长预测进行了传统计量经济学与机器学习方法的严格比较分析。基于2000-2025年（n=22）的年度数据，评估了ARIMA、GARCH、FNN、LSTM、GRU及惩罚回归方法（Ridge、Lasso、随机森林）。由于数据限制严重，采用理论驱动的特征选择策略，仅保留五个经济上有充分依据的预测变量。实证结果表明Ridge回归（RMSE=0.2865, R²=0.4591）显著优于所有竞争模型，比ARIMA基准减少了约59%的预测误差。神经网络模型表现出严重过拟合（FNN R²=-1960, LSTM R²=-13.07, GRU R²=-15.18），证实了深度学习在数据稀缺环境中的根本局限性。EGARCH模型提供了与油价冲击一致的波动率不对称性初步证据。SHAP分析识别出油价、滞后GDP增长和贸易收支是最具影响力的预测因子。该研究通过提供可复制的开源框架，强调在数据有限时模型简约性和理论根基优先于算法复杂性，为新兴市场AI驱动预测文献做出贡献。
AI.research_question: 在数据极端稀缺（n=22）的背景下，传统计量经济学方法与机器学习方法在预测阿尔及利亚GDP增长方面孰优孰劣？
AI.motivation: 阿尔及利亚作为依赖碳氢化合物的新兴经济体，其GDP预测面临数据严重不足的挑战，但深度学习等复杂方法在新兴市场中被广泛应用。然而，数据稀缺环境下复杂模型是否真的优于简约的传统模型仍然缺乏系统性的比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测变量数量应远小于观测值数量以维持统计功效的原则；模型简约性（parsimony）原则；贝叶斯/信息论视角下的偏差-方差权衡；资源依赖型经济体的经济结构理论（油价冲击传导机制）。
AI.method: 对ARIMA、GARCH/EGARCH、FNN、LSTM、GRU、Ridge、Lasso、随机森林等八种模型进行系统性比较分析。采用理论驱动的特征选择策略，仅纳入五个经济上合理的预测变量（油价、滞后GDP、汇率、贸易收支、货币供应量）。使用RMSE和R²作为评估指标，并利用SHAP分析进行模型可解释性评估。
AI.findings: 1) Ridge回归（RMSE=0.2865, R²=0.4591）是所有模型中表现最优的，比ARIMA基准（RMSE=0.7018）降低了约59%的预测误差；2) 神经网络模型（FNN、LSTM、GRU）均出现严重过拟合，R²为大幅负值；3) EGARCH模型成功收敛（GARCH(1,1)未能收敛），提供了与油价冲击一致的不对称波动率证据；4) SHAP分析确认油价、滞后GDP增长和贸易收支是最具影响力的预测因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究实证证实了在数据稀缺环境下"模型简约性优于算法复杂性"的理论主张，为偏差-方差权衡理论提供了新兴市场数据环境下的经验证据。同时，通过SHAP分析将机器学习可解释性方法与传统经济结构理论相结合，验证了资源依赖型经济体中油价冲击传导机制的理论预期。研究还表明，当数据量不足以支撑深度网络参数估计时，经典的正则化线性模型在理论上具有天然的统计优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场中数据受限的政策制定者和经济分析师提供了一套可复制的开源预测框架，明确了在n小的情况下应优先选择惩罚回归（尤其Ridge）而非复杂深度学习模型的实践指南。同时提供了阿尔及利亚GDP增长预测的基准性能指标，并借助SHAP分析为决策者提供了关于油价、贸易收支等关键影响因素的可解释性洞见。

title: Flight-Cycle Depreciation and Impairment of Reusable Launch Vehicles: A Mission-Cycle Accounting Framework under IFRS and US GAAP

detail.title: Flight-Cycle Depreciation and Impairment of Reusable Launch Vehicles: A Mission-Cycle Accounting Framework under IFRS and US GAAP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human or animal participants. The research relies on theoretical accounting methodologies, publicly available corporate information, and established reporting standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Reusable launch vehicles are changing the economics of access to space. Rockets and spacecraft that were once designed to be expended after a single mission are increasingly recovered, inspected, refurbished, certified, and flown again. This operational shift creates a direct measurement problem: when the economic life of a reusable launch vehicle is consumed through flight cycles, mission severity, refurbishment effort, component degradation, and residual reliability, a depreciation model anchored mainly to calendar time may fail to represent the pattern in which future economic benefits are consumed.

This paper develops the Mission-Cycle Depreciation Model (MCDM), a methodological framework for depreciation, useful life and residual-value reassessment, impairment testing, held-for-sale route selection, and audit evidence for reusable launch vehicles under IFRS and US GAAP. The model does not replace IAS 16, IAS 36, IFRS 5, ASC 360, or existing audit standards. It provides an engineering-to-accounting translation layer. Its central claim is bounded: where mission evidence is material and reliable, depreciation should reflect the measurable reduction in risk-adjusted remaining mission capacity rather than only elapsed time or an unadjusted flight count.

The public-market context became materially more immediate in June 2026, when Space Exploration Technologies Corp. completed its Nasdaq initial public offering under ticker SPCX. Its prospectus documented multibillion-dollar operations, a substantial GAAP loss, and intensive Starship research and development expenditure, bringing capitalization, depreciation, impairment, internal-control, and disclosure judgments into the routine SEC reporting and public-company audit environment. SpaceX's subsequent inclusion in the VanEck Space ETF through the MarketVector Space Index extended the relevance of those estimates to public shareholders and index-linked portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Mission-Cycle Depreciation Model（MCDM），一种用于可重复使用运载火箭的折旧方法框架，将工程数据转化为会计计量，在IFRS和US GAAP下处理折旧、使用寿命、残值重估、减值测试等会计问题。该模型不替代现有准则，而是提供"工程到会计"的翻译层，主张在任务证据充分可靠时，折旧应反映风险调整后剩余任务能力的可测减少，而非仅基于日历时间或未经调整的飞行次数。
AI.research_question: 当可重复使用运载火箭的经济寿命通过飞行周期、任务严重程度、翻修工作量、部件退化及剩余可靠性等方式消耗时，如何构建一个能准确反映未来经济利益消耗模式的折旧模型？
AI.motivation: 可重复使用运载火箭改变了进入太空的经济学逻辑——火箭和航天器不再单次使用后被弃置，而是被回收、检查、翻修、认证后再次飞行。传统以日历时间为主的折旧模型无法反映此类资产经济利益的实际消耗模式，需要一个基于任务周期的工程到会计翻译框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以IAS 16、IAS 36、IFRS 5、ASC 360和现有审计准则为基础的会计框架，结合工程风险管理中的剩余任务能力概念，建立了工程数据向会计计量转换的理论桥梁。
AI.method: 提出了Mission-Cycle Depreciation Model（MCDM）方法论框架，涵盖折旧、使用寿命与残值重估、减值测试、持有待售路径选择及审计证据生成等多个模块。
AI.findings: 在任务证据具有实质性且可靠的情况下，折旧应反映风险调整后剩余任务能力的可测量减少，而非仅依赖经过时间或未调整的飞行次数。SpaceX于2026年6月在纳斯达克IPO（股票代码SPCX）并纳入VanEck Space ETF，使该模型与资本化、折旧、减值、内部控制及披露判断直接关联至美国SEC报告和公众公司审计环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种跨学科的"工程到会计翻译层"理论框架，弥合了资产实物消耗模式与会计计量惯例之间的理论鸿沟，对可重复使用空间资产的经济利益消耗模式提供了新的理论解释路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可重复使用运载火箭的企业（如SpaceX）在IFRS和US GAAP下的折旧计提、减值测试、持有待售处理及审计证据收集提供了可操作的方法论参考，尤其对上市公司SEC报告和公众公司审计具有直接实践意义。

title: Industrial Water Pollution, Agricultural Productivity and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from China
affiliations: Jinan University - Institute for Economic and Social Research, Peking University and Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Industrial Water Pollution, Agricultural Productivity and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This article estimates the effect of industrial water pollution on agricultural productivity and its further consequences on labor reallocation in China, using a design that exploits a highresolution hydrological network. We show that a 10% increase in industrial wastewater discharged within 150 km upstream significantly reduces local crop yields by 0.5-0.6%. Rural households increasingly engage in non-farm work and migration in response to the environmental shock, and their increase in non-farm income more than offsets their farm income loss. Our findings illustrate significant downstream costs of industrial water pollution on crop production and their implications for sectoral reallocation in China.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高分辨率水文网络数据，估计了工业水污染对中国农业生产力及劳动力重新配置的影响。研究发现，上游150公里内工业废水排放量每增加10%，下游农作物产量将显著下降0.5-0.6%。面对环境冲击，农村家庭更多转向非农就业和迁移，其非农收入增加足以抵消农业收入损失。
AI.research_question: 工业水污染如何影响下游农业生产力，以及这种冲击如何进一步导致劳动力在农业与非农部门之间的重新配置？
AI.motivation: 中国快速工业化伴随大量工业废水排放，水污染对下游农业生产的负面影响缺乏系统性因果证据；同时，环境冲击对农村劳动力重新配置的影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境外部性理论与劳动力配置理论，通过水文网络的空间溢出机制，考察水污染对农业部门的负面影响如何改变农户的就业决策。
AI.method: 利用高分辨率水文网络构建因果关系识别设计，通过上游工业废水排放量（150公里范围内）作为核心解释变量，估计其对下游农作物产量的影响，并进一步分析农户非农就业与迁移行为。
AI.findings: （1）上游150公里内工业废水排放量每增加10%，当地农作物产量显著下降0.5-0.6%；（2）面对水污染冲击，农村家庭显著增加非农就业和迁移；（3）农户非农收入的增加超过农业收入损失，整体收入未受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 为工业水污染的跨区域外部性提供了因果证据，将环境冲击与劳动力部门间重新配置联系起来，拓展了环境经济学与劳动经济学交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了工业水污染的下游成本及其对农业生产的实际影响，为水污染治理政策的制定和农业保护措施提供了实证依据；同时表明环境冲击通过劳动力重新配置机制影响农村经济结构。

title: Reforming United Nations Mechanisms for the Resolution of Diplomatic and Consular Disputes: Reassessing the Role of International Arbitration in the Twenty-First Century

detail.title: Reforming United Nations Mechanisms for the Resolution of Diplomatic and Consular Disputes: Reassessing the Role of International Arbitration in the Twenty-First Century
detail.abstract: One of the fundamental goals of the international law system is still the peaceful resolution of conflicts. States engage in international affairs, safeguard their interests, and foster collaboration through diplomatic and consular ties. Conflicts over diplomatic privileges, immunities, consular access, and the treatment of diplomatic staff persist despite the existence of extensive legal frameworks under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations 1961 and the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations 1963. The effectiveness of the United Nations' (UN) current conflict resolution procedures, which include conciliation, arbitration, mediation, negotiation, and judicial settlement, has varied. However, present geopolitical tensions, dwindling trust in international organisations, and growing opposition to mandatory jurisdiction have shown serious flaws in the current system. In the context of the UN, this article explores the function of international arbitration in settling diplomatic and consular conflicts. It assesses the efficiency of current procedures and pinpoints structural flaws that impede the timely and fair resolution of conflicts. The paper makes the thesis-supported by doctrinal analysis and a few chosen case studies-that although arbitration provides flexibility, neutrality, and procedural efficiency, its potential is still underutilised since there is not a specific institutional framework. In order to improve adherence to international commitments and supplement current conflict resolution processes, the essay suggests creating a Standing United Nations Diplomatic and Consular Arbitration Mechanism. It comes to the conclusion that significant change is required to guarantee that the UN can continue to handle the changing problems of diplomatic and consular relations in the twenty-first century.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在联合国框架下，国际仲裁在解决外交与领事争端中的作用。论文通过理论分析和案例研究指出，尽管仲裁具有灵活性、中立性和程序效率等优势，但由于缺乏专门机构框架，其潜力尚未被充分利用。作者建议设立一个常设的联合国外交与领事仲裁机制，以补充现有争端解决程序，应对21世纪外交领事关系中的新挑战。
AI.research_question: 在联合国框架下，国际仲裁在解决外交与领事争端中发挥何种作用？现有争端解决机制存在哪些结构性缺陷？如何通过建立专门机制来改进这一状况？
AI.motivation: 尽管有1961年《维也纳外交关系公约》和1963年《维也纳领事关系公约》等广泛的法律框架，外交特权、豁免、领事探视及外交人员待遇等争端仍然持续存在。当前地缘政治紧张、对国际组织信任下降以及强制管辖权的反对日益增多，暴露出联合国现有争端解决机制（调解、仲裁、斡旋、谈判和司法解决）的严重缺陷，亟需探索更有效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法体系中的和平解决争端原则；《维也纳外交关系公约》（1961年）和《维也纳领事关系公约》（1963年）所确立的外交与领事法律制度；联合国宪章下的争端解决机制理论。
AI.method: 采用理论分析（doctrinal analysis）方法，辅以若干精选案例研究，评估现有争端解决程序的效率并识别结构性缺陷。
AI.findings: 仲裁虽然具备灵活性、中立性和程序效率等优势，但由于缺乏专门的机构框架，其在外交和领事争端解决中的潜力尚未被充分利用。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出现有联合国争端解决机制在应对外交与领事争端方面的结构性缺陷，提出仲裁作为补充机制的理论论证，并创新性地建议建立常设的联合国外交与领事仲裁机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联合国和国际社会提供具体的制度性改革建议——建立常设联合国外交与领事仲裁机制，以提升对国际承诺的遵守度，补充现有争端解决程序，确保联合国能够应对21世纪外交领事关系中的挑战。

title: The Analyst Matters More Than the Algorithm Specification Sensitivity in Machine Learning Models of Financial Crises
affiliations: Hilton Head Preparatory School

detail.title: The Analyst Matters More Than the Algorithm Specification Sensitivity in Machine Learning Models of Financial Crises
detail.abstract: Comparisons of machine learning against traditional statistical models in financial crisis prediction reach conflicting conclusions. This paper argues that a substantial part of the disagreement is attributable to undocumented analyst choices rather than to differences between algorithms. Using 88 systemic banking crisis onsets across 18 advanced economies from 1870 to 2020, together with a strictly real-time quarterly test for the United States, we estimate a specification curve (Simonsohn, Simmons, & Nelson, 2020) across the complete crossing of five decisions that published work rarely reports in full – hyperparameter tuning protocol, class-imbalance weighting, validation design, forecast horizon, and treatment of crisis-period observations – 108 configurations in all, every one of which produces a valid estimate. The apparent advantage of gradient boosting over logistic regression ranges from −0.181 to +0.056 in area under the ROC curve across these specifications, a span of 0.237 – larger than any difference we or the existing literature report between model families. Machine-learning accuracy is roughly twice as variable across specifications as logistic-regression accuracy (standard deviations 0.048 versus 0.026), and a random forest is more variable still (2.1 times), while a small neural network is only modestly less stable than the regression (1.2 times). Permutation inference – re-estimating the curve on data whose crisis dates have been randomly rotated within country – shows that this excess dispersion is a generic property of flexible estimators rather than a feature of crisis data: the observed dispersion ratio sits near the middle of its null distribution (p = 0.45 on the matched permutation design; Section 5.4), and the mean advantage of the regression (−0.020, machine learning preferred in 39 of 108 specifications) is likewise within the range noise produces (p = 0.20). No comparison between the model families survives at conventional significance levels in either direction. Two further results sharpen the picture. Holding the prediction task fixed, pipeline choices alone (tuning and class weighting) move gradient boosting six times more than the regression, and can silently move its out-of-sample crisis detection between zero and 69 percent by breaking probability-threshold transfer while leaving ranking accuracy intact. And splitting the sample at 1945 reverses the model ranking in all 24 matched configurations – the regression wins every pre-war cell, boosting every post-war cell – so the pooled comparison averages two regimes in which each family consistently wins one. The real-time United States evidence is consistent: a four-variable logistic regression warned six quarters before the 2007 funding-market freeze, and its single false alarm in 2002–2003 was generated by the same variables as the correct warning, peaking higher. We conclude that flexible models buy no reliable accuracy advantage and carry a real reproducibility cost under analyst discretion, and we recommend that comparative studies report specification curves with permutation-based inference rather than point estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过规格曲线分析（specification curve）系统性地评估了机器学习与传统统计模型在金融危机预测中的表现差异。研究发现，此前文献中关于两类模型孰优孰劣的分歧，大部分源于未报告的分析者选择（如超参数调整、类别不平衡加权等5项决策的108种组合），而非算法本身的真实差异。机器学习模型的精度变化幅度远大于逻辑回归，且这种差异是灵活估计器的普遍属性而非危机数据特有。最终结论是：灵活模型并未带来可靠的精度优势，反而在分析者自由裁量下产生更高的可复制性成本，建议比较研究应报告规格曲线并采用排列推断。
AI.research_question: 机器学习与传统统计模型在金融危机预测中的性能差异，到底是算法本身的差异，还是未记录的分析者选择（modeler choices）造成的伪差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对机器学习与传统统计模型在金融危机预测中的比较结论相互矛盾，本文认为大量分歧源于未报告的分析者决策选择（如超参数调整、类别加权、验证设计等），而非模型家族的实质差异。这一矛盾阻碍了危机预警研究的可复制性和科学共识的形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规格曲线分析（Specification Curve Analysis，Simonsohn等人2020年提出）；排列推断（Permutation Inference）；模型灵活性与方差偏差权衡（flexibility-variance tradeoff）；统计推断框架下的模型比较方法论。
AI.method: 使用18个发达经济体1870-2020年88次系统性银行危机爆发事件，结合美国实时季度测试，构建5项分析决策（超参数调整协议、类别不平衡加权、验证设计、预测时段、危机期观测处理）的完全交叉，共108种有效规格配置。采用逻辑回归、梯度提升、随机森林和小型神经网络四种模型，通过规格曲线显示模型间AUROC差异的完整分布，并进行排列推断检验（在国别内随机旋转危机日期）以及1945年前后分样本比较。
AI.findings: （1）梯度提升相对逻辑回归的AUROC优势在-0.181至+0.056之间，跨度0.237，大于文献中报告的任何模型家族间差异；（2）机器学习精度跨规格变化约为逻辑回归的2倍（标准差0.048 vs 0.026），随机森林更高（2.1倍），小神经网络仅1.2倍；（3）排列推断显示这种额外离散性是灵活估计器的普遍属性（p=0.45），平均回归优势也处于噪声范围（p=0.20），两种模型族类间差异均不显著；（4）管道选择（调参和类别加权）对梯度提升的影响是回归的6倍，可静默地将危机检测率从0%移动到69%；（5）以1945年为分界，24个匹配配置全部反转模型排名——战前回归全部胜出，战后提升全部胜出；（6）美国实时证据：四变量逻辑回归在2007年资金市场冻结前6个季度发出预警。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将规格曲线分析与排列推断引入金融危机预测领域，为模型比较提供了更严谨的推断框架；（2）揭示了模型比较文献中"分析者自由度"（analyst degrees of freedom）的问题，证明结论分歧可归因于未报告的选择而非算法差异；（3）从理论层面阐明了灵活估计器在预测任务中方差更大的普遍属性，与数据特征无关；（4）发现模型排名在1945年前后系统性反转，说明笼统的"全样本"比较可能掩盖实质性制度变迁。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管机构和政策制定者提供了实用建议：简单的逻辑回归模型在金融危机预警中足够可靠，无需依赖复杂机器学习模型隐含的"精度优势"；（2）提醒研究者和从业者，超参数调优和类别加权等管道选择可能对结果产生远超模型选择本身的影响，隐含的临界值转换可能将检测率从0%改变至69%；（3）建议比较研究应报告完整规格曲线并采用排列推断，而非单点估计，以提高金融预警研究的可复制性和可信度。

title: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-054, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.054]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Potential output and the natural rate of unemployment are commonly estimated through trend-cycle decompositions, where they are identified as underlying trends reflecting slow-moving supply factors. In this paper, we extend this framework to accommodate the possibility that cyclical disturbances affect trends endogenously through "scarring" effects. Two major changes occur relative to standard specifications. First, a significant share of business-cycle fluctuations is absorbed by endogenous movements in the trends rather than shifts in the cycle. Second, the estimated cycle--relieved of explaining the persistence in real variables--tracks inflation developments more closely, including through a steeper Phillips curve. While this steeper slope implies a strong co-movement between inflation and real activity in response to cyclical shocks, such strong co-movement is rarely apparent in the data. Consequently, the estimation shows a shift toward more sizable changes in the purely supply-driven components of the trends, mirrored by smaller innovations in the cycle process. In turn, this rebalancing entails different historical paths for the activity gaps, carrying important implications for the conduct of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了趋势-周期分解框架，允许周期性冲击通过"疤痕效应"内生地影响趋势（潜在产出与自然失业率）。研究发现，与标准设定相比，大量商业周期波动被趋势的内生变动而非周期本身所吸收；估计出的周期与通胀走势更为紧密，但陡峭的菲利普斯曲线与数据中通胀与实际活动的弱共动性相矛盾，导致估计结果转向更大的纯供给驱动趋势变动和更小的周期创新，这改变了活动缺口的路径并对货币政策产生重要含义。
AI.research_question: 周期性冲击如何通过"疤痕效应"内生地影响潜在产出和自然失业率等趋势变量，以及这种设定对趋势-周期分解、菲利普斯曲线估计和货币政策含义有何影响？
AI.motivation: 标准趋势-周期分解将趋势视为仅反映缓慢移动的供给因素，忽略了周期性扰动可能对趋势产生持久性（疤痕）影响的可能，从而可能低估了供给面的历史变动并高估了周期的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 趋势-周期分解框架、疤痕效应（hysteresis/scarring effects）、菲利普斯曲线、潜在产出与自然失业率估计
AI.method: 扩展趋势-周期分解模型，允许周期扰动内生影响趋势（疤痕效应），将估计结果与标准设定对比分析
AI.findings: （1）大量商业周期波动被趋势的内生变动所吸收而非周期本身；（2）估计的周期与通胀走势更紧密，菲利普斯曲线更陡峭；（3）陡峭的菲利普斯曲线暗示通胀与实际活动强共动，但数据中这种共动性较弱，导致估计转向更大的纯供给驱动趋势变动和更小的周期创新；（4）活动缺口的路径发生变化，对货币政策有重要启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 将疤痕效应引入趋势-周期分解框架，挑战了趋势仅由缓慢供给因素驱动的传统假设，揭示了周期与趋势之间的内生交互机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了对活动缺口的替代历史估计路径，对货币政策制定者在经济周期波动、潜在产出和通胀之间的权衡考量具有重要的政策启示。

title: IP Battles Carry High Defamation Risks Over Public Accusations [Bloomberg Law 2026]
affiliations: University of Colorado School of Law and White & Case LLP

detail.title: IP Battles Carry High Defamation Risks Over Public Accusations [Bloomberg Law 2026]
detail.abstract: In high-stakes IP disputes, the real battlefield is often the market rather than the courtroom. This article examines how enforcement communications such as press releases, customer alerts, and takedown notices can cross into actionable defamation when allegations are presented as established findings. It also offers practical guidance for both enforcement and defense-side parties on managing reputational risk with the same rigor applied to pleadings and trial testimony.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在高风险知识产权纠纷中，执法沟通（如新闻稿、客户警示、下架通知）在将指控表述为既定结论时，可能构成可诉的诽谤行为，并为双方提供了管理声誉风险的实务指引。
AI.research_question: 知识产权执法沟通（如新闻稿、客户警示、下架通知）在何种情况下会跨越法律边界，构成可诉的诽谤行为？
AI.motivation: 在高风险知识产权纠纷中，"真正的战场往往是市场而非法庭"。执法沟通虽然旨在维护知识产权，但当指控被呈现为既定事实时，可能引发诽谤责任。本文旨在帮助各方以同等的严谨态度管理声誉风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法与诽谤法的交叉领域，涉及言论自由与商业声誉保护的平衡理论。
AI.method: 法律分析/规范性研究，通过法律框架分析执法沟通中的诽谤风险并提供实务指引。
AI.findings: 知识产权执法沟通在将指控表述为既定结论时可能构成诽谤；需要区分"声称的指控"与"已确立的事实"之间的法律边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了知识产权执法沟通与诽谤法之间的法律交叉地带，为理解信息发布行为在知识产权纠纷中的法律后果提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识产权执法方和防御方提供了管理声誉风险的具体实务指导，强调应以起草诉状和庭审证词的同等严谨度来对待执法沟通。

title: The Causal Partition of Information: Theory and Applications

detail.title: The Causal Partition of Information: Theory and Applications
detail.abstract: We develop a general framework for information choice organized around a causal partition of signals into primary and secondary. Primary information consists of signals received or interpreted through the causal mechanism that generates the state; secondary information is any signal informative about the state without processing through that mechanism, including others' actions, prices, correlated non-causal indicators, and reduced-form empirical regularities. Under three primitives — a broadened secondary definition, an imperfect-aggregation assumption on secondary signals, and a fixed-cost assumption on primary acquisition — the agent's information-acquisition problem admits a discrete-choice corner solution partitioning agents into an interior regime (using both channels) and a corner regime (using secondary only). Seven propositions characterize the framework, including an asymmetric-corner result (cheap secondary can never drive primary demand to zero), an equilibrium in which the two-population mixture is the unique stable fixed point, and a welfare result under which the corner regime is inefficiently large in productive settings. An empirical study of prediction-market micro-data — 628,777 wallet-level trades across 236 resolved sports markets, with an external news clock alongside the price clock — verifies the mixture's variance ordering in full, including its noise-floor bound, and confirms the partition's central prediction: wallets classified as consensus-followers by trade timing alone earn significantly negative returns net of spread (−2.7 cents per share, t = −4.6), leaders earn positive returns, and the spread between the types is 3.5 cents per share (t = 4.7). The separation and the variance chain replicate in football and hockey and attenuate, exactly as the design implies, in continuous-arrival basketball; the same conditional-informativeness structure reappears among professional forecasters in a fifty-year survey panel. A dated consensus-visibility shock (the June 2025 X–Polymarket integration) shifts the population toward crowd-following by 9.1 percentage points relative to a control year (z = 2.1) while leaving established leaders unchanged — the asymmetric response no symmetric-substitution framework predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个围绕信号因果划分（主要信息与次要信息）的信息选择一般框架。在三个原始假设下，信息获取问题可化为离散选择角点解，将行为人分为混合使用两种渠道的内部解和仅用次要信息的角点解。通过预测市场微数据（628,777笔钱包级交易）验证了方差排序、噪声底限及分类预测，并发现共识追随者净收益显著为负、领导者为正。2025年6月X-Polymarket整合事件使群体向从众偏移9.1个百分点。
AI.research_question: 当信号可因果划分为主要（通过产生状态的因果机制获取）与次要（不经该机制的推断性信号，如他人行为、价格等）时，理性信息获取问题的最优解结构是什么？两类信息的使用者在均衡中的收益表现与群体分布如何？
AI.motivation: 现有信息选择文献通常将信号视为同类可替代品，忽略了因果机制在信号获取中的关键作用。现实中大量信息通过观察他人行为、价格等间接渠道获得，且存在固定成本与聚合不完全性，需要统一框架解释信息获取的离散选择与群体分层现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息选择理论；信号因果划分框架；离散选择模型；不完全聚合假设；固定成本假设
AI.method: 理论建模（基于三个原始假设推导七个命题）+ 实证检验（预测市场628,777笔钱包级交易数据、外部新闻时钟、价格时钟、行业专家50年调查面板、准自然实验与DID设计）
AI.findings: （1）理论层面：次要信息廉价永远不会将主要信息需求降至零（非对称角点结果）；两种群混合是唯一稳定不动点；生产性场景下角点解低效过大。（2）实证层面：共识追随者净收益显著为负（−2.7美分/股，t=−4.6），领导者为正，两类差3.5美分（t=4.7）；方差链在橄榄球和冰球中复现、在篮球中衰减；X-Polymarket整合使从众群体增加9.1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信息选择的一般框架，将信号按因果机制划分为主要与次要两类，扩展了传统信息获取理论；揭示了非对称角点解与两种群混合均衡的稳定性；阐明了从众追随的信息获取低效性与福利后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场设计、市场信息效率评估、政策干预（如平台整合对信息生态的影响）提供理论依据；为识别市场中的共识追随者与领导者提供可操作的交易时序分类方法；对市场参与者信息策略具有直接指导意义。

title: Robust Scale-Free Auctions

detail.title: Robust Scale-Free Auctions
detail.abstract: We study prior-independent auction design when bidder values are independently and identically distributed and the seller knows only a scale-invariant shape restriction on their distribution, but neither the distribution nor the scale of values. We show that the maximin problem over a broad class of dominant-strategy incentive compatible mechanisms reduces without loss to scale-free mechanisms. For any n ≥ 2 monotone-hazard-rate bidders, the second-price auction without a reserve is maximin optimal over this class, including randomized mechanisms that may allocate to a lower bidder. We derive its exact guarantee for every n and the sharp exponential rate at which its loss relative to the Bayesian optimum vanishes. Many familiar auctions are standard: they allocate only to a highest bidder, although incentive compatibility does not require this. For two regular bidders, we solve the standard problem exactly: its optimal mechanism mixes the second-price auction with a relative-markup auction and achieves a worst-case ratio of approximately 0.524413. We construct a nonstandard mechanism that sometimes allocates to the lower bidder and achieves approximately 0.524829, proving that standardness is strictly costly. The contrast is driven by tail restrictions: monotone hazard rate makes lower-rank allocation unhelpful, whereas regularity permits it to improve worst-case revenue.

AI.tldr: 本文研究先验独立（prior-independent）拍卖设计问题：当投标者价值独立同分布，且卖方仅知道分布满足尺度不变的形状限制（如单调风险率或正则性），但不知道具体分布和规模时，最大化最坏情况收益（maximin）的最优机制设计。
AI.research_question: 在卖方只知道值分布的尺度不变形状限制（而非具体分布）的先验独立拍卖设计中，最优的maximin机制是什么？标准机制（只分配给最高出价者）是否代价高昂？
AI.motivation: 现实拍卖中卖方通常不知道投标者价值的具体分布，仅可能知道一些形状特征（如单调风险率）。这引出了先验独立（prior-independent）拍卖设计的基本问题：在没有完整分布信息的情况下，如何设计稳健的拍卖机制？此外，一个长期被忽视的问题是：激励相容并不要求机制只分配给最高出价者，但"标准机制"隐含了这一限制，需要探究这一限制的成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: Maximin（最大最小）稳健优化框架；优势策略激励相容（DSIC）机制理论；单调风险率（MHR）和正则（regular）分布形状限制；先验独立机制设计理论。
AI.method: 理论分析：将maximin问题在广泛DSIC机制类别中无损化简为尺度自由（scale-free）机制；通过精确刻画最坏情况比率求解最优机制；对标准机制与非标准机制进行对比分析，构造最优混合机制。
AI.findings: (1) 对任意n≥2个单调风险率投标者，无保留价的次价拍卖在该机制类别中是maximin最优的（包括允许分配给非最高出价者的随机机制）；(2) 给出了精确的最坏情况保证以及相对于贝叶斯最优的损失呈指数衰减的精确速率；(3) 对两个正则投标者，标准问题的最优机制混合了次价拍卖与相对加成拍卖，最坏情况比约为0.524413；(4) 构造了一个非标准机制（有时分配给较低出价者），实现约0.524829的最坏情况比，证明标准性有严格成本；(5) 对比差异由尾部限制驱动：单调风险率使低排名分配无助于改善收益，而正则性则允许其改善最坏情况收益。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明了在广泛DSIC机制类别中maximin问题可无损化简为尺度自由机制，建立了方法论基础；(2) 首次精确刻画了单调风险率情形下次价拍卖的maximin最优性及精确保证；(3) 首次证明"标准性"（只分配给最高出价者）在拍卖设计中存在严格成本，揭示了形状限制（尾部条件）对非标准机制价值的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卖方在缺乏分布信息时的拍卖机制选择提供了明确的指导：在单调风险率假设下次价拍卖无需保留价即为最优稳健选择；而对于正则分布情形，更复杂的混合机制可以小幅但严格地改善最坏情况收益。

title: Pricing the Ungovernable
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Pricing the Ungovernable
detail.abstract: Contemporary AI governance regulates providers, deployers, and access to hosted systems. It faces a practical enforcement floor when an already-released open-weight model runs offline on local hardware: direct control becomes increasingly evasive and increasingly costly to civil liberties. This paper shifts attention to the governable layer above that floor, jurisdictional custody, defined as a state's verified licensing, audit, investigation, cooperation, and weight-security conduct toward high-risk actors and infrastructure on its territory. The proposal contains three distinct instruments: a public jurisdictional record, a firm-level custodian standard for underwriting and legal use, and an optional sovereign reward mechanism for participating states. Its claimed additionality is not another prohibition or incident rule. It is a cross-jurisdiction ledger that links verified custody conduct to decisions by insurers, courts, counterparties, and, where adopted, sovereign instruments. The paper supplies a provisional dangerous-capability rule, separates enabling capacity from verified effectiveness, and makes transmission an empirical question rather than an assumption. The mechanism cannot govern self-contained individual misuse or compel frontier states that shield national champions. Its nearer-term reach is organized and commercialized misuse that depends on hosting, payments, distribution, insurance, or legal exposure. FATF is therefore a bounded precedent: the target is measurable improvement in custody conduct, not elimination of misuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将AI治理的重点从难以执行的模型发布后控制，转向"司法管辖托管"（jurisdictional custody）这一可治理层，通过公共管辖记录、企业级托管人标准、主权奖励机制三种工具，建立跨司法管辖区的账本，将经核实的托管行为与保险、法院、交易对手方及主权工具的决策联系起来。
AI.research_question: 在开放权重模型离线运行导致直接控制难以执行的情况下，如何通过司法管辖托管这一可治理层来有效规制高风险AI行为？
AI.motivation: 当代AI治理面临实际执行底线：已发布的开放权重模型可在本地硬件离线运行，直接控制变得越来越难以实现且对公民自由的成本越来越高。现有治理方式（禁止规则、事件规则）已触及执行地板，需要寻求新的治理杠杆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法管辖托管理论（jurisdictional custody）：国家对其领土内高风险行为体和基础设施的经核实的许可、审计、调查、合作和权重安全行为的治理框架。借鉴FATF（金融行动特别工作组）模式作为有界先例。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析，提出三工具框架：公共管辖记录、企业级托管人标准、主权奖励机制；并设计了初步的危险能力规则，区分使能能力与经核实的有效性。
AI.findings: 该机制无法治理自包含的个人滥用行为，也无法强制庇护本国冠军企业的前沿国家。其近期可及范围是依赖托管、支付、分发、保险或法律暴露的有组织和商业化滥用行为。目标是托管行为的可测量的改进，而非消除滥用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"司法管辖托管"这一新概念作为AI治理的可行层；区分使能能力与经核实的有效性；将传播从假设转变为经验问题（开放世界模型）；建立跨管辖账本作为非禁止式的治理新增工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国提供可操作的托管行为记录机制，为保险机构、法院、交易对手方提供治理决策依据，通过主权奖励机制激励参与国改进托管实践。

title: Resolution of the St. Petersburg Paradox via Asymptotic Capital-Growth Optimization

detail.title: Resolution of the St. Petersburg Paradox via Asymptotic Capital-Growth Optimization
detail.abstract: For nearly three centuries the divergence between the St. Petersburg lottery's infinite mathematical expectation and the finite valuation placed on it by rational agents has been treated with subjective modifications of the objective function, beginning with Daniel Bernoulli's logarithmic utility. Utility repairs are ad hoc and, as Menger showed, defeated by a super-St. Petersburg construction that inflates the payoffs. We give an objective resolution that introduces no psychological primitive. Modelling wealth as a repeated multiplicative process and applying the discrete Kelly (growth-optimal) criterion to the lottery offered at price C, we first prove an exact characterization of the growth-optimal fraction, namely the sum over i>=1 of [C(1-f) + f*2^i]^(-1) = 1, together with the solvency (ruin) bound f < C/(C-2). From this identity we derive, by an Euler-Maclaurin evaluation whose half-integer midpoint correction is the exact source of the constant, the closed-form asymptotics f* ~ (C/sqrt(2))*2^(-C), and G(f*) ~ 2^(-C)/(sqrt(2) ln 2) = f*/(C ln 2), confirmed numerically to four significant figures. The resolution then follows in two parts: (i) because the expectation diverges, the game is favourable at every finite price, so a growth-optimal strategy always exists; and (ii) the maximal growth rate collapses geometrically in the price, so the wealth-doubling time grows like 2^C and any agent with a finite horizon rationally refuses tickets above a modest threshold (C ≈ 10-15). No concave utility is required, and none would suffice. We state the relation to the Bernoulli-Kelly-Peters line and to the growth-optimal treatments of Cover-Thomas and MacLean-Thorp-Ziemba, and isolate the contribution as the explicit price-dependent optimum and its role in the two-part resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将财富建模为重复乘法过程并应用离散Kelly（最优增长）准则，为圣彼得堡悖论提供了一个客观的解法。作者首先证明了一个精确的最优增长比例特征方程，然后通过Euler-Maclaurin展开推导出闭合渐近解，证明即使在无限期望下游戏在任意有限价格都是有利的，但由于最大增长率随价格几何级数衰减（翻倍时间呈2^C增长），有限视野的理性代理人会在约C≈10-15的阈值以上拒绝购买彩票。该解法不需要任何凹效用函数或其他心理学假设。
AI.research_question: 如何在不引入主观效用函数（如对数效用）的前提下，客观地解释圣彼得堡悖论中无限数学期望与有限估值之间的分歧？
AI.motivation: 自Daniel Bernoulli以来，圣彼得堡悖论一直通过主观修改目标函数（引入凹效用）来"修复"，但这种修复是临时的（ad hoc），且Menger证明了可以通过超圣彼得堡构造（super-St. Petersburg）使任何有界效用函数失效。因此需要一个不引入任何心理原始概念的客观解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kelly（增长最优）准则、财富重复乘法过程建模、Euler-Maclaurin渐近展开、离散最优增长理论。
AI.method: 将圣彼得堡彩票置于重复乘法财富过程中，应用离散Kelly准则，证明最优增长比例f*的精确特征方程（sum_{i>=1}[C(1-f)+f*2^i]^(-1)=1，伴随破产界f<C/(C-2)），再通过Euler-Maclaurin展开（半整数中点修正是常数项的确切来源）推导闭合渐近形式f*~(C/sqrt(2))*2^(-C)和G(f*)~2^(-C)/(sqrt(2)ln2)，并以四位有效数字数值验证。
AI.findings: (i) 由于期望发散，该游戏在任意有限价格下都是有利的，因此最优增长策略始终存在；(ii) 但最大增长率随价格几何级数崩溃（财富翻倍时间以2^C增长），任何有限视野的代理人都会在约C≈10-15的阈值以上理性拒绝购买。这一结果无需凹效用函数，且任何凹效用函数都不足以产生该结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为圣彼得堡悖论提供了一个无需主观效用假设的客观解法，将问题从"主观估值"重新框架为"客观增长最优性"问题；推导出价格依赖的最优比例f*的精确特征方程和闭合渐近式；将Bernoulli-Kelly-Peters理论线统一起来，并厘清了与Cover-Thomas和MacLean-Thorp-Ziemba的增长最优处理的区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个客观的决策准则：在圣彼得堡式彩票中，理性的有限视野代理人应在约C≈10-15的价格阈值以上拒绝购买，该阈值由财富翻倍时间的指数增长决定，而非由主观风险厌恶决定。这为处理具有无限期望的极端厚尾赌注的定价与参与决策提供了可操作的计算框架。

publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper has two objectives. First, it updates the set of Basic Model Elasticities (BMEs) of the Banque de France's semi-structural macroeconomic model for France (FR-BDF), initially presented in 2020. Since then, FR-BDF has been enhanced with detailed blocks for household credit and housing markets, corporate financing, and fully re-estimated following the release of national accounts in base 2020. The BMEs reported here reflect these improvements and remain constructed under an orthogonality principle, providing analytical responses to isolated shocks that can be combined to design alternative scenarios. Second, the paper introduces FR-BMEs, a simplified, linearized model based on FR-BDF BMEs, which has been used since March 2024 for interim projections. While this approach improves efficiency, it reduces the granularity of projections, notably for public finances and household income. FR-BMEs also supports policy analysis, including modelbased forecast-error decomposition. We illustrate this with a post-mortem of the 2024 GDP growth forecast error from the December 2023 Banque de France's projection. Actual growth reached 1.1 % versus a forecast of 0.9 %, implying a +0.2pp error. This discrepancy mainly reflects historical data revisions (+0.16pp) and, to a lesser extent, changes in Eurosystem assumptions (+0.05pp). By coincidence, revisions in public finance assumptions (+0.28 pp) and errors in expert judgement (-0.28pp) offset each other.

AI.tldr: 本文更新了法国央行半结构宏观经济模型FR-BDF的基础模型弹性（BMEs），并引入了FR-BMEs——一个基于BMEs的简化线性化模型，用于2024年3月以来的中期预测和预测误差分解分析。
AI.research_question: 如何更新法国央行FR-BDF模型的基础模型弹性（BMEs），并基于此构建一个高效且支持政策分析的简化预测模型（FR-BMEs）？
AI.motivation: FR-BDF模型自2020年首次提出以来已有所增强，包括家庭信贷与住房市场、企业融资等模块，并基于新的国民账户重新估计。需要更新BMEs以反映这些改进，同时提高中期预测的效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半结构性宏观经济模型（semi-structural macroeconomic model）；正交性原理（orthogonality principle）下的基础模型弹性（BMEs）
AI.method: 更新FR-BDF模型的BMEs；构建简化的线性化模型FR-BMEs；使用预测误差分解方法进行事后分析（post-mortem）
AI.findings: 2024年法国实际GDP增长为1.1%，高于2023年12月预测的0.9%（+0.2pp误差）。误差主要源于历史数据修订（+0.16pp）和欧元体系假设变化（+0.05pp）；公共财政假设修订（+0.28pp）与专家判断误差（-0.28pp）恰好相互抵消。
AI.theory_contributions: 为半结构宏观经济模型提供了更新后的BMEs，并展示了基于BMEs构建简化线性化模型进行政策分析与预测误差分解的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: FR-BMEs提高了中期预测效率，支持替代情景设计和预测误差归因分析，为央行预测流程提供实用工具。

title: A Window into Bond Investors’ Uncertainty About R‑Star
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: A Window into Bond Investors’ Uncertainty About R‑Star

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Monetary policymakers closely monitor the term structure of sovereign bond yields to uncover market participants’ beliefs about the future monetary policy stance, inflation, and activity. A particular object of interest is the natural real rate of return, or “r-star,” which acts as a guide for monetary policy decisions. Numerous papers have questioned how much information investors possess, and how precisely they know r-star. In this post based on a recent Staff Report, we explore what the term structure of interest rates can teach us about r-star and its perception by investors.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/08/a-window-into-bond-investors-uncertainty-about-r-star/

AI.tldr: 本文基于纽约联储最新工作人员报告，探讨利率期限结构如何揭示投资者对自然实际利率（r-star）的认知与不确定性，为货币政策决策提供参考。
AI.research_question: 利率期限结构能够为r-star及其在投资者眼中的认知提供哪些信息？
AI.motivation: 货币政策制定者密切关注主权债券收益率期限结构，以了解市场参与者对未来货币政策立场、通胀和经济活动的预期。r-star作为货币政策的指导基准，其被投资者认知的准确性受到广泛质疑，因此需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率期限结构理论；自然实际利率（r-star）理论
AI.method: 基于纽约联储工作人员报告（Staff Report No. 1187），利用利率期限结构数据进行分析，探讨投资者对r-star的认知及其不确定性。
AI.findings: 利率期限结构为理解r-star及其被投资者认知的程度提供了重要窗口，可以揭示投资者对r-star认知的不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为r-star的测量与投资者认知研究提供了基于期限结构的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者提供关于市场对r-star预期的信息，有助于更精准地进行货币政策决策。

title: Property Rights in Liquid Gold: Recognizing Breastmilk as Property
affiliations: Chicago-Kent College of Law - Illinois Institute of Technology

detail.title: Property Rights in Liquid Gold: Recognizing Breastmilk as Property
detail.abstract:
Breastmilk is a highly valued commodity. It is produced, stored, transferred, sold, and, at times, contaminated, stolen, improperly handled, and even lost. Litigants have largely sought remedies related to breastmilk under employment, family, and health law frameworks, consistently failing to bring claims directly related to the loss of property-the milk itself. These frameworks consistently deny plaintiffs access to well-established property based remedies when their breastmilk is lost, destroyed, damaged, and withheld. Breastmilk is a form of time-limited reproductive property. Its intentional production, fully vested value at the time of separation from a woman's body, and value derived from its transfer (instead of its presence in the producer's body) all indicate that breastmilk has more property-like qualities than many body products already recognized as property. As such, interference with produced breastmilk and, by extension, lactational capacity, can and should be treated as property and property-tort violations. This Article exposes a persistent remedy gap regarding breastmilk violations. Through a comprehensive review of over 1,300 cases, including frequent instances of breastmilk theft, intentional destruction, and custodial negligence by TSA, ICE, hospitals, employers, and ex-spouses, property claims are almost never raised in court. This, I posit, is a result of a combination of three factors in the legal space: 1) a persistent failure to treat some body materials as property, 2) a fear that, if all body materials were treated as property, such treatment would result in the negative commodification and exploitation of bodies, and 3) a systemic tendency within the plaintiff's bar and society to undervalue breastmilk as a biological asset. Failure and fear have brought American society to a concerning reality: the law as written and as applied undervalues and under-protects women's rights to their breastmilk. When women can legally sell their breastmilk, but regularly fail to claim monetary damages in court when others destroy their milk, the society has created a system where the law fails to recognize a harm that requires a remedy.
This Article introduces a novel four-part property taxonomy for breastmilk in order to assist lawyers and courts to develop mechanisms for recognizing wrongs under existing property doctrine, and to seek remedies under these doctrines – especially when other claims fail to provide remedies. The taxonomy divides into 1) expressed milk as possessory chattel, 2) stored milk as bailment property, 3) transferring breastmilk as relational property, and 4) lactational capacity as future productive property. Traditional doctrines of conversion, trespass to chattels, breach of bailment, and takings provide blueprints for securing accountability and monetary recovery for the unwanted destruction of “liquid gold.”

AI.tldr: 本文指出母乳作为一种有时限的生殖财产，其丧失、损毁或被扣留时，现行法律框架（就业法、家庭法、健康法）几乎不提供财产法上的救济。作者通过审查1300多个案例，发现涉及母乳被盗、故意销毁、监管疏忽等情形时，财产索赔几乎从未被提出，这归因于三个因素：法律不承认某些身体材料为财产、对身体商品化的恐惧、以及社会系统性地低估母乳的价值。文章提出一个四部分的母乳财产分类法，以帮助法院在现有财产原则下承认损害并提供救济。
AI.research_question: 当母乳被丢失、毁坏、扣留时，为什么原告几乎从未依据财产法提起诉讼，以及如何将母乳视为财产以填补这一救济缺口？
AI.motivation: 母乳是高度有价值的商品，但现有法律框架（就业法、家庭法、健康法）始终拒绝为母乳的损失提供财产性救济。社会现实中存在大量母乳被盗、故意销毁、保管疏忽等侵权行为，但法律未能承认这一伤害，造成系统性的救济缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财产法理论（尤其是身体材料作为财产的理论）、侵权法理论（侵占、动产侵害、违反寄托、征收）、以及关于身体商品化的学术辩论。
AI.method: 综合性的案例审查方法，涵盖1300多个案件，包括母乳被盗、故意销毁以及TSA、ICE、医院、雇主和前配偶的保管疏忽等情形，分析财产索赔在法院中被提出的频率及其失败原因。
AI.findings: 1) 在1300多个涉及母乳侵权案件中，财产索赔几乎从未被提出；2) 法律上的失败（不承认身体材料为财产）和恐惧（担心身体全面商品化）共同导致了对母乳权利的削弱；3) 原告律师界和社会系统性地低估母乳作为生物资产的价值；4) 当妇女可以合法出售母乳却在法院中未能就母乳被毁主张金钱赔偿时，法律未能承认需要救济的伤害。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新颖的四部分母乳财产分类法：（1）已挤出的母乳作为占有性动产；（2）存储中的母乳作为寄托财产；（3）转移中的母乳作为关系性财产；（4）泌乳能力作为未来生产性财产。这一分类法为律师和法院在现有财产原则下识别侵害和寻求救济提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师和法院提供了一套可操作的财产分类工具，使其能够运用传统的侵占、动产侵害、违反寄托和征收等原则，为母乳被不当毁坏的情形寻求问责和金钱赔偿，从而填补现有法律框架下的救济缺口。

title: Third-Country Deportations: Legal and Ethical Problems

detail.title: Third-Country Deportations: Legal and Ethical Problems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: The UN Refugee Convention and Protocol, as well as the UN Convention Against Torture, impose upon states a duty to prevent refoulement. Yet, migrant destination states increasingly attempt to triangulate and circumvent this obligation by removing asylum seekers to third countries to which they have no prior connection. Third-country deportation—often with no due process—has been a favorite tactic of the second Trump Administration in particular, in contravention of longstanding legal precedents. This paper explores some of the unique legal and ethical problems which arise in cases of third-country deportation, including disruption of migrants’ reasonable expectations; ignoring the historical responsibilities that arise out of particular bilateral or dyadic migration systems; what Allison Wolf calls “derivatization” of migrants in which cruelty is styled as deterrence; and, most troublingly, the specter of triangular refoulement (a risk which already has in fact been realized in numerous Trump-era third-country deportations). To the extent that a third-country deportation regime theoretically could be constructed without falling afoul of international and domestic law, it is clear no such regime has yet emerged in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了第三国驱逐移民（将寻求庇护者送往与其无先前联系的国家）所引发的独特法律与伦理问题。文章指出，尽管国际法（《联合国难民公约》及《禁止酷刑公约》）明确禁止"推回"（refoulement），但美国（特别是第二届特朗普政府）越来越多地通过第三国驱逐来规避这一义务，由此引发了包括三角推回在内的严重法律与伦理危机。
AI.research_question: 第三国驱逐移民在实践中产生了哪些独特的法律与伦理问题，以及为何现行第三国驱逐制度在法律和道德上均无法成立？
AI.motivation: 移民目的地国家（特别是第二届特朗普政府）越来越多地采用第三国驱逐策略来规避其国际法下的不推回义务，这一做法违反长期法律先例，且已经实际导致了三角推回的发生，亟需系统的法律与伦理审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际难民法（《联合国难民公约》及《议定书》）、国际人权法（《联合国禁止酷刑公约》）、不推回原则；Allison Wolf的"衍生化"（derivatization）理论；双边/二元移民系统的历史责任理论；合理期待理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律与伦理分析，结合国际法先例、现有法律判例以及特朗普政府时期的实际驱逐案例进行论证。
AI.findings: 第三国驱逐产生了若干严重的法律与伦理问题：（1）扰乱移民的合理期待；（2）忽视特定双边/二元移民系统所产生的历史责任；（3）将残酷行为包装为威慑（Wolf所谓的"衍生化"）；（4）最为严重的是引发"三角推回"的风险，且这一风险已在特朗普时代的多次第三国驱逐中实际发生。尽管理论上理论上可以构建不违反国际与国内法的第三国驱逐制度，但实践中尚不存在这样的制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地梳理并整合了第三国驱逐所产生的多重法律与伦理问题，特别是将"三角推回"概念引入对第三国驱逐的批判性分析中，并运用Wolf的"衍生化"理论揭示驱逐策略的伦理困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律从业者及人权倡导者提供了第三国驱逐制度在法律与伦理上的系统性批判框架，有助于推动移民政策改革，防止以规避国际义务为目的的驱逐行为继续发生。

title: Transitioning from SAA to TPA Governance and Communication Requirements
affiliations: and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

contentType.other: Invited contribution for a special issue of the journal of portfolio management

detail.abstract: The total portfolio approach (TPA) offers significant benefits over traditional strategic asset allocation (SAA), and its appeal has grown alongside institutional asset owners' increasing use of alternatives. Transitioning from SAA to TPA requires new thinking, new capabilities, and different delegation of authorities from board to management. This paper lays out a phased transition from SAA to TPA, letting an organization choose its pace and how far it wishes to go. It also addresses the communications a board needs, and questions it might ask, to oversee management across five areas: (i) people and culture, (ii) risk management, (iii) asset allocation, (iv) delegation of authorities, and (v) measures of success. Progress through these steps can be sequential, with an initial focus on foundational capabilities that also benefit an existing SAA approach, ahead of necessary changes to governance or incentives. TPA implementation can thus evolve at a pace suited to each fund's circumstances, letting the board build familiarity with the approach over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套从传统战略资产配置（SAA）向整体投资组合方法（TPA）分阶段转型的框架，允许机构根据自身情况选择转型速度和深度。文章还阐述了董事会在监督管理层时需要关注的五大领域，并提供了相应的沟通与质询指南。
AI.research_question: 机构资产所有者如何从传统的战略资产配置（SAA）平稳过渡到整体投资组合方法（TPA），以及董事会应如何在此过程中进行有效监督？
AI.motivation: 随着机构投资者越来越多地使用另类资产，TPA相比传统SAA具有显著优势，但转型需要新的思维方式、能力和董事会授权体系的重构，缺乏系统性的分阶段转型指导框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整体投资组合方法（TPA）；战略资产配置（SAA）；公司治理与授权理论；风险管理理论
AI.method: 概念性/框架性研究，提出分阶段转型路径和董事会监督框架，属于实践导向的规范性研究。
AI.findings: 提出了从SAA到TPA的分阶段转型路径，涵盖五大监督领域：（i）人员与文化、（ii）风险管理、（iii）资产配置、（iv）授权体系、（v）成功衡量标准。转型可以循序推进，优先建立基础能力（即使对现有SAA也有益），再推进治理和激励变革，以适配各基金的具体情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 为TPA转型提供了系统的分阶段框架，填补了从SAA到TPA转型路径研究的空白；将董事会监督与企业治理理论整合到资产配置转型的语境中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构资产所有者提供了可操作的转型路线图，帮助董事会在五大关键领域有效监督管理层，并提供了具体的质询问题和沟通策略，使转型可以根据各基金具体情况灵活推进。

title: The Origins of American Counties. Part V: The Great Basin and Pacific States: Counties as Agents of Empire

detail.title: The Origins of American Counties. Part V: The Great Basin and Pacific States: Counties as Agents of Empire
detail.abstract: This is the fifth of five papers of a book in progress, "The Origins of American Counties: A Fifty-State Tour of the History and Perseverance of America's Least Understood Local Governments." (For a full introduction see Part I, "Theory and New England.") This Part examines county origins in the states of (in order discussed) Utah, Nevada, California, Oregon, Washington, Alaska, and Hawaii.  All counties can be thought of as agents of empire in that they were the primary local unit by which US territories and states extended civilian authority over newly acquired territory. Of the five mainland states in this Part, counties’ imperial role was more prominent because of contested boundaries. Utah, Nevada, and California each used counties to extend and defend their state boundaries with their American neighbors, and Oregon and Washington counties were part of international contests with what is now Canada. Alaska’s “boroughs” are not counties by another name; they are a unique political experiment that responded to the acquisition from Russia of a vast, lightly populated, and unfamiliar area. Hawaii’s exclusive reliance on counties for local governance reflects the extreme centralization of power in Honolulu that was a product of King Kamehameha’s conquest of the islands and the annexation of the kingdom by the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文是《美国县制起源》系列论文的第五篇，考察了犹他州、内华达州、加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州、华盛顿州、阿拉斯加州和夏威夷州七个西部/太平洋沿岸州的县级政府起源。文章认为县级政府是帝国扩张的代理人，是美国领土和州在新获得土地上扩展民事权力的主要地方单位。这些州的县制起源各有独特背景：犹他、内华达和加利福尼亚用县来延伸和捍卫与邻州的边界；俄勒冈和华盛顿的县涉及与加拿大的国际竞争；阿拉斯加的"自治市镇"（boroughs）并非县的别名，而是一种独特的政治实验；夏威夷对县级治理的依赖反映了檀香山权力极端集中的历史。
AI.research_question: 美国西部及太平洋沿岸各州（犹他、内华达、加利福尼亚、俄勒冈、华盛顿、阿拉斯加、夏威夷）的县级政府是如何起源的？它们在美国领土扩张和帝国建设中扮演了怎样的角色？
AI.motivation: 县级政府是美国最不被理解的地方政府形式，本研究旨在通过对五十个州县级政府起源的系统考察，揭示其历史演变和持久性，特别是关注帝国扩张背景下县级政府在领土控制中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: "县级政府作为帝国代理人"（counties as agents of empire）的理论框架，即县级政府是美国领土和州在新获得土地上扩展民事权威的主要地方单位。
AI.method: 历史档案与文献分析，对各州的县制起源进行历史叙述和比较分析，涵盖西部有争议的边界、阿拉斯加从俄国购买的特殊情况以及夏威夷并入美国的历史过程。
AI.findings: 1) 县级政府在帝国扩张中发挥核心作用；2) 犹他、内华达和加利福尼亚利用县来延伸和捍卫州边界；3) 俄勒冈和华盛顿的县涉及与加拿大（时为英国殖民地）的国际边界争端；4) 阿拉斯加的"boroughs"不是县的简单变体，而是一种适应于广袤、人口稀少、陌生领土的独特政治实验；5) 夏威夷对县的依赖源自卡美哈梅哈国王征服群岛和王国被美国吞并后形成的檀香山极端集权结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"县作为帝国代理"的理论视角，揭示了县级政府在领土扩张和国家建设中容易被忽视的重要作用，并通过阿拉斯加和夏威夷的案例展示了县制在不同政治历史背景下的变异和适应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国县级政府的历史根源和持续存在提供了系统性的历史记录，有助于地方治理研究和政策制定者更好地理解县级政府的制度惯性及其在不同州际背景下的多样性。

title:
Reversibility as a Factor of Production : 
A General Theory of the Economics of Error

detail.title:
Reversibility as a Factor of Production : 
A General Theory of the Economics of Error
detail.abstract:
This article introduces reversibility — the yield at which an economy converts its failures into
reusable knowledge while preserving the capacity of agents to try again — as a factor of
production in its own right, and develops the general theory that follows from that single
amendment. A coefficient 𝜌 ∈ [0,1], decomposable into financial, legal, social, cognitive and
political components arranged in series, governs (i) the accumulation of an unmeasured stock of
experience capital, (ii) the volume of experimentation through an entry threshold that rationalizes
the observed prudence of poor economies, and (iii) the depth of hysteresis after shocks. The
interaction of these three channels generates a conformity trap with cusp-catastrophe geometry,
refutable early-warning signatures, and an asymmetric law of belief adjustment — the law of
freeze and thaw — microfounded as exact nonlinear filtering of a hidden institutional regime. On
this basis the paper establishes an aggregation theorem for a Reversibility Index, a bang-bang
optimal-reform result (the clean-jump theorem), and a series of amendments to canonical theories
— Ricardian trade, the Phillips curve, Modigliani–Miller, the Keynesian multiplier, prospect-
theoretic loss aversion, Eaton–Gersovitz sovereign debt, and Holmström–Milgrom contracts —
each of which is recovered exactly in the limit 𝜌 → 1. The construction closes with a general
theory organized around five axioms and an invariant (an institutional analogue of the Carnot
bound), a McKean–Vlasov field equation for the distribution of beliefs, a notion of economic
proper time whose dilation defines underdevelopment, and a correspondence principle showing that received economic theory is the zeroth-order term of an expansion in (1 − 𝜌). Ten signed
predictions and six prohibitions expose the theory to refutation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可逆性"（经济将失败转化为可重用知识并保持行动者再试能力的能力）作为独立的生产要素，构建了一个包含金融、法律、社会、认知和政治五个维度（串联分解）的系数ρ∈[0,1]。该系数通过三条渠道（经验资本积累、进入门槛调节实验量、冲击后滞后深度）塑造经济行为，这些渠道的交互产生"一致性陷阱"（具有尖点突变几何）、可证伪的早期预警信号和"冻结-解冻"不对称信念调整定律。论文还建立了可逆性指数的聚合定理、最优改革的"干净跳跃定理"，并证明在ρ→1极限下可还原李嘉图贸易、菲利普斯曲线、莫迪利亚尼-米勒定理等经典理论。最终形成一个以五个公理和制度类比卡诺界的不变量为核心的一般理论体系。
AI.research_question: 如何将"可逆性"作为一个独立的生产要素纳入经济理论，并发展由此衍生的一般理论框架？该理论如何统一解释贫困经济体的谨慎性、冲击后的滞后现象以及经典理论的极限情形？
AI.motivation: 现有经济理论将失败视为纯成本或外部性，忽略了失败转化为可重用知识的能力。作者观察到贫困经济体表现出系统性的实验谨慎和改革滞后，这无法用传统生产要素和市场失灵完全解释，因而需要引入"可逆性"作为独立的生产要素来填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文构建了整合多个理论模块的框架：(1) 可逆性系数ρ的串联分解（金融、法律、社会、认知、政治五维）；(2) 经验资本的不可观测积累模型；(3) 尖点突变几何中的一致性陷阱；(4) 非线性滤波微基础化的信念调整定律（冻结-解冻定律）；(5) 制度模拟热力学的卡诺界不变量；(6) McKean-Vlasov场方程描述信念分布；(7) 经济固有时间概念（膨胀即欠发达）；(8) 对应原理——经典理论是(1-ρ)展开的零阶项。
AI.method: 理论建模与演绎推导方法，包括：非线性滤波理论（隐藏制度状态的精确滤波）、突变论（尖点突变几何）、McKean-Vlasov随机场方程、最优控制理论（bang-bang控制）、热力学类比（卡诺界）、以及对应原理（在ρ→1极限下还原经典理论）。论文还提出十个有符号的预测和六个禁令以暴露理论于可证伪性检验。
AI.findings: (1) ρ系数通过三个渠道共同作用产生"一致性陷阱"（cusp-catastrophe几何）：当ρ低于临界值时，经济陷入低实验、低经验积累、高滞后的自强化均衡；(2) "冻结-解冻定律"描述了信念调整的显著不对称性——制度恶化时信念"冻结"缓慢调整，制度改善时信念"解冻"快速调整；(3) 最优改革是bang-bang性质的"干净跳跃"——改革要么不做，要么彻底；（4）在ρ→1极限下，所有经典理论（李嘉图贸易、菲利普斯曲线、Modigliani-Miller、凯恩斯乘数、前景理论损失厌恶、Eaton-Gersovitz主权债务、Holmström-Milgrom合约）都被精确还原；(5) 可逆性指数的聚合定理保证微观层面的可逆性可以聚合为宏观指数。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将"可逆性"提升为独立生产要素，拓展了生产函数和增长理论；(2) 建立了可逆性指数（五维串联分解）的可测聚合定理，为实证研究提供基础；(3) 通过"干净跳跃定理"给出了最优改革的bang-bang性质，对渐进主义改革理论构成挑战；(4) 提出"冻结-解冻"不对称信念调整定律，丰富了制度变迁和信念动态理论；(5) 以对应原理统一了多个经典理论——将它们视为(1-ρ)展开的零阶近似，展示了通用理论框架的整合力；(6) 提出"经济固有时间"概念及其膨胀与欠发达的等价关系；(7) 引入制度模拟的热力学类比（卡诺界不变量），为制度经济学提供新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为欠发达国家的改革时机和策略提供理论指导——改革应"干净跳跃"而非渐进主义；(2) 可逆性指数的五维分解为政策制定者提供了诊断工具，可识别制度中制约经济转型的薄弱环节；(3) 一致性陷阱的尖点突变几何和早期预警信号可用于预测制度性危机；(4) "冻结-解冻"定律指导危机沟通和预期管理策略；(5) 十个可证伪预测和六个禁令为实证检验和政策评估提供了清晰的基准。

title: Why Pakistan's Exports are Stagnant: A Macroeconomic Perspective

detail.title: Why Pakistan's Exports are Stagnant: A Macroeconomic Perspective
detail.abstract: In this paper, the macroeconomic determinants of the real export stagnation of Pakistan during 1980-2022 are researched, based on 43 annual observations. The key empirical driving force is a startling paradox: though the nominal exports of Pakistan increased by USD 2.98 billion to USD 39.5 billion within this time frame, the real exports (adjusted by a CPI index, the base year 2010) decreased by about 46 percent of its real exports in 1980. Pakistan is now a net exporter of less than what it used to export in the past 40 years. The aim of this paper is to find the structural factors behind this collapse and provide evidence-based policy recommendations to reverse it. The Augmented Dickey-Fuller, Phillips-Perron and KPSS Unit root tests indicate a combination of I(0) and I(1) terms with no I(2) series, which validates the applicability of the ARDL Bounds Testing framework of Pesaran, Shin, and Smith (2001). The AIC criterion is used to select a parsimonious model that includes six theoretically motivated determinants ln(REER), GDP Growth, Financial Development, Institutional Quality (Fraser Institute EFW), ln(Real Oil Price), and a structural Energy Crisis dummy (2007-2015). The Bounds F-test gives a value 3.819 (p = 0.035), which ascertains the long-run cointegration at the 5% level of significance. The -0.393 (p < 0.001) Error Correction Term confirms that the error is corrected at a rate of 39.3% per year, which means that it will take about 2.5 years to restore the export volumes to the long-run equilibrium after any shock. There are four long-run determinants that come out as statistically significant. The most powerful driver is the Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER), which has an elasticity of -1.168, such that a 1% real appreciation decreases the real exports by 1.17%. The long-run effect of GDP Growth is small and positive ( +0.106). Financial Development has a positive but a low effect (0.028), limited by the long-term government crowding-out of private credit. Most notably, the Institutional Quality has a large negative long-run coefficient (-0.456) which can be interpreted to mean that the process of institutional liberalisation of Pakistan through the Fraser EFW model, especially trade and financial liberalisation, has been implemented without the necessary supply-side adjustments to convert institutional change into export competitiveness. A Non-Linear ARDL (NARDL) model, as a robustness check, breaks down REER into two cumulative partial sums (positive (appreciation) and negative (depreciation)). Findings indicate that appreciation hurts exports worse (-1.529) than depreciation helps them better (-0.975), a 57% asymmetric differential, but the Wald test (F = 0.696, p = 0.411) does not reject the statement of symmetry at standard significance levels, allowing us to assert the symmetric ARDL as the desirable specification. Every diagnostic test, including Breusch-Godfrey, Breusch-Pagan, White Test, Jarque-Bera, ARCH, Ramsey RESET, VIF, CUSUM and CUSUMSQ have been passed, and HAC-robust standard errors validate all results. The policy recommendations are aimed at the economic planners in Pakistan and the international development partners. The first lever of highest priority that needs to be acted upon is the exchange rate. Institutional reform needs to be refocused on liberalisation quality, rather than quantity, focusing on contract enforcement and commercial dispute resolution. The medium-term imperatives include export finance reform, via the Export Finance Scheme of the SBP, and the turnaround in the crowding-out of private credit

AI.tldr: 本文研究了巴基斯坦1980-2022年间实际出口停滞的宏观决定因素，发现尽管名义出口大幅增长，但实际出口（以2010年为基期的CPI调整后）较1980年下降了约46%。通过ARDL边界检验框架，识别出四个显著的长期决定因素：实际有效汇率（REER）弹性为-1.168（最强驱动力）、GDP增长（+0.106）、金融发展（+0.028）和制度质量（-0.456，负效应）。NARDL稳健性检验表明升值对出口的损害（-1.529）大于贬值对出口的促进（-0.975），但Wald检验未拒绝对称性假设。所有诊断检验均通过。政策建议聚焦于汇率管理、制度质量改革（关注质量而非数量）和出口融资改革。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦1980-2022年间实际出口停滞的宏观结构性决定因素是什么？如何逆转这一实际出口崩溃趋势？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦存在一个惊人的悖论：名义出口从29.8亿美元增长至395亿美元，但实际出口（CPI调整后）却较1980年下降了约46%，成为过去40年实际出口净减少的国家。这种名义增长与实际衰退的巨大反差亟需结构性解释和实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: ARDL边界协整检验框架（Pesaran, Shin, and Smith, 2001）；非对称NARDL模型；购买力平价与实际有效汇率理论；制度经济学（Fraser Institute EFW制度质量指数）；金融发展与出口关系理论
AI.method: 基于43个年度观测值（1980-2022），运用ADF、PP、KPSS单位根检验确认I(0)和I(1)混合序列；采用ARDL Bounds Testing框架进行长期协整分析，AIC准则选择简约模型；包含六个决定因素：ln(REER)、GDP增长、金融发展、制度质量（EFW）、ln(实际油价)和能源危机虚拟变量（2007-2015）；以NARDL模型作为稳健性检验，将REER分解为累积正负偏和；通过完整的诊断检验（Breusch-Godfrey、Breusch-Pagan、White、Jarque-Bera、ARCH、Ramsey RESET、VIF、CUSUM、CUSUMSQ）验证模型稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）边界F检验值3.819（p=0.035）确认5%显著性水平下的长期协整关系；（2）误差修正项为-0.393，表明每年修正39.3%的偏差，约2.5年恢复到长期均衡；（3）四个显著的长期决定因素：REER弹性为-1.168（1%实际升值导致实际出口下降1.17%）、GDP增长+0.106、金融发展+0.028、制度质量-0.456（负面）；（4）NARDL显示升值对出口的损害（-1.529）比贬值对出口的促进（-0.975）强57%，但Wald检验（F=0.696，p=0.411）不拒绝对称性假设，确认对称ARDL为理想设定。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）揭示了制度自由化改革在缺乏供给侧配套调整时会对出口竞争力产生负面效应的实证证据，丰富了制度经济学与国际贸易的交叉理论；（2）提供了发展中国家实际出口停滞的新证据，挑战了名义出口增长即代表出口绩效的传统认知；（3）验证了REER作为发展中国家出口决定因素的强解释力，并量化了非对称效应的程度。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为巴基斯坦经济规划者提供优先政策杠杆排序：汇率管理为首要任务，制度改革的重点应从自由化数量转向质量（合同执行和商业争议解决）；（2）提出中期政策建议：通过SBP出口融资计划改革出口金融体系，扭转政府对私人信贷的挤出效应；（3）为国际发展伙伴提供巴基斯坦的实际出口恢复战略参考。

title:
Beyond Premiums: 
Rethinking Insurance Adoption in Africa through the Savings-linked Insurance Model (SLIM)

detail.title:
Beyond Premiums: 
Rethinking Insurance Adoption in Africa through the Savings-linked Insurance Model (SLIM)
detail.abstract:
Despite sustained efforts to improve insurance uptake across Africa, adoption remains persistently low. Existing literature primarily attributes this challenge to affordability, trust, access, and financial literacy. While these factors are well established, this discussion paper argues that they may not fully explain the behavioural barriers influencing insurance decisions.

Drawing on insights from behavioural economics and consumer psychology, the paper proposes the Savings-Linked Insurance Model (SLIM) as a conceptual framework for rethinking how insurance is presented to low-income households. Rather than viewing low adoption solely as a problem of access or awareness, SLIM advances the hypothesis that individuals may psychologically experience insurance premiums as a perceived loss when no claim is made. By repositioning savings as the primary value proposition and embedding insurance protection within a savings-oriented structure, the model seeks to reduce this perceived loss while preserving the risk-pooling function of insurance.

This paper does not present empirical findings or advocate for immediate implementation. Instead, it introduces a testable behavioural hypothesis intended to stimulate further research, experimentation, and policy discussion. It concludes by outlining a research agenda spanning behavioural experiments, actuarial modelling, consumer testing, and regulatory analysis to evaluate the viability of the proposed framework.

The discussion contributes to ongoing conversations on financial inclusion, insurance innovation, and sustainable development by suggesting that improving insurance adoption may require not only addressing economic barriers but also reconsidering how insurance is psychologically experienced by prospective users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出储蓄联动保险模型（SLIM）作为概念框架，从行为经济学和消费者心理学视角重新思考非洲低收入家庭保险采纳率低的问题。该模型的核心假设是：人们可能在未理赔时将保费视为心理损失，而通过将储蓄作为主要价值主张、将保险嵌入储蓄导向结构中，可以降低这种感知损失，同时保留风险共担功能。论文不提供实证发现，而是提出一个可检验的行为假设和研究议程。
AI.research_question: 非洲低收入家庭保险采纳率持续偏低的行为障碍是什么？如何通过重新设计保险的价值呈现方式来克服这些障碍？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将低保险采纳率归因于可负担性、信任、获取渠道和金融素养等经济因素，但这些因素可能无法完全解释影响保险决策的行为障碍。本文旨在提出一个新的概念视角来弥补这一解释缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学与消费者心理学，特别是损失厌恶理论（前景理论）——个体将未理赔的保费视为感知损失；储蓄-保险整合框架。
AI.method: 本文为概念性/讨论性论文，不包含实证研究。采用理论推导和概念框架构建的方法，提出可检验的假设，并规划涵盖行为实验、精算建模、消费者测试和监管分析的研究议程。
AI.findings: 本文无实证发现。核心理论贡献是提出"保费感知损失"假设——当投保人未获得理赔时，可能在心理上将保费支出视为损失，这一认知可能导致对保险的低采纳。SLIM模型通过将储蓄作为主要价值主张来重新定位保险产品以降低这种感知损失。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将损失厌恶理论引入保险采纳研究，提出"感知损失"机制解释低收入家庭保险决策；（2）提出SLIM作为新的概念框架，将储蓄与保险整合以缓解行为障碍；（3）为金融包容性和保险创新研究提供了新的理论视角，超越了传统的经济障碍解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为保险产品设计者提供了重新架构保险产品价值主张的新思路——以储蓄为核心、保险为保障；（2）为政策制定者提供了针对保险采纳"行为障碍"的讨论基础；（3）提出了一项具体的研究议程，指导未来在行为实验、精算模型、消费者测试和监管分析方面的实践探索。

title: Those Who Collect Taxes Use Transfers Better: Evidence of Decentralization Design and Service Outcomes in Bolivia

detail.title: Those Who Collect Taxes Use Transfers Better: Evidence of Decentralization Design and Service Outcomes in Bolivia

publicationDetails.detailsText: Latin American Journal of Economic Development (LAJED) N° 45, Mayo 2026-Octubre 2026, pp. 47-82

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the design elements of decentralization--own-revenue effort, operations and maintenance (opex), capital expenditure (capex), and total execution--help explain municipal differences in poverty-relevant service conditions and their downstream influence on human capital and the local economy. A recursive SEM is estimated within departments, with services defined as an SDG1-based composite. Robustness replaces the mediator with a basic-infrastructure services composite (biservices1) and reparameterizes execution as total executed expenditure per capita. Four results stand out: (i) own-revenue effort is the strongest predictor of services, while execution scale is positive but smaller; in composition, opex—not capex—supports services; (ii) capex influences the economy directly, consistent with an investment pass-through; (iii) higher services raise the predicted level of human-capital and economic outcomes in the model, with the former path larger; and (iv) population scale and density matter. The pattern is consistent with a flypaper-with-effort interpretation: where fiscal effort and operations and maintenance (O&M) discipline are present, available resources—including transfers—translate more effectively into poverty-relevant service conditions. At the same time, investment directly influences the economy.  Estimates are directed influences within the maintained model,  not counterfactual causal effects. Policy implications: (i) embed effort-compatible transfers so own-source revenue unlocks additional grant resources; (ii) protect O&M floors to keep assets working; (iii) pair new capex with credible O&M plans; and (iv) keep services abreast of agglomeration.

AI.tldr: 本文运用递归结构方程模型（SEM），检验地方分权四大设计要素——自有收入努力、运营维护支出（opex）、资本支出（capex）和总执行——如何影响与贫困相关的公共服务条件，并进一步传导至人力资本和本地经济。研究发现：自有收入努力是服务条件的最强预测因子，opex而非capex支撑服务供给，capex直接作用于经济（投资传导效应），服务条件对人力资本的影响大于对经济的影响，人口规模与密度也显著相关。结果支持"粘蝇纸加努力"（flypaper-with-effort）的解读，并提出四项政策建议。
AI.research_question: 地方分权设计要素（自有收入努力、opex、capex、总执行）如何解释市级贫困相关服务条件的差异，以及这些服务条件如何进一步影响人力资本和本地经济？
AI.motivation: 在地方分权改革中，财政资源的规模与构成对减贫服务效果的传导机制尚不清晰，尤其是不同分权设计要素（收入端努力与支出端构成）对服务条件和下游发展成果的相对贡献缺乏实证证据，需要厘清以指导分权政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政联邦主义与分权理论，结合"粘蝇纸效应"（flypaper effect）理论延伸出的"flypaper-with-effort"框架，强调财政努力和运维纪律是转移支付转化为有效服务条件的关键调节机制。
AI.method: 在省（部门）内估计递归结构方程模型（recursive SEM），以SDG1（消除贫困）为基础的复合指标定义服务条件作为中介变量；稳健性检验采用基础基础设施服务复合指标（biservices1）替换中介变量，并将执行变量重新参数化为按人均总执行支出。
AI.findings: 四项核心结果：（i）自有收入努力是服务条件的最强预测因子，执行规模效应为正但较小；在构成上，opex而非capex支撑服务；（ii）capex直接影响经济，符合投资传导机制；（iii）更高的服务条件提升模型中人力资本和经济成果的预测水平，且前者路径效应更大；（iv）人口规模与密度显著相关。整体模式符合"flypaper-with-effort"解读。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分分权设计中不同财政要素（收入努力、opex、capex、执行规模）对贫困相关服务条件及其下游人力资本和经济成果的差异化影响，提出并实证支持"flypaper-with-effort"扩展框架，丰富了分权与减贫关系的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项政策建议：（i）嵌入与努力兼容的转移支付机制，使自有收入解锁额外拨款资源；（ii）设置运维（O&M）最低下限以保持资产持续运作；（iii）新资本支出必须配套可信的运维计划；（iv）服务供给需跟上人口集聚（城市化）的步伐。

title: Import Price Shocks, FX-Monetary Policies, and Real Income Stabilization

detail.title: Import Price Shocks, FX-Monetary Policies, and Real Income Stabilization
detail.abstract: We characterize jointly optimal exchange rate and monetary policies under commitment in a heterogeneous-agent, import-dependent small open economy facing essential import price spikes. When some households are borrowing constrained, exchange rate management becomes a tool for real income stabilization through the intertemporal margin, requiring temporary interest parity deviations, while optimal monetary policy targets the labor wedge. In an open economy, these roles are not substitutable. A Ramsey planner internalizes how pecuniary general equilibrium effects from real exchange rate movements redistribute real incomes: facing a spike, the planner leans against the depreciation, cutting exports and shifting resources toward constrained households through higher real wages. Calibrated to Japan's 2022 energy price path, optimal policy departs from representative-agent prescriptions and uses FX interventions to cut the contemporaneous co-movement of the real exchange rate with world energy prices while accepting costly interest parity deviations. Monetary policy complements FX policy by taking a disinflationary stance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在异质性主体、依赖进口的小型开放经济中，面对必需品进口价格飙升时，承诺机制下最优汇率政策与货币政策的联合设计。当部分家庭面临借贷约束时，汇率管理通过跨期渠道成为实际收入稳定的工具，需要暂时偏离利率平价；而最优货币政策则针对劳动楔子。在开放经济中，这两种角色不可替代。Ramsey计划者内部化了实际汇率变动通过货币性一般均衡效应再分配实际收入的机制：面对价格冲击时，计划者抑制贬值、削减出口，通过提高实际工资将资源转向受约束家庭。以日本2022年能源价格路径校准，最优政策偏离代表性主体处方，使用外汇干预削减实际汇率与世界能源价格的同期联动，同时接受昂贵的利率平价偏离。货币政策通过采取紧缩立场来补充外汇政策。
AI.research_question: 在面临必需品进口价格飙升的异质性主体小开放经济中，承诺机制下的最优汇率政策与货币政策应如何联合设计？
AI.motivation: 传统代表性主体框架下的最优货币与汇率政策处方无法捕捉异质性家庭间的再分配效应。当部分家庭受到借贷约束时，实际汇率变动会产生重要的货币性一般均衡效应，通过实际工资和收入渠道在不同家庭间进行再分配，这要求重新审视开方式经济中汇率管理与货币政策的角色分工。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济宏观经济学中的最优政策设计框架（Ramsey计划者）、异质性主体模型（HANK）、新凯恩斯主义框架、利率平价理论、借贷约束模型。
AI.method: 构建异质性主体小型开放经济模型（包含借贷约束家庭与无约束家庭），在承诺机制下求解Ramsey最优政策问题，并以日本2022年能源价格冲击路径进行数值校准和政策模拟。
AI.findings: （1）当存在借贷约束家庭时，汇率管理成为实际收入稳定化的工具（通过跨期边际），需要暂时的利率平价偏离；货币政策则聚焦于劳动楔子，两者不可替代。（2）Ramsey计划者会抑制本币贬值、削减出口，通过更高实际工资将资源转移给受约束家庭。（3）在日本的校准中，最优政策使用外汇干预降低实际汇率与世界能源价格的同期联动，同时接受昂贵的利率平价偏离；货币政策配合采取紧缩（反通胀）立场。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在异质性主体开放经济框架中联合刻画最优汇率与货币政策，揭示了两者角色在存在金融约束时的不可替代性。（2）阐明了实际汇率变动的货币性一般均衡效应如何通过再分配渠道影响最优政策设计，将再分配考量系统融入开放经济最优政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临进口价格冲击的小型开放经济体（如日本）提供了外汇干预与货币政策的联合处方：应使用外汇干预对冲能源价格冲击对实际汇率的传导，同时以紧缩性货币政策配合稳定通胀预期，而非依赖单一政策工具。

reference: The 14th Annual International Scientific and Practical Conference "Insurance AI: A New Era in Global Insurance?", MGIMO, 2025
title: Artificial Intelligence in Energy Risk Underwriting
affiliations: MGIMO and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Energy Risk Underwriting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO) - Master's Student Sogaz (Russian Insurance Company) - Worker

publicationDetails.detailsText: The 14th Annual International Scientific and Practical Conference "Insurance AI: A New Era in Global Insurance?", MGIMO, 2025

detail.abstract: The ongoing transformation of the insurance industry through artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as one of the most significant developments of recent years. Now AI is permeating a broad range of business processes: from dynamic underwriting to automated claims handling. However, in energy risk insurance this shift faces substantial constraints. The sector's defining characteristics-highly distinctive features of each asset, considerable insured values, and the inherent unpredictability of the risks involved-demand not only computational accuracy, but also profound professional judgment. This paper advances the thesis that, in the context of energy insurance, AI should be considered solely as a support tool-one that augments, yet in no way supplants, the underwriter's professional expertise.

AI.tldr: 本文论述了在能源风险保险领域，人工智能应仅作为辅助工具来增强而非取代核保人的专业判断。该行业资产特征高度独特、保额巨大、风险固有不确定性，这些特性决定了AI无法替代人类专业判断。
AI.research_question: 在能源风险保险中，人工智能应扮演什么角色？它能否取代核保人的专业判断？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在广泛渗透保险业的各个业务流程（从动态核保到自动理赔），但在能源风险保险领域面临重大制约。该行业资产高度独特、保额巨大、风险不可预测，这些特性导致AI应用面临挑战，需要明确AI的定位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源风险保险行业特征（资产独特性、高保额、风险不可预测性）的分析框架，论证AI与人类专业判断之间的人机协同关系。
AI.method: 基于行业特征的理论论证与分析，通过分析能源保险领域的独特性来论证AI应作为支持工具的论点。
AI.findings: 在能源保险背景下，AI应仅作为支持工具使用——它能够增强核保人的专业能力，但绝不能取代核保人的专业判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在高度专业化、高风险保险领域的角色边界提供了理论澄清，区分了AI可增强与不可取代的判断维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源保险行业在引入AI技术时提供了清晰的定位指引，避免过度依赖AI而忽视专业判断带来的风险。

title: Who Backs Women? Business Angels' Traits and Investment in Female Entrepreneurship
affiliations: University of Piemonte Orientale - Department of Economics and Business Studies, , Universita Del Piemonte Orientale and

detail.title: Who Backs Women? Business Angels' Traits and Investment in Female Entrepreneurship

declarations.funderStatement: The data used in this study were collected within the BAC4SHC project ("Business Angels and Crowd investors for startups' human capital"), which has received funding from the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (Staff Exchanges), grant agreement No 101129958 (HORIZON-MSCA-2022-SE-01-01).

detail.abstract: Despite growing scholarly attention to gender disparities in entrepreneurial finance, existing research has predominantly focused on venture-level characteristics to explain the funding gap faced by women-led ventures. How investor-side traits relate to this gap remains an open and underexplored question. Drawing on a unique survey dataset of 84 business angels (BAs) operating across Italy, France, Belgium, and the Netherlands, this study provides pioneering evidence on the associations between BAs' personal characteristics, human capital, investment practices, and their exposure to women-led ventures. We identify consistent empirical associations: membership in an angel network and co-investment alongside venture capital funds are each positively related to greater exposure to female entrepreneurship. These associations remain stable across alternative model specifications. Taken together, our findings shift the analytical lens from the demand side to the supply side of the angel market and have direct implications for angel network design, investor training, and policy initiatives aimed at broadening women entrepreneurs' access to early-stage capital.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于意大利、法国、比利时和荷兰84位商业天使投资人的独特调查数据，首次从投资者供给侧视角探讨性别融资差距，发现天使网络成员身份及与风险资本联合投资与接触女性创业项目呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 投资者侧的个人特征、人力资本和投资实践如何与他们对女性创业项目的接触（exposure）相关联？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要从企业层面（需求侧）特征解释女性主导企业的融资差距，投资者侧（供给侧）特质如何影响这一差距仍未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别差异与创业金融理论，将分析视角从天使市场的需求侧转向供给侧。
AI.method: 基于84位商业天使投资人的独特调查数据集，采用实证回归分析（跨意大利、法国、比利时和荷兰），并通过多种模型规格检验结果的稳健性。
AI.findings: 天使网络成员身份和与风险投资基金联合投资分别与接触女性创业项目呈正相关，该关联在多种模型规格下保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别融资差距的研究焦点从需求侧（企业特征）转向供给侧（投资者特质），填补了投资者侧因素如何影响女性创业融资不足的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为天使网络设计、投资人培训和拓展女性创业者早期资本获取渠道的政策举措提供直接启示。

title: Who Provides It Matters: Source Characteristics and Trust in Online Information
affiliations: , University of Mannheim - Department of Economics and University of Mannheim - Department of Economics

detail.title: Who Provides It Matters: Source Characteristics and Trust in Online Information
detail.abstract: We study how observable characteristics of information sources shape individuals' evaluations of their content. In an online experiment, we vary source characteristics while holding content constant. We find that disclosing these characteristics leaves both the content's perceived accuracy and the willingness to share it largely unaffected but substantially shapes trust in the source. Highly educated sources are trusted more; disclosing low education, popularity, and Republican affiliation each reduces trust. Participants sort across sources based on observable characteristics even before seeing any content, suggesting that source cues serve as credibility signals that influence who is trusted and heard.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在线实验，在保持内容不变的情况下操纵信息来源的可观察特征，发现这些特征披露对内容感知准确性和分享意愿影响甚微，但显著影响对来源的信任度。高学历来源更受信任；披露低学历、高人气和共和党隶属关系均降低信任。参与者在看到内容之前就会根据来源特征进行筛选，表明来源线索作为可信度信号影响谁被信任和倾听。
AI.research_question: 信息来源的可观察特征如何影响个体对信息内容及其来源的评价？
AI.motivation: 在信息过载和虚假信息泛滥的时代，人们如何评估信息来源的可信度是一个关键问题。理解来源特征（如学历、政治倾向、人气）如何影响信任判断，有助于解释信息传播中的偏见和信息生态失衡现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源可信度信号理论（source credibility signaling），涉及启发式处理（heuristic processing）和线索理论（cues theory）
AI.method: 在线随机实验（online experiment），在控制内容不变的条件下系统性地操纵来源的可观察特征（学历、人气、政治隶属），测量参与者对内容感知准确性、分享意愿以及来源信任度的反应。
AI.findings: （1）披露来源特征对内容感知准确性和分享意愿影响不大；（2）但这些特征显著影响对来源本身的信任；（3）高学历来源获得更高信任；（4）披露低学历、高人气、共和党隶属均降低信任；（5）参与者在看到内容前就会基于来源特征进行来源筛选，表明来源线索作为可信度信号起作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了来源特征对信任判断的独立影响机制，表明来源线索作为可信度信号在信息接收之前就已发挥作用；区分了来源信任与内容评价两个不同维度，说明二者可以被来源特征差异性地影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息平台设计、新闻传播策略和公共传播实践提供启示：来源的可见标识（如学历、政治标签、人气指数）会影响受众信任度，平台在展示来源信息时需考虑这些特征对信任塑造的潜在影响。

title: Protracted Processes and the Timing of Disclosure After the Listing Act

detail.title: Protracted Processes and the Timing of Disclosure After the Listing Act
detail.abstract: The Listing Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2809) and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/789 have recast the timing o fissuers’ disclosure under Article 17 MAR: the prohibition of insider dealing continues to attach to inside information as soon as it arises, while the duty to disclose is, for protracted processes, postponed to the final event listed — non-exhaustively — in Annex I to the Delegated Regulation, with a new confidentiality duty covering the intermediate phase. Drawing on the Level 2 record, from ESMA’s consultation to the adopted text, the paper defends an inclusive construction of the notion of protracted process — a participation test rather than a control test — under which any process in which the issuer performs at least some of the steps is disclosed at its final event, including processes whose decisive step lies with an authority, a court or a counterparty. The case for that construction is exegetical and functional alike, since the contrary reading would reintroduce the early disclosure of immature information that the reform sought to avoid. The paper then examines the immediate-disclosure regime of profit warnings and earnings surprises, distinguishing its textually secure ground from its inferential extensions; reads the thirty-five entries of Annex I as a repertoire of formal disclosure anchors available for analogical reasoning; reconstructs the recast relationship between the delay of disclosure and the treatment of intermediate steps; and identifies in the attribution of knowledge to the issuer — now pending before the Court of Justice — the major question that the reform leaves open.

AI.tldr: 本文分析《上市法案》(EU) 2024/2809 及委员会授权条例 (EU) 2026/789 对 MAR 第17条下发行人披露时点的重构：内幕交易禁止仍自内幕信息产生时起适用，但历时性过程的披露义务被推迟至最后事件，且中间阶段适用新的保密义务。作者主张对"历时性过程"作包容性解释（参与测试而非控制测试），并分析盈利预警、附件一清单、披露延迟与中间步骤处理的关系，指出发行人知识归属问题是改革留下的最大未决问题。
AI.research_question: 欧盟Listing Act改革后，如何界定"历时性过程"（protracted process）的范围？改革后延迟披露制度与中间步骤的保密义务如何运作？改革留下的关键未决问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧盟2024年Listing Act和2026年授权条例重构了MAR第17条下发行人的信息披露时点，将历时性过程的披露义务推迟至最后事件，以解决此前过早披露不成熟信息的问题，但"历时性过程"的界定及其法律解释存在重大争议，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟市场滥用监管框架（MAR第17条）、内幕交易禁止与披露义务的区分理论、历时性过程（protracted process）的参与测试与控制测试之争、文本解释与功能解释相结合的法律解释方法。
AI.method: 法律文本分析：对ESMA咨询文件至最终采纳文本的Level 2立法记录进行梳理，对附件一的35个条目进行逐一解读，运用法解释学方法（文义解释、体系解释、目的解释）分析立法意图。
AI.findings: ①"历时性过程"应采取参与测试而非控制测试，只要发行人参与了过程的至少部分步骤，即应在最后事件时披露，即使决定性步骤由当局、法院或交易对手方掌握；②相反解释将导致不成熟信息的过早披露重新出现，违背改革初衷；③盈利预警和盈余意外适用即时披露制度，需区分文本上有坚实依据的部分与推断性扩展；④附件一35个条目可作为正式披露锚点的"剧目"，供类推推理使用；⑤披露延迟与中间步骤处理之间形成新的关系结构。
AI.theory_contributions: ①系统阐明了"历时性过程"概念应采参与测试而非控制测试的法理依据；②从文本与功能两个维度论证了包容性解释的正当性；③重建了延迟披露与中间步骤保密义务之间的规范关系；④识别出发行人知识归属问题（现待欧洲法院裁决）作为改革留下的核心理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为发行人提供了如何界定"历时性过程"的可操作标准（参与测试）；②阐明了附件一35个条目的类推适用方法，为实务中的披露时点判断提供指引；③厘清了盈利预警与盈余意外的即时披露制度边界；④提示市场参与者关注欧洲法院即将裁决的发行人知识归属问题，为合规风险管理提供前瞻性指引。

title: Bayesian Bootstrap Ensembles for Low-Rank Causal Discovery

detail.title: Bayesian Bootstrap Ensembles for Low-Rank Causal Discovery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses exclusively publicly available, de-identiffed datasets.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no speciffc grant from any funding agency. Computing resources were purchased by the author personally.

detail.abstract: Objective: Differentiable causal discovery methods produce point estimates of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) but lack uncertainty quantification. Existing uncertainty-aware methods are limited to d ≤ 50 due to O(d 3) complexity, while genomic studies routinely profile d ≥ 500 genes. We develop a Bayesian bootstrap ensemble of low-rank models to produce posterior edge probabilities under a Dirichlet process prior (Rubin 1981). Results: Low-rank factorization (W = U V ⊤ , r ≪ d) reduces the DAG constraint from O(d 3) to O(dr 2). Dirichlet-weighted Bayesian bootstrap across 20-50 training runs yields ensemble distributions over the adjacency matrix, outperforming standard resampling-based bootstrap on difficult configurations: at d = 50, standard bootstrap detects zero edges (F1 = 0.000) while the Bayesian bootstrap recovers edges (F1 = 0.025); at d = 200, the Bayesian bootstrap more than doubles F1 (0.080 vs. 0.034; Supplementary Table S4). On synthetic Erdős-Rényi DAGs (d = 30-500), expected calibration error (ECE) decreases from 0.036 at d = 30 (comparable to DiBS at 0.038) to 0.003 at d = 500, where DiBS is inapplicable. On TCGA BRCA expression data (d = 500, n = 1,218), the 21 edges with posterior probability exceeding baseline (P > 0.1, out of 250,000 candidates) achieve 71.4% combined STRING protein-protein interaction validation precision (vs. 10.6% baseline)-a 6.7-fold enrichment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种贝叶斯自助法集成低秩模型（Bayesian bootstrap ensemble of low-rank models），用于大规模（d≥500）可区分因果发现中的不确定性量化。通过低秩分解将DAG约束从O(d³)降至O(dr²)，并结合Dirichlet加权贝叶斯自助法生成边后验概率，在合成数据与TCGA BRCA基因表达数据上均显著优于标准自助法。
AI.research_question: 如何在d≥500的大规模基因组研究中，为可区分因果发现方法提供有效的不确定性量化（边后验概率），同时克服现有方法O(d³)的计算瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 现有可区分因果发现方法缺乏不确定性量化；已有不确定性感知方法受限于d≤50（O(d³)复杂度），而基因组研究常规涉及d≥500个基因，亟需可扩展的不确定性量化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Dirichlet过程先验（Rubin 1981）、贝叶斯自助法（Bayesian bootstrap）、低秩矩阵分解（W = UVᵀ, r≪d）、可区分因果发现
AI.method: 将邻接矩阵参数化为低秩分解W=UVᵀ（r≪d），将DAG约束复杂度从O(d³)降至O(dr²)；采用Dirichlet加权贝叶斯自助法进行20-50次训练运行，对邻接矩阵的分布进行集成，生成边后验概率。
AI.findings: 在d=50时标准自助法无法检测到边（F1=0.000），贝叶斯自助法恢复边（F1=0.025）；在d=200时贝叶斯自助法F1提高一倍以上（0.080 vs 0.034）；合成Erdős-Rényi DAG上ECE从d=30的0.036（与DiBS的0.038相当）降至d=500的0.003（DiBS无法适用）；TCGA BRCA数据（d=500）中21条边（P>0.1）达到71.4%的STRING蛋白质互作验证精度，较基线10.6%富集6.7倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Dirichlet贝叶斯自助法与低秩分解结合，为大规模因果发现提供可扩展的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架；将DAG约束的计算复杂度从O(d³)降至O(dr²)，拓展了贝叶斯因果推断到大尺度基因组问题的可行边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基因组研究（d≥500）提供实用的因果边不确定性量化工具，可在大规模基因表达数据中鉴别高置信度调控关系，并通过蛋白质互作验证实现6.7倍富集，具有生物发现的实际应用价值。

title: First Impressions Matter: The Lasting Impact of Slanted Media on Attitudes
affiliations: , University of Mannheim - Department of Economics and University of Verona - Department of Economics

detail.title: First Impressions Matter: The Lasting Impact of Slanted Media on Attitudes
detail.abstract: We investigate how slanted articles influence attitudes. We conducted a field experiment in which university students were randomly assigned to different treatments, reading news articles with either a positive or negative slant on both familiar and novel topics over four weeks. We collected students' attitudes weekly and conducted a follow-up survey four weeks after the experiment ended. We find that: a) slanted information significantly shifts attitudes in the intended direction; b) the effect is more substantial for novel topics; c) the first impression about a novel topic shapes attitudes; d) the change in attitudes persists over time. Our findings highlight that media are more effective at shaping initial attitudes than at altering pre-existing ones. Thus, our results show the importance of providing timely information in the early stages of public discourse.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过田野实验发现，带有倾向性的新闻文章能显著影响读者态度，且对新颖话题的影响更大，首次接触形成的第一印象塑造态度，态度改变在实验结束后仍持续。媒体在塑造初始态度方面比改变既有态度更有效。
AI.research_question: 带有倾向性的（正面或负面）新闻文章如何影响读者的态度？这种影响对于熟悉话题和新颖话题有何不同？
