The original model rejects universal leadership recipes and understands performance as a dynamic relationship among person, task, organization, relevant system, and time. It also conceptualizes organizational viability as a heuristic relation of agility and robustness to system complexity. An evidence-weighted integrative review of leadership research from January 2014 through 24 July 2026 examines leadership theory, organizational adaptability, psychological safety and employee voice, shared leadership, temporal person-environment fit, intuition, resilience, meaningful work and well-being, hybrid work, generative artificial intelligence, algorithmic management, and AI governance. Meta-analyses, systematic and integrative reviews, randomized field experiments, peerreviewed primary studies, and authoritative legal and governance sources are prioritized and triangulated. The review largely confirms the relational, systemic, and temporal premises of the 2014 model, while qualifying three claims: the viability equation is a theory heuristic rather than a calibrated metric; intuition is reliable only under identifiable conditions of expertise and feedback; and shared leadership requires vertical framing and accountability. Artificial intelligence adds a new governance dimension because leadership increasingly concerns coupled human-AI systems. The paper develops Viability Leadership as the dynamic meta-capability to preserve purposeful action, learning, and regeneration by continuously rebalancing agility, robustness, resonance, dynamic fit, and governance relative to complexity. Eight propositions and an empirical research agenda are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性工作论文，重新评估并推进了Schließmann（2014）提出的领导力框架，基于2014年至2026年的整合性文献回顾，提出了"活力领导力"（Viability Leadership）作为动态元能力，通过持续平衡敏捷性、稳健性、共鸣、动态匹配和治理来应对复杂性。文章确认了原模型的关系性、系统性和时间性前提，同时也限定了三个主张，并提出八项命题和实证研究议程。
AI.research_question: 如何基于2014年提出的领导力框架，结合2014年至2026年最新的领导力研究证据，重新评估并推进该框架，以应对包括人工智能治理在内的当代领导力挑战？
AI.motivation: 原2014年领导力模型拒绝普遍适用的领导力配方，但需要基于最新研究证据（2014-2026）进行重新评估。特别是人工智能、混合办公等新情境的出现，使领导力面临新的治理维度，亟需一个能整合这些新兴因素的更新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原模型将绩效理解为个人、任务、组织、相关系统与时间之间的动态关系；将组织活力概念化为敏捷性和稳健性与系统复杂性的启发式关系。在此基础上发展了"活力领导力"框架，整合了领导力理论、组织适应性、心理安全感、共享领导力、人-环境匹配、直觉、韧性、意义感、混合办公、AI治理等理论。
AI.method: 采用证据加权整合性综述方法，对2014年1月至2026年7月24日期间的领导力研究进行系统回顾，优先选取并三角验证元分析、系统综述、整合性综述、随机现场实验、同行评议原始研究以及权威法律和治理来源。
AI.findings: 研究大体上确认了2014年模型的关系性、系统性和时间性前提，但限定了三个主张：（1）活力方程是理论启发式而非校准指标；（2）直觉仅在专业知识和反馈的可识别条件下才可靠；（3）共享领导力需要垂直框架和问责制。人工智能为领导力增加了新的治理维度，因为领导力日益涉及人机耦合系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"活力领导力"（Viability Leadership）作为动态元能力的概念框架，整合了敏捷性、稳健性、共鸣、动态匹配和治理五个维度；对原模型的三个主张进行了理论限定和修正；将人工智能治理纳入领导力理论的核心维度；提出八项可检验的研究命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了一种超越单一领导风格的动态元能力框架，帮助其在复杂性环境下持续平衡多重维度；明确了直觉使用的条件边界、共享领导力的实施要求，并指出人工智能治理已成为领导力的新核心职责，为组织实践提供了方向性指导。

title: From Registration to Repayment: Using Bidirectional Debt-Management Behavior as an Early Creditworthiness Signal for Data-Scarce Micro-Merchants in Saudi Arabia

detail.title: From Registration to Repayment: Using Bidirectional Debt-Management Behavior as an Early Creditworthiness Signal for Data-Scarce Micro-Merchants in Saudi Arabia
detail.abstract: Access to formal credit remains a persistent barrier for micro-merchants who lack the transaction history, digital footprint, or credit bureau records that alternative-data lending models typically rely on. While prior research has shown that digital transaction data, behavioral data, social network graphs, and psychometric assessments can improve credit risk assessment for underserved borrowers, these approaches share a common limitation: they all depend on applicants who already possess some minimal financial or digital footprint. Even psychometric tools, designed explicitly to bypass financial history, show weaker predictive power for applicants with no prior banking relationship at all. This gap is especially relevant in Saudi Arabia, where formal credit infrastructure for very small, informal retail businesses remains limited. This paper proposes a novel proxy signal for this underserved "no-file" segment: the bidirectional debt-management behavior micro-merchants exhibit from the moment they register on a digital ledger platform-specifically, how they manage receivables owed to them by customers alongside payables owed to their own suppliers. Unlike prior studies that model the creditworthiness of the end borrower, this framework inverts the analytical lens to examine whether a merchant's own financial management discipline can predict their own creditworthiness before any external lending relationship exists. Grounded in the Dayni platform-an early-stage debt-management application for Saudi micro-merchants-this paper presents a conceptual framework, a proposed variable set, and a staged empirical validation plan, positioning the approach for future testing as platform data matures.

AI.tldr: 本文针对缺乏任何金融或数字足迹的"无档案"微型商户，提出利用其在数字记账平台上双向债务管理行为（应收账款与应付账款的管理）作为信用风险代理信号，颠覆了以往从借款人角度建模的传统视角，转而考察商户自身的财务管理纪律来预测其信用worthiness。研究基于沙特阿拉伯Dayni平台，提出了概念框架、变量体系和分阶段实证验证计划。
AI.research_question: 对于没有任何金融或数字足迹的微型商户，如何利用其在数字记账平台上的双向债务管理行为来预测其信用风险？
AI.motivation: 现有替代数据信用评估方法（数字交易数据、行为数据、社交网络图心、心理测验）都依赖于申请人已具备最低限度的金融或数字足迹。即使在设计上绕过金融历史的心理测验工具，对完全没有银行关系的申请人的预测力也较弱。沙特阿拉伯正规信用基础设施对小型非正式零售企业覆盖不足，亟需新的信用评估代理信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险评估理论、替代数据借贷模型、财务管理纪律与信用worthiness的关系理论
AI.method: 概念性研究：提出概念框架、变量集和分阶段实证验证计划，基于Dayni平台（沙特微型商户早期债务管理应用）的数据，待平台数据成熟后实施测试。
AI.findings: 本文为概念性论文，尚未呈现实证结果。主要成果是提出了一个新型代理信号框架：商户在数字记账平台上注册以来的双向债务管理行为（客户应收账款与供应商应付账款的管理）可作为其信用worthiness的预测指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 翻转了分析视角：从以往建模最终借款人的信用worthiness，转向考察商户自身的财务管理纪律来预测其信用worthiness，填补了"无档案"借款人信用评估的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特及类似市场中的信贷机构提供了一种无需任何金融或数字足迹即可评估微型商户信用风险的方法，有望拓展正规信贷对无档案微型商户的覆盖面。

title: The Political Economy of Mandatory Shareholder Arbitration
affiliations: Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati and

detail.title: The Political Economy of Mandatory Shareholder Arbitration
detail.abstract:
For decades, mandatory arbitration provisions in corporate charters and bylaws—particularly those covering shareholder and federal securities claims—were widely regarded as both legally uncertain and practically unavailable. Their absence did not result from a single express prohibition, but from the interaction of federal regulatory practice and state corporate law. At the federal level, the Securities and Exchange Commission exercised informal but highly effective gatekeeping by opposing arbitration provisions in the IPO process. At the state level, Delaware law preserved judicial adjudication for internal corporate and securities claims, reinforcing a litigation-centered system of shareholder dispute resolution.

In 2025, the SEC disrupted this equilibrium by announcing that the presence of arbitration provisions would no longer affect the effectiveness of a registration statement. This policy shift removed the principal federal constraint and reopened the question whether arbitration may emerge as a viable governance mechanism for public companies. Yet the removal of legal barriers does not by itself determine governance outcomes.

This Article argues that the future of mandatory shareholder arbitration cannot be understood through legal doctrine alone. It must instead be analyzed through the political economy of corporate governance. The adoption of arbitration provisions will depend on the interaction of institutional incentives among Delaware, competing states, federal regulators, corporate managers, institutional investors, and the plaintiffs’ bar. Each of these actors has distinct—and often conflicting—interests in the structure of shareholder dispute resolution.

We show that Delaware’s resistance reflects the centrality of courts to its governance model and the importance of precedent production to its dominance in the market for corporate charters. The SEC’s shift toward disclosure-based regulation, by contrast, reallocates decision-making authority from the regulator to market actors. Institutional investors, managers, and litigation intermediaries further shape the landscape through their responses to arbitration’s potential effects on enforcement, accountability, and litigation risk.

The Article concludes that the persistence of shareholder litigation reflects not merely legal constraints, but a broader institutional equilibrium. The evolution of shareholder arbitration, much like the evolution of corporate governance more generally, depends not only on changes in legal doctrine, but also on the interaction of institutional forces that determine which governance mechanisms are viable—and sustainable—in practice.

 Mandatory arbitration provisions may now be legally conceivable in ways that they were not before, but their widespread adoption remains uncertain. It may ultimately depend on whether early adopters can shift market expectations and perceptions associated with such provisions, much as early adopters of dual-class stock—such as Google and Facebook—contributed to its widespread use, especially among technology companies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了2025年SEC政策转变后，强制性股东仲裁条款在美国上市公司中可能发挥的作用。作者认为，仲裁能否被广泛采用不能仅从法律教义角度理解，而必须通过公司治理的政治经济学来分析——即特拉华州、竞争州、联邦监管机构、公司管理层、机构投资者和原告律师等各方的制度激励互动。文章指出，虽然法律障碍已被移除，但仲裁的广泛采用仍不确定，可能取决于早期采用者能否像谷歌和脸书推广双重股权结构那样，改变市场对该条款的期望和认知。
AI.research_question: 在SEC于2025年取消对章程和内部规章中强制性仲裁条款的联邦监管障碍后，强制性股东仲裁能否以及在何种条件下成为上市公司可行的治理机制？
AI.motivation: 数十年来，上市公司章程中的强制性仲裁条款一直处于法律不确定和实践中不可用的状态，这并非源于单一明确禁令，而是联邦监管实践（SEC通过IPO程序进行非正式但有效的把关）与州公司法（特拉华州保留内部公司及证券索赔的司法审判）互动的结果。2025年SEC宣布仲裁条款不再影响注册声明生效，移除了主要联邦约束，但法律障碍的移除本身并不能决定治理结果，因此需要更深入的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理的政治经济学框架，强调制度均衡（institutional equilibrium）概念，即治理结果由多方行为主体的制度激励互动决定，而非仅由法律教义决定。该框架借鉴了公司特许经营权市场竞争理论（特拉华州通过先例生产维持其主导地位）以及制度变迁理论（早期采用者如何改变市场期望）。
AI.method: 本文采用规范性的法学分析方法，结合政治经济学视角进行多主体制度分析。具体包括：（1）历史分析SEC监管实践与特拉华州公司法的制度渊源；（2）对特拉华州、竞争州、联邦监管机构、公司管理层、机构投资者、原告律师等各方的激励结构进行系统性考察；（3）通过与双重股权结构的采用历史进行类比推理来分析可能的采用路径。
AI.findings: （1）特拉华州的抵制反映了法院在其治理模式中的核心地位，以及先例生产对其在公司特许经营权市场主导地位的重要性；（2）SEC转向以披露为基础的监管，将决策权从监管者重新分配给市场参与者；（3）机构投资者、管理层和诉讼中介机构通过其对仲裁在执法、问责和诉讼风险方面潜在影响的反应，进一步塑造了这一格局；（4）股东诉讼的持续存在不仅反映法律约束，更反映更广泛的制度均衡；（5）仲裁条款的广泛采用仍不确定，可能取决于早期采用者（如谷歌和脸书对双重股权结构的推广）能否改变市场期望和认知。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：（1）将强制性股东仲裁的分析从单纯的法律教义维度拓展到政治经济学维度，提出了理解治理机制可行性的多主体制度均衡分析框架；（2）揭示了特拉华州法院体系在先例生产与特许经营权市场竞争中的制度功能，深化了对州际公司法竞争理论的理解；（3）通过制度均衡概念，解释了为何法律障碍的移除本身不足以导致制度变迁，为理解治理制度变迁的条件和路径提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：（1）为上市公司和公司律师评估是否采纳强制性仲裁条款提供了系统的决策分析框架，帮助各利益相关方理解不同行为主体对仲裁条款的立场和反应；（2）对SEC的监管政策转变提供了制度层面的解读，有助于理解以披露为基础的监管范式的含义；（3）为早期采用者提供了关于如何推动市场期望转变的策略性启示，例如参照双重股权结构在科技公司中的推广路径。

title: Beyond Average Accuracy: Statistical Distinguishability and Temporal Concentration in Data-Rich Macroeconomic Forecasting

detail.title: Beyond Average Accuracy: Statistical Distinguishability and Temporal Concentration in Data-Rich Macroeconomic Forecasting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available aggregate macroeconomic data and does not involve human participants, personal data, animals, or clinical interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Machine-learning forecasts can achieve lower average errors than simple benchmarks without establishing a statistically distinguishable or persistent advantage. This study examines those distinctions in a fixed-length rolling pseudo-out-of-sample exercise using the dated June 2026 FRED-MD vintage, frozen in July 2026. Four U.S. monthly targets—CPI inflation, PCE inflation, industrial production growth, and the monthly change in unemployment—are forecast at horizons of 1, 3, 6, and 12 months. The comparison covers nine individual models and three forecast combinations, using 360-month estimation windows and up to 90 target months from December 2018 through May 2026. XGBoost records the lowest average relative RMSE (0.821) against transformed-series persistence, followed closely by the random-forest variants; the forecast combinations also deliver sizable numerical gains. Formal inference is much less conclusive. After Holm adjustment, none of the 176 squared-error Diebold-Mariano comparisons rejects equal predictive accuracy in favor of an alternative. Five absolute-error comparisons do so, all at the one-month industrial-production horizon. A 90% Model Confidence Set retains all twelve approaches in 25 of 32 target-horizon-loss panels and never retains fewer than ten. Rankings also vary over time: in 12-month rolling evaluations, the winner set changes between adjacent windows in 18% to 38% of cases. Within each model-target-horizon cell, the twelve largest favorable and unfavorable monthly contributions account, on average, for 85.6% of gross improvements and 89.1% of gross deteriorations relative to the benchmark. These patterns persist under longer ranking windows, and the average gain falls sharply when the benchmark's largest-error dates are removed. Lower average loss, statistical distinguishability, and temporal durability are therefore separate properties. For this short, shock-heavy sample, the evidence favors reporting forecast combinations and uncertainty diagnostics alongside the leading models rather than treating a single ex post winner as definitive.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2026年6月版FRED-MD数据（2026年7月冻结），在固定长度滚动伪样本外预测框架下，对四个美国月度目标（CPI通胀、PCE通胀、工业生产增长、失业率月变化）在1、3、6、12个月四个预测时域上比较了九种个体模型和三种预测组合。XGBoost在平均相对RMSE上表现最佳（0.821），但经过Holm调整后，176次均方误差Diebold-Mariano检验无一拒绝等预测精度原假设，排名随时间波动明显，表明较低的平均损失、统计可区分性和时间持久性是三个相互独立的性质。研究建议在报告领先模型的同时提供预测组合和不确定性诊断信息。
AI.research_question: 机器学习预测能否在统计可区分性和时间持久性方面真正超越简单基准模型，而非仅在平均误差上胜出？
AI.motivation: 机器学习预测虽然常能取得更低的平均误差，但这一优势是否具有统计显著性和时间稳定性存在疑问。作者旨在检验较低平均损失、统计可区分性和时间持久性是否为相互独立的性质，从而为预测评估和使用提供更严谨的方法论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测评估理论：Diebold-Mariano检验（均方误差与绝对误差）、模型置信集（Model Confidence Set）、滚动伪样本外预测框架、Holm多重检验调整。
AI.method: 使用2026年6月版FRED-MD数据（2026年7月冻结），采用360个月估计窗口和最多90个目标月份（2018年12月至2026年5月），对四个美国月度目标的1/3/6/12个月时域进行固定长度滚动伪样本外预测。比较九种个体模型和三种预测组合，使用Diebold-Mariano检验（经Holm调整）、90%模型置信集以及12个月滚动排序稳定性分析。
AI.findings: (1) XGBoost取得最低平均相对RMSE（0.821），随机森林变体次之，预测组合也有可观数值改进；(2) 经Holm调整后，176次均方误差DM检验无一拒绝等精度原假设，仅5次绝对误差比较拒绝（全在1个月时域的工业生产预测）；(3) 90%模型置信集在25/32个目标-时域-损失函数面板中保留全部12种方法；(4) 12个月滚动评估中，相邻窗口的胜者集在18%-38%的情况下发生变化；(5) 各模型-目标-时域单元格中，最大的12个有利和不利月度贡献平均占毛改善的85.6%和恶化的89.1%；(6) 移除基准最大误差日期后平均增益急剧下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了较低平均损失、统计可区分性和时间持久性是三个相互独立且需要分别评估的预测性质，丰富了预测评估方法论，指出统计检验的严格性（如Holm调整）会大幅弱化机器学习优势的显著性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对宏观经济预测实践提供建议：在短期、冲击密集的样本中，不应将单一事后（ex post）胜出模型视为定论，而应同时报告预测组合和不确定性诊断信息，以增强预测的稳健性和可靠性。

title: A Theory of Country-Sensitive Financial Modelling (CSFMT): A Conceptual Foundation for Institutional Adaptation in Comparative Financial Systems
affiliations: Institute of Certified Public Accountant ( ICPAP)

detail.title: A Theory of Country-Sensitive Financial Modelling (CSFMT): A Conceptual Foundation for Institutional Adaptation in Comparative Financial Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or other conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a conceptual theory-building paper based on literature synthesis, logical deduction, and cross-disciplinary integration. It does not involve human participants, human data, animals, clinical research, surveys, interviews, or experiments requiring ethics committee or institutional review board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was independently conceived, developed, and completed by the author.

detail.abstract:
The increasing globalization of financial decision-making has encouraged the widespread application of quantitative financial models across jurisdictions with fundamentally different institutional, regulatory, legal, and governance environments. Although this practice has improved analytical consistency, it has also reinforced the implicit assumption that financial models are universally transferable, regardless of institutional context. Existing research has extensively examined institutional diversity, comparative financial systems, legal origins, and governance quality; however, it has not established a comprehensive theoretical foundation explaining how financial models should adapt when applied across institutionally diverse environments.

This paper addresses this gap by developing the Theory of Country-Sensitive Financial Modelling (CSFMT), which argues that financial models are conditionally rather than universally transferable. Using a conceptual theory-building approach based on knowledge synthesis, logical deduction, and cross-disciplinary integration, the study develops the core assumptions, foundational principles, theoretical propositions, and progressive adaptation levels that collectively explain institutional adaptation in financial modelling. The paper further introduces the Alaali Country Adaptation Layer (A-CAL) as the conceptual mechanism through which institutional adaptation can be systematically incorporated within the broader Alaali Financial Models Meta-Framework (AFMF), a conceptual architecture for adaptive financial modelling.

The study contributes to the literature by establishing CSFMT as a new theoretical perspective linking institutional distance to financial model applicability, introducing a progressive adaptation theory comprising Contextual, Parametric, and Structural Adaptation, and positioning institutional adaptation as a fundamental determinant of financial model design rather than merely a contextual consideration. The proposed framework offers conceptual guidance for financial analysts, regulators, policymakers, and researchers, particularly within the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and other emerging-market environments. Future research should focus on operationalizing the theory through empirical validation, adaptation indices, decision-support methodologies, and software assisted implementation. By positioning institutional compatibility as a fundamental determinant of financial model applicability, CSFMT establishes a new conceptual direction for comparative financial modelling that balances global analytical consistency with local institutional relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"国家敏感性金融建模理论"（CSFMT），主张金融模型是条件性而非普遍可迁移的。通过概念性理论构建方法，论文发展了一套核心假设、基本原则、理论命题和渐进式适应层级，并引入了Alaali国家适应层（A-CAL）作为制度化适应的概念机制，嵌入到更广泛的Alaali金融模型元框架（AFMF）中。
AI.research_question: 金融模型在跨制度多样环境中应如何适应？即：当金融模型被应用于制度、监管、法律和治理环境不同的司法管辖区时，应如何进行调整？
AI.motivation: 金融全球化导致量化金融模型被广泛应用于制度环境截然不同的司法管辖区，这强化了"金融模型普遍可转移"的隐含假设。现有研究虽然广泛探讨了制度多样性、比较金融体系、法律起源和治理质量，但缺乏一个综合性的理论基础来解释金融模型在不同制度环境中应如何适应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家敏感性金融建模理论（CSFMT），包含三个核心观点：（1）金融模型是条件性而非普遍可转移的；（2）渐进式适应理论（情境适应、参数适应和结构适应三个层次）；（3）制度距离与金融模型适用性的理论联系。
AI.method: 概念性理论构建方法，基于知识综合、逻辑演绎和跨学科整合。
AI.findings: 发展了CSFMT的核心假设、基本原则、理论命题和渐进式适应层级；引入了Alaali国家适应层（A-CAL）作为制度化适应的概念机制，嵌入到Alaali金融模型元框架（AFMF）中。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）建立CSFMT作为将制度距离与金融模型适用性联系起来的新理论视角；（2）引入包含情境、参数和结构适应的渐进式适应理论；（3）将制度适应定位为金融模型设计的基本决定因素，而非仅仅是情境性考虑因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融分析师、监管者、政策制定者和研究人员提供概念性指导，尤其对海湾合作委员会（GCC）及其他新兴市场环境具有实践意义。未来可操作性方向包括实证验证、适应指数、决策支持方法和软件辅助实施。

title: Form Without Substance? Charter Capital and the Limits of Creditor Protection in Azerbaijani Corporate Law

detail.title: Form Without Substance? Charter Capital and the Limits of Creditor Protection in Azerbaijani Corporate Law
detail.abstract: This paper examines charter capital as a legal institution under the Civil Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Articles 87-105-1), tracing its concept, functions, formation, and protective role across limited liability companies, joint-stock companies, partnerships, and entities with additional liability. Charter capital is generally presented as a straightforward guarantee: a minimum fund that secures creditors' interests from the moment of incorporation. This paper argues that the guarantee is more limited, and more dependent on institutional enforcement, than that presentation suggests. Comparative analysis of German, French, Russian, British, and American company law shows that capital thresholds-whether strict, as in Germany, or largely abandoned, as in the United Kingdom and the United States-protect creditors only where they are backed by credible valuation of non-monetary contributions, effective net-asset monitoring, and enforceable consequences for undercapitalization. Azerbaijani law contains each of these mechanisms in formal terms, through the net-asset rules of Articles 90.4 and 103.5, the mandatory-contribution rules of Articles 90.3 and 103.4, and the general framework governing capital increase and reduction, but their practical bite depends on enforcement capacity that the Civil Code itself does not supply. The U.S. case Kinney Shoe Corp. v. Polan is used as a comparative illustration of what happens when capital rules are formally present but substantively unobserved. The paper concludes that Azerbaijan's reform priority should not be abandoning the civil-law capital model, but closing the gap between its formal architecture and its practical enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文考察阿塞拜疆共和国民法典（第87-105-1条）中法定资本作为法律制度的运作，论证其作为债权人保护机制的保障作用比表面呈现的更有限、更依赖制度执行。通过比较德国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国公司法，指出资本门槛（无论严格如德国，或基本放弃如英美）只有在可信的非货币出资估值、有效的净资产监控和可执行的资本不足后果支持下才能保护债权人。阿塞拜疆法律虽形式具备这些机制，但实际效果取决于民法典本身无法提供的执法能力。结论是改革重点不应放弃大陆法系资本模式，而应弥合形式架构与实务执行之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆民法典中的法定资本制度作为债权人保障机制，其实际保护效果如何？形式上存在的资本规则在缺乏有效执行时会产生什么后果？
AI.motivation: 法定资本通常被简单呈现为保障债权人利益的直接机制，但这一呈现可能过于乐观。需要检验该保障的实际限度及其对制度执行的依赖程度，以指导阿塞拜疆公司法改革方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法定资本作为债权人保障机制的法律经济分析；比较公司法视角下的资本制度三种模式（严格法定资本制、授权资本制、无最低资本要求制）及其配套保障机制理论。
AI.method: 比较法律分析方法：系统梳理阿塞拜疆民法典法定资本条款（第87-105-1条），对比德国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国的公司法规定，并以美国Kinney Shoe Corp. v. Polan案作为形式资本规则但实质未被遵守的例证进行案例分析。
AI.findings: 资本门槛只有在三项配套条件同时满足时才能有效保护债权人：（1）非货币出资的可信估值；（2）有效的净资产监控；（3）资本不足的强制制裁后果。阿塞拜疆法形式上具备净资产规则（第90.4条和第103.5条）、强制出资规则（第90.3条和第103.4条）及资本增减框架，但缺乏民法典之外的执法能力支撑。Kinney Shoe案表明形式上存在但实质上不被遵守的资本规则无法提供保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了法定资本作为"直接担保"的简单认知，论证资本制度的保护效果具有强烈的制度执行依赖性；为大陆法系法定资本模式的存废争论提供了关键视角——问题不在于制度模式本身的存废，而在于制度架构与执行能力的匹配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿塞拜疆公司法改革提供明确方向：不应放弃法定资本模式，而应着重加强执法能力建设，弥合形式规则与实践执行之间的鸿沟。对同类转型经济体的公司资本制度改革具有参考价值。

title: From Static Knowledge Assets to Verifiable agent Assets
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Static Knowledge Assets to Verifiable agent Assets

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual and protocol-design study did not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, experiments, surveys, interviews, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
As artificial agents move from passive software tools toward persistent, networked systems that discover
one another, invoke external services, delegate tasks, and generate measurable economic value, the
conventional objects of digital ownership become increasingly inadequate. Prompts, code repositories, model
weights, and workflow files may remain valuable, but they are readily copied, regenerated, forked, or
separated from their creators and from the execution histories that make them commercially credible. This
paper proposes the concept of a Verifiable Agent Asset (VAA): a persistent, economically addressable agent
object that binds identity, controller and creator relationships, capability provenance, version lineage,
authorization and licensing terms, signed execution receipts, contextual reputation, economic-right
mappings, and lifecycle controls. The contribution is not a new cryptographic identity primitive. Rather, it is
an institutional-technical synthesis that connects existing building blocks - including Agent2Agent discovery,
decentralized identifiers, verifiable credentials, software supply-chain attestations, authenticated delegation,
and reputation evidence - into an asset envelope suitable for licensing, attribution, audit, revenue allocation,
and revocation. The framework is explicitly distinct from legal personhood: an agent is treated as a verifiable
carrier of rights and obligations assigned to human or organizational principals, not as an autonomous owner
by default. The paper also connects this architecture to temporal sovereignty. If agents are permitted to earn
but their indefinite autonomous accumulation must remain bounded, economic value first needs a traceable
carrier through which permissions, revenue claims, operational capital, and accumulation constraints can be
enforced. The proposed framework supplies that carrier and establishes the middle layer between a normative
theory of AI wealth boundaries and a future agent economic protocol governing multi-agent transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可验证智能体资产"（VAA）概念，将身份、能力溯源、版本谱系、授权许可、签名执行收据、声誉、经济权利映射和生命周期控制绑定为一个持久、可经济寻址的智能体对象，作为连接现有技术构件（Agent2Agent发现、DID、可验证凭证、供应链 attestation、认证委托、声誉证据）的制度-技术综合框架，服务于许可、归属、审计、收入分配和撤销，并建立AI财富边界规范理论与未来智能体经济协议之间的中间层。
AI.research_question: 当人工智能智能体从被动工具演化为持久、联网、可发现、可委托并产生经济价值的系统时，传统数字所有权对象（提示词、代码库、模型权重、工作流文件）日益不足以支撑许可、归属、审计和收入分配，如何构建一种可验证的智能体资产载体来实现这些功能？
AI.motivation: 传统数字资产容易被复制、再生、分叉或与创作者及执行历史分离，使其缺乏商业可信度。随着智能体开始产生可衡量的经济价值，需要一种新的资产架构来支撑经济权利映射、生命周期控制和约束累积等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文不提出新的密码学身份原语，而是采用制度-技术综合视角，整合Agent2Agent发现协议、去中心化标识符（DID）、可验证凭证、软件供应链 attestation、认证委托和声誉证据等现有构件。同时连接"时间主权"（temporal sovereignty）概念，即智能体可以赚取但不可无限自主累积，经济价值需要有可追溯的载体来执行权限、收入主张、运营资本和累积约束。
AI.method: 概念性/架构性方法：通过综合分析现有技术构件（DID、可验证凭证、供应链 attestation等），提出并系统化一个"资产信封"（asset envelope）框架，并将其与法律人格概念明确区分——智能体被视为可验证的权利与义务载体，而非默认的自主所有者。
AI.findings: VAA框架提供了持久、可经济寻址的智能体对象，该对象绑定身份、控制者/创建者关系、能力溯源、版本谱系、授权与许可条款、签名执行收据、情境化声誉、经济权利映射和生命周期控制；该框架构成AI财富边界规范理论与未来多智能体经济协议之间的中间层。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可验证智能体资产"（VAA）这一新概念框架，弥合了AI财富边界的规范性理论与智能体经济协议之间的理论空白；明确区分了智能体作为权利/义务载体与法律人格（法人）之间的概念差异；将"时间主权"概念与智能体经济价值的可追踪载体架构相连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能体经济提供了可操作的资产架构，支持许可、归属、审计、收入分配和撤销等实际功能；通过绑定控制者/创建者关系防止智能体脱离其人类或组织委托人；为智能体赚取收入但受累积约束的经济治理提供基础设施支持。

title: Economic Spectrum: Decision Positioning, Value Migration, and the Algorithmic Non-export Hypothesis -evidence from the 5G Patent Race

detail.title: Economic Spectrum: Decision Positioning, Value Migration, and the Algorithmic Non-export Hypothesis -evidence from the 5G Patent Race
detail.abstract:
Existing decision theories—rational decision models, bounded rationality, and prospect theory—primarily
focus on process optimization and preference structures, yet lack a systematic framework for locating
decisions within the position of an economic value-creation spectrum and for evaluating whether decisions
propel organizations toward higher-value tiers. This paper proposes the "Economic Spectrum" analytical
model, which partitions economic activity from left to right into four tiers: Pure Arbitrage → Information
Arbitrage → Cognitive Arbitrage → Value Creation. It further introduces the "Parallelism is Abyss" proposition—
competing in parallel with rivals at the same spectral position is not catching up, but sinking side by side.
This paper further proposes the dynamic mechanism of spectral transition—the "Emergence Formula": more
granularity → more touchpoints → more data → sensitivity source collisions → emergence. This reveals that
the underlying logic of migrating from the arbitrage end to the value-creation end is not "knowing more" but
"allowing new structures to emerge." Version v3 upgrades the Emergence Formula into a semi-mathematical
model, introducing variable definitions, recurrence relations, transition thresholds, and continuous functions,
thereby equipping the theory with the formal foundations of testable hypotheses.
Through systematic dialogue with Porter's competitive strategy, Christensen's disruptive innovation,
Bourdieu's field theory, Kahneman's prospect theory, Barney's resource-based view, Williamson's transaction
cost theory, and complex adaptive systems theory, this paper elucidates the incremental contributions of the
Economic Spectrum. Version v4 deepens the seven theoretical dialogues—each expanded from a summary
level to an argumentation level, introducing specific mechanisms of spectral mutation, incremental
propositions of reverse mapping, and cross-validation with the Causal Twin Pinnacle system.This paper integrates the Economic Spectrum with an original theoretical construct (Quality Field Theory) into a
"Causal Twin Pinnacle" system: Quality Field Theory constitutes the "cause" (the field of being, describing the
field conditions for value generation), while the Economic Spectrum constitutes the "effect" (the decision lens,
describing the position and direction of decisions within the value spectrum). Together, they form a causal
closed loop. The empirical validation of the model relies on three primary case studies: (1) Huawei's 5G patent
strategy as a test of the algorithmic non-export hypothesis, (2) Samsung's market exit calculus as a test of the
global pricing redundancy proposition, and (3) cross-industry spectral positioning of instant retail, SaaS, new
energy vehicles, AI large models, fintech, and the creator economy. Version v4 deepens the integration of the
Refraction relationship framework with the Economic Spectrum—the spectral mapping of the three-factor
behavioral model, the systematic correspondence between the W-H-O profiling model and the four-
dimensional spectral assessment, and the four typical refraction patterns and their resonance with §9.2.4's
refraction effects.
This paper provides a four-dimensional assessment method for decision positioning, a quantitative indicator
system for spectral positions (including quantifiable indicator definitions, measurement methods, and
assessment examples), and six deeply developed cross-industry positioning cases (instant retail, SaaS, new
energy vehicles, AI large models, fintech, and the creator economy—each containing spectral positioning
analysis, migration vector computation, barrier decay assessment, and parallel risk quantification). The
discussion section extends the interdisciplinary incremental contributions of the theory, a four-dimensional
deepening of limitations, and operationalized future research directions. The references expand from 13 to 47
entries, covering eight domains: decision theory, arbitrage and information economics, innovation and
disruption, organizational theory and institutions, complex systems and emergence, behavioral economics,
value and strategy, and the Chinese context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"经济光谱"分析模型，将经济活动划分为从纯套利到价值创造的四个层级，并引入"平行即深渊"命题与"涌现公式"作为光谱跃迁的动态机制。该理论进一步与原创的"质场论"整合为"因果双峰"系统，通过华为、三星及六大跨行业案例进行验证，为决策定位提供了四维评估方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将决策定位纳入经济价值创造光谱的框架中，并评估决策是否推动组织向更高价值层级跃迁？
AI.motivation: 现有决策理论（理性决策模型、有限理性、前景理论）主要关注过程优化和偏好结构，缺乏一个系统框架来定位决策在经济价值创造光谱中的位置，也缺少评估决策能否推动组织迈向更高价值层级的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济光谱模型（纯套利→信息套利→认知套利→价值创造）、平行即深渊命题、涌现公式、质场理论（质场论）、因果双峰系统，以及与波特竞争战略、克里斯滕森颠覆式创新、布迪厄场域理论、卡尼曼前景理论、巴尼资源基础观、威廉姆森交易成本理论及复杂适应系统理论的对话。
AI.method: 理论建构与案例验证相结合：提出半数学化模型（变量定义、递推关系、跃迁阈值、连续函数），并基于三个主要案例（华为5G专利战略、三星市场退出决策、六大跨行业光谱定位）进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 发现从套利端向价值创造端迁移的底层逻辑不是"知道更多"而是"允许新结构涌现"；与同一光谱位置上的竞争对手平行竞争不是追赶而是并肩下沉（平行即深渊）；提出光谱突变的具体机制、逆向映射增量命题，以及折射关系框架与光谱的系统性整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 为决策理论增加了光谱定位维度；提出"平行即深渊"命题修正了竞争战略中关于追赶的认知；将涌现机制引入决策跃迁理论；建立了"因果双峰"体系将质场论（原因）与经济光谱（结果）整合为因果闭环，赋予理论可检验假设的形式化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供四维决策定位评估方法、光谱位置的定量指标体系（可量化指标定义、测量方法与评估示例），以及六大跨行业的深度定位案例（即时零售、SaaS、新能源车、AI大模型、金融科技、创作者经济），包含光谱定位分析、迁移向量计算、壁垒衰减评估与平行风险量化。

title: Designing and Evaluating a Blockchain-based Traceability and Integrity Framework for Hajj and Umrah Logistics
affiliations: Islamic University of Madinah, Islamic University of Madinah, Islamic University of Madinah, University of Jeddah, Islamic University of Madinah and Islamic University of Madinah - Faculty of Computer and Information Systems

detail.title: Designing and Evaluating a Blockchain-based Traceability and Integrity Framework for Hajj and Umrah Logistics
detail.abstract: Hajj and Umrah logistics represent one of the world's largest and most complex mass-gathering logistics environments, requiring coordinated management of food supplies, water distribution, transportation services, medical resources, and other critical assets for millions of pilgrims within constrained spatial and temporal conditions. Despite ongoing digital transformation efforts, logistics operations continue to face challenges related to fragmented data management, limited end-to-end visibility, and insufficient mechanisms for accountability and traceability across multiple stakeholders. This paper presents a blockchain-based framework to enhance traceability, integrity, and trust in Hajj and Umrah logistics operations. The proposed architecture integrates a permissioned blockchain, smart contracts, IoTenabled data acquisition, and analytics services within a multilayer framework that supports secure asset registration, event logging, custody transfer verification, and stakeholder coordination. A simulation-based evaluation was conducted using six major pilgrimage logistics locations and adaptive consensus management through PBFT, Tendermint, and BigFoot protocols. Results show that the framework processed 288,951 transactions and finalized 516 blocks during the simulation period, achieving an average throughput of approximately 241 transactions per second while maintaining stable operation during consensus reconfiguration. The results demonstrate the potential of permissioned blockchain architectures to improve transparency, auditability, integrity assurance, and coordination in large-scale pilgrimage logistics environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于区块链的框架来增强朝觐和副朝（Hajj and Umrah）物流运营的可追溯性、完整性和信任度。该架构集成了许可型区块链、智能合约、物联网数据采集和分析服务，并在六个主要朝觐物流地点进行了模拟评估，处理了28.9万笔交易，平均吞吐量约241笔/秒，证明了许可型区块链在大规模朝觐物流环境中的潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用区块链技术解决朝觐和副朝物流运营中数据管理分散、端到端可见性有限、多利益相关方之间问责和可追溯机制不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 朝觐和副朝物流是全球最大、最复杂的大规模聚集物流环境之一，需要在有限时空条件下协调数百万朝觐者的食品、水、交通、医疗等关键资源。尽管持续进行数字化转型，物流运营仍面临数据碎片化、可见性不足、问责和可追溯机制缺失等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 许可型区块链理论、智能合约理论、物联网数据采集、自适应共识管理机制（PBFT、Tendermint、BigFoot协议）
AI.method: 提出多层区块链架构框架，集成许可型区块链、智能合同、物联网数据采集和分析服务；通过模拟实验，在六个主要朝觐物流地点使用三种共识协议（PBFT、Tendermint、BigFoot）进行自适应共识管理评估。
AI.findings: 框架在模拟期间处理了288,951笔交易，完成516个区块，平均吞吐量约241笔/秒，在共识重配置期间保持稳定运行，验证了许可型区块链架构在大规模朝觐物流中的可行性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大规模聚集物流场景中的区块链应用提供了理论框架，展示了许可型区块链、智能合约和物联网集成如何增强物流运营的透明度、可审计性、完整性保障和多方协调能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为朝觐和副朝物流管理提供了实际可行的区块链解决方案，支持安全的资产注册、事件日志记录、保管转移验证和利益相关方协调，可提升物流运营效率、可追溯性和信任度。

title: The Political Economy of Mandatory Shareholder Arbitration
affiliations: and Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati

detail.title: The Political Economy of Mandatory Shareholder Arbitration
detail.abstract:
For decades, mandatory arbitration provisions in corporate charters and bylaws—particularly those covering shareholder and federal securities claims—were widely regarded as both legally uncertain and practically unavailable. Their absence did not result from a single express prohibition, but from the interaction of federal regulatory practice and state corporate law. At the federal level, the Securities and Exchange Commission exercised informal but highly effective gatekeeping by opposing arbitration provisions in the IPO process. At the state level, Delaware law preserved judicial adjudication for internal corporate and securities claims, reinforcing a litigation-centered system of shareholder dispute resolution.

In 2025, the SEC disrupted this equilibrium by announcing that the presence of arbitration provisions would no longer affect the effectiveness of a registration statement. This policy shift removed the principal federal constraint and reopened the question whether arbitration may emerge as a viable governance mechanism for public companies. Yet the removal of legal barriers does not by itself determine governance outcomes.

This Article argues that the future of mandatory shareholder arbitration cannot be understood through legal doctrine alone. It must instead be analyzed through the political economy of corporate governance. The adoption of arbitration provisions will depend on the interaction of institutional incentives among Delaware, competing states, federal regulators, corporate managers, institutional investors, and the plaintiffs’ bar. Each of these actors has distinct—and often conflicting—interests in the structure of shareholder dispute resolution.

We show that Delaware’s resistance reflects the centrality of courts to its governance model and the importance of precedent production to its dominance in the market for corporate charters. The SEC’s shift toward disclosure-based regulation, by contrast, reallocates decision-making authority from the regulator to market actors. Institutional investors, managers, and litigation intermediaries further shape the landscape through their responses to arbitration’s potential effects on enforcement, accountability, and litigation risk.

Against this backdrop, the Article identifies an “adoption puzzle”: why the expansion of legal possibility does not necessarily translate into governance change. Several key actors have strong historical and financial incentives to preserve the status quo and resist the use of arbitration. Their opposition may prevent, or at least significantly constrain, the widespread adoption of mandatory arbitration provisions regardless of the SEC’s position.

The Article concludes that the persistence of shareholder litigation reflects not merely legal constraints, but a broader institutional equilibrium. Mandatory arbitration may now be legally conceivable in ways that it was not before, but its widespread adoption remains uncertain. It may ultimately depend on whether early adopters can shift market expectations and reduce the reputational costs associated with such provisions, much as successful early adopters of dual-class stock contributed to its broader acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年SEC政策转变后，强制仲裁条款在公司治理中的未来前景。作者认为，解除法律障碍本身不会决定治理结果，强制股东仲裁的采纳与否必须通过公司治理的政治经济学来理解——取决于特拉华州、竞争州、联邦监管者、公司管理层、机构投资者和原告律师等制度行动者之间相互竞争的利益互动。
AI.research_question: 在SEC于2025年解除对强制仲裁条款的联邦监管障碍后，强制股东仲裁能否成为上市公司可行的治理机制？其广泛采纳将取决于哪些制度性因素？
AI.motivation: 数十年来，公司章程和细则中的强制仲裁条款（尤其是涵盖股东和联邦证券索赔的条款）在法律上不确定、实践上不可用。这并非源于明确的禁止，而是联邦监管实践与州公司法互动的结果。2025年SEC的政策转变改变了这一均衡，但法律障碍的解除本身并不能决定治理结果，因此需要超越法律教义，从政治经济学的角度分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理的政治经济学框架，重点关注制度行动者（特拉华州、竞争州、联邦监管者、管理层、机构投资者、原告律师）之间的激励互动与利益冲突。
AI.method: 法律与政治经济学的规范性分析，通过考察各主要制度行动者的历史利益、制度激励和权力关系，构建一个关于强制仲裁条款采纳前景的分析框架。
AI.findings: 发现了一个"采纳之谜"：法律可能性的扩大并不必然转化为治理变革。特拉华州的抵制反映了法院对其治理模式的核心地位以及判例生产对其特许经营市场主导地位的重要性；多个关键行动者具有维持现状的强烈历史和财务激励；强制仲裁的广泛采纳面临显著约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了仅从法律教义理解治理变革的传统视角，提出理解强制仲裁未来必须通过政治经济学分析，并引入"采纳之谜"概念来解释法律可能性与治理现实之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、公司管理层和投资者提供了理解强制仲裁条款采纳前景的分析框架，指出早期采纳者可能通过改变市场预期和降低声誉成本来推动更广泛的接受，类似双重股权结构的早期采纳经验。

title: Funding Constraints and Quality Signaling in Initial Coin Offerings
affiliations: School of Management, Zhejiang University, Southeast University and School of Management, Zhejiang University, School of Management, Zhejiang University

detail.title: Funding Constraints and Quality Signaling in Initial Coin Offerings
detail.abstract: This paper studies token issuance strategies in Initial Coin Offering (ICO) markets and examines how an external funding constraint designed to mitigate post-financing fund misappropriation risk affects quality signaling. We develop a three-stage model of fundraising, production, and market trading, in which a venture privately observes project quality and uses token issuance as both a financing instrument and a quality signal. After fundraising, the external funding constraint restricts the use of raised capital and affects subsequent production and token valuation. We show that the external funding constraint has a dual effect. While it reduces fund misappropriation risk by limiting the venture's discretion over capital use, it may weaken quality signaling by increasing the signaling cost of the high-quality venture and reducing the cost for the lowquality venture to imitate the high-quality venture. Furthermore, unlike the conventional signaling intuition in ICO literature that a high-quality venture separates itself by reducing token issuance, we find that the high-quality venture may increase token issuance to signal quality under certain conditions. The optimal issuance strategy depends on investor liquidity structure and the extent of information asymmetry regarding project quality. These results provide guidance for designing optimal token issuance strategies and reveal an important tradeoff in ICO governance: funding constraints designed to reduce post-financing moral hazard may simultaneously affect the effectiveness of quality signaling during fundraising.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ICO市场中的代币发行策略，以及外部融资约束（旨在缓解融资后资金挪用风险）如何影响质量信号传递。研究发现外部融资约束具有双重效应：既能减少资金挪用风险，又可能削弱质量信号传递。与ICO文献中传统信号理论不同，高质量企业在某些条件下可能增加代币发行量来传递质量信号。
AI.research_question: 在ICO市场中，外部融资约束如何影响企业的代币发行策略和质量信号传递？高质量企业应如何选择最优代币发行量来传递质量信号？
AI.motivation: ICO市场中存在融资后的资金挪用风险，外部融资约束被用来缓解此风险，但其对融资阶段质量信号传递的影响尚不清楚。此外，传统信号理论认为高质量企业通过减少代币发行来分离自身，但这一直觉在外部融资约束下可能需要修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论；信息不对称理论；ICO治理与融资约束相关理论
AI.method: 构建三阶段博弈模型（融资、生产、市场交易），企业私有观测项目质量，以代币发行作为融资工具和质量信号，分析外部融资约束对信号传递的双重效应。
AI.findings: （1）外部融资约束具有双重效应：减少资金挪用风险但可能削弱质量信号传递；（2）外部融资约束提高了高质量企业的信号成本，同时降低了低质量企业模仿高质量企业的成本；（3）与传统信号理论不同，高质量企业在某些条件下可能增加代币发行来传递质量信号；（4）最优发行策略取决于投资者流动性结构和项目质量信息不对称程度。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）拓展了ICO文献中质量信号传递理论，发现高质量企业可能增加而非减少代币发行的新分离条件；（2）揭示了ICO治理中融资约束与质量信号的权衡关系，弥补了现有文献对融资约束信号效应的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为ICO发行人设计最优代币发行策略提供指导；（2）为监管者和平台设计ICO治理机制提供参考，帮助理解融资约束在减少道德风险与维持有效信号之间的权衡。

title: The COR Strategy: A New Method to Improve The Dip Trip Traders' Profitability
affiliations: ,  and WorldQuant University

detail.title: The COR Strategy: A New Method to Improve The Dip Trip Traders' Profitability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was created as part of a WorldQuant University degree program towards an MSc in Financial Engineering. This paper is reproduced with the consent and permission of WorldQuant University. All rights reserved.
declarations.funderStatement: WorldQuant University.This paper was created as part of a WorldQuant University degree program towards an MSc in Financial Engineering. This paper is reproduced with the consent and permission of WorldQuant University. All rights reserved.

detail.abstract: Traditional dip-buying strategies rely heavily on indicators like Relative Strength Index (RSI), Bollinger Bands, and moving averages to time entries, but they fail to measure the actual velocity and strength of the subsequent bullish pullbacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce in this study a novel, physics-inspired technical indicator: the Coefficient of Restitution (COR) indicator. Adapting the physics principles of collision dynamicswhere the coefficient of restitution measures kinetic energy retention after impact-the COR indicator is mathematically defined as the ratio of the absolute differences between asset and market RSI values before and after price dips, offering a quantitative gauge of pullback strength relative to broader market conditions. Using a rigorous backtesting framework with walk-forward optimization across multiple timeframes (from 30-minutes to daily intervals), we evaluated the COR strategy on Magnificent Seven stocks and leveraged ETFs, incorporating volatility-adjusted position sizing via Average True Range (ATR). Our findings show that the COR strategy significantly outperforms traditional mean-reversion frameworks, particularly on high-volatility assets. Notably, at the 1-hour timeframe, the COR indicator combined with the ATR sizing achieved 41.56% total return, an 85.71% win rate, and a Sharpe Ratio of 1.51. These results provide market practitioners with a robust quantitative framework to validate rebound strength and assets trade quality prior to execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受物理学启发的新型技术指标——恢复系数（COR）指标，通过将碰撞动力学中"恢复系数衡量碰撞后动能保留"的原理移植到金融市场，以资产与市场RSI在价格回撤前后绝对差异之比来量化看涨回撤的力度与速度。研究基于多个时间周期（30分钟至日线）的walk-forward优化回测框架，在"美股七巨头"及杠杆ETF上结合ATR波动率调整仓位进行验证，结果显示该策略显著优于传统均值回归框架，尤其在1小时周期上取得了41.56%的总回报、85.71%的胜率和1.51的夏普比率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够量化价格回撤"强度与速度"的新型技术指标，以弥补传统技术指标（如RSI、布林带、移动平均线）无法测量看涨回撤实际动能的缺陷，并验证其在交易策略中的有效性？
AI.motivation: 传统的抄底（dip-buying）策略依赖RSI、布林带和移动平均线等技术指标来把握入场时机，但这些指标无法测量后续看涨回撤的实际速度与强度，导致策略在识别反弹质量方面存在盲区。作者希望借鉴物理学中碰撞动力学的恢复系数概念，填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论基础融合了：(1) 物理学中的碰撞动力学原理，特别是恢复系数（Coefficient of Restitution）概念，用于衡量碰撞后动能保留比例；(2) 技术分析中的相对强弱指标（RSI）作为市场动量测量工具；(3) 均值回归理论框架。
AI.method: 本文采用定量研究方法：(1) 将恢复系数的物理概念数学化，定义为资产与市场RSI在价格回撤前后绝对差异的比值；(2) 构建严密的回测框架，采用walk-forward优化方法；(3) 覆盖多个时间周期（30分钟至日线）；(4) 在"美股七巨头"股票及杠杆ETF上进行测试；(5) 结合平均真实波幅（ATR）进行波动率调整的仓位管理。
AI.findings: 研究结果表明，COR策略显著优于传统的均值回归策略，尤其在高波动性资产上表现突出。具体而言，在1小时时间周期上，COR指标结合ATR仓位管理实现了41.56%的总回报、85.71%的胜率和1.51的夏普比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次将物理学中的恢复系数概念系统性引入技术分析领域，构建了全新的COR技术指标，为量化"回撤强度"这一传统指标难以捕捉的维度提供了新的理论工具，拓展了技术分析的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场从业者提供了一个稳健的量化框架，使其能够在执行交易前验证反弹强度和资产交易质量，从而优化入场时机和仓位管理决策，尤其有助于在高波动性市场中提升交易绩效。

title: An Institutional Law and Economics Framework for the Analysis of Bank Governance: Methodology and Conceptual Definitions

detail.title: An Institutional Law and Economics Framework for the Analysis of Bank Governance: Methodology and Conceptual Definitions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a Senior Legal Counsel at Nordea Asset Management, part of Nordea Group. The paper is written strictly in the author’s personal academic capacity. The views, analyses, and conclusions expressed herein are entirely those of the author and do not reflect the official positions, policies or views of Nordea Asset Management or those of other entities within the Nordea Group.

detail.abstract:
This paper provides a robust theoretical and qualitative research design for the analysis of board governance within systemically important banks. The framework relies largely on institutional law and economics and originates from a broader monograph aimed at structuring board governance in banks to curb excessive risk appetite and to enhance systemic stability.

Moving beyond traditional legal dogmatics, the outlined methodology adopts an interdisciplinary approach that integrates economic analysis of law and perspectives from the company law tradition with microeconomic principles, specifically principal-agent and stakeholder theories. It leverages normative and descriptive law and economics alongside behavioral law and economics to scrutinize the boundaries of human rationality and decision-making within corporate boards.

Furthermore, the paper establishes a problem-centric, de lege ferenda legal political framework aimed at evaluating legal pathways to align shareholder and creditor interests. Central to this framework is extensive conceptual mapping that defines critical terminology for bank governance research. Ultimately, this framework provides regulators and legal scholars with an accessible yet theoretically rigorous foundation to evaluate regulatory interventions in the governance structures of systemic banks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于制度法律经济学的稳健理论与质性研究设计，用于分析系统重要性银行的董事会治理，旨在通过跨学科方法（法律经济学、公司法、微观经济学）遏制银行过度风险偏好并增强系统性稳定，为监管者和法律学者提供了一个理论严谨且易于使用的监管评估框架。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个稳健的理论与质性研究框架，以分析系统重要性银行的董事会治理，从而遏制过度风险偏好并增强金融系统稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统法律教义学方法不足以应对系统重要性银行董事会治理的复杂性，需要跨学科方法整合法律经济学与微观经济学原理，以更好理解董事会决策中的人类理性边界，并为监管干预提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度法律经济学（Institutional Law and Economics）；委托-代理理论（Principal-Agent Theory）；利益相关者理论（Stakeholder Theory）；规范性与描述性法律经济学；行为法律经济学（Behavioral Law and Economics）；公司法传统视角。
AI.method: 采用质性研究设计，结合跨学科方法论：整合法律经济分析、公司法传统与微观经济学原理；运用规范性与描述性法律经济学、行为法律经济学分析董事会决策的理性边界；建立以问题为中心、de lege ferenda（应然法）取向的法律政治框架，并进行广泛的概念图谱绘制以界定关键术语。
AI.findings: 论文建立了一个以问题为中心、de lege ferenda（应然法）取向的法律政治框架，用以评估协调股东与债权人利益的法律路径；通过广泛的概念图谱绘制界定了银行治理研究的关键术语，为监管者和法律学者提供了评估系统性银行治理结构中监管干预的可操作且理论严谨的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破了传统法律教义学的局限，将制度法律经济学、行为法律经济学与公司法传统、委托-代理及利益相关者理论相结合，构建了分析银行董事会治理的跨学科理论框架；引入了对人类理性边界的考量（行为法律经济学视角），丰富了公司治理理论在银行情境中的适用性；建立了问题中心、de lege ferenda取向的法律政治分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供了评估系统重要性银行治理结构监管干预的可操作框架；为法律学者提供了研究银行治理的关键术语图谱与概念体系；有助于指导监管政策设计以协调股东与债权人利益，从而遏制过度风险偏好并增强系统性稳定。

title: Untestable Neutrality: Pecuniary Interest and the Disinterested Decisionmaker in Automated Administration

detail.title: Untestable Neutrality: Pecuniary Interest and the Disinterested Decisionmaker in Automated Administration
detail.abstract: In January 2026 the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services began a six-year model in which private technology companies review prior authorization and prepayment requests in traditional Medicare using artificial intelligence alongside clinical review, and are paid a share of the savings their sustained adverse determinations produce. Due process entitles a person to an impartial and disinterested decisionmaker, and a line of cases running from Tumey v. Ohio disqualifies a decider with a direct, personal, substantial pecuniary interest in the outcome whether or not bias is shown. Medicare has produced its own precedent on the point. Schweiker v. McClure upheld determinations made by private carriers' appointed hearing officers, but rested on the absence of financial interest on the carriers' part, observing that the officers' connection to the carriers would matter only if the carriers themselves were interested. The model inverts that predicate, so the reserved case has arrived, and the doctrine reaches it without difficulty: an admitted institutional interest is enough to put the presumption of neutrality in issue, and no access to the technology is required to establish it. What the arrangement makes untestable is everything that follows. Whether the interest is direct and substantial as to any particular determination, and whether a function classified as screening has become the operative adjudication, are questions about configuration. Thresholds, defaults, review conditions, and reviewer measurement are set by the interested party, and none of them is available to the party who must raise the objection at the time it must be raised. The interest is admitted. Its bearing on the judgment is not. The argument is a diagnosis of a structural gap, not a claim that any determination was biased or unlawful.

AI.tldr: 本文分析2026年CMS启动的一项为期六年的模式：私营科技公司使用AI审查传统Medicare的事先授权和预付款请求，并按持续不利裁定的节省金额分成。文章论证该模式违反了正当程序所要求的决策者公正性与无经济利益原则，援引Tumey v. Ohio判例链，指出Schweiker v. McClure所依据的"无经济利益"前提已被翻转，使该模式的制度性利益足以推翻中立性推定，但利益与具体裁定之间的关联性因技术配置不透明而无法检验，构成结构性漏洞。
AI.research_question: 当私人科技公司因AI辅助审查传统Medicare事先授权而产生直接经济利益分成时，该安排是否符合正当程序所要求的公正决策者原则？其结构设计是否在制度层面产生了不可检验的利益冲突漏洞？
AI.motivation: CMS于2026年1月启动了为期六年的新模型，让私营科技公司以AI辅助临床审查在传统Medicare中处理事先授权和预付款请求，并按持续不利裁定节省的费用分成。这一安排将决策者的直接经济利益直接引入行政裁决程序，与既有宪法判例确立的公正决策者原则产生根本冲突，而技术黑箱又使得利益冲突的具体影响无法被检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正当程序（Due Process）中的公正与无私决策者原则；Tumey v. Ohio判例确立的"决策者不得在结果中具有直接、个人、重大经济利益"原则；Schweiker v. McClure案中对调解人公正性的经济中立前提假设。
AI.method: 法律判例分析法（doctrinal analysis）：通过梳理从Tumey v. Ohio到Schweiker v. McClure的判例路径，将CMS新模型置于既有的正当程序先例框架下进行规范性论证，诊断制度结构中的利益冲突与不可检验性。
AI.findings: 1) CMS模型翻转了Schweiker v. McClure的判例前提——该案依赖于承运人无财务利益，而新模型中私营公司明确按节省金额分成，构成直接的经济利益；2) 判例法足以认定该制度性利益已使中立性推定成为争议问题，无需技术访问即可确立；3) 然而利益与具体裁定是否直接且重大、筛查功能是否已演变为实质性裁决等问题，取决于由利益相关方设定的阈值、默认值、审查条件和审查者度量，这些配置信息对必须及时提出异议的一方不可见，导致结构性不可检验性；4) 该论证是对结构漏洞的诊断，而非主张具体裁定存在偏见或违法。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文扩展了正当程序原则在算法治理时代的适用边界，论证了Tumey v. Ohio的经济利益排除原则不仅覆盖人工决策者，同样适用于AI辅助决策的制度安排中；揭示了Schweiker v. McClure案"保留情形"（reserved case）的判例空白已被本案填补；提出了"利益被承认但利益与判断之间关联性不可检验"的结构性论证框架，为算法化行政裁决的正当程序审查提供了新的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为挑战CMS AI审查模型中的利益冲突提供法律论证基础；指出无需技术访问即可确立中立性推定被推翻的事实，降低了诉讼门槛；揭示需要监管改革的制度薄弱环节——即技术配置不透明使受影响方无法在关键时刻提出有效异议；为Medicare受益人和医疗服务提供者在面临AI审查不利裁定时提供正当程序救济的理论依据。

title: Banking's New Architecture:  Agent Economics, Embedded Finance, BaaS, Stablecoins, and the Restructuring of Global Treasury Settlement
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: Banking's New Architecture:  Agent Economics, Embedded Finance, BaaS, Stablecoins, and the Restructuring of Global Treasury Settlement
detail.abstract: This report advances a singular thesis: the financial system is not digitising-it is decomposing and recomposing along entirely different structural lines. The bank as a monolithic intermediary, which held a near-monopoly over payments, credit, treasury, and settlement for most of the twentieth century, is being functionally disaggregated by a combination of API-native infrastructure, programmable money, and distribution-layer innovation. What emerges in its place is not a postbanking world but a re-banked one-where financial functionality is embedded in the operating environment of commerce, agriculture, logistics, and governance, rather than accessed through a dedicated financial services channel.The analytical framework of this paper rests on five interlocking concepts: agent banking as the physical and human-intermediated last mile for financial access; embedded finance as the structural integration of financial services into non-financial platforms; Banking as a Service (BaaS) as the API infrastructure layer enabling that integration; stablecoins as the programmable settlement medium solving the latency, cost, and counterparty risk problems of traditional correspondent banking; and treasury modernisation as the institutional imperative driving adoption of these innovations across sovereign and corporate balance sheets alike. The paper then applies this framework to eight major financial markets — the United States (New York), the United Kingdom (London), Japan (Tokyo), Singapore, Brazil, Nigeria, South Africa, and the UAE (Dubai). For each jurisdiction, we conduct a five-year macroeconomic retrospective through Q1 2026, examine the structural condition and capitalisation of the domestic banking sector, identify the specific inefficiencies most amenable to the innovations described, survey the institutional actors already operating at the frontier, and propose jurisdiction-specific solutions grounded in the distinctive economic, regulatory, and infrastructural context of each market. The paper concludes that the convergence of these five forces — agent networks, embedded rails, BaaS platforms, stablecoins, and treasury automation — represents not an incremental improvement over existing financial infrastructure but a phase transition in how monetary value is stored, moved, and intermediated at scale. The jurisdictions that design regulatory frameworks accommodating this convergence while maintaining systemic stability will define the financial architecture of the next quarter century.

AI.tldr: 本文提出核心论点：金融体系并非正在"数字化"，而是在解构并沿全新结构线重构。银行作为传统垄断性中介机构，正被API原生基础设施、可编程货币和分销层创新在功能上分解。新的世界并非"后银行"时代，而是"再银行"时代——金融功能嵌入商业、农业、物流和治理的运营环境中。论文基于五大概念框架（代理银行、嵌入式金融、银行即服务BaaS、稳定币、国库现代化），分析了全球八个主要金融市场，并提出针对性解决方案。
AI.research_question: 金融体系正在经历怎样的结构性变革？传统银行中介模式如何被分解和重组？八个主要金融市场的具体现状与变革路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统"银行数字化"叙事不足以描述当前金融体系正在发生的根本性结构变化。金融功能正在从银行这一单一中介机构中被分解出来，并以嵌入非金融平台的新方式重新整合。理解这一"相变"（phase transition）对各国金融政策设计和未来金融架构至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文提出五大互锁概念框架：1）代理银行（agent banking）——物理与人工中介的"最后一公里"；2）嵌入式金融（embedded finance）——金融服务结构性融入非金融平台；3）银行即服务（BaaS）——支撑整合的API基础设施层；4）稳定币——可编程结算媒介，解决传统代理行的延迟、成本和对手方风险；5）国库现代化——主权和企业资产负债表采纳创新的制度驱动力。
AI.method: 对八个金融市场（美国纽约、英国伦敦、日本东京、新加坡、巴西、尼日利亚、南非、阿联酋迪拜）进行至2026年Q1的五年宏观经济学回顾；审查各国银行业部门的结构状况和资本化程度；识别最适配这些创新的特定低效环节；调查已在金融前沿运营的制度参与者；提出基于各国经济、监管和基础设施背景的针对性解决方案。
AI.findings: 五大力量（代理网络、嵌入式轨道、BaaS平台、稳定币和国库自动化）的融合不是对现有金融基础设施的渐进式改进，而是货币价值存储、移动和中介化方式的"相变"（阶段转型）。能够设计兼容这一融合同时维护系统性稳定的监管框架的司法管辖区，将定义未来四分之一世纪的金融架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"再银行化"（re-banked）概念替代简单的"去银行化"或"后银行"叙事；构建了五大互锁概念分析框架，为理解金融体系解构与重构提供系统性理论工具；引入"相变"概念描述金融基础设施演进的本质性跃迁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为八个主要金融市场的政策制定者提供了基于各国具体情境的差异化解决方案；为金融机构、监管机构和商业主体提供了理解金融功能嵌入化趋势的操作性框架；指出监管设计（在促进创新与维持稳定之间平衡）将是决定未来金融主导权的关键变量。

title: Web-Based Wordwall for Improving Reading Skills in EFL Primary Education: Pedagogical Implication
affiliations: Universitas Muhammadiyah Makassar

detail.title: Web-Based Wordwall for Improving Reading Skills in EFL Primary Education: Pedagogical Implication
detail.abstract: Reading is the foundation of literacy development in young English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners, yet primary-level classrooms frequently rely on repetitive, teacher-centred drills that struggle to sustain children’s attention and motivation. This paper examines the pedagogical potential of Wordwall, a free, web-based game-authoring platform, as a tool for developing reading and vocabulary skills among EFL learners in primary education. Drawing on recent empirical and theoretical literature, the paper discusses how Wordwall’s game-based features, including matching, quizzes, anagrams, word searches, and labelled diagrams, align with principles of gamification, digital game-based learning (DGBL), and developmentally appropriate practice such as the Montessori approach. The discussion is organised around four themes: the characteristics of Wordwall as an EFL learning tool; the components of reading skills relevant to young learners; the broader role of educational technology in primary EFL classrooms; and the pedagogical implications for teachers, curriculum designers, and teacher-education programmes. The paper argues that when Wordwall is integrated purposefully, rather than used as a standalone novelty, it can support letter-to-sound recognition, sight-word fluency, vocabulary retention, and reading motivation, while also raising considerations regarding screen time, equitable access to devices and connectivity, and the continued need for teacher scaffolding. The paper concludes with recommendations for classroom practice and directions for future empirical research on web-based Wordwall in primary EFL reading instruction.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Wordwall这一免费网页游戏创建平台在小学英语外语（EFL）阅读和词汇教学中的潜力，认为当该工具被有目的性地整合而非作为独立新奇事物使用时，能够促进字母-发音识别、高频词流利度、词汇保持和阅读动机，同时也需关注屏幕时间、设备访问公平性以及教师支架作用的持续需求。
AI.research_question: Wordwall这一基于网页的游戏化平台如何作为工具来发展小学EFL学习者的阅读和词汇技能？
AI.motivation: 小学EFL课堂常常依赖重复的、以教师为中心的操练活动，难以维持儿童的注意力和动机，亟需探索有效的教学方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 游戏化（Gamification）、数字游戏化学习（DGBL）、发展适宜性实践（如蒙特梭利方法）
AI.method: 基于近期实证和理论文献的综述性讨论，围绕四个主题组织：Wordwall作为EFL学习工具的特征、年轻学习者阅读技能组成部分、教育技术在小学EFL课堂中的更广泛角色、以及对教师、课程设计者和教师教育项目的教学启示。
AI.findings: Wordwall的匹配、测验、字谜、单词搜索和标记图表等游戏功能与游戏化和DGBL原则相一致；当被有目的性地整合时，可支持字母-发音识别、高频词流利度、词汇保持和阅读动机；同时需评估屏幕时间、设备与连接获取公平性以及教师支架的持续需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将游戏化、DGBL与发展适宜性实践（蒙特梭利方法）相结合，为小学EFL阅读教学中网页游戏工具的使用提供了理论整合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教师在小学EFL阅读课堂中整合Wordwall提供实践建议，为课程设计者提供设计方向，为教师教育项目提供课程整合启示，并为未来关于网页版Wordwall的实证研究指明方向。

title: Tenir: A Counter-Pressure Architecture for Safe Agentic AI Under Irreversible Constraint

detail.title: Tenir: A Counter-Pressure Architecture for Safe Agentic AI Under Irreversible Constraint
detail.abstract: Agentic AI systems-capable of autonomous planning, decision-making, and action-represent a decisive evolution in artificial intelligence. However, this architectural shift introduces a critical failure mode: the acceleration of action precisely when irreversibility, systemic coupling, and time compression intersect. I identify this as a structural vulnerability that cannot be addressed through alignment tuning, post-hoc safeguards, or human oversight alone. This paper proposes Tenir, a diagnostic and holding architecture designed to operate upstream of agentic planning systems. Tenir introduces admissibility as a formal, upstream decision layer that precedes and gates agentic planning. It evaluates constraint geometry across four dimensions-reversibility, coupling depth, temporal asymmetry, and narrative lock-in-and returns graduated decisions: PERMIT, CONDITIONAL, HOLD, ESCALATE, or UNCERTAIN. I present: (1) a formal specification of Tenir's constraint geometry framework, (2) a reference implementation in healthcare clinical decision support, (3) a retrospective counterfactual analysis of the Knight Capital trading failure suggesting 99% loss prevention potential under the Tenir model, and (4) architectural principles generalizable across high-stakes domains including finance, healthcare, and infrastructure control. My key contribution is the formalization of holding as a first-class protocol state-not system failure, but designed suspension of agency under pressure. This represents a fundamental shift from reactive safety (detect problem → halt) to preventive architecture (assess constraints → gate action).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tenir架构，一种在智能体规划系统上游运行的诊断与"持有"机制。Tenir通过引入"可容许性"这一正式的上游决策层，在四个维度（可逆性、耦合深度、时间不对称性、叙事锁定）评估约束几何，并返回PERMIT、CONDITIONAL、HOLD、ESCALATE、UNCERTAIN五级决策。论文认为智能体AI在不可逆性、系统耦合与时间压缩交织时会出现加速行动的关键失效模式，而Tenir通过将"持有"形式化为一级协议状态（而非系统失败），实现了从反应式安全到预防性架构的根本转变。
AI.research_question: 如何从架构层面预防智能体AI系统在不可逆性、系统耦合与时间压缩交织时产生的加速失效？能否构建一个上游的、形式化的决策门控层来解决这一结构性脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统具备自主规划、决策和行动能力，但这种架构转变引入了关键失效模式——当不可逆性、系统性耦合和时间压缩在关键时刻交汇时，行动会加速发生。作者认为这一结构性脆弱性无法仅通过对齐调整、事后防护或人类监督来解决。因此需要一种能够在智能体规划系统上游运行的预防性架构，而非依赖事后检测和止损。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的核心理论框架包括：（1）"可容许性"（admissibility）作为正式的、上游的决策层概念；（2）"约束几何"（constraint geometry）框架，涵盖四个维度：可逆性（reversibility）、耦合深度（coupling depth）、时间不对称性（temporal asymmetry）和叙事锁定（narrative lock-in）；（3）"持有"（holding）作为一级协议状态的形式化——即设计性的、在压力下的代理权暂停，而非系统故障。
AI.method: 论文采用了多重方法：（1）对Tenir约束几何框架进行形式化规范；（2）在医疗临床决策支持领域实施参考实现；（3）对Knight Capital交易失败案例进行回顾性反事实分析，估算Tenir模型下的损失预防潜力；（4）提炼可推广至金融、医疗和基础设施控制等高风险领域的一般化架构原则。
AI.findings: 研究发现：（1）智能体AI的加速行动失效是一种结构性脆弱性，无法通过现有对齐或事后防护手段解决；（2）Tenir的约束几何框架可以形式化地评估行动前的约束条件；（3）在Knight Capital交易失败的回顾性反事实分析中，Tenir模型显示出约99%的损失预防潜力；（4）持有应被重新概念化为设计性的协议状态，而非系统故障。"
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：（1）将"持有"（holding）形式化为一级协议状态，实现了从"反应式安全"（检测问题→停止）到"预防性架构"（评估约束→门控行动）的根本范式转变；（2）提出"可容许性"作为智能体决策上游的正式概念，拓展了AI安全的理论框架；（3）建立四维约束几何框架，为理解智能体行动的风险边界提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：（1）提供了Tenir的完整参考实现，可在医疗临床决策支持等场景落地；（2）通过Knight Capital案例分析实证检验了框架的损失预防效果（99%潜在损失预防）；（3）提炼出可推广至金融、医疗和基础设施控制等高危领域的一般化架构原则，为高风险行业中的智能体系统部署提供了设计指南。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Financial Volatility: From Model Augmentation to Market Disruption -A Critical Integrative Review

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Financial Volatility: From Model Augmentation to Market Disruption -A Critical Integrative Review
detail.abstract: The literature on artificial intelligence and financial volatility has developed along three disconnected paths-machine-learning volatility forecasting, AI-related economic and valuation shocks, and algorithmic or AI-driven trading-without a unifying framework organized around volatility. This fragmentation leaves open a question with direct consequence for model-risk management and macroprudential supervision: how does artificial intelligence reshape the modeling, generation, amplification, and management of financial volatility? This review introduces a Technology-Shock-Agent (TSA) framework, evaluated against a four-part evidentiary taxonomy-established, emerging, simulation-based, and regulatory or theoretical evidence-supported by 71 coded evidence entries across four evidence maps (Tables 2-5; Figures 1 and 3). As a Technology, AI augments rather than substitutes for traditional volatility models, with model risk in tail regimes the central limitation of the most flexible approaches. As a Shock, AI-related capital investment, compute and energy infrastructure, valuation dynamics, and regulatory uncertainty generate three distinct volatility transmission channels; separating AI-sector volatility from AI-induced volatility in adjacent markets is critical for portfolio-level risk assessment. As an Agent, evidence indicates efficiency gains in normal conditions, while stress amplification, model herding, and agentic trading remain at emerging and regulatory-concern stages of maturity. Synthesizing across roles, the evidence is consistent with, but does not establish, the AI volatility paradoxformalized as hypotheses that AI compresses ordinary volatility in normal regimes (H1) while amplifying tail volatility under stress (H2), decomposed into three testable propositions (P1-P3) with implications for model-risk governance and macroprudential policy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出"技术-冲击-主体"（TSA）统一框架，系统整合了人工智能与金融波动性研究中三条相互割裂的路径（机器学习波动率预测、AI相关经济与估值冲击、算法或AI驱动交易），基于71条编码证据和四部分证据分类法，提出并形式化了"AI波动率悖论"假设（H1：AI压缩正常状态下的普通波动；H2：AI放大压力状态下的尾部波动）。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑金融波动性的建模、生成、放大与管理？
AI.motivation: 现有AI与金融波动性的文献沿三条互不关联的路径发展，缺乏以波动性为核心的统一框架，这一碎片化状态为模型风险管理与宏观审慎监管带来直接后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Technology-Shock-Agent（TSA）框架；AI波动率悖论（AI volatility paradox）假设（H1、H2及P1-P3三个可检验命题）；四部分证据分类法（既有证据、新兴证据、模拟证据、监管或理论证据）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，通过四个证据图谱（Tables 2-5；Figures 1和3）对71条编码证据条目进行分类与评估。
AI.findings: （1）作为技术，AI增强而非替代传统波动率模型，尾部情景下的模型风险是最灵活方法的核心局限；（2）作为冲击，AI相关资本投资、算力与能源基础设施、估值动态及监管不确定性产生三条不同的波动率传导渠道，需区分AI板块波动与相邻市场中的AI诱发波动；（3）作为主体，正常条件下表现出效率提升，而压力放大、模型羊群效应和主体化交易仍处于新兴和监管关注阶段；（4）证据与AI波动率悖论一致但未完全证实，即正常状态下压缩普通波动（H1），压力状态下放大尾部波动（H2）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并形式化了"AI波动率悖论"假设，将碎片化的三支文献整合到以波动性为核心的统一TSA框架中，为后续实证检验提供了可操作的研究命题（P1-P3），弥合了AI技术与金融波动性研究之间缺乏统一组织框架的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为模型风险治理提供识别AI增强型波动率模型在尾部情景下局限性的指南；为宏观审慎监管提供AI冲击的波动率传导渠道分析框架，并在投资组合层面提供区分AI板块波动与相邻市场AI诱发波动的风险评估方法。

title: The Underside of Corporate Strategy. How Strategic Investment Builds Organizational Capital

detail.title: The Underside of Corporate Strategy. How Strategic Investment Builds Organizational Capital
detail.abstract: Managers typically evaluate strategic investments by expected returns and competitive advantage. This article argues that such a lens systematically overlooks how today's investments shape tomorrow's strategic possibilities. By shifting the analytical focus from the performance of investments to the roles they enable in value chains, the article explains how sequences of individually rational decisions progressively expand or constrain the opportunity space available to a firm's committed capital. It revisits the concept of organizational capital as the cumulative outcome of this process and complements portfolio management by introducing a strategic question and practical recommendations for long-term investment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文认为管理者通常以预期回报和竞争优势来评估战略投资，但这种视角系统性地忽视了今天的投资如何塑造明天的战略可能性。文章将分析焦点从投资绩效转向投资在价值链中所扮演的角色，解释了个体理性决策序列如何逐步扩展或限制企业承诺资本的机遇空间，并重新审视组织资本概念，为长期投资评估提供了战略问题和实践建议。
AI.research_question: 企业的战略投资如何通过塑造其在价值链中的角色，逐步扩展或限制未来的战略机遇空间？
AI.motivation: 传统的投资评估仅关注预期回报和竞争优势，系统性地忽视了投资对企业在价值链中角色定位的长期影响，从而可能错失或限制未来的战略可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织资本理论；价值链角色理论；战略投资与机遇空间理论
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析，通过重新审视组织资本概念，提出新的分析框架和战略评估维度。
AI.findings: 个体理性决策的序列会逐步扩大或限制企业承诺资本可用的机遇空间；组织资本是这一过程的累积结果；需要在投资组合管理基础上引入战略性问题以评估长期投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资评估的焦点从投资绩效转向投资在价值链中扮演的角色，重新定义了组织资本作为累积机遇空间的结果，补充了投资组合管理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了评估长期投资的战略性问题框架和实用建议，帮助其避免因短期财务指标而忽视投资的长期战略影响。

title: Beyond Traditional Paradigms: A Bibliometric and Systematic Content Analysis of Quantitative and Qualitative Methodological Innovations in Organizational Psychology
affiliations: NATIONAL ELECTRONIC MEDIA INSTITUTE OF SOUTH AFRICA

detail.title: Beyond Traditional Paradigms: A Bibliometric and Systematic Content Analysis of Quantitative and Qualitative Methodological Innovations in Organizational Psychology
detail.abstract: The study aimed to map methodological innovations in the field through a comprehensive bibliometric and systematic content analysis of 14,617 peerreviewed publications indexed in the Web of Science, Scopus, and APA PsycINFO databases from 2020 to 2025. The research did not involve collecting primary data from human subjects; instead, it used VOSviewer (version 1.6.20) and the bibliometrix package (version 4.2.1) in R to analyse publication trends, citation patterns, keyword co-occurrence networks, and methodological practices. Key findings included a 79.8% increase in publications using advanced quantitative approaches, and dramatic growth in digital ethnography (229%) and natural language processing applications (296%). Mixed-methods studies had a higher mean citation count (47.3 citations per paper) than quantitative-only (31.6) and qualitative-only (19.4) papers; these are corpus-level descriptive statistics and were not subjected to inferential testing. Co-occurrence analysis identified five thematic clusters, indicating increasing interest in within-person dynamics, computational text analysis, network modeling, and digital organizational phenomena. The study warns of the danger of uncritical adoption of novel methods, which may lead to prioritizing methodological fashion over epistemological and contextual fit. The paper proposes the Methodological Fit Matrix, a framework comprising seven empirically grounded dimensions and demonstrating face validity, to help researchers align methodological choices with research questions, temporal orientation, epistemological assumptions, data structures, and organizational context. While the matrix is conceptually derived, it has not yet been empirically validated as a decision-making tool, but it provides a practical basis for more contextually appropriate and theoretically coherent methodological innovation in organizational psychology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量学和系统内容分析，对2020-2025年间Web of Science、Scopus和APA PsycINFO数据库中14,617篇同行评审出版物进行了全面分析，绘制了组织心理学领域方法论创新的全景图。研究发现高级定量方法、数字民族志和自然语言处理应用显著增长，混合方法论文引用量最高。论文提出了包含七个维度的"方法论适配矩阵"框架，帮助研究者将方法论选择与研究问题、认识论假设和组织情境对齐，同时警示了不加批判地采用新方法的风险。
AI.research_question: 组织心理学领域在2020-2025年间的方法论创新趋势是什么？新兴方法论的使用模式、增长情况及潜在风险如何？
AI.motivation: 组织心理学领域正经历方法论变革，但缺乏对方法论创新趋势的系统性梳理和批判性审视。研究者需要了解领域内新兴方法的采用模式，并警惕盲目跟风可能导致方法论选择脱离理论与情境适配的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 方法论适配理论（Methodological Fit）、科学计量学/文献计量学理论、知识图谱与共现网络分析框架
AI.method: 采用文献计量学与系统内容分析相结合的混合方法：通过VOSviewer（1.6.20版）和R语言bibliometrix包（4.2.1版）分析出版趋势、引文模式、关键词共现网络和方法论实践；对14,617篇论文进行描述性统计分析和主题聚类分析。
AI.findings: 1) 高级定量方法出版物增长79.8%；2) 数字民族志增长229%，自然语言处理应用增长296%；3) 混合方法论文平均引用量（47.3次）显著高于纯定量（31.6次）和纯定性（19.4次）论文（描述性统计，未经推断检验）；4) 共现分析识别出五个主题聚类，反映对个体内动态、计算文本分析、网络建模和数字组织现象的日益关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"方法论适配矩阵"框架，包含七个经验依据的维度，为方法论选择提供了系统性理论框架，有助于将方法论创新从"时尚追逐"转向"情境适配"，丰富了组织心理学方法论理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和学术评审者提供了实用的决策工具——方法论适配矩阵，帮助研究人员在方法论选择时综合考虑研究问题、时间取向、认识论假设、数据结构和组织情境，促进更情境适切和理论一致的研究实践。

title: The HIDCHANS Axioms: The Cybernetic Architecture of Societal Systems a  Neuro-Cybernetic Framework for Non-Ergodic Socio-Economic Systems

detail.title: The HIDCHANS Axioms: The Cybernetic Architecture of Societal Systems a  Neuro-Cybernetic Framework for Non-Ergodic Socio-Economic Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study, as it is a purely theoretical and conceptual research paper that did not involve human participants, clinical data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was partially supported by the Research Council of Norway (NFR) and Business Intelligence Partner AS."

detail.abstract: The fragility of contemporary socio-economic institutions originates from a foundational category error: the systematic application of ergodic, equilibrium-oriented analytical frameworks to systems that are irreversibly path-dependent, heterogeneously adaptive, and structurally non-stationary. Because this failure is ontological and epistemological—and therefore unrecoverable through auxiliary modifications to orthodox models—this paper introduces the superset HIDCHANS: a formal ontology and mathematical architecture for the analysis, modelling, simulation, and governance of non-ergodic socio-economic systems. The framework formalises the neurobiological and meta-metacognitive boundary conditions of human agency as hard constraints — not management preferences — on perception, learning, and coordination in high-dimensional state spaces. The Individual Core Ecosystem (ICE), represented as a 10-dimensional state vector grounded in the allostatic load model, constitutes the primary recursive unit of the system manifold, replacing the fiction of the representative rational agent with a metabolically and cognitively realistic substrate. The path from this substrate to societal-scale governance is recursive through the multilevel architecture rather than aggregative through representative individuals. The paper makes seven original contributions, spanning ontology, architecture, and formal mathematics. First, the HIDCHANS axiomatic ontology — the 11 axioms (Holistic, Hierarchical, Homeorhetic, Information-based, Dynamic, Complex, Causal, Heterogeneously Adaptive, Neuroplastic, Stochastic, System), with the first 10 specifying component and interaction dynamics and the 11th closing the mereological architecture by formalising the irreducible whole — is established as a formally proven mathematical superset over Complex Adaptive Systems theory, Viable System Models, and classical control theory, with the Individual Core Ecosystem (ICE) as the primary recursive unit replacing the fictional representative, bounded rational agent. Second, the Haarberg multilevel architecture of societal cybernetics (Appendix A1) organises governance across 12 recursive regulatory levels (L1–L12), spanning the Individual Core Ecosystem through to planetary-scale institutional architecture, with each level admitting the Augmented Viable System Model heptarchy under a uniform homeorhetic discipline. Third, the universal governing equation — a non-stationary Itô stochastic differential equation with an explicit viability boundary and Pearlian causal control input — transforms the system from a descriptive evolution model into a structural survival model, establishing ruin as a topological absorbing barrier rather than a statistical outlier. Fourth, the Haarberg–HIDCHANS Stability Theorem derives, via Itô's lemma, the conditions for Global Asymptotic Stability in Probability, proving that homeorhetic sovereignty is a function of potential-field curvature over stochastic diffusion pressure — a result that renders sovereignty measurable and governable rather than merely aspirational. Fifth, the framework establishes a rigorous two-timescale architecture via singular perturbation theory, separating fast agentic state dynamics from slow neuroplastic parameter evolution and formally justifying habit formation and identity change as phenomena operating on distinct temporal scales. Sixth, the framework introduces spiral causality as the original re-specification of circular causality required once homeorhesis replaces homeostasis: regulation traces a path-dependent evolutionary helix in the system manifold rather than closing on a fixed point. Seventh, a path-dependent stochastic-functional apparatus, developed under the functional Itô calculus, reconstructs the systemdynamics primitives — stocks and flows, decay, non-linearity, time delays and oscillatory dynamics, emergence, and loop dominance — under a uniform discipline of stochastic flows, strict path-dependence, and discontinuous structural-break admission, formally generalising the deterministic-differential treatment of the classical system-dynamics tradition and supplying the mathematical foundation on which the universal governing equation and the stability theorem rest. HIDCHANS is proposed as the hard core of a Lakatosian research programme whose protective belt generates four independently testable predictions distinguishable from those of competing programmes: regime-shift hysteresis under intervention, a quantitative generalisation of the Lucas critique, the nonlinearity of the toxicity multiplier in psychologically safe environments, and a finite predictability horizon estimable from structural system properties. Three formal conditions for refutation are specified under which the programme would itself be displaced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HIDCHANS框架，一个超越传统均衡范式的形式化本体论与数学架构，用于分析、建模、仿真和治理不可遍历的社会经济系统。该框架以个体核心生态系统（ICE）为基本递归单元，通过12层递归治理架构和通用控制方程，将存活（ruin）建模为拓扑吸收边界，并证明了全局渐近稳定性条件，为社会经济系统治理提供了可度量、可治理的数学基础。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一种能够替代传统遍历性、均衡导向分析框架的形式化本体论和数学架构，以正确描述和治理不可遍历的、路径依赖的、异构自适应的社会经济系统？
AI.motivation: 当代社会经济制度的脆弱性源于根本性范畴错误：将遍历性、均衡导向的分析框架系统性地应用于不可逆路径依赖、异构自适应且结构非平稳的系统。这一失败是本体论和认识论层面的，无法通过对正统模型的辅助性修改来修复，因此需要全新的形式化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂自适应系统理论、可行系统模型（VSM）、经典控制理论、异稳态（homeorhesis）理论、异稳态负荷模型（allostatic load）、Pearl因果推断、Itô随机微分方程、奇摄动理论、函数Itô微积分、Lakatos科学研究纲领方法论
AI.method: 本文构建形式化数学架构，包括：11条公理的本体论（HIDCHANS）、12层递归治理架构（Haarberg架构）、非平稳Itô随机微分方程作为通用控制方程、通过Itô引理证明稳定性定理、奇摄动理论处理双时间尺度、螺旋因果重新表述循环因果、函数Itô微积分构建路径依赖随机函数装置。
AI.findings: （1）HIDCHANS公理本体论被形式化证明为复杂自适应系统理论、可行系统模型和经典控制理论的数学超集；（2）Haarberg稳定性定理证明异稳态主权是势场曲率对随机扩散压力的函数，使得主权可度量、可治理；（3）建立了严格的双时间尺度架构，区分快速个体状态动力学与缓慢神经可塑性参数演化；（4）提出螺旋因果作为异稳态替代稳态后的循环因果重构；（5）生成了四个可独立检验的预测：干预下的状态跃迁滞后、Lucas批判的定量推广、心理安全环境中毒性乘数的非线性、可由结构系统属性估计的有限可预测性视界。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）建立HIDCHANS作为复杂自适应系统理论、可行系统模型和经典控制理论的数学超集，扩展了这些理论的适用边界；（2）用异稳态（homeorhesis）替代稳态（homeostasis），引入螺旋因果概念重新定义了循环因果；（3）用代谢与认知现实的个体核心生态系统（ICE）替代代表性理性行为人假设，为社会经济理论提供了新的微观基础；（4）将主权（sovereignty）概念数学化为可度量的稳定性条件；（5）通过三个形式化证伪条件，将整个框架置于Lakatosian研究纲领的严格检验之下。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了从个体到行星尺度的12层递归治理架构，为多层次社会经济治理提供操作化框架；（2）将ruin建模为拓扑吸收边界而非统计离群值，使风险管理和制度设计更具结构性；（3）主权可度量化使治理责任可分配、可问责；（4）通过区分快速与慢速时间尺度，为习惯形成和身份变迁等治理干预提供了时间维度指导；（5）四个可检验的预测为政策制定者提供了与竞争理论可区分的实证检验方案。

title: BRICS Economic and Financial Policy in Contemporary Geopolitical Realities: Challenges and Prospects

detail.title: BRICS Economic and Financial Policy in Contemporary Geopolitical Realities: Challenges and Prospects
detail.abstract: The transformation of the global economic order has increased the importance of BRICS as a platform for coordination among emerging markets and developing economies. The group's enlargement has strengthened its economic and political weight, broadened its geographical representation, and introduced new areas of cooperation. It has also made consensusbuilding more complex because the member states differ in their development models, financial systems, foreign-policy priorities, and exposure to geopolitical risks. This paper examines BRICS economic and financial policy as a distinct but internally heterogeneous field of interstate coordination. The research applies institutional, comparative, and systemic analysis, supported by qualitative content analysis of summit declarations, financial-track documents, New Development Bank materials, and reports of international organisations. The paper distinguishes between established institutions, partially institutionalised mechanisms, and initiatives that remain at an early stage of development. The New Development Bank represents the most mature component of the BRICS financial system. The Contingent Reserve Arrangement has a formal legal and resource base but limited operational practice. Cross-border payment cooperation, multilateral guarantees, localcurrency financing, and settlement infrastructure remain developing areas. The principal challenges include geoeconomic fragmentation, divergent national interests, limited organisational capacity, exposure to sanctions and financial restrictions, and the gap between political declarations and operational implementation. The paper concludes that BRICS is unlikely to develop into a supranational economic union or a unified monetary bloc. Its more realistic prospect is selective institutional deepening in development finance, payment interoperability, risk-sharing, trade facilitation, and reform of global economic governance.
