AI.tldr: 本文提出了模拟-提议-整数规划处置（SPORD）方法，并部署为京东的NetSim平台。该方法通过解耦设计——模拟负责生成和评估所有运营有效的候选路径（吸收所有特殊业务逻辑），整数规划负责选择全局最优子集——解决了电商供应链规划中三大障碍：运营碎片化、计算不可行性和实施障碍。自2025年以来，NetSim已为超过20,000家供应商优化端到端服务，跨区域履约率从6.1%降至4.9%，月均减碳约5,745吨CO2e。
AI.research_question: 如何克服电商企业供应链规划中存在的运营碎片化、计算不可行性和实施障碍三大壁垒，实现从零散项目到统一高效规划平台的转变？
AI.motivation: 电商企业的供应链规划长期以孤立的项目形式运作，每个规划任务（从静态网络规划到动态仓库分类规划）都需要分析师花费数周从零构建模型、校准并说服高管接受无法验证的输出。这一现状低效且不可持续，亟需一种统一的、可扩展的且能被管理者信任的规划框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: SPORD方法——模拟提议与整数规划处置的解耦框架；基于解耦思想将业务逻辑吸收（模拟端）与全局优化（整数规划端）分离。
AI.method: 模拟-提议-而后整数规划处置（SPORD）方法：模拟端通过矩阵向量化的CPU/GPU加速生成并评估全量运营有效候选路径，吸收所有特殊业务逻辑；整数规划端选择全局最优子集；结合列表调度算法处理耦合订单；通过智能诊断引擎建立闭环。
AI.findings: NetSim平台自2025年起已为超过20,000家供应商优化端到端服务；跨区域履约率从6.1%降至4.9%；月均碳减排约5,745吨CO2e；矩阵向量化加速实现10-100倍速度提升；列表调度算法将耦合订单处理从数小时缩短至数分钟。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模拟从单纯的监控角色推进到主动规划角色（moves simulation from monitoring to active planning）；提出了模拟与整数规划解耦的理论框架，为处理大规模组合优化问题提供了新的方法论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 透明的输出结果使持怀疑态度的管理者转变为积极合作者；模块化架构确保未来的规划只需配置而非重构，降低了规划成本并提高了可实施性；为电商供应链规划提供了可落地的标准化平台范式。

title: Empowering the Telecom Workforce Mitigating Insider Threats in Telecommunications Espionage through Socio-Economic Improvements
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - Heinz College

detail.title: Empowering the Telecom Workforce Mitigating Insider Threats in Telecommunications Espionage through Socio-Economic Improvements
detail.abstract: Insider threats continue to plague organizations with reports continuing to show that trends of attacks are only rising since 2023. Despite technological advances and continual process modification in an effort to thwart these threats like "Zero Trust" architecture, increasing attacks show that these methods are not enough to thwart attempts. Research into the subject shows that insider threats have long standing commonalities with historical practices in espionage and sabotage recruitment efforts that often have attribution to negative socioeconomic conditions. These same conditions can lead to dire consequences for telecommunications and other organizations as these insiders have the knowledge of the intricate security processes and mechanisms of the organizations while also having the opportunity to seize opportunities to conduct espionage and sabotage. This thesis explores historical facets of insiders correlated to economic and political espionage, with modern-day telecommunications and other organizations. We then explore and connect military principles and strategies to these mechanisms-ultimately concluding that insiders can only be detected and defeated through the cultivation of holistic work practices and cultures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨内部威胁（insider threats）问题，指出现有技术方案（如"零信任"架构）和流程改进不足以阻止日益增长的内鬼攻击。论文通过将历史间谍与破坏活动中的内鬼招募模式与当代电信及其他组织中的内部威胁进行关联分析，并引入军事原则和策略，最终得出只有通过培养整体性工作实践与文化才能检测和击败内部威胁的结论。
AI.research_question: 为何现有的技术防御手段（如"零信任"架构）和流程改进仍无法有效阻止内部威胁？如何从历史间谍/破坏活动的视角理解内鬼行为，并借鉴军事策略来构建有效的防御机制？
AI.motivation: 自2023年以来内部威胁攻击趋势持续上升，尽管有技术进步和流程优化（包括"零信任"架构），攻击依然不断，说明现有方法不足以应对。研究发现内部威胁与历史上的间谍和破坏活动招募有长期共性，常与负面社会经济条件相关，这些条件可能对电信等组织造成严重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史间谍/破坏活动理论（espionage and sabotage recruitment），内部威胁行为学，社会经济条件与内鬼形成的关联理论，军事原则与策略理论。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析和历史案例关联研究的方法：探索历史上与经济和政治间谍相关的内鬼特征，将其与现代电信及其他组织中的内部威胁进行对照分析，并通过连接军事原则和策略来推导防御机制。
AI.findings: 技术手段和流程修改无法单独有效防御内部威胁；内部威胁与历史间谍/破坏活动中的招募模式存在长期共性；内部威胁常受负面社会经济条件驱动；最终结论是只有通过培育整体性的工作实践和组织文化才能检测并击败内部威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 将历史间谍与破坏活动的理论框架与当代内部威胁研究相连接，引入军事原则和策略作为分析内部威胁防御的新理论视角，拓展了内部威胁研究的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信及其他组织提供了超越技术解决方案的内部威胁防御思路，强调通过整体性工作实践和组织文化建设来预防和检测内部威胁，补充了"零信任"等纯技术方案之外的实践指导。

title: Blue Gold: An Unfiltered Look at the Resource We Can't Live Without and the Crisis We Can't Afford to Ignore

detail.title: Blue Gold: An Unfiltered Look at the Resource We Can't Live Without and the Crisis We Can't Afford to Ignore

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships with any organizations that could be perceived to have influenced the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper contains no human subjects research, patient data, or clinical trials. All data referenced is sourced from publicly available datasets and published reports.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded as independent research.

detail.abstract: Between 2002 and 2024, satellite gravity measurements from NASA's GRACE and GRACE-FO missions recorded the loss of roughly 1,200 cubic kilometers of freshwater from the world's largest aquifers, river basins and ice reserves. To put that number in human terms, it is enough water to fill Lake Erie more than twice over, or to supply every household in the United States for close to a decade. This loss is not a slow, symmetric drawdown. It is concentrated in a handful of basins that grow a large share of the planet's food and host hundreds of millions of people, and it is accelerating. The financial exposure is larger than most investors realize. The World Bank and the World Resources Institute estimate that global GDP exposed to high water stress will rise from roughly $15 trillion in 2010 to as much as $70 trillion by 2050-a sum comparable to the combined annual output of the United States, China and the European Union today. Water touches semiconductor fabrication, thermal power generation, beverage manufacturing, data center cooling and municipal credit markets alike, which means a shock to water availability is rarely a single-sector event. Despite that exposure, water is arguably the most mispriced major resource on earth. Oil, natural gas and agricultural commodities all trade on liquid futures markets that let producers and consumers hedge years in advance. Water does not. A single, thinly traded California water futures contract represents the entire formal financial market for a resource more essential than any of them. This paper calls that gap the mispricing paradox: the commodity that makes every other commodity possible has almost no price discovery mechanism at all. This paper's purpose is twofold. First, to lay out the physical, financial and geopolitical dimensions of the crisis in plain language, with the data and the human-scale comparisons that let a non-specialist reader grasp the stakes. Second, and just as important, to make the case for optimism grounded in evidence: desalination costs have fallen more than 90 percent since the 1970s, wastewater recycling capacity has more than doubled in two decades, and capital is beginning to move. The technology and the money to solve this problem already exist.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2002-2024年NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO卫星重力数据，记录了全球最大含水层、河流流域和冰储备约1200立方千米淡水流失的加速趋势，指出水资源是全球定价最扭曲的重大资源。作者提出"错误定价悖论"——水是使所有其他商品成为可能的商品，却几乎没有任何价格发现机制。论文旨在一方面以通俗语言说明危机的物理、金融和地缘政治维度，另一方面基于海水淡化成本下降90%以上、废水回收能力翻倍的证据论证乐观前景。
AI.research_question: 全球淡水资源危机的物理、金融和地缘政治维度是什么？为什么水资源作为最关键的资源却缺乏价格发现机制？存在的技术和资本能否解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 全球淡水流失正在加速且集中在粮食主产区，但金融风险暴露远超投资者认知（全球高水压力暴露GDP预计从2010年15万亿美元升至2050年70万亿美元）。水资源影响半导体、火电、饮料制造、数据中心冷却和市政信贷等多个行业，却几乎没有任何正规金融对冲工具，这一巨大错配亟需引起关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: "错误定价悖论"（mispricing paradox）：水是使所有其他商品成为可能的商品，却几乎没有价格发现机制。论文将水视为一种被系统性错误定价的金融资产和大宗商品，分析其物理稀缺性与金融定价之间的结构性错配。
AI.method: 基于NASA GRACE和GRACE-FO卫星重力测量数据（2002-2024年）的实证分析，结合世界银行和世界资源研究所的经济暴露估算数据，以及海水淡化成本和废水回收能力的历史趋势数据，采用跨学科综合分析框架。
AI.findings: （1）全球淡水损失约1200立方千米，相当于密歇根湖两倍以上或美国所有家庭近十年用水量；（2）损失集中在少数养活全球大量人口的盆地且正在加速；（3）全球GDP对高水压力的暴露将从2010年15万亿美元增至2050年70万亿美元；（4）水的唯一正规金融工具是流动性极低的加州水期货合约；（5）海水淡化成本自1970年代以来下降超过90%，废水回收能力20年内翻倍以上，资本开始流入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"错误定价悖论"概念，为理解水资源作为大宗商品的金融定价缺失提供了新的理论框架，将物理水文数据与金融市场机制联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 以非专业读者可理解的语言和人尺度对比呈现水危机全貌；提供证据支持的乐观案例（海水淡化和废水回收技术进步），表明技术解决方案和资金已具备可行性，为政策制定者和投资者提供行动依据。

title: Baqir's Nine Dimensions of Product Quality: Extending Garvin's Framework with Environmental Sustainability

detail.title: Baqir's Nine Dimensions of Product Quality: Extending Garvin's Framework with Environmental Sustainability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper and does not involve human participants or primary data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: David Garvin's 1987 framework of eight dimensions of product quality-performance, features, reliability, conformance, durability, serviceability, aesthetics, and perceived quality-remains the dominant vocabulary for describing product quality in both academic and applied quality management. The framework was built for a manufacturing economy in which environmental cost was externalized and rarely part of a buyer's quality judgment. That assumption no longer holds. Regulatory frameworks built on the life cycle perspective, buyer expectations shaped by climate awareness, and quality standards that now formally incorporate environmental management have together created a gap in Garvin's taxonomy. This paper proposes a ninth dimension-Environmental Sustainability-defined as the measurable environmental footprint of a product across its life cycle, from raw material extraction through use to disposal or recovery. The paper defines the dimension, grounds its necessity in the climate and regulatory record since 1987, and demonstrates that it is conceptually distinct from each of Garvin's existing eight dimensions rather than a restatement of durability, conformance, or serviceability under a different name.

AI.tldr: 本文基于David Garvin 1987年提出的产品八维度质量框架，指出该框架建立在制造业经济时代、环境成本被外部化的前提之下，已不适用于当代。论文提出第九个维度——环境可持续性，将其定义为产品在整个生命周期内可测量的环境足迹，并论证该维度与Garvin原有八个维度在概念上截然不同。
AI.research_question: 在环境和气候意识日益增强的当代，Garvin的八维度产品质量框架是否存在结构性缺口？是否需要一个独立的第九维度——环境可持续性——来补充该框架？
AI.motivation: Garvin的八维度框架仍是学界和实务界描述产品质量的主导词汇，但其诞生于制造业经济时代，当时环境成本被外部化，几乎不构成购买者的质量判断因素。如今，基于生命周期视角的监管框架、受气候意识影响的买家预期以及正式纳入环境管理的质量标准，共同造成了原框架的缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: Garvin（1987）产品质量八维度框架：性能、特性、可靠性、符合性、耐久性、可服务性、美学和感知质量。
AI.method: 概念性论文：通过定义新维度、梳理1987年以来气候与监管记录论证其必要性，并通过概念辨析证明其与既有八维度的独立性。
AI.findings: 环境可持续性是一个概念上独立于Garvin原有八个维度的第九维度，不应被简单地视为耐久性、符合性或可服务性的重新表述。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Garvin的产品质量框架，将环境可持续性纳入产品质量的概念体系，填补了经典文献在环境维度上的理论缺口，使质量概念框架与当代环境现实相衔接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业质量管理实践提供新的质量维度参考，帮助质量管理者将环境足迹纳入产品质量评估体系，回应监管要求和消费者日益增长的环境关切。

title: Application of the Okishio-Type Capital Accumulation Model to AI Investment -An Analysis of Cumulative Disequilibrium Processes and Investment Reversal Thresholds
affiliations: Rodem Asset Co.,Ltd. CEO

detail.title: Application of the Okishio-Type Capital Accumulation Model to AI Investment -An Analysis of Cumulative Disequilibrium Processes and Investment Reversal Thresholds
detail.abstract: Based on Nobuo Okishio's theory of capital accumulation, this paper constructs one-sector and two-sector dynamic models utilizing Harrod-Okishio investment functions. First, in the one-sector model, we show the instability of the warranted growth path and clarify the conditions under which an upward cumulative process occurs. Next, expanding to a two-sector model, we formalize the mechanism of cumulative inter-sectoral disequilibrium. Furthermore, by introducing physical constraints (electricity and construction upper bounds) into Sector 1, we explicitly derive the thresholds at which investment reverses. Finally, applying these results to AI infrastructure investment in the mid-2020s, we argue that the current phase is in an upward cumulative process and that reversal risks are rising due to the manifestation of physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文基于置盐信雄的资本积累理论，利用哈罗德-置盐投资函数构建单部门和双部门动态模型，分析累积性不均衡的机制，并结合AI基础设施投资的现实案例，论证当前处于上升累积过程且面临反转风险。
AI.research_question: 在资本积累的动态过程中，保证增长速度路径的不稳定性如何导致累积性失衡？物理约束如何触发投资反转？AI基础设施投资是否正处于上升累积过程且面临反转风险？
AI.motivation: 传统增长模型未能充分解释资本积累过程中累积性失衡的机制，尤其是在存在物理约束（如电力、建筑上限）的情况下投资如何发生反转。将理论模型与当前AI基础设施投资的现实情境结合，具有重要的时代意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 置盐信雄的资本积累理论、哈罗德-置盐投资函数、哈罗德增长模型中的保证增长率（warranted growth path）不稳定性理论。
AI.method: 构建单部门和双部门动态经济模型，运用哈罗德-置盐投资函数进行理论推导；在双部门模型中引入第一部门的物理约束（电力和建筑上限），显式推导投资反转的临界条件；最后将理论结果应用于AI基础设施投资的实证情境分析。
AI.findings: （1）单部门模型中，保证增长速度路径具有不稳定性，并明确了出现向上累积过程的条件；（2）双部门模型中，部门间累积性失衡机制得以形式化；（3）引入物理约束后，能够显式推导出投资发生反转的阈值；（4）AI基础设施投资目前处于上升累积阶段，但由于物理约束日益显现，反转风险正在上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了置盐信雄的资本积累理论，将其应用于双部门框架并引入物理约束，形式化了累积性部门间失衡与投资反转机制，丰富了哈罗德-置盐增长理论的动态分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI基础设施投资的动态演变提供了理论分析框架，提示政策制定者和投资者关注物理约束（电力、建筑）对投资可持续性的影响，对预判投资周期反转具有现实指导意义。

title: Modified SERVQUAL: Adding Recovery Quality (Extending the RATER Framework with a Sixth, Post-Failure Dimension)

detail.title: Modified SERVQUAL: Adding Recovery Quality (Extending the RATER Framework with a Sixth, Post-Failure Dimension)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper proposing a theoretical extension to the SERVQUAL model; it does not involve human participants, patient data, or empirical data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The SERVQUAL model, developed by Parasuraman, Zeithaml, and Berry, has for nearly four decades organized service quality around five dimensions summarized by the acronym RATER: Reliability, Assurance, Tangibles, Empathy, and Responsiveness. These five dimensions describe how well a service is delivered, but none of them describe what happens after a service failure has already occurred. This paper argues that the RATER framework is systematically silent on a distinct and measurable moment in the service encounter, service recovery, and proposes Recovery Quality as a sixth dimension. The proposal is positioned against two bodies of prior work it is most easily mistaken for, Berry, Parasuraman, and Zeithaml's Service Quality Ring, which treated recovery as a management lesson rather than a measurable customer-perceived dimension, and context-specific replacement scales such as the Retail Service Quality Scale, which bolt on an ad hoc dimension for one industry rather than extending RATER generally. Recovery Quality is then defined, distinguished from Reliability, Responsiveness, and Assurance to establish non-overlap, and grounded in the service recovery paradox literature, which shows that a wellhandled failure can leave a customer more satisfied than if no failure had occurred at all. The paper concludes with implications for how service organizations measure quality and directions for empirical validation of the proposed dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在经典的SERVQUAL模型（RATER五维度：可靠性、保证性、有形性、同理心、响应性）基础上，增加第六个维度——"服务恢复质量"（Recovery Quality），以弥补现有框架对服务失败后恢复过程的系统性忽视。该维度与其他五个维度不重叠，并基于服务恢复悖论文献进行理论支撑。
AI.research_question: RATER五维度框架是否遗漏了服务失败后恢复这一关键服务接触时刻？能否将"恢复质量"作为第六个可测量的维度纳入SERVQUAL模型？
AI.motivation: RATER五个维度仅描述服务"如何被交付"，但没有一个维度描述服务失败发生后"怎么办"。服务恢复是服务接触中一个独立且可测量的关键时刻，现有框架对此保持系统性的沉默。
AI.theoretical_framework: SERVQUAL模型（RATER五维度）、服务恢复悖论（Service Recovery Paradox）、Berry等人提出的服务质量环（Service Quality Ring）、零售服务质量量表（RSQS）等替代性框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文。通过文献定位与概念辨析的方法，将所提出的"恢复质量"维度与既有框架（服务质量环、零售服务质量量表）进行区分，并从理论上论证其与可靠性、响应性、保证性三个维度的非重叠性。
AI.findings: 1. RATER框架在服务恢复方面存在系统性的维度空白；2. 恢复质量应作为一个独立的第六维度而非管理建议（区别于服务质量环）或行业特定量表（区别于零售服务质量量表）；3. 恢复质量与可靠性、响应性、保证性在理论上有明确边界；4. 服务恢复悖论文献为恢复质量的独立价值提供了实证基础——处理得当的失败甚至能带来比无失败更高的满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"恢复质量"作为SERVQUAL模型的第六个普适性维度，扩展了服务质量的经典理论框架，使服务失败后的恢复过程纳入可测量的顾客感知维度体系，为服务质量测量理论提供了更完整的维度结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务组织提供测量恢复质量的操作化方向，帮助企业在服务质量评估中覆盖服务失败后的恢复环节，从而更全面地识别和改进服务短板，利用服务恢复悖论提升顾客满意度。

title: Reversibility as a Factor of Production - A General Theory of the Economics of Error

detail.title: Reversibility as a Factor of Production - A General Theory of the Economics of Error
detail.abstract:
This article introduces reversibility as a factor of production in its own right. Reversibility is the efficiency with which an economy converts its failures into reusable knowledge while preserving the capacity of agents to try again.

A coefficient Rho between 0 and 1, decomposable into five components mounted in series — financial, legal, social, cognitive and political — governs three channels: the accumulation of an unmeasured stock of experience capital; the volume of experimentation, through an entry threshold that rationalizes the observed prudence of poor economies; and the depth of hysteresis after shocks.

The interaction of these three channels generates a conformity trap, whose geometry is that of the “cusp catastrophe” and whose early-warning signals are refutable.

It also generates an asymmetric law of belief adjustment, the law of freeze and thaw, which we microfound as the exact nonlinear filtering of a hidden institutional regime.

On this basis, the article establishes an aggregation theorem for a Reversibility Index; an all-or-nothing optimal-reform result, the clean-jump theorem; and a series of amendments to canonical theories — Ricardian trade, the Phillips curve, Modigliani–Miller, the Keynesian multiplier, loss aversion, Eaton–Gersovitz sovereign debt, Holmström–Milgrom contracts — each of which is recovered exactly in the limit Rho tends towards 1.

The construction closes with a general theory: five axioms; an invariant that is the institutional analogue of the Carnot bound; a McKean–Vlasov field equation for the distribution of beliefs; a notion of economic proper time whose dilation defines underdevelopment; and a correspondence principle that makes received economic theory the zeroth-order term of an expansion in (1-Rho).

AI.tldr: 本文引入"可逆性"作为独立的生产要素，定义为经济体将失败转化为可复用知识并保持主体再尝试能力的效率。通过一个可分解为五个组成部分（金融、法律、社会、认知、政治）的系数Rho（0到1之间），该理论调控三个渠道：经验资本的积累、实验规模（通过进入门槛合理化穷国审慎行为）、以及冲击后的滞后深度。三者交互产生"从众陷阱"（几何形态为尖点突变）和"冻结与解冻定律"（信念调整的不对称法则，微观基础是隐藏制度体制的非线性滤波）。在此基础上，文章建立了可逆性指数的加总定理、"清洁跳跃定理"的最优改革全有或全无结果，并修正了李嘉图贸易、菲利普斯曲线、MM定理、凯恩斯乘数、损失厌恶、主权债务和契约理论等经典理论——这些均可在Rho趋近于1时精确恢复。最终以一般理论收尾：五个公理、制度类比卡诺界的不变量、信念分布的McKean-Vlasov场方程、经济"固有时间"概念（其膨胀定义欠发达）以及对应原理。
AI.research_question: 如何将"可逆性"（经济体将失败转化为可复用知识并保持再尝试能力的效率）系统地形式化为一套统一的经济学理论，并在此基础上推导出改革最优策略、修正经典经济学理论？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学理论缺乏对"失败—学习—再尝试"这一动态过程的系统刻画；经典理论往往隐含假设完全可逆（Rho=1），无法解释穷国的审慎行为、冲击后的持久滞后（迟滞效应）以及制度僵化现象。本文试图提供一个统一框架，将可逆性作为独立生产要素纳入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尖点突变理论（Cusp Catastrophe）、非线性滤波（隐藏制度体制）、McKean-Vlasov场方程、卡诺界（热力学类比）、对应原理、公理化方法。综合运用复杂系统、信息经济学与制度经济学工具。
AI.method: 理论建模与公理化推导。通过五维可逆性系数Rho构建系列生产函数框架，推导三个渠道的相互作用，建立一般理论体系（五公理+场方程+对应原理），并通过极限情形（Rho→1）验证与经典理论的一致性。
AI.findings: (1) 可逆性系数Rho调控经验资本积累、实验规模与滞后深度三条渠道；(2) 三者交互产生"从众陷阱"（尖点突变几何）和"冻结与解冻定律"（不对称信念调整）；(3) 建立了可逆性指数的加总定理和"清洁跳跃定理"（最优改革全有或全无）；(4) 所有经典理论（李嘉图、菲利普斯曲线、MM定理等）均在Rho→1极限下被精确恢复，验证了框架的一般性。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将"可逆性"确立为独立的生产要素和核心理论概念；(2) 提出"从众陷阱"与"冻结与解冻定律"等新理论机制；(3) 建立了以（1-Rho）为展开参数的对应原理，将既有经济理论统一为框架的特例（零阶项）；(4) 引入制度类比卡诺界的不变量和McKean-Vlasov场方程，实现制度经济学与统计物理方法论的交叉创新。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供可逆性指数的构建与度量框架，可实际操作评估经济体制度质量；(2) "清洁跳跃定理"为改革时机与策略提供全有或全无的判断准则；(3) 通过从众陷阱的预警信号识别，为防范制度性危机提供早期诊断工具；(4) 有助于理解欠发达（固有时间膨胀）机制，指导发展中国家制度设计与改革路径。

title: Construction of Audit Evidence Chain and SOX Control Verification Mechanism for Transaction -level Financial Data in High Volume E -commerce Platform
affiliations: Columbia University, Johns Hopkins University, University of College London and George Washington University

detail.title: Construction of Audit Evidence Chain and SOX Control Verification Mechanism for Transaction -level Financial Data in High Volume E -commerce Platform
detail.abstract: Order, refund, settlement, tax and revenue-recognition data in high-volume e-commerce platforms are dispersed across source systems, transformation jobs and reporting layers. Typical lineage tools capture table dependency or pipeline lineage, but they are not typically tied to each transaction record, SOX control points, rule-validation results and audit samples. To fill this gap of transaction-level control testing, an audit evidence chain framework for financial details was built. Records in source tables, SQL logic in transformations, Airflow tasks, quality rules, and control points and report fields were organized into a data-lineage graph. GAT was used to identify high-risk lineage nodes, Great Expectations was used for rule validation, and LightGBM was used to predict SOX control anomalies. The dataset contains more than 10 million monthly orders, 260 core tables, 1200 report fields and 240 million job logs. Based on historical replay of production-scale logs, the results indicate that sample tracing time was reduced from 5.6 hours to 38 minutes, field-drift discovery time was reduced to 4.8 hours, GAT precision was improved to 93.1%, and LightGBM AUC was improved to 0.927. The framework provides for evidence tracing at the transaction level and control verification for SOX, but the review of the judgment and remediation is still being done manually for high volume financial data.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向电商平台财务明细的审计证据链框架，将数据血缘图与图注意力网络（GAT）、Great Expectations规则校验和LightGBM预测相结合，实现了交易级别的SOX控制测试，将样本追溯时间从5.6小时缩短至38分钟。
AI.research_question: 如何在高交易量电商平台中实现交易级别的审计证据追踪和SOX控制测试，弥合传统血缘工具无法关联到每笔交易记录、控制点和审计样本的差距？
AI.motivation: 高交易量电商平台的订单、退款、结算、税务和收入确认数据分散在多个源系统、转换任务和报表层，传统血缘工具仅捕获表依赖或管道血缘，未能与每笔交易记录、SOX控制点、规则验证结果和审计样本关联，缺乏交易层面的控制测试能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据血缘图（Data Lineage Graph）、图注意力网络（GAT）、Great Expectations规则验证框架、LightGBM梯度提升树模型、SOX内部控制框架
AI.method: 构建数据血缘图（包含源表记录、SQL转换逻辑、Airflow任务、质量规则、控制点和报表字段），使用GAT识别高风险血缘节点，Great Expectations进行规则验证，LightGBM预测SOX控制异常。
AI.findings: 样本追溯时间从5.6小时降至38分钟；字段漂移发现时间降至4.8小时；GAT精度提升至93.1%；LightGBM AUC提升至0.927。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了交易级审计证据链框架，将数据血缘从表级/管道级延伸至交易记录级，实现了控制点与血缘节点的深度关联，弥补了传统血缘工具在审计场景中的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高交易量电商平台提供了可落地的审计证据追踪方案，显著提升了审计样本追溯效率和字段漂移检测速度，支持SOX合规控制验证，但判断和修复审核仍需人工完成。

title: Risk Aversion in the Small and in the Large: Beyond Arrow-Pratt A Wiener Chaos Hierarchy of Dynamic Risk Premia
affiliations: University of Glasgow

detail.title: Risk Aversion in the Small and in the Large: Beyond Arrow-Pratt A Wiener Chaos Hierarchy of Dynamic Risk Premia
detail.abstract: The Arrow-Pratt approximation is one of the cornerstones of expected utility theory, providing the classical local approximation of certainty equivalents and risk premia in terms of absolute risk aversion. Despite its widespread use, its mathematical scope and relationship to higher-order risk preferences remain only partially understood. This paper develops a new framework for the analysis of certainty equivalents and dynamic risk premia based on Malliavin calculus and Wiener chaos analysis. We first show that the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is not asymptotically valid for arbitrary sequences of vanishing risks, thereby identifying precise limitations of the traditional theory. Motivated by this observation, we formulate certainty equivalents dynamically by considering the progressive revelation of uncertainty through a Brownian filtration. Combining Itô calculus, the Clark-Ocone representation and the Wiener chaos decomposition, we derive a complete hierarchy of higher-order dynamic risk premia and obtain explicit representations of the corresponding coefficients in terms of Malliavin derivatives. For mixed Wiener chaos expansions, higher-order preference measures, including prudence and temperance, emerge naturally through interactions between chaos components and are characterised using Bell polynomial representations. Explicit results for quadratic Gaussian functionals and the Vasicek interest-rate model illustrate the theory and identify a broad class of regular Wiener functionals for which the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is recovered as the leading-order term. The results establish a unified framework linking expected utility theory, stochastic analysis and Wiener chaos expansions, opening a new perspective on higher-order certainty equivalents and the dynamic measurement of risk.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Malliavin演算和Wiener混沌分析，构建了一个分析确定性等价和动态风险溢价的新框架。作者首先指出经典Arrow-Pratt近似并非对所有消失风险序列都渐近有效，随后通过Brownian滤波下的动态视角，利用Itô演算、Clark-Ocone表示和Wiener混沌分解，推导出高阶动态风险溢价的完整层级，并揭示谨慎（prudence）和节制（temperance）等高阶偏好度量如何通过混沌分量间的交互自然涌现。
AI.research_question: 经典Arrow-Pratt近似在何种条件下失效？如何构建一个统一的数学框架来刻画确定性等价和高阶动态风险溢价？
AI.motivation: Arrow-Pratt近似是期望效用理论的基石，但其数学适用范围及其与高阶风险偏好的关系尚未被完全理解，尤其是对于任意消失风险序列，经典近似的渐近有效性存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望效用理论、Malliavin演算、Wiener混沌分析、Itô演算、Clark-Ocone表示定理、Bell多项式
AI.method: 通过Brownian滤波动态构建确定性等价；结合Itô演算、Clark-Ocone表示和Wiener混沌分解推导高阶风险溢价；使用Bell多项式刻画混沌分量交互产生的高阶偏好度量；并通过二次Gaussian泛函和Vasicek利率模型进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）经典Arrow-Pratt近似对任意消失风险序列并非渐近有效，存在精确限制；（2）推导出高阶动态风险溢价的完整层级，其系数可由Malliavin导数显式表示；（3）谨慎和节制等高阶偏好度量通过Wiener混沌分量交互自然涌现；（4）识别了一类正则Wiener泛函，其中经典Arrow-Pratt近似可作为首阶项被恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了连接期望效用理论、随机分析和Wiener混沌展开的统一框架，揭示了高阶确定性等价与动态风险测量的新视角，拓展了Arrow-Pratt近似理论的数学边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了动态风险溢价的高阶显式表达，为金融领域的风险度量、利率建模（如Vasicek模型）以及更一般的随机泛函风险分析提供了可操作的工具。

title: Psychometric properties of the short version of the Perceived Organizational Dehumanization Scale (PODS-8): A diagnostic tool for educational administration in Peru
affiliations: Universidad Peruana Union, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universidad Peruana Union

detail.title: Psychometric properties of the short version of the Perceived Organizational Dehumanization Scale (PODS-8): A diagnostic tool for educational administration in Peru
detail.abstract: Despite the growing attention given to teachers' psychosocial working conditions, perceived organizational dehumanization remains an understudied concept in educational settings due to a lack of psychometrically robust instruments. Therefore, this study aimed to translate, adapt, and evaluate the psychometric properties of the Perceived Organizational Dehumanization Scale (PODS-8). An instrumental study was conducted with 410 Peruvian teachers of Regular Basic Education, representative of the three regions of Peru (coast, highlands, and jungle). Participants were between 19 and 65 years old (M = 35.41 and SD = 10.23). The analyses used structural equation modeling (SEM) with the AMOS 24 statistical software. Confirmatory factor analysis yielded an 8-item unifactorial fit model (CMIN/DF = 3.509; CFI = 0.991; SRMR = 0.012; RMSEA = 0.078; and Pclose = 0.015). The results demonstrated good internal consistency. PODS-8 confirmed positive and significant associations with related constructs (job insecurity and job burnout). The Spanish version of the PODS-8 is positioned as a valid and reliable tool for assessing dehumanization in basic education organizations. This study contributes to the scientific field and important areas such as organizational psychology and human talent management in the education sector, thus providing a diagnostic tool for educational administration in Peru.

AI.tldr: 本研究对感知组织非人化量表（PODS-8）进行了西班牙语翻译、改编和心理测量学评估，以410名秘鲁基础教育的教师为样本，通过结构方程模型验证了其8条目单因素结构，证实该量表具有良好的信效度，可作为教育组织中评估非人化现象的有效工具。
AI.research_question: 感知组织非人化量表（PODS-8）的西班牙语版本是否具有有效的心理测量学特性，能否适用于秘鲁基础教育教师群体？
AI.motivation: 教师的心理社会工作条件日益受到关注，但在教育情境中缺乏心理测量学上稳健的工具来评估感知组织非人化这一概念，因此有必要对PODS-8进行跨文化改编与验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知组织非人化理论（Perceived Organizational Dehumanization）
AI.method: 横断面工具性研究设计，对410名秘鲁基础教育教师（涵盖海岸、高地、丛林三个地区）施测，使用AMOS 24软件进行结构方程建模（SEM）和验证性因子分析（CFA），并检验内部一致性与效标关联效度。
AI.findings: 验证性因子分析得出8条目单因素拟合模型（CMIN/DF=3.509; CFI=0.991; SRMR=0.012; RMSEA=0.078; Pclose=0.015），内部一致性良好；PODS-8与工作不安全感、职业倦怠呈显著正相关，验证了效标关联效度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将感知组织非人化量表首次改编并验证于西班牙语教育情境，填补了教育组织中该构念缺乏测量工具的理论空白，拓展了组织非人化研究的跨文化适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为秘鲁教育行政部门提供了一项诊断工具，可用于评估基础教育组织中教师的非人化感知，服务于组织心理学与人力资本管理实践，帮助改善教师心理社会工作条件。

title: Forecastability and Cost Structure: The Effect of Forecasted Sales Changes and Demand Uncertainty
affiliations: Osaka Metropolitan University, Kindai University,  and

detail.title: Forecastability and Cost Structure: The Effect of Forecasted Sales Changes and Demand Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Firms routinely face demand fluctuations that differ in their degree of forecastability, yet prior studies measure demand uncertainty using aggregate sales volatility, conflating forecastable variation with unforecastable shocks. We argue that these two components lead to fundamentally different capacity and cost structure decisions. We develop an analytical model showing that unforecastable demand shocks increase the value of committed capacity, resulting in a more rigid cost structure, whereas forecastable demand variation enables firms to rely on flexible resources and maintain greater cost elasticity. The model further predicts that cost responses to unexpected favorable demand shocks are weaker than responses to comparable planned demand increases because capacity is committed ex ante. We test these predictions using Japanese listed firms, whose mandatory management sales forecasts allow us to decompose realized sales changes into forecastable variation and unforecastable forecast errors. Using 44,021 firm-year observations from 1997 to 2023, we find that unforecastable demand variation is associated with lower cost elasticity across SG&A, cost of goods sold, and employment, while forecastable demand variation increases cost elasticity for SG&A and employment. We also find that firms respond less aggressively to unexpected favorable demand shocks than to comparable planned demand increases, consistent with binding capacity constraints. Our findings reconcile competing predictions in the cost structure literature by demonstrating that the operational consequences of demand uncertainty depend on its forecastability and highlight demand forecasting as an important determinant of capacity commitment and operational flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文通过区分可预测的需求波动与不可预测的需求冲击，构建分析模型并利用日本上市公司强制披露的销售预测数据（1997-2023年，44,021个公司-年观测值），检验了需求不确定性的可预测性如何影响企业成本结构决策。研究发现：不可预测的需求冲击增强了对已承诺产能的价值，导致更刚性的成本结构（更低的成本弹性）；而可预测的需求变动使企业依赖弹性资源，保持更高的成本弹性。此外，企业对意外有利需求冲击的成本响应弱于对可比计划内需求增长的反应，这与事前产能承诺一致。
AI.research_question: 需求不确定性的可预测性（forecastability）如何影响企业的产能承诺（capacity commitment）与成本结构（cost structure）决策？
AI.motivation: 既往研究将需求不确定性等同于总体销售波动（aggregate sales volatility），混淆了可预测变动与不可预测冲击两类本质上不同的需求变动。作者认为这两类需求变动会导致根本不同的产能与成本结构决策，因此需要将二者区分开来研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产能承诺理论（capacity commitment）、运营弹性理论（operational flexibility）、成本粘性/弹性理论（cost elasticity/stickiness）
AI.method: 开发分析模型（analytical model）从理论上推导预测；利用日本上市公司强制披露的管理层销售预测数据，将实际销售变化分解为可预测变动和不可预测的预测误差（forecast errors），然后通过面板回归检验成本弹性（SG&A、销货成本、雇佣）与两类需求变动的关系。
AI.findings: （1）不可预测的需求变动与更低的SG&A、销货成本和雇佣成本弹性相关；（2）可预测的需求变动提高SG&A和雇佣的成本弹性；（3）企业对意外有利需求冲击的成本响应弱于对可比计划内需求增长的响应，与事前产能约束一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了成本结构文献中关于需求不确定性与成本弹性相互竞争的预测；证明了需求不确定性的运营后果取决于其可预测性，将需求预测纳入产能承诺与运营弹性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者区分可预测与不可预测的需求变动以优化产能和成本结构决策提供指导；凸显了需求预测能力作为运营灵活性重要决定因素的管理意义。

title: Improving Existing Protected areas could Double their Modelled Threat-Reduction Impact
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome, University of Texas at Dallas - School of Economic, Political and Policy Sciences and Sapienza University of Rome - Global Mammal Assessment Program

detail.title: Improving Existing Protected areas could Double their Modelled Threat-Reduction Impact

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: C.V. thanks the Italian Ministry of Education, University and Research, Programma Operativo Nazionale (CUP B85F21005360001) for funding her research activities.

detail.abstract: Biodiversity is essential for ecosystem stability and human well-being, but human activities have intensified pressures on nature, leading to biodiversity loss and ecosystem degradation. Protected areas are considered an effective instrument for safeguarding biodiversity and are among the most widely used conservation strategies worldwide, yet assessing their ability to reduce human pressures remains difficult as it requires disentangling the effects of protection from confounding factors such as location and accessibility. Here we estimate average treatment effects on terrestrial protected areas for fourteen spatial threat indicators and an overall composite index using a quasi-experimental approach. We find that the composite index is 31.5% lower for protected pixels than in matched controls, with statistically significant reductions in built area, cropland, mining, roads, powerlines, and forest loss. Threat reductions are strongest in tropical forests, where protected areas reduce threats at nearly twice the global average. Assuming that not all protected areas can eliminate all threats, we use the best-performing protected areas within comparable pressure contexts as a benchmark and estimate that existing protected areas achieve 49.2% of their model-implied, area-weighted threat-reduction potential. Furthermore, our results show that many threatened vertebrate ranges remain exposed to ongoing pressure even inside protected areas. Our analysis shows considerable room for improvement in the management of existing protected areas, and provides a decision-support framework that balances protection expansion with improvements in effectiveness to achieve the Convention on Biological Diversity's protected area target.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用准实验方法评估全球陆地保护区对十四项空间威胁指标及综合指数的平均处理效应，发现保护区使综合威胁指数降低31.5%，在热带森林中效果最强（约为全球平均水平的两倍），但现有保护区仅实现其模型隐含威胁减排潜力的49.2%，且许多受威胁脊椎动物分布区在保护区内仍面临持续压力，表明保护区管理仍有显著改进空间。
AI.research_question: 保护区在减少人类对自然的压力方面究竟有多大效果？如何将保护效应与位置、可达性等混杂因素区分开来，并评估现有保护区的管理改进空间？
AI.motivation: 保护区是全球最广泛使用的生物多样性保护策略，但评估其减少人类压力的能力存在方法论困难，因为需要将保护效应与位置、可达性等混杂因素分离。以往研究缺乏严格的因果推断，难以准确衡量保护区的真实效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准实验方法（Quasi-experimental approach）、平均处理效应估计（Average Treatment Effect）、匹配对照方法（Matched controls）
AI.method: 采用准实验方法，对十四个空间威胁指标和一个综合指数估计陆地保护区的平均处理效应。通过匹配对照组来控制位置和可达性等混杂因素，并以保护压力情景相似的地区中表现最佳的保护区内绩效作为基准，估算现有保护区的威胁减排潜力。
AI.findings: 1) 保护区的综合威胁指数比匹配对照组低31.5%，在建成区、农田、采矿、道路、输电线和森林砍伐等方面均有统计显著的减少；2) 威胁减少在热带森林中最强，约为全球平均水平的两倍；3) 现有保护区仅实现其模型隐含、面积加权威胁减排潜力的49.2%；4) 许多受威胁脊椎动物的分布区在保护区内仍面临持续压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了严格因果推断框架下的保护区有效性评估方法，将准实验设计引入保护区效果测量，能够将保护效应与混杂因素分离，并提出了以绩效基准估算保护区潜力实现程度的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为《生物多样性公约》保护区目标提供了决策支持框架，帮助决策者在扩大保护区面积与提升现有保护区管理有效性之间取得平衡，识别出保护区管理改进的显著空间。

title: Enterprise Development through Women's Collectives: Experimental Evidence from Rural India
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Enterprise Development through Women's Collectives: Experimental Evidence from Rural India
detail.abstract: Female entrepreneurship remains constrained by multiple market and social barriers, yet there is limited causal evidence on whether enterprise development programmes delivered through women's collectives can overcome these constraints. We evaluate a multi-component enterprise development programme that combines business training, postharvest processing, value addition, and market linkage support for women's self-help groups engaged in millet value chains in Odisha, India. The programme was evaluated using a three-arm cluster randomised controlled trial that separately identifies the effects of postharvest processing support and commercially oriented value-addition training. Commercially oriented value-addition training substantially increased female enterprise creation, startup investment, business revenues, and profits, whereas postharvest processing support alone generated little measurable impact on entrepreneurial outcomes. The intervention also improved women's empowerment, increasing participation in entrepreneurial decision-making, strengthening control over income, and reducing work hours. The results suggest that general business training alone is insufficient to stimulate female entrepreneurship. Rather, combining technical skills with commercially viable product development and market opportunities relaxes multiple constraints simultaneously and enables women to establish profitable enterprises. These findings contribute new causal evidence that integrating value addition into agricultural value chains can promote both female entrepreneurship and women's economic empowerment, with important implications for the design of enterprise development programmes in low-income settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项三臂集群随机对照试验，评估了印度奥迪沙邦女性自助小组参与小米价值链的多组件企业发展项目，发现以商业为导向的增值培训显著促进了女性创业和企业绩效，而单独的采后加工支持几乎没有影响，且干预还提升了女性赋权。
AI.research_question: 通过女性集体提供的企业发展项目能否克服制约女性创业的多重市场和社会壁垒？具体而言，商业导向的增值培训与采后加工支持对女性创业和企业绩效分别有何影响？
AI.motivation: 女性创业面临多重市场和社会壁垒，但缺乏关于通过女性集体实施的企业发展项目能否克服这些约束的因果证据。现有证据多关注一般性商业培训，忽略了技术技能、产品开发与市场机会的整合作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重约束理论（multiple constraints framework）：女性创业受限于技能、资本、市场准入和社会规范等多重约束，需要同时放松多个约束才能有效促进创业。
AI.method: 三臂集群随机对照试验（RCT），将样本分为商业导向增值培训组、采后加工支持组和控制组，分别识别两类干预的独立效应，并测量创业创造、投资、收入、利润及女性赋权指标。
AI.findings: 商业导向的增值培训大幅提升了女性企业创建率、初始投资、商业收入和利润；单独的采后加工支持对创业成果几乎没有可测影响；干预还增强了女性参与创业决策、收入控制和减少了工作时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新的因果证据，表明一般商业培训不足，须将技术技能与商业可行的产品开发和市场机会相结合，以同时放松多重约束，促进女性创业和赋权；拓展了农业价值链整合与女性经济赋权的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入环境中企业发展项目的设计提供了重要启示：应整合增值加工、商业训练和市场联结等多组件干预，而非仅依赖一般性商业培训。

title: The Impact of Short-Video Content on the Impulse Buying Behavior of University Students in Pakistan

detail.title: The Impact of Short-Video Content on the Impulse Buying Behavior of University Students in Pakistan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individual or organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: As this was an independent undergraduate research project rather than an institutionally-funded study, formal ethics board (IRB) approval was not sought. However, participant safety and rights were maintained throughout: participation was entirely voluntary and anonymous, no personally identifying information was collected, and respondents gave implied consent by choosing to complete the survey.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was self-funded by the author as part of an independent undergraduate research project.

detail.abstract:
The fast emergence of short video platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts has led to a drastic change in the manner in which younger consumers identify and assess products. The current study examines the effect of short video content on the impulsive purchase decisions of Pakistani university students, an understudied context compared to the East and Southeast Asian context, which have been studied more extensively thus far. Based on the S-O-R theoretical perspective, the study considers short video content features, which include visually stimulating material, influencers’ credibility, celebrities' endorsements, promotion, and FOMO, as stimuli to consumer impulses.

This study adopted a quantitative cross-sectional survey research design. The data was collected from 122 university students of Pakistan via an online survey employing the 5-point Likert scale. Descriptive statistics, reliability, correlation and regression analyses were used to analyze the collected data. The findings indicate that there is a strong positive and statistically significant association between the content-exposure and impulse buying behavior (r = .722, p < .001), with the model accounting for about 52% of the variance in impulse buying behavior (R² = .522). The content-exposure scale (α = .919) and impulse buying behavior scale (α = .810) both showed high internal consistency. Promotional cues and celebrity endorsement were the two most important variables predicting impulsive buying behavior.

The results support the assertion that short videos can act as strong behavior stimulators among Pakistani university students, providing insight into marketing strategies and the financial benefits of consumers. This paper ends with the recommendation of future directions, which include mediating psychological factors and larger sample sizes.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于S-O-R理论框架，考察短视频内容特征（视觉刺激、网红可信度、名人代言、促销和FOMO）对巴基斯坦大学生冲动购买行为的影响。通过122名大学生的定量调查发现，内容接触与冲动购买行为呈显著正相关（r=.722），模型解释了约52%的方差，其中促销线索和名人代言是最重要的预测变量。
AI.research_question: 短视频内容如何影响巴基斯坦大学生的冲动购买决策？
AI.motivation: 短视频平台（如TikTok、Instagram Reels、YouTube Shorts）快速兴起，改变了年轻消费者的产品识别与评估方式。与已广泛研究的东亚和东南亚情境相比，巴基斯坦这一背景下短视频对冲动购买的影响尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: S-O-R（刺激-有机体-反应）理论框架
AI.method: 定量横截面调查研究设计，通过在线问卷（5点李克特量表）收集122名巴基斯坦大学生的数据，采用描述性统计、信度分析、相关性分析和回归分析。
AI.findings: 内容接触与冲动购买行为之间存在强正相关关系（r=.722, p<.001），模型解释了约52%的冲动购买行为方差（R²=.522）。内容接触量表（α=.919）和冲动购买行为量表（α=.810）均显示高内部一致性。促销线索和名人代言是预测冲动购买行为最重要的两个变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将S-O-R理论框架扩展到巴基斯坦这一新兴研究情境，验证了短视频内容特征作为刺激因素对消费者冲动购买反应的有效性，为短视频营销在非东亚语境下的理论适用性提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供了利用短视频（特别是促销线索和名人代言）激发消费者冲动购买的策略参考，同时揭示了短视频对消费者财务行为的影响，为制定营销策略和消费者保护提供了实践洞见。

title: Forecastability and Cost Structure: The Effect of Forecasted Sales Changes and Demand Uncertainty
affiliations: Osaka Metropolitan University, Kindai University,  and

detail.title: Forecastability and Cost Structure: The Effect of Forecasted Sales Changes and Demand Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Firms routinely face demand fluctuations that differ in their degree of forecastability, yet prior studies measure demand uncertainty using aggregate sales volatility, conflating forecastable variation with unforecastable shocks. We argue that these two components lead to fundamentally different capacity and cost structure decisions. We develop an analytical model showing that unforecastable demand shocks increase the value of committed capacity, resulting in a more rigid cost structure, whereas forecastable demand variation enables firms to rely on flexible resources and maintain greater cost elasticity. The model further predicts that cost responses to unexpected favorable demand shocks are weaker than responses to comparable planned demand increases because capacity is committed ex ante. We test these predictions using Japanese listed firms, whose mandatory management sales forecasts allow us to decompose realized sales changes into forecastable variation and unforecastable forecast errors. Using 44,021 firm-year observations from 1997 to 2023, we find that unforecastable demand variation is associated with lower cost elasticity across SG&A, cost of goods sold, and employment, while forecastable demand variation increases cost elasticity for SG&A and employment. We also find that firms respond less aggressively to unexpected favorable demand shocks than to comparable planned demand increases, consistent with binding capacity constraints. Our findings reconcile competing predictions in the cost structure literature by demonstrating that the operational consequences of demand uncertainty depend on its forecastability and highlight demand forecasting as an important determinant of capacity commitment and operational flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本上市公司的强制管理层销售预测数据，将实际销售变化分解为可预测部分与不可预测部分，发现不可预测的需求冲击会提高产能承诺价值，导致成本结构更刚性（成本弹性更低）；而可预测的需求变化使企业能够依赖弹性资源，保持更高的成本弹性。同时，企业对意外有利需求冲击的响应弱于对可比计划需求增长的响应，表明产能约束的约束作用。
AI.research_question: 需求不确定性的可预测性（可预测变化与不可预测冲击）如何影响企业的产能承诺和成本结构决策？
AI.motivation: 以往研究用总体销售波动衡量需求不确定性，混淆了可预测变化与不可预测冲击，无法区分二者对企业成本结构的不同影响，导致成本结构文献中出现竞争性预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产能承诺与运营灵活性理论；成本弹性分析框架
AI.method: 解析模型；利用日本上市公司强制性管理层销售预测数据将实际销售变化分解为可预测部分与不可预测预测误差；1997-2023年44,021个企业-年观测样本进行实证检验
AI.findings: （1）不可预测需求变化与SG&A、销售成本及就业的成本弹性更低相关；（2）可预测需求变化提高SG&A和就业的成本弹性；（3）企业对意外有利需求冲击的响应弱于对可比计划需求增长的响应，与产能约束一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了成本结构文献中的竞争性预测，证明需求不确定性的运营后果取决于其可预测性，将需求预测纳入产能承诺与运营灵活性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者根据需求可预测性制定产能和成本结构决策提供指导；强调需求预测在运营管理中的重要性。

title: What Do Firm-Level AI Measures Measure? Disclosure, Selection, and the Employment Effects of Generative AI
affiliations: and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University)

detail.title: What Do Firm-Level AI Measures Measure? Disclosure, Selection, and the Employment Effects of Generative AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Firm-level measures of corporate AI built from 10-K text are increasingly used to study how artificial intelligence affects labor, yet what they capture is unclear. We build a public, full-window (2018–2025) generative-AI disclosure measure for a Russell 3000-scale panel of large US public firms and audit it. About a quarter of the firm-years it flags mention generative AI only as a risk rather than as something the firm does, and an independent language-model reading of the filings confirms that the measure conflates genuine adopters with firms naming the technology as a threat. The measure is a noisy, endogenous proxy for adoption.
We then show that this matters for inference. We pair the measure with a predetermined-exposure design that weights each firm’s pre-shock occupation mix by occupation-level language-model exposure and interacts it with the November 2022 ChatGPT shock.
The negative adoption-employment correlation that animates the displacement narrative disappears under this design: it reflects selection, because the firms that adopt were already on different employment paths. Exposure is also nearly collinear with the workforce’s remote-work capability, a twin that biases naive estimates toward displacement, so the null we report is conservative.
Applied to the first-order question, the cleaned design shows that generative-AI exposure has not displaced net employment through fiscal 2025. The absence of displacement is precise rather than merely undetected, uniform across industry sectors,
and echoed by the secondary margins (productivity, revenue, margins, mass layoffs, and firm value). Our contribution is a validated, reusable measure of corporate generative-AI engagement, a measurement-and-identification caution for a literature that increasingly reads firm-level AI correlations as causal, and firm-level evidence that generative AI has not displaced the corporate workforce.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并审计了一个基于10-K文本的生成式AI企业披露度量（2018-2025，Russell 3000规模面板），发现该度量存在噪声：约四分之一的公司年提及生成式AI仅是作为风险而非实际采用。通过预设暴露设计与2022年11月ChatGPT冲击交互后，发现负向的AI采用-就业相关性消失，表明此前文献中的替代叙事源于选择效应。清洁设计显示生成式AI暴露至2025财年并未导致净就业替代，且该零结果是精确的、跨行业一致的。
AI.research_question: 基于10-K文本构建的企业AI度量究竟捕捉了什么？生成式AI暴露是否真的导致了企业层面的就业替代？
AI.motivation: 已有文献越来越多地使用基于10-K文本构建的企业AI度量来研究AI对劳动力市场的影响，但这些度量捕捉的内容尚不清楚。本文旨在验证这些度量的有效性，并重新检验生成式AI暴露与就业之间的因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预设暴露设计（predetermined-exposure design）、语言模型暴露度量（language-model exposure）、ChatGPT冲击（November 2022 ChatGPT shock）、因果关系识别框架。
AI.method: 构建公开的、全窗口（2018-2025）的生成式AI披露度量（覆盖Russell 3000规模的大型美国上市公司面板），通过独立语言模型阅读审计该度量；采用预设暴露设计，将每家公司在冲击前的职业构成按职业层面的语言模型暴露加权，并与2022年11月ChatGPT冲击交互；同时检验暴露与远程工作能力的共线性问题。
AI.findings: （1）约四分之一的公司年被标记为采用生成式AI仅是将其作为风险提及，而非实际采用行为；（2）独立语言模型确认该度量混淆了真实采用者与将AI视为威胁的公司；（3）负向的采用-就业相关性在预设暴露设计下消失，反映的是选择效应而非因果效应；（4）暴露与远程工作能力几乎共线，导致朴素估计偏向替代结论；（5）干净设计显示生成式AI到2025财年未导致净就业替代，且该零结果是精确的、跨行业一致。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提供经过验证、可复用的企业生成式AI参与度度量；（2）对日益将企业层面AI相关性解读为因果关系的文献提出了测量与识别层面的警示；（3）提供了生成式AI未替代企业劳动力的企业层面证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供一个经过审计的可复用企业生成式AI衡量工具，帮助后续研究者避免测量噪声导致的错误因果推断，并为政策制定者和企业管理者提供关于生成式AI对就业影响的企业层面实证证据。

title: DYNAMICS-8: An Eight Dimension Personality Framework for Computational Behavioural Simulation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DYNAMICS-8: An Eight Dimension Personality Framework for Computational Behavioural Simulation

declarations.funderStatement: Self funded

detail.abstract: We present DYNAMICS-8, an eight dimension continuous personality framework designed for computational behavioural simulation. DYNAMICS-8 retains six dimensions grounded in thirty years of validated personality science (the Big Five and HEXACO models) and introduces two built for this purpose dimensions: Acuity (digital fluency and platform nativeness) and Impulsivity (delay discounting and reward sensitivity). Unlike the Big Five and HEXACO, which optimise for internal consistency of self report questionnaires, DYNAMICS-8 optimises for predictive validity of observable behaviour in digital, financial, and social contexts. We define the framework formally: eight dimensions with four facets each (32 parameters), continuous 0.0-1.0 scoring, deterministic derivation mappings from personality to economic behaviour, political orientation, and interpersonal compatibility, and a census weighted persona generation methodology producing demographically representative synthetic populations. We validate the framework against a published dataset of 1,000 synthetic personas (500 UK, 500 US) with up to 187 behavioural fields per persona. Ten prespecified statistical tests confirm all hypotheses at Bonferroni corrected alpha (10 comparisons): Discipline predicts savings rate (d = 1.74), Mercuriality predicts emotional reactivity (d = 5.32), Sociability predicts relationship network size (d = 1.55), Impulsivity predicts impulse spending (d = 0.94) and price insensitivity (d = 0.78), Acuity predicts credit score (d = 0.22), Novelty predicts experience seeking behaviour (d = 0.44), Candour predicts brand loyalty (d = 0.21), Yielding predicts institutional trust (d = 0.54), and a Discipline and Impulsivity interaction test produces an emergent effect (d = 2.27) exceeding either single dimension. All p < 0.025, eight at p < 0.001. We demonstrate three downstream applications: synthetic consumer panel research, personality conditioned dialogue generation, and pairwise compatibility scoring with conflict prediction. The framework specification (CC BY 4.0), reference implementations in Python and Go (BSL 1.1), and the 1,000-persona validation dataset (CC BY-NC 4.0) are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DYNAMICS-8，一个八维度连续人格框架，用于计算行为模拟。它在基于大五人格和HEXACO模型的六个经科学验证的维度基础上，新增了适应性（数字流畅度）和冲动性（延迟贴现和奖励敏感度）两个维度，旨在优化数字、金融和社会情境中可观察行为的预测效度，而非自我报告问卷的内部一致性。框架通过1,000个合成人格数据集的十项预先指定的统计检验验证了所有假设，并展示了三个下游应用：合成消费者面板研究、人格条件对话生成和成对兼容性评分。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个人格框架，使其在计算行为模拟中能够优化数字、金融和社会情境下可观察行为的预测效度，而非像大五人格和HEXACO模型那样仅优化自我报告问卷的内部一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有的大五人格和HEXACO模型虽然在人格科学中经过三十年验证，但其设计目的是优化自我报告问卷的内部一致性，而非预测数字、金融和社会情境中的可观察行为。在计算行为模拟（如合成消费者研究、对话生成、兼容性评估）的背景下，需要一个专门为此目的设计的人格框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大五人格（Big Five）和HEXACO模型这两个经过三十年验证的人格科学框架，新增两个专门为计算行为模拟设计的维度：Acuity（数字流畅度和平台原生性）和Impulsivity（延迟贴现和奖励敏感度）。框架采用八维度×四facets（32参数）的连续0.0-1.0评分体系。
AI.method: 1) 构建DYNAMICS-8八维度人格框架（每维度四个facets，共32个参数）；2) 定义从人格到经济行为、政治倾向和人际兼容性的确定性推导映射；3) 采用人口普查加权的人格生成方法产生人口统计学代表性的合成人群；4) 使用1,000个合成人格数据（500英国+500美国，每人最多187个行为字段）进行验证；5) 执行十项预先指定的统计检验，使用Bonferroni校正的alpha水平。
AI.findings: 所有十项假设均在Bonferroni校正后通过：纪律性预测储蓄率（d=1.74）、善变性预测情绪反应性（d=5.32）、社交性预测关系网络规模（d=1.55）、冲动性预测冲动消费（d=0.94）和价格不敏感度（d=0.78）、适应性预测信用评分（d=0.22）、求新性预测体验寻求行为（d=0.44）、坦率性预测品牌忠诚度（d=0.21）、顺从性预测制度信任（d=0.54）。纪律性与冲动性的交互作用产生涌现效应（d=2.27），超过任一单一维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个专门为计算行为模拟优化的人格框架，扩展了传统人格科学框架（大五、HEXACO）到数字行为预测领域，并展示了维度间交互作用可以产生超出单一维度预测能力的涌现效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供合成消费者面板研究的框架；2) 支持人格条件对话生成；3) 实现成对兼容性评分和冲突预测。框架规范（CC BY 4.0）、Python和Go参考实现（BSL 1.1）、1,000人格验证数据集（CC BY-NC 4.0）均公开可用。

title: Financial Literacy, Trust, and Receptivity to AI Financial Advice: Evidence from the 2024 National Financial Capability Study

detail.title: Financial Literacy, Trust, and Receptivity to AI Financial Advice: Evidence from the 2024 National Financial Capability Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with other people or organisations that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required. This study is a secondary analysis of publicly available, de-identified survey data (the 2024 National Financial Capability Study, FINRA Investor Education Foundation). No participants were recruited, and no identifiable personal data were accessed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Who is open to receiving financial advice from artificial intelligence? Prior work on robo-advisory adoption reports a paradox in which subjective financial confidence, rather than objective competence, drives trust in algorithmic advice (Chen, Aw and Tan, 2025). This study provides a pre-registered test of that claim, derived from the Contextual Trust Calibration Framework (CTCF; Hari, 2026), using the first nationally representative United States measure of receptivity to AI financial advice: item B61 of the 2024 National Financial Capability Study (n = 25,539; analytic n = 18,102). The pre-registered prediction was not supported. Objective financial literacy is a strong positive predictor of interest in AI advice (OR = 1.24 per standard deviation), and the pre-specified equivalence test rejects the predicted null. In contrast, selfassessed knowledge shows no significant association, and day-today financial self-efficacy shows a small negative association. Generalised trust propensity predicts receptivity as hypothesised. Unexpectedly, respondents who believe they were targeted by financial fraud in the past year are considerably more interested in AI advice (OR = 1.63). A pre-registered test of a decision-stakes moderation (portfolio value × trust propensity) in the merged Investor Survey subsample (n = 2,006) shows no evidence of an interaction. The results indicate that the confidence-over-competence pattern documented among roboadvisory users does not generalise to stated receptivity in the general population, consistent with the CTCF's core claim that dispositional effects on trust in algorithmic advice are context-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过首次全美代表性样本（2024年国家金融能力调查，n=18,102）预注册检验了"主观金融信心而非客观能力驱动对AI理财建议信任"的悖论。结果推翻了该预测：客观金融素养与AI建议兴趣显著正相关（OR=1.24），而自我评估知识与自评效能感无正相关。该结果支持情境信任校准框架（CTCF）的核心主张——性格特质对算法建议信任的影响具有情境依赖性。
AI.research_question: 人们对人工智能理财建议的接受度是由客观金融能力还是主观金融信心驱动？该悖论能否推广到一般人群？
AI.motivation: 先前关于机器人投顾（robo-advisory）的研究报告了一个悖论：主观金融信心（而非客观能力）驱动对算法建议的信任。但该发现基于特定用户群体，可能不适用于一般人群。本研究旨在通过全国代表性样本对这一主张进行预注册检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情境信任校准框架（Contextual Trust Calibration Framework, CTCF）
AI.method: 预注册研究设计，使用2024年国家金融能力调查（NFCS）B61题项（n=25,539；分析样本n=18,102）。采用逻辑回归（OR值报告）、预注册等价性检验，以及在投资者调查子样本（n=2,006）中进行决策风险调节作用的预注册检验（组合价值×信任倾向的交互效应）。
AI.findings: 1. 预注册预测未获支持：客观金融素养是AI建议兴趣的强正向预测因子（OR=1.24/标准差）；2. 自评知识与兴趣无显著关联；3. 日常金融自我效能感呈小幅负向关联；4. 一般化信任倾向如假设预测正向预测接受度；5. 意外发现：过去一年认为自己遭受金融欺诈的受访者对AI建议兴趣显著更高（OR=1.63）；6. 决策风险调节检验（组合价值×信任倾向）无交互效应证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究发现"信心优于能力"这一模式在机器人投顾用户中成立，但无法推广到一般人群的陈述性接受度。这一结果与CTCF核心主张一致：性格特质对算法建议信任的影响依赖于情境。为信任校准理论提供了大型全国代表性样本的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对金融科技产品设计和政策制定有参考价值：客观金融素养较高的人群更愿意接受AI金融建议，这对AI理财顾问的市场定位、监管合规以及投资者教育策略（如针对低金融素养人群的推广）具有实践启示。同时，欺诈受害经历与更高的AI建议兴趣相关，提示对此类人群需加强风险提示。

title: Recruiting for Scarcity: A Soft-Systems Analysis of the Niche-Technology Skills Gap in the Indian IT Workforce, Revisited in the Generative-AI Era
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Recruiting for Scarcity: A Soft-Systems Analysis of the Niche-Technology Skills Gap in the Indian IT Workforce, Revisited in the Generative-AI Era
detail.abstract: This paper examines the recruitment and retention of niche-technology talent in the Indian information-technology (IT) sector using a soft-systems perspective. The analysis was originally developed as a management-consultancy coursework exercise in 2023, built on stakeholder mapping, Soft Systems Methodology (SSM), CATWOE analysis, and a BCG growth-share prioritisation of interventions. The present paper retains that conceptual architecture but reexamines it against 2025-2026 evidence on India's artificial-intelligence (AI) talent gap, IT-sector attrition, and the accelerating adoption of AI in hiring. The re-analysis finds that the structural conflict identified in 2023-IT firms and clients competing for a scarce pool of experienced, nicheskilled professionals, while candidates and hiring teams negotiate under asymmetric informationhas not resolved; if anything, the gap has narrowed in generality (fewer roles are affected) but sharpened in intensity (the affected roles, concentrated in AI, cloud, and data engineering, are harder to fill than before). The paper argues that AI has entered the system twice over: as a driver of the skills shortage (because AI-related roles are now the hardest to fill) and as a candidate solution to it (because AI-assisted screening, upskilling, and workforce analytics are now mainstream HR practice in India). The original recommendation-that firms should prioritise structured training of early-career talent over competing for scarce experienced hires-is reassessed against current evidence and found to remain broadly sound, with an added caveat that AI-literacy training must now be treated as a first-order component of that pipeline rather than an auxiliary skill. Declaration of Generative AI Use Generative AI tools were used under the author's supervision to support literature search and synthesis, drafting assistance, and formatting of this manuscript from the author's original 2023 coursework analysis. All conceptual frameworks, stakeholder judgements, and interpretive conclusions are the author's own. The author reviewed and takes full responsibility for the final content.

AI.tldr: 本文以软系统视角研究了印度IT行业利基技术人才的招聘与保留问题。该分析最初是2023年的管理咨询课程作业，基于利益相关者图谱、软系统方法论（SSM）、CATWOE分析和BCG增长-份额干预优先级排序构建。论文将这些概念框架与2025-2026年关于印度AI人才缺口、IT行业人员流失及AI招聘加速采用的证据进行重新审视，发现2023年识别的结构性冲突（IT公司与客户争夺稀缺的有经验利基技能专业人才，而候选人与招聘团队在信息不对称下谈判）并未解决，反而在广度上收窄但在强度上加剧。论文认为AI在系统中扮演双重角色：既是技能短缺的驱动因素，又是候选解决方案。原建议——优先对早期职业人才进行结构化培训而非争夺稀缺的有经验人才——经重新评估后仍然基本稳健，但需补充一点：AI素养培训必须被视为该流程的一阶组成部分而非辅助技能。
AI.research_question: 在印度IT行业中，利基技术人才的招聘与保留是如何运作的？当AI作为技能短缺的驱动因素和解决方案双重进入系统后，原有的结构性冲突是否以及如何演变？
AI.motivation: 填补对印度IT行业利基技术人才短缺问题在AI时代变化的理解空白，重新验证2023年基于软系统方法论的分析框架在2025-2026年新证据下的有效性，并考察AI作为系统内双重角色对人才招聘与保留的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软系统视角（Soft Systems Perspective），具体包括：软系统方法论（SSM）、CATWOE分析、利益相关者图谱、BCG增长-份额矩阵、信息不对称理论。
AI.method: 基于2023年管理咨询课程作业的二次分析。核心方法包括：利益相关者映射、软系统方法论（SSM）、CATWOE商业分析，以及BCG增长-份额干预优先级排序。随后用2025-2026年印度AI人才缺口、IT行业流失率及AI招聘采用的最新证据对原有框架进行重新检验和评估。
AI.findings: （1）2023年识别的结构性冲突（IT公司与客户竞争稀缺经验型利基人才，以及候选人与招聘团队间的信息不对称）在2025-2026年依然存在且未获解决；（2）该冲突的范围有所收窄（受影响的岗位类别减少），但强度显著加剧（AI、云计算和数据工程领域的关键岗位比以前更难填补）；（3）AI在系统中扮演双重角色——既是技能短缺的驱动因素（AI相关岗位最难填补），又是候选解决方案（AI辅助筛选、技能提升和工作力分析已成为印度HR主流实践）；（4）原建议（优先结构化培训早期职业人才）仍然有效，但AI素养培训必须被提升为一阶组件。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明了软系统方法论（SSM）在动态变化环境中进行纵向重新评估的有效性；（2）在软系统视角下揭示了AI作为"双重角色"（问题驱动者和解决方案）在人才生态系统中同时存在的新现象；（3）将信息不对称理论的应用从候选人-招聘方二元关系扩展至包含IT企业-客户竞争关系的更复杂系统结构。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为印度IT企业提供了经最新证据验证的人才招聘与保留策略建议，即继续优先结构化培训早期职业人才而非在稀缺经验人才市场上激烈竞争；（2）明确指出AI素养培训应从辅助技能升级为培训管道中的一阶核心组件；（3）为企业利用AI辅助筛选、技能提升和工作力分析等工具应对人才短缺提供了实践路径参考。

title: The Role of Food Delivery Applications and Social Media in Shaping Consumer Decision-Making and Food Purchasing Behaviour Among Generation Z in Mumbai

detail.title: The Role of Food Delivery Applications and Social Media in Shaping Consumer Decision-Making and Food Purchasing Behaviour Among Generation Z in Mumbai

declarations.ethicsApproval: Before beginning the questionnaire, participants were informed about the purpose of the study and were notified that their responses would remain anonymous and be used solely for academic research purposes. Participation in the study was entirely voluntary, and respondents could choose whether or not to complete the questionnaire. No personally identifiable information, such as names or contact details, was collected, and all responses were analysed in aggregate to maintain participant confidentiality. Completion of the questionnaire was considered as implied consent to participate in the study.

detail.abstract: The fast growth of food delivery applications and social media has changed the way consumers discover restaurants, select food options, and make purchasing decisions. This study aimed to examine the combined influence of food delivery applications and social media on the consumer decision-making and food purchasing behaviour of Generation Z consumers in Mumbai. A quantitative cross-sectional research design was adopted, and primary data were collected through an online questionnaire administered to 204 respondents using convenience and snowball sampling. The findings indicate that factors such as convenience, discounts, delivery speed, visually appealing content, and social media engagement significantly influence consumer purchasing behaviour. The study also found that Generation Z increasingly relies on digital platforms when making food-related decisions. The findings support the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), suggesting that technological and social factors together shape consumer behaviour. The study contributes to the growing literature on digital consumer behaviour by examining the combined influence of food delivery applications and social media within the context of Generation Z consumers in Mumbai.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了食品配送应用与社交媒体对孟买Z世代消费者决策和食品购买行为的综合影响，通过在线问卷收集204名受访者数据，发现便利性、折扣、配送速度、视觉吸引内容和社交媒体参与显著影响购买行为，研究结果支持技术接受模型（TAM）和计划行为理论（TPB）。
AI.research_question: 食品配送应用与社交媒体如何综合影响孟买Z世代消费者的决策过程和食品购买行为？
AI.motivation: 食品配送应用和社交媒体的快速增长改变了消费者发现餐厅、选择食品和做出购买决策的方式，但已有研究较少关注这两种数字平台对Z世代消费者的综合影响，尤其是在新兴市场城市（如孟买）的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（Technology Acceptance Model, TAM）和计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behaviour, TPB）
AI.method: 采用定量横截面研究设计，通过在线问卷收集数据，使用便利抽样和滚雪球抽样方法，共获得204名受访者样本。
AI.findings: （1）便利性、折扣、配送速度、视觉吸引内容和社交媒体参与显著影响消费者购买行为；（2）Z世代在做出食品相关决策时日益依赖数字平台；（3）研究结果支持TAM和TPB，表明技术因素和社会因素共同塑造消费者行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过考察食品配送应用和社交媒体的综合影响，扩展了数字消费者行为领域的文献，特别是在Z世代消费者的情境下，并验证了TAM和TPB在食品配送场景中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食品配送平台和餐饮企业提供了关于影响Z世代消费者购买行为关键因素（如便利性、折扣、配送速度、视觉内容和社交媒体参与）的实证依据，有助于优化营销策略和平台设计。

title: Christian Royal Priesthood Identity and Its Influence on Luxury Fashion Consumption

detail.title: Christian Royal Priesthood Identity and Its Influence on Luxury Fashion Consumption
detail.abstract: This study examines the influence of Christian royal priesthood identity on luxury fashion consumption through an interdisciplinary analysis of theology, consumer psychology, fashion studies, and cultural identity. Drawing from the biblical concept of believers as a “royal priesthood” (1 Peter 2:9, KJV), this research explores how sacred identity shapes perceptions of beauty, adornment, self-presentation, and material expression. Through a qualitative theological-interpretive methodology, the study analyzes biblical texts concerning priesthood, kingship, holiness, and symbolic garments alongside contemporary scholarship on religious consumer behavior, luxury consumption, and fashion identity. The findings suggest that Christian royal priesthood identity does not inherently reject luxury fashion but transforms its meaning by reframing luxury as a potential expression of dignity, stewardship, spiritual representation, and consecrated identity. Rather than viewing luxury solely through the lenses of status signaling or materialism, this framework positions fashion as a symbolic medium through which believers negotiate faith, culture, and personal identity. The study further identifies three primary influences of royal priesthood identity on luxury consumption: symbolic self-presentation, spiritually motivated consumption, and ethical boundaries shaped by holiness and stewardship. By integrating biblical theology with consumer psychology and fashion theory, this research contributes to emerging discussions on religion’s role in marketplace behavior and challenges assumptions that luxury fashion is inherently secular. The study proposes that Christian identity functions as a significant interpretive framework through which luxury goods acquire theological, cultural, and symbolic meaning.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过神学、消费者心理学、时尚研究和文化认同的跨学科分析，探讨基督教"皇家祭司"身份认同对奢侈品时尚消费的影响。研究发现，这一神圣身份并未从根本上拒绝奢侈品时尚，而是通过将其重新定义为尊严、管家职分、属灵表征和成圣身份的表达，转变了奢侈品的意义。研究识别出三种主要影响：象征性自我呈现、属灵驱动的消费，以及由圣洁和管家职分塑造的伦理边界。
AI.research_question: 基督教"皇家祭司"身份认同如何影响信徒的奢侈品时尚消费行为与意义建构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往将奢侈品时尚视为本质上世俗的现象，忽视了宗教身份在消费者市场行为中的解释性作用。本研究旨在填补宗教身份与奢侈品消费之间关系的理论空白，挑战"奢侈品天然世俗"的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于圣经"皇家祭司"概念（彼得前书2:9），整合神学（祭司职分、君王身份、圣洁观）、消费者心理学（宗教消费行为）、时尚研究（时尚身份构建）与文化认同理论。
AI.method: 质性神学诠释学方法：分析圣经文本中关于祭司职分、君王身份、圣洁和象征性服饰的经文，并结合当代宗教消费者行为、奢侈品消费与时尚身份的学术文献进行交叉分析。
AI.findings: 基督教"皇家祭司"身份并不从根本上排斥奢侈品时尚，而是将其意义从地位信号或物质主义转变为尊严、管家职分、属灵表征和成圣身份的表达。研究识别出三种主要影响：象征性自我呈现、属灵驱动的消费，以及由圣洁和管家职分塑造的伦理边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将圣经神学与消费者心理学和时尚理论相结合，拓展了宗教在市场竞争行为中角色的新兴讨论，挑战了奢侈品时尚本质上是世俗的假设，并提出基督教身份是奢侈品获得神学、文化和象征意义的重要解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宗教背景下的消费者行为提供新的理解视角，帮助营销者和时尚从业者理解宗教身份在奢侈品消费中的调节作用，同时也为基督徒消费者提供神学反思框架以指导其消费决策。

title: The Marketing Context Graph: A Governed Substrate for Causal Marketing Measurement and Auditable Decision Provenance Causal Inference as a Governed Layer on a Bitemporal Context Graph
affiliations: Lifesight and Lifesight

detail.title: The Marketing Context Graph: A Governed Substrate for Causal Marketing Measurement and Auditable Decision Provenance Causal Inference as a Governed Layer on a Bitemporal Context Graph

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors are employees of Lifesight, a company that develops AI augmented unified marketing measurement SaaS including media-mix modelling and incrementality tooling; Anil Kumar Singh is its CTO and co-founder. The Marketing Context Graph described in this paper reflects an architecture in commercial development at Lifesight, a relationship that could be perceived as an interest in its favourable evaluation. The contribution is methodological: all reported results derive from synthetic data with known ground truth and openly released code; no proprietary dataset, customer data, or commercial product is evaluated or benchmarked, and all comparisons are against standard public methods. The authors declare no other competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research involves no human participants, patients, animal subjects, or personal data; all results derive from computer simulations on synthetic data with known ground truth.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted by the authors as employees of Lifesight, which provided no funding beyond their regular employment.

detail.abstract:
Marketing decisions increasingly depend on two capabilities that have evolved separately: causal marketing measurement (distinguishing real advertising effects from the correlational patterns in marketing data, the domain of Causal AI) and governed, graph-based context for the AI agents now trusted to act on those effects, the domain of Agentic AI. Both are limited by the same architectural gap. 
Problem 1: measurement is correlational by construction (not only in media-mix models but in touch-based attribution and observational methods generally), so a channel’s direct, indirect, and total effects are hard to separate and to calibrate against experiments. Problem 2: the agents acting on those effects lack persistent, governed, historically accurate context, and to answer questions such as which campaigns to scale or how to optimize the mix they must reason over incremental effects, uncertainty, evidence strength, applicable populations, and decision lineage, not language.

We introduce the Marketing Context Graph (MCG), a bi-temporal, governed property graph, formally a tuple G = (E, R, γE, γR), in which campaign entities, spend vectors, conversion outcomes, and external macro factors are connected by typed, directional, causally identified edges carrying bi-temporal attributes and reified decision traces. We give it a precise set-theoretic semantics, define a point-in-time snapshot operator Σ(tv, tr), and prove it is free of look-ahead contamination. Crucially, the MCG is a governed substrate, not a new estimator: the measurement methods applied on it are classical: mediation / path analysis, inverse-probability weighting, and transport. We (i) inject an experiment-identified halo edge as an informative structural prior into a Gaussian-conjugate Bayesian MMM, showing it reduces posterior variance along the collinear directions (Remark 1) while separating that variance claim from identification (Proposition 2); (ii) compose each channel’s total effect by traversing the graph, so budget decisions improve as cross-channel mediation grows and gain nothing when no structure exists; (iii) reconstruct complete, auditable decision provenance; and (iv) transport an identified edge across populations exactly when the graph’s selection diagram licenses it, and refuse when it does not.

Our evaluation is decision-centric rather than fit-centric. Across 8,000 simulated budget decisions the graph cuts budget-decision regret by up to 43% as cross-channel mediation grows (a paired within-replication reduction); look-ahead-free backtesting exposes 70% over-investment that a flat store conceals; the graph answers the provenance queries that require multi-hop, policy, temporal, and audit structure a flat fact/vector store cannot represent; and governed transport stays low-error as populations diverge, where naive transfer’s error grows linearly with divergence. Evidence is synthetic by design, isolating each mechanism against a known oracle; all results are reproducible from released code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出营销上下文图（MCG），一个双时态、受治理的属性图，将因果测量与代理智能体的上下文治理统一在同一架构下。MCG不是新的估计器，而是为经典因果方法（中介分析、IPW、迁移学习）提供受治理的图基板，支持无前瞻污染的时序快照、可审计的决策溯源以及受许可的跨人群效应迁移，实验表明可将预算决策遗憾降低最多43%。
AI.research_question: 如何将因果营销测量（Causal AI）与代理智能体的受治理图上下文（Agentic AI）统一在同一架构中，以克服两者共同面临的结构性缺陷——即测量的相关性局限和代理缺乏持久、受治理的历史上下文？
AI.motivation: 营销决策日益依赖两个分开发展的能力：因果测量（区分真实广告效应与相关性模式）和受治理的图上下文（为AI代理提供可依据的决策信息）。两者都受限于同一架构性缺口：测量本质上基于相关性，难以分离直接/间接/总效应；代理缺乏持久、受治理、历史准确的情境来进行增量效应、不确定性、证据强度等推理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图论（属性图）、集合论语义、双时态数据模型、因果推断（中介/路径分析、逆概率加权、迁移/传输）、贝叶斯共轭推断（高斯共轭MMM）、选择图（selection diagram）理论
AI.method: 构建MCG形式框架（G=(E,R,γE,γR)），定义点快照算子Σ(tv,tr)并证明无前瞻污染；注入实验识别光环边作为结构化先验进入高斯共轭贝叶斯MMM；通过图遍历组合各渠道总效应；重建完整可审计的决策溯源；基于选择图许可进行跨人群效应迁移。评估采用8,000次模拟预算决策、无前瞻回测等。
AI.findings: MCG在跨渠道中介增长时最多将预算决策遗憾降低43%（配对复制内减少）；无前瞻回测揭示了扁平存储掩盖的70%过度投资；MCG能回答需要多跳、策略、时间与审计结构的溯源查询（扁平事实/向量存储无法表示）；受治理的迁移在人群分化时保持低误差，而朴素迁移的误差随分化线性增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化定义了MCG这一双时态受治理属性图，给出精确集合论语义并证明了无损前瞻污染性质；将实验识别效应作为结构化先验注入贝叶斯MMM并区分了方差缩减声明与识别性（命题2与注记1）；建立了图结构许可效应迁移的形式条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销决策提供了可审计、可溯源、受治理的统一图基板，使代理智能体能够基于真正因果效应而非相关性进行决策；通过无前瞻回测暴露过度投资风险；提供可复现代码，支持预算分配、效果评估和跨人群迁移的实际落地。

title: The New Industrial Race- How AI, National Policy, and Talent Are Reshaping Global Manufacturing

detail.title: The New Industrial Race- How AI, National Policy, and Talent Are Reshaping Global Manufacturing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed as a Staff Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., which is discussed in this paper as one of several companies receiving CHIPS Act incentives and expanding U.S. semiconductor manufacturing investment. This paper reflects the author's independent analysis and does not represent the views, positions, or proprietary information of Micron Technology, Inc. All data on Micron and other companies referenced is drawn from public sources cited in the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a policy and industry analysis based entirely on publicly available data, government sources, and previously published research. It does not involve human subjects, patient data, or original primary research requiring ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding or financial support. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: A research brief on manufacturing's technological transformation, the industrial policies of major economies, and the talent and workforce dynamics shaping the next decade of production.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份研究简报，聚焦制造业技术转型、主要经济体的产业政策以及人才与劳动力动态，探讨未来十年生产领域的变革趋势。
AI.research_question: 制造业的技术转型、主要经济体的产业政策以及人才与劳动力动态将如何塑造未来十年的生产格局？
AI.motivation: 制造业正处于深刻的技术变革期，同时各主要经济体纷纷出台产业政策以增强竞争力，人才与劳动力市场也在发生结构性变化，三者交织将决定未来十年制造业的发展方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及产业政策理论、技术转型理论以及劳动力市场与人才发展理论。
AI.method: 简报形式，综合分析与综述性研究方法。
AI.findings: 制造业技术转型、产业政策与人才劳动力动态是塑造未来十年生产发展的三大关键维度，三者之间存在紧密的相互作用关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术转型、产业政策与劳动力动态三个维度整合起来，为理解制造业未来发展趋势提供了综合性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、制造业企业和相关利益方提供了关于未来十年制造业发展方向的前瞻性洞察与参考。

title: Personal Intellectual Capital: A Framework for Professional Excellence in the AI Era

detail.title: Personal Intellectual Capital: A Framework for Professional Excellence in the AI Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual contribution and does not involve human participants, data collection, or experimental procedures; accordingly, no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes Personal Intellectual Capital (Personal IC) as a micro-foundational framework explaining how knowledge workers configure, govern and mobilise intellectual resources to sustain Professional Excellence in AI-mediated knowledge work. It addresses a persistent theoretical gap: while Intellectual Capital and Knowledge Management research explain how organisations create value from intangible resources, they provide limited explanation of how individuals do so. Personal IC is conceptualised as an evolving configuration of Human, Structural and Relational intellectual resources whose value is realised through Human Agency (governance) and Knowledge-inAction (enactment). Following a formal theory-building methodology, the paper synthesises Intellectual Capital, Knowledge Management, and Artificial Intelligence research into a causal framework with five theoretical propositions. The framework specifies a causal architecture in which Personal Intellectual Capital provides intellectual potential, Human Agency governs and orchestrates its mobilisation, Knowledge-inAction represents its enactment, and Professional Excellence emerges through sustained value-creating professional contribution. This is captured by the Direction Imperative: as AI-generated knowledge becomes abundant, purposeful human direction becomes the primary source of differentiation in knowledge work. The paper advances Intellectual Capital theory by providing a causal framework for Individual-Level Intellectual Capital, contributing the tripartite architecture of Personal IC, positioning Human Agency as the governance mechanism linking intellectual resources to action, introducing Knowledge-inAction as the enactment mechanism, conceptualising Professional Excellence as sustained value creation in AI-mediated knowledge work, and proposing the Direction Imperative to explain why AImediated knowledge abundance increases-rather than diminishes-the strategic importance of human intellectual capital.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"个人智力资本"（Personal IC）作为微观基础框架，解释知识工作者如何在AI中介的知识工作中配置、治理和调动智力资源以维持专业卓越。该框架通过整合智力资本、知识管理和人工智能研究，构建了一个包含五项理论命题的因果框架，核心观点是"方向指令"（Direction Imperative）：随着AI生成知识的丰富，有目的的人类方向成为知识工作中差异化的主要来源。
AI.research_question: 个人如何配置、治理和调动智力资源以在AI中介的知识工作中维持专业卓越？
AI.motivation: 智力资本和知识管理研究解释了组织如何从无形资源中创造价值，但对个人如何做到这一点缺乏解释，存在持续的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智力资本理论（智力资本、知识管理和人工智能研究）、人的能动性（Human Agency）、行动中知识（Knowledge-in-Action）
AI.method: 正式理论构建方法（formal theory-building methodology），综合智力资本、知识管理和人工智能研究，构建包含五项理论命题的因果框架。
AI.findings: 提出个人智力资本的三重架构（人力、结构、关系智力资源）；人的能动性作为治理机制连接智力资源与行动；行动中知识作为执行机制；专业卓越被概念化为AI中介知识工作中的持续价值创造；提出"方向指令"解释AI中介知识丰裕为何增加而非减少人类智力资本的战略重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进智力资本理论：提供个体层面智力资本的因果框架；贡献个人智力资本的三重架构；将人的能动性定位为连接智力资源与行动的治理机制；引入行动中知识作为执行机制；概念化专业卓越为AI中介知识工作中的持续价值创造；提出"方向指令"解释AI知识丰裕与人类智力资本战略重要性的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识工作者在AI时代如何配置和治理个人智力资源以维持专业卓越提供理论指导；为企业管理个人智力资本提供框架基础。

title: The Covenantal Marketing Framework: Proposing a Biblically Inspired Model for Silent Marketing in Luxury and Fashion Through the Lens of Semiotics, Iconography and Psychology

detail.title: The Covenantal Marketing Framework: Proposing a Biblically Inspired Model for Silent Marketing in Luxury and Fashion Through the Lens of Semiotics, Iconography and Psychology
detail.abstract: This study introduces the Covenantal Marketing Framework, a biblically inspired conceptual model that reinterprets luxury and fashion marketing through the integrated lenses of semiotics, iconography, psychology, and theological aesthetics. Challenging dominant marketing paradigms centered on persuasion, dominance, and status signaling, this research proposes “silent marketing” as an alternative framework rooted in symbolic restraint, spiritual intentionality, and covenantal meaning. Through qualitative conceptual analysis of existing literature on luxury consumption, consumer psychology, religious orientation, branding, and visual communication, the study examines how products, environments, and brand rituals function as semiotic systems that communicate identity, values, and transcendence. Drawing from Christian theology and biblical principles, the framework argues that luxury can operate not as a mechanism of social elevation or material performance, but as a vessel of stewardship, testimony, and sacred expression. The study further explores how Christian consumers interpret luxury symbolism through moral cognition, spiritual identity, and theological discernment, demonstrating that marketplace behavior is shaped not only by psychological motivations but also by faith-based meaning systems. By reframing branding as revelation, design as testimony, and consumer engagement as covenantal participation, this research contributes a spiritually grounded perspective to luxury marketing scholarship. The Covenantal Marketing Framework expands discussions of branding beyond transactional exchange, proposing that luxury communication can function as a symbolic language of purpose, legacy, and divine alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"圣约营销框架"（Covenantal Marketing Framework），一个基于圣经启示的概念模型，通过符号学、图像学、心理学和神学美学的整合视角重新诠释奢侈品与时尚营销。研究挑战以说服、支配和地位信号为核心的传统营销范式，提出"无声营销"（silent marketing）作为替代框架，该框架植根于象征克制、精神意图和圣约意义。通过质性概念分析，论文探讨了产品、环境和品牌仪式如何作为符号系统传达身份、价值和超越性。研究主张奢侈品不应作为社会提升或物质表演的机制，而应作为管家职分、见证和神圣表达的载体。
AI.research_question: 奢侈品和时尚营销能否以及如何通过基于圣经原则的"圣约营销框架"被重新诠释，即从说服和地位信号范式转向以象征克制、精神意图和圣约意义为核心的"无声营销"范式？
AI.motivation: 传统营销范式过度聚焦于说服、支配和地位信号，忽视了信仰驱动的意义系统在消费者市场行为中的重要作用。本研究旨在填补奢侈品营销研究中精神和神学维度的空白，为理解品牌、消费与信仰之间的关系提供新的理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究整合了符号学（Semiotics）、图像学（Iconography）、心理学（Psychology）和神学美学（Theological Aesthetics）四大理论视角，并借鉴基督教神学与圣经原则作为核心理论框架。
AI.method: 质性概念分析方法（Qualitative Conceptual Analysis），对奢侈品消费、消费者心理学、宗教取向、品牌和视觉传播领域的现有文献进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现奢侈品可以超越社会提升或物质表演的功能，作为管家职分（stewardship）、见证（testimony）和神圣表达（sacred expression）的载体。基督教消费者通过道德认知、精神身份和神学辨别的框架来解读奢侈品象征，表明市场行为不仅受心理动机塑造，也受基于信仰的意义系统影响。品牌可被重构为启示（revelation）、设计为见证（testimony）、消费者参与为圣约参与（covenantal participation）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"圣约营销框架"这一全新的理论模型，将奢侈品传播重新定义为一种目的、遗产和神圣对齐的象征语言。将品牌讨论从交易性交换扩展至精神和超越性维度，为奢侈品营销学术研究贡献了灵性根基的视角，并整合了符号学、神学与消费者心理学的跨学科理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品和时尚品牌提供了基于信仰导向的营销实践替代方案——"无声营销"，即通过象征克制和精神意图传递品牌价值；为面向基督教消费者群体的品牌提供了关于如何解读和回应信仰驱动的消费行为的实践指导。

title: Moving Targets: Promissory Instability in the Pricing and Access Terms of Generative AI Subscription Services (2024-2026)

detail.title: Moving Targets: Promissory Instability in the Pricing and Access Terms of Generative AI Subscription Services (2024-2026)
detail.abstract: Between October 2024 and July 2026, the leading commercial providers of generative artificial intelligence repeatedly modified the pricing, usage limits, and access terms of subscription services after consumers had already paid for them. This paper documents that pattern through a rapid multiple-case documentary analysis of four providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Moonshot AI), drawing exclusively on dated public sources: official announcements, technology press coverage, community bug trackers, and the public record of two formal legal actions.
