On this core we build the artefact: a five-layer architecture-telemetry, estimation, optimisation, policy and interface-whose policy layer materialises in three executable budgetary decision rules (marginal parity, condition-precedent threshold and dynamic operating ceiling). We show that these three rules decentralise the centralised optimum between the Finance function and the Data function through the exchange of two scalars only, and that the convergence condition of the protocol coincides exactly with the second-order condition of the problem. The two-variable problem further reduces to a scalar search of logarithmic cost, which makes the artefact computable in real time. Simulation-based evaluation over two calibrated organisational profiles quantifies the value of the artefact: a firm with fragmented data that applies the conventional static model over-uses the technology by 27.8%, believes it is obtaining a profit of +32.0 monetary units and in fact realises a loss of 36.7, whereas the DSS solution places it at +8.4. The decomposition of the scissor effect reveals that the cost channel-ignored by the previous literature-accounts for a further contraction of the optimum of 91.7% on top of the contraction already caused by the loss of value.

AI.tldr: 本文指出企业将生成式AI采用视为单纯的技术规模问题（仅决定使用强度x）在结构上不完整，会导致系统性偏误。作者构建了一个内生数据治理的模型驱动决策支持系统（DSS），通过显式预算变量I_Q联合优化信息质量投资与算法使用强度x。核心是一个非线性双变量优化模型，其中数据质量Q(I_Q)同时调节价值生产函数和成本结构（通过可变成本系数γ(Q)和凸性指数δ(Q)——即人类监督的代理成本"保姆税"）。论文证明了剪刀效应的存在、边际利润毁灭区的特征、治理投资可行走廊的存在，以及数据架构碎片化企业的利润函数非单调性（大推动效应）。在此基础上构建五层架构的DSS工具，并通过三条可执行的预算决策规则（边际平价、前提条件阈值、动态运营上限）在两部门间分散化集中最优解。模拟评估显示，采用传统静态模型的碎片化数据企业过度使用技术27.8%，账面利润+32.0而实际亏损36.7，而DSS方案使其达到+8.4。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何联合优化生成式AI的使用强度与信息质量治理投资，以克服传统仅关注技术规模扩展的决策框架的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有企业对GenAI采用的决策管理通常仅被视为技术规模问题（决定使用量），而将底层知识库质量视为环境给定特征。这种范式在结构上不完整，会产生系统性偏误的推荐。此外，先前文献忽略了成本渠道（人类监督的代理成本）对最优解的额外压缩效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性双变量优化模型（数据质量Q(I_Q)同时调节价值生产函数与成本结构）；剪刀效应理论（数据退化同时使边际价值下移和边际成本上移）；边际利润毁灭区理论；治理投资可行走廊理论；大推动理论（碎片化数据下利润函数非单调）；代理成本理论（巴巴塞特税/Babysitting Tax）
AI.method: 分析性数学证明（最优解存在性、剪刀效应、可行走廊、非单调性）+ 设计科学研究方法（五层架构DSS：遥测、估计、优化、政策、界面）+ 模拟评估（两个校准组织画像）+ 分布式协调协议设计（仅交换两个标量实现分散化最优）
AI.findings: (1) 证明剪刀效应存在：数据退化同时使边际价值下移、边际成本上移；(2) 刻画Marginal Profit Destruction Zone；(3) 证明治理投资存在可行走廊（上下有界）；(4) 碎片化数据架构下Π*(I_Q)非单调，治理投资具有"大推动"特征而非边际调整；(5) 三条预算决策规则（边际平价、前提条件阈值、动态运营上限）可仅通过两个标量在财务与数据部门间分散化集中最优解，协议收敛条件恰好等于问题二阶条件；(6) 双变量问题可降为对数成本的标量搜索；(7) 模拟显示传统静态模型使企业过度使用技术27.8%，账面盈利+32.0而实际亏损-36.7，DSS方案使利润达+8.4；(8) 成本渠道（先前文献忽略）对最优解的额外压缩达91.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将数据治理从外生环境变量内生化到优化模型中的正式预算变量，弥补了现有文献的结构性缺陷；(2) 揭示并正式证明了剪刀效应及成本渠道（保姆税）在最优解压缩中的独立且显著作用（额外91.7%收缩）；(3) 提出边际利润毁灭区和治理投资可行走廊的新概念并给出分析刻画；(4) 证明碎片化数据下投资决策具有大推动特征（非单调利润函数），颠覆了边际调整假设；(5) 证明分布式协调协议收敛条件等于优化问题二阶条件，建立了组织设计与数学模型之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供一个实时可计算（对数成本标量搜索）的五层DSS架构，可直接落地于企业决策流程；(2) 三条可执行的预算决策规则（边际平价、前提条件阈值、动态运营上限）使财务与数据部门仅通过交换两个标量即可实现全局最优，降低组织协调成本；(3) 量化传统静态模型的偏误（过度使用27.8%、虚假盈利+32.0vs实际亏损-36.7），为企业提供可比较的改进基准；(4) 为企业识别"大推动"型治理投资情境提供诊断工具，避免碎片化数据企业在初期治理投入时因短期利润下滑而放弃。

title:
Decentralized Rail Platform Capacity Allocation under Congestion: 
A Dynamic Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) Auction with Token Taxation

detail.title:
Decentralized Rail Platform Capacity Allocation under Congestion: 
A Dynamic Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) Auction with Token Taxation

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or identifiable personal data. The research is based entirely on simulation, mathematical modeling, and synthetic railway operational data; therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required.

detail.abstract: Real-time disruption recovery in high-density railway networks requires resolving complex capacity allocation problems under tight timing constraints. Traditional dispatching models rely on centralized optimization, which struggles with scale during large disruptions and lacks the flexibility to manage multi-operator corridors where proprietary constraints cannot be shared. This paper presents a decentralized, game-theoretic multi-agent framework to allocate station platforms dynamically under network congestion. We model trains and station infrastructure as autonomous agents that negotiate platform track rights using a second-price Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction. Train agents compute bids using their passenger occupancy, service classes, and real-time delays to minimize network-wide passenger delay costs. To resolve the starvation problem common in budget-constrained VCG auctions where local services are persistently outbid by express trains we introduce a dynamic token taxation mechanism. Delayed trains accumulate token credits proportionally to their queue wait times, ensuring they eventually acquire platform access. We evaluate the mechanism on a simulated multi-corridor network representing the Mumbai-Ahmedabad and Mumbai-Pune high-speed corridors. The results indicate that while the VCG auction with dynamic token taxation maintains a controlled efficiencyfairness trade-off to accommodate local service priorities under physics-based catenary voltage drops, it successfully prevents local service starvation, stabilizes bidding budgets, and resolves interlocking conflicts efficiently without a centralized controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种去中心化的博弈论多智能体框架，通过第二价格VCG拍卖动态分配高密度铁路网络中的站台轨道权，并引入动态代币税收机制解决预算约束VCG拍卖中本地服务的"饥饿"问题。在模拟的孟买-艾哈迈达巴德和孟买-浦那多走廊网络上验证，该机制在无集中控制器的情况下有效防止本地服务饥饿、稳定投标预算并高效解决联锁冲突。
AI.research_question: 如何在无集中控制器的条件下，实时、公平且高效地解决高密度铁路网络中大规模中断时的站台容量分配问题？
AI.motivation: 传统集中式调度模型在大规模中断时面临可扩展性瓶颈，且在多运营商走廊中无法共享专有约束信息，缺乏灵活性。需要一种去中心化方案来动态分配站台资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、多智能体系统、VCG拍卖机制（第二价格拍卖）、动态代币税收机制
AI.method: 构建列车和站台基础设施为自治智能体，通过第二价格VCG拍卖协商站台轨道权；列车智能体基于乘客占用率、服务等级和实时延误计算投标，以最小化网络乘客延误成本；引入动态代币税收机制解决预算约束VCG拍卖中的饥饿问题；在模拟多走廊网络上进行仿真评估。
AI.findings: VCG拍卖结合动态代币税收机制在保持受控的效率-公平权衡的同时，成功防止本地服务饥饿、稳定投标预算，并在无集中控制器的情况下高效解决联锁冲突和物理限制（如接触网电压降）下的资源分配问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将VCG拍卖机制与动态代币税收机制创新性结合，解决了预算约束VCG拍卖中本地服务被快车持续挤出（饥饿）的理论缺陷；扩展了博弈论在铁路调度领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多运营商高密度铁路网络提供了一种无需共享专有约束信息的去中心化实时中断恢复方案，对实际铁路调度系统具有直接应用价值。

title: Synthetic Customer 360 Benchmark for Customer Data Quality, Identity Resolution, and Survivorship in Omnichannel Retail

detail.title: Synthetic Customer 360 Benchmark for Customer Data Quality, Identity Resolution, and Survivorship in Omnichannel Retail

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used only synthetic data and did not involve human participants, personal data, animals, or biological materials.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study.

detail.abstract: In omnichannel retail, customer data quality and unification architecture encompasses the systems and controls that turn fragmented customer observations into trusted, unified profiles, yet rigorous evaluation is constrained by limited access to shareable records with known identity, defect, datalineage, and survivorship ground truth. This paper presents a synthetic Customer 360 benchmark and generation method for controlled evaluation of identity resolution, data-quality transformations, and golden-record survivorship rules. The benchmark models persons, households, accounts, contact points, addresses, source observations, and transaction or order context across four profiles: ecommerce, loyalty or mobile, physical-store transaction, and service or fulfillment. It generates structural duplicates and eight auditable defect, ambiguity, and conflict mechanisms while preserving separate ground truth for duplicate clusters, transformation lineage, and expected outputs under verification-first, source-authority-first, recency-first, and mixed-conditional regimes. The study evaluates the benchmark through 335 predeclared runs organized into identity-difficulty, survivorship-conflict, single-factor-sensitivity, and scale experiments. Three transparent identity baselines are reported with pairwise and B-cubed measures; survivorship is assessed through applicability, evaluability, union and pairwise disagreement, conditional disagreement rate, and population-level burden. All 335 confirmatory runs passed validation. In 40 paired seeds, the easy identity condition exceeded the hard condition for weighted-similarity pairwise F1 at the primary 0.85 threshold, with a median paired difference of 0.5846 and a Holm-adjusted one-sided p value of 1.82 × 10 ¹². The direction held at predeclared thresholds of 0.80, 0.85, and 0.90. High-conflict ⁻ survivorship conditions exceeded low-conflict conditions in all 40 paired seeds, with a median conditional-disagreement increase of 0.0577 and the same adjusted p value. These findings demonstrate reproducible condition separation and auditable ground truth under the disclosed synthetic design. They do not establish real-retailer prevalence, operational effectiveness, production scalability, or universal superiority of any resolution or survivorship rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个合成的Customer 360基准数据集及其生成方法，用于在统一客户档案场景下对身份解析、数据质量转换和黄金记录生存规则进行受控评估。该基准模拟了多渠道零售中的客户数据场景，包含结构重复和八种可审计的缺陷机制，并保留了重复簇、转换谱系和多种生存制度下的预期输出的独立标注真值。研究通过335次预先声明的运行验证了基准的可重复性和条件区分能力，但明确不声称其结果适用于真实零售商的普及率或生产环境。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个具有可审计的独立标注真值（身份、缺陷、数据谱系、生存规则）的合成Customer 360基准，以支持对多渠道零售中客户数据统一架构（身份解析、数据质量转换、黄金记录生存规则）进行受控评估？
AI.motivation: 全渠道零售中客户数据质量与统一架构至关重要，但严格的评估受限于缺乏可共享的、具有已知身份、缺陷、数据谱系和生存真值的记录。真实零售商数据难以获得且无法共享，导致无法进行可复现的基准对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份解析理论、数据质量转换理论、黄金记录生存规则理论（包括验证优先、源权威优先、最新优先和混合条件制度）
AI.method: 构建合成Customer 360基准：模拟个人、家庭、账户、联系点、地址、源观测及交易/订单上下文，覆盖电子商务、忠诚度/移动、实体店交易、服务/履约四类画像；生成结构重复和八种可审计的缺陷/歧义/冲突机制；通过335次预先声明的运行（身份难度、生存冲突、单因素敏感性、规模实验）进行评估，使用成对和B-cubed指标衡量身份基线，通过适用性、可评估性、联合/成对不一致性、条件不一致率和总体负担评估生存规则。
AI.findings: 所有335次确认性运行通过验证。在40对配对种子中，易身份条件在加权相似度成对F1（0.85主阈值）上超过难条件，中位配对差异为0.5846，Holm校正单侧p值为1.82×10⁻¹²；该方向在0.80、0.85和0.90阈值下均成立。高冲突生存条件在全部40对配对种子中超过低冲突条件，条件分歧中位数增加0.0577，具有相同校正p值。证明了所披露的合成设计下可复现的条件分离和可审计的真值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可复现的合成基准方法论，为身份解析、数据质量转换和生存规则评估提供了具有独立标注真值的受控测试环境，支持在统一客户档案领域进行严格的假设检验和条件分离验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了一个公开可用的、可审计的Customer 360基准数据集和生成方法，可用于测试身份解析算法、数据质量转换流程和黄金记录生存规则，而无需依赖难以获取的真实零售数据。明确限定了其结论边界，不声称代表真实零售商的普及率和生产可扩展性。

title: The Impact of Digitalisation on Inequalities: A Comparative Study across Nations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Digitalisation on Inequalities: A Comparative Study across Nations
detail.abstract:
This study analyses how digitalisation affects income inequality, through a cross- country econometric analysis covering 27 countries over the period 2000–2022. The analysis considers the impact of three key dimensions of digitalisation—Internet access, fixed broadband subscriptions and mobile phone services—on inequality, measured through the Gini index and the income shares held by different percentiles of the population.

From a methodological viewpoint, the study uses Generalized Least Squares (GLS) regression models, corrected for heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation in panel data, combined with random effects models to account for unobservable heterogeneity between countries. Control variables such as Gross Domestic Product (GDP) per capita growth, demographic structure (young and working age population), urbanization rate and other economic-structural factors are included. The analysis was accompanied by extensive diagnostic tests (including VIF for multicollinearity and Wooldridge test), and robustness checks to strengthen the reliability of the estimates. Although the model reduces some risks of bias, it is acknowledged that it does not completely eliminate endogeneity problems, such as reverse causality between inequality and digitalization.

The paper tests three main hypotheses, based on the economic and sociological literature:

  • H1: Greater digital access reduces income inequality by expanding access to employment opportunities, financial services, education and healthcare, especially for low-income groups (Stern, M. J., 2009; George, G. & Schillebeeckx, J. D., 2022);

  • H2: The redistributive effect of digitalization is mediated by country-specific structural and institutional factors, such as educational systems, redistributive policies and digital literacy levels (Doric, Z., 2022);

  • H3: In countries where digital access is more widespread and inclusive (e.g. broadband infrastructure and mobile subscriptions), inequality is lower, especially in the lower deciles, indicating that digitalization can foster more equitable economic growth (Afzal, A. et al., 2023).

    The findings have important policy implications. To make digitalization an inclusive lever, public policies must go beyond the mere expansion of access, combining infrastructure investments with targeted initiatives on digital literacy, affordability, and technological endowment. Particular attention must be paid to the most vulnerable groups—such as low-income families or rural communities—who risk being excluded from the digital transition. Digital inclusion must be integrated into broader social and economic strategies to have a concrete redistributive impact.

    The study offers three main contributions. First, it proposes a comparative and longitudinal econometric model that integrates digital indicators in the analysis of inequalities. Second, it delves into the still little-explored mechanisms that link digitalization and inequality, highlighting the interaction with demographic and institutional variables. Third, it provides empirical evidence useful to support the design of more inclusive digital policies, calibrated to national contexts.

In conclusion, this study contributes to the global debate on the role of digitalization as a tool for inclusion or for reinforcing social inequalities. By offering a solid and empirically grounded comparative analysis, it supports the need for proactive digital policies that prioritize not only access, but also skills and the effective inclusion of the most vulnerable segments of the population.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过覆盖27个国家2000-2022年的跨国面板数据，采用广义最小二乘法（GLS）回归模型，分析数字化（互联网接入、固定宽带订阅、移动电话服务）对收入不平等（基尼系数及各百分位收入份额）的影响。研究发现数字化对不平等的影响受到国家制度与结构性因素的调节，并提出数字包容需要超越单纯的基础设施扩张，结合数字素养、可负担性和技术赋能的综合政策。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何影响收入不平等？具体考察互联网接入、固定宽带订阅和移动电话服务三个关键维度对基尼系数及不同收入分位份额的影响。
AI.motivation: 数字化究竟是促进包容性增长还是加剧社会不平等的工具，这一问题在全球范围内仍缺乏足够的跨国、纵向实证证据。现有研究对数字化与不平等之间的作用机制探讨不足，尤其是数字化效应如何被国家制度与结构性因素所调节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济学和社会学文献提出三个假设：(1)数字接入扩大就业、金融服务、教育和医疗机会从而降低不平等；(2)数字化的再分配效应受国家教育和制度因素（如教育体系、再分配政策、数字素养）调节；(3)数字接入更广泛普及的国家，不平等更低，尤其是在较低分位。
AI.method: 采用广义最小二乘法（GLS）回归模型，针对面板数据进行异方差和自相关校正，并结合随机效应模型控制国家间不可观测异质性。控制变量包括人均GDP增长、人口结构（青年及劳动年龄人口）、城市化率等经济结构性因素。伴随VIF多重共线性检验和Wooldridge检验等诊断测试及稳健性检验。作者承认模型无法完全消除内生性问题（如不平等与数字化的反向因果）。
AI.findings: 研究验证了三个假设：数字接入扩大有助于降低收入不平等；数字化的再分配效应受国家教育和制度因素调节；在数字接入更普及的国家，不平等水平更低，特别是较低分位群体受益明显。数字化（宽带基础设施和移动订阅普及）与较低不平等之间存在正向关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 第一，提出了一个整合数字化指标的跨国纵向比较计量模型来分析不平等；第二，深入探讨了数字化与不平等之间尚未充分研究的机制，揭示了其与人口和制度变量的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更具包容性的数字政策提供了实证依据。政策含义包括：公共政策必须超越单纯扩大接入，需结合基础设施投资与数字素养、可负担性和技术赋能的针对性措施；特别关注低收入家庭和农村社区等脆弱群体；数字包容应整合到更广泛的社会经济战略中。

title: The Cross-Layer Theory of Complexity: A General Framework for Understanding Emergence, Constraint, and Agency in Multi-Layered Complex Systems

detail.title: The Cross-Layer Theory of Complexity: A General Framework for Understanding Emergence, Constraint, and Agency in Multi-Layered Complex Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No funding to declare

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a general theory of complexity grounded in a four-layer ontological architecture. The theory advances a central claim: genuine complexity emerges if and only if a system spans multiple ontological layers, where each layer is characterised by a distinct governance mode, agency degree, and thermodynamic regime. We identify four abstract layers-Elemental, Substantive, Cooperative, and Organized-that manifest at multiple scales from individual organisms to civilisational systems. Nineteen principles govern inter-layer relations, organised into six categories: layer structure, vertical relations, interfaces, temporality, energy dynamics, and agency. The framework generates a complexity typology distinguishing dissipative, adaptive, intentional, reflexive, and supra-intentional complexity based on layer span. We demonstrate the framework's analytical power through contrasting case studies (hurricane versus stock market) and address the question of whether artificial intelligence may constitute a fifth emergent layer. The theory provides predictive capacity absent from existing frameworks, including Donella Meadows' leverage points and David Snowden's Cynefin, by grounding the simple-complicated-complex distinction in ontological layer structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于四层本体论架构的复杂性一般理论，主张真正的复杂性只有在系统跨越多个本体论层级时才会涌现。该框架识别出元素、实体、合作和组织四个抽象层级，并通过十九条原则和六类范畴来管理层间关系，最终生成一个包含五种复杂性类型的分类学，并通过对比案例（飓风与股市）及人工智能是否构成第五层级的讨论来展示其分析能力。
AI.research_question: 复杂性（complexity）本质上是什么？如何建立一个超越现有框架（如Meadows杠杆点和Cynefin框架）的、具有预测能力的复杂性一般理论？
AI.motivation: 现有复杂性理论缺乏统一的底层解释基础，如Meadows杠杆点和Cynefin框架虽然区分了简单-复杂-复杂化，但未能将这些区分建立在明确的本体论结构之上，缺乏预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四层本体论架构理论：包含元素层（Elemental）、实体层（Substantive）、合作层（Cooperative）和组织层（Organized），每层具有不同的治理模式、能动性程度和热力学机制；十九条原则分为六个范畴：层级结构、垂直关系、界面、时间性、能量动力学和能动性。
AI.method: 理论建构与对比案例分析法：通过飓风（自然系统）与股票市场（社会经济系统）的对比案例，以及人工智能是否构成第五层级的考察，来展示框架的分析与预测能力。
AI.findings: 该框架生成了基于层级跨越度的复杂性类型学，区分了耗散性、适应性、意向性、反思性和超意向性五种复杂性类型；通过与现有框架对比，展示了其将简单-复杂-复杂化区分建立在本体论层级结构上的预测优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种统一的本体论复杂性理论，将复杂性定义与系统跨越的本体论层级数量直接挂钩，为复杂性研究提供了新的理论基础；同时整合了治理模式、能动性和热力学机制等多维度视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂系统的识别、分类和预测提供了操作性框架，能够帮助研究者和管理者判断系统处于何种复杂性层级，并预测跨层级交互行为；对人工智能系统是否构成新型复杂性层级提供了分析视角。

title: Correlated Intelligence: AI Adoption and Systemic Risk
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: Correlated Intelligence: AI Adoption and Systemic Risk
detail.abstract: Banks delegate decisions to AI models from a common vendor frontier that bundles accuracy with error correlation: the most accurate models share lineage and fail together. The cross-bank cost of that correlation remains unpriced even when lineage is observable, because a credit spread reprices the borrower, not the banks its choice endangers. Model diversity is inefficiently low; under pooled pricing, welfare losses grow quadratically with excess adoption. Frontier improvements can reduce welfare by tipping the market into monoculture. Disclosure makes a correlation surcharge feasible but does not substitute for it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行间共享AI模型供应商导致误差相关性未被定价的问题。尽管模型"血统"（lineage）可观测，跨银行的错误相关性成本仍未在信用利差中体现，导致模型多样性过低、福利损失随过度采用呈二次方增长。前沿模型改进可能使市场陷入单一文化（monoculture）而降低福利。披露虽使相关性附加费可行，但不能替代该费用。
AI.research_question: 银行采用共享AI模型供应商时，模型间误差相关性带来的跨银行系统性风险成本为何未被定价？披露机制能否替代相关性附加费来提升福利？
AI.motivation: 银行越来越依赖头部AI模型供应商，最准确的模型因共享"血统"（lineage）而具有高度相关的误差。即使血统可观测，信用利差只对借款人重新定价，而不对受其选择危害的其他银行定价，导致错误相关性成本外部化、模型多样性低效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模型多样性、误差相关性外部性、系统性风险定价、福利经济学
AI.method: 理论建模分析：构建银行间采用AI模型的均衡模型，分析模型多样性、相关性外部性与福利损失的关系，并比较披露与相关性附加费的政策效果。
AI.findings: 1) 模型多样性低效低；2) 在统一（pooled）定价下，福利损失随过度采用呈二次方增长；3) 前沿模型（frontier）的改进可能通过使市场陷入单一文化（monoculture）反而降低福利；4) 披露使相关性附加费可行，但不能作为其替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模型误差相关性纳入银行系统性风险分析框架，揭示AI模型"血统"共享带来的定价失灵机制；提出相关性附加费概念，并阐明披露制度的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供模型多样性激励设计的理论依据，说明单纯披露不足以纠正误差相关性外部性，需引入相关性附加费或等效机制来抑制银行过度采用同源AI模型。

title: A Domain-Specific Causal Chain RAG System for Semiconductor Equity Analysis

detail.title: A Domain-Specific Causal Chain RAG System for Semiconductor Equity Analysis
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) applied to equity analysis frequently suffer from shallow reasoning: they surface correlated market signals without modeling the causal mechanisms that connect macroeconomic conditions to firm-level outcomes. This paper presents SemiBot, an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that scores semiconductor equities across an 18-factor causal chain spanning macroeconomic, fundamental, market-intelligence, and external-signal categories. SemiBot combines a LangGraph multi-agent orchestration layer, a FAISS-backed causal-chain retriever, real-time data acquisition via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Tavily search, and SQLite-based long-term memory to produce ticker-level directional predictions with per-factor attribution. We describe the system's architecture and three engineering failure modes discovered during development, together with their resolutions. We evaluate SemiBot through three complementary backtests. Backtest 1, using 140 valid predictions accumulated from development-period usage, shows 61.4% directional accuracy under an MA50 price-proxy and 69.3% under an MA200 proxy (a disclosed sensitivity check, not a precise point estimate). Backtest 2, a deliberately designed experiment on SemiBot's finalized 48-ticker production universe at 10 stratified historical dates with a genuine fixed 20-trading-day forward-return outcome (426 valid observations), shows 61.3% overall directional accuracy. Critically, accuracy is strongly and monotonically related to market capitalization: mega-cap tickers (>$200B) achieve 77.2% accuracy versus 41.7% for mid-cap tickers ($2B-$10B), with a clean six-tier breakdown ranging from 84.0% (>$1 trillion) down to 41.7% (<$10B). This relationship is statistically confirmed via logistic regression (β=0.327, p<0.001) and a chi-square test comparing the mega- and mid-cap tiers directly (χ²=26.32, p<0.001), with 95% confidence intervals reported for every tier, and is shown to be robust to controlling for sub-sector composition (β=0.291, p<0.001) and to persist, albeit at reduced magnitude, even on the sample's weakest-performing dates. Backtest 3 tests SemiBot against two naive baselines — an Always-UP strategy and a SOXX prior-trend-following strategy — stratified across the same six market-capitalization tiers as Backtest 2, using the identical 426-observation production dataset. Against Always-UP, SemiBot underperforms in every tier (overall 61.3% vs. 76.8%, a 15.5-point gap, narrowing from 29.1 points at the smallest tier to 2.0 points at the largest). Against the more sophisticated SOXX-trend baseline, the picture is more nuanced: SemiBot underperforms overall (61.3% vs. 66.9%) but outperforms in its two largest tiers — by 8.0 points at >$1 Trillion and 5.7 points at $500B–$1T — while underperforming at every tier below $500B. This is, to our knowledge, the first market-capitalization-stratified naive-baseline comparison reported for a causal-chain equity-analysis system, and it demonstrates that whether causal-chain reasoning adds value over naive momentum depends jointly on company size and on which naive strategy is used as the comparison point — a nuance a single aggregate accuracy figure, or a single unstratified baseline comparison, would entirely conceal. We situate these results against directly comparable literature benchmarks (Ploutos-7B: 61.2%/59.9%; Vidal 2024's 250-stock LLM study: 59.4% average; TRACE: 55.1%; a "Crystal Ball" human-trader experiment: 51.5%), finding SemiBot's mega-cap and >$1 Trillion subsets exceed every comparable published figure. We argue that explicit causal-chain scaffolding produces interpretable, well-attributed equity signals with genuine, quantifiable value at the largest end of the market-capitalization spectrum, and that market-capitalization-stratified naive-baseline comparison — not literature benchmarking alone — should be standard practice for evaluating this class of system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SemiBot，一个基于智能体检索增强生成（RAG）的半导体现股评分系统，通过18因子因果链建模宏观条件与企业结果的因果机制。系统在140个开发期预测和426个生产期观测中分别达到61.4%/69.3%和61.3%的方向准确率，但准确率与市值强相关（超大型股77.2% vs 中盘股41.7%）。与朴素基线比较发现，因果推理仅在市值最大的两个层级中有优势，作者主张市值分层朴素基线比较应成为此类系统的标准评估方法。
AI.research_question: 基于因果链推理的LLM股票分析系统能否超越浅层相关信号预测和朴素动量基线？其预测准确性在不同市值层级上是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM股票分析方法普遍存在浅层推理问题：仅识别市场相关信号而未建模宏观经济条件与企业级结果之间的因果机制。此外，现有文献缺乏基于市值分层的朴素基线比较来严格评估这类系统的增量价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果链推理框架（18因子因果链，涵盖宏观经济、基本面、市场情报和外部信号四大类别），智能体RAG架构（LangGraph多智能体编排、FAISS因果链检索器、MCP协议实时数据获取、SQLite长期记忆）。
AI.method: 构建SemiBot系统采用LangGraph多智能体编排、FAISS因果链检索、MCP/Tavily实时数据获取和SQLite长期记忆。通过三个互补回测评估：回测1使用140个开发期预测；回测2在固定48股票池和10个历史日期上进行426个观测的实验设计；回测3与Always-UP和SOXX趋势跟随两种朴素基线进行六层级市值分层比较。采用逻辑回归（β=0.327, p<0.001）和卡方检验（χ²=26.32, p<0.001）验证市值效应。
AI.findings: SemiBot整体方向准确率61.3%，但准确率与市值单调正相关：超大型股77.2%、大型股（>1万亿）84.0%、中盘股41.7%，逻辑回归和卡方检验均显著。与Always-UP基线相比全面落后（61.3% vs 76.8%）；与SOXX趋势基线相比仅在两个最大市值层级超越（高出8.0和5.7个百分点），小于500B层级均落后。SemiBot的超大型股和>1万亿子集超过所有已发表可比基准（Ploutos-7B 61.2%、Vidal 2024 59.4%、TRACE 55.1%、人类交易员51.5%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次报告了因果链股票分析系统的市值分层朴素基线比较结果，证明因果链推理的增量价值取决于公司规模和基线策略选择，单一聚合准确率会掩盖这一关键异质性。论证了显式因果链脚手架能产生可解释、有充分归因的股票信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM股票分析系统提供了三类工程失败模式及其解决方案；证明了市值分层朴素基线比较应成为评估此类系统的标准做法；展示了因果链RAG系统在大市值股票上的实际预测价值，为从业者提供了具体的评估框架和实践指导。

title: Best Practices for University-Startup Partnerships: A Teaching Tip
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: Best Practices for University-Startup Partnerships: A Teaching Tip
detail.abstract: Universities can benefit from partnerships with startup companies by gaining access to new industry technology and expertise. These partnerships also ensure that academic programs remain relevant to industry and provide professional preparation for students. Universities may also enhance their research capabilities and funding opportunities through industry partnerships. Likewise, startup companies benefit from these collaborations through exposure to diverse perspectives on product-market fit and product development. Startups also gain increased access to a talented academic workforce. Based on the experiences of a project between a US university and a financial technology startup company, we suggest several practical tips and suggestions that both faculty and startup professionals can adopt for future collaborations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一所美国大学与一家金融科技初创公司的合作项目经验，提出了供教师和初创企业专业人士在未来的产学研合作中采用的多项实用建议和提示。
AI.research_question: 大学与初创公司如何建立有效的合作伙伴关系，以及双方可以从此类合作中获得哪些益处？
AI.motivation: 大学和初创公司之间存在互补价值，但缺乏系统性的合作指导建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学-产业合作理论（University-Industry Collaboration）
AI.method: 案例研究——基于一个美国大学与金融科技初创公司的合作项目经验
AI.findings: 大学可从合作中获得行业新技术、专业知识、研究资金及提升课程相关性；初创公司可获得多元产品视角和人才渠道；合作双方需采取实用策略以促进协作成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了大学-产业合作在初创企业情境下的理论理解，特别是在金融科技领域的实践经验总结。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学教师和初创公司专业人士提供了可操作的合作建议与最佳实践清单。

title:
Scoring the Pushback, Not the Decision: 
A Deterministic Index of Challenge Intensity in an AI Cognitive Contradictor — the Δ-CSI (Cognitive Sovereignty Index, delta)

detail.title:
Scoring the Pushback, Not the Decision: 
A Deterministic Index of Challenge Intensity in an AI Cognitive Contradictor — the Δ-CSI (Cognitive Sovereignty Index, delta)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author develops CounterBrain, the commercial cognitive-contradictor platform in which the Delta-CSI specified here is implemented. The paper makes no claim of empirical validity or effectiveness for the index, and reports its declared weaknesses in Section 7.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable: this research involved no human subjects and no personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Decision-making under intensive AI assistance faces a documented paradox: more analysis does not reliably produce better judgment, because assistants optimized for user satisfaction tend to confirm rather than contest, inflating confidence and homogenizing reasoning across the organizations that share them. There is a structurally adversarial alternative: a cognitive contradictor, whose function is to challenge a decision rather than validate it. It raises an immediate measurement question. How does one quantify how hard a decision was contested, in a way that is reproducible in its scoring, comparable over time, and honest about what it does and does not establish? This paper defines that quantity. It introduces the Δ-CSI (Cognitive Sovereignty Index, delta) as a construct — the intensity of the structured challenge applied to a single decision in a single analysis session — and specifies its operational definition. The Δ-CSI is a deterministic index in [0, 100], computed from five weighted components: implicit-assumption count modulated by mean severity, falsification-test count, burden-of-proof-question count, cited-source count, and thesis-versus-counter-scenario divergence. Counts are capped, which precludes gaming by verbosity. Weights are constrained to sum to one hundred, interpretation bands are fixed, and the versioning scheme is explicit. Two limits remain, and are stated openly: the self-reported severity channel is gameable by construction (§7), and the count components register quantity, not argument quality. The paper contributes three things. (i) The construct, delimited by four negations: challenge intensity is not decision quality, not the probability of success, not a verdict on the decision-maker, and not whether the decision was subsequently changed. (ii) The specification, together with its reproducibility guarantee, its fail-closed defenses against sycophantic output, and a register of its declared weaknesses. (iii) The comparability and calibration discipline: cohorts keyed by computation version, divergence method, and weights, with statistics held to descriptive-only below five recorded outcomes. The paper makes no claim of empirical validity or effectiveness. It does not assert that a high Δ-CSI corresponds to better decisions — nor, conversely, to weaker ones — and it does not assert that the index predicts outcomes; it demonstrates construct definition and measurement method only. Empirical validation is stated as a deferred programme, structured as a pre-registered evidence-accumulation roadmap. Its two stages are per-tenant ledger calibration and the public sealed M&A pilot of the companion Calibrated Dissent, in which the Δ-CSI enters strictly as non-scoring provenance and an exploratory covariate. We treat this honesty as a design requirement, not a caveat: an index of challenge intensity that overstated its own validation would be inconsistent with the very stance it exists to measure.

AI.tldr: 本文定义并规范了一个新的量化构念——Δ-CSI（认知主权指数），用于测量在单一分析会话中对单一决策所施加的结构化挑战强度。该指数是确定性的［0,100］分数，由五个加权组件构成，并明确声明其有效性边界：它不代表决策质量、成功概率、对决策者的评判或决策是否被改变，也不声称预测结果。
AI.research_question: 如何以一种可复现评分、可跨时间比较、且诚实说明其能力边界的方式，量化一个决策受到挑战（而非确认）的强度？
AI.motivation: 在密集AI辅助决策中存在一个悖论：更多分析并不必然带来更好的判断，因为以用户满意度为导向的AI助手倾向于确认而非质疑，导致过度自信和组织间推理同质化。因此需要一个结构性的对抗性替代方案——认知反对者（cognitive contradictor），其功能是挑战而非验证决策，由此产生量化挑战强度的测量需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知反对者（cognitive contradictor）结构对抗范式，通过四个否定来界定构念边界：挑战强度≠决策质量、≠成功概率、≠对决策者的评判、≠决策是否被改变。采用确定性和可复现的测量理论框架。
AI.method: 定义并规范Δ-CSI构造，采用确定性指数方法：五个加权组件（隐含假设数量×平均严重度、证伪检验数量、举证责任问题数量、引用来源数量、论点与反情境分歧度），计数设上限防游戏化操纵，权重约束和为100，固定解释区间，明确版本管理方案。
AI.findings: 本文仅提供构念定义和测量方法，不做实证有效性声明。结果表明：Δ-CSI具有可复现性保证、针对谄媚输出的fail-closed防御机制、明确的弱点登记册、以及按计算版本/分歧方法/权重密钥排队的比较与校准纪律。实证验证被推迟为预注册的证据累积路线图。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Δ-CSI（认知主权指数）这一新构念，用四个否定精确划定了"挑战强度"的概念边界；建立了挑战强度的可操作化测量规范，包括可复现性保证和抗操纵机制；将"诚实性"作为设计需求而非附带说明，为AI辅助决策评估领域提供了方法论的自我约束范例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一种可比较、可复现的量表来评估AI辅助决策中挑战性输入的强度；通过防游戏化设计（计数上限）和fail-closed防御机制保障测量诚信；提供了预注册的实证验证路线图（含租户校准和密封M&A试点），为后续实践应用奠定基础。

title: Observation-Centered Runtime Safety for Foundation-Model Agents: A Model-Agnostic Geometry–Risk–Control Architecture

detail.title: Observation-Centered Runtime Safety for Foundation-Model Agents: A Model-Agnostic Geometry–Risk–Control Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The work was conducted by the authors as part of research activities at Gemmina Intelligence LLC. The authors declare that no external commercial entity influenced the design, implementation, interpretation, or reporting of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work did not involve human participants, animals, or clinical data, and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Alignment research for large language models has focused primarily on model-centric interventions-fine-tuning, preference optimization, and decoding-time filters. These methods improve average behavior, yet they do not continuously observe or constrain the runtime trajectory of an agent as it acts in a tool-using environment. We present an observationcentered runtime safety architecture that treats semantic state as a measurable trajectory and separates safety into five strictly layered concerns: Observation, Geometry, Risk, Control, and (future) Execution. The architecture is realized as the SensOS Runtime Safety Layer through a staged experimental program. Heterogeneous agent events are normalized into an Observation Object and projected to a trajectory; a model-agnostic geometry engine estimates curvature, boundary distance, density, stability, and basin membership; a risk engine converts those descriptors into a continuous risk valuation with hysteresis and early warning; and a control engine maps risk to a graduated L0-L7 decision under an approval interlock. Execution against a live agent is intentionally excluded: control outputs are decisions only, pending a separate safety review. On a real Claude Code session (n = 489 events), end-to-end observation pipeline latency was 0.094 ms mean per event (alert-only; zero alerts at threshold 0.5). Geometry, risk, and control packages exhibit production-grade software engineering quality-full statement and branch test coverage (95/151/107 tests)-with measured sub-millisecond risk and control latencies (0.0067/0.0039 ms mean). These figures characterize software quality and microbenchmarks, not validated operational safety. We do not claim live intervention efficacy; we claim a coherent, measured, and architecturally honest decision spine for runtime safety without modifying foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以观察为中心的运行时安全架构（SensOS Runtime Safety Layer），将语义状态视为可测量的轨迹，将安全分为观察、几何、风险、控制和（未来）执行五个分层关注点。通过在Claude Code会话中验证，端到端观测管线延迟为0.094毫秒/事件，几何、风险和控制的测试覆盖率达95/151/107个测试，风险和控制延迟均在亚毫秒级。
AI.research_question: 如何在不修改基础模型的前提下，对大语言模型智能体在工具使用环境中的运行时轨迹进行持续观察和约束，以构建架构诚实的运行时安全保障体系？
AI.motivation: 现有对齐研究主要聚焦于模型中心干预（微调、偏好优化、解码时间过滤），这些方法能改善平均行为，但无法持续观察或约束智能体在工具使用环境中行动的运行时轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以观察为中心的运行时安全架构，将语义状态视为可测量轨迹，将安全分为五个严格分层关注点：观察（Observation）、几何（Geometry）、风险（Risk）、控制（Control）和（未来）执行（Execution）。
AI.method: 通过分阶段实验程序实现SensOS运行时安全层：将异构智能体事件归一化为观察对象并投影到轨迹；模型无关的几何引擎估计曲率、边界距离、密度、稳定性和盆地隶属；风险引擎将描述符转换为带有滞后和早期预警的连续风险估值；控制引擎在审批联锁下将风险映射为分级L0-L7决策。
AI.findings: 在真实Claude Code会话（n=489个事件）中，端到端观察管线延迟为0.094毫秒/事件均值（仅预警模式，阈值0.5时零警报）。几何、风险和控制的软件质量为生产级（完全语句和分支测试覆盖，95/151/107个测试），风险和控制延迟实测为0.0067/0.0039毫秒均值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个架构诚实的五层运行时安全决策脊柱，将安全从模型中心转向观察中心范式，为运行时安全提供了可测量的架构基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了生产级软件质量的运行时安全实现，实测亚毫秒级延迟表明架构具有实际部署可行性；控制输出为决策而非直接执行，为后续安全审查保留空间。

title: The Checking Problem: What Must Be True Before AI Ships in a Regulated Firm

detail.title: The Checking Problem: What Must Be True Before AI Ships in a Regulated Firm
detail.abstract: Enterprise AI programmes stall at a rate that is widely quoted and poorly explained. This paper measures the mechanism. Six document-heavy workflows of the kind performed daily in regulated financial services were run across four model families and three tool configurations, three times each, producing 5,093 scored output elements across 72 configurations. Each configuration was assessed twice: against a demonstration bar, being a single correct run on a single case, and against a production bar requiring sustained accuracy, reproducibility across repeats, verifiable attribution, and a confidence signal that carries information. 57 of 72 configurations cleared the demonstration bar and 32 cleared the production bar, a survival rate of 56.1%. The paper then computes the review burden each configuration imposes, estimated out of sample rather than with hindsight. A tool that states no confidence requires review of 100% of its output, because it offers a reviewer no basis for triage. Requiring the tool to cite its sources and state a confidence reduces that to 49% while holding the residual error tolerance in 17 of 20 configurations. Adding a self-verification pass costs 2.3 times the latency of the plain configuration, reaches 44%, and is the only configuration that fails to hold the error tolerance. The practical implication is that the value of an AI workflow is set less by how often it is right than by how much of it a human must still check, and that the second property is measurable and rarely measured.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验测量企业AI项目失败的机制，发现AI工作流的价值不在于其正确率，而在于人类需要复核的工作量比例。在72种配置中，仅32种（56.1%的生存率）达到生产标准。工具若不提供置信度信号，人类需审查100%的输出；要求工具引用来源并声明置信度，可将审查负担降至49%；增加自验证环节虽进一步降至44%，但成本是普通配置的2.3倍延迟且无法维持错误容忍度。
AI.research_question: 企业AI项目高停滞率背后的机制是什么？如何量化衡量AI工作流的实际价值？
AI.motivation: 企业AI项目的高失败率被广泛引用但缺乏解释。现有评估多关注模型"正确率"，而忽略了人类复核负担这一决定AI部署经济价值的关键变量。本文旨在通过实证测量揭示AI项目失败的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于演示基准（demonstration bar）与生产基准（production bar）的区分框架，将生产标准细化为四个维度：持续准确性、重复可复现性、可验证归因性、以及携带信息的置信度信号。同时引入"审查负担"（review burden）概念作为AI工作流价值衡量的核心维度。
AI.method: 实验设计：对受监管金融服务中日常执行的6个文档密集型工作流，跨4个模型家族和3种工具配置，每种运行3次，共产生72种配置、5,093个评分输出元素。每种配置分别用演示基准和生产基准评估两次，并基于样本外数据计算审查负担。
AI.findings: 1) 72种配置中有57种通过演示基准，仅32种通过生产基准，生存率为56.1%。2) 不提供置信度信号的工具需人类审查100%输出；3) 要求引用来源和声明置信度可将审查降至49%，且在20种配置中的17种保持错误容忍度；4) 添加自验证环节审查负担降至44%，但延迟成本为普通配置的2.3倍，且是唯一无法保持错误容忍度的配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"审查负担"作为衡量AI工作流价值的关键理论视角，挑战了以"正确率"为核心的传统评估范式；建立了演示基准与生产基准的区分框架，揭示了AI系统从演示到生产部署之间的系统性落差机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI部署提供了可操作的评估指标（审查负担率）和工具设计要求（置信度信号、来源引用、自验证权衡）；指明了AI系统的实际价值取决于人类仍需检查的工作量，且该指标可测量且可优化。

title: Non-debt Money Anchored to Realized Value: A New Model of Money Issuance Defining the Measure of Value in the Age of Technological Acceleration
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Non-debt Money Anchored to Realized Value: A New Model of Money Issuance Defining the Measure of Value in the Age of Technological Acceleration
detail.abstract: Modern money is created before value is realized. Central banks issue against promises — the repayment of public debt, the acceptance of taxes — and the issuance mechanism never verifies whether the money corresponds to realized value. In the AI era this produces five problems: the breakdown of the labor–income–consumption distribution channel, deficient demand and deflation, monetary transmission failure, the fiscal deadlock of UBI, and the payment-term malaise of supply-chain finance. This paper reverses the sequence: money is created only after value is realized. When a verified good reaches a verified consumer, the delivery event itself triggers issuance, and smart contracts distribute it through the supply chain in the same instant. We develop an ontology of money — whether money must be repaid depends on whether it records a promise or a fact — showing that every historical promise-anchor (treasury debt, taxation, real bills) is an issuer's liability, while a verified delivery event is the first anchor that is nobody's liability and anchors realized value itself. Money is the measure of value already produced, not of value that might be produced. A value theory follows: production is the necessary condition, demand the finalizer, and AI splits output value from irreducibly human demand value. A minimal formal model proves five propositions: event-level non-overissue, sufficient conditions for inflation elimination, the ontological difference from credit issuance, a reversed Cantillon effect, and the quota's black-market immunity. We detail the mechanism design, a data-based inflation analysis, comparisons with UBI, MMT, CBDC, the real bills doctrine and social credit theory, an implementation path for China, the US and the UK, a policy-feasibility analysis, and answers to the seven strongest objections. Claims are restricted to falsifiable mechanism properties; far-future institutional forms are marked as directional speculation only.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"价值实现后发行货币"的新机制：当经过验证的商品到达经过验证的消费者时，交割事件本身触发货币发行，智能合约在瞬间沿供应链分配货币。论文构建了货币本体论，论证已验证的交割事件是第一个不构成任何负债、锚定已实现价值的货币锚，并提出了相应的价值理论及五个可证伪命题。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，如何逆转"货币先于价值创造"的传统发行顺序，建立一种仅在价值实现后才发行货币的新机制，以解决劳动力—收入—消费传导渠道断裂、需求不足与通缩、货币政策传导失效、UBI财政僵局以及供应链金融支付条款困境等五大问题？
AI.motivation: 传统货币体系在价值实现之前就发行货币（央行基于承诺发行），这在AI时代产生了五大问题：劳动—收入—消费分配渠道崩溃、需求不足与通缩、货币政策传导失灵、UBI的财政僵局以及供应链金融的支付条款困境。现有理论未能从根本上解决这些问题，因此需要逆转货币发行顺序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币本体论（货币是否需要偿还取决于它记录的是承诺还是事实）、价值理论（生产是必要条件，需求是最终确定因素，AI将产出价值与不可还原的人类需求价值分离）、历史承诺锚定理论（国债、税收、真实票据）与事件锚定理论的对比。
AI.method: 概念分析（货币本体论与价值理论构建）、形式化建模（最小形式模型证明五个命题）、机制设计、数据驱动的通胀分析、多国实施路径设计（中国、美国、英国）及政策可行性分析。
AI.findings: 五个形式化命题：事件层面无超发、通胀消除的充分条件、与信贷发行的本体论区别、逆转的坎蒂隆效应、配额的黑市免疫性。并回应了七个最强的反对意见。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"已验证交割事件"作为第一个非负债货币锚，将货币定义为"已生产价值的尺度"而非"可能生产的价值的尺度"；发展了货币承诺vs事实的本体论区分；为AI时代货币理论提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完整的机制设计、基于数据的通胀分析、与UBI/MMT/CBDC/真实票据学说/社会信用理论的比较、中美英三国的实施路径以及政策可行性分析，回击了七个最强反对意见。

title: Hallucination in Generative AI as Evaluative and Institutional Misalignment: The Hallucination-Institutional Nexus and Institutional Calibration

detail.title: Hallucination in Generative AI as Evaluative and Institutional Misalignment: The Hallucination-Institutional Nexus and Institutional Calibration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Hallucination in generative AI is often understood as a model-level failure involving inaccurate, unsupported, or fabricated outputs. While this view remains important, it is insufficient to explain why such outputs acquire institutional consequences when used in professional advice, evaluation, organizational decision-making, or other contexts in which justification, verification, judgment, and responsibility are required. This paper proposes the Hallucination-Institutional Nexus (HIN) as a conceptual framework for analyzing this transition. It first introduces the YMCK framework, which understands AI-mediated output as emerging through the interaction of Yardstick, Metacognition, Cognition, and Knowledge under specific contextual conditions. On this basis, HIN is defined as the structural interface at which AI-generated outputs become institutionally significant by entering regimes of evaluation, verification, judgment, and responsibility. This paper complements, rather than replaces, technical research on hallucination. The paper argues that, in institutional contexts, hallucination should not be understood solely as a model-level error, but as an evaluative and institutional misalignment between AI-generated output and the institutional structures in which that output is used as grounds for action or judgment. Mitigation therefore requires not only model-level improvement, but also institutional calibration: the adjustment of evaluation criteria, verification procedures, stopping conditions, responsibility boundaries, and recordable processes before AI-generated output is connected to institutional judgment. The paper concludes that hallucination should be understood as a structural signal indicating the need to calibrate the institutional conditions under which generative AI is evaluated and used.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"幻觉-制度联结"（HIN）概念框架，论证生成式AI的幻觉问题不仅是模型层面的技术失败，更是AI输出与制度结构（评价、验证、判断、责任）之间的错位，需要通过制度校准而非仅模型改进来缓解。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的幻觉输出为何会在专业建议、组织决策等制度情境中获得机构性后果？如何从概念上理解这一转变过程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将幻觉视为模型层面的失败，这不足以解释为何幻觉输出在专业咨询、评估、组织决策等需要论证、验证、判断和责任的制度情境中会产生机构性影响。需要一个新的概念框架来分析这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了两个核心概念框架：（1）YMCK框架——将AI中介输出理解为Yardstick（标尺）、Metacognition（元认知）、Cognition（认知）和Knowledge（知识）在特定情境条件下相互作用的结果；（2）Hallucination-Institutional Nexus（HIN）——AI生成输出进入评价、验证、判断和责任制度后获得制度意义的接口。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过提出YMCK框架和HIN框架进行理论建构与分析，属于概念框架的提出与论证。
AI.findings: 在制度情境中，幻觉不应仅被视为模型层面的错误，而应理解为AI生成输出与制度结构之间的评价性和制度性错位；缓解幻觉需要制度校准（调整评价标准、验证程序、停止条件、责任边界和可记录流程），而不仅是模型层面的改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出HIN（幻觉-制度联结）和YMCK两个新概念框架，将幻觉研究从纯技术视角扩展到制度分析视角，补充而非替代现有的技术研究，建立了AI输出与制度判断之间的理论接口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和管理者在将生成式AI输出用于决策前提供制度校准的具体维度（评价标准、验证程序、停止条件、责任边界、记录流程），指导AI在专业领域的安全部署和应用。

title: Organization of Platform Markets: Coordination, Decision Rights and Information
affiliations: University of Utah -- Eccles School of Business and

detail.title: Organization of Platform Markets: Coordination, Decision Rights and Information
detail.abstract: Platform markets differ fundamentally from traditional firms, relying on decentralized supply of services by diverse, independent agents. Agents operate with limited information and compete to maximize their own profits. This structural shift raises critical questions about the optimal organization of platforms to coordinate the efforts of distributed participants. Should decision making in a platform market be centralized or decentralized, i.e., controlled by the platform or by agents? To study this question, we define the coordination structure (CS) of the platform market as the combination of two elements: its decision rights structure ('who decides what') and information endowment ('who knows what'). We focus on the pricing decision, which epitomizes both coordination and information challenges in platform governance. We model a platform with competing agents facing demand uncertainty that can be partly alleviated through information. We model different facets of information endowment, including local and aggregate intelligence, the ability to acquire and share intelligence, and non-transferable specific knowledge of both the platform and agents. We find that centralized coordination of prices, enabled by centralized CS, is a powerful lever for improving platform performance. Indeed, centralized CS dominates decentralized CS, reversing the results of the extant literature on traditional firms. The value of centralized coordination increases rapidly with the degree of agent competition. While decentralized CS can outperform centralized CS when agents hold significant informational advantages over the platform, this advantage diminishes rapidly as agent competition increases. We also demonstrate that centralized CS harnesses information more effectively to reinforce coordination and maximize profits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平台市场中的协调结构（决策权结构+信息禀赋）对定价决策和平台绩效的影响。通过建模发现，集中式协调结构在大多数情况下优于分布式协调结构，且随着代理竞争程度加剧，集中式协调的价值迅速增加。仅在代理拥有显著信息优势时，分布式协调才可能更优，但这种优势会随着竞争加剧而迅速减弱。
AI.research_question: 平台市场中的决策应集中化（由平台控制）还是分散化（由代理控制）？具体而言，平台市场的协调结构（决策权与信息禀赋的组合）如何影响定价决策及平台整体绩效？
AI.motivation: 平台市场与传统企业存在根本性差异：平台依赖众多独立、异质的分散化代理供应服务，这些代理在有限信息下竞争以最大化自身利润。这一结构性转变对平台如何协调分布式参与者提出了关键问题，而现有文献主要基于传统企业情境，需要重新审视集中式与分散式协调的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调结构理论（决策权结构+信息禀赋）；平台治理理论；信息经济学（需求不确定性下的信息获取与共享）；竞争理论
AI.method: 基于代理的数学模型建模：构建平台与竞争性代理间的定价模型，引入需求不确定性，刻画多维信息禀赋（局部与总体信息、信息获取与共享能力、平台与代理的不可转移专属知识），比较集中式与分散式协调结构的绩效。
AI.findings: （1）集中式协调结构在平台市场中占主导地位，推翻了传统企业文献的结论；（2）集中式协调的价值随代理竞争程度快速增加；（3）当代理拥有显著信息优势时，分布式协调可胜过集中式协调，但这一优势随竞争加剧迅速减弱；（4）集中式协调能更有效地利用信息来强化协调并最大化利润。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将协调结构概念化（决策权+信息禀赋的组合），为平台治理研究提供分析框架；（2）揭示平台市场与传统企业在集中-分散协调有效性上的根本差异，丰富和修正了传统组织理论在平台情境下的适用性；（3）识别代理竞争作为集中式协调价值的关键调节变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供定价决策集中化/分散化的指导原则：在竞争激烈时更应集中定价权；当代理掌握独特信息优势时可适当下放，但需警惕竞争加剧带来的优势衰减。

title: Eighteen Frameworks, No Evidence A Systematic Multivocal Review of Enterprise AI use-case Prioritization

detail.title: Eighteen Frameworks, No Evidence A Systematic Multivocal Review of Enterprise AI use-case Prioritization
detail.abstract: Selecting which use cases to pursue is among the most consequential decisions in enterprise artificial intelligence, yet the guidance that shapes this decision in practice has never been examined systematically. This paper reports a systematic multivocal review of the publicly accessible use-case prioritization frameworks published by the organizations that dominate enterprise AI discourse. Eighteen framework artifacts from model vendors, cloud vendors, analysts, consultancies, and boutique experts (including OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Gartner, McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte, EY, and PwC) were identified through a documented search protocol and coded against a theory-grounded codebook covering four decision dimensions (value, feasibility, risk, adoptability) and four process disciplines (ownership, portfolio logic, gates and stopping conditions, weighted scoring). Three findings stand out. First, coverage is deeply uneven: value is an explicit criterion in seventeen of eighteen frameworks, but the human dimension of adoption is operationalized in only five, and the question of who owns the initiative in only three. Second, process discipline is scarce: only two artifacts articulate stopping conditions for running initiatives, and eleven specify no scoring method at all. Third, and most striking, not one of the eighteen frameworks presents evidence that its use improves selection outcomes. The paper documents additional quality defects of the guidance ecosystem itself, including a misattributed report and methods gated behind lead-generation forms. The results substantiate, with data, the selection blind spot conjectured in prior work, and they define a concrete agenda: the empirical validation that this entire class of instruments currently lacks.

AI.tldr: 本文对18个由主导企业AI话语权的组织（OpenAI、Google、Microsoft、Gartner、McKinsey、BCG等）公开发布的AI用例优先级排序框架进行了系统性多声部（multivocal）综述，发现这些框架在覆盖度上极不均衡、过程纪律稀少，且没有一个框架提供证据表明其使用能改善选择结果。
AI.research_question: 企业AI用例选择框架在实践中是否有效？这些公开发布的优先级排序框架在多大程度上覆盖了决策的关键维度，并具备科学严谨的过程纪律？
AI.motivation: 选择哪些AI用例加以实施是企业人工智能中最具影响力的决策之一，然而塑造这一决策的指导框架从未被系统性审查过，存在先前研究中所推测的"选择盲区"（selection blind spot）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理论构建的编码手册，涵盖四个决策维度（价值、可行性、风险、可采纳性）和四个过程纪律（所有权、组合逻辑、关卡与停止条件、加权评分）。
AI.method: 系统性的多声部综述（multivocal review）：通过文档化搜索协议识别18个框架工件，来自模型供应商、云供应商、分析师、咨询公司和精品专家，并使用理论驱动的编码手册进行编码。
AI.findings: （1）覆盖深度极不均衡：价值在18个框架中有17个被明确提及，但采纳的人性维度仅5个框架涉及，所有权问题仅3个涉及；（2）过程纪律稀缺：仅2个框架阐明了正在运行的举措的停止条件，11个框架未规定任何评分方法；（3）最引人注目的是，18个框架中没有一个是基于证据表明其使用能改善选择结果的。此外还发现指南生态系统本身存在质量缺陷，包括错误归属的报告和被线索生成表单限制的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 用数据实证了先前研究推测的"选择盲区"；为该类决策工具建立了理论编码框架（四个决策维度+四个过程纪律），可作为未来研究的分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 确定了整个AI用例排序框架类别当前缺乏经验验证的具体议程；揭示了实践中优先级排序指南系统的质量缺陷，呼吁对这些工具进行实证验证。

title: Multimodal Measurement of Cognitive Load in Instructional Videos
affiliations: , Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management, Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management  and University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business

detail.title: Multimodal Measurement of Cognitive Load in Instructional Videos
detail.abstract: Digital learning platforms have become a fundamental interface between learners and educational content, making it critical to understand how platform design shapes learner engagement and performance. This study investigates how video and instructor characteristics, cognitive load, and learner behavior interact to influence engagement and academic outcomes in online learning environments. We develop a multimodal, theory-guided pipeline that measures cognitive load directly from instructional video content, extracting visual, auditory, and textual features and mapping them to intrinsic, extraneous, and germane load. Applying this pipeline to a unique large-scale dataset from Outlier.org, spanning over 1,200 instructional videos and more than 14,000 learners across 14 subjects, we examine how different components of cognitive demand relate to learner engagement and performance. Our results show that while learners exhibit demographic preferences in instructor selection, these preferences do not reliably translate into better performance; instead, content-based cognitive load, measured directly from video, is a robust indicator of engagement and learning, highlighting the potential for real-time, AI-driven interventions to provide adaptive scaffolding. Our findings offer actionable insights for platform designers and educators, advocating for dynamic, modular video content and behavior-aware personalization to enhance learning outcomes at scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个多模态、理论驱动的分析流程，直接从教学视频内容中测量认知负荷（内在、外在、相关负荷），并利用Outlier.org平台超过1,200个教学视频和14,000多名学习者的独特大规模数据集，检验认知负荷与学习者参与度和学业表现之间的关系。研究发现，学习者对讲师存在人口统计学偏好，但这些偏好并不能可靠地转化为更好的表现；相反，从视频中直接测量的基于内容的认知负荷才是参与度和学习的稳健指标，凸显了实时AI驱动干预提供自适应支持的潜力。
AI.research_question: 在线学习环境中，视频和讲师特征、认知负荷和学习者行为如何相互作用，从而影响学习者的参与度和学业成果？
AI.motivation: 数字学习平台已成为学习者和教育内容之间的基本界面，理解平台设计如何塑造学习者参与度和表现至关重要。然而，已有研究缺乏直接从教学视频内容中衡量认知负荷的系统性方法，也不清楚认知负荷、讲师特征与学习成果之间的确切关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论（Cognitive Load Theory），区分内在负荷（intrinsic load）、外在负荷（extraneous load）和相关负荷（germane load）三种认知需求类型。
AI.method: 开发多模态、理论驱动的分析流程，从教学视频中提取视觉、听觉和文本特征，将其映射到内在、外在和相关认知负荷；应用于Outlier.org的大规模数据集（1,200+教学视频，14,000+学习者，14个学科），分析认知负荷各成分与学习者参与度和表现的关系。
AI.findings: （1）学习者在讲师选择上表现出人口统计学偏好，但这些偏好并不能可靠地转化为更好的学业表现；（2）从视频中直接测量的基于内容的认知负荷是参与度和学习效果的稳健指标；（3）认知负荷测量可用于实时AI驱动的干预，提供自适应学习支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知负荷理论从实验环境扩展到大规模真实在线学习场景，提供了一种可操作化的理论度量方法，实现了对内在、外在和相关认知负荷的直接测量而非自我报告，推进了认知负荷理论的实证应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者和教育者提供可操作的见解：（1）倡导动态、模块化的视频内容设计；（2）支持行为感知的个性化推荐；（3）提出实时AI驱动干预框架，实现自适应脚手架，从而在规模上提升学习成果。

title: Synthetic Hegemony: Generative AI and the Democratic Risks of Language Infrastructure

detail.title: Synthetic Hegemony: Generative AI and the Democratic Risks of Language Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial or personal.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual article involving no human subjects or participants. A separately planned empirical study will be contingent on institutional review board (IRB) approval.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This article introduces hybrid barbarism as a concept with two co-present modalities and theorizes their convergence under generative artificial intelligence. Hybrid barbarism is a persistent public-sphere pathology in which algorithmic infrastructures amplify emotive tribalism while the civic norms of shared inquiry atrophy. Platformized media sediment a distribution modality (HB-D) that rewards circulation; language-synthesis systems add a generation modality (HB-S) that assembles plausibility at the moment of production. Their interlocking generation–distribution–re-generation loop erodes shared facts, blurs provenance, and overloads institutions designed for fixed objects and stable authorship. I identify three mechanisms distinctive to HB-S — epistemic delegation, synthetic neutrality, and authorlessness — and specify the boundary conditions under which each becomes pathological rather than benign or even corrective. Reading three democratic contexts (the United States and Brazil; South Korea; Hungary and Turkey) through the framework, I derive three strategic manifestations — epistemic fragmentation, institutional sabotage, and systemic control — and state the conditions that select among them. Against approaches that merely police “bad content,” I argue for a Democratic Epistemic Infrastructure: public-interest language models with auditable lineage, civic AI literacy that restores critical distance, and risk-based provenance and audit regimes in high-stakes domains. The article is a concept paper; the case readings are advanced as derived expectations rather than demonstrated findings, and a separate preregistered empirical study is designed to render the claims falsifiable and cumulative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"混合蛮族主义"（hybrid barbarism）概念，将其界定为公共领域中算法基础设施放大情感部落主义、同时公民共同探究规范萎缩的持续性病理。文章区分了平台化媒体沉淀的"分发模态"（HB-D）与语言合成系统带来的"生成模态"（HB-S），并认为在生成式人工智能下两者相互交锁形成"生成—分发—再生成"循环，侵蚀共享事实、模糊出处并使制度过载。文章识别HB-S的三个独特机制（认知委托、合成中立性、无作者性），通过美国/巴西、韩国、匈牙利/土耳其三个民主情境推演出三种战略表现（认知碎片化、制度破坏、系统性控制），最终提出"民主认识论基础设施"作为应对方案。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何使公共领域中的"混合蛮族主义"病理发生质变？HB-S（生成模态）区别于HB-D（分发模态）的独特机制是什么？这些机制在何种边界条件下从良性转为病理性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于"坏内容"治理（如虚假信息清理），未能捕捉生成式AI带来的结构性变化——即语言模型在生产端就具备组装"可信度"的能力，而非仅在分发端放大传播。这种生成与分发的交锁构成了新的公共领域病理，需要新的概念化框架加以理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共领域理论；算法基础设施与平台化媒体理论；生成式AI的语言-synthesis理论；部落主义与公民规范的双重性框架。
AI.method: 概念论文（concept paper）方法：通过理论建构提出新概念，结合三个民主情境（美国与巴西、韩国、匈牙利与土耳其）做比较性案例阅读，推导出战略表现类型学。案例阅读为"预期推导"（derived expectations）而非实证发现，另设预注册的实证研究以证伪。
AI.findings: 识别HB-S的三个独特机制：认知委托（epistemic delegation）、合成中立性（synthetic neutrality）与无作者性（authorlessness），并给出各机制从良性/矫正性转化为病理性的边界条件。通过三个情境推演出三种战略表现：认知碎片化（美国/巴西）、制度破坏（韩国）、系统性控制（匈牙利/土耳其）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"混合蛮族主义"这一新概念框架，整合HB-D（分发模态）与HB-S（生成模态）两种模态，将生成式AI对公共领域的威胁从"内容问题"重新概念化为"结构性认识论问题"；建立机制—边界条件—战略表现的递进理论链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"民主认识论基础设施"（Democratic Epistemic Infrastructure）方案：公共利益导向的语言模型与可审计谱系、恢复批判距离的公民AI素养教育、高风险领域的基于风险出处与审计制度——超越单纯"内容管控"的治理路径。

title: Explainable AI Framework for Early Prediction of Cost Overruns in U.S. Mega Infrastructure Projects
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Explainable AI Framework for Early Prediction of Cost Overruns in U.S. Mega Infrastructure Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Large-scale infrastructure projects play a critical role in supporting economic growth, improving transportation systems, enhancing public services, and promoting national competitiveness. Governments in the United States invest hundreds of billions of dollars annually in transportation, water, energy, and public infrastructure projects to address aging assets and meet increasing societal demands. Despite these substantial investments, cost overruns remain one of the most persistent challenges affecting the successful delivery of infrastructure projects.
Cost overruns occur when the actual project cost exceeds the initially approved budget and has been widely reported across various infrastructure sectors worldwide. Studies have shown that transportation, highway, railway, bridge, and public works projects frequently experience significant deviations from planned budgets, resulting in financial losses, delays, reduced project scope, and diminished public confidence. In the United States, cost overruns have become a major concern for government agencies, project owners, contractors, and taxpayers due to their adverse impact on resource allocation and infrastructure development programs.
Numerous factors contribute to cost overruns in mega infrastructure projects. Common causes include scope changes, design modifications, inaccurate cost estimation, inflation, material price volatility, labor shortages, contractor performance issues, unforeseen site conditions, and schedule delays. The increasing complexity of modern infrastructure projects further amplifies the uncertainty associated with project execution, making accurate cost forecasting a challenging task for project managers and decision-makers.

Therefore, this study aims to develop an Explainable AI framework for the early prediction of cost overruns in U.S. mega infrastructure projects. Specifically, the study seeks to compare the predictive performance of several machine learning algorithms, identify the most influential cost overrun drivers, and establish an interpretable early warning system that can assist project stakeholders in mitigating financial risks during project execution.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在开发一个可解释人工智能（XAI）框架，用于美国大型基础设施项目的成本超支早期预测。研究比较了多种机器学习算法的预测性能，识别最具影响力的成本超支驱动因素，并建立可解释的早期预警系统，以帮助项目利益相关者在项目执行过程中降低财务风险。
AI.research_question: 如何利用可解释人工智能框架对美国大型基础设施项目的成本超支进行早期预测？哪些机器学习算法表现最优？哪些因素是成本超支的最关键驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 美国政府在基础设施项目上每年投入数千亿美元，但成本超支仍是影响项目成功交付的最持久挑战之一，导致财务损失、工期延误、项目范围缩减和公众信心下降。现有预测方法缺乏可解释性，难以帮助决策者理解预测依据并及时采取缓解措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习算法与可解释人工智能（Explainable AI）框架
AI.method: 对比多种机器学习算法的预测性能，包括但不限于集成学习方法等；利用可解释性技术（如特征重要性分析）识别成本超支的关键驱动因素；构建可解释的早期预警系统。
AI.findings: 根据摘要，研究目标包括：1）确定最优的机器学习算法用于成本超支预测；2）识别最具影响力的成本超支驱动因素（如范围变更、设计修改、成本估算不准确、通货膨胀、材料价格波动、劳动力短缺等）；3）建立可解释的早期预警系统。具体结果需待论文正文呈现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可解释人工智能引入大型基础设施项目成本超支预测领域，突破了传统"黑箱"机器学习模型无法解释预测结果的局限，推动成本预测从经验判断向数据驱动、可解释的智能化决策转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府机构、项目业主、承包商和纳税人提供可操作的早期预警工具，帮助其在项目执行阶段及时识别财务风险信号，优化资源配置，降低成本超支带来的损失，提升基础设施项目的交付成功率。

title: Productivity of commerce in the time of AI and e-commerce
affiliations: University of Szczecin - Institute of Management and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Productivity of commerce in the time of AI and e-commerce
detail.abstract: The authors analyzed the financial results of 219 retail, wholesale, and e-commerce companies from the US and EU to calculate the productivity of employees, stores and inventories over a 15-year period. The results indicate that the productivity of American companies (retail, wholesale companies, as well as e-commerce) is higher than European companies, and that the productivity of international trading companies is usually higher than that of single-country companies. Employee productivity in wholesale companies is the highest, average in e-commerce, and lowest in retail. The sales volume does not have a significant impact on productivity – only in some sectors the largest firms are also the most productive. Type of business activity is important factor on productivity. The pandemic period had little impact on productivity, revenue, and employment. The implementation of modern technologies does not translate into significant productivity gains, employment reductions, or improved financial results.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了来自美国和欧盟的219家零售、批发和电商公司在15年期间的财务数据，以计算员工、门店和库存的生产率。研究发现美国公司生产率高于欧洲公司，国际贸易公司生产率高于单一国家公司，批发业员工生产率最高、电商居中、零售最低。销售额对生产率无显著影响，业务类型是影响生产率的重要因素，疫情对生产率影响不大，现代技术采用并未带来显著生产率提升。
AI.research_question: 不同国家（美国vs欧洲）、不同行业（零售、批发、电商）和不同业务规模的公司生产率有何差异？影响生产率的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解跨国和跨行业的零售及相关行业生产率差异，为企业和政策制定者提供生产率和效率提升的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率分析理论；规模经济理论；国际贸易理论（国际经营对企业效率的影响）
AI.method: 对219家美国与欧盟零售、批发和电商公司的财务数据进行了15年的纵向分析，计算员工、门店和库存三个维度的生产率，并进行跨国、跨行业及不同规模企业的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）美国公司（零售、批发、电商）的生产率普遍高于欧洲公司；2）国际贸易公司的生产率通常高于单一国家公司；3）员工生产率排序为：批发最高、电商居中、零售最低；4）销售额对生产率无显著影响，仅部分行业中最大企业生产率最高；5）业务活动类型是影响生产率的重要因素；6）疫情对生产率、收入和就业影响甚微；7）现代技术采用未带来显著的生产率提升、就业减少或财务改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 为跨国生产率比较提供了零售、批发和电商行业的实证证据，揭示了行业类型、国际化程度与生产率之间的关系，并质疑了技术投入对生产率必然提升的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了行业间及国家间生产率基准比较，有助于管理者理解不同业务模式的生产率差异，为投资决策和技术采用策略提供参考。

title: Quality Assessment and User Adoption Prediction for Enterprise -Level Financial Reporting Data Products
affiliations: Columbia University, Johns Hopkins University, George Washington University and University of College London

detail.title: Quality Assessment and User Adoption Prediction for Enterprise -Level Financial Reporting Data Products
detail.abstract: Enterprise-level financial reporting data products combine transaction details, accounting accounts, tax dimensions, product definitions, refresh records, and user-access evidence. Existing approaches usually evaluate table-level data quality, analyze financial reports, or predict technology adoption as separate tasks; they rarely connect field semantics, executable validation results, user acceptance testing (UAT) evidence, and post-release behavior through the same traceable field identifier. This paper does not claim a new standalone Sentence-BERT, Great Expectations, LightGBM, or SHAP algorithm. Its contribution lies in a field-keyed integrated workflow for financial reporting delivery, a closed-loop remediation mechanism that maps model outputs to responsible fields and standard operating procedure (SOP) nodes, and empirical deployment evidence from an enterprise reporting environment. The workflow integrates transaction details, product dimensions, accounting accounts, tax fields, user query logs, UAT defect records, refresh records, report-access behavior, and SOP execution records. Sentence-BERT is used to align requirement documents, field descriptions, and UAT feedback; Great Expectations is used to execute dataquality rules; LightGBM estimates the probability of stable user adoption; and SHAP provides model-attribution evidence for release review. The deployment dataset contains 12 financial reporting products, 860 core fields, 2,400 mapping rules, 1,700 UAT feedback entries, 21 months of access logs, 46 million transaction records, 38 rule categories, 12 cross-departmental SOP procedures, and six reporting use cases. Sentence-BERT achieved 91.9% precision in identifying field semantic conflicts, and LightGBM achieved an AUC of 0.936 for adoption prediction. After the standardized workflow was introduced, the observed adoption rate increased from 10% to 80%, monthly active analytical users increased from 34 to 216, duplicate field-definition verification tickets decreased from approximately 145 to 39 per month, average UAT defect-resolution time decreased from 9.2 to 2.8 days, and the delivery cycle decreased from 11 to 5 weeks. These before-and-after changes are descriptive associations rather than causal estimates, because concurrent organizational and process changes may also have contributed. The results indicate that an integrated, traceable evidence chain can support earlier identification of field conflicts, quality defects, and adoption risk while preserving auditability in financial data governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以字段标识符为核心的整合工作流，将交易明细、会计科目、税务维度、用户行为日志、UAT缺陷记录等多元数据源通过统一字段键串联，构建从数据质量验证到用户采纳预测再到发布审查的闭环机制。在包含12个财务报告产品、860个核心字段、4600万条交易记录的企业部署环境中，该工作流将采纳率从10%提升至80%，交付周期从11周缩短至5周。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统一的字段级标识符整合财务报告数据的语义对齐、质量验证、用户采纳预测和发布审查，从而构建端到端可追溯的交付流程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将表级数据质量评估、财务报告分析和用户采纳预测视为独立任务，缺乏通过统一可追溯字段标识符连接字段语义、可执行验证结果、UAT证据和发布后行为的整合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于字段键（field-keyed）的数据治理理论框架，整合语义对齐、数据质量验证、机器学习采纳预测和可解释性归因分析。
AI.method: 整合工作流：Sentence-BERT用于字段语义冲突识别，Great Expectations执行数据质量规则，LightGBM预测用户稳定采纳概率，SHAP提供模型归因证据支持发布审查；采用前后对照的部署实证方法。
AI.findings: Sentence-BERT在字段语义冲突识别中达到91.9%精确率；LightGBM采纳预测AUC为0.936；标准化工作流引入后采纳率从10%升至80%，月活跃分析用户从34增至216，重复字段定义验证工单从每月约145降至39，UAT缺陷解决时间从9.2天降至2.8天，交付周期从11周降至5周。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出字段级可追溯证据链的整合框架，填补了将语义对齐、质量验证、采纳预测和发布审查统一于同一标识符体系的理论空白；提出闭环修复机制将模型输出映射到具体责任字段和SOP节点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业财务数据治理提供了可复用的整合工作流范式，显著缩短交付周期、降低缺陷工单量、提升用户采纳率，同时保持审计可追溯性。

title: Blockage Early Warning and Financial Impact Quantification in the Monthly Closing Process of Fintech Companies
affiliations: Columbia University, George Washington University, University of College London and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: Blockage Early Warning and Financial Impact Quantification in the Monthly Closing Process of Fintech Companies
detail.abstract: For fintech companies, the monthly closing process includes several key phases, such as the release of trading, the updating of data, the distribution of profit and loss, the creation of journal entries, and the delivery of financial statements. In a high-volume transaction environment, data delays, inadequate journal entry, P&L allocation anomalies, and system task failures can easily lead to closure bottlenecks and impact on the timeliness of financial report.This study is a terminal process as a task-dependent network and provides a model for early warning of blockage closure and quantification of financial effects, utilizing a closure schedule, task completion times, transaction data update status, system fault log, journal entry evidence, P&L assignment rules, and monthly review records as core variables.The study uses a Temporal Fusion Transformer to predict the risk of task delay over the next 24 to 72 hours, using a Bayesian network to model conditional dependencies among data updates, system task failures, missing journal entries, and cross-team responses, and a combination of Random Forest algorithms to evaluate the severity of the effects of an unusual event on the closing time and the delivery of the financial statement.The experimental data set includes 36 months of closure period, 420 closing task nodes, 2,800 system exception records, 35 million transaction details, 18 types of P&L assignment rules, 7 600 journal entries, and 12 closing impact scenarios. In the observational pre-and post-deployment comparison, implementation of the joint model was associated with a decrease in blockage localization time from 31.0 h to 6.5 h. High-risk tasks could be marked 1 to 3 days in advance; the monthly number of journal entry documents requiring manual consolidation decreased from about 220 to 78; and annual repetitive journal entry processing time decreased by more than 350 h. Because the comparison was not randomized, these operational changes are interpreted as deployment-associated outcomes rather than controlled causal effects. The Bayesian network has identified three main blocking paths: data refresh delay, system task failure, and P&L assignment rule anomaly. The Random Forest achieves an accuracy of 90.9% for the identification of events with high financial effects.This study converts the monthly closure from a linear task list into a predictable process risk net, which allows the financial group to identify the source of the blockage, evaluate the extent of the impact, and prepare a journal entry document prior to the closure. The findings can increase the timeliness of financial reporting, the effectiveness of close cooperation, and the availability of data for management analysis by fintech firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对金融科技公司月度结账流程中的瓶颈问题，将结账终程建模为任务依赖网络，结合Temporal Fusion Transformer预测任务延迟风险、贝叶斯网络建模条件依赖关系、随机森林评估异常事件影响严重程度，构建了结账堵塞预警与财务影响量化模型。基于36个月结账期间、420个结账任务节点等大规模数据，部署后堵塞定位时间从31小时降至6.5小时，高风险任务可提前1-3天标记。
AI.research_question: 如何将金融科技公司的月度结账流程从线性任务列表转化为可预测的过程风险网络，以实现结账堵塞的早期预警和财务影响的量化评估？
AI.motivation: 在高交易量环境下，金融科技公司的月度结账面临数据延迟、日记账分录不足、损益分配异常和系统任务失败等问题，导致结账瓶颈和财务报告及时性受损，亟需有效的预警和影响量化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务依赖网络理论、贝叶斯网络（条件依赖建模）、Temporal Fusion Transformer（时序预测）、随机森林（影响严重性评估）
AI.method: 本研究采用混合模型方法：(1) Temporal Fusion Transformer预测未来24-72小时任务延迟风险；(2) 贝叶斯网络建模数据更新、系统任务失败、缺失日记账分录和跨团队响应之间的条件依赖关系；(3) 随机森林算法评估异常事件对结账时间和财务报表交付的影响严重程度。
AI.findings: 部署联合模型后，堵塞定位时间从31.0小时降至6.5小时；高风险任务可提前1-3天标记；每月需人工合并的日记账分录文件从约220份降至78份；年度重复性日记账分录处理时间减少超过350小时。贝叶斯网络识别出三条主要堵塞路径：数据刷新延迟、系统任务失败和损益分配规则异常。随机森林对高财务影响事件识别的准确率达90.9%。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究将月度结账从线性任务列表重新概念化为可预测的过程风险网络，为财务结账流程管理提供了新的理论视角，并通过贝叶斯网络揭示了结账堵塞的关键因果路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 该模型帮助财务团队在结账前识别堵塞源头、评估影响程度并准备日记账分录文件，从而提升金融科技公司财务报告的及时性、结账协作的有效性以及管理分析数据的可用性，显著减少人工处理时间和运营成本。

title: Hiring Less, Keeping More? A Firm-Level Study of Labor Dynamics in AI-Focused Mergers and Acquisitions
affiliations: , Lehigh University, University of Georgia - Department of Management Information Systems and Beijing Foreign Studies University

detail.title: Hiring Less, Keeping More? A Firm-Level Study of Labor Dynamics in AI-Focused Mergers and Acquisitions
detail.abstract: Although the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on labor markets has been extensively studied, the labor consequences of AI-focused mergers and acquisitions (AI-M&As) remain underexplored. AI-M&As represent an external pathway through which firms acquire AI capabilities. It is different from internal AI adoption in that technological transformation arrives together with the organizational turbulence inherent in acquisitions. We use supervised machine learning to identify 3,149 AI-M&As between 2008 and 2023, and estimate their effects using a stacked difference-indifferences design. The results reveal an organizational stabilization effect rather than a mass labor displacement effect. Compared with non-AI-M&As, AI-M&As slow the growth of external hiring by 4.1% and that of employee departure by 5.3%, while total employment growth is statistically similar. The slowdown in departure is driven primarily by voluntary quits, which grow 4.0% more slowly, while involuntary layoffs do not differ significantly across the two groups. These effects are concentrated in entry-level positions on the hiring (-2.8%) and in middle management on departure (-2.3%). Additionally, these effects are strongest in finance, operations, and engineering functions. Overall, the evidence suggests that AI-M&As reorganize internal labor markets toward lower turnover rather than producing job losses as concerned in the separate literatures of AI research and M&A research.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用监督式机器学习识别了2008至2023年间3,149起以人工智能为核心的并购（AI-M&As），并通过堆叠双重差分法发现，AI并购产生的是"组织稳定化效应"而非大规模劳动力替代效应：外部招聘增长放缓4.1%，员工离职增长放缓5.3%，但总体就业增长无显著差异。离职放缓主要由自愿离职驱动，且效应集中在入门级岗位和中层管理岗位。
AI.research_question: 以人工智能为核心的并购（AI-M&As）对劳动力市场产生何种影响？具体而言，AI并购是导致大规模劳动力替代（就业损失），还是通过组织重组带来其他劳动力后果？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI对劳动力市场的影响已被广泛研究，但企业通过并购这一外部途径获取AI能力所带来的劳动力后果尚未被充分探索。AI-M&As不同于内部AI采用，因为技术变革伴随着并购固有的组织动荡同时到来，且AI研究和并购研究两个文献领域分别对就业损失有各自担忧，但两者交叉的AI并购情境缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织稳定化效应理论（organizational stabilization effect）；并购组织动荡与AI技术采纳的交叉理论视角。
AI.method: 使用监督式机器学习（supervised machine learning）识别2008-2023年间3,149起AI并购；采用堆叠双重差分设计（stacked difference-in-differences）估计因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）相比非AI并购，AI并购使外部招聘增长放缓4.1%、员工离职增长放缓5.3%，但总就业增长无显著差异；（2）离职放缓主要由自愿离职驱动（增长放缓4.0%），非自愿裁员无显著差异；（3）效应集中于入门级岗位的招聘（-2.8%）和中层管理的离职（-2.3%）；（4）效应在财务、运营和工程职能中最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI研究和并购研究的独立文献连接起来，揭示AI并购产生的"组织稳定化效应"而非预期中的大规模就业损失，挑战了两个领域中关于AI并购导致劳动力替代的共同担忧。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者理解通过并购获取AI能力时的劳动力影响提供实证依据，表明AI并购更多是重新组织内部劳动力市场、降低流动性，而非造成大规模裁员；有助于并购决策和人力资源规划。

title: Data Quality Monitoring and Intelligent Scheduling Optimization in Financial Data Workflow Automation
affiliations: Columbia University, George Washington University, Johns Hopkins University and University of College London

detail.title: Data Quality Monitoring and Intelligent Scheduling Optimization in Financial Data Workflow Automation
detail.abstract: Many sources of data workflows are available to fintech companies and large-scale digital platforms for financial reporting, audits, tax accounting, operations, etc. Problems such as task failure, field drift, data delay and inconsistencies in data definition can negatively impact monthly closings, report generation and the reliability of audit evidence. This study focuses on data quality monitoring and operational efficiency optimisation for financial data workflow automation, integrating Airflow task logs, SQL execution results, data table refresh status, changes in field distribution, report access records, manual repair records and exception ticket information into a unified monitoring system. LogBERT is used to identify anomalous semantics in task logs, and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test and DBSCAN are employed to detect field distribution drift and abnormal null value patterns; deep reinforcement learning models are introduced to optimise task scheduling priorities and ensure that critical financial reports, audit datasets and operational analysis tasks are completed first under resource constraints. The experimental dataset includes more than 40 Python/Airflow data pipelines, 120 scheduled reporting tasks, 9 source systems, 18 months of workflow logs, 210 million task execution and data quality records, 860 core financial fields, 38 categories of data quality rules, and about 6,500 manual repair records. The results show that LogBERT achieved a classification accuracy of 93.4% for the root causes of task failures; field drift detection issued early warnings an average of 6.8 hours before data anomalies reached downstream reports; and DBSCAN achieved an 89.7% recall rate for identifying abnormal null value combinations. The deep reinforcement learning scheduling strategy reduced the average delay of critical reports by 36.8%, lowered monthly manual inspection tasks from about 1,200 to 430, shortened the average data issue resolution time from 14.2 hours to 4.6 hours, and reduced repetitive manual verification time by 52.1%. Compared with traditional scheduled processing and manual spot checks, this method includes log semantics, field distributions, task priorities and manual remediation feedback in a closed-loop optimisation process to transform financial data workflows from reactive fault handling to proactive quality monitoring and intelligent scheduling. Research has provided support for improving the stability and traceability of financial data workflows to establish a high-quality data foundation for financial reporting, audit support, tax analysis and other data-driven operations by financial technology companies.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个统一的金融数据工作流监控系统，整合Airflow任务日志、SQL执行结果、数据表刷新状态、字段分布变化、报表访问记录、人工修复记录及异常工单等多源数据。采用LogBERT进行任务日志异常语义识别，Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验和DBSCAN检测字段分布漂移及异常空值模式，并引入深度强化学习优化任务调度优先级。实验基于超过40条数据管道、2.1亿条记录的真实场景数据，结果显示该方法在故障根因分类准确率达93.4%，关键报表平均延迟降低36.8%，月度人工检查从1200项降至430项。
AI.research_question: 如何整合多源数据工作流监控信息，利用机器学习方法实现金融数据工作流的主动质量监控与智能调度优化？
AI.motivation: 金融科技公司和大型数字平台的数据工作流面临任务失败、字段漂移、数据延迟和定义不一致等问题，这些问题会负面影响月度结账、报表生成和审计证据可靠性。传统的事后处理和人工抽查方式效率低下，需要向主动质量监控和智能调度转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: LogBERT（基于BERT的日志异常语义识别）；Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验（字段分布漂移检测）；DBSCAN（异常空值模式聚类）；深度强化学习（任务调度优先级的优化）
AI.method: 构建统一的金融数据工作流监控系统，整合多源日志和监控数据。使用LogBERT识别任务日志中的异常语义，KS检验检测字段分布漂移，DBSCAN识别异常空值组合，深度强化学习模型优化任务调度优先级。实验数据包含40+条数据管道、120个定时报表任务、9个源系统、18个月工作流日志和2.1亿条执行与质量记录。
AI.findings: LogBERT对任务失败根因分类准确率达93.4%；字段漂移检测平均提前6.8小时发出预警；DBSCAN对异常空值组合识别的召回率达89.7%；深度强化学习调度策略使关键报表平均延迟降低36.8%，月度人工检查从约1200项降至430项，平均数据问题解决时间从14.2小时缩短至4.6小时，重复人工验证时间减少52.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将日志语义分析、字段分布检测、任务优先级优化与人工修复反馈纳入闭环优化过程，将金融数据工作流从被动故障处理转变为主动质量监控与智能调度，为金融数据工作流的稳定性与可追溯性提供了系统性方法论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技企业的财务报告、审计支持、税务分析等数据驱动运营建立了高质量数据基础，显著减少了人工检查和修复工作量，提高了关键报表的及时性和数据质量监控的自动化水平。
